companies.description_zh: 肺动脉高压（PAH）专科药企，曲前列尼尔产品线多元，包括Tyvaso DPI、Remodulin及Orenitram。2024财年收入28.8亿美元（+24%）。

revenue.note_en: FY2024 revenue USD 9,256M (+8% YoY). Input had USD 9,467M — corrected to actual reported figure.
revenue.note_zh: 2024财年营收92.56亿美元，同比增长8%。原数据94.67亿美元有误，已更正。

rnd_spend.note_en: FY2024 R&D expense USD 686M. Input had USD 698M — corrected.
rnd_spend.note_zh: 2024财年研发费用6.86亿美元。原数据6.98亿美元有误，已更正。

companies.description_en: World's largest animal health company. Origins as Pfizer Animal Health division (1952); spun off as independent public company in February 2013. Portfolio spans vaccines, parasiticides, anti-infectives, and dermatology products for companion animals (~70% of revenue) and livestock. Blockbuster companion-animal dermatology drugs: Apoquel and Cytopoint.
companies.description_zh: 全球最大的动物健康公司。前身为辉瑞动物保健部门（1952年），2013年2月独立上市。产品组合涵盖疫苗、驱寄生虫药、抗感染药及皮肤病产品，面向伴侣动物（约占营收70%）和畜禽。明星产品：犬类皮肤病药物Apoquel和Cytopoint。

revenue.note_en: FY2024 total revenues $16,544M (+4% YoY, +6% local currency); note: prior input revenue of $17,258M and country US were both wrong — Teva is Israeli, revenue was $16.544B in 2024

companies.description_en: World's largest generics company (Israeli HQ), also building branded portfolio; AUSTEDO for tardive dyskinesia, AJOVY for migraine, UZEDY for schizophrenia.
companies.description_zh: 全球最大仿制药企业（总部以色列），同时打造创新品牌药组合：AUSTEDO治疗迟发性运动障碍、AJOVY治疗偏头痛、UZEDY治疗精神分裂症。
companies._note: This entry merged and supersedes duplicate 'teva' entry (id=teva); original 'teva-pharmaceutical' had wrong country (US) and inflated revenue ($17,258M). Authoritative figures from Teva IR.

revenue.note_en: FY2024 total revenues USD 1,557.6 million per Q4/full-year 2024 earnings release (10-K filed)
revenue.note_zh: 2024财年总收入15.576亿美元（依据2024年第四季度及全年业绩公告，10-K已提交）

employees.note_en: 1,800 employees as of December 31, 2024 (2,050 as of December 31, 2025)

companies.description_en: CNS-focused biopharma specializing in addiction and psychiatric disorders. Commercial products: VIVITROL (naltrexone extended-release injection), ARISTADA (aripiprazole lauroxil), LYBALVI (olanzapine/samidorphan). Pipeline lead: ALKS 2680 (alixorexton) for narcolepsy. FY2024 total revenues USD 1.56B.
companies.description_zh: 专注中枢神经系统（CNS）的生物制药公司，聚焦成瘾与精神疾病。已上市产品：VIVITROL（纳曲酮缓释注射剂）、ARISTADA（阿立哌唑月桂酰酯）、LYBALVI（奥氮平/沙米多芬）。管线核心：用于发作性睡病的ALKS 2680。2024财年总收入15.6亿美元。

market_cap.note_en: Market cap $10.40B as of Dec 31, 2024; prior input of $20.02B was the 2025 acquisition premium value

revenue.note_en: FY2024 total revenue $2.759B (+10% YoY, +11% core basis); prior input of $3.247B was incorrect — that figure appears to be a forward/2025 estimate

rnd_spend.note_en: FY2024 R&D expenses $431M; prior input of $500M corrected

employees.note_en: 7,000 employees as of Dec 31, 2024 (per 10-K); prior input of 7,200 slightly overstated

companies.description_en: Precision oncology diagnostics leader with Cologuard (at-home colorectal cancer stool DNA screening) and Oncotype DX (breast/colon/prostate cancer gene expression profiling). FY2024 revenue $2.76B (+10% YoY). Acquired by Abbott in March 2026.
companies.description_zh: 精准肿瘤诊断领军企业，旗下Cologuard（结直肠癌粪便DNA筛查）和Oncotype DX（乳腺/结直肠/前列腺癌基因表达谱）。2024年收入27.6亿美元，2026年3月被雅培收购。

revenue.note_en: FY2024 total revenues US$1,696.9M (+56.7% YoY); product revenues US$1,685.1M; gross margin 60.3%.

companies.description_en: Genetic testing and cell-free DNA diagnostics company with Panorama (NIPT prenatal), Horizon (carrier screening), Signatera (ctDNA cancer MRD) and Prospera (transplant rejection). FY2024 total revenues US$1.70B (+56.7% YoY); Signatera is the fastest-growing franchise.
companies.description_zh: 基因检测与游离DNA诊断公司，产品包括Panorama（无创产前检测）、Horizon（携带者筛查）、Signatera（肿瘤ctDNA微小残留监测）及Prospera（移植排斥）。2024财年总收入17.0亿美元（同比+56.7%）；Signatera为增长最快的业务。

revenue.note_en: Full year 2025 total revenue US$982.0M (+33% YoY from $739.0M in 2024)

companies.description_en: Liquid biopsy pioneer with Guardant360 CDx (comprehensive genomic profiling from blood), Guardant Reveal (MRD for colorectal cancer), and Shield (first FDA-approved blood-based colorectal cancer screening test, 2024). Full year 2025 total revenue reached $982.0M (+33% YoY); FY2024 was $739.0M.
companies.description_zh: 液体活检先驱，产品包括Guardant360 CDx（血液综合基因组分析）、Guardant Reveal（结直肠癌微小残留病灶监测）及Shield（2024年首个FDA批准的血液结直肠癌筛查检测）。2025全年总收入9.82亿美元（同比+33%）；2024年为7.39亿美元。

companies.description_en: Pioneer of PROTAC targeted protein degradation. Vepdegestrant (ARV-471, ER degrader) FDA-approved as VEPPANU in May 2026 — first-ever approved PROTAC drug — for ESR1-mutated ER+/HER2- advanced breast cancer, co-developed with Pfizer. Pipeline: ARV-102 (LRRK2, Parkinson's Ph1), ARV-393 (BCL6, lymphoma), ARV-806 (KRAS G12D).
companies.description_zh: PROTAC靶向蛋白降解技术先驱。首个PROTAC药物VEPPANU（伏佩格斯坦）2026年5月获FDA批准，适用于ESR1突变ER+/HER2-晚期乳腺癌，与辉瑞联合开发。管线含LRRK2/BCL6/KRAS靶点。

companies.description_en: Gene editing company co-founded by Nobel laureate Emmanuelle Charpentier. CASGEVY (exagamglogene autotemcel), co-developed with Vertex, became the world's first approved CRISPR therapy (2023) for sickle cell disease and beta-thalassemia. 2025 Casgevy revenue $116M. Deep pipeline includes in vivo editing and CAR-T programs.
companies.description_zh: 基因编辑公司，由诺贝尔奖得主Emmanuelle Charpentier共同创立。CASGEVY（依沙格迈洛塞尔）为全球首个获批CRISPR疗法（2023年），适用于镰刀型细胞病和输血依赖性地贫。2025年CASGEVY营收1.16亿美元，管线持续扩展。

companies.description_en: Base editing pioneer co-founded by David Liu (Broad Institute). Platform enables precise A-to-G or C-to-T single-letter DNA changes without double-strand breaks. Lead program risto-cel (BEACON trial) for sickle cell disease/beta-thalassemia. Collaborations with Pfizer and Eli Lilly. Cash runway into 2028.
companies.description_zh: 碱基编辑技术先驱，由David Liu教授（博德研究所）共同创立。平台实现单碱基精准修改（无双链DNA断裂）。旗舰项目risto-cel（BEACON试验）针对镰刀型细胞病/地中海贫血，已与辉瑞和礼来合作。
4basebio是一家总部位于英国剑桥的生命科学工具公司，专注于酶促合成DNA（hpDNA）和TruePrime™无引物DNA扩增技术，为基因与细胞疗法及核酸疫苗客户提供高纯度DNA原料。
companies.description_en: 4basebio is a Cambridge-based life sciences tools company producing enzymatically-manufactured hairpin DNA (hpDNA) using its proprietary TruePrime primer-free amplification technology for gene therapy, cell therapy, and nucleic acid vaccine developers. FY2025 revenue grew 81% to £1.7 million with over 125 customers.

sources.title: 4basebio Final Results and Notice of AGM 2025

companies.description_zh: 4SC AG是一家位于德国慕尼黑附近的临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于肿瘤学表观遗传学领域，核心候选药物为resminostat（Kinselby）——一种口服HDAC抑制剂，正在申请欧洲皮肤T细胞淋巴瘤（CTCL）维持治疗上市许可。
companies.description_en: 4SC AG is a clinical-stage German biotech focused on oncology epigenetics. Its lead compound resminostat (Kinselby), an oral HDAC inhibitor, is under EMA review for maintenance treatment of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL). As of H1 2025 the company had negative equity per German GAAP and 13 employees.

companies.description_zh: AB Science是一家总部位于法国巴黎的制药公司，专注于蛋白激酶抑制剂（PKI）的研究、开发和商业化。核心化合物masitinib已获批用于兽医，并在人类癌症（AML、CTCL）、神经退行性疾病（ALS、MS）和病毒性疾病等多种适应症中处于临床开发阶段。
companies.description_en: AB Science is a Paris-based pharma company specialising in protein kinase inhibitors (PKIs). Its lead compound masitinib is approved for veterinary use and in clinical development for AML, CTCL, ALS, MS, and viral diseases. FY2025 net turnover was €1.17 million, all from veterinary medicine marketing.

companies.description_zh: Abingdon Health是一家位于英国约克的横向流（Lateral Flow）检测CDMO公司，为临床、动物健康、植物健康和环境测试客户提供检测开发、制造和监管咨询服务。2025财年（截至2025年6月30日）收入为840万英镑，同比增长40%。
companies.description_en: Abingdon Health is a York-based lateral flow assay CDMO offering development, manufacturing, and regulatory services across clinical diagnostics, animal health, plant health, and environmental testing. FY2025 (year to June 2025) revenue was £8.4 million (+40% YoY).

sources.title: Abingdon Health Final Results Year Ended 30 June 2025

companies.description_zh: Abionyx Pharma是一家位于法国拉贝日的生物制药公司，专注于基于重组apoA-I的HDL模拟疗法，用于治疗心血管代谢疾病、LCAT缺乏症（诺鲁姆病）及脓毒症。旗下子公司IRIS Pharma为眼科领域的CRO。
companies.description_en: Abionyx Pharma is a Labège-based French biotech developing HDL mimetic therapies based on recombinant apoA-I for cardiovascular/metabolic diseases, LCAT deficiency (Norum disease), and sepsis. Subsidiary IRIS Pharma provides CRO services in ophthalmology. Trailing 2025 revenue ~$4.6 million (CRO activity).

companies.description_zh: Abivax是一家总部位于法国巴黎的临床阶段生物技术公司，开发靶向内源性miR-124增强剂机制的创新疗法。核心候选药物obefazimod（ABX464）已完成溃疡性结肠炎两项Phase 3诱导试验（ABTECT-1/2均达主要终点），正在进行维持试验及克罗恩病Phase 2b研究，NDA预计2026年Q4提交。
companies.description_en: Abivax is a Paris-based clinical-stage biotech developing obefazimod (ABX464), a first-in-class oral miR-124 enhancer. Phase 3 ABTECT induction trials in ulcerative colitis met primary endpoints; maintenance trial readout expected late Q2 2026 with NDA submission targeted Q4 2026. FY2025 R&D expenses €177.8 million; cash €530 million.

companies.description_zh: Abliva（前身NeuroVive Pharmaceutical）是一家瑞典隆德的临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于原发性线粒体疾病治疗药物开发。核心候选药物KL1333正在进行关键性临床试验（FALCON研究，2024年中期分析结果阳性）。2025年2月，Pharming Technologies完成收购约92.7%股权，公司已于2025年3月从Nasdaq Stockholm摘牌。
companies.description_en: Abliva (formerly NeuroVive Pharmaceutical) is a Lund-based Swedish biotech developing treatments for primary mitochondrial diseases. Its lead compound KL1333 is in a pivotal clinical trial (FALCON study with positive interim analysis in July 2024). Pharming Technologies acquired ~92.7% in February 2025; shares delisted from Nasdaq Stockholm in March 2025.

sources.title: Pharming Increases Ownership in Abliva to 92.70%

companies.description_zh: Acticor Biotech是INSERM的分拆公司，开发靶向血小板GPVI受体的人源化单抗片段glenzocimab，用于急性缺血性卒中治疗。Phase 2/3 ACTISAVE试验结果未达主要终点，公司于2025年1月2日被巴黎商业法院宣布进入清算程序。
companies.description_en: Acticor Biotech was an INSERM spin-off developing glenzocimab, a humanised anti-GPVI antibody fragment for acute ischaemic stroke. The Phase 2/3 ACTISAVE trial did not meet its primary endpoint. The Paris Commercial Court declared the company in liquidation proceedings on 2 January 2025.

companies.description_zh: Active Biotech是一家总部位于瑞典隆德的生物技术公司，开发用于肿瘤和免疫学领域的首创免疫调节疗法。核心管线包括tasquinimod（骨髓纤维化）、laquinimod（非感染性葡萄膜炎）及naptumomab（实体瘤，与NeoTX合作）。
companies.description_en: Active Biotech is a Lund-based Swedish biotech developing first-in-class immunomodulatory treatments for oncology and immunology. Its pipeline includes tasquinimod (myelofibrosis), laquinimod (non-infectious uveitis), and naptumomab (solid tumours, partnered to NeoTX). FY2025 net sales nil; operating loss SEK 37.6 million; cash SEK 65.1 million.

companies.description_zh: Addex Therapeutics是一家瑞士日内瓦的临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于神经系统疾病的变构调节剂（allosteric modulator）小分子药物。2024年4月与Perceptive Advisors共同创建Neurosterix（Addex持股20%）并将大部分员工和研发项目转入Neurosterix，Addex现仅保留mGlu2 PAM等部分资产。
companies.description_en: Addex Therapeutics is a Geneva-based clinical-stage biotech focused on novel small molecule allosteric modulators for neurological disorders. In April 2024, it co-founded Neurosterix with Perceptive Advisors ($63 million raised) and transferred most employees and programs; Addex retains 20% equity in Neurosterix and is rebuilding its in-house pipeline with mGlu2 PAM. FY2025 market cap CHF 12.1 million; cash CHF 1.6 million.

companies.description_zh: Adocia是一家位于法国里昂的临床阶段生物制药公司，专注于糖尿病和肥胖症创新解决方案的研发，拥有BioChaperone®技术平台。核心产品BioChaperone® Lispro（超速效胰岛素）已在中国完成1型和2型糖尿病Phase 3试验并获阳性结果，另有AdoXLong™和AdOral®多个平台。
companies.description_en: Adocia is a Lyon-based clinical-stage biopharma focused on diabetes and obesity therapies. Its BioChaperone® Lispro (ultra-rapid insulin) achieved positive Phase 3 results in 1,500 patients in China. FY2025 revenue €1.5 million (feasibility study fees); net loss €16.6 million; ~80 employees.

companies.description_zh: AegirBio AB于2024年7月更名为Magnasense AB，是一家总部位于瑞典卢德（Lund）的精准医学诊断公司，专注于生物制剂治疗的治疗药物监测（TDM）。2025年11月完成对Subgen AI的反向并购，更名为Subgen AI AB。
companies.description_en: AegirBio AB rebranded to Magnasense AB in July 2024 and focuses on therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) of biologics for autoimmune, oncology, and neurology. The company completed a reverse takeover of Subgen AI in November 2025 and changed its name to Subgen AI AB. Headquartered in Lund, listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market.

sources.title: Magnasense (AegirBio) Acquires LifeAssays and Abreos Bioscience

companies.description_zh: Aelis Farma是一家总部位于法国波尔多的临床阶段生物制药公司，专注于开发内源性大麻素系统CB1受体信号特异性抑制剂（CB1-SSi）。核心候选药物AEF0117已完成Phase 2b大麻使用障碍（CUD）研究（未达主要终点，但部分子组显示统计学意义）。
companies.description_en: Aelis Farma is a Bordeaux-based clinical-stage biopharma developing first-in-class CB1 receptor Signaling-Specific inhibitors (CB1-SSi). Lead compound AEF0117 completed a Phase 2b study in cannabis use disorder (did not meet primary endpoint but showed significant cannabinoid reduction in subgroups). Cash position €14 million as of end 2024.

companies.description_zh: Allergy Therapeutics是一家总部位于英国沃辛的专业医药集团，从事过敏性疾病的诊断和免疫治疗，提供无铝佐剂过敏疫苗和诊断产品，产品覆盖草、花粉、尘螨、草本植物及毒液过敏。
companies.description_en: Allergy Therapeutics is a Worthing-based specialty pharma group developing allergen-specific immunotherapy (AIT) products including aluminium-free allergy vaccines and diagnostics. FY2025 (year to June 2025) revenue £55 million; 584 employees; key products include Pollinex Quattro, Oralvac, Venomil, Acarovac Plus.

companies.description_zh: Alligator Bioscience是一家总部位于瑞典隆德的临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于肿瘤导向免疫肿瘤学抗体药物开发，以CD40激动剂mitazalimab和4-1BB激动剂ATOR-1017为核心管线。Mitazalimab正在准备进入Phase 3（转移性胰腺癌）。2024年末完成重大裁员（约70%员工），现仅剩约11人。
companies.description_en: Alligator Bioscience is a Lund-based clinical-stage immuno-oncology biotech developing mitazalimab (CD40 agonist, preparing Phase 3 in pancreatic cancer) and ATOR-1017 (4-1BB agonist). After a ~70% workforce reduction in late 2024, the company retains ~11 employees. FY2025 net sales SEK 0.5 million; operating loss SEK 105.8 million; cash SEK 62.2 million.

companies.description_zh: Alvotech是一家总部位于冰岛雷克雅未克、在爱尔兰注册的全球生物类似药公司，在Nasdaq上市。核心产品包括阿达木单抗（Humira）生物类似药（美国商品名SIMLANDI，欧洲名HUKYNDRA）和乌司奴单抗（Stelara）生物类似药，同时拥有多条在研管线。2025年全年收入5.93亿美元（同比增长21%）。
companies.description_en: Alvotech is a Reykjavik-headquartered (Ireland-incorporated) global biosimilar company listed on Nasdaq. Key approved products: adalimumab biosimilar (SIMLANDI/HUKYNDRA) and ustekinumab biosimilar. FY2025 total revenue $593 million (+21% YoY); adjusted EBITDA $137 million; 1,032 employees. Also listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (since May 2025).

sources.title: Alvotech Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: AlzeCure Pharma是一家总部位于瑞典胡丁厄（Karolinska Institutet附近）的生物技术公司，专注于阿尔茨海默病和疼痛领域的神经系统药物开发。核心候选药物NeuroRestore ACD856（TrkA激动剂，用于阿尔茨海默病）已获欧洲创新委员会250万欧元资助，Phase II研究正在准备中。
companies.description_en: AlzeCure Pharma is a Huddinge-based Swedish biotech (near Karolinska Institutet) developing CNS drugs for Alzheimer's disease and pain. Lead compound ACD856 (TrkA agonist) received a €2.5 million EIC grant; new Phase Ib trial initiated in 2025. FY2025 annual report published April 2026; funded by oversubscribed rights issue of SEK 58.5 million.

companies.description_zh: Alzinova是一家总部位于瑞典哥德堡（哥德堡大学分拆）的临床阶段生物制药公司，基于AβCC肽技术开发精准靶向毒性淀粉样β寡聚体的阿尔茨海默病治疗性疫苗ALZ-101，已获FDA快速通道资格。公司正准备启动Phase II研究，2026年Q1通过增发筹资约3650万瑞典克朗。
companies.description_en: Alzinova is a Gothenburg-based clinical-stage Swedish biotech developing ALZ-101, a therapeutic vaccine targeting toxic amyloid-beta oligomers using its patented AβCC peptide technology. FDA Fast Track designation granted. Phase II study preparation underway. Rights issue in Q1 2026 raised approximately SEK 36.5 million; financing for 2026 not fully secured.

sources.title: Alzinova on Financing and Phase II with ALZ-101

companies.description_zh: CelLBxHealth（原ANGLE plc）是一家精准液体活检公司，专注于循环肿瘤细胞（CTC）情报服务。其Parsortix® PC1平台通过专利微流控技术从全血中富集并回收完整CTC，支持下游蛋白质组学和基因组学分析。公司于2025年10月从AIM:AGL更名并更换股票代码为AIM:CLBX。
companies.description_en: CelLBxHealth plc (formerly ANGLE plc) is a precision CTC intelligence company whose Parsortix® PC1 microfluidic platform harvests intact circulating tumour cells from patient blood for downstream proteomic and genomic analysis. The company rebranded in October 2025 to reflect its sharpened focus on pharmaceutical services and clinical diagnostics. Products are CE-marked and FDA-cleared for use in metastatic breast cancer research.

sources.title: ANGLE rebrands as CelLBxHealth – Proactive Investors

companies.description_zh: 安耐辛制药是一家瑞典临床阶段生物技术公司，开发以人重组蛋白Annexin A5（ANXV）为核心的药物，靶向血管损伤与炎症，适应症包括视网膜静脉阻塞（RVO）及心血管疾病。ANXV已获FDA批准开展II期RVO临床试验。
companies.description_en: Annexin Pharmaceuticals AB is a clinical-stage Swedish biotech developing ANXV, a human recombinant Annexin A5 protein for vascular injury and inflammation. The lead program targets retinal vein occlusion (Phase 2 FDA-approved) and cardiovascular indications. The company had 27.4 MSEK cash at year-end 2025 after a 50 MSEK rights issue.

companies.description_zh: 阿庞蒂斯制药专注于单片复方制剂（Single Pills），将两到三种通用活性成分合并为一粒药片，主要针对心血管疾病（高血压、高脂血症、二级预防）、呼吸系统疾病及糖尿病。2024年11月，公司已成为Zentiva AG的全资子公司并计划退市。
companies.description_en: Apontis Pharma AG specialises in single-pill combination products that merge two to three generic active ingredients for cardiovascular, respiratory and metabolic indications in Germany. The company was acquired by Zentiva AG in November 2024 (mandatory offer at EUR 10.40/share) and a squeeze-out is planned; the company continues to operate and file reports as of mid-2025.

sources.title: Apontis Pharma 2024 Financial Year – EQS News

companies.description_zh: 北极生物科学开发基于海洋生物活性化合物（鲱鱼鱼卵提取物）的药品和营养保健品。核心药物候选HRO350是一种口服小分子，处于轻中度牛皮癣的临床开发阶段；同时商业化销售ROMEGA品牌海洋脂质营养保健产品。
companies.description_en: Arctic Bioscience AS develops pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products based on bioactive marine lipids extracted from herring roe and algae. Lead drug candidate HRO350 (oral small molecule) targets mild-to-moderate psoriasis. The company also commercialises ROMEGA-branded nutraceuticals; US market accounted for 33% of 2025 revenues.

companies.description_zh: 阿雷科尔治疗利用其专有Arestat®技术平台开发改良剂型药物，核心管线是AT278——全球唯一超浓缩（500U/mL）超速效胰岛素，专为自动胰岛素输送系统（AID）设计，正在与Sequel Med Tech联合开发并推进II期试验。此外公司运营口服多肽递送平台，通过与大型药企的合作产生授权前收入。
companies.description_en: Arecor Therapeutics plc applies its proprietary Arestat® technology platform to develop enhanced formulations of existing therapeutics. Lead asset AT278 is the only ultra-concentrated (500U/mL) ultra-rapid-acting insulin for automated insulin delivery, being co-developed with Sequel Med Tech with positive FDA feedback. The company also operates an oral peptide delivery platform and secured $11M royalty financing from Ligand Pharmaceuticals in 2025.

companies.description_zh: 阿斯塞利亚制药是一家瑞典临床阶段肿瘤药物公司，拥有两条管线：Orviglance（氯化锰）是用于肾功能受损患者肝脏MRI检查的口服造影剂，NDA已向FDA提交（PDUFA 2026年7月）；Oncoral是一种口服伊立替康片，用于难治性肿瘤。
companies.description_en: Ascelia Pharma AB is a Swedish clinical-stage oncology company. Lead asset Orviglance (manganese chloride tetrahydrate) is an oral MRI contrast agent for liver lesion detection in renally impaired patients; NDA submitted to FDA with PDUFA date in July 2026. Second programme Oncoral is an oral irinotecan tablet with improved tolerability. Company cash was SEK 49.9M at end of 2025.

sources.title: Ascelia Pharma Annual Trading Report 2025 – Nasdaq

companies.description_zh: 欧图勒斯治疗是由伦敦大学学院（UCL）孵化的早期商业化CAR-T细胞治疗公司，旗舰产品AUCATZYL®（obecabtagene autoleucel，obe-cel）已于2024年11月获FDA批准，用于复发/难治性B细胞前体急性淋巴细胞白血病（B-ALL）。2025年全年产品收入7430万美元，并已获欧盟及英国MHRA有条件批准。
companies.description_en: Autolus Therapeutics PLC (UCL spinout, 2014) is an early commercial-stage biopharma company manufacturing next-generation programmed T cell therapies. Its flagship AUCATZYL® (obe-cel) received FDA approval in November 2024 for adult r/r B-cell precursor ALL. 2025 net product revenue was $74.3M with 60+ activated US treatment centers. AUCATZYL also received EC and UK MHRA conditional approvals. Manufacturing facility in Stevenage, UK.

sources.title: Autolus Q4 & Full Year 2025 Results – GlobeNewswire

companies.description_zh: 阿瓦克塔集团是一家临床阶段生物制药公司，利用专有pre|CISION®肿瘤微环境激活药物释放平台及Affimer®蛋白技术开发创新肿瘤药物。核心候选药物AVA6000（FAP-Dox）是靶向FAP的多柔比星肽药物偶联物，已进入Ib期多肿瘤临床试验并在ESMO 2025上公布数据。
companies.description_en: Avacta Group plc is a UK clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing tumour-microenvironment-activated cancer therapies using its proprietary pre|CISION® peptide conjugate platform and Affimer® protein scaffolds. Lead candidate AVA6000 (FAP-Dox) is a FAP-targeted doxorubicin peptide drug conjugate in Phase 1b multi-indication trials. The diagnostics division was divested in 2025.

sources.title: Avacta Full Year 2025 Preliminary Results – Investegate

companies.description_zh: 百特盾医疗是一家瑞典医疗器械公司，专注于感染预防解决方案。其核心技术BIP（Bactiguard感染防护）是永久结合于医疗器械表面的贵金属薄涂层，可减少导尿管、气管插管、中心静脉导管等医械相关感染。公司同时销售Hydrocyn伤口护理系列产品并推进合作生产模式。
companies.description_en: Bactiguard Holding AB is a Swedish medtech company whose proprietary Bactiguard Infection Protection (BIP) precious-metal nano-coating permanently bonds to medical device surfaces—urinary catheters, ETTs, CVCs, orthopedic implants—to reduce healthcare-associated infections (HAI). The company is transitioning to a partnership/licensing business model. Wound management (Hydrocyn) grew double digits in 2025.

companies.description_zh: 巴塞利亚制药是一家从罗氏分拆（2000年）的瑞士商业化生物制药公司，已上市两款医院品牌产品：Cresemba®（伊曲康唑）用于侵袭性真菌感染，Zevtera®（头孢洛林）用于严重细菌感染。2025年收入2.324亿瑞士法郎，增长11%；公司正推进两项III期临床研究（fosmanogepix、ceftibuten-ledaborbactam）。
companies.description_en: Basilea Pharmaceutica AG (SIX: BSLN; Roche spin-off, 2000) is a commercial-stage Swiss biopharmaceutical company. Marketed products: Cresemba® (isavuconazole, antifungal) and Zevtera® (ceftobiprole, antibacterial). 2025 revenue of CHF 232.4M (+11%), net profit CHF 40.2M, R&D CHF 105.9M funding two Phase 3 programs (fosmanogepix and ceftibuten-ledaborbactam).

companies.description_zh: 拜奥德萨制药是一家临床阶段英国生物制药公司，拥有四条临床管线：eRapa™（纳米技术增强口服雷帕霉素）用于家族性腺瘤性息肉病（FAP）正在推进III期、用于非肌层浸润性膀胱癌（NMIBC）II期已完成入组；tolimidone用于1型糖尿病处于IIa期；MTX240（康伯替尼纳米制剂）用于胃肠道间质瘤（GIST）。公司面临持续融资压力，存在重大持续经营不确定性。
companies.description_en: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals PLC (formerly Midatech Pharma) is a UK clinical-stage company with four programs: eRapa™ (rapamycin nanoparticle) in Phase 3 FAP and completed Phase 2 NMIBC enrolment; tolimidone (Lyn kinase activator) in Phase 2a T1D; MTX240 (in-licensed panobinostat nanoparticle) for GIST. Going-concern risk flagged by auditors for Q3 2026 without additional funding. 2025 net loss £6.38M; cash £8.53M at year-end.

sources.title: Biodexa 2025 20-F Annual Report – SEC via StockTitan

companies.description_zh: 生物萃取公司（Bioextrax AB）是一家瑞典工业生物技术公司，开发和商业化以细菌为原料的生物基材料提取专利工艺，产品包括聚羟基脂肪酸酯（PHA）生物塑料颗粒、有机水解蛋白、角蛋白纤维和生物油，通过向合作伙伴授权技术实现商业化。
companies.description_en: Bioextrax AB is a Swedish industrial biotech company developing and commercialising patented bio-extraction processes to produce polyhydroxyalkanoate (PHA) bioplastics, organic hydrolysed protein, keratin fibers and bio-oils from bacterial biomass. Business model is technology licensing to industrial partners. Revenue is pre-commercial (SEK 757 thousand in 2025) with operating loss SEK 17.8M.

companies.name_zh: 比奥法姆制药（罗马尼亚）
companies.description_zh: 比奥法姆是罗马尼亚最古老的制药公司之一（1921年创立），在布加勒斯特交易所上市（BVB:BIO）。公司生产和销售覆盖多个治疗领域的通用药、OTC产品、食品补充剂、化妆品及医疗设备，其中OTC占59%、食品补充剂占36%、处方药占5%。出口至9个国家，占总销售额约3%。
companies.description_en: Biofarm S.A. (founded 1921) is one of Romania's oldest pharmaceutical manufacturers, producing generics, OTC products, food supplements, cosmetics and medical devices across multiple therapeutic areas. 2024 revenue RON 286.8M (+11.4%); 2025 revenue c. RON 319.3M with net income RON 100.8M (margin 31%). OTC products account for 59% of portfolio, supplements 36%, Rx 5%. Exports to 9 countries.

companies.description_zh: 拜奥芙朗泰拉制药是一家德国皮肤科生物制药公司，主打产品Ameluz®（5-氨基乙酰丙酸凝胶）联合BF-RhodoLED®光动力治疗仪，用于治疗光线性角化病（AK）及表浅性皮肤基底细胞癌。Ameluz在欧盟自2012年上市，美国自2016年上市。2025年集团营收4170万美元（创记录），增长约12%。
companies.description_en: Biofrontera AG is a German dermatology biopharmaceutical company. Its flagship Ameluz® (aminolevulinic acid HCl 10% gel) combined with the BF-RhodoLED® lamp is approved for photodynamic therapy (PDT) of actinic keratoses (AK) and superficial basal cell carcinoma. Ameluz marketed in EU since 2012, US since 2016. Record group revenue $41.7M in 2025 (+12%). Also sells Belixos cosmetic line.

companies.description_zh: 拜奥英文特国际是一家瑞典临床阶段生物技术公司，发现并开发用于肿瘤免疫治疗的首创单克隆抗体。核心候选药物：BI-1808（抗TNFR2）处于T细胞淋巴瘤II期及联合pembrolizumab用于卵巢癌的临床试验；BI-1206（抗FcγRIIB）处于联合rituximab用于非霍奇金淋巴瘤的IIa期。公司同时拥有全集成抗体制造单元，向第三方提供抗体生产服务。
companies.description_en: BioInvent International AB (Lund, Sweden; founded 1996) is a clinical-stage biotech that discovers and develops first-in-class immuno-modulatory antibodies for cancer therapy. Lead programs: BI-1808 (anti-TNFR2) in Phase 2 T-cell lymphoma + pembrolizumab combination for ovarian cancer; BI-1206 (anti-FcγRIIB) in Phase 2a with rituximab for NHL. Revenue SEK 226.5M in 2025 (up from 44.7M in 2024) driven by collaborations and manufacturing services.

companies.description_zh: 拜奥菲提斯是法国临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于老龄化相关疾病的药物开发。核心候选药物BIO101（20-羟基蜕皮激素口服小分子）正在肌少症（Phase 3就绪）、杜氏肌营养不良（DMD，准备I/II期）及严重COVID-19呼吸衰竭（II/III期已完成）等适应症开发中。公司正在亚洲寻求合资伙伴开展肌少症III期试验，2025年财务报告尚未发布（截至2026年5月）。
companies.description_en: Biophytis SA is a French clinical-stage biotech developing therapeutics for age-related diseases. Lead candidate BIO101 (20-hydroxyecdysone, oral small molecule) targets sarcopenia (Phase 3-ready), Duchenne muscular dystrophy (Phase 1/2 pending), severe COVID-19 respiratory failure (Phase 2/3 completed), and obesity (Phase 2 planned). A joint venture in Asia is being created for the global Phase 3 sarcopenia trial. 2025 accounts delayed beyond April 2026 deadline; cash runway extended 4 months via €2M bond facility.

sources.title: Biophytis H1 2025 Results and Strategic Update

companies.description_zh: 博赛内克斯诊断是法国领先的快速诊断检测（RDT/TROD）设计、生产和分销企业，产品线涵盖免疫印迹、分子生物学及即时检验（POC）解决方案，覆盖传染病筛查、诊断及预防。总部位于斯特拉斯堡（Illkirch-Graffenstaden），在10个国家设有直接业务。2025年收入9520万欧元（-6%），净亏损5820万欧元受大额减值拖累。
companies.description_en: Biosynex SA (ticker ALBIO on Euronext Growth Paris; HQ Illkirch-Graffenstaden/Strasbourg) designs, manufactures and distributes rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs/TRODs), immunoblot, molecular biology and POC diagnostics for infectious disease screening and prevention in France and 10 countries internationally. 2025 revenue €95.2M (-6% YoY); net loss €58.2M (widened 34%) due to impairments; ~475 employees.

companies.description_zh: 拜奥维赛斯制药是一家瑞士临床阶段抗菌药物研发公司（2025年2月在SIX交易所IPO，募资7670万瑞士法郎）。核心管线：BV100（静脉注射抗生素）正在开展针对耐碳青霉烯鲍曼不动杆菌（CRAB）引起的HABP/VABP的全球III期RIV-TARGET试验；Alpibectir（GSK合作）用于肺结核处于IIb/c期；BV500（Shionogi合作）用于非结核分枝杆菌（NTM）感染处于临床前研究。
companies.description_en: BioVersys AG (SIX: BIOV; Basel, founded 2008; IPO February 2025, raised CHF 76.7M) is a clinical-stage Swiss antibacterial company. Lead asset BV100 (IV antibiotic) initiated global Phase 3 RIV-TARGET trial for CRAB-caused HABP/VABP with FDA alignment. Alpibectir (partnered with GSK) is in Phase 2b/c for pulmonary TB (NMJ results published; EMA Orphan Designation). BV500 in Shionogi collaboration for NTM. 2025 R&D CHF 16.5M; cash CHF 82.5M.

companies.name_zh: 湖南安邦制药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 湖南省中小型制药企业，主营青霉素类、妇科用药、儿科用药、脑血管药及消化系统药品的研发、生产和销售；约30%员工为残疾人。
companies.description_en: Hunan-based generics manufacturer producing penicillins, gynecological, pediatric, cerebrovascular, and gastrointestinal medicines; welfare enterprise with ~30% disabled employees.

companies.description_zh: 专注病理诊断领域，提供液基细胞学（LBP）、PCR、免疫组化（IHC）及荧光原位杂交（FISH）等肿瘤筛查和诊断产品，并开发AI病理诊断方案。
companies.description_en: Pathology diagnostics company offering LBP liquid-based cytology, PCR, IHC, and FISH product lines for tumor screening and diagnosis; also developing AI-powered cervical cytology analysis.

companies.description_zh: 健康电子和智能硬件制造商，产品涵盖血压计、血氧仪、血糖仪、体温计、雾化器及新冠检测试剂等，通过iHealth品牌面向全球销售。
companies.description_en: Health electronics and smart hardware company manufacturing blood pressure monitors, pulse oximeters, glucose meters, thermometers, and diagnostic test kits; sells globally via the iHealth brand.

companies.description_zh: 全球领先的隐形正畸解决方案提供商，通过Angel Aligner品牌为中国及全球正畸市场提供透明牙套治疗方案，2024年全球案例量约35.9万例。
companies.description_en: Leading clear aligner solution provider; operates the Angel Aligner brand for orthodontic treatment in China and international markets; ~359,400 cases shipped globally in 2024.

sources.title: Angelalign Technology Reports Strong 2024 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 专注化学原料药、制剂、药用辅料及专用中间体的研发生产，优势领域包括心血管制剂、口服头孢菌素原料药、阿法酮酸原料药等，位居中国制药百强。
companies.description_en: API and pharmaceutical preparation manufacturer specializing in cardiovascular generics, oral cephalosporin APIs, alpha-ketoacid APIs, anesthetic APIs, and antiandrogen intermediates; top-200 China pharma company.

companies.name_en: Anhui Huaren Health Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.

companies.description_en: Anhui-based pharmaceutical retail chain operator offering retail chain, centralized procurement, retail services, and e-commerce; sells medicines, health foods, and medical devices.

sources.title: Anhui Huaren Health Pharmaceutical Company Profile

companies.description_zh: 商业化阶段的创新生物制药公司，专注于血液肿瘤和实体瘤的创新药物开发与商业化，核心产品XPOVIO®（塞利尼索/selinexor）已在亚太10个市场获批。
companies.description_en: Commercial-stage R&D-driven biopharmaceutical company focused on hematologic malignancies and solid tumors; XPOVIO® (selinexor) approved in 10 APAC markets; pipeline includes CLDN18.2 ADC (ATG-022) and CD73 inhibitor (ATG-037).

companies.description_en: Domestic endoscope equipment and accessories maker; products include electronic GI endoscopes, ENT scopes, bronchoscopes, and endoscopic consumables; overseas revenue grew 42.7% in 2024.

companies.description_zh: 全球领先的医疗敷料及感控产品供应商，产品包括纱布、绷带、隔离衣、手术帽、鞋套等，销往全球70余个国家和地区，在湖北仙桃拥有六大生产基地。
companies.description_en: Global supplier of wound care and infection control medical products including gauze, bandages, isolation gowns, surgical caps, and shoe covers; products sold in 70+ countries across six continents.

companies.name_zh: 浙江奥翔药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 专注于特色复杂原料药、药用中间体及制剂研发生产，治疗领域涵盖呼吸系统、心血管、抗感染、神经系统、抗肿瘤及妇科，在天台、杭州及扬州设有研发中心。
companies.description_en: R&D-focused API, pharmaceutical intermediate, and finished dosage form manufacturer covering respiratory, cardiovascular, anti-infective, CNS, oncology, and women's health; six R&D centers and two production bases.

companies.description_zh: 研究型制药企业，专注国内高端首仿化学药及生物药研发，重点领域包括消化系统、肿瘤、耐药菌感染及慢性病，旗下拥有众多抗肿瘤靶向药及化疗品种。
companies.description_en: Research-based pharma company focusing on high-end first-to-file generics and biologics; key areas include digestive disease, oncology, drug-resistant infection, and chronic disease; portfolio spans targeted therapy and chemotherapy.

companies.description_en: Taizhou-based specialty API and pharmaceutical intermediate company; offers customized manufacturing and R&D services; exports to Europe, Americas, and Japan.

companies.description_en: Diversified health industry group operating through chemical fiber, medical logistics, medical services, and health management segments; runs hospitals, rehabilitation centers, and pharmaceutical retail chains.

companies.description_zh: 博济医药是领先的一站式CRO/CDMO企业，提供药物和医疗器械全程研发外包服务，涵盖临床前研究、临床研究（新药/新器械注册临床、BE试验、SMO）、数据管理与统计分析、临床药物生产及上市注册服务，总部位于广州天河区智慧城。2025年营收8.69亿元（同比+17.1%），净利润3,049万元。
companies.description_en: Boji Medical Technology is a leading one-stop CRO/CDMO in China providing pre-clinical, clinical (new drug/device registration, BE, SMO), data management, clinical-stage manufacturing, and regulatory submission services. Headquartered in Smart City, Tianhe District, Guangzhou. FY2025 revenue CNY 869 mn (+17.1% YoY); net profit CNY 30.5 mn.

sources.title: About Guangzhou Boji Medical and Biotechnological Co Ltd – Investing.com

companies.name_zh: 博瑞生物医药（苏州）股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 博瑞生物医药（苏州）股份有限公司（SSE科创板：688166）是专注于API、中间体及制剂研发生产的平台型制药企业，产品覆盖抗肿瘤、代谢、免疫抑制、抗病毒、抗感染等多个领域，同时布局GLP-1/GIP双靶点激动剂BGM0504（2型糖尿病/肥胖，III期）等创新药管线。2025年营收12.2亿元（同比-4.6%），净利润5,451万元。
companies.description_en: BrightGene Bio-Medical Technology (SSE STAR: 688166) is a Suzhou-based integrated pharma platform producing API, intermediates, finished formulations and veterinary drugs across oncology, cardiometabolic, antiviral, antifungal, and immunosuppression. Pipeline includes GLP-1/GIP dual agonist BGM0504 (Phase III, obesity/T2D) and long-acting amylin BGM1812. FY2025 revenue CNY 1.22 bn (-4.6% YoY); net profit CNY 54.5 mn.

companies.name_zh: 脑动极光医疗科技有限公司
companies.description_zh: 脑动极光是中国认知障碍数字疗法（DTx）领域的先行者，开发了中国首个获监管批准的认知障碍医疗级DTx产品——脑功能信息管理平台软件系统。产品覆盖血管性疾病、神经退行性疾病相关认知障碍、儿童注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）、抑郁症和诵读困难等适应症。2025年1月于港交所IPO（募资5.83亿港元）。H1 2025营收1.0亿元（同比+92.8%），净亏损1.27亿元。
companies.description_en: BrainAurora Medical Technology (HKEX: 6681; IPO January 2025, raised HK$583 mn) is China's first company to commercialise a medical-grade digital therapeutic (DTx) for cognitive impairment. Its Brain Function Information Management Platform covers vascular cognitive impairment, neurodegenerative conditions, depression, ADHD (children), and dyslexia. H1 2025 revenue CNY 100 mn (+92.8% YoY); net loss CNY 127 mn; 205 hospital customers. CEO resigned citing health reasons in 2025.

sources.title: BrainAurora Medical Technology H1 2025 Results – Simply Wall St
BrainAurora Medical Technology HK$583M IPO – Cooley

companies.name_zh: 博腾股份（北京）生物科技有限公司 / 清石生物科技
companies.description_zh: 清石生物是一家专注于乙型肝炎病毒（HBV）功能性治愈的临床阶段生物技术公司，核心项目为BRII-179（HBV表面抗原治疗性疫苗）与siRNA/核苷酸类药物联合的功能性治愈组合方案（ENSURE、ENRICH、ENHANCE三项2b期研究），同时与Joincare集团达成IP许可交易。2025年营收1,860万元（来自知识产权许可首付款），净亏损2.24亿元（同比减少56%），现金储备19.41亿元（约2.76亿美元）。
companies.description_en: Brii Biosciences (HKEX: 2137) is a clinical-stage biotech pursuing functional cure for chronic HBV infection. Late-stage portfolio: BRII-179 (therapeutic HBV surface antigen vaccine) combined with NAs or siRNAs across three Phase 2b studies (ENSURE, ENRICH, ENHANCE). Launched discovery labs in Beijing and Shanghai with AI partnership. FY2025 revenue CNY 18.6 mn (IP licence upfront payment from Joincare); net loss CNY 224 mn (56% narrower YoY); cash US$276 mn.

sources.title: Brii Biosciences Full Year 2025 Financial Results – PR Newswire

companies.description_en: A leading medical device distribution company in China, engaged in direct sales and distribution of medical devices, and providing hospital SPD (centralized supply processing and distribution) services covering vascular intervention, surgical, and IVD diagnostic products.

companies.name_zh: 科济药业控股有限公司

companies.description_en: A biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative CAR T-cell therapies for hematologic malignancies, solid tumors, and autoimmune diseases. Zevor-cel (CT053) is approved in China for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma; satri-cel (CT041) completed confirmatory Ph2 for gastric cancer.

companies.description_en: A Shanghai Zhangjiang-based full-service CRO/CDMO company providing pharmaceutical research, development and manufacturing services from early discovery to commercial production for chemical and biologic drugs. Reported a net loss in 2024 due to goodwill impairment.

companies.description_en: A Jiaxing-based manufacturer of pharmaceutical intermediates, APIs, and food/feed additives (notably L-carnitine and L-carnitine tartrate) for domestic and international markets. Revenue 333 million CNY in 2024 with an operating loss.

companies.description_en: A Shanghai-based medical technology company specializing in core hardware for superconducting MRI equipment, including RF detectors, superconducting magnets, gradient coils, RF amplifiers, and gradient amplifiers for medical imaging and scientific research.

companies.description_en: Founded in 1966 as Wenzhou No. 3 Pharmaceutical Factory, this Zhejiang-based company produces and sells APIs, injections, capsules, tablets, traditional Chinese medicines, and pharmaceutical intermediates for domestic and international markets. First pharma listed company in Wenzhou (2017).

Engages in biological drug sales, in vitro diagnostic reagents, medical devices, and vaccine academic promotion services, with plans for elderly medical rehabilitation and health e-commerce platforms. Minimal public financial data available.

companies.description_en: Formerly Qianzu Pearl Group, pivoted in 2016 to hospital investment and management. Operates four hospitals in Zhejiang: Jianhua Hospital (Grade 3A), Kanghua Hospital (Grade 2A), Futian Hospital (Grade 2 rehabilitation), and Mingzhu Hospital (Grade 2A). Reported a net loss of RMB 94M in 2024.

companies.description_zh: 伊犁川宁生物技术股份有限公司（SZSE:301301）是四川科伦药业旗下子公司，位于新疆伊宁经济开发区，专注于生物发酵技术与合成生物学产品的研发与产业化。主要产品包括红霉素硫氰酸盐、头孢菌素中间体（7-ACA、7-ADCA）、青霉素中间体（6-APA）、粗品熊去氧胆酸及辅酶Q10菌丝体等。
companies.description_en: Yili Chuanning Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (SZSE:301301) is a subsidiary of Sichuan Kelun Pharmaceutical, headquartered in the Yining Economic Development Zone, Xinjiang. The company specializes in bio-fermentation technology and synthetic biology products, manufacturing antibiotic intermediates (erythromycin thiofluorate, cephalosporin intermediates 7-ACA/7-ADCA/D-7ACA, penicillin intermediates 6-APA), crude ursodeoxycholic acid, and coenzyme Q10 mycelia. 2024 revenue reached CNY 5.76 billion, up 19% YoY.

companies.name_zh: 拨康视云制药有限公司
companies.description_zh: 拨康视云制药（HKEX:2592）是一家临床阶段眼科生物技术公司，聚焦慢性眼病创新药物研发。核心管线包括：CBT-001（翼状胬肉，三期临床）、CBT-004（睑裂斑新生血管化，三期临床）、CBT-009（青少年近视，一/二期）。公司创立于2015年，总部设于杭州，并在香港及美国加州尔湾设有办事处。
companies.description_en: Cloudbreak Pharma (HKEX:2592) is a clinical-stage ophthalmology biotech developing first-in-class and best-in-class ophthalmic drugs using proprietary Multi-Kinase Inhibitors technology. Lead candidates: CBT-001 (pterygium, Phase 3 multi-center; partnered with Santen), CBT-004 (vascularised pinguecula, entering Phase 3), CBT-009 (juvenile myopia, Phase 1/2). Founded 2015, HQ in Hangzhou with offices in Hong Kong and Irvine, CA.

companies.name_zh: 三叶草生物制药有限公司
companies.description_zh: 三叶草生物制药（HKEX:2197）是一家全球临床阶段生物技术公司，成立于2007年，专注疫苗及生物治疗候选药物研发。核心技术为专有Trimer-Tag®重组蛋白表达平台。主要管线包括SCB-2019（新冠疫苗，重组蛋白亚单位）、AdimFlu-S（四价流感疫苗，已商业化）、SCB-1019（RSV疫苗，老年人）及SCB-219M（血小板减少治疗）。总部设于上海，原注册于成都。
companies.description_en: Clover Biopharmaceuticals (HKEX:2197) is a global clinical-stage biotech founded in 2007, leveraging proprietary Trimer-Tag® recombinant protein technology for vaccines and biologics. Key pipeline: SCB-2019 (COVID-19 protein subunit vaccine), AdimFlu-S (quadrivalent influenza vaccine, commercialized), SCB-1019 (RSV vaccine for older adults), SCB-219M (cancer-related thrombocytopenia). FY2024 revenue CNY 38.4M, R&D spend CNY 183.4M. HQ in Shanghai (originally Chengdu).

companies.description_en: China Medical System Holdings (HKEX:0867), founded 1995 in Shenzhen, is a leading specialty pharmaceutical manufacturer and marketer in China. FY2024 revenue CNY 7.47B (-6.8% YoY, impacted by National VBP policy); exclusive and innovative products accounted for 52.8% of revenue. Therapeutic focus: cardio-cerebrovascular (Plendil felodipine, XinHuoSu recombinant BNP), CNS (Deanxit), digestive, dermatology, and ophthalmology. Employs 6,415 people.

companies.name_zh: 上海康耐特光学有限公司
companies.description_zh: 上海康耐特光学（HKEX:2276）成立于1996年，是国内领先的树脂眼镜镜片制造商，产品销往中国大陆、美洲、亚洲、欧洲、大洋洲和非洲。2024年收入人民币20.6亿元（同比增长17.1%），净利润4.28亿元（同比增长31%）。产品涵盖UV++系列、1.74超薄系列、渐进多焦点、防雾及护目镜等。
companies.description_en: Shanghai Conant Optical (HKEX:2276), founded 1996, is a leading Chinese manufacturer of resin spectacle lenses with global distribution across China, Americas, Asia, Europe, Oceania, and Africa. FY2024 revenue CNY 2.06B (+17.1% YoY), net income CNY 428M (+31%). Product lines include UV++ series, 1.74 high-index, single vision, progressive, anti-fog, and specialty lenses. Employs 2,890.

Conant Optical revenue and profit up sharply in 2024

companies.name_zh: 重庆康刻尔制药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 重庆康刻尔制药股份有限公司（NEEQ:874210）成立于1999年，是专注于高端化学糖尿病药物研发、生产和销售的国家级高新技术企业，2023年8月挂牌新三板创新层。核心产品包括度来宁（盐酸二甲双胍微孔渗透泵控释制剂）及利宜平（格列美脲，首仿药）。2024年产品销售收入约1.31亿元。
companies.description_en: Chongqing Kangkeer Pharmaceutical (NEEQ:874210, brand: CONQUER), founded 1999, is a national high-tech enterprise focusing on high-end chemical diabetes drugs. Listed on NEEQ Innovation Layer in August 2023. Core products: Duleningm (microporous osmotic pump metformin controlled-release formulation) and Liyiping (glimepiride, first-generic). FY2024 revenue approximately CNY 131M, up significantly from CNY 26M in the prior period.

companies.name_zh: 康臣药业集团有限公司
companies.description_zh: 康臣药业集团（HKEX:1681）成立于1997年，总部位于广州，是集研发、生产、销售于一体的现代制药企业，2013年于香港联合交易所上市。集团旗下有康臣药业（广州）、广西玉林制药等多家子公司，产品组合涵盖143种药品（62种中成药、81种化学药）。旗舰产品尿毒清颗粒用于慢性肾病，另有益肾化石颗粒、玉林正骨水等。2024年收入约人民币29.7亿元，同比增长约15%。
companies.description_en: Consun Pharmaceutical Group (HKEX:1681), founded 1997 in Guangzhou, is an integrated pharma group listed on HKEX in 2013. The group operates through Consun Pharmaceutical and Yulin Pharmaceutical segments, with 143 medicines (62 TCM, 81 chemical). Flagship: Uremic Clearance Granule for CKD; also Yishen Huashi Granule (kidney stones), Zheng Gu Shui (orthopedics). FY2024 revenue CNY 2.97B (+15% YoY). Employs 3,164.

sources.title: Consun Pharmaceutical Group (HKG:1681) Stock Price & Overview

companies.name_zh: 康芝药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 康芝药业股份有限公司（SZSE:300086）成立于1993年，前身为海南康芝药业，总部现位于广州。公司专注于儿童药品的研发、制造与销售，产品覆盖抗过敏、止泻消化、镇咳、抗流感、退热、抗感染、抗真菌、解热镇痛及内分泌等领域，并经营一次性医疗防护口罩业务。2024年营业收入约4.73亿元。
companies.description_en: Honz Pharmaceutical (SZSE:300086, formerly Hainan Honz Pharmaceutical), founded 1993, HQ in Guangzhou. Focuses on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of pediatric medicines. Products treat anti-anaphylaxis, antidiarrheal, cough relief, anti-flu, antipyretic, anti-infection, anti-fungal, and endocrine conditions; also medical face masks. FY2024 revenue CNY 473M. Employs 659.

companies.name_zh: 嘉事堂药业股份有限公司

market_cap.note_en: Market cap CNY 3.77B as of Dec 31, 2024; prior 3.66B was a mid-year 2024/2025 snapshot

revenue.note_en: FY2024 revenue CNY 24.02B (declined ~20% YoY per filing)

companies.description_zh: 北京嘉事堂药业，1997年成立，在深交所上市，业务涵盖医药批发、零售药房、医疗器械、电商及仓储物流。2024年收入240.2亿元（同比约降20%）。
companies.description_en: Beijing-based pharmaceutical distribution, retail, and logistics company listed on SZSE (002462). Founded 1997. Operations span wholesale, retail pharmacy chains, medical devices, e-commerce, and warehousing. FY2024 revenue CNY 24.0B (declined ~20% YoY).

companies.name_zh: 石药集团欧意药业有限公司（石药集团创新制药股份有限公司）
companies.description_zh: 石药集团创新制药股份有限公司（SZSE:300765）成立于2006年，是石药集团旗下子公司，总部位于石家庄。主营生物制药、功能食品及原料药的研发、生产和销售。核心原料药产品包括咖啡因、阿卡波糖、茶碱等；健康食品主要为国维康维生素系列。另提供生物技术转让和技术咨询服务。2024年收入约人民币19.8亿元（同比降22%），员工2,369人。
companies.description_en: CSPC Innovation Pharmaceutical (SZSE:300765), founded 2006 as a subsidiary of CSPC NBP Pharmaceutical / CSPC Group, Shijiazhuang. Business spans biopharmaceuticals, functional foods, and API production (caffeine, acarbose, theophylline, aminophylline, dyphylline, theobromine, pentoxifylline, doxofylline); health food line under Guoweikang brand (Vitamin C, B vitamin). FY2024 revenue CNY 1.98B (-22% YoY), earnings CNY 53.7M (-88%). Employs 2,369.

sources.title: CSPC Innovation Pharmaceutical (SHE:300765) Stock Price & Overview

companies.name_zh: 科笛生物医药（上海）股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 科笛生物医药（HKEX:2487）成立于2019年，总部位于上海，专注皮肤病生物制药。核心管线覆盖脱发、痤疮、特应性皮炎、局部脂肪积聚及皮肤科局麻等领域。CU-10201（4%盐酸米诺环素泡沫剂）于2025年10月商业化上市，成为全球首个获批的外用米诺环素产品，并于当年实现逾1亿元营收。CU-40102（外用非那雄胺喷雾）、CU-10101（外用小分子特应性皮炎）等在研推进中。
companies.description_en: Cutia Therapeutics (HKEX:2487), founded 2019 in Shanghai, is a dermatology biotech focused on scalp diseases, skin conditions, topical anesthesia, and localized adipose management. Key pipeline: CU-10201 (4% minocycline foam for acne, first-in-class globally, NDA accepted by NMPA, launched commercially Oct 2025 with >CNY 100M revenue); CU-40102 (topical finasteride for AGA); CU-10101 (topical small molecule for atopic dermatitis); CU-20401 (collagenase for submental fat, Phase 2). FY2024 revenue CNY 280M. Employs 304.

companies.name_zh: 湖南大家维康医药产业股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Hunan Dajiaweikang Pharmaceutical Industry Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 湖南大家维康医药产业股份有限公司（SZSE:301126）成立于2002年，总部位于长沙，是专注于抗肿瘤、免疫调节、心脑血管、呼吸、抗病毒等新特药批发配送与DTP专业药房零售的医药流通企业。2024年营业收入人民币52.33亿元，研发支出1,626万元，净利润2,657万元，员工5,339人。
companies.description_en: Hunan Dajiaweikang Pharmaceutical Industry (SZSE:301126), founded 2002 in Changsha, is a pharma distribution and DTP (direct-to-patient) specialty pharmacy operator. Core focus: oncology, immunomodulatory, cardiovascular, respiratory, and antiviral drugs distribution and retail. FY2024 revenue CNY 5.23B, R&D CNY 16.3M, net income CNY 26.6M. Employs 5,339.

sources.title: Hunan Dajiaweikang Pharmaceutical (SHE:301126) Stock Price & Overview

companies.name_zh: 丹娜（天津）生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 丹娜生物（BSE:920009）成立于2014年3月，总部位于天津中新生态城，专注于侵袭性真菌病（IFD）等病原微生物早期快速体外诊断产品的研发、生产、销售及临床应用。旗下产品覆盖真菌检测（曲霉菌、念珠菌、隐球菌等）、传染病（流感、新冠、猴痘、RSV）、胃肠道、生殖系统及耐药检测等。6款真菌检测产品入选WHO全球推荐目录，产品应用于全球超80个国家。
companies.description_en: Dynamiker Biotechnology (BSE Beijing:920009), founded March 2014, HQ in Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-City. Specializes in early rapid IVD for invasive fungal disease (IFD) and other pathogenic microorganisms. Product portfolio: fungal detection (aspergillosis, candidiasis, cryptococcosis, mucormycosis, PCP, talaromyces), infectious disease tests (influenza, COVID-19, monkeypox, RSV), gastrointestinal, reproductive, drug resistance assays, and endotoxin testing. 6 fungal kits on WHO global recommended list; products in 80+ countries. TTM revenue ~USD 32M (2025).

companies.name_zh: 深圳大佛药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 深圳大佛药业股份有限公司（NEEQ:836649）成立于1994年3月，是专注于喷雾剂、鼻喷雾剂及吸入溶液等特殊制剂研发、生产与销售的专科药企。核心产品盐酸羟甲唑林喷雾剂和鲑降钙素鼻喷雾剂，2024年上半年销售同比增长约30%。公司同时覆盖皮肤科、内分泌、心血管等领域。现由杭州云柏医药科技有限公司控股。
companies.description_en: Shenzhen Daphne Pharmaceutical (NEEQ:836649), established March 1994, HQ in Luohu District, Shenzhen; controlled by Hangzhou Yunbai Pharmaceutical Technology. Specializes in special formulations: nasal sprays, inhalation solutions, topical sprays. Key products: oxymetazoline HCl spray (otolaryngology) and salmon calcitonin nasal spray (bone). Also covers dermatology, endocrinology, cardiovascular, respiratory, and obstetrics. H1 2024 saw ~30% growth in core product revenues.

sources.title: 大佛药业 2025年半年度报告
大佛药业 2024年半年度报告 - 东方财富

companies.name_zh: 广州达瑞生物技术股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 广州达瑞生物技术股份有限公司（NEEQ:832705）成立于2003年，2015年7月在新三板挂牌，是国内最早专注分子诊断技术的高新技术企业之一。主营出生缺陷筛查、遗传病、肿瘤早筛诊断及二代测序（NGS）技术与先进免疫诊断产品的研发和制造。总部位于广州科学城，团队逾500人（含博士、研究生等高学历人员超200人）。
companies.description_en: Guangzhou Darui Biotechnology (NEEQ:832705), founded 2003, listed on NEEQ July 2015. One of China's earliest molecular diagnostics high-tech enterprises. Business: birth defect screening, hereditary disease, oncology screening/diagnosis, NGS technology, and advanced immunodiagnostics. HQ in Guangzhou Science City (7,300 sqm R&D center + ISO-certified clean manufacturing). Staff 500+, including 200+ with doctoral/master's degrees.

companies.name_zh: 内蒙古大唐药业股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Inner Mongolia Datang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 内蒙古大唐药业股份有限公司（BSE:836433，亦称内蒙古格兰德药业）位于呼和浩特市如意开发区，生产257种药品，是内蒙古地区重要的制药企业之一，在北京股权交易所挂牌上市。具体财务数据因公开信息有限，尚无法核实。

Produces 257 types of medicines, making it one of the major pharmaceutical companies in the region. Detailed financial data not verifiable from available public sources.

companies.name_en: Ningbo David Medical Device Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 宁波戴维医疗器械股份有限公司（SZSE:300314）成立于1992年，是专注儿科与产科护理设备、微创手术器械研发生产的国家级高新技术企业。核心产品包括婴儿保温箱、转运暖箱、辐射台、新生儿蓝光光疗设备、复苏器、脑功能监测仪及体温管理系统等。产品销往全球140多个国家和地区。2024年营收约5.27亿元，员工920人。
companies.description_en: Ningbo David Medical Device (SZSE:300314), founded 1992, is a national high-tech enterprise in Ningbo specializing in neonatal/obstetric care equipment and minimally invasive surgical instruments. Products (David brand): infant incubators, transport incubators, radiant warmers, bilirubin phototherapy units, resuscitators, neonate monitors, EEG monitors, hypothermia treatment devices, and medical pendants. Sold in 140+ countries. FY2024 revenue CNY 527M, 920 employees.

Ningbo David Medical Device Company Introduction
Ningbo David Medical Device Company History

companies.name_zh: 迪亿医药(控股)有限公司
companies.description_zh: 迪亿医药成立于1995年，总部位于苏州，在香港联交所主板上市（股票代码2348）。公司专注于头孢菌素类抗生素原料药、中间体及制剂的生产，同时布局心血管、抗肝炎、抗过敏、消化系统等系统专属药品，实现从医药中间体到原料药和制剂的全垂直整合。
companies.description_en: Dawnrays Pharmaceutical (Holdings) Limited, founded in December 1995 and listed on HKEX Main Board (2348) since 2003, is a vertically integrated pharmaceutical group headquartered in Suzhou. It is principally engaged in developing, manufacturing and selling cephalosporin antibiotics (APIs and finished drug products) and system-specific medicines spanning cardiovascular, anti-HBV, anti-allergic, digestive, urinary and endocrine therapeutic areas.

companies.name_zh: 四川德博尔生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 四川德博尔生物科技股份有限公司（证券代码：874066）是一家全球领先的生物酶生产与研发专家型企业，总部位于四川广汉小汉镇工业园区，持续通过欧盟GMP及中国GMP认证（自2005年起）。主要产品包括胰酶、胃蛋白酶、胰激肽原酶、弹性蛋白酶、胰蛋白酶、糜蛋白酶及肝素钠等生化原料药，产品出口欧洲、北美、日本、韩国等30多个国家和地区，是赛诺菲、Celltrion、丽珠等国际知名药企的长期合作伙伴。
companies.description_en: Sichuan Deebiotech Co., Ltd. (NEEQ: 874066) is a leading global bio-enzyme production and R&D specialist headquartered in Guanghan, Sichuan. Continuously GMP-certified by the EU and China since 2005, the company manufactures high-activity, high-purity biological enzyme APIs including pancreatin, pepsin, kallikrein, elastase, trypsin, chymotrypsin, and heparin sodium, exporting to 30+ countries and serving partners such as Sanofi, Celltrion, and Lizhu.

sources.title: 德博尔公司介绍 – 东方财富新三板F10

companies.name_zh: 江苏德源药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 江苏德源药业股份有限公司（股票代码：832735）成立于2006年，总部位于连云港经济技术开发区，是北京证券交易所首批上市企业之一。公司专注于代谢性慢性病药物的研发和生产，主要产品涵盖吡格列酮甲福明片、坎地沙坦氢氯噻嗪片、奈格列奈片、二甲双胍缓释片、依帕司他片、阿卡波糖片及西格列汀磷酸盐片等，同时布局吡格列酮盐酸盐、奈格列奈、安立生坦、利拉鲁肽等API。2024年度营业收入8.68亿元，同比增长22.46%，净利润1.77亿元，同比增长28.26%。
companies.description_en: Jiangsu Deyuan Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (BSE: 832735), founded in 2006 and among the first batch of companies listed on the Beijing Stock Exchange (November 2021), is headquartered in Lianyungang Economic and Technological Development Zone. The company focuses on chemical pharmaceutical preparations and APIs for metabolic chronic diseases, with marketed products including pioglitazone-metformin tablets, candesartan-hydrochlorothiazide tablets, nateglinide tablets, metformin extended-release tablets, epalrestat tablets, acarbose tablets, and sitagliptin phosphate tablets. FY2024 revenue reached CNY 868M (+22.46% YoY) with net profit of CNY 177M (+28.26% YoY).

companies.name_zh: 德展健康股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 德展健康股份有限公司成立于1980年，总部位于北京，在深交所上市（股票代码：000813）。公司以心脑血管药物研发、生产和销售为核心，主要品种包括阿托伐他汀钙片、氨氯地平阿托伐他汀钙片、盐酸曲美他嗪胶囊、盐酸胺碘酮片及法昔洛韦、硫唑嘌呤、羟基脲、秋水仙碱等其他药物。此外，公司还涉及生物肽、工业大麻和医疗服务业务。2024年实现营收4.66亿元，研发投入6837万元，净亏损2041万元。
companies.description_en: Dezhan Healthcare Company Limited (SZSE: 000813), founded in 1980 and headquartered in Beijing, engages in the R&D, manufacture, and sale of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular drugs in China. Core products include atorvastatin calcium tablets, amlodipine-atorvastatin calcium tablets, trimetazidine hydrochloride capsules, and amiodarone hydrochloride tablets, plus famciclovir, azathioprine, hydroxyurea, and colchicine. The company also has businesses in biological peptides, industrial hemp, and healthcare services. FY2024 revenue was CNY 466.5M with R&D spend of CNY 68.4M and a net loss of CNY 20.4M.

sources.title: Dezhan Healthcare Company Profile – Yahoo Finance

companies.name_zh: 山东数字人科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 山东数字人科技股份有限公司（股票代码：835670）总部位于济南高新区天辰大道1188号，是一家专注于数字医学教育的软件开发企业。公司依托层图像分割、3D重建和可视化处理技术，研发和推广《中国数字人解剖系统》和《医学形态学数字化教学平台》等产品，面向高校医学师生提供完整的医学教育信息化解决方案。产品已在全国500余所医学院校落地应用，并已在40余个国家开展试点销售。公司持有14项发明专利和69项著作权。
companies.description_en: Shandong Digihuman Technology Co., Ltd. (BSE: 835670), headquartered in the High-tech Zone of Jinan, is a software enterprise specializing in digital medical education. Leveraging proprietary layer image segmentation, 3D reconstruction, and visualization technologies, the company develops the 'Chinese Digital Human Anatomy System' and 'Medical Morphology Digital Teaching Platform,' deployed in 500+ medical schools nationwide and pilot-selling in 40+ countries. The company holds 14 invention patents and 69 copyrights.

sources.title: 山东数字人2024年度报告摘要
山东数字人2024年年度报告

companies.name_zh: 迪瑞医疗科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 迪瑞医疗科技股份有限公司成立于1992年，总部位于长春市高新技术产业开发区宜居路3333号，是国内领先的体外诊断仪器和试剂供应商，产品涵盖尿液分析、生化分析、血细胞分析、化学发光免疫分析、妇科分泌物分析、凝血分析及标准化实验室检测系统，持有545项专利技术，被认定为国家企业技术中心和国家知识产权示范企业。2024年营收9.77亿元，研发投入1.30亿元。
companies.description_en: Dirui Industrial Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 300396), founded in 1992 and headquartered at No.3333 Yiju Road, Changchun High-tech Development Zone, is a leading Chinese IVD company offering complete laboratory solutions across urinalysis, biochemical analysis, blood cell analysis, chemiluminescence immunoassay, gynecological secretion analysis, coagulation analysis, and standard lab testing systems. The company holds 545 patents and is designated a National Enterprise Technology Center. FY2024 revenue was CNY 977.2M with R&D spend of CNY 129.8M.

companies.name_zh: 江苏东星智慧医疗科技股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Jiangsu Canopus Wisdom Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 江苏东星智慧医疗科技股份有限公司（深交所：301290）成立于2001年2月，总部位于江苏省常州市，于2022年11月在深交所创业板上市。公司主营外科手术器械（含直线切割吻合器、管状吻合器及痔疮吻合器等）及外科设备（电动手术床、无影灯、多功能智能手术台等）两大业务板块，同时提供骨科牵引架、妇产科检查床等医疗设备，并开展外科手术器械配件研发与生产。2024年营收4.35亿元，净利润9742万元（毛利率49.37%），研发投入2243万元，员工约700余人。
companies.description_en: Jiangsu Canopus Wisdom Medical Technology Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 301290), founded February 2001 and listed on ChiNext in November 2022, is headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu. The company operates in two segments: (1) surgical instruments—including linear cutting staplers, tubular staplers, and hemorrhoidal staplers; and (2) surgical equipment—electric operating tables, shadowless lamps, and multi-functional intelligent operating tables. It also provides orthopedic traction frames, OB/GYN examination tables, and surgical endoscopes. FY2024 revenue CNY 435.5M, net profit CNY 97.4M, gross margin 49.4%, R&D spend CNY 22.4M.

companies.description_en: Double Medical Technology Inc. (SZSE: 002901), founded 2004 and headquartered in Xiamen, is a leading Chinese orthopedic medical device company. Its diversified portfolio includes spinal implants, trauma devices, dental implants, and neurosurgical and general surgery instruments, exported to approximately 50 countries across the EU, Russia, South America, Australia, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and South Africa. FY2024 revenue CNY 2,135.6M, net profit CNY 357M (+505% YoY), R&D spend CNY 331.2M.

companies.name_zh: 重庆多普泰制药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 重庆多普泰制药股份有限公司（新三板：831057）成立于2004年3月，总部位于重庆市万盛经济技术开发区，是一家集中药研发、生产和销售于一体的综合健康服务企业。核心产品包括麦血康胶囊、麦血康肠溶片、云汀镇痛胶囊等中成药，以及山楂降压茶包、满盈宁茶包、金质咽喉茶等茶袋类国药标准产品，是国内中药茶袋品类的领军企业。2024年营收2.62亿元（同比下降52.15%）；公司已于2024年3月被山西新北林医药收购。
companies.description_en: Chongqing Duoputai Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (NEEQ: 831057), founded in March 2004 in Chongqing's Wansheng Economic and Technological Development Zone, is an integrated TCM health services company engaged in the R&D, production, and sale of Chinese patent medicines. Core products include Maixuekang capsules and enteric-coated tablets, Yunting analgesic capsules, and a range of National Medicine Standard tea bags (hawthorn blood-pressure tea, Manyanning tea bags, Jinzhi throat tea bags). The company is recognized as China's leading manufacturer of pharmaceutical tea bags. FY2024 revenue declined 52.2% to CNY 262.1M; the company was acquired by Shanxi Xin Beilin Medical in March 2024.

companies.description_en: Tibet Duo Rui Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 301075), founded in 2005 and headquartered in Lhasa, Tibet, engages in the R&D, production, and sale of chemical pharmaceutical preparations, intermediates, and APIs. The company's product portfolio covers fluid therapy, anesthesiology medications, analgesics, and emergency rescue drugs. FY2024 revenue CNY 154.2M, net loss CNY 102.2M, R&D spend CNY 32.4M, with 497 employees.

companies.name_zh: 深圳市易瑞生物技术股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 深圳市易瑞生物技术股份有限公司（创业板：300942，上市时间2021年2月）成立于2007年7月，总部位于深圳，是一家专注于食品安全和临床诊断快速检测产品的企业。主要产品涵盖胶体金免疫层析试纸、酶联免疫法（ELISA）试剂盒、核酸提取试剂盒、便携式食品快速分析系统、荧光免疫分析仪等POCT产品及传染病检测系列（含兽药、违禁药物、热带传染病、胃肠道疾病等）。2024年营收2.24亿元（同比下降11.75%），研发投入4045万元，净利润1712万元，员工650人。
companies.description_en: Shenzhen Bioeasy Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (SZSE ChiNext: 300942, IPO February 2021), founded July 2007 and headquartered in Shenzhen, develops and sells rapid food safety and clinical diagnostic products. Core offerings include colloidal gold immunochromatographic test strips, ELISA kits, nucleic acid extraction kits, portable food rapid analysis systems, fluorescence immunoassay analyzers, and POCT products for infectious diseases (including veterinary, coronavirus, tropical disease, and gastrointestinal panels). FY2024 revenue CNY 224.3M (-11.75% YoY), net profit CNY 17.1M, R&D spend CNY 40.5M.

companies.name_zh: 深圳市理邦精密仪器股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 深圳市理邦精密仪器股份有限公司（SZSE：300206）成立于1995年，总部位于深圳，是一家全球化医疗电子设备和体外诊断产品供应商。产品线涵盖静息心电图、运动负荷测试、Holter系统、无线ECG方案等心电系列；患者监护仪和生命体征监护仪；胎儿/母婴监护和超声系统；血液分析仪和试剂等IVD产品，在国际市场的销售占相当份额。2024年营收18.34亿元（同比-5.35%），研发投入3.40亿元，净利润1.62亿元，员工2546人。
companies.description_en: Edan Instruments, Inc. (SZSE: 300206), founded 1995 and headquartered in Shenzhen, is a global manufacturer of medical electronic equipment and IVD products. Its portfolio spans ECG products (resting, stress test, Holter, wireless), patient monitors, fetal/maternal monitoring, OB/GYN ultrasound, ultrasound systems (color Doppler and B/W), and hematology analyzers with reagents. The company has a significant international revenue footprint. FY2024 revenue CNY 1,834M (-5.4% YoY), R&D spend CNY 340.2M, net profit CNY 162.1M, 2,546 employees.

companies.name_zh: 深圳市精锋医疗科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 深圳市精锋医疗科技股份有限公司（港交所：2675，2026年1月8日上市）成立于2017年，总部位于深圳市龙岗区宝荷大道76号智汇佳园二期2B栋。公司是中国领先的手术机器人企业，核心产品包括多孔腔镜手术机器人（MP1000、MP2000）、单孔腔镜手术机器人（SP1000、SP1000 Plus）、支气管镜手术机器人（CP1000）和EdgeCloud远程手术系统，在国内多孔腔镜手术机器人销量位居首位。2024年出售20台MP1000，全球累计签约61台（截至2025年6月），覆盖25个以上国家，超过700项全球专利授权和申请，2024年营收15.99亿元。
companies.description_en: Shenzhen Edge Medical Co., Ltd. (HKEX: 2675, listed January 8, 2026), founded in 2017 and headquartered in Longgang District, Shenzhen, is a pioneering Chinese surgical robotics company. Core products include multi-port laparoscopic surgical robots (MP1000, MP2000), single-port laparoscopic robots (SP1000, SP1000 Plus), bronchoscopic surgical robot (CP1000), and the EdgeCloud Telesurgery System. The company ranked first among Chinese domestic manufacturers in multi-port laparoscopic robot unit sales in 2024, with 20 MP1000 units sold and 61 cumulative global agreements across 25+ countries. Over 700+ global patents granted or pending. FY2024 revenue CNY 1,599.9M.

companies.name_zh: 恩泰医疗器械股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 恩泰医疗器械股份有限公司（新三板：872180）成立于2004年，总部位于内蒙古乌兰察布市，于2016年由原名宜海仁和医疗更名为恩泰医疗。公司专注于雾化器产品的研发、生产和销售，拥有4000平方米工厂及2个无尘车间，产品涵盖18个系列共280款医用压缩雾化器及其配件（面罩、雾化杯、一次性耗材等），覆盖全国4000多家医院及数百万家庭用户，并通过代理商和分销商销往全球20余个国家和地区。公司拥有34项国家专利，研发团队26人。
companies.description_en: ENTIE Medical Co., Ltd. (NEEQ: 872180), formerly YHRT Medical (renamed 2016), founded in 2004 and headquartered in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, specializes in R&D, production, and sale of medical compressor nebulizers and accessories (masks, nebulizer cups, disposable components). The company's 18 product series encompass 280 nebulizer items serving 4,000+ hospitals and millions of households nationwide, with exports to 20+ countries via agents and distributors. It holds 34 national patents and has a dedicated R&D center with 26 staff.

companies.description_en: Enwei Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 301331), founded in 2005 and headquartered in Chengdu, is engaged in the R&D, production, and sale of proprietary Chinese medicines and chemical medicines, focusing on gynecology, pediatrics, and respiratory system therapeutic areas. FY2024 revenue CNY 812.1M, net profit CNY 37.5M, R&D spend CNY 9.1M, 1,548 employees.

companies.name_zh: 湖南尔康制药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 湖南尔康制药股份有限公司（SZSE：300267）成立于2003年，总部位于长沙，于2011年9月在创业板上市。公司主营药用辅料、API和化学药品制剂，产品包括药用甘油、乙醇、丙二醇、氢氧化钠、药用糖等辅料，磺苄西林钠注射液和复方甘草片等制剂，以及吡格列酮盐酸盐等原料药。2024年营收11.40亿元，净亏损3.73亿元（因药用辅料市场供求失衡导致销量下滑和价格大幅下跌），研发投入4517万元，员工1453人。
companies.description_en: Hunan Er-Kang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 300267), founded 2003 and headquartered in Changsha, listed on ChiNext in September 2011. The company manufactures and sells pharmaceutical excipients (glycerol, ethanol, propylene glycol, sodium hydroxide, pharmaceutical sugars), finished drug products (sulbenicillin sodium injection, compound licorice tablets), and APIs (pioglitazone HCl). FY2024 revenue CNY 1,140M, net loss CNY 373.4M (due to price and demand pressure in pharmaceutical intermediate and excipient markets), R&D spend CNY 45.2M, 1,453 employees.

companies.name_zh: 湖南益而康医疗器械股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 湖南益而康医疗器械股份有限公司（新三板：839074）成立于2003年，总部位于湖南，于2016年在新三板挂牌上市。公司专注于医用分子筛制氧系统和集中供气系统的研发、生产、安装和维护，同时拓展IoT智慧病房解决方案业务，拥有CE认证及ISO9001、ISO13485和ISO14001等多项质量体系认证。产品覆盖PSA制氧机、医用空气压缩机、真空负压系统及数字化智慧病房系统，服务对象包括全球各类医疗机构。
companies.description_en: Hunan Eter Medical Co., Ltd. (NEEQ: 839074), founded in 2003 and listed on NEEQ in 2016, is headquartered in Hunan province. The company specializes in R&D, manufacture, installation, and maintenance of medical molecular sieve PSA oxygen generators, centralized medical gas supply systems (oxygen, compressed air, vacuum), and IoT smart ward solutions for hospitals. It holds CE certification and ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and ISO 14001 certifications, with more than 20 years of experience and international distribution.

companies.description_zh: 湖南方盛制药成立于1997年，2014年在上海证券交易所上市（股票代码603998），主要从事中药和化学药产品的研发、生产和销售，核心产品包括血塞通系列、加斯克强骨片等。
companies.description_en: Hunan Fangsheng Pharmaceutical, established in 1997 and listed on the SSE in 2014, develops, manufactures and sells traditional Chinese medicine and chemical pharmaceutical products. Key products include Xuesetong dispersible tablets, Garcinia bone-strengthening tablets, and Pudilan anti-inflammatory tablets, targeting cardiovascular, musculoskeletal, respiratory, and pediatric indications.

companies.description_en: Fangzhou Inc. (HKEX: 6086) is China's leading online chronic disease management platform, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Guangzhou. It serves 56.4 million registered users and 251,000 physicians, operating an online pharmacy with 217,000 SKUs (62% prescription drugs) and AI-powered chronic care tools. FY2025 revenue rose 30.2% YoY to RMB 3.53 billion with a return to full-year profitability.

companies.description_en: Fusen Pharmaceutical Company Limited (HKEX: 1652), founded 2003 and listed 2018, is a health industry group integrating TCM, chemical drugs and biopharmaceuticals. Pipeline includes SY617 (novel TCM for influenza) and Enzalutamide Soft Capsules (prostate cancer).

companies.description_zh: 苏州富士莱医药（深交所：301258，前身为常熟富士莱医化）专注于医药中间体、原料药及健康护理原料的研发、生产和销售，产品涵盖硫辛酸、L-肌肽、磷脂酰胆碱及依来昔布原料药，广泛应用于药品、膳食补充剂和化妆品领域。
companies.description_en: Suzhou Fushilai Pharmaceutical (SZSE: 301258), formerly Changshu Fushilai Medicine & Chemical Co., develops, manufactures, and sells pharmaceutical intermediates, APIs, and healthcare raw materials including lipoic acid, L-carnosine, phosphatidylcholine, and erelcoxib API, used in medicines, dietary supplements, and cosmetics.

sources.title: Suzhou Fushilai Pharmaceutical (301258.SZ) Profile – Yahoo Finance

companies.name_zh: 江西富昇（江西富翔）制药
companies.description_zh: 江西富昇制药（深交所：300497，原名景德镇富翔制药）成立于2002年，总部位于景德镇，是中国最大的β-内酰胺酶抑制剂生产商，专注于青霉素、碳青霉烯类及抗病毒药物中间体等原料药及中间体的研发、生产和销售。
companies.description_en: Jiangxi Fushine Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 300497), founded 2002 in Jingdezhen (formerly Jingdezhen Fuxiang Pharmaceutical, renamed in 2012), is China's largest manufacturer of β-lactamase inhibitors. It develops, manufactures, and sells APIs and pharmaceutical intermediates including penicillin, carbapenem, and antiviral drug intermediates for domestic and international markets.

sources.title: Jiangxi Fushine Pharmaceutical (300497.SZ) Profile – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 北京福元医药（上交所：601089）成立于1999年2月，2022年6月上市，总部位于北京通州工业开发区，是一家实行仿创结合战略的综合性制药公司，产品涵盖创新药、化学仿制药、API、中药、保健品和医疗器械。2024年营收34.46亿元，研发投入4.17亿元（同比增长18.13%）。
companies.description_en: Beijing Fuyuan Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (SSE: 601089), established February 1999 and listed June 2022, is a diversified pharma company headquartered in Tongzhou, Beijing, pursuing a 'generic + innovation' dual-track strategy. Product portfolio spans innovative drugs, chemical generics, APIs, TCM, health supplements, and medical devices. FY2024 revenue RMB 3.45 billion; R&D spend RMB 417 million (record high, +18.1% YoY).

sources.title: Beijing Foyou Pharma (SHA:601089) Number of Employees – Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: 四川辅正药业股份有限公司（新三板：836450）是一家以中药材道地性为核心竞争力的综合型现代中药企业，专注于发酵中药（曲类）、临床单味饮片及纯养生中药饮片的研发与生产，总资产超9000万元，三年累计营收逾3亿元，系成都市高新技术企业。住所：简阳市镇金镇红日桥路188号。
companies.description_en: Sichuan Fuzheng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (NEEQ: 836450), headquartered in Jianyang (Sichuan), is an integrated modern TCM enterprise specializing in fermented herbal medicines (Qu-class), clinical single-ingredient herbal decoction pieces, and wellness herbal pieces. It is a national high-tech enterprise in the early stages of business-model transformation with total assets exceeding RMB 90 million.

companies.name_en: Sichuan Gangtong Medical Equipment Group Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 四川港通医疗设备集团股份有限公司（深交所：301515）成立于1998年，总部位于简阳，专注于医用气体系统（中心供氧、中心吸引、医用空气集中供应、医用气体报警及分子筛制氧）及净化工程设备的研发、设计、生产、集成、运营和维护，产品服务于国内外医疗机构。
companies.description_en: Sichuan Gangtong Medical Equipment Group Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 301515), founded 1998 in Jianyang (Sichuan), engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, integration, operation, and maintenance of medical gas systems (central oxygen supply, central suction, medical air, alarm systems, molecular sieve oxygen production) and clean-room engineering for healthcare facilities in China and internationally.

sources.title: Sichuan Gangtong Medical Equipment (301515.SZ) Financials – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 劲方医药（港股2595）成立于2017年，2025年9月在港交所主板上市（募资18亿港元），是一家专注于肿瘤及自身免疫疾病创新药开发的生物制药公司。核心资产GFH925（Dupert®/fulzerasib，KRAS G12C抑制剂）已在中国获批治疗晚期非小细胞肺癌，并与信达生物就大中华区达成独家授权。
companies.description_en: GenFleet Therapeutics (Shanghai) Inc. (HKEX: 2595), founded 2017 and listed on HKEX Main Board in September 2025 raising HK$1.8 billion, is a clinical-stage biopharma specializing in oncology and autoimmune therapies. Lead asset GFH925 (fulzerasib/Dupert®, KRAS G12C inhibitor) received NMPA approval for advanced NSCLC with KRAS G12C mutation; GFH375 (KRAS G12D inhibitor) is in Phase I/II. Pipeline also includes assets out-licensed to Innovent for Greater China.

sources.title: GenFleet Announces KRAS G12C Inhibitor China Approval – PR Newswire

companies.name_zh: 嘉和生物（已更名：港进嘉和集团）
companies.name_en: Edding Genor Group Holdings Limited (formerly Genor Biopharma Holdings Ltd.)
companies.description_zh: 嘉和生物（港股6998）成立于2007年，总部位于上海张江高科技园区，2020年10月在香港主板上市。2024年底与Edding集团战略合并，更名为港进嘉和集团。合并后整合Edding的商业化体系（万古霉素、头孢克洛等成熟产品）与嘉和原有的肿瘤/自免管线（GB242英夫利昔单抗生物类似药、GB226抗PD-1）。2025财年合并营收24.87亿元，净利润3.99亿元（同比增长2.9%）。
companies.description_en: Edding Genor Group Holdings Limited (HKEX: 6998, formerly Genor Biopharma Holdings Ltd.), founded 2007 in Shanghai's Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park and listed October 2020, merged with Edding Group in late 2024 to form an integrated biopharmaceutical platform. The combined entity commercializes established products (Vancocin, Ceclor) from Edding and Genor's biopharmaceutical pipeline including GB242 (infliximab biosimilar) and oncology bispecific antibodies. FY2025 revenue RMB 2.487 billion, net profit RMB 399 million.

sources.title: Edding Genor Boosts Profit as Landmark Biotech Merger Drives New Growth – TipRanks

companies.name_zh: 巨子生物控股有限公司
companies.description_zh: 巨子生物是全球领先的重组胶原蛋白研发、生产及销售企业，总部位于西安。旗下品牌包括可复美、可丽金、KEYoung等，产品覆盖功能性护肤品、医用敷料、功能性食品。2022年在香港联交所上市。
companies.description_en: Giant Biogene is a global leader in recombinant collagen-based skin treatment products, headquartered in Xi'an. Its portfolio of functional skincare, medical dressings and functional food is sold under the Comfy (可复美), Collgene (可丽金), Ke Yu and SKIGIN brands. Listed on HKEX in 2022.

companies.name_zh: 安徽环球药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 安徽环球药业是国家火炬计划重点高新技术企业，前身为1958年成立的蚌埠第一制药厂，2000年重组改制，2015年挂牌新三板。主要从事仿制化学药及API的研发、生产和销售，核心产品包括基础输液、治疗性输液和左氧氟沙星片等抗感染药物。
companies.description_en: Anhui Globe Pharmaceutical originates from the 1958 Bengbu No.1 Pharmaceutical Factory, restructured in 2000 and listed on NEEQ in 2015. The company focuses on R&D and production of generic chemical drugs and APIs for common diseases, with a primary emphasis on anti-infective drugs and infusion solutions. Holds 49 drug approval numbers and 9 invention patents.

sources.title: Anhui Globe Pharmaceutical NEEQ F10 - Eastmoney

companies.name_zh: 湖北共同药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 湖北共同药业是国内领先的甾体类原料药及中间体生产企业，总部位于湖北省襄阳市，2021年在深交所创业板上市（300966）。公司以生物发酵和化学合成方式生产皮质激素、性激素、孕激素等甾体类全系产品。
companies.description_en: Hubei Gongtong Pharmaceutical is a leading Chinese producer of steroid APIs and intermediates, listed on SZSE ChiNext in 2021. The company manufactures a complete product line of corticosteroids, sex hormones and progesterone intermediates through biological fermentation and chemical synthesis. HQ in Xiangyang, Hubei.

companies.description_en: Grand Pharmaceutical Group (HKEX:0512) is a Hong Kong-listed diversified pharmaceutical conglomerate headquartered in Wuhan, engaged in innovative drug R&D, pharmaceutical preparations, medical devices, and biotechnology products. Key areas: ophthalmology, respiratory, cerebrovascular emergency, oncology. Over 200 NRDL products; 16 products each exceeding US$100M annual revenue. Operates five R&D platforms and nine R&D centers.

It is also advancing innovative drugs: AR882 (gout, URAT1 inhibitor) received FDA Fast Track designation in August 2024. R&D spend reached 22.4% of revenue in 2024. Holds 193 drug registration certificates.

Revenue fell ~36% in 2024 due to key control-list policy impacts on its main injectable products.

It holds 101 drug approval numbers including 32 original/innovative varieties and 10 exclusive products, with 16 products on the national essential medicines list. Building a diversified health ecosystem alongside its pharmaceutical core.

companies.description_en: Guangdong Zhongsheng Pharmaceutical (SZSE:002317) specializes in traditional Chinese medicine and ophthalmic drugs. Its flagship Fufang Xueshuantong preparations hold leading market position in ophthalmology and cerebrovascular treatment. The company also advances innovative small molecules; first innovative drug Liruluo® is approved and commercialized, with additional projects in clinical development.

Core products span Vitamin B2/B6/B12, sodium ascorbate, lactic acid series, gluconic acid series, starch-based products, and pharmaceutical preparations, produced via biofermentation and chemical synthesis. State-controlled, listed since 1999.

Its flagship products Guilingji (CNY 429M revenue in 2024, 91.9% gross margin) and Dingkundan (CNY 365M) are both listed as National Intangible Cultural Heritage. 2024 revenue of CNY 1.22B, with net profit of CNY 74.5M.

companies.description_zh: 福建广生堂（深交所300436）是福州专注抗病毒和肝健康领域的高新技术制药企业，同时持有阿德福韦酯、拉米夫定、恩替卡韦、替诺福韦、丙酚替诺福韦（TAF）五大抗乙肝病毒药物。创新药GST-HG141（乙肝）在研，首个创新药太冲定2023年获批上市，2025年1月入医保目录。2024年营收4.41亿元，同比增4.43%。
companies.description_en: Fujian Cosunter Pharmaceutical (SZSE:300436), based in Fuzhou, is a high-tech specialty pharma focused on antiviral and liver health drugs. It simultaneously holds five anti-HBV drugs: adefovir dipivoxil, lamivudine, entecavir, tenofovir and tenofovir alafenamide (TAF). Its first innovative drug (Taichongding) was approved in 2023; novel HBV candidate GST-HG141 is in Phase II. 2024 revenue CNY 441M (+4.4% YoY).

companies.description_en: Guangzhou Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. (NEEQ:874839, GP Corp.) was founded in 1951 and is the largest pharmaceutical distribution company in South China. It is 90.92%-owned by Guangzhou Baiyunshan Pharmaceutical Holdings. GP Corp listed on NEEQ innovation tier in May 2025 with reported 2024 revenue of ~CNY 54.6B, mainly from wholesale and retail distribution of pharmaceutical products.

Business segments: biomaterials (regenerative medicine materials), pharmaceuticals (benvitimod cream for dermatology) and cell therapy (immune cells, stem cells). 2024 revenue CNY 377M (-6.6% YoY).
