sources.title: Hebei Hejia Pharmaceutical Technology Group – Official Website

companies.name_zh: 河南太龙药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 河南太龙药业成立于1998年，是河南省医药行业首家上市公司，主营中药材种植、制剂、中药饮片及R&D服务，核心产品为双黄连口服液系列和双金连混合液，产品覆盖呼吸、心脑血管、消化、妇科等多系统，2024年营收19.41亿元（同比-6.21%）。
companies.description_en: Henan Tailong Pharmaceutical, founded 1998 in Zhengzhou, is Henan's first listed pharma company; manufactures TCM preparations, Chinese herbal pieces, and R&D services; flagship products include Shuanghuanglian oral liquid and Shuangjinlian mixture targeting respiratory, cardiovascular, digestive, and gynecological conditions; FY2024 revenue CNY 1.94 B (-6.2% YoY).

companies.name_zh: 河南裕辰药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 河南裕辰药业（NEEQ:870875）位于河南省许昌市，为新三板挂牌企业，经营药品的研发、生产与销售，曾于2014年实现销售收入约1.4亿元，具体近期财务数据暂无可核实的公开来源。
companies.description_en: Henan Yuchen Pharmaceutical (NEEQ:870875) is located in Xuchang, Henan Province; engages in pharmaceutical R&D, manufacturing, and sales; reported sales income of ~CNY 140 M in 2014; recent financials not verifiable from primary public sources.

companies.name_zh: 湖北亨迪药业股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Hubei Biocause Heilen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 湖北亨迪药业成立于1995年，是全球领先的API生产及CDMO服务商，主产布洛芬、右布洛芬（非甾体抗炎）、托塞米、米力农（心血管）及醋酸阿比特龙、磷酸氟达拉滨等抗肿瘤API，产品销往90余个国家和地区，通过欧美官方GMP检查12次，2024年营收4.46亿元。
companies.description_en: Hubei Biocause Heilen Pharmaceutical (亨迪药业), founded 1995 in Jingmen, is a leading global API/CDMO supplier specializing in NSAIDs (ibuprofen, dexibuprofen), cardiovascular APIs (torsemide, milrinone), and oncology APIs (abiraterone acetate, fludarabine phosphate); products distributed to 90+ countries; EU & US GMP approved 12 times; FY2024 revenue CNY 446 M (-32.8% YoY due to price normalization).

sources.title: Hubei Biocause Heilen Profile – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 拜维卡国际开发并商业化基于血液的肿瘤生物标志物检测产品，其旗舰产品DiviTum® TKa通过检测血液中胸腺嘧啶激酶活性（TKa）来监测癌症进展，已与美国Tempus AI展开合作。
companies.description_en: Biovica International develops and commercialises blood-based biomarker assays that help oncologists monitor cancer treatment response. Its flagship product DiviTum® TKa measures thymidine kinase activity (TKa) in blood as a proxy for tumour cell proliferation; partnered with US diagnostics company Tempus AI for nationwide distribution from May 2025.

sources.title: Biovica International Annual Report 2024/2025 Press Release

companies.description_zh: BRAIN生物技术AG是工业生物技术领域的领先企业，专注于特种酶、生物催化剂和微生物产品的研发与生产，服务于食品、饲料、化妆品及工业化学品行业，在英国及欧洲大陆拥有发酵生产设施。FY2024/25收入4960万欧元。
companies.description_en: BRAIN Biotech AG is a leading industrial biotechnology company researching, developing and producing specialty enzymes, biocatalysts and microorganisms for food, feed, cosmetics and industrial applications. It operates fermentation facilities in the UK and continental Europe. FY2024/25 revenue €49.6 million; listed on Frankfurt Prime Standard since February 2016.

sources.title: FY 2024/25 BRAIN Biotech AG Full Year Results

companies.description_zh: Brain+ A/S是一家专注于认知衰退和痴呆症的数字医疗公司，其旗舰产品Ayla是基于认知刺激疗法（CST）的数字平台，供医疗机构向痴呆患者提供治疗，已在丹麦和英国商业化。
companies.description_en: Brain+ A/S is a Danish digital therapeutics company focused on Alzheimer's disease and dementia. Its flagship product Ayla is a Cognitive Stimulation Therapy (CST) platform for healthcare providers; commercially deployed with Copenhagen Municipality and a UK private care-home group. Full-year 2024 total income DKK 7.9 million.

companies.description_zh: C4X探索是一家专注于免疫炎症疾病的药物发现公司，其专有4Sight分子设计平台可进行构象分析以优化先导化合物。2024年4月自愿从AIM退市转为私人公司，以获得更广泛投资渠道。与AstraZeneca及Indivior签有合作协议。
companies.description_en: C4X Discovery is an immuno-inflammatory drug discovery company using its proprietary 4Sight conformational analysis platform. It voluntarily delisted from AIM in April 2024 to operate as a private company, with cash of ~£20.8 million at that date. Portfolio includes partnered programmes with AstraZeneca (received $11 million milestone) and Indivior (sold oral Orexin-1 antagonist for £15.95 million).

sources.title: C4X Discovery Seeks AIM Delisting — AJ Bell

companies.description_zh: 坎塔吉亚是一家瑞典临床阶段生物技术公司，基于IL1RAP靶点开发抗体疗法，治疗癌症和炎症疾病。其核心产品nadunolimab（CAN04）在胰腺癌和非小细胞肺癌中处于二期临床阶段；CAN10已于2025年9月授权给大冢制药，获6.3亿美元潜在里程碑。
companies.description_en: Cantargia AB is a Swedish clinical-stage biotech with an IL1RAP-targeting antibody platform. Lead asset nadunolimab (CAN04) is in Phase II for pancreatic cancer (FDA Fast Track) and NSCLC. CAN10 (autoimmune/inflammatory) was licensed to Otsuka Pharmaceutical in September 2025 for up to USD 630 million, driving FY2025 revenue of SEK 316.7 million.

companies.description_zh: 卡普托治疗是一家专注于靶向蛋白降解技术（TPD）的波兰生物制药公司，其PROTEOLYTAC平台提供口服生物利用度优化的降解剂。核心产品CR-001靶向突变KRAS（G12D/G12V），适用于胰腺癌、肺癌和结直肠癌，已于2024年进入一期临床。2021年在华沙证券交易所IPO，为欧洲首家TPD上市公司。
companies.description_en: Captor Therapeutics is a Polish biotech specialising in Targeted Protein Degradation (TPD). Its PROTEOLYTAC platform offers oral bioavailability advantages over traditional PROTACs. Lead asset CR-001 targets mutant KRAS G12D/G12V in pancreatic, lung and colorectal cancer (Phase I since 2024). IPO on Warsaw Stock Exchange in April 2021 was Europe's first TPD-focused public offering.

companies.description_zh: 赛莱克提斯是一家临床阶段基因编辑公司，使用TALEN技术开发同种异体（现货型）CAR-T细胞疗法（UCART）用于血液肿瘤，并开发基因编辑造血干细胞产品。在巴黎和美国北卡罗来纳州罗利设有先进制造设施。2025年全年收入7960万美元。
companies.description_en: Cellectis is a clinical-stage gene-editing company using TALEN technology to develop allogeneic (off-the-shelf) CAR-T cell therapies (UCART platform) for blood cancers, and gene-edited hematopoietic stem-cell products. Manufacturing in Paris, France and Raleigh, North Carolina. FY2025 consolidated revenues USD 79.6 million. Dual-listed on Nasdaq (CLLS) and Euronext Growth Paris.

companies.description_zh: 塞隆制药是一家综合性波兰制药公司，专注于癌症、神经系统疾病、糖尿病及其他代谢疾病的研发、生产和市场推广，其研究中心开展多治疗领域的新药研发，2016年在华沙证券交易所上市。
companies.description_en: Celon Pharma S.A. is an integrated Polish pharmaceutical company engaged in research, development, manufacture and marketing of pharmaceuticals targeting oncology, neurology, diabetes and other metabolic disorders. Listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange main market in October 2016. FY2024 revenue PLN 207.2 million.

sources.title: Celon Pharma Full Year 2024 Earnings Results

companies.description_zh: 赛利亚德肿瘤学是比利时临床阶段CAR-T细胞治疗公司，曾开发同种异体和自体CAR-T疗法，但受现金压力影响，公司于2025年8月宣布停止所有研发活动，并将研究设施以300万欧元出售。目前公司仅维持壳架运营，仅剩3名员工。
companies.description_en: Celyad Oncology is a Belgian clinical-stage company that developed allogeneic and autologous CAR-T cell therapies for cancer. Following cash constraints, the company discontinued all R&D activities in August 2025 and sold its Mont-Saint-Guibert research facility for EUR 3 million in September 2025. As of 2026 only 3 employees remain; FY2025 net profit EUR 0.8 million (from asset sale gains).

sources.title: Celyad Oncology Full Year 2025 Financial Results
Celyad Oncology Discontinuation of R&D Activities

companies.description_zh: 塞雷诺科学是一家专注于心血管和肺部罕见疾病的瑞典生物技术公司，通过组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制（HDAC抑制）实现表观遗传调控。核心产品CS1是HDAC抑制剂，用于肺动脉高压治疗，已进入监管对齐的全球IIb期临床阶段；第二候选药物CS014在一期临床试验中取得积极结果。
companies.description_en: Cereno Scientific AB pioneers epigenetic modulation via HDAC inhibition to treat cardiovascular and rare pulmonary diseases. Lead asset CS1 (HDAC inhibitor) has advanced into a regulatory-aligned global Phase IIb trial for pulmonary arterial hypertension. Second candidate CS014 delivered positive Phase I results in 2025. HQ at GoCo Health Innovation City, Gothenburg; US subsidiary in Kendall Square, Boston.

companies.description_zh: 克利尼根集团是一家全球性制药服务公司，专注于通过临床试验供应、早期准入项目、监管服务和授权/未授权药品商业化为超过1,000家制药及生物技术合作伙伴提供触达患者解决方案。2022年4月被Triton Partners以约16亿英镑收购后退市，成为私有企业。
companies.description_en: Clinigen Group is a global pharmaceutical services company offering clinical trial supply, early access programmes, regulatory services and licensed/unlicensed medicine commercialisation to over 1,000 pharma and biotech partners across 16 countries. Delisted from AIM in April 2022 following acquisition by Triton Partners for ~£1.6 billion enterprise value.

sources.title: Clinigen Group Strategic Position & Company Metrics 2026

companies.description_zh: 科伊尔治疗是英国AIM上市的临床阶段肿瘤公司，于2026年3月以Roquefort Therapeutics完成反向并购AO-252资产后更名。核心产品AO-252是TACC3抑制剂，目前在美国进行一期临床试验；还评估STAT-6 siRNA项目用于免疫治疗适应症。
companies.description_en: Coiled Therapeutics PLC is a UK AIM-listed clinical-stage oncology company formed from the reverse takeover acquisition of AO-252 from A2A Pharmaceuticals in March 2026 (formerly Roquefort Therapeutics). Lead programme AO-252 is a novel TACC3 inhibitor in Phase I clinical trials in the USA. The company also assesses a STAT-6 siRNA programme for immunology. Raised £8.5 million gross on AIM admission.

sources.title: Coiled Therapeutics on AO-252 and Roquefort RTO

companies.description_zh: 科斯摩制药是意大利制药公司，在瑞士证交所上市，专注于胃肠病学、皮肤病学、AI医疗技术（GI Genius内镜AI系统，与美敦力合作）及合同开发制造（CDMO）。2025年全年收入1.042亿欧元，85%为经常性收入。2026年4月更名为Cosmo N.V.。
companies.description_en: Cosmo Pharmaceuticals NV (SIX: COPN) is an Italy-headquartered specialty pharma/medtech company listed on SIX Swiss Exchange. It operates in gastroenterology, dermatology, AI healthtech (GI Genius AI endoscopy platform with Medtronic) and CDMO. FY2025 revenue EUR 104.2 million (85% recurring); EBITDA EUR 9.5 million. Renamed Cosmo N.V. in April 2026.

companies.description_zh: 赛克松是瑞典临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于自身免疫和自身炎症疾病的疾病修饰疗法。其核心产品rabeximod正在进行类风湿性关节炎二期临床试验；T20K用于多发性硬化症的早期临床开发。公司位于马尔默，规模极小，属微型股。
companies.description_en: Cyxone AB is a Swedish clinical-stage biotech developing disease-modifying therapies for autoimmune and autoinflammatory diseases. Rabeximod is in Phase II for rheumatoid arthritis; T20K (cyclic peptide) is in Phase I for multiple sclerosis. Very small team (~8 employees), nano-cap with minimal cash runway; HQ in Malmö.

sources.title: Cyxone AB — Simply Wall St Profile

companies.description_zh: DBV技术是一家法国临床阶段生物制药公司，开发经皮免疫疗法（Viaskin技术平台），通过皮肤贴片给药治疗食物过敏。旗舰产品Viaskin Peanut（花生过敏贴片）已与FDA达成一致，计划于2026年上半年提交4-7岁儿童适应症BLA申请。年收入560万美元，净亏损1.47亿美元。
companies.description_en: DBV Technologies is a French late-stage biopharma developing Viaskin epicutaneous immunotherapy patches for food allergy (peanut, milk, egg). FDA agreement reached on safety data package for Viaskin Peanut BLA in children aged 4-7; BLA submission targeted H1 2026. FY2025 revenue USD 5.64 million; net loss USD 147 million. Dual-listed Euronext Paris and Nasdaq (ADRs).

sources.title: DBV Technologies Full Year 2025 Financial Results
DBV Technologies Full Year 2024 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 德玛制药控股是德国领先的无专利品牌制药公司，持有约950个营销授权，涵盖超过250种活性药物成分，产品涵盖皮肤科、过敏、维生素D（Dekristol）等领域，并通过axicorp运营平行进口业务。2024年收入11.81亿欧元，调整后EBITDA3.16亿欧元。
companies.description_en: Dermapharm Holding SE is a leading German manufacturer of patent-free branded pharmaceuticals, holding ~950 marketing authorisations for more than 250 active ingredients across dermatology, allergology, vitamins/supplements (Dekristol, Ampho Moronal, Keltican, Tromcardin). Parallel import business operated under axicorp brand. FY2024 revenue EUR 1.181 billion; adjusted EBITDA EUR 316 million; 3,503 employees.

sources.title: Dermapharm FY2024 Results: Revenue and EBITDA Guidance Exceeded

companies.description_zh: 德斯提尼制药是一家英国抗菌药物研发公司，开发旨在预防危及生命感染的新型抗菌产品（XF平台）。XF-73（exeporfinium chloride）鼻用凝胶用于预防术后葡萄球菌感染，已完成IIb期临床。公司于2024年8月进入管理程序，2025年8月清算，其XF-73抗菌平台已被EMV Capital旗下Moirai收购。
companies.description_en: Destiny Pharma was a Brighton-based antimicrobial biotech developing the XF platform to prevent life-threatening post-surgical infections. XF-73 nasal gel (exeporfinium chloride) completed Phase IIb; XF-73 dermal and NTCD-M3 (C. difficile prevention) also in pipeline. The company entered administration in August 2024 and liquidation in August 2025; XF-73 platform acquired by Moirai (EMV Capital subsidiary).

sources.title: EMV Capital Subsidiary Moirai Acquires Destiny Pharma's XF-73 Platform
Destiny Pharma Hops on the AIM Delisting Train — Pharmaphorum

companies.description_zh: 德瓦控股是土耳其领先制药集团，成立于1958年，在以下10个治疗领域拥有1,404个注册产品，出口至82个国家。公司在Çerkezköy和Kartepe设有三个符合欧盟GMP和美国FDA标准的生产设施，年产能6.2亿单位。2024年在土耳其市场以单位销量位居第3（占比5.3%）。
companies.description_en: Deva Holding A.Ş. is a leading Turkish integrated pharma group founded in 1958, with 1,404 registered products across 10 therapeutic areas exported to 82 countries. Operates three EU GMP- and FDA-approved manufacturing sites in Çerkezköy and Kartepe with annual production capacity of 620 million units. Ranked 3rd in Turkish pharma market by unit sales (5.3%) in 2024; FY2024 revenue USD 423 million.

sources.title: Deva Holding Turkish Pharma Group 2024 Strong Results

companies.name_zh: 恒升医学科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 国家高新技术企业，专注血糖监测与糖尿病管理产品、医疗耗材及试剂，在北京、杭州设有销售中心和生产研发中心，与全国逾3000家医院建立合作，旗下8家全资子公司。
companies.description_en: National high-tech enterprise integrating R&D, production and sales; focuses on blood-glucose monitoring and diabetes-management devices, medical consumables and reagents. Has 8 wholly-owned subsidiaries, a national sales centre in Beijing and production/R&D centre in Hangzhou; products distributed across 3,000+ hospitals nationwide. Listed on NEEQ Innovation Layer in March 2023.

sources.title: 恒升医学 2024年半年度报告 (NEEQ 874056)
恒升医学 2025年半年度报告摘要

companies.name_zh: 牡丹江恒远药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 牡丹江本地仿制药生产企业，专注于胃肠道和呼吸系统药物，主要产品包括美沙拉嗪栓剂、美沙拉嗪肠溶片及孟鲁司特钠咀嚼片等，通过生物等效性研究进行药品注册。
companies.description_en: Mudanjiang-based generic drug manufacturer focused on gastrointestinal and respiratory formulations. Key products include mesalamine suppositories, mesalazine enteric-coated tablets and montelukast sodium chewable tablets. Conducts bioequivalence studies for drug registration in China.

companies.name_zh: 南京海融医药科技股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Nanjing Heron Pharmaceutical Science and Technology Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 南京创新型医药企业，全球活性维生素D衍生物领域领导者，专注新药及首仿药研发与工业化生产，2016年登陆新三板（870070）。主要产品为活性维生素D衍生物原料药及制剂。
companies.description_en: Innovation-oriented pharma company in Nanjing. Global leader and first-to-file generics specialist in active vitamin D derivatives synthesis. Focuses on R&D and industrial production of new drugs and first-to-file generic drugs in China. Listed on NEEQ in 2016.

sources.title: 南京海融医药 2024年度报告 (NEEQ 870070)

companies.name_zh: 和田维吾尔药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 新疆和田地区维吾尔医药科技企业，由新疆吴氏投资与和田维吾尔医院共同创办，是集科研、生产、销售、医疗为一体的高新技术民族药企业。主要产品包括依木萨克片、洛布泊克比热斯坦颗粒等民族药独家品种，2016年登陆新三板。
companies.description_en: Xinjiang-based Uygur traditional medicine enterprise founded jointly by Xinjiang Wu's Investment and Hotan Uygur Medical Hospital. Integrates R&D, production, and sales of Uygur ethnic medicines. Key products include Yimusakesike tablets, Luzhufu Kebirisitan granules, and other nationally-unique approved Uygur medicine products. Listed on NEEQ in May 2016.

companies.name_zh: 安徽合益制药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 安徽合肥医药中间体和原料药研发生产企业，主要产品包括抗过敏、抗血栓、抗氧化、胃溃疡、抗病毒、解热镇痛及紫外吸收剂等系列产品，是北京证券交易所上市公司。
companies.description_en: Hefei-based specialty pharmaceutical intermediates and API manufacturer. Product categories span anti-allergy, anti-thrombosis, anti-oxidation, gastric ulcer, anti-viral, antipyretic/analgesic, and UV-absorbent compounds. Listed on the Beijing Stock Exchange (BSE).

companies.name_zh: 和元生物技术（上海）股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 专注细胞与基因治疗领域CRO/CDMO服务的科创板上市企业，2024年营业收入2.48亿元（同比+21.16%），其中CDMO业务收入1.35亿元（+26.12%），归母净利润约-3.22亿元。在临港建有工业化基地，并已布局再生医学领域。
companies.description_en: STAR-market listed cell and gene therapy CRO/CDMO company. 2024 revenue RMB 248 million (+21% YoY); CDMO segment RMB 135 million (+26%). Net loss attributable to shareholders ~RMB 322 million. Operates Lingang industrial base at full capacity; expanding into regenerative medicine. 692 employees at year-end 2024.

sources.title: 和元生物2024年营收增长超20%
和元生物：2024年度净利润约-3.22亿元
和元生物 2024年年度报告摘要

companies.name_zh: 健合（H&H）国际控股有限公司
companies.name_en: Health and Happiness (H&H) International Holdings Limited
companies.description_zh: 港交所上市的全球家庭营养与婴幼儿护理集团，旗下拥有合生元（Biostime）、Swisse、Healthy Times等知名品牌。2024年收入130.5亿元（同比-6.3%），归母净亏损5370万元。主营婴儿配方奶粉、营养保健品及宠物营养。
companies.description_en: HKEX-listed global family nutrition and baby care conglomerate. Brands include Biostime (infant formula), Swisse (supplements), Healthy Times and others. FY2024 revenue RMB 13.05 billion (-6.3% YoY); net loss RMB 53.7 million (vs. profit RMB 581.8 million in 2023). 2,800 employees.

sources.title: H&H International Holdings Reports 2024 Financial Decline - TipRanks

companies.name_zh: 浙江海翔药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 浙江台州老牌制药企业，专注抗生素、心血管及降糖药原料药、制剂及精细化工产品，同时生产染料。2024年营收19.4亿元（同比-10.75%），净亏损3.30亿元。2736名员工。
companies.description_en: Established Taizhou-based manufacturer of antibiotics, cardiovascular and hypoglycemic APIs, formulations, fine chemicals and dyestuffs. FY2024 revenue RMB 1.94 billion (-10.75% YoY); net loss RMB 330 million. 2,736 employees. Listed on SZSE since 2006.

companies.name_zh: 苏州弘森药业股份有限公司

companies.name_zh: 药明巨诺（开曼）有限公司
companies.description_zh: 药明巨诺是一家专注于细胞免疫治疗的生物科技公司，核心产品Carteyva®（瑞基奥仑赛注射液）是国内首批获批的自体CAR-T疗法，已获NMPA批准用于复发/难治性B细胞淋巴瘤、滤泡性淋巴瘤和套细胞淋巴瘤三个适应症，同时布局实体瘤和自身免疫病管线。
companies.description_en: JW Therapeutics is an independent innovative cell-therapy biotech focused on CAR-T and other cellular immunotherapies. Its lead product Carteyva® (relmacabtagene autoleucel, relma-cel) is China's first approved anti-CD19 CAR-T cell therapy with three NMPA-approved indications for B-cell lymphoma, follicular lymphoma and mantle cell lymphoma. The company also has a pipeline covering solid tumors and autoimmune diseases. Listed on HKEX in September 2020.

companies.name_zh: 康辰药业（北京康辰药业股份有限公司）
companies.description_zh: 北京康辰药业股份有限公司，致力于血液病及肿瘤创新药研发，核心产品为注射用血凝酶（苏灵），同时布局ZY5301（慢性盆腔炎III期）和KC1036（实体瘤II期）等创新药管线。
companies.description_en: Beijing-based specialty pharma focused on hematology and oncology. Core marketed product is agkistrodon hemocoagulase (Suling). Pipeline includes ZY5301 (Phase 3, chronic pelvic pain) and KC1036 (Phase 2, solid tumors). 2024 revenue CNY 825M, R&D spend CNY 139M (~16.8% of revenue).

companies.name_zh: 山东康华生物医疗科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 山东康华生物医疗科技股份有限公司，成立于1996年，总部位于山东潍坊。专注于体外诊断（IVD）领域，涵盖POCT、化学发光免疫诊断、分子诊断、生物活性原料、酶联免疫及生化诊断六大产品线，产品逾600种，服务客户全球2000余家。
companies.description_en: NEEQ-listed IVD company headquartered in Weifang, Shandong. Established 1996. Operates six diagnostic product lines: POCT, chemiluminescence immunoassay, molecular diagnostics, bioactive raw materials, ELISA, and biochemical diagnostics; over 600 registered products. Holds ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO15189 and MDSAP certifications.

companies.name_zh: 成都康华生物制品股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Chengdu Kanghua Biological Products Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 成都康华生物制品股份有限公司，2004年创立于成都，主要产品为冻干人用狂犬病疫苗（人二倍体细胞）和ACYW135脑膜炎球菌多糖疫苗，2024年营收14.3亿元，同比下降9.2%。
companies.description_en: Chengdu-headquartered vaccine company founded 2004. Key products: freeze-dried human diploid cell rabies vaccine and Group ACYW135 meningococcal polysaccharide vaccine. FY2024 revenue CNY 1.43B (-9.2% YoY); net profit CNY 399M (-21.7% YoY). ~620 employees.

companies.name_zh: 湖南华康生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 湖南华康生物科技股份有限公司，2003年成立，位于长沙高新技术开发区，专注于天然植物提取物的提取分离与生产，产品用于医药、食品、保健品、化妆品及饲料添加剂行业，持有ISO9001、HACCP、清真、有机认证。
companies.description_en: Changsha-based NEEQ-listed plant extract manufacturer established in 2003. Specializes in extraction of active ingredients from natural plants for pharmaceutical, food, health supplement, cosmetic, and feed additive industries. Holds ISO9001-2015, HACCP, halal, kosher and organic certifications.

companies.name_zh: 康基医疗控股有限公司
companies.description_zh: 康基医疗控股有限公司，2004年创立于杭州，主营微创外科器械及耗材（腔镜切割吻合器、超声刀、套管针等），为中国最大的国产微创手术器械耗材平台之一。2024年营收10.1亿元，归母净利润5.81亿元，毛利率约79%。
companies.description_en: Hangzhou-based medical device group founded 2004, listed on HKEX in 2020. Designs, manufactures and sells minimally invasive surgical instruments and accessories (disposable trocars, ultrasonic scalpels, staplers, electrosurgical devices). FY2024 revenue CNY 1.01B (+8.9% YoY), net profit CNY 581M (+15.4%), gross margin ~79%. 1,007 employees.

companies.name_zh: 合肥康居人医疗器械科技股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Hefei Kangjuren Medical Device Technology Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 合肥康居人医疗器械科技股份有限公司，2011年创立，位于合肥高新技术产业开发区，主营家用制氧机、雾化器等呼吸健康医疗器械，品牌氧精灵、康居人。2024年营收3.21亿元（同比降32%），净利润1,701万元（同比降66%），员工224人。
companies.description_en: Hefei-based NEEQ-listed respiratory medical device company founded 2011. Core products: home oxygen concentrators, nebulizers, non-invasive ventilators under brands Oxygen Elf (氧精灵) and Kangjuren. FY2024 revenue CNY 321M (-32% YoY), net profit CNY 17M. 224 employees.

companies.name_zh: 北京康乐卫士生物技术股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 北京康乐卫士生物技术股份有限公司，成立于2008年，以结构设计重组蛋白疫苗为核心技术，拥有全球最丰富的HPV疫苗产品组合（三价、九价等），2023年在北交所上市，是北交所首支人用疫苗股。三价HPV疫苗BLA已被纳入CDE优先审评。2024年研发支出2.54亿元，仍处于上市前亏损阶段。
companies.description_en: Beijing-based pre-revenue vaccine biotech founded 2008, listed on BSE 2023 (first human vaccine stock on BSE). Core technology is structure-based recombinant protein antigen design. Pipeline centres on HPV vaccines: trivalent HPV BLA accepted by NMPA CDE (priority review); 9-valent Phase 3 completed. FY2024 R&D spend CNY 254M; operating revenue near zero (pre-commercialization).

companies.description_zh: 浙江康乐药业股份有限公司，2001年成立，位于浙江温州经济技术开发区，聚焦化学药品原料药制造（呼吸系统），主要品种包括对乙酰氨基酚和厄多司坦（祛痰原料药），是国家高新技术企业及浙江省专精特新中小企业。
companies.description_en: Wenzhou-based NEEQ-listed API manufacturer founded 2001. Focuses on analgesic-antipyretic and expectorant APIs. Key products: paracetamol (acetaminophen) and erdosteine (expectorant). FY2025 revenue CNY 417M (-7.8% YoY); net profit CNY 115M (-22.5% YoY). Recognized as Zhejiang provincial specialized innovative SME.

companies.name_zh: 康美药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 康美药业股份有限公司，1997年创立于广东普宁，为大型中药企业，从事中药材种植、加工、销售及现代医药产品研发生产，历史上曾为千亿市值中药龙头，2016-2019年因财务造假888亿元受监管处罚，创始人获刑12年，现处重整恢复期。2024年营收51.9亿元，归母净利润857万元。
companies.description_en: Puning (Guangdong)-headquartered TCM major founded 1997. Business spans TCM raw material sourcing, processing, and sales of herbal formulas and modern pharmaceuticals. Notorious for a CNY 88.7B accounting scandal (2016-2019) resulting in regulatory sanctions and founder's 12-year imprisonment. Now undergoing post-restructuring recovery: FY2024 revenue CNY 5.19B (+6.5%), net profit CNY 8.6M. ~5,492 employees.

sources.title: 康美药业股份有限公司2024年年度报告

companies.name_en: Shenzhen Kangtai Biological Products Co., Ltd.

companies.description_en: Shenzhen-based vaccine company founded 1992, SZSE-listed (300601). Founder: Du Weimin. Key marketed vaccines: 13-valent PCV (first domestic), human diploid rabies vaccine, varicella, hepatitis B, measles-rubella. Also held AstraZeneca COVID-19 exclusive manufacturing rights for mainland China. FY2024 revenue CNY 2.65B (-23.75%), net profit CNY 202M (-76.6%), R&D CNY 569M (~21.5% of revenue). 2,043 employees.

companies.name_zh: 江苏康为世纪生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 江苏康为世纪生物科技股份有限公司，2007年成立，由王春香博士创立，是核酸提取纯化领域先驱，2022年科创板上市。主要产品为分子检测酶原料、核酸保存试剂、核酸提取纯化试剂及分子诊断试剂盒。2024年营收1.26亿元（同比降27%），净利润-1.57亿元，研发支出9,923万元（占收入78.8%）。
companies.description_en: Jiangsu-registered (HQ in Beijing) STAR-listed IVD molecular diagnostics company founded 2007 by Dr. Wang Chunxiang. Pioneer in nucleic acid extraction kits; led drafting of national standard GB/T 37875-2019. Products: molecular enzyme reagents, nucleic acid preservation, extraction and purification kits, MDx diagnostic kits. FY2024 revenue CNY 126M (-26.5%), net loss CNY 157M; R&D intensity 78.8%. ~800 employees.

companies.description_en: Yinchuan (Ningxia)-based NEEQ-listed generics manufacturer. National high-tech enterprise engaged in R&D, production and sales of chemical drug formulations and APIs. H1 2024 revenue CNY 46.5M (-29% YoY), net loss CNY 2.8M. ~300 employees; 200-acre production facility.

companies.name_en: Shandong Kang Yuan Tang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 山东康源堂药业股份有限公司，2012年成立，主营蟾酥、水蛭等中药材及中药饮片的加工与销售，实际控制人为山东省国资委（山东颐养健康集团新业发展有限公司控股）。2024年营收2.10亿元（同比降33%），净利润159万元（同比降93%）。
companies.description_en: Shandong-based NEEQ-listed TCM ingredient processor founded 2012, state-controlled (Shandong SOE via Yiyang Health Group). Core business: processing and sales of traditional Chinese medicinal materials including toad venom (蟾酥), leeches (水蛭) and herbal decoction pieces. FY2024 revenue CNY 210M (-33% YoY), net profit CNY 1.6M (-93% YoY).

companies.name_zh: 上海凯赛生物技术股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 上海凯赛生物技术股份有限公司（凯赛生物），2000年创立，总部位于上海张江高科技园区，聚焦合成生物学与生物制造，核心产品为长链二元酸系列（癸二酸等）及生物基聚酰胺PA5X，广泛用于纺织、医药、汽车、电子等行业。2024年营收29.6亿元（同比增40%），净利润4.89亿元（同比增33%），研发支出2.33亿元。
companies.description_en: Shanghai-based synthetic biology and bio-manufacturing company founded 2000. Listed on STAR market (688065) in August 2020. Core technology: fermentation of long-chain diacids (C9–C18) and bio-based pentamethylene diamine (PDA) for production of bio-based polyamides PA5X. Production sites in Jinxiang (Shandong) and Wusu (Xinjiang). FY2024 revenue CNY 2.96B (+39.9%), net profit CNY 489M (+33.4%), R&D spend CNY 233M (7.9% of revenue). Year-end 2024 market cap CNY 22.6B.

companies.name_zh: 上海科州药物股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 上海科州药物股份有限公司（前称：上海可成药业），2014年成立，位于上海张江高科技园区，聚焦MAPK信号通路创新药研发，核心产品妥拉美替尼（MEK抑制剂）已获NMPA批准用于NRAS突变晚期黑色素瘤，并纳入国家医保，另有多个肿瘤适应症处于II/III期临床。2025年6月转至新三板创新层。
companies.description_en: Shanghai Zhangjiang-based oncology biotech founded 2014, NEEQ-listed (innovation layer since June 2025). Focused on MAPK pathway inhibitors. Lead product: Tunlametinib (MEK1/2 inhibitor, China's first domestic MEK inhibitor), NMPA-approved for NRAS-mutant advanced melanoma, included in national reimbursement list January 2025. Multiple additional oncology indications in Ph2/Ph3. Raised USD 45M Series C.

companies.name_zh: 上海科华生物工程股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 上海科华生物工程股份有限公司，1981年成立，1998年股改，2004年深交所上市，为中国第一家上市体外诊断（IVD）企业。主营IVD试剂（化学发光、分子诊断等）及医学检测仪器。2024年营收17.6亿元（同比降28%），净亏损6.41亿元，新控股股东为西安知同（2024年）。
companies.description_en: Shanghai-based IVD pioneer founded 1981, first publicly listed IVD company in China (SZSE 002022, listed 2004). Core products: IVD reagents (chemiluminescence, molecular diagnostics, ELISA) and instruments. FY2024 revenue CNY 1.76B (-27.5%), net loss CNY 641M driven by volume-based procurement price cuts. Ownership changed to Xi'an Zhitong in 2024. 2,033 employees.

companies.description_zh: 湖南科瑞生物制药股份有限公司，2009年成立，位于湖南省邵阳市新邵县大坪经济开发区，专注于植物源胆固醇（甾醇）及甾体药物中间体的研发、生产与销售，荣获第一届全国颠覆性技术创新大赛最高奖。2024年营收2.66亿元（同比增9.5%），净利润7,878万元（同比增25%）。
companies.description_en: Hunan-based (Xinshao county) NEEQ-listed specialty chemical pharma founded 2009. Core products: plant-derived cholesterol (phytocholesterol) and steroid pharmaceutical intermediates. Won top prize at China's 1st Disruptive Technology Innovation Competition (2022) for its phytocholesterol project. Designated provincial enterprise technology center. FY2024 revenue CNY 266M (+9.5%), net profit CNY 78.8M (+24.5%).

companies.description_zh: 江苏凯基生物技术股份有限公司是一家专注于细胞生物学试剂产品的生命科学品牌供应商，在流式细胞术试剂、细胞凋亡检测及体外诊断产品研发、生产和销售领域具有核心竞争力。
companies.description_en: Jiangsu KeyGEN BioTECH Corp. is a life-science reagent supplier focused on cell biology, specialising in flow cytometry reagents, cell apoptosis detection kits, and in-vitro diagnostic products. companies.description_en: Keymed Biosciences (HKEX: 2162) is a Chengdu-based biotechnology company focused on in-house discovery and development of novel biological therapies for autoimmune and oncology indications. Its core product Kangyueda® (stapokibart/CM310), a humanised anti-IL-4Rα mAb, is approved in China for atopic dermatitis, chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps, and seasonal allergic rhinitis. The pipeline also includes CMG901 (Claudin 18.2 ADC, out-licensed to AstraZeneca as AZD0901) and CM336 (BCMA×CD3 bispecific, acquired by Gilead). FY2025 revenue was ~CNY 720 million (+67% YoY); R&D spend ~CNY 720 million.

companies.description_en: Jiangxi Keyuan Biopharm Co., Ltd. is located in Jishan Chemical Industrial Zone, Pengze County, Jiangxi. (SZSE: 301281) engages in the R&D, production, and sale of chemical APIs and formulations, with a portfolio spanning hypoglycaemic agents, anaesthesia drugs, cardiovascular treatments, and psychiatric medications. (NEEQ: 831186) is a Zhuhai-based integrated pharmaceutical manufacturer specialising in oral and injectable cephalosporins, analgesic/anti-inflammatory agents, cardiovascular drugs, and traditional Chinese medicine. companies.name_zh: 开拓药业集团股份有限公司

companies.description_en: Kintor Pharmaceutical Limited (HKEX: 9939) is a Suzhou-based clinical-stage biotech focused on androgen receptor (AR)-targeted innovative medicines. Lead dermatology asset KX-826 (5α-reductase/AR dual inhibitor for androgenetic alopecia) completed Phase III with top-line results in March 2026; NDA to NMPA expected in 2026. GT20029, a topical PROTAC for AGA and acne, is in Phase II. FY2024 revenue was CNY 5 million; company has 123 employees.

sources.title: Phase 3 enrollment KX-826 1.0% for AGA – Kintor Pharmaceutical

companies.name_zh: 科福医疗技术股份有限公司

(SZSE: 301087) is a Changsha-based manufacturer and distributor of professional home-care medical devices including blood pressure monitors, glucose meters, pulse oximeters, nebulisers, oxygen concentrators, and thermometers. companies.name_zh: 来凯医药科技股份有限公司

companies.description_en: Laekna, Inc. (HKEX: 2105) is a Shanghai Zhangjiang-based clinical-stage biotech focused on oncology, metabolic diseases, and liver fibrosis. Core asset LAE002 (afuresertib, oral AKT inhibitor, licensed from Novartis) is in a Phase III pivotal trial (AFFIRM-205) in China for HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer, with NDA submission targeted for H1 2026. As of December 31 2024, cash and bank balances were CNY 800 million; operating cash burn CNY 278 million. FY2024 revenue minimal (pre-commercialisation); 83 employees.

FY2024 revenue was CNY 367.8 million (+63% YoY); 710 employees.

companies.name_en: Shaanxi Panlong Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 陕西盘龙药业是深交所上市的中成药集团，以盘龙七片为核心独家专利品种（骨骼肌肉系统风湿性疾病），同时布局骨松宝片、痛风舒片等风湿骨病产品集群，兼营中药饮片。2024年营收9.74亿元（同比降0.71%），净利润1.20亿元（同比增8.91%）。
companies.description_en: Shaanxi Panlong Pharmaceutical Group is a SZSE-listed Chinese patent medicine company headquartered in Xi'an, Shaanxi (note: the company's registration is Shaanxi-based, not Yunnan). Its flagship product Panlong Qi Tablet is a nationally exclusive patented drug in the rheumatic-orthopedic category. The portfolio also includes Gusonbao Tablet and Tongfengshu Tablet. FY2024 revenue was CNY 974M (-0.7% YoY) with net profit CNY 120M (+8.9% YoY).

sources.title: 盘龙药业：2024年净利润同比增长8.91%
Shaanxi Panlong Pharmaceutical Group (SZSE:002864) – Simply Wall St

companies.name_zh: 派格生物医药（杭州）股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 派格生物是杭州创新型生物制药公司，专注代谢性疾病（T2DM、肥胖、NASH）创新肽类和小分子药物研发。核心产品PB-119为每周一次GLP-1受体激动剂，已完成III期临床并于2025年进入NMPA补充审评。2025年5月在港交所主板挂牌（2565）。公司目前无营收，处于研发阶段。
companies.description_en: PegBio is a Hangzhou-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on innovative peptide and small-molecule therapies for metabolic diseases including T2DM, obesity, and NASH. Its lead asset PB-119, a once-weekly GLP-1 receptor agonist, completed Phase III trials and entered NMPA supplementary review in May 2025. PegBio listed on HKEX Main Board in May 2025 (ticker 2565) and remains pre-revenue with 58 employees.

companies.name_zh: 沛嘉医疗科技（苏州）有限公司（沛嘉医疗）
companies.description_zh: 沛嘉医疗是苏州领先的结构性心脏病和神经介入医疗器械公司，旗下TAVR（经导管主动脉瓣置换）系统在中国市场占约25%份额（经股TAVR细分）。2024年营收6.15亿元（同比增39.5%），神经介入业务首次实现全年盈利，净亏损持续收窄至2.29亿元。
companies.description_en: Peijia Medical is a Suzhou-based structural heart disease and neurointerventional medical device company. Its TAVR portfolio holds ~25% of China's transfemoral TAVR market. In FY2024, revenue grew 39.5% YoY to CNY 615M; the neurointerventional segment achieved its first full-year profitability, while total net loss narrowed 41.8% YoY to CNY 229M. R&D investment CNY 203M reflects ongoing pipeline expansion.

companies.name_zh: 北京华脉泰科医疗器械股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 北京华脉泰科（NEEQ:874042）是专注血管疾病治疗的高新技术企业，主营主动脉及外周、冠状动脉、神经介入及血管通路领域医疗器械的研发、生产和销售，产品包括主动脉覆膜支架、原位开窗技术装置、可调弯导丝组件、血栓破碎导丝等创新介入器械。2025年4月在NEEQ挂牌（874042）。
companies.description_en: Beijing Percutek Therapeutics (Huamaitaike) is a Beijing-based medical device innovator focused on vascular disease treatment. Its product portfolio spans aortic stent grafts, in-situ fenestration devices, adjustable-steering guidewires, and thrombus-disruption guidewires for aortic, peripheral, coronary, neurointerventional, and vascular access applications. Listed on NEEQ (874042) in April 2025.

sources.title: 华脉泰科 NEEQ: 874042 2025年度报告

companies.name_zh: 南京药石科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 药石科技是南京深交所上市的小分子CDMO及药物分子砌块供应商，提供候选药物筛选、先导化合物优化、工艺开发、注册批生产及商业化量产等全链条服务；同时布局靶蛋白降解剂（PROTAC）、多肽、寡核苷酸、ADC等新型模态。2024年营收16.89亿元（同比降2.12%），净利润2.20亿元（同比增11.2%）。
companies.description_en: PharmaBlock Sciences (Nanjing) is a SZSE-listed small-molecule CDMO and pharmaceutical building-block supplier. Services span candidate screening, lead optimization, process development, GMP manufacturing, and commercialization, with expanding new-modality capabilities (PROTAC, peptide, oligonucleotide, ADC). FY2024 revenue was CNY 1.69B (-2.1% YoY) driven by pricing pressure; net profit rose 11.2% YoY to CNY 220M.

sources.title: 药石科技(300725.SZ)：2024年年报净利润为2.20亿元

companies.name_zh: 苏州沪云新药研发股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Suzhou Pharmavan Co., Ltd. (Huyun New Drug R&D)
companies.description_zh: 苏州沪云（Pharmavan）是新三板挂牌的苏州工业园区新药研发企业，专注心脑血管疾病化学药制剂研发与生产，规模较小（员工约47人），2015年在NEEQ挂牌（833464）。
companies.description_en: Suzhou Pharmavan (Huyun New Drug R&D) is a small NEEQ-listed pharmaceutical R&D company based in Suzhou Industrial Park, focused on cardiovascular and cerebrovascular disease chemical drug preparations. The company has approximately 47 employees and was listed on NEEQ in September 2015.

sources.title: 苏州沪云 NEEQ:833464 2022年度报告

companies.description_zh: 戴赛提克斯是一家全球精准医学数据分析与诊断商业化平台公司，总部位于北爱尔兰贝尔法斯特。其旗舰平台DXRX整合全球实验室网络的真实世界诊断检测数据，帮助生物制药公司加速伴随诊断的商业化落地，2025年收入同比增长20%至3840万英镑并实现盈利。
companies.description_en: Diaceutics is a global precision medicine data analytics and diagnostic commercialisation platform headquartered in Belfast, Northern Ireland. Its flagship DXRX platform aggregates real-world diagnostic testing data from a worldwide network of laboratories, enabling pharma companies to accelerate companion diagnostic commercialisation. In 2025 the company returned to profitability with revenue up 20% to £38.4 million.

sources.title: Diaceutics Returns to Profit on Strong Revenue Growth and Record Order Book
Diaceutics shares rise on upbeat 2025 report card

companies.description_zh: 迪索林是意大利跨国体外诊断公司，总部位于萨卢贾，产品涵盖免疫诊断和分子诊断试剂盒，应用于传染病、骨矿物质疾病、内分泌、肿瘤、胃肠道感染、自身免疫及心脏疾病检测。2025年营收12亿欧元，调整后EBITDA利润率33%。
companies.description_en: DiaSorin is an Italian multinational in vitro diagnostics company headquartered in Saluggia, producing immunodiagnostic and molecular diagnostic reagent kits for infectious diseases, bone and mineral disorders, endocrinology, oncology, gastrointestinal infections, autoimmune and cardiac diseases. 2025 revenue reached €1.195 billion with adjusted EBITDA margin of 33%.

sources.title: DiaSorin SpA Full Year 2025 Earnings Call

companies.description_zh: 迪科特制药是一家瑞典临床阶段生物技术公司，总部位于乌普萨拉，专注于开发治疗勃起功能障碍和早泄的植物源性化合物LIB-01。该公司已完成2a期概念验证研究，显示LIB-01能有效改善勃起功能，计划通过与制药合作伙伴共同推进进一步研发。
companies.description_en: Dicot Pharma is a Swedish clinical-stage biotech headquartered in Uppsala developing LIB-01, a plant-derived compound targeting erectile dysfunction and premature ejaculation. The company completed a Phase 2a proof-of-concept study demonstrating improved erectile function and plans to partner with pharma companies for later-stage development.

sources.title: Dicot Pharma Company Profile - Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: e治疗是一家英国临床前/IND阶段RNAi生物技术公司，总部位于牛津，利用其专有HepNet和GalOmic平台开发高度差异化的RNAi候选药物，重点关注代谢相关性脂肪肝（MASH）、干性年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）和凝血障碍等领域，正在推进首个候选药物ETX-312的IND申报。
companies.description_en: e-Therapeutics is a UK-based RNAi biotech headquartered in Oxford, developing highly differentiated RNA interference candidates using its proprietary HepNet and GalOmic delivery platforms. Lead assets include ETX-312 for MASH, ETX-148 for bleeding disorders, and ETX-407 for dry AMD, all advancing toward IND filing.

sources.title: e-therapeutics Announces Business Updates and Interim Results

companies.name_zh: 埃扎基巴什医药工业与金融投资股份公司
companies.name_en: EİS Eczacıbaşı İlaç, Sınai ve Finansal Yatırımlar Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş.
companies.description_zh: EİS是土耳其埃扎基巴什集团旗下控股子公司，通过子公司、联营公司和合资企业从事医药、兽药、个人护理品及房地产开发业务。医药业务覆盖人类健康和兽医药品，同时持有Eczacıbaşı多个制药和健康子公司的股权。
companies.description_en: EİS is the pharmaceutical and industrial investment holding arm of the Eczacıbaşı Group of Turkey, operating through subsidiaries, affiliates, and joint ventures in human health medicines, veterinary products, personal care products, and real estate development. It is listed on Borsa Istanbul and is the parent holding for the group's pharma activities.

sources.title: Eczacıbaşı Pharmaceutical and Industrial Investment Co. FAQ

companies.sub_sector: Pharmaceutical holding (generic drugs, personal care, veterinary)

companies.description_zh: 伊甸研究是一家专注于可持续生物农药和生物防治技术的英国公司，总部位于牛津郡阿宾顿。公司基于萜类植物活性成分开发微囊化环保解决方案，主要产品包括Mevalone（叶面生物杀菌剂）和Cedroz，目标市场为全球农用化学品和动物健康行业。2025年预期收入同比增长约16%。
companies.description_en: Eden Research is a UK biopesticide and biocontrol technology company headquartered in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, developing terpene-based, naturally-occurring encapsulated solutions for the global agrochemicals, animal health, and consumer products industries. Key products include Mevalone (biofungicide) and Cedroz. Revenue expected to grow approximately 16% in FY2025.

sources.title: Eden Research reports strong growth in 2024 eyes further expansion in 2025

companies.description_zh: 埃格提斯治疗（前身为PledPharma AB）是一家瑞典罕见病制药公司，总部位于斯德哥尔摩，专注于孤儿药开发与商业化。旗舰产品Emcitate®（tiratricol）用于治疗MCT8缺乏症，2025年2月获欧盟批准，5月在德国商业上市，2025年产品收入同比增长40%至6230万瑞典克朗，同时正向FDA滚动提交NDA。
companies.description_en: Egetis Therapeutics (formerly PledPharma AB) is a Swedish rare disease pharma company headquartered in Stockholm focused on developing and commercialising orphan drugs. Lead product Emcitate® (tiratricol) for MCT8 deficiency received EU approval in February 2025, launched commercially in Germany in May 2025, and generated SEK 62.3 million (40% growth) in 2025 product revenue. A rolling NDA submission to FDA was completed in January 2026.

sources.title: Egetis Therapeutics Highlights Rare Disease Focus in 2025 Annual Report

companies.description_zh: 表观基因组学是一家德国分子诊断公司，总部位于柏林，专注于利用DNA甲基化技术检测血液中的癌症标志物。其主要产品Epi proColon®是首个FDA批准的结直肠癌血液筛查检测。2023年New Day Diagnostics以980万美元收购了其核心资产，公司目前仅保留极少量运营规模。
companies.description_en: Epigenomics AG is a German molecular diagnostics company based in Berlin focused on blood-based cancer detection using DNA methylation technology. Its lead product Epi proColon® was the first FDA-approved blood-based test for colorectal cancer screening. In October 2023 New Day Diagnostics acquired substantially all assets for $9.8 million; the listed shell retains minimal operations.

sources.title: New Day Diagnostics to Acquire Epigenomics AG Assets

companies.description_zh: EQL制药是一家总部位于瑞典隆德的专科仿制药公司，专注于为北欧及欧洲市场提供利基仿制处方药。公司已在北欧市场上市超过47种利基仿制药，另有50种产品在研管线，2024/25财年（4月-3月）收入同比增长约45%至约3.68亿瑞典克朗，EBITDA利润率达25%。
companies.description_en: EQL Pharma is a Lund-based specialist niche generics company supplying Nordic and European markets with prescription medicines with limited competition. With over 47 niche generics launched and a pipeline of 50 products, the company achieved approximately 45% revenue growth in fiscal year 2024/25 (April–March) to approximately SEK 368 million, with an EBITDA margin of 25%.

companies.description_zh: 艾戈美德是一家全球临床研究和药物警戒服务提供商，总部位于英国吉尔福德。公司通过临床研究服务（CRO）和药物警戒（PV）两大部门，在100多个国家提供服务。2023年9月被私募股权公司Permira以约7.031亿英镑完成私有化收购，此前在伦敦证券交易所上市。
companies.description_en: Ergomed is a global provider of specialist clinical research and pharmacovigilance services headquartered in Guildford, UK, operating through Clinical Research Services (CRO) and Pharmacovigilance (PV) segments across 100+ countries. The company was taken private by Permira in a £703 million acquisition completed November 2023 and is no longer publicly traded.

companies.description_zh: 埃夫根制药（现更名为TheraCryf PLC）是一家英国临床阶段药物开发公司，总部位于内阿尔德利，旗下拥有萝卜硫素磺胺平台（SFX-01/Sulforadex）和通过收购Chronos Therapeutics获得的Orexin-1项目。公司2025财年（至3月）通过定向增发筹集520万英镑，将Ox-1项目推进至临床就绪阶段，现金跑道延至2026年Q4。
companies.description_en: Evgen Pharma (now renamed TheraCryf PLC) is a UK clinical-stage drug developer headquartered in Nether Alderley with a sulforaphane platform (SFX-01/Sulforadex) and an Orexin-1 (Ox-1) programme acquired via Chronos Therapeutics. FY25 gross fundraising of £5.2 million extends cash runway to Q4 2026 while Ox-1 advances to clinical readiness.

sources.title: TheraCryf FY25 Results: Focus on Ox-1

companies.description_zh: ExpreS2ion生物技术是一家丹麦临床阶段生物技术公司，总部位于赫尔辛格，旗下持有Hørsholm运营子公司ExpreS2ion Biotechnologies ApS，依托其专有ExpreS2™蛋白质表达平台（品牌名GlycoX-S2）快速开发复杂疫苗和免疫治疗蛋白。先导资产包括HER2乳腺癌治疗性疫苗ES2B-C001（I期）及疟疾、CMV、尼帕病毒等多个感染性疾病疫苗项目。
companies.description_en: ExpreS2ion Biotech Holding AB is a Danish clinical-stage biotech listed in Stockholm, operating through its fully-owned Danish subsidiary ExpreS2ion Biotechnologies ApS in Hørsholm. Its proprietary ExpreS2™ protein expression platform (branded GlycoX-S2) enables rapid development of complex vaccines and immunotherapy proteins. Lead assets include HER2 therapeutic breast cancer vaccine ES2B-C001 (Phase I) and vaccine programs for malaria, CMV, and Nipah virus.

companies.description_zh: 法厄斯制药是一家总部位于西班牙莱奥阿（比斯开）的跨国制药公司，成立于1933年，已在马德里交易所上市数十年。旗舰产品比拉斯汀（bilastine）是一种非镇静性第二代抗组胺药，在逾70个国家销售，2025年销售额达1.34亿欧元。2025年公司制药业务收入同比增长21%至5.517亿欧元，并以2.7亿欧元收购意大利眼科公司SIFI，系其历史最大并购。
companies.description_en: Faes Farma is a Spanish multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Leioa, Bizkaia, founded in 1933. Its flagship product bilastine is a non-sedating second-generation antihistamine marketed in over 70 countries, generating €134 million in 2025 sales. Pharmaceutical revenues grew 21% to €551.7 million in 2025; the company acquired Italian ophthalmic company SIFI for €270 million, its largest-ever deal.

companies.description_zh: 法隆制药是一家总部位于芬兰图尔库的临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于开发靶向Clever-1（STABILIN-1）的大分子免疫肿瘤疗法。先导抗体bexmarilimab通过重编程肿瘤微环境激活抗肿瘤免疫反应，2025年在BEXMAB试验（MDS/AML）中取得高风险MDS 45%完全缓解率、中位总生存期14.5个月的重要数据，并与FDA完成2期后会议。
companies.description_en: Faron Pharmaceuticals is a Finnish clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in Turku focused on macrophage-targeted cancer immunotherapy. Lead antibody bexmarilimab targets Clever-1 to reprogram the tumour microenvironment. In 2025 the BEXMAB trial in HR-MDS/AML achieved 45% complete remission rate in treatment-naive patients and median OS of 14.5 months in R/R patients; an End-of-Phase 2 meeting with FDA was completed.

companies.description_zh: 荧光导引是一家丹麦临床阶段医疗技术公司，总部位于哥本哈根，开发靶向uPAR的近红外荧光引导手术探针FG001，旨在术中精确标记癌细胞以提高切除精度。先导适应症为胶质母细胞瘤和口腔头颈部癌症。2025年FDA批准IND申请，获奥林巴斯（内镜成像）和蔡司（手术显微镜）两大战略合作，并完成1.04亿瑞典克朗定向增发。
companies.description_en: FluoGuide is a Danish clinical-stage medtech company in Copenhagen developing FG001, a uPAR-targeted near-infrared fluorescence imaging probe to improve surgical precision by illuminating cancer cells intraoperatively. Lead indications are glioblastoma and head & neck cancer. In 2025 FDA cleared the IND, strategic partnerships with Olympus and ZEISS were signed, and SEK 104 million was raised via directed share issue.

companies.description_zh: 福美康是一家总部位于德国马丁斯里德（慕尼黑近郊）的独立生物类似药专家，拥有从开发到上市许可的完整生物类似药研发平台。已批准产品包括FYB201（雷珠单抗类似药，已在20个国家上市）、FYB202（乌司奴单抗类似药）和FYB203（阿柏西普类似药，FDA/EMA已批准）。开发管线还有FYB206（帕博利珠单抗类似药）和FYB208（度普利尤单抗类似药）等四个候选药物。
companies.description_en: Formycon AG is an independent biosimilars specialist headquartered in Martinsried near Munich, with a complete biosimilar development platform from development to marketing authorisation. Approved products include FYB201/Cimerli (ranibizumab, available in 20 countries), FYB202 (ustekinumab) and FDA/EMA-approved FYB203 (aflibercept). Pipeline includes FYB206 (pembrolizumab) and FYB208 (dupilumab) among four candidates.

companies.description_zh: 未来医疗是一家总部位于英国吉尔福德的消费者健康公司，核心产品为Eroxon（MED2005），一种用于治疗勃起功能障碍的非处方局部凝胶，已在欧洲和美国获批上市。2025年在25个国家相继推出，但消费者使用量和复购率显著低于预期，全年收入约130-140万英镑。公司同时持有女性性健康项目WSD4000。
companies.description_en: Futura Medical is a Guildford-based consumer healthcare company behind Eroxon (MED2005), an OTC topical gel for erectile dysfunction approved in Europe and the US. Launched in up to 25 countries in H1 2025, consumer uptake lagged expectations; full-year 2025 revenue came in at approximately £1.3–1.4 million. The company also holds WSD4000 for female sexual health.

sources.title: Futura Medical lifts full-year revenue forecast

companies.description_zh: 吉迪恩·里克特是中欧最大的制药企业之一，总部位于匈牙利布达佩斯，成立于1901年。公司专注于女性健康（避孕/妇产科）、中枢神经系统、生物类似药（免疫学/肌肉骨骼）和仿制药领域，产品销往全球100余个国家。2025年制药营收达9290亿匈牙利福林（同比增长8%），市值47.5亿欧元，员工逾1.16万人。
companies.description_en: Gedeon Richter is one of Central Europe's largest pharmaceutical companies, founded in Budapest in 1901. The company has strong positions in women's health (contraception/gynecology), CNS, biosimilars (immunology/musculoskeletal), and generics, with products sold in over 100 countries. 2025 pharmaceutical revenues reached HUF 929 billion (8% growth), market capitalisation EUR 4.8 billion, and employees exceed 11,600.

sources.title: Gedeon Richter Annual Report 2025 Non-Official Draft

companies.name_zh: 平安健康医疗科技有限公司
companies.name_en: Ping An Healthcare and Technology Company Limited
companies.description_zh: 平安健康医疗科技（平安好医生）是中国领先的互联网医疗健康平台，提供在线问诊、慢病管理、企业健康管理及医险协同等服务，依托平安集团生态持续向B端和F端转型。
companies.description_en: Ping An Healthcare and Technology (Ping An Good Doctor) operates China's leading internet healthcare platform, offering online consultations, chronic disease management, corporate health management, and insurance-linked health services, leveraging the Ping An Group ecosystem.

companies.name_zh: 深圳普瑞金生物药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 深圳普瑞金生物药业专注于CAR-T和CAR-NK细胞与基因治疗药物研发，管线覆盖血液肿瘤、实体瘤及自身免疫疾病；已与Dr. Reddy's和CellPoint签署抗BCMA CAR-T（PRG-1801）授权合作。
companies.description_en: Pregene Biopharma is a clinical-stage cell and gene therapy company developing CAR-T and CAR-NK therapeutics for hematological malignancies, solid tumors, and autoimmune diseases. Its lead asset PRG-1801 (anti-BCMA CAR-T) is out-licensed to Dr. Reddy's (India) and CellPoint (EU/US).

companies.name_zh: 普蕊斯（上海）医药科技开发股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 普蕊斯（SMO ClinPlus）是中国领先的临床试验现场管理组织（SMO），为制药、医疗器械和健康领域提供临床试验点管理、可行性评估、项目管理等综合服务。
companies.description_en: SMO ClinPlus is China's leading site management organization (SMO), providing clinical trial site management, feasibility research, center identification, on-site execution, and project management services to pharma, biotech, and medical device companies.

companies.name_zh: 普利制药股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Pruli Pharmaceutical (Hainan Poly Pharm) Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 普利制药（海南）主营化学原料药及制剂的研发、生产和销售，产品涵盖API、造影剂、抗肿瘤制剂，积极推进国际化战略。注：公司因虚增收入被证监会立案调查，2024年报披露受延迟。
companies.description_en: Pruli Pharmaceutical (Hainan Poly Pharm) focuses on R&D, production, and sale of active pharmaceutical ingredients and formulations including contrast agents and anti-tumor compounds. Note: under CSRC investigation for revenue inflation; 2024 annual report filing was delayed.

companies.name_zh: 普迈（杭州）医疗科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 普迈医疗专注于糖尿病护理（胰岛素笔针、血糖针）、通用药物输注及微创介入医疗器械的研发、生产与销售，产品已通过FDA注册，在全球多市场销售。
companies.description_en: Promisemed Hangzhou Meditech develops, produces, and sells medical devices for diabetes care (insulin pen needles, blood lancets), universal drug delivery/infusion, and minimally invasive interventional procedures. Products hold FDA clearances and are sold globally.

companies.name_zh: 太平洋双林生物制药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 太平洋双林生物制药专注于血液制品的研发、生产与销售，主要产品包括人血白蛋白、静脉注射人免疫球蛋白、乙型肝炎人免疫球蛋白、破伤风人免疫球蛋白等，在国内浆站规模持续扩张。
companies.description_en: Pacific Shuanglin Bio-pharmacy engages in the R&D, production, and sale of plasma-derived blood products in China and internationally, with key products including human serum albumin, IVIG, hepatitis B immunoglobulin, tetanus immunoglobulin, and rabies immunoglobulin.

companies.name_zh: 深圳普门科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 普门科技是STAR市场上市的医疗器械企业，主营IVD（糖化血红蛋白HPLC/ECLIA、血细胞分析）、治疗康复（呼吸机、ICU设备、冲击波）及皮肤医美设备；2024年IVD业务占收入~79%。
companies.description_en: Pumen Technology is a STAR-Market listed medtech company offering IVD diagnostics (glycated hemoglobin HPLC/ECLIA, hematology), therapeutic/rehabilitation devices (respiratory, ICU, shockwave), and skin aesthetics equipment. IVD represented ~79% of 2024 revenue.

sources.title: 普门科技2024年营收情况分析

companies.description_zh: 培力农本方专注于浓缩中药颗粒（CCMG）及中医保健产品的研发、生产与销售，业务覆盖香港、中国内地及海外，设有自有中药材种植基地及多家中医诊所。
companies.description_en: PuraPharm specializes in the R&D, production, and sale of concentrated Chinese medicine granules (CCMG) and Chinese healthcare products across Hong Kong, mainland China, and international markets, with vertically integrated plantation and clinic operations.

sources.title: PuraPharm Reports Reduced Losses Amid Revenue Decline in 2024

companies.name_zh: 明亮视界医疗股份有限公司（成都明亮眼科）
companies.name_en: Bright Eye Hospital Group Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 明亮眼科（原成都明亮眼科）是国内领先的眼科专科连锁医疗机构，提供屈光手术、白内障、青光眼、斜弱视及眼底病等全线诊疗服务，已于2025年6月更名为明亮视界医疗股份有限公司。
companies.description_en: Bright Eye Hospital Group is a leading ophthalmology specialty chain in China, offering a full range of services including refractive surgery, cataract, glaucoma, strabismus, pediatric ophthalmology, and retinal disease. Renamed from 'Chengdu Bright Eye' to 'Bright Eye Hospital Group' in June 2025.

sources.title: Purui Bright Eye Hospital China Life Investment

companies.name_zh: 株洲千金药业股份有限公司

companies.description_en: Qianjin Pharmaceutical is a longstanding Hunan pharmaceutical company known for its traditional Chinese medicine (gynecology, orthopaedic series) and branded healthcare products. Also operates pharmaceutical wholesale and retail channels.

companies.name_zh: 山西振东健康产业集团股份有限公司（山西前元）

companies.description_en: ShanXi C&Y Pharmaceutical Group (formerly Qianyuan Pharmaceutical) is a mid-sized Shanxi pharmaceutical company focused on R&D, production, and marketing of chemical drug formulations (anti-infective, anti-allergic, respiratory) and health food products.

companies.name_en: Beijing Qihuang Traditional Chinese Medicine Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 北京岐黄医药股份有限公司，成立于2000年，2016年挂牌新三板（837007），注册于北京市平谷区，主营中成药（中药配方颗粒等）的生产与销售，属中药制造行业分类。
companies.description_en: Beijing Qihuang Traditional Chinese Medicine Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and listed on the NEEQ in April 2016 (ticker 837007). Headquartered in Pinggu District, Beijing, the company is classified in the Chinese patent medicine manufacturing industry.

companies.name_zh: 西藏奇正藏药股份有限公司

companies.description_en: Tibet Cheezheng (Qizheng) is the leading Tibetan medicine company in China, with core products in pain-relief plasters and Tibetan medicine formulations covering orthopedics, neurology, dermatology, and gynecology. 2024 revenue was CNY 2.34 bn; flagship pain patch series generated CNY 1.6 bn.

companies.name_zh: 河南全宇制药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 河南全宇制药是位于南召工业园区的中小型综合制药企业，主营口服液、片剂、软膏等制剂及中成药的生产销售，产品包括西咪替丁片、维生素B1片、四环素片等。原名南阳全宇制药，2014年改制并更名。
companies.description_en: Henan Quanyu Pharmaceutical is a small-cap generic drug producer in Nanzhao Industrial Park, Henan. It manufactures oral solutions, tablets, ointments and Chinese patent medicines including cimetidine tablets, vitamin B1 tablets, and tetracycline tablets.

sources.title: Henan Quanyu Pharmaceutical Profile on Pharmacompass

companies.name_zh: 江苏荃信生物医药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 荃信生物是专注于自身免疫和过敏性疾病生物治疗药物研发的生物技术公司，管线以IL-17A抑制剂QX002N（强直性脊柱炎、狼疮性肾炎，Ⅲ期）和IL-4Rα阻断抗体QX005N（结节性痒疹，Ⅲ期）为主，2024年营收同比大幅增长。
companies.description_en: Qyuns Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company developing biologic therapies for autoimmune and allergic diseases. Its pipeline is led by QX002N (IL-17A inhibitor, Ph3 for ankylosing spondylitis/lupus nephritis) and QX005N (IL-4Rα blocker, Ph3 for prurigo nodularis).

companies.description_en: Sichuan Rekind Medtec is a PW Medtech spin-off (listed on NEEQ in September 2024) specializing in blood purification medical devices including hemodialyzers, hemoperfusion devices, hemodialysis machines, and CRRT circuits. Holds 73 patents and operates an independent hollow-fiber production line.

sources.title: Wilson Sonsini advises on Rekind Medtec spin-off

companies.name_zh: 深圳瑞思普利生物制药股份有限公司

companies.description_en: Resproly Biopharmaceutical is a clinical-stage company developing inhalation drug formulations and delivery devices (MDI, DPI, nebulizer, nasal spray) for respiratory diseases (asthma, COPD) and neurological conditions (Parkinson's, migraine). Completed a CNY 50M Series A financing.

sources.title: Resproly Drug Pipelines & Patents on Synapse

companies.description_zh: 新乡瑞诚科技股份有限公司成立于2000年2月，主营医药中间体及核苷类原料药的研发、生产和销售，产品涵盖核苷类抗病毒原料药、培哚普利原料药及维生素。公司在新乡和新疆设有生产基地，在上海设有研发中心，2016年登陆新三板。
companies.description_en: Xinxiang Ruicheng Technology Co., Ltd. (NEEQ: 836437), founded in February 2000, specialises in the R&D, production and sale of pharmaceutical intermediates and nucleoside APIs covering antiviral nucleoside APIs, perindopril APIs and vitamins. The company operates production bases in Xinxiang (Henan) and Xinjiang, plus an R&D centre in Shanghai; it has been NEEQ-listed since April 2016.

(NEEQ: 839881), established April 2010 in Shenzhen's Futian District, manufactures and distributes Class I and II home medical devices including blood pressure monitors, thermometers, infrared thermometers, nebulisers and blood glucose meters, and provides health consultation and tele-health management services.

revenue.note_en: FY2024 operating revenue RMB 7.966B (-0.85% YoY); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 20.6M (+1.50% YoY)

companies.description_zh: 江苏赛康医疗设备股份有限公司成立于2002年，是国内医院病房家具与护理设备的知名供应商，产品涵盖医疗病床、ICU床、护理床、手术台及医院家具等，已通过ISO 9001/13485/14001及欧盟CE、美国FDA等认证，拥有专利175项，在全球设有7家子公司、20个办事处。

(NEEQ: 870098), founded 2002, is a leading Chinese manufacturer of hospital ward furniture and nursing equipment including hospital beds, ICU beds, operating tables and related medical furniture. The company holds 175 patents and certifications including ISO 13485, CE and US FDA, operating globally with 7 subsidiaries and 20 offices.

Pursuing AI-driven digital transformation.

companies.name_zh: 北京赛升药业股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Beijing Science Sun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 北京赛升药业股份有限公司（SZSE: 300485）成立于1999年，总部位于北京经济技术开发区，主营注射剂类生物生化药品的研发、生产和销售，核心品种涵盖心脑血管（纤溶酶注射液）、免疫调节（薄芝糖肽注射液）、神经系统（GM1）等领域。2024年营业收入4.16亿元（同比下降12.61%），净亏损6885万元。
companies.description_en: Beijing Science Sun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 300485), founded 1999 in Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area, is a biopharmaceutical company developing and commercialising injectable biologics and biochemical drugs for cardiovascular (Fibrinolysin injection), immunomodulation (BTGP injection) and neuroscience (GM1) indications. 2024 revenue CNY 416 mn (down 12.61% YoY); net loss CNY 68.9 mn; R&D spend CNY 130 mn.

sources.title: 赛升药业2024年财报：营收下滑12.61%，净利润亏损6885万元 – 腾讯新闻
About Beijing Science Sun Pharmaceutical Co Ltd – Investing.com

companies.name_zh: 山东赛托生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 山东赛托生物科技股份有限公司（SZSE: 300583）成立于2002年，位于山东菏泽，是国内甾体药物中间体及原料药领域的领先企业，运用合成生物学与微生物转化技术规模化生产甾体药物原料，为心血管、免疫调节等多领域制药企业提供核心中间体。2024年实现营业收入9.71亿元（同比下降约24.2%）。
companies.description_en: Shandong Saito Bio-technology Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 300583), founded 2002 in Heze, Shandong, is China's leading steroid pharmaceutical intermediate and API producer. Using synthetic biology and microbial transformation technology, the company supplies key steroid intermediates for cardiovascular, immunomodulatory and respiratory drugs. 2024 revenue CNY 971 mn (down ~24.2% YoY due to price declines).

sources.title: 赛托生物：2024年年度报告 – 新浪财经
山东赛托生物科技股份有限公司2023年年度报告 – 官网

companies.name_zh: 三爱健康产业集团有限公司
companies.name_en: Sanai Health Industry Group Company Limited
companies.description_zh: 三爱健康产业集团有限公司（HKEX: 1889）是一家在香港上市的控股公司，通过子公司从事品牌处方药、非处方药及中成药的研发、生产、营销和销售，同时提供融资租赁服务。公司规模较小，2024年实现收入约8522万元人民币（同比下降约20.9%），员工约160人。
companies.description_en: Sanai Health Industry Group Company Limited (HKEX: 1889) is a Hong Kong-listed investment holding company engaged in the manufacture, marketing and sale of branded prescription and OTC drugs and Chinese pharmaceutical products in mainland China and Hong Kong, also providing finance leasing services. 2024 revenue CNY 85.2 mn (down ~20.9% YoY); ~160 employees; market cap ~HKD 41.3 mn.

companies.name_zh: 三博脑科医院管理集团股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Sanbo Brain Hospital Management Group Limited
companies.description_zh: 三博脑科医院管理集团股份有限公司（SZSE: 301293）成立于2003年，是国内首家上市的私立神经专科医院管理集团，总部位于北京，旗下运营6家医院（含2家在建），年门诊量近50万人次、住院4万余人次、手术超1万台。2024年实现营业收入14.29亿元（同比增长8.84%），归母净利润1.053亿元（同比增长34.24%）。
companies.description_en: Sanbo Brain Hospital Management Group Limited (SZSE: 301293), founded 2003 in Beijing, is China's first listed private neurology specialty hospital group. Operating six hospitals (two under construction) with >1,500 beds, ~500,000 outpatient visits and >10,000 surgeries per year. 2024 revenue CNY 1.43 bn (+8.84% YoY); net profit CNY 105 mn (+34.24% YoY); ~2,646 employees.

sources.title: 三博脑科医院管理集团股份有限公司2024年年度报告全文
三博脑科2024年营收、净利双增长 加速全国神经专科网络布局 – 新浪财经

companies.name_zh: 阳光诺和药业（上海）股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 阳光诺和药业（上海）股份有限公司（STAR: 688336），即原上海CP国健药业，是3SBio集团旗下专注抗体药物的生物类似药龙头企业。公司专注于单克隆抗体和生物类似药的研发、生产和销售，已在中国、美国、欧洲推广贝伐珠单抗生物类似药等多个品种，并与多个全球合作伙伴签署许可协议（涉及5个品种约14项授权）。2024年实现营收约6.42亿元，net profit大幅增长，公司于2025年5月将SSGJ-707双抗以超10亿美元的价格授权辉瑞。
companies.description_en: Sunshine Guojian Pharmaceutical (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. (STAR Market: 688336), a subsidiary of Hong Kong-listed 3SBio Group, is a leading China biosimilar developer and manufacturer of antibody drugs. The company has commercially launched bevacizumab biosimilar and other antibody biosimilars in China, the US and Europe, signing ~14 licence-out deals across 5 products globally. 2024 revenue CNY 642 mn (+7.6% YoY); net profit up sharply. In May 2025, licensed SSGJ-707 bispecific antibody (PD-1/VEGF) to Pfizer in a deal valued at USD 1.25 bn upfront.

sources.title: SSE STAR Market Pharma Company Sets New Record in Global Expansion – SSE

companies.name_zh: 江西三鑫医疗科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 江西三鑫医疗科技股份有限公司（SZSE: 300453）成立于1997年，总部位于江西南昌，专注于血液净化（透析）医疗器械的研发、生产和销售，血液净化产品2024年实现收入12.17亿元，占总营收81%，海外业务同比增长39.70%。2024年公司实现营业总收入约15亿元（同比增长15.41%），归母净利润2.27亿元（同比增长10.05%）。
companies.description_en: Jiangxi Sanxin Medtec Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 300453), founded 1997 in Nanchang, Jiangxi, is a leading Chinese medical device maker specialised in blood purification (haemodialysis) consumables and equipment. Blood purification products contributed CNY 1.22 bn (81% of revenue) in 2024. 2024 total revenue CNY 1.50 bn (+15.41% YoY); net profit CNY 227 mn (+10.05% YoY); overseas revenue +39.7% YoY.

sources.title: 内地海外市场双开花 三鑫医疗2024年营收净利稳健增长 – 证券时报
三鑫医疗(300453.SZ)：2024年年报净利润为2.27亿元 – 界面新闻

companies.name_zh: 北京三元基因药业股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Beijing Tri-Prime Gene Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 北京三元基因药业股份有限公司（北交所: 837344）成立于1992年9月，是中国首个具有自主知识产权的基因工程一类新药——重组人干扰素α1b（运德素）的研发和生产企业，已在全球6000余家等级医院终端实现准入。公司还布局γδT细胞治疗、新型聚乙二醇干扰素突变体及胶原蛋白系列产品。2024年实现营业收入约2.57亿元（同比增长4.83%），研发投入4366万元，占收入17.02%。
companies.description_en: Beijing Tri-Prime Gene Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (BSE: 837344), founded September 1992, developed and markets China's first class-1 proprietary gene-engineering drug — recombinant human interferon α1b (Yundeosu), now approved at >6,000 graded hospitals. The pipeline includes γδT-cell therapy, pegylated novel IFN mutants and collagen cosmeceuticals. 2024 revenue CNY 257 mn (+4.83% YoY); R&D CNY 43.7 mn (17.0% of revenue).

sources.title: 三元基因2024年报：新产品新技术 AI贯穿产品开发及生产环节 – 医药魔方
三元基因：2024年年度报告 – 新浪财经

companies.name_zh: 乐普心泰医疗科技（上海）股份有限公司
companies.name_en: LEPU ScienTech Medical Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 乐普心泰聚焦结构性心脏病介入治疗器械，主要产品为先天性心脏病封堵器（房间隔缺损、室间隔缺损、动脉导管未闭、卵圆孔未闭、左心耳封堵器）及心脏瓣膜产品，是乐普医疗旗下港股上市子公司。
companies.description_en: LEPU ScienTech develops and manufactures interventional occluders for congenital heart disease (ASD, VSD, PDA, PFO, left atrial appendage) and transcatheter heart valves. It is a Hong Kong-listed subsidiary of Lepu Medical Technology (Beijing).

companies.name_zh: 江苏森轩药业有限公司（含南通晶华）
companies.name_en: Jiangsu Senxuan Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (incl. Nantong Jinghua Senxuan)
companies.description_zh: 江苏森轩药业成立于2003年，总部位于南通，专注于抗肿瘤API、解热镇痛抗炎API、抗癫痫API及含氧杂环中间体的研发、生产与销售，旗下含南通晶华等多家子公司，在南通、山东、宁夏设有生产基地。
companies.description_en: Jiangsu Senxuan Pharmaceutical (est. 2003, Nantong) manufactures anti-tumor APIs, antipyretic/analgesic/anti-inflammatory APIs, anti-epileptic APIs, and oxygen-containing heterocyclic chemical intermediates. It operates multiple subsidiaries including Nantong Jinghua and has production sites in Jiangsu, Shandong, and Ningxia.

companies.name_zh: 上海先声药业控股有限公司
companies.description_zh: 上海先声控股是进口药品及医疗器械在华综合营销推广服务商，覆盖眼科、疼痛管理、胃肠科等领域，为外资原研药企提供注册、市场推广及渠道管理服务，1996年成立，港交所上市。
companies.description_en: Shanghai Pioneer Holding provides comprehensive marketing, promotion, and channel management services for imported pharmaceutical products and medical devices in China. Its core portfolio covers high-growth areas including ophthalmology, pain management, and gastroenterology, serving originator multinationals.

Shanghai Pioneer Holding Business Overview – Bitget

companies.name_zh: 山东药玻股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 山东药玻是中国最大的药用玻璃包装企业，主营模制瓶、管制瓶、安瓿瓶、输液瓶等药用玻璃及丁基橡胶系列产品，产品出口欧美、日韩、东南亚等50多个国家，1970年成立，沪市主板上市。
companies.description_en: Shandong Pharmaceutical Glass is China's largest pharmaceutical glass packaging manufacturer, producing moulded and tubular vials, ampoules, infusion bottles, and butyl rubber closures. Products are exported to over 50 countries including Europe, the US, Japan, and Korea.

companies.name_zh: 山东华特达因健康股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Shandong Wit Dyne Health Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 山东华特达因健康（原山达华特）成立于1993年，总部济南，主营小儿专用药及成人常用药，核心产品包括阿奇霉素颗粒、维生素AD滴剂、甘草锌颗粒、依帕司他、缬沙坦氢氯噻嗪等，同时涉及环保材料、电子信息产业。
companies.description_en: Shandong Wit Dyne Health (est. 1993, Jinan) focuses on children's specialty drugs and general adult pharmaceuticals, including azithromycin granules, vitamin AD drops, licorice zinc granules, epalrestat, and valsartan/HCTZ combinations. The company also has environmental and electronics segments.

sources.title: Shandong Wit Dyne Financials – Stock Analysis

companies.name_zh: 济南尚博医药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 济南尚博医药成立于2011年，由济南圣泉集团与英国Biosynth合资，专注于糖类、核苷及含氮杂环医药中间体的研发、生产及CDMO服务，已完成300多个研究项目，为客户提供从实验室到商业规模的定制合成服务，2023年在北交所新三板挂牌。
companies.description_en: Jinan Shangbo Pharmaceutical (est. 2011, JV between Jinan Shengquan Group and UK-based Biosynth) provides pharmaceutical intermediate CDMO services specializing in carbohydrates, nucleosides, and heterocyclic scaffolds, covering lab-scale synthesis through commercial production. Listed on NEEQ in October 2023.

sources.title: Jinan Shangbo 2023 Annual Report – Eastmoney NEEQ

companies.name_zh: 上海八通生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 上海八通生物科技成立于1998年，位于上海徐汇区，主营体外诊断试剂的研发、生产与销售，产品涵盖多药联检尿液/唾液毒品检测试剂盒、毛发快速筛查试剂及新冠/流感/RSV多联抗原检测试剂盒，拥有BIO-VENTURE、JSJ、Eva等品牌，于新三板挂牌。
companies.description_en: Shanghai Batong Biotechnology (est. 1998, Xuhui, Shanghai) develops and produces in-vitro diagnostic reagents, specializing in multi-panel drug-of-abuse urine/saliva test kits, hair screening kits, and multiplex respiratory antigen detection kits (COVID-19/RSV/influenza). Brands include BIO-VENTURE, JSJ, and Eva. Listed on NEEQ.

sources.title: Batong Bio 2024 Annual Report – Eastmoney NEEQ

companies.name_zh: 上海康达利医疗集团股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Shanghai Kindly Enterprise Development Group Co., Ltd. (KDL Medical)
companies.description_zh: 上海康达利（KDL）成立于1987年，是国内最大的医用高分子产品制造商之一，主营注射器、输液器、采血管、医用导管等一次性医疗器械，产品出口50余国，沪市主板上市。
companies.description_en: Shanghai Kindly (KDL, est. 1987) is one of China's largest medical polymer products manufacturers, producing syringes, infusion sets, blood collection tubes, and medical tubes sold in over 50 countries. Listed on the SSE Main Board.

companies.name_zh: 上海凯利泰医疗科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 上海凯利泰成立于2005年，专注脊柱及骨科创伤植入物，主营椎体成形、脊柱固定、人工椎间盘及射频消融等产品，深市创业板上市，2024年因市场竞争加剧出现净亏损。
companies.description_en: Shanghai Kinetic Medical (est. 2005) focuses on invasive spinal and orthopedic trauma implants, including kyphoplasty systems, spinal fixation, interlocking intramedullary nails, anatomical bone plates, and radiofrequency ablation devices. Listed on SZSE ChiNext; posted a net loss in 2024.

sources.title: Shanghai Kinetic Medical Financials – Stock Analysis
Shanghai Kinetic Medical Profile – Yahoo Finance

companies.name_zh: 上海第一医药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 上海第一医药创立于1992年，是上海领先的连锁药店零售与批发企业，经营药品、医疗器械、保健品及食品，服务于医疗机构、药店、分销商及加盟店，沪市主板上市。
companies.description_en: Shanghai No.1 Pharmacy (est. 1992) is a leading retail and wholesale pharmaceutical chain in Shanghai, selling medications, medical equipment, health products, and food through its stores and franchise network serving hospitals, pharmacies, and distributors.

sources.title: Shanghai No.1 Pharmacy Overview – Stock Analysis

companies.name_zh: 上海谊众药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 上海谊众成立于2009年，专注抗肿瘤创新制剂，核心产品为紫杉醇聚合物胶束注射液（中国首个紫杉醇胶束制剂，2021年批准，适应证：晚期非小细胞肺癌），2024年11月纳入医保目录，科创板上市。
companies.description_en: Shanghai Yizhong Pharmaceutical (est. 2009) focuses on innovative oncology formulations. Its lead product, paclitaxel polymeric micelle injection, was China's first approved paclitaxel micelle (2021) for advanced NSCLC. Included in the National Medical Insurance Directory in November 2024. Listed on STAR Market.

sources.title: Shanghai Yizhong 2024 Annual Report Summary – China Securities Journal

companies.name_zh: 上海泽生科技开发股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 上海泽生科技成立于2000年，位于张江高科技园区，专注心力衰竭、消化系统平滑肌衰竭及神经系统疾病领域创新药研发，核心管线为重组人纽兰格林（纽卡定，rh-Neuregulin-1）注射液，为潜在First-in-Class心衰生物新药，正在中美开展III期临床研究，已获FDA快速通道资格，新三板创新层挂牌。
companies.description_en: Zensun (est. 2000, Zhangjiang, Shanghai) is a biotech developing first-in-class drugs for heart failure, smooth muscle failure, and neurological diseases. Its lead asset, recombinant human Neuregulin-1 (Neucardin/rh-NRG1), is in Phase 3 trials in China and the US for heart failure (FDA Fast Track). Listed on NEEQ Innovation Tier.

companies.name_zh: 安徽山河药用辅料股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Anhui Sunhere Pharmaceutical Excipients Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 安徽山河药用辅料成立于2001年，是中国领先的药用辅料专业生产企业，主营纤维素类、淀粉类、聚维酮、硬脂酸、包衣粉、树脂及食品添加剂等新型辅料，产品出口多国，深市创业板上市。
companies.description_en: Anhui Sunhere Pharmaceutical Excipients (est. 2001, Huainan) is one of China's leading specialty pharmaceutical excipient manufacturers, producing cellulose derivatives (HPMC, MCC), starch, povidone, stearic acid, coating powders, and resins for domestic and export markets. Listed on SZSE ChiNext.

sources.title: Anhui Sunhere Company Profile – Stock Analysis

companies.name_zh: 重庆山外山血液净化技术股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 重庆山外山（SWS）成立于2001年，是中国血液净化行业领军企业及第一家科创板上市公司，专注血液透析设备（血透机、CRRT）、透析耗材（透析器、管路、透析粉）及连锁透析中心智能管理系统，2024年占中国血透机市场份额约20%，CRRT市场约23.5%，产品出口全球。
companies.description_en: SWS Hemodialysis Care (est. 2001, Chongqing) is China's first STAR Market-listed blood purification company, providing integrated hemodialysis equipment (HD machines, CRRT), consumables, dialysis fluid/powder, and chain dialysis center management systems. Holds ~20% share in China's hemodialysis machine market and ~23.5% in CRRT as of Q3 2024.

companies.name_zh: 山西兰花药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 山西兰花药业是位于晋城的新三板挂牌企业（ST兰药），为大型综合医疗健康企业，业务涵盖化学制剂、化学原料药、保健品及连锁药店，旗下拥有山西兰花太行中药有限公司等子公司，产品包括阿哌沙班片、阿莫西林胶囊等，荣获国家高新技术企业认定。
companies.description_en: Shanxi Lanhua Pharmaceutical (NEEQ: 870936, ST-designated) is a Jincheng-based integrated healthcare company covering chemical preparations, raw APIs, health products, and chain pharmacies. Subsidiaries include Shanxi Lanhua Taihing Chinese Medicine. Products include apixaban tablets and amoxicillin capsules. National high-tech enterprise designation held.

companies.name_zh: 上海申齐医药投资管理股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Shanghai Shenqi Pharmaceutical Investment Management Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 上海申齐医药（原上海实业医药，600613）成立于1990年，是沪市主板上市的医药控股投资管理公司，通过参控股企业从事抗肿瘤、心脑血管、风湿骨痛、镇静安神、妇科等多治疗领域的药品研发与生产，2024年营收约20.5亿元。
companies.description_en: Shanghai Shenqi Pharmaceutical Investment Management (est. 1990, SSE 600613) is a pharmaceutical holding company investing in drug R&D and manufacturing across anti-tumor, cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, rheumatism, sedative, gynecology, and anti-fungal therapeutic areas through its portfolio companies.

companies.name_zh: 沈阳兴齐眼药股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Shenyang Xingqi (Sinqi) Eye Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 沈阳兴齐眼药是中国领先的眼科药物专业企业，主营眼科抗感染、非甾体抗炎、散瞳/睫状肌麻痹、抗青光眼及干眼用药，2024年低浓度阿托品磺酸盐滴眼液（0.01%）获批上市，全年营收达19.4亿元，同比增长32%，深市创业板上市。
companies.description_en: Shenyang Sinqi (Xingqi) Eye Pharmaceutical is China's leading ophthalmic drug company, producing anti-infective, NSAID, mydriatic, anti-glaucoma, and dry eye formulations. Its 0.01% atropine sulfate eye drops for myopia control were approved in March 2024, driving strong revenue growth to CNY 1.94B (+32%) in 2024. Listed on SZSE ChiNext.

companies.name_zh: 深圳市海普瑞药业集团股份有限公司

companies.description_zh: 全球领先的肝素产业链企业，业务覆盖肝素API、制剂（依诺肝素钠）、生物大分子CDMO及创新药投资；在欧美中等市场销售。旗下Techdow Pharma主营欧洲肝素制剂市场。
companies.description_en: A leading multinational biopharma company dual-listed in Hong Kong and Shenzhen, specializing in the vertically-integrated heparin supply chain (API and finished dose), recombinant biomacromolecule CDMO services, and innovative drug commercialization. Products sold in 50+ countries; subsidiaries include Techdow Pharma (Europe/US) and Cytovance Biologics.

companies.name_zh: 中国神威药业集团有限公司

companies.description_en: An investment holding company engaged in the R&D, manufacture, and sale of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) products, including injections, soft capsules, granules, and TCM granules. Key products include Qing Kai Ling Injection, Shen Mai Injection, and Wu Fu Xin Nao Qing Soft Capsule, addressing respiratory, cardiovascular, neurological, and digestive conditions.

revenue.note_zh: 2024年营业收入100.21亿元（同比+0.09%）；归母净利润6.92亿元（同比+5.75%）；制药装备增长、医疗器械板块承压

companies.description_zh: 新华医疗成立于1943年，是综合性医疗器械与制药装备企业，提供感染控制设备（灭菌器）、放疗设备、手术器械、口腔设备、实验室设备、制药生产系统及医疗服务，是中国领先的医院灭菌设备制造商。2024年营收100.21亿元（+0.09%），制药装备增长抵消医疗器械板块走弱。
companies.description_en: A comprehensive medical device and pharmaceutical equipment company established in 1943, providing infection-control instruments (sterilizers), radiotherapy equipment, surgical instruments, dental units, laboratory equipment, pharmaceutical manufacturing systems, and medical services. One of China's leading makers of hospital sterilization equipment. FY2024 revenue CNY 10.02B (+0.09%), with pharma-equipment segment growth offsetting a weaker medical-device segment.

companies.name_zh: 浙江寿仙谷医药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 专注于灵芝、铁皮石斛等名贵中药材的选育种植、精深加工与销售，核心品牌为寿仙谷，主要产品有灵芝孢子粉、铁皮石斛系列及藏红花提取物等保健品和中药饮片。
companies.description_en: A TCM company specializing in the cultivation, processing, and sale of premium medicinal herbs including Ganoderma lucidum (Reishi) and Dendrobium officinale under the Shouxiangu brand. Key products are Ganoderma lucidum spore powder, Dendrobium officinale granules, saffron extracts, and related health products.

companies.name_zh: 首药控股（北京）股份有限公司

companies.description_en: A clinical-stage innovative small-molecule drug company listed on China's STAR Market. Pipeline covers 24 candidates in oncology (NSCLC, lymphoma, HCC, pancreatic cancer, breast cancer, leukemia) and metabolic diseases including type 2 diabetes. Lead asset CT-707 (Kangtaitinib, 首曜泽) NDA filed for ALK+ NSCLC. Revenue remains pre-commercial; R&D-stage company.

companies.description_en: A generic injectable pharmaceutical company specializing in synthesized peptide drugs and API. Key products include thymalfasin (thymosinalpha-1), bortezomib, paclitaxel, somatostatin, eptifibatide, bivalirudin, liraglutide, and exenatide injections. Revenue declined significantly in 2024 amid product price pressures.

Key pipeline asset STSP-0601 (hemophilia injection) in Phase II for new indication (on-demand hemostasis without inhibitors).

companies.name_zh: 江苏四环生物股份有限公司

companies.description_en: A bioengineering company specializing in antitumor biotherapeutics. Core products include Delusen (human interleukin-2 for injection) for renal cancer, malignant melanoma, and malignant pleural/ascitic effusion; Xinlisheng (G-CSF) for chemotherapy-induced neutropenia; and erythropoietin (EPO). Also operates a minor landscaping/seedling business. Expected revenue ~200M CNY in 2024 with significant losses.

companies.name_zh: 四环医药控股集团有限公司

Subsidiary Jilin Huisheng Biopharmaceutical is based in Jilin Province. Spun off Xuanzhu Biopharm for separate HK listing.

companies.name_zh: 中国抗体制药有限公司

Lead asset SM03 (Suciraslimab, anti-CD22 mAb): Phase III RA (completed), Phase II NHL/SLE, Phase I Alzheimer's/Sjögren's. SM17 (anti-IL-25R): Phase I asthma/atopic dermatitis. companies.description_en: Zhejiang Tiansong Medical Instrument Co., Ltd., established in 1998 and formerly Hangzhou Tonglu Acme Endoscope Co., Ltd., specializes in the R&D, manufacturing, and sales of medical endoscopes and related instruments. Domestic and international revenues are approximately 50/50. Listed on NEEQ in January 2014; BSE IPO application terminated in December 2022.

companies.name_zh: 宁波天益医疗器械股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Ningbo Tianyi Medical Appliance Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 宁波天益医疗器械股份有限公司，1998年成立，总部宁波，专注于血液净化及病房护理领域的高分子医用耗材研发、生产和销售。主要产品包括血液透析管路、CRRT管路、透析器、血浆灌流器及腹膜透析相关产品。
companies.description_en: Ningbo Tianyi Medical Appliance Co., Ltd., incorporated in 1998 and headquartered in Ningbo, develops, manufactures, and sells medical polymer consumables for blood purification and ward nursing. Key products include hemodialysis tubing, CRRT tubing kits, hemodialysis concentrates, dialyzers, and plasma perfusion devices.

companies.name_zh: 西藏诺迪康药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 西藏诺迪康药业股份有限公司，1999年成立于拉萨，主要产品包括现代藏药（诺迪康胶囊等）、现代中药及重组人脑利钠肽注射液（心益舒）等，覆盖心脑血管、肝胆、骨骼肌肉及风湿等治疗领域。2024年营收28.07亿元，净利润10.51亿元。
companies.description_en: Tibet Rhodiola Pharmaceutical Holding Co., founded in 1999 in Lhasa, produces modern Tibetan medicines (Nodickon capsules), modern Chinese medicines, and recombinant human brain natriuretic peptide (Neovactin) for cardiovascular, hepatobiliary, musculoskeletal, and rheumatic indications. FY2024 revenue CNY 2.81 billion; net profit CNY 1.05 billion.

companies.name_zh: 东富龙科技集团股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Tofflon Science and Technology Group Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 东富龙科技集团股份有限公司，1993年成立于上海闵行区，是全球领先的制药装备供应商，产品涵盖冻干机、无菌隔离器、制药水处理、生物工程及固体制剂生产线，已向超40个国家约2000家制药企业供应逾8000套设备系统。2024年营收50.10亿元。
companies.description_en: Tofflon Science and Technology Group Co., Ltd., founded in 1993 in Shanghai's Minhang District, is a leading global pharmaceutical equipment manufacturer. Its product lines cover freeze dryers, aseptic isolators, pharmaceutical water systems, biopharmaceutical engineering, and solid-preparation production lines, supplying over 8,000 systems to ~2,000 pharma companies in 40+ countries. FY2024 revenue CNY 5.01 billion.

companies.name_zh: 同仁堂科技发展股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Tong Ren Tang Technologies Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 同仁堂科技发展股份有限公司（港股：1666）是百年中医药老字号北京同仁堂集团旗下的香港上市子公司（另有A股600085、港股3613两家关联上市公司），历史可追溯至1669年，主营传统中成药的研发、生产、批发及零售，覆盖中成药、保健品及相关原材料。2024年营收72.60亿元。
companies.description_en: Tong Ren Tang Technologies Co., Ltd. (HKEX:1666) is the Hong Kong-listed subsidiary of the iconic Beijing Tong Ren Tang Group, whose origins trace to 1669. The company develops, manufactures, and retails traditional Chinese medicine products including ointments, healthcare supplements, tea drinks, and cosmetics in mainland China and Hong Kong. FY2024 revenue CNY 7.26 billion.

companies.description_en: Jiangxi Synergy Pharmaceutical (Tonghe Pharmaceutical), founded in 2004 and headquartered in Fengxin Industrial Park, Yichun, Jiangxi, focuses on chemical API and pharmaceutical intermediate R&D, manufacturing, and sales. The company has been extending into first-to-file generics (e.g., empagliflozin tablets). FY2024 revenue CNY 758.89 million (+5.09% YoY); R&D spend CNY 59.45 million.

companies.name_zh: 通化金马药业集团股份有限公司

companies.description_en: Tonghua Golden-Horse Pharmaceutical Industry Co., Ltd., founded in 1990 and headquartered in Tonghua, Jilin, develops, manufactures, and sells traditional Chinese medicine and chemical pharmaceuticals across oncology, cardiovascular, gynecological, musculoskeletal, digestive, and neurological indications. FY2024 revenue CNY 1.32 billion; net profit CNY 56.44 million.

companies.name_zh: 浙江拓普药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 浙江拓普药业股份有限公司（新三板：837631），1999年7月成立，位于浙江省湖州市德清县中馆镇湖南路88号，2016年6月在新三板挂牌。公司专注于特种原料药的研发和生产，主打产品聚卡波非钙（polycarbophil calcium，慢性便秘/腹泻API），在美国、欧盟、日本及韩国均有市场份额，另从事医药中间体委托生产。
companies.description_en: Zhejiang Top Medicine Co., Ltd. (NEEQ:837631), founded July 1999 and located in Zhongguan, Deqing, Zhejiang, listed on NEEQ in June 2016. The company specializes in specialty API development and production, with polycarbophil calcium (for chronic constipation/diarrhea) as its core product sold in the US, EU, Japan, and South Korea. It also provides contract manufacturing of pharmaceutical intermediates.

companies.name_zh: 东曜药业股份有限公司（现更名BioDlink）
companies.name_en: TOT BIOPHARM International Co., Ltd. (rebranded BioDlink International)
companies.description_zh: 东曜药业股份有限公司（港股1875，2025年7月更名BioDlink International）成立于2009年，总部苏州，专注于肿瘤药物的研发和商业化。管线包含单克隆抗体（mAb）、抗体偶联药物（ADC/XDC）、溶瘤病毒及特种肿瘤药（脂质体等），同时开拓CDMO业务（2024年新增58个项目）。2024年营收10.98亿元（同比+40.7%），首次实现净盈利。TAA013为国内首个进入III期临床的T-DM1 ADC。
companies.description_en: TOT BIOPHARM International Co., Ltd. (HKEX:1875; rebranded BioDlink International as of July 2025), founded in 2009 in Suzhou, develops and commercializes oncology drugs including mAbs, ADCs/XDCs, oncolytic viruses, and specialty oncology drugs (liposome formulations). The company operates an expanding CDMO arm (58 new projects in 2024). FY2024 revenue CNY 1.10 billion (+40.7% YoY); first-ever net profit of CNY 34.76 million. TAA013 (anti-HER2 ADC) was China's first T-DM1 ADC entering Phase III.

sources.title: TOT BIOPHARM IPO - PR Newswire APAC

companies.name_zh: 广州崔特生物科技股份有限公司
