companies.description_en: Guangzhou Trauer Biotechnology Co., Ltd., founded August 2002 and headquartered in Guangzhou, is a NEEQ-listed (831187) biotech company specializing in biomedical active collagen materials. Products include Trauer-brand medical devices for wound and skin repair, and Trauer/Trauemy-brand skincare cosmetics. FY2023 revenue CNY 306 million (+26.48% YoY); net profit up 33.43% YoY.

companies.name_zh: 汉中天瑞光生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 汉中天瑞光生物科技股份有限公司，2006年4月成立于陕西省汉中市，属陕西核工业集团旗下企业，新三板挂牌（833760），专注于植物提取物的研发、生产、销售及进出口，主要产品包括淫羊藿提取物、红景天提取物、刺蒺藜提取物、葡萄籽提取物及锯棕榈提取物等，出口导向型企业。
companies.description_en: Hanzhong TRG Biotech Co., Ltd., established April 2006 in Hanzhong, Shaanxi, and affiliated with Shaanxi Nuclear Corporation, is a NEEQ-listed (833760) export-oriented enterprise specializing in botanical plant extract R&D, production, and international trade. Key products include Epimedium P.E., Rhodiola P.E., Tribulus terrestris P.E., Grape seed P.E., and Saw Palmetto P.E.

companies.name_zh: 楚天科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 楚天科技股份有限公司，2000年成立于湖南省长沙市，是全国领先的制药装备整体解决方案提供商，产品涵盖无菌制剂、生物工程、制药水系统、固体制剂及食品工程设备等，在国内外制药企业中具有广泛装机量。2024年营收58.30亿元（同比下降14.94%），研发投入6.26亿元。
companies.description_en: Truking Technology Limited, founded in 2000 and headquartered in Changsha, Hunan, is a leading Chinese pharmaceutical equipment manufacturer offering integrated solutions spanning sterile preparations, bioengineering, pharmaceutical water systems, solid preparations, and food engineering. FY2024 revenue CNY 5.83 billion (-14.94% YoY); R&D spend CNY 625.5 million.

companies.name_zh: 拓新药业集团股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 拓新药业集团股份有限公司（原新乡拓新药业），2001年成立于河南省新乡市，专注于核苷（酸）原料药及医药中间体的研发、生产和销售，产品覆盖嘧啶系列、嘌呤系列和核苷酸系列，包括胞磷胆碱钠、利巴韦林、肌苷、阿昔洛韦、5-氟胞嘧啶等。2024年营收4.22亿元（较2023年暴跌约50%），出现净亏损。
companies.description_en: Tuoxin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. (formerly Xinxiang Tuoxin), founded in 2001 in Xinxiang, Henan, focuses on nucleoside and nucleotide API and pharmaceutical intermediate development and manufacturing. Products include pyrimidine/purine series (citicoline sodium, ribavirin, inosine, acyclovir, cytarabine, 5-fluorocytosine). FY2024 revenue CNY 421.69 million (down ~50% vs 2023); net loss CNY 19.88 million due to market oversupply in nucleoside APIs.

companies.name_zh: 浙江同源康医药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 浙江同源康医药是一家临床阶段生物医药公司，专注于开发和商业化差异化靶向肿瘤疗法。核心产品TY-9591为第三代EGFR-TKI，用于治疗EGFR突变非小细胞肺癌，包括脑转移适应症；管线含12个候选药物，涵盖CDK4/6、CDK7、ROS1/NTRK抑制剂。
companies.description_en: TYK Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on discovery, development, and commercialization of differentiated targeted therapies for cancer. Its lead product TY-9591 is a third-generation EGFR-TKI targeting NSCLC with EGFR mutations, including brain metastases. The pipeline includes 12 drug candidates in oncology.

companies.name_zh: 优宁维（上海）生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 优宁维是一家生命科学工具公司，主要从事生命科学试剂、抗体、生物实验耗材的研发、生产与销售，服务科研机构和制药企业，2024年营收约10.84亿元。
companies.description_en: Shanghai Universal Biotech (Youningwei, 301166) is a life science tools company engaged in R&D, production, and distribution of biological reagents, antibodies, and laboratory supplies. It serves academic research institutions and pharmaceutical companies across China. 2024 revenue ~RMB 1.08B.

sources.title: 优宁维2024年年度报告 – Sina Finance

companies.name_zh: 通用环球医疗集团有限公司
companies.name_en: Genertec Universal Medical Group Company Limited

revenue.note_en: FY2025 total income CNY 14,939.5M (+9.3% YoY); healthcare revenue CNY 9,901.8M (66.3% of total); profit attributable to owners CNY 2,156.8M (+6.2%).

companies.description_zh: 通用环球医疗是中国领先的医疗健康综合企业，拥有医疗健康（医院运营、专科医疗、健康科技）与金融（医疗资产融资）双主业。2025财年总收入149.4亿元（同比+9.3%），归母净利润21.6亿元。由中国通用技术集团控股，国有为主。
companies.description_en: Genertec Universal Medical is a leading Chinese healthcare conglomerate with dual businesses: healthcare (hospital operations, specialized care, health technology) and finance (medical asset financing). FY2025 total income CNY 14.94B (+9.3% YoY); profit attributable to owners CNY 2.16B. Majority state-owned via China General Technology Group.

sources.title: Genertec Universal Medical 2025 Annual Report Overview – Minichart

companies.name_zh: 上海上博生物医药技术股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Shanghai Upper Bio-Tech Pharma Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 上海上博生物医药技术是一家专注于重组人干扰素产品研发与生产的生物制药企业，主要产品包括重组人干扰素α2b滴眼液、鼻喷雾剂等抗病毒生物制品，在新三板（NEEQ:873758）挂牌。
companies.description_en: Shanghai Upper Bio-Tech Pharma (NEEQ:873758) is a biopharmaceutical company focused on recombinant human interferon products, including interferon alpha-2b ophthalmic drops and nasal sprays for antiviral indications. Listed on China's NEEQ market.

companies.name_zh: 南京领科生物技术股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 南京领科生物技术（HKEX:9887）是一家临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于创新抗体药物研发，核心产品Opamtistomig（LBL-024）为PD-L1/TIGIT双功能抗体，已完成肺外神经内分泌癌关键临床入组，管线还包括CD3 T细胞衔接体和4-1BB/PD-L1双抗平台。2025年7月于港交所上市，融资1.89亿美元。
companies.description_en: Nanjing Leads Biolabs (HKEX:9887) is a clinical-stage biotech developing novel antibody drugs in oncology and immunology. Core product Opamtistomig (LBL-024) is a PD-L1/TIGIT bifunctional antibody for extra-pulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma; platform includes LeadsBody CD3 T-cell engagers and X-body bispecific antibodies. IPO July 2025 raised USD 189M.

sources.title: Leads Biolabs Lists on HKEX – PR Newswire
Nanjing Leads Biolabs Income Statement – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 维昇药业（HKEX:2561）是专注于中国内地的内分泌及罕见病疗法商业化公司。核心产品Lonapegsomatropin（SKYTROFA）为每周一次长效生长激素替代疗法，已获中国NMPA批准用于儿童生长激素缺乏症，为中国首个长效生长激素。管线还包括TransCon CNP（软骨发育不全）和Palopegteriparatide（甲状旁腺功能减退症）。
companies.description_en: VISEN Pharmaceuticals (HKEX:2561) is a commercial-stage company focused on paradigm-shifting endocrine and rare disease therapies in China. Lead product Lonapegsomatropin (SKYTROFA) is the only approved once-weekly long-acting growth hormone in China for pediatric GHD. Pipeline includes TransCon CNP for achondroplasia and Palopegteriparatide for hypoparathyroidism.

companies.name_zh: 维信制药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 维信制药是位于海南海口的综合制药企业，专注于口服固体制剂（硬胶囊、片剂、颗粒、软胶囊等）的研发、生产与销售，面向中美两国市场，GMP设施通过FDA和NMPA多次检查，挂牌新三板（NEEQ:874191）。
companies.description_en: Visum Pharmaceutical (NEEQ:874191) is a Haikou, Hainan-based integrated pharma company specializing in oral solid, semi-solid, and liquid pharmaceutical products for both US and China markets. Its formulation development center and manufacturing facility have been inspected by the US FDA and China NMPA multiple times.

companies.name_zh: 维亚生物科技控股有限公司
companies.description_zh: 维亚生物技术（HKEX:1873）是以结构生物学和生物物理学为核心的新药发现CRO/CDMO公司。CRO业务提供结构驱动小分子及生物大分子新药发现服务；CDMO业务通过子公司浙江朗华制药承接商业化小分子API/中间体生产。2025年营收17.29亿元，净利润2.69亿元。
companies.description_en: Viva Biotech (HKEX:1873) is a CRO/CDMO group anchored in structural biology and biophysics. Its CRO arm provides structure-based small-molecule and biologics drug discovery services globally; CDMO services are delivered through Langhua Pharmaceutical for commercial-scale API and intermediate manufacturing. FY2025 revenue RMB 1.73B; net profit RMB 269M.

sources.title: Viva Biotech 2024 Annual Results – PR Newswire
Viva Biotech 2025 Annual Results – Morningstar/PR Newswire

companies.name_zh: 广东溢多利生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 广东溢多利生物科技是一家从事生物酶制剂、生物合成产品及健康营养产品研发、生产与销售的高新技术企业。主要产品包括饲用木聚糖酶、植酸酶等饲料添加剂，以及工业用酶制剂，产品出口至欧盟等市场。2024年营收8.26亿元。
companies.description_en: Guangdong VTR Bio-Tech (SZSE:300381) researches, develops, produces, and sells bio-enzyme preparations, biosynthetics, and nutrition/health products in China and internationally. Key products include feed additives (xylanase, phytase) and industrial enzymes. EU approvals obtained for xylanase and phytase (2024–2026). FY2024 revenue RMB 826M.

sources.title: Guangdong VTR Bio-Tech Revenue – Investing.com Pro

companies.name_zh: 安徽万邦医药科技股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Anhui Wanbang Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 安徽万邦医药科技是一家综合型合同研究机构（CRO），主要为制药企业和上市许可持有人提供仿制药研发、一致性评价和临床研究服务（临床试验运营、生物样本分析、数据管理与统计分析等）。2024年营收约2.87亿元，员工362人。
companies.description_en: Anhui Wanbang Pharmaceutical Technology (SZSE:301520) is a comprehensive CRO providing generic drug development, consistency evaluation, and clinical research services (trial operations, PK/BA sample analysis, data management, biostatistics) to Chinese pharma companies and MAHs. FY2024 revenue ~RMB 287M; 362 employees.

companies.name_zh: 万邦德医药控股集团股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Wanbangde Pharmaceutical Holding Group Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 万邦德医药控股集团是一家多元化制药企业，主营现代中药、化学原料药及化学制剂的研发、生产和销售，同时经营医疗器械及医院工程服务，另有铝制品和金属涂料板块。旗下拥有遍布全国30余省的营销网络。2024年营收约13.87亿元。
companies.description_en: Wanbangde Pharmaceutical Holding Group (SZSE:002082) is a diversified pharma conglomerate based in Taizhou, Zhejiang. Core businesses: modern TCM and chemical drug R&D/manufacturing, medical devices and hospital engineering services. Also has aluminum products and metallic coatings divisions. 2024 revenue ~RMB 1.39B.

companies.name_zh: 北京万东医疗科技股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Beijing Wandong Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 北京万东医疗科技成立于1955年，是中国最早的医学影像设备制造商之一，主要产品涵盖MRI（含液氦免维护超导MRI）、DR数字X光、血管造影及心脏系统等影像设备，同时提供影像诊断服务。2024年营收15.24亿元（同比+23.26%），归母净利润1.57亿元。
companies.description_en: Beijing Wandong Medical Technology (SSE:600055), founded 1955, is one of China's earliest medical imaging equipment manufacturers. Products include MRI (including a liquid-helium-free superconducting MRI featured in Nature 2024), DR, angiography, and cardiac systems, plus diagnostic imaging services. FY2024 revenue RMB 1.52B (+23% YoY); net profit RMB 157M.

sources.title: 万东医疗2024年年报简析 – Sina Finance
Beijing Wandong Medical Technology – Baidu Baike

companies.name_zh: 苏州望山望水生物制药有限公司
companies.name_en: Suzhou Wangshan Wangshui Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (Vigonvita)
companies.description_zh: 苏州望山望水生物制药（港交所上市名：Vigonvita，2630.HK）专注于小分子创新药，三大治疗领域为病毒感染、神经精神疾病和生殖健康。核心产品VV116（Deuremidevir，氘代瑞米地韦）为RdRp抑制剂，已在中国和乌兹别克斯坦获批用于COVID-19治疗，2025年11月于港交所主板上市。
companies.description_en: Suzhou Wangshan Wangshui Biopharmaceutical (HKEX:2630, branded Vigonvita) focuses on innovative small-molecule drugs across viral infections, neuropsychiatric disorders, and reproductive health. Lead product VV116 (Deuremidevir) is an RdRp inhibitor approved for COVID-19 in China and Uzbekistan. Listed on HKEX Main Board in November 2025. Nine-asset pipeline includes LV232 and TPN171.

sources.title: Wangshan Wangshui IPO Filing – Futu News
IPO Insights: Wangshan Wangshui – Futu News

companies.name_zh: 万泽实业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 万泽实业是一家双主业上市公司：医药事业部（内蒙古双奇药业）生产微生态活菌制品（消化道和妇科微生态），在国内市场享有较高知名度；高温合金事业部专注于航空发动机和燃气轮机用高温合金研发、生产与销售。2024年营业总收入10.79亿元（+9.9%），归母净利润1.93亿元。
companies.description_en: Wanze Co. (SZSE:000534) operates two main businesses: (1) pharmaceutical arm producing microecological live bacterial products for digestive and gynecological indications via Inner Mongolia Shuangqi; (2) high-tech arm producing superalloys and hot-end components for aero engines and gas turbines. FY2024 total revenue RMB 1.079B (+9.9%); net profit RMB 193M.

companies.name_zh: 贵州威门药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 贵州威门药业是新三板挂牌的中药制药企业，以一核三链战略运营：一核聚焦中药研发与销售，三链覆盖种植、产品开发和市场营销，产品销售网络覆盖全国30余省市及出口越南。核心产品之一为已获NMPA注册批件的二冬汤颗粒。2024年营收约4385万元，为微型企业。
companies.description_en: Guizhou Warmen Pharmaceutical (NEEQ:430369) is a micro-cap TCM company pursuing a 'one-core three-chains' strategy: core = TCM R&D and sales; three chains = cultivation, product development, and marketing. Products sold in 30+ provinces and exported to Vietnam. Erlei Tang granules received NMPA registration in 2024. FY2024 revenue RMB 43.9M.

sources.title: 威门药业2024年半年度报告 – Eastmoney NEEQ

companies.name_zh: 山东威高血液净化制品股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Shandong Weigao Blood Purification Products Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 山东威高血液净化制品是中国血液净化行业领先企业，2023年血液透析器市场份额32.5%，IPO于2025年5月在上交所主板上市（市值约200亿元）。主要产品：血液透析器（52%营收）、透析机（17.5%）、血路管（14%）、腹膜透析液（6.8%）及配套耗材。2024年营收36.04亿元，归母净利润4.49亿元。
companies.description_en: Shandong Weigao Blood Purification (SSE:603014) is the leading Chinese blood purification company with 32.5% market share in hemodialyzers (2023). Listed on SSE Main Board in May 2025. Products: dialyzers (52% revenue), hemodialysis machines (17.5%), bloodlines (14%), peritoneal dialysis solution (6.8%), and accessories. FY2024 revenue RMB 3.60B; net profit RMB 449M.

companies.name_zh: 深圳卫光生物制品股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Shenzhen Weiguang Biological Products Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 深圳卫光生物制品是国有控股（深圳市国资委持股65%）血液制品企业，主要产品包括人血白蛋白、静注人免疫球蛋白（pH4）、狂犬病免疫球蛋白、人纤维蛋白原、凝血因子等，共9个品种21个规格。2024年营收12.67亿元，净利润2.46亿元。
companies.description_en: Shenzhen Weiguang Biological Products (SZSE:002880) is a state-controlled blood products company (65% owned by Shenzhen SASAC). Products include human albumin, IVIG, rabies immunoglobulin, human fibrinogen, coagulation factors — 9 product categories, 21 SKUs. FY2024 revenue RMB 1.27B; net profit RMB 246M.

companies.name_zh: 浙江维康药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 浙江维康药业是以现代中药和西药并举的制药企业，核心产品包括银黄滴丸、益母草软胶囊和罗红霉素软胶囊，持有37个药品注册证书。公司与多位院士及高校科研团队合作，在研创新中药包括申丹通脑滴丸和黄甲软肝颗粒（均为1.1类创新中药）。2024年营收3.51亿元（同比-32%），净亏损1.47亿元。
companies.description_en: Zhejiang Wecome Pharmaceutical (SZSE:300878) produces modern TCM and Western medicines from Lishui. Key products: Yinhuang Dripping Pills, Chinese Motherwort Soft Capsules, Roxithromycin Soft Capsules (37 drug certificates). R&D pipeline includes two Class 1.1 innovative TCM drugs. FY2024 revenue RMB 351M (-32% YoY); net loss RMB 147M.

companies.name_zh: 山东未名生物医药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 山东未名生物医药股份有限公司（股票简称：*ST未名）是未名集团旗下核心控股子公司，主营干扰素系列产品、神经生长因子、生物医药CRO/CDMO服务、疫苗及药物中间体等五大业务板块。2024年营业收入约3.6亿元，同比下降16.14%，净亏损约1.37亿元；2024年研发费用2537.39万元，同比下降57.57%；公司旗下天津未名生物子公司因质量问题于2025年4月被责令停产整顿。
companies.description_en: Shandong Sinobioway Biomedicine Co., Ltd. (*ST Weiming, SZSE:002581) is the core listed subsidiary of Weiming Group, operating across five biologics segments: interferon series, nerve growth factor, biopharma CRO/CDMO, vaccines, and pharmaceutical intermediates. 2024 revenue approximately CNY 360M (down 16.1% YoY), net loss CNY 137M; R&D spend CNY 25.4M (down 57.6%). Subsidiary Tianjin Weiming was suspended for quality issues in April 2025.

companies.description_en: Tibet Weixinkang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (SSE:603676), registered in Tibet but operationally headquartered in Xiamen, is a leading domestic parenteral nutrition manufacturer. Core products include amino acid injections and large-volume infusions, distributed to 2,000+ hospitals nationwide. 2024 revenue CNY 1.30B (down 1.69% YoY); net profit CNY 246M.

(SZSE:002107), headquartered in Weifang, Shandong, manufactures and markets TCM and Western pharmaceutical preparations focused on cardiovascular-cerebrovascular diseases (66% of revenue), musculoskeletal conditions, and antiviral respiratory products. 2024 revenue CNY 764M (down 16.0% YoY); net profit CNY 36.4M (down 38.1%).

companies.description_zh: 武汉贝参药业股份有限公司（NEEQ:871910）成立于2003年，专注于呼吸系统疾病中药研发创新与生产，主要产品包括颗粒剂、散剂、口服液、糖浆剂等多种剂型，旗下品牌有晶之爱、丹汛山、乐拜塞、护理等，主打复方太子参止咳益气散等独家产品；员工约155人。
companies.description_en: Wuhan Beican Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (NEEQ:871910) was established in 2003 and specialises in TCM R&D and manufacturing for respiratory diseases. Products span granules, powders, oral liquids and syrups across brands including Jing Zhi Ai, Dan Xun Shan and Le Bai Sai. Approx. 155 employees.

companies.name_zh: 无锡晶海氨基酸股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Wuxi Jinghai Amino Acid Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 无锡晶海氨基酸股份有限公司（BSE:836547）成立于1995年，是国内高端氨基酸原料药领先制造商，采用发酵法生产30余种药用级和食品级氨基酸，持有14项氨基酸原料药注册证书，2012年率先通过2010版GMP认证；2024年营业收入3.39亿元，净利润4285万元；员工400余人。

sources.title: 一心堂2024年年度报告 CNINFO

companies.description_zh: 基因驱动是英国曼彻斯特的临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于快速即时基因检测平台，产品包括Genedrive® MT-RNR1 ID Kit（氨基糖苷类耳毒性相关基因检测）和Genedrive® CYP2C19 ID Kit（心血管药物代谢基因检测）。
companies.description_en: Genedrive plc is a Manchester-based clinical-stage biotech developing rapid, cost-effective point-of-care pharmacogenomic testing platforms. Its products include the MT-RNR1 ID Kit (aminoglycoside-induced hearing loss) and CYP2C19 ID Kit (cardiovascular drug metabolism), targeting NHS and global hospital settings.

sources.title: Genedrive plc Releases 2025 Annual Report and Sets AGM Date

companies.description_zh: 基因菲特是法国里尔近郊的晚期生物制药公司，专注于罕见及危重肝脏疾病的创新治疗和诊断解决方案。其授权产品Iqirvo®（elafibranor）已获FDA及EMA批准用于原发性胆汁性胆管炎（PBC），由Ipsen商业化。公司在研管线涵盖急性慢性肝衰竭（ACLF）、胆管癌等多个领域。
companies.description_en: Genfit SA is a late-stage French biopharmaceutical company focused on rare and life-threatening liver diseases. Its out-licensed asset Iqirvo® (elafibranor) received FDA/EMA approval for primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) in 2024, commercialized by Ipsen; Genfit receives royalties and milestones. Pipeline includes four ACLF/hepatic encephalopathy programs and cholangiocarcinoma.

sources.title: GENFIT Reports Full-Year 2025 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update
GENFIT: Publication of the 2026 Extra-Financial Report (fiscal year 2025)

companies.description_zh: 基诺维斯是瑞典的生命科学工具公司，总部位于卡夫林厄，向全球生物制药和研究机构提供SmartEnzymes®酶产品及抗体分析工具，助力抗体药物的开发与质量控制。
companies.description_en: Genovis AB is a Swedish life sciences tools company headquartered in Kävlinge, supplying SmartEnzymes® enzyme products and antibody analysis tools to biopharmaceutical and research customers worldwide. Its products facilitate development and quality control of biologics and biosimilars.

companies.description_zh: 基纽斯是FTSE 250成分股的英国动物遗传学公司，总部位于贝辛斯托克，通过PIC（猪遗传学）和ABS（牛遗传学）两大业务，向全球畜牧和食品生产商销售精英遗传育种产品，并积极开展PRRSv抗性基因编辑猪的研发。
companies.description_en: Genus PLC (FTSE 250) is a UK-based global animal genetics leader headquartered in Basingstoke, operating through PIC (porcine genetics) and ABS (bovine genetics) to supply elite breeding stock and semen to dairy, beef and pork producers worldwide. R&D includes gene-edited pigs resistant to PRRS virus.

companies.description_zh: 格雷斯海默成立于1864年，是全球领先的医药包装产品和药物递送装置制造商，总部位于德国杜塞尔多夫，在16个国家拥有40余座工厂，为制药、医疗和生物技术行业提供玻璃与塑料初级包装、注射器、吸入器等产品。
companies.description_en: Gerresheimer AG (founded 1864) is a global leader in pharmaceutical packaging and drug delivery devices headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany. It operates 40+ facilities in 16 countries, producing glass and plastic primary packaging, syringes, inhalers, and drug delivery devices for the pharma, healthcare and biotech sectors. Its 2025 annual report publication was delayed pending auditor completion.

sources.title: Gerresheimer AG reschedules publication of annual financial statements for 2025

companies.description_zh: 糖链移植（Glycorex Transplantation）是瑞典隆德的生物技术公司，开发并销售用于器官和血液相容性的医疗器械，核心技术可从血液中去除特异性抗体，从而支持跨血型器官移植和安全输血。
companies.description_en: Glycorex Transplantation AB (Lund, Sweden) develops and commercialises medical devices for organ and blood compatibility. Its core technology selectively removes blood-group antibodies from plasma, enabling ABO-incompatible organ transplantation and safer transfusions.

sources.title: Interim report January–September 2025 – Glycorex Transplantation AB

companies.description_zh: 汉莎生物制药是瑞典隆德的临床阶段生物制药公司，专注于免疫调节疗法。旗舰产品IDEFIRIX®（imlifidase）是全球首款IgG抗体切割酶，已在欧洲获批用于高致敏肾移植患者的脱敏治疗；公司已向FDA提交BLA申请。下一代分子HNSA-5487处于开发中。
companies.description_en: Hansa Biopharma AB (Lund, Sweden) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel immunomodulatory therapies for acute or complex immune disorders. IDEFIRIX® (imlifidase), its first-in-class IgG-cleaving enzyme, is approved in Europe for desensitization in highly sensitized kidney transplant patients; a BLA was submitted to the FDA in December 2025. Next-generation HNSA-5487 is in development for Guillain-Barré Syndrome.

sources.title: Hansa Biopharma Reports Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Financial Results
Hansa Biopharma publishes 2025 Annual and Sustainability Reports

companies.description_zh: 海德堡制药是德国拉登堡的临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于以α-鹅膏毒素（Amanitin）为毒素核的抗体偶联药物（ADC）平台（ATAC技术）。核心候选药物HDP-101（pamlectabart tismanitin）针对多发性骨髓瘤处于I/IIa期，已获FDA快速通道认定；2025年9月宣布将裁员75%以削减成本。
companies.description_en: Heidelberg Pharma AG (Ladenburg, Germany) is a clinical-stage ADC company developing its proprietary ATAC technology platform using α-amanitin as a novel payload. Lead candidate HDP-101 (pamlectabart tismanitin) targets BCMA for multiple myeloma in Phase I/IIa with FDA Fast Track designation. In September 2025 the company announced a 75% workforce reduction as part of cost-cutting measures.

sources.title: Heidelberg Pharma Announces Financial Figures 2025 and Outlook for 2026

companies.description_zh: hVIVO是全球人类挑战试验领域的领军合同研究机构（CRO），总部位于伦敦，拥有全球规模最大的隔离设施，提供传染病和呼吸道疾病疫苗与治疗的早期临床开发服务，并通过收购扩展为涵盖CRS、Cryostore等的全链条临床平台。
companies.description_en: hVIVO plc (London, AIM: HVO) is the world-leading full-service CRO specialising in human challenge clinical trials for infectious and respiratory diseases. It operates the world's largest quarantine facility in London and offers 10+ validated human challenge models, challenge agent manufacturing, drug development consultancy (Venn Life Sciences), and lab services (hLAB).

companies.description_zh: 海博遗传（现重组为ATON集团）是法国伊尔基尔希的生命科学公司，整合了Inoviem Scientific（蛋白质互作研究服务）、PIMS Technology和B Cell Design三项互补资产，定位为综合生命科学平台。
companies.description_en: Hybrigenics SA (rebranded as ATON group) is a French life sciences company headquartered in Illkirch-Graffenstaden, operating as an integrated platform with three assets: Inoviem Scientific (protein interaction CRO services), PIMS Technology, and B Cell Design. Full-year 2025 consolidated revenue was €0.7 million.

companies.description_zh: 海洛里斯制药是比利时列日的特药公司，专注于对现有成熟药物进行创新重新配制，以提升安全性、疗效或便利性。商业化产品包括Maxigesic® IV（对乙酰氨基酚+布洛芬静脉注射）和Sotalol IV（用于心房颤动），管线拥有26项产品和候选药物。
companies.description_en: Hyloris Pharmaceuticals SA (Liège, Belgium) is an early-stage specialty pharma company focused on reformulating existing medicines to add clinical value. Commercial assets include Maxigesic® IV (paracetamol/ibuprofen IV for acute pain), Sotalol IV (atrial fibrillation) and Podofilox Gel; the portfolio encompasses 26 products and candidates as of mid-2025.

sources.title: Hyloris Pharmaceuticals (EBR:HYL) Stock Price & Overview – Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: 免疫维亚是瑞典隆德的早期癌症检测公司，专注于胰腺癌高风险人群的早期血液检测。2025年在美国推出PancreaSure®（下一代血液检测），基于IMMray™抗体微阵列分析平台，实现了从研发阶段向商业化公司的转型。
companies.description_en: Immunovia AB (Lund, Sweden) is an early-stage diagnostics company focused on early detection of pancreatic cancer in high-risk individuals. In 2025 the company launched PancreaSure® in the United States, a next-generation blood test based on the IMMray™ antibody microarray platform, completing its transition from development to commercialisation.

sources.title: Immunovia publishes the Annual Report for 2025
Immunovia Publishes Full Year Report for 2025 – MFN.se

companies.description_zh: 免疫制药是英国伦敦的临床阶段生物制药公司，专注于自身免疫和抗感染领域的肽类创新疗法。核心候选药物Lupuzor（P140肽）是一款针对系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）的非免疫抑制、first-in-class候选药物，处于国际III期研究中。
companies.description_en: ImmuPharma plc (London, AIM: IMM) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing peptide-based therapies for autoimmune and anti-infective diseases. Its lead candidate Lupuzor (P140 peptide) is a first-in-class non-immunosuppressive treatment for systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) in an international Phase 3 study. The company has no commercial revenue as of mid-2025.

sources.title: Financial, Business and Portfolio Development Update – ImmuPharma PLC
ImmuPharma plc (AIM:IMM) Stock Price & Overview – Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: 启动制药是丹麦哥本哈根的临床阶段新兴制药公司，专注于中枢和周围神经系统药物开发。管线包括针对心理性和器质性勃起功能障碍的IP2018和pudafensine等临床项目，致力于解决神经系统未满足的临床需求。
companies.description_en: Initiator Pharma A/S (Copenhagen, Denmark) is a clinical-stage emerging pharma company developing innovative drugs targeting unmet needs in the central and peripheral nervous system. Pipeline includes IP2018 and pudafensine for psychogenic and organic erectile dysfunction respectively, with additional CNS programs in development.

companies.description_zh: 先天制药是法国马赛的临床阶段生物制药公司，创立于1999年，是NK细胞生物学研究的先驱，专注于肿瘤微环境与肿瘤抗原领域，开发差异化的first-in-class和best-in-class创新肿瘤免疫疗法，与赛诺菲、阿斯利康等顶级药企建立了合作。
companies.description_en: Innate Pharma SA (Marseille, France) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company and pioneer in NK cell biology, advancing a portfolio of differentiated potential first- and/or best-in-class immunoncology assets. Strategic collaborations include Sanofi and AstraZeneca. Cash runway was stated as until end of Q3 2026 as of December 31, 2025.

sources.title: Innate Pharma Reports Full Year 2025 Financial Results and Business Update
Innate Pharma Reports First Half 2025 Business Update and Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 英维提瓦是法国第戎近郊的临床阶段生物制药公司，专注于口服小分子疗法用于代谢相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH，即原NASH）的治疗。核心候选药物lanifibranor（PPAR全激动剂）正在NATiV3 III期临床试验中，顶线数据预计于2026年Q4公布；公司2025年11月完成约1.49亿欧元美国公开募资。
companies.description_en: Inventiva SA (Daix, France) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on oral small-molecule therapies for MASH (metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis). Lead candidate lanifibranor (pan-PPAR agonist) is in the NATiV3 Phase 3 trial with topline data expected Q4 2026. The company raised ~€149 million in a U.S. public offering in November 2025 and held €230.9 million cash at year-end 2025.

sources.title: Inventiva reports 2025 full year results and provides a business update

companies.description_zh: IXICO是英国伦敦的神经影像与生物标志物分析专家，通过IXI™ AI平台为神经科学临床试验提供数据分析服务，专注于阿尔茨海默病、亨廷顿病、帕金森病和多发性硬化症领域，FY2025（截至2025年9月）收入增长13%至650万英镑。
companies.description_en: IXICO plc (London, AIM: IXI) is a global neuroscience imaging and biomarker analytics specialist, using its AI-driven IXI™ platform to support drug development in neurological disorders including Alzheimer's, Huntington's, Parkinson's, and MS. FY2025 (year ended September 30, 2025) revenue grew 13% to £6.5 million.

sources.title: IXICO Financial Results for year ended 30 September 2025
IXICO plc Annual Report and Accounts 2025

companies.description_zh: 科尔卡制药成立于1954年，是斯洛文尼亚新梅斯托的国际知名仿制药企业，在欧洲和欧亚地区居主导地位，产品涵盖心血管、神经系统、消化道等多个慢性病治疗领域，在70余个国家销售产品，2025年实现创纪录收入20.4亿欧元，东欧市场占比最高。
companies.description_en: Krka d.d., Novo Mesto (founded 1954, LJSE: KRKG) is one of Europe's leading generic pharmaceutical companies headquartered in Slovenia, with a dominant presence across Central and Eastern Europe. Products address chronic disease areas including cardiovascular, neurological, gastrointestinal and anti-infective therapy. 2025 revenue of €2.04 billion and net profit of €403 million were both record results. R&D spend represents approximately 9.4% of revenue.

sources.title: Krka Reports January to September 2025 Business Results

companies.description_en: Jiangsu Yongchuang Pharmaceutical Technology is located in Xuexing Chemical Industrial Park, Lianshui County, Jiangsu. The company manufactures pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs including chlorobenzene series, trifluorotoluene series, and phosphorus-based series, with international exports.

companies.description_zh: 雍禾医疗集团是中国最大的连锁植发医疗机构，提供植发手术、医疗养发、常规固发及斯文森品牌养发等服务，旗下53家医疗机构覆盖50个城市。2021年在港交所主板上市。
companies.description_en: Yonghe Medical Group is China's largest hair-related healthcare clinic chain, offering hair transplant surgery, medical hair care, routine hair restoration, and Svenson brand hair care services. The network covers 53 medical institutions across 50 cities in China. Listed on HKEX Main Board in December 2021.

Yonghe Medical Group (HKG:2279) Stock Price & Overview

companies.description_zh: 广东永顺生物制药股份有限公司成立于2002年，总部位于广州黄埔区，是集兽用生物制品研发、生产、销售和技术服务为一体的生物医药企业。公司产品涵盖约30个猪用疫苗和禽用疫苗品种，在猪瘟疫苗细分市场具有领先地位。2021年11月成为北交所首批上市企业之一。
companies.description_en: Guangdong Yongshun Biological Pharmaceutical (also known as Winsun Bio) was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Huangpu District, Guangzhou. It is a biomedical enterprise integrating R&D, production, sales, and technical services for veterinary biological products. The company has a portfolio of approximately 30 pig and poultry vaccine varieties and is a leading enterprise in the swine fever vaccine sector. Listed on the Beijing Stock Exchange in November 2021 as one of its inaugural companies.

companies.description_en: Beijing Yuanyan Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. (NEEQ: 836477), founded in 2009, is located in Jinqiao Science and Technology Industrial Base, Zhongguancun Science and Technology Park, Tongzhou District, Beijing. The company focuses on R&D and production of pharmaceutical active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs).

companies.description_zh: 悦康药业集团股份有限公司（科创板：688658）成立于2001年，总部位于北京，是以高端化学药为核心、国家高新技术企业驱动创新研发的大型药业集团。核心产品包括银杏叶提取物注射液等，2024年全年营业总收入37.81亿元，同比下降9.9%。
companies.description_en: Youcare Pharmaceutical Group (STAR Market: 688658), founded in 2001 and headquartered in Beijing, is a large pharmaceutical enterprise group primarily focused on high-end chemical drugs, driven by innovation. The company covers cardio-cerebrovascular, antiviral, CNS, gastrointestinal, endocrinology, anti-infection, and oncology therapeutic areas. FY2024 revenue was RMB 3.781 billion, down 9.9% YoY. Listed on the STAR Market of the Shanghai Stock Exchange on December 24, 2020.

companies.description_en: Yueyang Xingchang Petro-Chemical Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 000819), founded in February 1990 and headquartered in Yueyang, Hunan, is a state-owned listed enterprise controlled by Sinopec Group. The company's core business is petrochemicals, producing methanol, polypropylene, MTBE, high-purity hydrogen, industrial isooctane, and o-cresol. This is a petrochemical company, NOT a pharmaceutical company. FY2024 revenue was RMB 3.823 billion.

sources.title: Yueyang Xingchang Petrochemical Co., Ltd. - Baike Baidu

companies.name_zh: 哈尔滨誉衡药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 哈尔滨誉衡药业股份有限公司（深交所：002437），总部位于哈尔滨，是东北地区重要的医药企业，以化学药为主要业务（占营收92%），同时涉足中药业务。2024年营业收入24.41亿元（同比下降7.06%），归母净利润2.33亿元（同比增长93.43%），研发费用9079万元。
companies.description_en: Harbin Yuheng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 002437) is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in Harbin, Heilongjiang, one of Northeast China's key pharma companies. Chemical pharmaceuticals account for 92% of revenue, with TCM comprising the remainder. FY2024 revenue was RMB 2.441 billion (down 7.06% YoY), net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 233 million (up 93.43% YoY), and R&D spend was RMB 90.8 million (3.97% of revenue).

companies.description_zh: 江西宇能制药股份有限公司成立于2003年，位于江西省吉安市井冈山经济技术开发区，占地54800平方米，注册资本2445万元。主要产品涵盖甾体激素、抗艾滋药、抗肿瘤等中间体和原料药，包括地夫可特、雌三醇、雌酮、地塞米松磷酸钠等，2022年12月在新三板挂牌上市。
companies.description_en: Jiangxi Yuneng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., founded in 2003, is located in Jinggangshan Economic and Technological Development Zone, Ji'an City, Jiangxi Province, covering 54,800 square meters. The company focuses on R&D and production of steroid hormone APIs, anti-AIDS intermediates, and anti-tumor APIs, including Deflazacort, Estriol, Estrone, Dexamethasone Sodium Phosphate, L-Alaninol, and related compounds. Listed on NEEQ in December 2022. National-level specialized and new 'little giant' enterprise designation obtained in October 2022.

江西宇能制药 NEEQ 873992 2022年度报告

companies.name_zh: 云南大唐汉方制药股份有限公司

companies.description_zh: 云南大唐汉方制药股份有限公司成立于2000年，位于云南省昆明市，专注于传统草药呼吸道疾病产品的研发与生产，主要产品为满山红素片（Alstonia scholaris Tablets），该产品于2020年9月获批上市，适应症为咳嗽。
companies.description_en: Yunnan Datang Hanfang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., founded in 2000 and headquartered in Yunnan Province, specializes in traditional herbal medicine for respiratory diseases. companies.description_en: Liaoning Zhonghaikang Biopharmaceutical, founded 2008, is a high-tech company specializing in drug delivery system (DDS) R&D, production and sales in Benxi, Liaoning. Core product is Coenzyme Q10 injection; the firm holds sustained-release and targeted-delivery technology platforms. Revenue declined approximately 24.6% YoY in 2024 due to cash-flow pressure. 60 employees; listed on NEEQ basic tier.

Core business covers traditional Chinese medicines (notably Xueshuantong injection), health food, medical devices, plus real estate and electric power. FY2025 revenue ~CNY 1.7 billion (-17% YoY); market cap ~CNY 8.82 billion (Dec 2025); ~2,971 employees.

companies.description_zh: 中红普林医疗用品股份有限公司成立于2010年12月，总部位于河北唐山，是一家专业从事丁腈手套、PVC手套等一次性医用防护产品的研发、生产和销售的公司。公司还经营输液器材（精密输液器、留置针）及创新医疗设备（输注泵、脑电图电极、温度传感器）。2024年营业收入约25.41亿元，拥有4228名员工，产品出口约80个国家和地区。
companies.description_en: Zhonghong Pulin Medical Products Co., Ltd. (est. Dec 2010, Tangshan, Hebei) develops and manufactures disposable medical protective products including nitrile and PVC gloves (80+ production lines), precision infusion sets, indwelling needles, syringe pumps, EEG electrodes, and temperature sensors. FY2024 revenue CNY 2.54 billion; 4,228 employees; exports to ~80 countries.

companies.name_zh: 江苏中慧元通生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 江苏中慧元通生物科技股份有限公司（港交所：2627）成立于2015年，总部位于江苏泰州，是一家专注于创新疫苗研发、生产和销售的生物技术公司。核心产品为四价流感病毒裂解（亚单位）疫苗，已获批上市。研发管线包含冻干人用狂犬病疫苗（2024年完成I期）、肺炎球菌疫苗、带状疱疹疫苗、RSV疫苗等12个候选产品。2024年营业收入2.596亿元，员工583人，2025年于香港联交所上市。
companies.description_en: Ab&B Bio-Tech CO., LTD. JS (HKEX: 2627), founded 2015, Taizhou, Jiangsu, develops, manufactures and sells innovative vaccines. Lead commercial product: quadrivalent subunit influenza vaccine. Pipeline includes lyophilized human rabies vaccine (Phase I completed Oct 2024, Phase III expected 2025Q3), pneumococcal, zoster, RSV, mpox, varicella vaccines. FY2024 revenue CNY 259.6 million (from CNY 52.2 million in 2023); 583 employees; listed HKEX 2025.

companies.name_zh: 中科美菱低温科技股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Zhongke Meiling Cryogenics Technology Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 中科美菱低温科技股份有限公司成立于2002年，由合肥美菱股份有限公司与中国科学院理化技术研究所联合出资创立，总部位于安徽合肥。公司专注于生物医学低温存储设备的研发、生产和销售，产品涵盖超低温冰箱、血液低温保存箱、生物安全柜、液氮生物容器及智能冷链管理系统。2022年10月在北京证券交易所上市（股票代码835892）。2024年营业收入约2.913亿元，市值约12.46亿元。
companies.description_en: Zhongke Meiling Cryogenics Technology Co., Ltd. (est. 2002, Hefei, Anhui) is a joint venture of Changhong Meiling Co., Ltd. and the Technical Institute of Physics and Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences. The company focuses on biomedical cryogenic storage: ultra-low temperature freezers (-40°C to -86°C), blood bank refrigerators, biosafety cabinets, liquid nitrogen biocontainers, and smart cold-chain management. Listed on Beijing Stock Exchange Oct 2022. FY2024 revenue CNY 291.3 million; market cap ~CNY 1.25 billion.

companies.description_en: Wuhan Zhongzhi Biotechnologies Inc. (est. March 2011, listed NEEQ May 2016, code 836834) is headquartered in Wuhan East Lake Hi-Tech Development Zone Biomedical Park. The company develops nucleic acid rapid diagnostic products, including a Mycoplasma pneumoniae nucleic acid detection kit and SARS-CoV-2 nucleic acid detection reagents holding Class III medical device registration certificates.

companies.description_zh: 天津中瑞药业股份有限公司成立于2004年3月，是一家专业生产化学原料药、药用辅料及食品添加剂的高新技术企业，主要产品包括烟酸、烟酰胺、法舒地尔盐酸盐（心血管）、特拉唑嗪盐酸盐（泌尿）、氨磷汀、顺式阿曲库铵苯磺酸盐等，均通过GMP认证。公司挂牌于全国中小企业股权转让系统（新三板），股票代码430645，注册资本2600万元。2024年度（2025财报）营业总收入约8464万元，同比下降26.58%。
companies.description_en: Tianjin Zhongrui Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (est. March 2004, Wuqing District, Tianjin) is a high-tech enterprise manufacturing chemical pharmaceutical raw materials, excipients, and food additives. Key products include nicotinic acid, niacinamide, fasudil HCl (cardiovascular), terazosin HCl (urology), amifostine, cisatracurium besylate, clopidogrel hydrogen sulfate, and febuxostat—all GMP-certified. NEEQ code 430645. FY2024 revenue CNY 84.6 million (-26.6% YoY). ~111 employees.

(est. 1970, Zhuhai, Guangdong) operates across pharmaceuticals (primarily eye drops), hospital investment management, medical devices, and real estate development. FY2024 revenue CNY 521.4 million (-18.4% YoY); net loss attributable to parent CNY 620 million. Currently carries 'ST' risk designation on SSE. ~1,246 employees.

companies.name_zh: 四川梓橦宫药业股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 四川梓橦宫药业股份有限公司品牌始于1780年清乾隆年间，拥有240余年历史，是国家级高新技术企业和四川省「专精特新」中小企业，总部位于四川内江（原公告地为自贡）。公司以药品的研发、生产与销售为主，拥有近100个药品生产批准文号，产品剂型涵盖片剂、胶囊、散剂等，代表品种包括清肠通便胶囊（彝族传统中药）、虎杖伤痛酊、紫草软膏等。2021年在北京证券交易所挂牌上市，当年年营业收入逼近4亿元。
companies.description_en: Sichuan Zitonggong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. traces its brand heritage to 1780 (Qing Dynasty), making it a 240+ year-old Chinese medicine brand. A national high-tech enterprise listed on the Beijing Stock Exchange since August 2021, the company holds nearly 100 drug production approval numbers across tablets, capsules, and powders. Key products include Qingchang Tongbian capsules (Yi ethnic traditional medicine for constipation), Knotweed Pain Tincture, and Comfrey Ointment. FY2021 revenue approached CNY 400 million. Note: hq_city listed as Zigong in input but company registration addresses show Neijiang; filed as Neijiang.

companies.name_zh: 归创通桥医疗科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 归创通桥医疗科技股份有限公司成立于2012年，总部位于浙江杭州，是一家专注于神经血管和外周血管介入医疗器械创新研发、制造和商业化的高速成长企业。公司拥有79个产品管线（其中61个已获NMPA批准），覆盖3300余家国内医院及80余个国家和地区。2025年营业收入10.6亿元（同比+35.1%），净利润2.44亿元（同比+143.7%），毛利率72.1%，员工925人。
companies.description_en: Zylox-Tonbridge Medical Technology Co., Ltd. (est. 2012, Hangzhou, Zhejiang) is a leading interventional medtech innovator in neurovascular and peripheral vascular devices. Pipeline: 79 products, 61 NMPA-approved; cumulative clinical use >1.1 million units across 3,300+ hospitals in China and 80+ countries. FY2025: revenue CNY 1.06 billion (+35.1% YoY), net profit CNY 244 million (+143.7% YoY), gross margin 72.1%; 925 employees; market cap HKD 6.96 billion.

companies.description_zh: 安杰斯株式会社（东京证券交易所成长板：4563）成立于1999年12月，总部位于大阪府茨木市（Saito Bio-Incubator）。公司专注于基因药物研发，核心产品Collategene（HGF质粒基因疗法）曾于2019年获得日本条件性批准，用于慢性动脉闭塞引起的缺血性溃疡，但该批准已于2024年6月到期。当前管线包括NF-κB诱饵寡核苷酸（慢性椎间盘源性腰痛）及高血压DNA疫苗。2025财年收入8.74亿日元，净亏损49.6亿日元，员工56人。
companies.description_en: AnGes, Inc. (TSE Growth: 4563, est. December 1999, Ibaraki City, Osaka) develops gene-based medicines. Formerly held Japan's first domestically-approved gene therapy product Collategene (HGF plasmid) for lower limb ischemic ulcers (conditional approval March 2019, terminated June 2024). Active pipeline: NF-κB decoy ODN for chronic discogenic lumbar back pain (Phase II), hypertension DNA vaccine. FY2025 revenue JPY 874 million; net loss JPY 4.96 billion; 56 employees; market cap JPY 20.6 billion.

sources.title: AnGes: Termination of Exclusive Sales Rights for Collategene — MarketScreener

companies.description_zh: ASKA制药控股株式会社（东京证券交易所：4886）创立于1920年，总部位于东京，是日本产科妇科领域的领军制药企业，主要产品涵盖内分泌、产科妇科及泌尿科药物。FY2025（2025年3月末）营业收入671.1亿日元，研发费用约81亿日元，员工1632人，市值约4.7亿美元。公司致力于解决女性健康问题，并持续推进妇产科相关新药研发。
companies.description_en: ASKA Pharmaceutical Holdings Co., Ltd. (TSE: 4886, est. 1920, Tokyo) is Japan's leading pharmaceutical company in obstetrics and gynecology. It researches, develops, manufactures, and markets drugs in endocrinology, obstetrics/gynecology, and urology. FY2025 (ending March 2025) TTM revenue JPY 67.1 billion; R&D spend ~JPY 8.1 billion; 1,632 employees; market cap ~USD 470 million.

companies.description_zh: BrightPath生物制药株式会社（东京证券交易所成长板：4594）成立于2003年，原名GreenPeptide Co., Ltd.，2017年7月更名，总部位于神奈川川崎。公司专注于癌症免疫疗法的研发，核心候选产品包括BP2201（靶向肿瘤抗原，I期临床）、BP2202（I期临床）和BP2301（实体瘤/肉瘤/妇科肿瘤，I期临床），另有靶向CD73（BP1200）和CD39（BP1202）的临床前候选药物。2025财年收入仅113万日元（早期研发阶段），员工42人，市值62.5亿日元。
companies.description_en: BrightPath Biotherapeutics Co., Ltd. (TSE Growth: 4594, est. 2003, Kawasaki; formerly GreenPeptide Co., Ltd., renamed July 2017) develops cancer immunotherapy drugs. Clinical pipeline: BP2201 (solid tumor antigen-targeted cancer vaccine, Phase I), BP2202 (Phase I), BP2301 (sarcoma/gynecological cancer, Phase I); preclinical: BP1200 (anti-CD73) and BP1202 (anti-CD39). FY2025 revenue JPY 1.13 million (pre-commercial stage); operating loss JPY 1.30 billion; 42 employees; market cap JPY 6.25 billion.
companies.sub_sector: cancer peptide vaccines / iPS-NKT cell therapy

companies.description_zh: 坎巴斯株式会社（东京证券交易所成长板：4575）成立于2000年1月，总部位于静冈县沼津市，是一家专注于肿瘤细胞周期靶向药物研发的临床阶段生物技术公司。核心候选产品CBP501（合成修饰多肽，卡铂增敏剂，临床II期）和CBS9106（XPO1可逆性抑制剂，实体瘤，I期临床）。公司尚无商业化产品，营业收入为零，员工11人，市值约172亿日元。
companies.description_en: CanBas Co., Ltd. (TSE Growth: 4575, est. January 18, 2000, Numazu, Shizuoka) is a clinical-stage oncology company targeting the cell cycle. Lead assets: CBP501 (calmodulin-modulating synthetic peptide, enhances cisplatin efficacy, Phase II) and CBS9106/selinexor-class XPO1 reversible inhibitor (solid tumors, Phase I). No commercial revenue; 11 employees; market cap JPY 17.2 billion.

companies.name_zh: 卡纳生物科学株式会社
companies.description_zh: 卡纳生物科学株式会社（东京证券交易所：4572）成立于2003年4月，总部位于兵库县神户市，是一家专注于激酶抑制剂发现与开发的生物技术公司。公司运营两个业务板块：药物开发支持（销售蛋白激酶产品，提供激酶分析和筛选服务）及新药研发（以BTK抑制剂为主）。核心候选药物docirbrutinib（AS-1763），为非共价可逆BTK抑制剂，正在美国开展I期临床（B细胞恶性肿瘤）。2025财年收入约22.68亿日元，员工61人，市值约65亿日元。
companies.description_en: Carna Biosciences, Inc. (TSE Growth: 4572, est. April 2003, Kobe, Hyogo) operates two segments: Drug Development Support (kinase protein products, profiling/screening services generating stable annual revenue ~JPY 1.0–1.5 billion) and Drug Development (kinase inhibitor R&D). Lead asset: docirbrutinib (AS-1763), a non-covalent reversible BTK inhibitor in Phase 1b US trials for B-cell malignancies resistant to existing BTK inhibitors. FY2025 total revenue JPY 2.27 billion; 61 employees; market cap JPY 6.5 billion.

companies.description_zh: CellSource株式会社（东京证券交易所：4880）成立于2015年，总部位于东京，是一家专注于再生医疗产业化的生命科学服务公司。公司主要业务包括：为医疗机构提供脂肪来源干细胞和富血小板血浆的委托处理服务，以及再生医疗法规合规支持服务（再生医学业务板块）；另有消费者业务板块（护肤及抗衰老产品）。FY2025（截止2025年10月）收入约44.5亿日元，员工157人，市值105.8亿日元。公司因未达到东京证券交易所Prime市场持续上市要求而正申请转至标准市场。
companies.description_en: CellSource Co., Ltd. (TSE: 4880, est. 2015, Tokyo) industrializes regenerative medicine services. Regenerative Medicine segment: processes adipose-derived stem cells (SVF/ASC) and platelet-rich plasma (PRP) from patient fat and blood for medical institutions; provides regulatory compliance support for the Regenerative Medicine Safety Act. Consumer segment: cosmetics and anti-aging products. Fiscal year ends October 31. FY2025 (Oct 2025) revenue JPY 4.45 billion; 157 employees; market cap JPY 10.58 billion. Moving from TSE Prime to Standard Market.

sources.title: CellSource to Shift Listing to TSE Standard Market — TipRanks

companies.description_zh: 科迪亚治疗株式会社（东京证券交易所：190A）成立于2017年10月，由原武田制药药物发现研究人员创立，是武田制药的孵化衍生公司，2024年6月在东京证券交易所成长市场上市。公司专注于小分子first-in-class抗癌药物研发，核心候选药物rogocekib（CTX-712，CLK激酶抑制剂，RNA剪接机制）已完成日本I期临床，并于2025年1月获得美国FDA授予的急性髓系白血病（复发/难治性）孤儿药资格，目前正在美国开展I期临床试验。FY8/2025（截止2025年8月31日）研发费用14亿日元，净亏损17.85亿日元，员工23人（含12名博士）。
companies.description_en: Chordia Therapeutics Inc. (TSE Growth: 190A, est. October 2017, Tokyo) is a Takeda Pharmaceutical spin-out focused on first-in-class small-molecule oncology drugs. Lead asset: rogocekib (CTX-712), a CLK kinase inhibitor that induces RNA splicing stress selectively in cancer cells—Phase I completed in Japan; FDA Orphan Drug Designation for relapsed/refractory AML (January 2025); US Phase I ongoing; interim results expected mid-2026. Pipeline also includes CTX-177 (MALT1 inhibitor). FY ended August 2025: R&D expense JPY 1.40 billion (~JPY 1.0 billion for rogocekib); net loss JPY 1.785 billion; no revenue; 23 employees (12 PhDs); market cap JPY 9.55 billion. NDA filing target end of 2028.

companies.description_en: Develops scaffold-free 3D bioprinting technology (Regenova®, S-PIKE®) for regeneration of cartilage, blood vessels, and nerve tissues; founded on Kyushu University research by Dr. Koichi Nakayama.

companies.description_en: Osaka University spin-off developing functional peptides; lead SR-0379 (skin ulcer, Ph3); AJP001 antibody-inducing peptide for therapeutic mRNA vaccines; FPP003 (Ph2, psoriasis); pre-revenue stage.

companies.description_en: Japan-listed innovator with primary operations in China via Gyre Pharmaceuticals; Etuary® (pirfenidone) was China's first Class 1.1 new drug approval (2011, IPF); FY2025 revenue ¥26.8B; pipeline: F351 (IPF/NASH), F573, pirfenidone in oncology Ph2/3.

companies.description_en: iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte spheroid therapy developer; HS-001 (advanced heart failure) LAPiS Ph1/2 enrollment complete (10 patients); HS-005 (dilated cardiomyopathy) EMERALD Ph1/2 first patient dosed March 2026; IPO July 2024.

companies.description_en: Japan regenerative medicine pioneer; acquired Athersys MultiStem® assets (2024) for ARDS and ischemic stroke; iPSC eNK cell platform for solid tumors; FY2025 revenue ¥104M (-81% YoY); 65 employees.

companies.description_en: Fujioka-based life science tools company offering ELISA kits, custom antibody production, and transgenic silkworm protein expression platform for recombinant proteins including human collagen and diagnostic antibodies.

companies.description_zh: 专注于自体骨骼肌细胞疗法治疗大便失禁和尿失禁的临床阶段企业；起源于因斯布鲁克医科大学（奥地利）2000年，2021年将全球总部迁至东京，2026年2月于TSE成长板IPO（募资约92亿日元）；核心管线ICEF15已进入全球多中心Phase3。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage autologous cell therapy company for fecal and urinary incontinence; originated at Medical University of Innsbruck (2000), HQ relocated to Tokyo (2021); IPO Feb 2026 raising ~¥14.2B; ICEF15 in global multiregional Ph3.

companies.description_zh: 以SLC转运蛋白（尤其是LAT1氨基酸转运体）为药物靶点的创新药发现企业，核心管线JPH034（中枢神经系统脱髓鞘疾病/多发性硬化症），与学术机构合作推进药物发现研究；尚无商业收入。
companies.description_en: Drug discovery biotech targeting solute carrier (SLC) transporters, primarily L-type amino acid transporter 1 (LAT1); lead JPH034 for CNS demyelinating disease/MS; academic collaboration model; pre-revenue.

companies.description_zh: 利用疾病特异性iPSC技术开发脊髓损伤和脑梗塞再生医疗产品的临床前/临床早期企业；成立于2016年，尚无商业收入，FY2025净亏损约9.93亿日元。
companies.description_en: Early-stage biotech developing disease-specific iPSC-based regenerative therapies for spinal cord injury and cerebral infarction; founded 2016, pre-revenue, FY2025 net loss ¥993M.

companies.description_zh: 抗体药物发现及许可合作企业（注：市场代码4583原为Chiome Bioscience，可能已更名为KaioM BioScience），核心业务包括抗体药物发现（靶向肿瘤/免疫高需求领域）和合同抗体研发支持服务。
companies.description_en: Tokyo antibody drug discovery company (TSE:4583, roster-listed as KaioM BioScience; previously Chiome Bioscience); operates drug discovery pipeline targeting high-unmet oncology/immunology needs and drug discovery support services for pharma/biotech clients.

sources.title: Chiome Bioscience Inc. Profile – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 日本专科药企，以皮肤科（外用抗真菌药依芬康唑）和骨科领域为核心；产品包括骨质疏松症、关节炎、皮肤病、过敏和镇痛等领域，90%以上收入来自日本国内。FY2026营收768亿日元，净利润21亿日元。
companies.description_en: Tokyo-based specialty pharma with dermatology (antifungal efinaconazole/Clenafin), orthopedics, and pain management as core; FY2026 (ended Mar 2026) revenue ¥76.9B (-18% YoY from peak); 90%+ Japan domestic sales.

Kaken Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. Profile – GlobalData

companies.description_zh: 采用双层商业模式：生物类似药业务提供稳定现金流（GBS-001/010/007/011），同时以乳牙干细胞SHED技术推进儿科及罕见病细胞疗法（GCT-103儿童脑瘫，GCT-102先天性肠道神经病）。前身为Gene Techno Science，2021年更名。
companies.description_en: Dual-model biotech: biosimilar products (GBS-001/010/007/011) generate stable cash flow while SQ-SHED (stem cells from human exfoliated deciduous teeth) cell therapy pipeline targets pediatric cerebral palsy (GCT-103 Ph ongoing) and rare disease; FY2026 revenue ¥6.59B (+29.7%).

sources.title: Kidswell Bio Corporation Profile – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 科林格制药是大阪大学衍生的生物技术公司，专注于开发基于重组人肝细胞生长因子（HGF）蛋白的再生医学疗法，适应症包括急性脊髓损伤、肌萎缩侧索硬化症、声带瘢痕和急性肾损伤，旗舰产品KP-100IT已于2025年6月获FDA孤儿药资格。
companies.description_en: Osaka University spin-off developing recombinant human HGF protein therapeutics for intractable diseases. Lead asset KP-100IT (intrathecal HGF) is in Phase III for acute spinal cord injury and vocal fold scarring; FDA orphan drug designation granted June 2025. US subsidiary Kringle Pharma USA established in 2025.

sources.title: Acute Spinal Cord Injury Pipeline - Kringle Pharma

companies.description_zh: 久保田制药控股专注于眼科领域，开发用于治疗视网膜疾病的药物和医疗器械，包括远程视网膜监测设备eyeMO、用于Stargardt病的emixustat hydrochloride（III期）以及光遗传学基因疗法，前身为2002年成立于西雅图的Acucela Inc.。
companies.description_en: Ophthalmology-focused biopharma and medical device company developing remote retinal monitoring (eyeMO OCT devices) alongside drug candidates for Stargardt disease (emixustat hydrochloride, Phase III), diabetic retinopathy, and optogenetics-based gene therapy for retinitis pigmentosa. Founded as Acucela Inc. in Seattle in 2002 by Dr. Ryo Kubota.

sources.title: Innovation in Drugs and Devices - Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 杏林制药是日本中型制药企业，研究开发、生产和销售伦理药和仿制药，治疗领域包括哮喘、过敏、咳嗽、膀胱疾病及胃肠疾病，于2023年4月由杏林控股合并子公司重组，同时开发数字疗法KRP-DC125（慢性咳嗽）。
companies.description_en: Mid-size Japanese pharmaceutical company researching, developing, manufacturing and selling ethical and generic drugs, with key focus on respiratory (asthma, cough), allergy, urology and gastrointestinal therapeutics. April 2023 merger of KYORIN Holdings with its operating subsidiary. Also developing digital therapeutics (KRP-DC125 for chronic cough). HQ: Ochanomizu Sola City, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo.

companies.description_zh: 医疗新星是日美双重上市的生物制药公司，专注于神经系统、呼吸系统和肝脏疾病的小分子创新疗法。核心管线为MN-166（ibudilast），正在ALS、多发性硬化症、神经胶质母细胞瘤、化疗诱导的周围神经病变等多个适应症推进临床；MN-001（tipelukast）用于NAFLD等代谢性疾病。
companies.description_en: US-Japan dual-listed biopharmaceutical company (incorporated in Delaware, operational HQ in La Jolla CA, listed on TSE JASDAQ as 4875 and NASDAQ as MNOV). Develops small-molecule therapeutics for neurology, respiratory and liver diseases. Lead asset MN-166 (ibudilast) in clinical development for ALS, MS, glioblastoma, CIPN, ARDS; MN-001 (tipelukast) for NAFLD and hypertriglyceridemia.

companies.description_zh: MedRx是全球首家利用离子液体技术开发新型透皮给药药物的制药公司，核心技术平台为ILTS（离子液体透皮系统），管线包括MRX-4TZT（痉挛麻痹，I期）、MRX-9FLT（慢性癌性及重度疼痛，I期）及帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病候选药物，总部位于日本香川县东香川市。
companies.description_en: World's first pharmaceutical company utilizing ionic liquid technology for transdermal drug delivery. Proprietary ILTS (Ionic Liquid Transdermal System) and nano-sized colloid platforms underpin a pipeline including MRX-4TZT (spastic paralysis, Phase I), MRX-9FLT (chronic/cancer/severe pain, Phase I), and preclinical candidates for Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease. HQ: 431-7 Nishiyama, Higashikagawa-city, Kagawa.

companies.description_zh: 持田制药成立于1913年，是日本具有百年历史的制药公司，核心业务聚焦心血管、产科妇科、精神科及消化内科，主要产品包括dotinurad（痛风/高尿酸血症）、mesalazine（溃疡性结肠炎）、tocilizumab（类风湿关节炎）及妇科产品，总部位于东京新宿区四谷。
companies.description_en: Century-old Japanese pharmaceutical company (est. 1913) focused on cardiovascular, obstetrics/gynecology, psychiatry and gastroenterology. Key marketed products include dotinurad (gout/hyperuricemia), mesalazine (ulcerative colitis), tocilizumab (rheumatoid arthritis) and dienogest (dysmenorrhea). Also develops generics, biosimilars and medical devices. HQ: 1-7 Yotsuya, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo.

sources.title: Mochida Pharmaceutical TSE:4534 Earnings - Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 莫达利斯治疗是东京大学系的临床前基因疗法公司，利用专有CRISPR-GNDM（基因组核调控元件调控）平台进行表观基因组编辑，无需双链DNA剪切，适应症聚焦肌肉疾病、心肌病和中枢神经系统罕见遗传病，管线包括MDL-101（LAMA2-CMD）、MDL-201（FSHD）等。
companies.description_en: University of Tokyo spin-off developing non-cutting CRISPR-based epigenome editing therapeutics for rare genetic disorders. Proprietary CRISPR-GNDM technology modulates gene expression without DNA cleavage. Pipeline includes MDL-101 (LAMA2-deficient congenital muscular dystrophy), MDL-201 (facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy, collaboration with SOLVE FSHD), and programs for cardiomyopathy and CNS conditions. R&D operations based in Waltham, Massachusetts.

companies.description_zh: 纳诺控股（前身NANO MRNA，2025年12月更名）是利用胶束纳米粒子技术开发mRNA、siRNA和ASO创新药物的日本生物技术公司，管线包括RUNX1 mRNA（膝关节骨关节炎，已商业化Comlex耳科抗菌药）、NC-6100 PRDM14 siRNA（乳腺癌，I期）及多种肿瘤疫苗和感染性疾病预防疫苗项目。
companies.description_en: Formerly NanoCarrier/NANO MRNA (renamed Nano Holdings December 2025), leverages proprietary micellar nanoparticle drug delivery technology for mRNA, siRNA and ASO medicines. Pipeline includes RUNX1 mRNA (knee osteoarthritis), NC-6100 PRDM14 siRNA (breast cancer, Phase I), and programs in cancer vaccines, preventive vaccines and genome editing. Comlex antibacterial otic solution launched June 2023. HQ: Minato, Tokyo.

sources.title: NANO MRNA / Nano Holdings Official Website

companies.description_zh: 日本化学制药（Nippon Chemiphar，创立于1950年）是日本综合制药企业，核心业务为处方药研发、生产、进出口及诊断试剂，同时涉及医疗、健康和美容相关业务，总部位于东京千代田区，2000年起推进仿制药业务。
companies.description_en: Japanese pharmaceutical company (est. 1950 as Hitachi Chemical, renamed 1970) manufacturing and selling ethical pharmaceuticals, diagnostic agents and healthcare/beauty products. Core focus: prescription drugs including urology (Uralyt), cardiovascular, and metabolic disease agents. Also operates generics (from 2000) and medical sterilization services. HQ: Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. Listed TSE 1976.

revenue.note_en: FY ended March 31 2026 revenue JPY235.10 billion (+4.29% YoY); prior FY ended March 2025 was JPY225.42 billion (+1.55%)

companies.description_zh: 日本领先的医用电子设备制造商（1951年创立），研发、生产、销售并维护生理测量设备，包括患者监护仪、心电/脑电系统、除颤器及急救设备。业务遍及日本、美洲、欧洲及亚洲。总部位于东京新宿区。截至2026年3月财年营收2,351亿日元（+4.3%）；上一财年（截至2025年3月）为2,254亿日元。
companies.description_en: Japan's leading medical electronic equipment manufacturer (est. 1951), researching, developing, producing, selling and servicing physiological measurement equipment including patient monitors, ECG/EEG systems, defibrillators and emergency medical devices. Global operations spanning Japan, Americas, Europe and Asia. HQ: Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo. FY ending March 2026 revenue JPY 235.1B (+4.3%); the FY ended March 2025 was JPY 225.4B.

companies.description_zh: 诺伊尔免疫生物技术成立于2015年，是山口大学系的CAR-T细胞疗法公司，专有PRIME（促进增殖和迁移增强）技术可改善免疫细胞在实体瘤中的增殖和浸润，管线包括NIB101-NIB104、ADAP01、AUTL01等，与武田、中外制药、C4U等公司达成授权合作。
companies.description_en: Yamaguchi University spin-off (est. 2015) developing next-generation CAR-T cell therapies for solid tumors using proprietary PRIME (Proliferation-Inducing and Migration-Enhancing) technology, exclusively licensed from Yamaguchi University. Pipeline includes NIB101 (solid tumors), NIB102 (autologous CAR-T), NIB103 (mesothelin-targeting), NIB104, plus allogeneic programs ADAP01, AUTL01 and CHUG01. Partners include Takeda, Chugai and C4U. HQ: 2-12-10 Shibadaimon, Minato-ku, Tokyo.

sources.title: Chugai and Noile-Immune PRIME CAR-T License Agreement

companies.description_zh: 奥可利斯生物制药成立于2004年，专注于溶瘤病毒、肿瘤诊断试剂和抗癌药的研发，旗舰产品Telomelysin（OBP-301）为溶瘤腺病毒，正在食管癌、头颈癌、肝细胞癌等适应症推进临床，TelomeScan（OBP-401/1101）用于循环肿瘤细胞检测，总部位于东京港区虎之门。
companies.description_en: Oncolytic virus-focused biopharmaceutical company (est. 2004) developing Telomelysin (OBP-301, telomerase-specific oncolytic adenovirus) in Phase II for gastric/GEJ, head&neck and esophageal cancers, and Phase I for HCC; OBP-702 (solid tumors, preclinical); OBP-801 (HDAC inhibitor, preclinical); TelomeScan (OBP-401/1101) for circulating tumor cell detection. Operations span Japan, Asia and US. HQ: Toranomon Towers, Minato-ku, Tokyo.

companies.description_zh: 肿瘤治疗科学成立于2001年，是东京大学人类基因组研究中心的系属生物技术公司，专注癌症基因组学和肿瘤抗原发现，开发癌症肽疫苗、抗体药物、液体活检和免疫治疗，与大冢制药、小野药品和盐野义制药等签有授权协议，子公司Cancer Precision Medicine专注新抗原预测。
companies.description_en: University of Tokyo Human Genome Center spin-off (est. April 6, 2001) pioneering cancer genomics-based drug discovery. Develops cancer peptide vaccines, antibody drugs, liquid biopsy diagnostics and novel immunotherapies including neoantigen-based approaches. Out-licensing partnerships with Otsuka, Ono Pharmaceutical and Shionogi. Subsidiary Cancer Precision Medicine (CPM) focuses on genome analysis and neoantigen prediction. HQ: 3-2-1 Sakado, Takatsu-ku, Kawasaki, Kanagawa.

companies.description_zh: 珀耳修斯蛋白质组学是东京大学先端科学技术研究中心的系属生物技术公司，成立于2001年，利用专有抗体技术开发功能性治疗抗体和抗体药物偶联物（ADC）用于肿瘤治疗，并于2024年与宇部兴产签署ADC合作研究协议。
companies.description_en: Drug discovery biotech venture (est. 2001) founded on proprietary antibody technologies from the University of Tokyo RCAST. Develops functional therapeutic antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates (ADC) targeting cancer antigens. Entered ADC collaborative research agreement with UBE Corporation in October 2024. IPO on TSE Growth June 2021. HQ: Tokyo.

sources.title: Perseus Proteomics and UBE ADC Collaboration - UBE Corporation

companies.description_zh: PRISM BioLab成立于2006年，利用专有PepMetics技术（模拟alpha螺旋和beta转角三维结构的拟肽小分子）开发蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）靶向小分子抑制剂，适应症包括肿瘤、自身免疫和纤维化疾病，管线中FEP633针对癌症eIF4E/eIF4G1，E7386（CBP/β-catenin，II期，授权艾莎制药）及PRI724（肝硬化，II期）。
companies.description_en: Drug discovery biotech (est. 2006, Fujisawa Japan) leveraging proprietary PepMetics technology — small molecules mimicking alpha-helix and beta-turn peptide structures — to inhibit protein-protein interactions in cancer, autoimmune disease and fibrosis. Clinical-stage assets: E7386 (CBP/beta-catenin, Phase II cancer, licensed to Eisai) and PRI724 (CBP/beta-catenin, Phase II cirrhosis, Ohara Pharmaceuticals). In-house program FEP633 (eIF4E/eIF4G1, urothelial carcinoma, lead optimization). HQ: Tokyo.

companies.description_zh: 克瑞普斯（Cuorips，前名QualiPs，TSE 4894）成立于2017年，专注于开发和商业化来源于iPS细胞的心肌细胞片治疗产品，用于重度心力衰竭的再生医疗，已向厚生劳动省申报iPS细胞来源心脏细胞片的制造销售许可，并与斯坦福大学心胸外科系签订联合研究合同，总部位于东京中央区日本桥本町。
companies.description_en: Regenerative medicine company (est. March 21, 2017) developing and commercializing iPS cell-derived cardiomyocyte sheets for severe heart failure. Submitted manufacturing and sales approval application for iPS cell-derived cardiac cell sheets to Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare. Joint research contract with Stanford University Cardiothoracic Surgery. HQ: 507, Nihonbashi Life Science Building 2, 3-11-5 Nihonbashi Honcho, Chuo-ku, Tokyo 103-0023. Note: company name in TSE input listed as 'QualiPs' but official name is Cuorips Inc.

companies.description_zh: 罗夸利亚制药是名古屋的科学驱动型药物研发公司，成立于2008年，专注于胃肠道、疼痛和代谢疾病领域，人类管线包括tegoprazan（胃食管反流病）、grapiprant（癌症和疼痛）；兽医管线包括capromorelin（犬猫食欲不振）和grapiprant（犬骨关节炎），总部位于名古屋市中村区名驿，研发中心位于名古屋大学。
companies.description_en: Science-driven pharmaceutical R&D company (est. 2008) based in Nagoya, focused on gastroenterology, pain and metabolic diseases. Human products: tegoprazan (GERD), grapiprant (pain/cancer). Veterinary products: capromorelin (anorexia in dogs/cats) and grapiprant (canine osteoarthritis) — a meaningful revenue driver. R&D facility at Nagoya University. HQ: 8F Meieki Southside Square, 1-21-19 Meieki Minami, Nakamura-ku, Nagoya 450-0003.

companies.description_zh: 再生科学成立于2000年，是东北大学系的仙台生物技术公司，核心平台为PAI-1（纤溶酶原激活物抑制剂-1）抑制剂，管线包括RS5614（多种癌症及肺损伤，临床前/I期）、RS5441（脱发，I期）和RS8001（经前综合征/更年期，维生素类）；公司同时开发AI诊断解决方案（FENI）和医疗器械，2025年与西北大学及东北大学签署MOU开展合作研究。
companies.description_en: Sendai-based biotech (est. 2000) spun out from Tohoku University research, developing PAI-1 (plasminogen activator inhibitor-1) inhibitors and adjacent platforms. Pipeline: RS5614 (PAI-1 inhibitor for CML, melanoma, NSCLC, angiosarcoma, COVID lung injury, systemic scleroderma-ILD); RS5441 (PAI-1 inhibitor, alopecia, Phase I); RS8001 (water-soluble vitamin, PMS/PMDD and menopausal disorder); FENI AI diagnostic solution; medical devices. MOU with Northwestern University and Tohoku University signed November 2025 for collaborative longevity research.

companies.description_zh: 株式会社リボミックは、RNA（リボ核酸）アプタマー技術を用いた医薬品の探索・開発を行うバイオ創薬企業。主要パイプラインRBM-007（抗FGF2アプタマー）は、加齢黄斑変性・軟骨無形成症・肺動脈性肺高血圧症等の治療を対象として臨床試験を進める。
companies.description_en: RIBOMIC Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Tokyo that discovers and develops RNA aptamer-based therapeutics. Its lead asset RBM-007 (anti-FGF2 aptamer) is in clinical development for wet age-related macular degeneration (wAMD) and achondroplasia. The company also develops aptamer affinity tools for antibody purification. As of 2025, RIBOMIC was pre-revenue with approximately JP¥3.0b cash and ~2.9 years of runway.

companies.description_zh: サンバイオは、同種骨髄由来改変間葉系幹細胞療法（SB623）を中核とする再生医療バイオテクノロジー企業。主力製品AKUUGO（SB623）は、2024年7月に外傷性脳損傷による慢性運動麻痺を適応症として日本初の条件付き時限承認を取得した。
companies.description_en: SanBio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company specializing in allogeneic modified mesenchymal stem cell (SB623) therapies for central nervous system disorders. Its lead product AKUUGO (SB623) received conditional and time-limited approval in Japan in July 2024 as the world's first regenerative cell therapy for chronic motor paralysis due to traumatic brain injury (TBI). Additional pipeline targets include chronic cerebral infarction, AMD, spinal cord injury, Parkinson's disease, and Alzheimer's disease.

sources.title: Simply Wall St - SanBio AKUUGO Progress

companies.name_zh: サワイグループホールディングス株式会社

revenue.note_en: FY2025 (ended March 31, 2025) consolidated revenue JPY 189.024 billion (+6.88% YoY)

companies.description_zh: 泽井集团控股是日本最大仿制药制造商之一的控股公司，核心子公司泽井制药在心血管、中枢神经、消化、肿瘤等领域开发、生产并销售仿制药，并正向生物类似药与高附加值仿制药扩展，目标年产约220亿片自有产能。2025财年收入1,890亿日元（+6.88%）。
companies.description_en: Sawai Group Holdings is the holding company for one of Japan's largest generic pharmaceutical manufacturers. Its core subsidiary Sawai Pharmaceutical develops, manufactures and markets generic drugs across cardiovascular, CNS, gastrointestinal, oncology and other therapeutic areas. The group is expanding into biosimilars and value-added generics, targeting ~22 billion tablets per year of in-house production capacity. FY2025 revenue JPY 189.0B (+6.88%).

sources.title: Stock Analysis - Sawai Group Holdings Revenue
Simply Wall St - Sawai Group Valuation

companies.description_zh: 生化学工業はグリコサミノグリカン（ヒアルロン酸・コンドロイチン硫酸等）の研究・開発・製造・販売を行う特殊製薬企業。主力製品ARTZ（ヒアルロン酸ナトリウム関節内注射）は世界40以上の国・地域で販売。LAL（カブトガニ血球抽出物）事業も手掛け、エンドトキシン測定試薬を供給。
companies.description_en: Seikagaku Corporation is a Tokyo-based specialty pharmaceutical company focused on glycosaminoglycan-based products. Its Pharmaceuticals segment markets ARTZ and SUPARTZ FX intra-articular hyaluronate injections for knee osteoarthritis in over 40 countries, as well as ophthalmic surgical aids and endoscopic submucosal injection materials. The LAL Business segment supplies limulus amebocyte lysate (LAL) reagents used globally for endotoxin testing in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

companies.name_zh: ソラシアファーマ株式会社
companies.description_zh: ソラシアファーマは、日本・アジア市場向けにオンコロジー医薬品の開発・販売を行う特化型製薬企業。DARVIAS（プラリトレキサート注射剤、再発・難治性末梢性T細胞リンパ腫）およびEpisil（口腔粘膜炎治療用口腔内液剤）を市場化している。
companies.description_en: Solasia Pharma K.K. is a specialty biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and marketing oncology drugs in Japan and other Asian markets. Approved products include DARVIAS (pralatrexate injection for relapsed/refractory peripheral T-cell lymphoma) and Episil (oral liquid for oral mucositis/stomatitis). Pipeline includes SP-04 for chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy and SP-05 for colorectal cancer.

companies.name_zh: ステラファーマ株式会社
companies.description_zh: ステラファーマは、ホウ素中性子捕捉療法（BNCT）向けホウ素薬剤の開発・製造・販売に特化した製薬企業。主力製品のBPA（4-ボロノフェニルアラニン）製剤ステボロニンは、世界初の臨床承認ホウ素薬剤として、頭頸部がんおよび悪性神経膠腫の治療に用いられる。
companies.description_en: Stella Pharma Corporation is an Osaka-based specialty pharmaceutical company exclusively focused on boron neutron capture therapy (BNCT). Its borophenylalanine (BPA) product Steboronine is the world's first and only clinically approved boron drug for BNCT, indicated for head and neck cancer and malignant glioma. The company partners with accelerator-based BNCT system operators for clinical deployment globally.

sources.title: Simply Wall St - Stella Pharma Earnings & Revenue

companies.description_zh: ステムリムは、骨髄由来幹細胞を誘導するHMGB1ペプチド（PJ1）を中核に、難治性疾患向けの再生誘導医薬品を開発する茨木市拠点のバイオテク企業。PJ1は表皮水疱症・脳梗塞・変形性関節症・慢性肝臓病・心筋症を対象に第II相臨床試験中。前臨床段階の後継パイプラインPJ2～PJ5も保有。
companies.description_en: StemRIM Inc. is a Ibaraki, Osaka-based clinical-stage biotechnology company developing regenerative induction medicines based on HMGB1 peptides that mobilize bone marrow-derived stem cells. Lead asset PJ1 is in Phase II trials for epidermolysis bullosa, cerebral infarction, osteoarthritis, chronic liver disease, and cardiomyopathy. Pre-clinical pipeline includes PJ2/PJ3 (multi-tissue damage), PJ4 (autologous cell sampling device), and PJ5 (stem cell gene therapy). The company was pre-revenue with JP¥7.7b cash as of January 2025.

companies.name_zh: シンバイオ製薬株式会社
companies.description_zh: シンバイオ製薬は、血液腫瘍・ウイルス感染症領域に特化した東京拠点の特化型製薬企業。TREAKISYM（ベンダムスチン塩酸塩）は低悪性度B細胞性非ホジキンリンパ腫・慢性リンパ性白血病を適応症に承認済み。バイオリミテッドとの協力のもと開発を推進。
companies.description_en: SymBio Pharmaceuticals Limited is a specialty pharmaceutical company based in Tokyo focused on hematology, oncology, and infectious disease. Its approved product Treakisym (bendamustine hydrochloride) is indicated for indolent B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia in Japan. The company was experiencing revenue decline in 2025 (down ~50% year-over-year) as it refocuses its commercial and pipeline strategy.

companies.description_zh: 大幸薬品は、整腸薬「セイロガン糖衣A」をはじめとする一般用医薬品の製造販売に加え、二酸化塩素ガスを用いた感染制御製品（クレベリン）を展開する大阪発の製薬企業。腸管系OTC薬と感染制御の2事業を柱とし、法人向け除菌・殺菌ソリューション市場にも参入。
companies.description_en: Taiko Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is an Osaka-based pharmaceutical company with two main business segments. Its Pharmaceutical segment manufactures and sells the well-known SEIROGAN gastrointestinal OTC drugs (for diarrhea/food poisoning). Its Infection Control segment develops and markets Cleverin-branded chlorine dioxide gas products for space decontamination and air purification in commercial and industrial settings.

companies.description_zh: TMSは、東京農工大学発ベンチャーとして2005年に設立された小規模の創薬バイオテク企業。溶解性エポキシドハイドロラーゼ（sEH）阻害を基軸に、急性脳梗塞（TMS-007、第2相試験完了）・炎症性疾患・高血圧（JX09）などを対象に研究開発を展開。Biogenと急性虚血性脳卒中向けTMS-007のオプション契約を締結した実績あり。
companies.description_en: TMS Co., Ltd. is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical R&D company spun out of Tokyo University of Agriculture and Technology in 2005, headquartered in Fuchu, Tokyo. Its pipeline is focused on soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH) inhibitors for anti-inflammatory indications. Lead asset TMS-007 completed Phase 2a for acute ischemic stroke, with Biogen exercising an option to acquire it. Other pipeline assets include TMS-008 (acute inflammatory diseases including kidney injury and cancer cachexia) and JX09 (resistant hypertension). The company had no commercial revenue as of 2024, with ~JP¥3.1b cash.
companies.sub_sector: SMTP small molecules for acute ischemic stroke

revenue.note_en: FY2025 (ended March 31 2025) net sales JPY259,594 million (+13.9% YoY); domestic JPY206,103M, overseas JPY53,865M; operating profit JPY23,242M (+31.7%)

companies.description_zh: 東和薬品株式会社是日本领先的仿制药制造商之一，总部位于大阪，在大阪、冈山、山形设有生产基地。公司销售逾500种仿制药，覆盖心血管、中枢神经、消化、抗过敏、抗肿瘤等领域。2025财年（截至2025年3月）净销售额达2,596亿日元，同比增长13.9%，营业利润增长31.7%。
companies.description_en: Towa Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is one of Japan's leading generic drug manufacturers headquartered in Osaka, with manufacturing at its Osaka, Okayama, and Yamagata plants. The company markets over 500 generic drugs spanning cardiovascular, CNS, digestive, anti-allergy, anti-cancer, and other therapeutic areas. FY2025 (ended March 2025) net sales reached JP¥259.6 billion, up 13.9% year-over-year, with operating profit up 31.7%.

companies.description_zh: 坪田ラボは、慶應義塾大学医学部の坪田一男教授が設立した東京拠点の眼科専門バイオテク。近視・ドライアイ・老視・円錐角膜の革新的治療法開発に取り組む。収益は共同研究契約・ライセンス一時金・マイルストーン・ロイヤルティで構成。FY2025売上高は13.6億円（前年比102%増）で初の黒字化を達成。
companies.description_en: Tsubota Laboratory, Inc. is a Tokyo-based ophthalmic biotechnology company founded in 2012 by Professor Kazuo Tsubota of Keio University. It develops innovative treatments for myopia, dry eye, presbyopia, and keratoconus, including violet light-emitting spectacle devices and pharmacological candidates. Revenue is derived from joint R&D agreements, licensing, and royalties. FY2025 revenue was JP¥1.36b (up 102% YoY), with the company achieving its first annual profit.

revenue.note_en: FY2025 (ended March 2025) net sales JPY 181.09B (+20.05% YoY)

companies.description_zh: 津村株式会社是日本汉方药（传统日本草药）领军企业，创立于1893年。核心业务为处方汉方提取制剂（颗粒剂）和OTC汉方产品，掌控从原料种植、质量管理到生产和临床研究的全价值链。2025财年净销售额1810.9亿日元（同比+20%），2027财年中期目标2340亿日元。
companies.description_en: Tsumura & Co. is Japan's leading Kampo (traditional Japanese herbal medicine) pharmaceutical manufacturer, founded in 1893. The company's core business is prescription Kampo extract formulations (granules) and OTC Kampo products, controlling the entire value chain from raw material cultivation and quality management to manufacturing and clinical research. FY2025 (ending March 2025) net sales were JP¥181.09 billion, up 20% YoY. Medium-term target is JP¥234 billion by FY2027.

companies.name_zh: 株式会社ベリタスインシリコ
companies.description_zh: ベリタスインシリコは、独自のAIプラットフォーム（ibVIS）を用いて低分子医薬・核酸医薬の創薬を行う東京発の創薬AI企業。塩野義製薬との共同プロジェクトで主要マイルストーンを達成。ALS・急性腎障害・心血管手術後適応症向け核酸医薬パイプラインを構築中。将来はスペシャリティファーマへの転換を目指す。
companies.description_en: Veritas In Silico Inc. is a Tokyo-based AI drug discovery company founded in 2016, publicly listed on TSE Growth (ticker: 130A). Its proprietary ibVIS platform enables mRNA-targeted small molecule and nucleic acid drug design. The company has progressed pipeline milestones with Shionogi and is developing nucleic acid therapeutics for ALS, acute kidney injury after cardiovascular surgery, and other indications via its catheter-based DDS 'Perfusio'. Long-term strategy is to evolve into a specialty pharmaceutical company.

sources.title: Stock Analysis - Veritas In Silico Market Cap
BigGo Finance - Veritas In Silico AI Drug Discovery

companies.name_zh: わかもと製薬株式会社
companies.description_zh: わかもと製薬は1929年創業の東京拠点製薬企業。医療用医薬品（眼科薬・消化器薬）、一般用医薬品（整腸薬）、特販事業の3事業を展開。主力製品は強力わかもと（整腸薬）、AVANTBISE（口腔内フローラ調整サプリ）、およびパタノール等眼科薬。
companies.description_en: Wakamoto Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., founded in 1929, is a Tokyo-based specialty pharmaceutical company operating in three segments: Medicines (ophthalmic and gastrointestinal ethical drugs), Non-Prescription Drugs (digestive health OTCs including Wakamoto digestive tablets), and Special Sales. Products include oral and topical gastrointestinal preparations and ophthalmic agents. The company also markets AVANTBISE oral bacterial supplements for oral flora balance.

companies.name_zh: ゼリア新薬工業株式会社
companies.description_zh: ゼリア新薬工業は、胃腸・消化器疾患を中核領域とする日本の中堅製薬企業。ウルソ（ウルソデオキシコール酸）等の肝・胆・消化器治療薬を世界的に展開し、海外売上比率はFY2024に56.9%に達した。第11次中期計画ではグローバルGI（消化器）リーダーを目標として掲げる。
companies.description_en: Zeria Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is a Tokyo-based mid-size pharmaceutical company with a strategic focus on gastrointestinal health. Key products include Urso (ursodeoxycholic acid for liver/biliary disorders) and other GI treatments marketed globally. Overseas sales reached a record 56.9% of total revenue in FY2024. Under its 11th Mid-Term Management Plan, the company targets becoming a global GI specialist. FY2025 (ending March 2025) revenue was JP¥87.3 billion, up 15% YoY.

companies.description_zh: Biomm S.A.はブラジル唯一のバイオテクノロジー専業上場企業で、ミナスジェライス州ノバリマ拠点。インスリン製品（GLARGILIN、Afrezza吸入インスリン、Wosulin）の製造・販売と、バイオシミラー（Herzuma/トラスツズマブ、Bevyx/ベバシズマブ）の商業化を手掛ける。バイオブラス（Biobrás）の分割で設立、同社のバイオ医薬26年超の知見を継承。
companies.description_en: Biomm S.A. is Brazil's first and only publicly listed company exclusively dedicated to biotechnology, headquartered in Nova Lima, metropolitan Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais. Founded in 2001 from a partial split of global insulin producer Biobrás, the company manufactures and commercializes insulin products (GLARGILIN/glargine, Afrezza inhalable insulin, Wosulin human insulins) and biosimilars (Herzuma/trastuzumab, Bevyx/bevacizumab, Ghemaxan/enoxaparin). FY2024 revenue was approximately BRL 142.9 million.

companies.description_zh: Blau Farmacêutica S.A.は1987年創立のブラジルを代表する特化型製薬企業（コチア市拠点）。腫瘍科・腎臓科・血液科・感染症・麻酔科向けバイオ医薬品・バイオシミラー・注射用抗がん剤・血液製剤・抗ウイルス薬を主に製造販売。ブラジル・アルゼンチン・チリ・コロンビア等ラテンアメリカ各国にも展開。FY2024売上高17.5億BRL（前年比27.8%増）。
companies.description_en: Blau Farmacêutica S.A. is a leading Brazilian specialty pharmaceutical company founded in 1987, headquartered in Cotia, São Paulo state. It develops, manufactures, and commercializes injectables, biosimilars, blood products, antivirals, antiretrovirals, and oncology drugs across immunology, hematology, oncology, nephrology, infectology, and anesthesiology. The company operates across Latin American markets including Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Uruguay, and Ecuador. FY2024 revenue was BRL 1.75 billion (up 27.8% YoY), with Q3 2025 gross margin reaching 41%.

companies.description_zh: 弗拉瓜集团是墨西哥最大的药房零售集团，旗下运营瓜达拉哈拉药房连锁，在全国拥有超过1,300家门店。集团同时经营物流运输（Transportes y Envios de Guadalajara）和安防服务子公司。
companies.description_en: Corporativo Fragua is Mexico's largest pharmacy retail group, operating the Farmacia Guadalajara chain with over 1,300 stores nationwide. The company sells prescription and OTC medicines, food, cosmetics, and related products through subsidiaries including Fotosistemas Especializados and logistics operations.

sources.title: Simply Wall St – Corporativo Fragua profile

companies.description_zh: 欧洲法玛是巴西最大的制药集团之一，也是拉丁美洲领先的仿制药和生物制药生产商。公司成立于1972年，在22个国家开展业务，提供处方药、非处方药、肿瘤科、医院及兽药产品。2023年收购赛诺菲巴西仿制药业务。
companies.description_en: Eurofarma is one of Brazil's largest pharmaceutical companies and a leading generic and biopharmaceutical manufacturer in Latin America. Founded in 1972, it operates in 22 countries across 42 medical specialties with ~2,000 products. In 2023 it acquired Sanofi's generics operations in Brazil.

companies.description_zh: 贝纳维德斯药房是墨西哥第三大药房连锁，隶属于沃博联（Walgreens Boots Alliance）。公司成立于1917年，在全国拥有超过700家门店，销售处方药、非处方药、化妆品和个人护理产品，并提供实验室检测和网络药房服务。
companies.description_en: Farmacias Benavides is Mexico's third-largest pharmacy chain, a subsidiary of Walgreens Boots Alliance. Founded in 1917 in Monterrey, it operates over 700 stores nationwide offering prescription and OTC medicines, cosmetics, baby care products, lab services, and an online pharmacy.

companies.name_zh: 基诺玛实验室国际公司
companies.name_en: Genomma Lab Internacional SAB de CV
companies.description_zh: 基诺玛实验室国际公司是墨西哥领先的品牌消费健康品和OTC产品公司，成立于1996年。公司开发、生产和销售涵盖祛痘、抗皱、抗菌、胃肠、洗护等多类别消费品，在拉丁美洲15个以上国家销售产品。
companies.description_en: Genomma Lab is a leading Mexico-based branded OTC and consumer health company founded in 1996. It develops, manufactures, and markets pharmaceutical, beauty, and personal care products across 15+ Latin American countries, with brands in anti-acne, personal care, gastroenterology, and women's health.

sources.title: PR Newswire – Genomma Lab Q1 2025 results

rnd_spend.note: R&D as % of net revenue per Q3 2025 report; absolute figure not separately disclosed

companies.description_zh: 海佩拉制药（原Hypermarcas）是巴西最大的制药公司之一，2001年成立，2017年更名为Hypera Pharma，在B3 Novo Mercado上市。公司旗下拥有处方药、皮肤科、消费健康、仿制药及非零售市场五大业务单元，研发中心Hynova位于圣保罗。
companies.description_en: Hypera SA (formerly Hypermarcas) is Brazil's largest pharmaceutical company by domestic revenue, founded in 2001 and renamed Hypera Pharma in 2017. Listed on B3 Novo Mercado, it spans five business units: Branded Prescription, Skincare, Consumer Health, Similars & Generics, and Non-Retail Market, with its Hynova R&D center in Barueri.

companies.description_zh: 里士满实验室是阿根廷老牌制药企业，创立于1935年。公司专注于开发、生产和销售抗病毒（含HIV）、肿瘤、心血管及神经精神科药物，产品销售覆盖拉丁美洲、非洲、亚洲和中东市场。
companies.description_en: Laboratorios Richmond is a long-established Argentine pharmaceutical company founded in 1935. It develops, manufactures, and sells antiretroviral (HIV), oncology, oncohematology, cardiometabolic, and neuropsychiatric pharmaceuticals, with exports to Latin America, Africa, Asia, and the Middle East.

companies.name_zh: 奥罗菲诺动物健康参与公司
companies.name_en: Ouro Fino Saúde Animal Participações S.A.
companies.description_zh: 奥罗菲诺动物健康是巴西领先的动物保健制药公司，成立于1987年，总部位于圣保罗州克拉维尼奥斯。公司在拉丁美洲拥有最大型工厂之一，生产抗寄生虫药、抗生素、疫苗和动物生殖产品，出口至30多个国家。
companies.description_en: Ouro Fino Saúde Animal is Brazil's leading animal health pharmaceutical company, founded in 1987 in Cravinhos, São Paulo. It operates one of Latin America's largest animal health manufacturing facilities (125,000 m²), producing anti-inflammatory, antibiotic, antiparasitic, vaccine, and reproductive biology products for cattle, swine, poultry, and companion animals, exporting to 30+ countries.

companies.description_zh: 阿斯特拉工业集团是沙特综合型工业集团，1988年成立，旗下拥有四大业务板块：制药（主要为塔布克制药）、特种化工（Astra Chem、Astra Polymers）、电力钢铁和其他业务。制药板块为集团最大收入来源，年收入约14.5亿里亚尔。
companies.description_en: Astra Industrial Group is a Saudi Arabian diversified industrial conglomerate founded in 1988, with four segments: Pharmaceuticals (Tabuk Pharmaceuticals), Specialty Chemicals (Astra Chem, Astra Polymers), Power & Steel, and Other. The pharmaceutical segment generates ~SAR 1.45B annually and is the group's largest revenue contributor.

sources.title: Stock Analysis – Astra Industrial Group revenue

companies.sub_sector: Pharma + specialty chemicals conglomerate (Tabuk Pharma subsidiary)

companies.name_zh: 中东制药工业公司（阿瓦隆制药）
companies.name_en: Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Co. (Avalon Pharma)

revenue.note: Estimated from TTM ~$0.12B USD and profit SAR 97M at ~21% margin

companies.description_zh: 中东制药工业公司（品牌名阿瓦隆制药）成立于1998年，2022年转制为股份公司，2024年2月在塔达武尔证券交易所上市（代码4016）。公司专注于仿制药开发、生产、营销及分销，产品涵盖外用制剂（乳霜、乳液等）和美妆产品，面向沙特及海外市场。
companies.description_en: Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Co. (Avalon Pharma), founded in 1998 in Riyadh, was converted to a joint stock company in 2022 and listed on Tadawul in February 2024 (ticker 4016). It develops, manufactures, markets, and distributes generic medicines including topical creams, lotions, and cosmetics for Saudi Arabia and export markets.

companies.description_zh: 百奥莱恩RX是以色列临床阶段生物制药公司，成立于2003年，同时在纳斯达克和特拉维夫证券交易所上市。公司最具代表性产品APHEXDA（motixafortide）已在美国获批用于多发性骨髓瘤造血干细胞动员，由Ayrmid商业化推广。在研管线包括针对胶质母细胞瘤的首创口服小分子GLIX1。
companies.description_en: BioLineRx is an Israeli clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2003, dual-listed on Nasdaq and TASE. Its first approved product, APHEXDA (motixafortide), is commercialized in the US for stem cell mobilization in multiple myeloma. Its lead pipeline asset GLIX1 is a first-in-class oral small molecule for glioblastoma, with Phase 1/2a initiation planned in 2026.

companies.description_zh: 坎菲特生物制药是以色列临床阶段生物技术公司，1994年成立，在纽交所美国板和特拉维夫证交所上市。公司专注于腺苷受体（A3AR）靶向小分子药物，核心管线包括肝癌三期临床候选药namodenoson和银屑病三期临床候选药piclidenoson，已累计募资1.75亿美元。
companies.description_en: Can-Fite BioPharma is an Israeli clinical-stage biotech founded in 1994, dual-listed on NYSE American and TASE. It targets the A3 adenosine receptor (A3AR) with small-molecule drugs. Key pipeline: namodenoson (Phase 3, hepatocellular carcinoma; Phase 2b, MASH) and piclidenoson (Phase 3, psoriasis), with cumulative fundraising of $175M.

companies.name_zh: 埃及克利奥帕特拉医院集团
companies.description_zh: 克利奥帕特拉医院集团是埃及最大私立医院集团，按床位数和运营医院数量均排名第一。集团成立于1984年，2014年经整合重组，目前运营6家顶级医院和2家多学科门诊中心，拥有779张床位，覆盖50多个专科。2025财年营收72.3亿埃镑，同比增长33%。
companies.description_en: Cleopatra Hospitals Group is Egypt's largest private hospital group by bed count and number of hospitals. Founded in 1984, the group operates 6 top hospitals and 2 polyclinics in Cairo with 779 beds across 50+ specialties. FY2025 revenue reached EGP 7.2 billion (+33% YoY) with net profit of EGP 824 million.

companies.description_zh: 科尔普兰特生物技术是以色列再生医学公司，成立于2004年，在魏茨曼科学园（雷霍沃特）运营，核心技术为转基因烟草植物合成重组人I型胶原蛋白（rhCollagen）。公司管线包括与艾伯维合作的可注射皮肤填充剂、再生乳房植入物以及商业化生物打印材料（Vergenix STR）。2025年营收因艾伯维里程碑付款至240万美元。
companies.description_en: CollPlant Biotechnologies is an Israeli regenerative medicine company founded in 2004 and headquartered at Weizmann Science Park, Rehovot. Its platform uses transgenic tobacco plants to produce recombinant human type I collagen (rhCollagen). Pipeline includes photocurable dermal fillers (AbbVie partnership), regenerative breast implants, and commercial Vergenix STR bioprinting material.

companies.description_zh: 康普根是以色列AI/ML计算发现驱动的临床阶段癌症免疫治疗公司，1993年成立，在霍隆和旧金山设有办公室。旗舰项目rilvegostomib（原COM902）已进入三期临床，由阿斯利康开发，公司2025年将部分特许使用费出售给阿斯利康获得6500万美元。其他在研项目：COM701（anti-PVRIG，一期）、GS-0321（anti-IL-18BP，吉利德，一期）。
companies.description_en: Compugen is an Israeli AI/ML-driven clinical-stage cancer immunotherapy company founded in 1993, with offices in Holon and San Francisco. Its lead asset rilvegostomig (anti-PVRIG×anti-PD-1) is in Phase 3 by AstraZeneca; Compugen monetized royalties for $65M in 2025.
