Additional pipeline includes COM701 (Phase 1) and GS-0321 licensed to Gilead (Phase 1).

companies.name_zh: 达尔阿尔达瓦开发投资公司
companies.name_en: Dar Al Dawa Development and Investment Co. Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 达尔阿尔达瓦是约旦领先的综合制药企业，创立于1975年，生产并分销覆盖19个药理学类别的200种产品。公司在约旦和阿尔及利亚运营7座工厂，产品销售至黎凡特、海湾、也门、中东、非洲、欧洲和亚洲市场。
companies.description_en: Dar Al Dawa is a leading fully-integrated Jordanian pharmaceutical company founded in 1975. It develops, manufactures, markets, and distributes 200+ products across 19 pharmaceutical groups, operating seven factories in Jordan and Algeria with sales across the Levant, Gulf, Middle East, Africa, Europe, and Asia.

companies.name_zh: 埃及国际制药工业公司（EIPICO）
companies.description_zh: 埃及国际制药工业公司（EIPICO）成立于1980年，1985年投产，是埃及最大的制药企业之一，总部和工厂均位于第十拉马丹城工业区。公司生产安瓿、片剂、糖浆等剂型，与国际药企签有许可协议，产品覆盖多个治疗领域并大量出口。
companies.description_en: EIPICO (Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries Co.) was established in 1980 and began production in 1985. It is one of Egypt's largest pharmaceutical manufacturers, headquartered in the 10th of Ramadan City industrial zone. The company produces ampoules, tablets, syrups, and other forms under license from international partners, exporting across the Middle East, Africa, and beyond.

revenue.note: Pre-revenue clinical-stage company; no product revenue since inception

companies.description_zh: 恩利韦克斯（2026年2月更名为Enlivex Ltd.）是以色列临床阶段巨噬细胞重编程免疫治疗公司，成立于2005年，总部位于内斯齐奥纳。核心产品Allocetra™正处于膝关节骨关节炎二期b临床（美国已入组首名患者）和脓毒症一/二期临床阶段。公司2025年底还投资了RAIN去中心化预测市场协议。
companies.description_en: Enlivex (renamed Enlivex Ltd. in February 2026) is an Israeli clinical-stage macrophage reprogramming immunotherapy company founded in 2005 in Ness Ziona. Its lead asset Allocetra™ is in Phase 2b for knee osteoarthritis (first US patient dosed) and Phase 1/2 for sepsis-related organ dysfunction. The company also invested >$200M in the RAIN decentralized prediction market protocol in late 2025.

companies.description_zh: 恩特拉生物是以色列临床阶段生物技术公司，成立于2010年，总部位于耶路撒冷。公司专注于口服多肽和蛋白质替代疗法，核心平台N-Tab®能在胃肠道保护生物活性分子。主要管线：EB613（口服PTH(1-34)，骨质疏松症，三期方案已提交FDA）、EB612（口服PTH，甲旁减，与OPKO合作）、EB618（口服GLP-1/胰高糖素双激动剂，肥胖症）。
companies.description_en: Entera Bio is an Israeli clinical-stage biotech founded in 2010 in Jerusalem, developing oral peptide and protein replacement therapies via its N-Tab® platform. Lead asset EB613 (oral PTH(1-34) tablet) targets postmenopausal osteoporosis with a Phase 3 protocol submitted to FDA (amendment filed; FDA feedback expected). Pipeline also includes EB612 (oral PTH, hypoparathyroidism, OPKO collaboration) and EB618 (oral GLP-1/glucagon dual agonist for obesity).

companies.description_zh: 以色列计算化学公司，专注于利用生成式AI（ChemPass AI™）为制药和农业设计新型小分子。核心技术为跨靶点多参数优化的生成式AI平台，主要业务包括内部药物发现及对外授权合作。
companies.description_en: Israeli computational chemistry company specializing in generative AI design of novel small molecules for pharma and agriculture via its proprietary ChemPass AI™ platform. Operates through internal drug discovery programs and partnerships.

companies.description_zh: 埃及第二大药品分销商，向超过46,000家药房、医院及批发商配送350余家本土和国际药企产品，同时经营兽药、保健品及医疗设备。
companies.description_en: Egypt's second-largest pharmaceutical distributor, supplying products from over 350 companies to more than 46,000 customers including pharmacies, hospitals, and wholesalers. Also covers veterinary, nutraceutical, and medical equipment.

sources.title: Ibnsina Pharma consolidated net profits jump 54.9% YoY in 2025 – Zawya

companies.description_zh: 沙特阿拉伯制药生产商，产品涵盖人用药品、抗生素、眼科用药、抗肿瘤及皮肤科产品，同时经营保健品和化妆品，产品销往中东及北非市场。
companies.description_en: Saudi Arabian pharmaceutical manufacturer offering human medicines, antibiotics, ophthalmics, oncology, skin, and nutraceutical products across the MENA region. Listed on Tadawul since 2021.

sources.title: Jamjoom Pharma 2024 revenue growth reflects operational improvements – Argaam

companies.description_zh: 阿联酋最大仿制药制药商，也是中东北非地区最大仿制药生产商之一。成立于1980年，产品遍及40多个国家，以仿制药为主，同时生产抗感染、心血管及呼吸系统用药。
companies.description_en: UAE's largest generic pharmaceutical manufacturer and one of the largest in MENA, founded in 1980. Products distributed to 40+ countries, with focus on generics, anti-infectives, cardiovascular, and respiratory medicines.

companies.description_zh: 以色列等离子体衍生生物制药公司，专注于罕见病及严重疾病的特种血浆衍生产品。商业化产品包括六种FDA批准的等离子体衍生生物制剂，在以色列及中东北非地区开展分销业务。
companies.description_en: Israeli plasma-derived biopharmaceutical company focused on specialty products for rare and serious conditions. Markets six FDA-approved plasma-derived biologics including KEDRAB, GLASSIA, CYTOGAM, VARIZIG, WINRHO SDF, and HEPAGAM B, plus operates plasma collection centers in the US.

companies.description_zh: 埃及上市的化妆品与药品制造商，主要生产护肤、护发、口腔护理、抗瘢痕、消毒剂及外用肌肉松弛剂等化妆品及药品，同时涉足保健品领域。
companies.description_en: Cairo-based Egyptian manufacturer of cosmeceutical and pharmaceutical products, including skin care, hair care, oral care, anti-scar, antiseptics, and topical muscle relaxants. Also produces nutraceuticals and flavors.

sources.title: Macro Group Pharmaceuticals Financials – Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: 以色列生物技术公司，专注于口服胰岛素（ORMD-0801）和GLP-1受体激动剂（ORMD-0901）的开发，采用专有蛋白质口服递送（POD™）技术平台，口服胰岛素项目已与中国合作伙伴成立合资公司OraTech。
companies.description_en: Israeli biotech developing oral insulin (ORMD-0801) and oral GLP-1 (ORMD-0901) using its proprietary Protein Oral Delivery (POD™) technology. Formed the OraTech JV with Hefei Tianhui Biotech to accelerate commercialization in 2025.

companies.description_zh: 以色列细胞治疗公司，利用胎盘来源的间充质基质细胞（PLX-PAD、PLX-R18）开发针对炎症、肌肉损伤及血液系统疾病的候选疗法。2025年完成对以色列可可公司Kokomodo约79%股权的收购，扩展至细胞农业领域。
companies.description_en: Israeli cell therapy company developing placenta-derived mesenchymal stromal cell products (PLX-PAD, PLX-R18) for inflammatory, muscle injury, and hematologic conditions. Acquired ~79% of Kokomodo (cacao cellular agriculture) in April 2025.

companies.description_zh: 以色列临床阶段生物制药公司，基于专有PLEX（聚合物-脂质封装基质）局部药物递送平台，主要产品D-PLEX100用于预防腹部结直肠手术切口感染，NDA滚动提交已于2026年初启动。
companies.description_en: Late-stage Israeli biopharma using its PLEX (Polymer-Lipid Encapsulation MatriX) platform for targeted local drug delivery. Lead product D-PLEX100 (paclitaxel) targets prevention of abdominal surgical site infections; rolling NDA submission begun Q1 2026.

companies.name_zh: 普罗他力克斯生物治疗
companies.description_zh: 以色列生物治疗公司，利用ProCellEx®植物细胞表达系统生产重组蛋白治疗罕见病。已上市产品包括Elelyso（戈谢病）和Elfabrio（法布里病），研发管线含PRX-115（痛风）和PRX-119（肾脏罕见病）。
companies.description_en: Israeli biotherapeutics company using its ProCellEx® plant cell-based expression system to produce recombinant proteins for rare diseases. Marketed products include Elelyso (Gaucher disease, licensed to Pfizer) and Elfabrio (Fabry disease, commercialized with Chiesi). Pipeline includes PRX-115 for gout and PRX-119 for rare renal diseases.

companies.name_en: Tenth of Ramadan Pharmaceutical Industries & Diagnostic Reagents (Rameda)
companies.description_zh: 埃及领先的品牌仿制药生产商，产品涵盖心血管、神经系统、抗生素、保健品及兽药等，生产设施位于开罗第六十月工业区，2024年收入增长44%。
companies.description_en: Leading Egyptian branded generic pharmaceutical manufacturer producing cardiovascular, CNS, anti-infective, nutraceutical, and veterinary products. Three manufacturing facilities in 6th of October Industrial Zone; revenue grew 44% in 2024 and 79% in H1 2025.

companies.description_zh: 以色列特种制药公司，专注于消化道及传染病领域。Talicia（奥美拉唑/阿莫西林/利福布汀）已获FDA批准用于治疗幽门螺杆菌感染；RHB-204（克罗恩病）正在推进FDA审批；Opaganib处于前列腺癌II期临床试验阶段。
companies.description_en: Israeli specialty pharma focused on GI and infectious diseases. FDA-approved Talicia for H. pylori; advancing RHB-204 for Crohn's disease (MAP-positive) with positive FDA pathway feedback; Opaganib in Phase 2 for prostate cancer.

companies.name_en: Saudi Pharmaceutical Industries & Medical Appliances Corp. (SPIMACO)
companies.description_zh: 沙特阿拉伯最大制药企业之一，1986年成立，总部位于卡西姆省布赖代市，在中东、埃及和摩洛哥生产并销售仿制药，经营医疗器械和分销服务。2025年庆祝成立40周年。
companies.description_en: One of Saudi Arabia's largest pharma companies, founded 1986, headquartered in Buraidah, Al-Qassim. Manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products and medical appliances across Saudi Arabia, MENA, Egypt, and Morocco through manufacturing, trading, and healthcare services segments.

companies.description_zh: 以色列生物制药公司，专注于泌尿系统和特种肿瘤治疗。已上市JELMYTO（丝裂霉素反热凝胶）用于低级别上尿路尿路上皮癌，2025年新增ZUSDURI（UGN-102）上市用于非肌层浸润性膀胱癌。2025年总收入1.098亿美元，同比增长21%。
companies.description_en: Israeli biopharma specializing in urothelial and specialty oncology. Marketed JELMYTO (mitomycin) for low-grade upper-tract urothelial cancer and ZUSDURI (UGN-102, mitomycin intravesical gel) launched in Q3 2025 for NMIBC. 2025 revenue $109.8M (+21% YoY).

sources.title: UroGen Q2 2025 Financial Results and ZUSDURI Launch

companies.description_zh: 美国生命科学工具公司，开发单细胞分析（Chromium）、空间转录组学（Visium）及原位空间生物学（Xenium）平台，为科学研究提供高分辨率基因组分析工具。2025年全年收入6.43亿美元，净亏损大幅收窄至4350万美元。
companies.description_en: US life science tools company providing single-cell analysis (Chromium), spatial transcriptomics (Visium), and in situ spatial biology (Xenium) platforms. 2025 revenue $642.8M; net loss narrowed to $43.5M from $182.6M in 2024.

companies.description_zh: 美国临床阶段基因治疗公司，利用工程化AAV载体（Therapeutic Vector Evolution技术）开发靶向基因疗法。主要管线：4D-150（湿性AMD/DME的III期FRONT-1研究）、4D-710（囊性纤维化）；2025年与大冢制药签署亚太区合作协议，获得8500万美元前期付款。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage US gene therapy company using engineered AAV vectors (Therapeutic Vector Evolution) for targeted genetic medicines. Lead programs: 4D-150 in Phase 3 (wet AMD/DME) and 4D-710 (cystic fibrosis). Partnered with Otsuka for APAC rights of 4D-150 in 2025.

companies.description_zh: 加拿大临床阶段生物技术公司，运用全栈AI驱动的抗体发现平台搜索自然免疫系统数据库，开发首创抗体药物。2025年共19个分子进入临床，主要研发领域涵盖内分泌、女性健康、免疫和肿瘤，期末流动资金约7亿美元。
companies.description_en: Canadian clinical-stage biotech using a full-stack AI-powered antibody discovery platform. Cumulative 19 molecules in the clinic as of end-2025; focus areas include endocrinology, women's health, immunology, and oncology. ~$700M liquidity at year-end 2025.

companies.description_zh: 美国罕见病基因治疗公司，ZEVASKYN™（prademagene zamikeracel，pz-cel）已于2025年4月29日获FDA批准，成为首个也是唯一获批用于治疗隐性营养不良性大疱性表皮松解症（RDEB）伤口的细胞基因治疗。2025年12月完成首例商业患者治疗，全年净利润7120万美元（含优先审评凭证出售收益1.524亿美元）。
companies.description_en: US rare-disease gene therapy company. ZEVASKYN™ (pz-cel, prademagene zamikeracel) received FDA approval April 29, 2025 as the first and only cell-based gene therapy for RDEB wounds. First commercial patient treated December 2025; 2025 net income $71.2M (includes $152.4M PRV sale gain).

sources.title: Abeona Therapeutics Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: Absci是一家临床阶段的生物技术公司，利用人工智能和合成生物学平台加速抗体药物的发现与开发，专注于肿瘤学和免疫学领域。
companies.description_en: Absci Corporation is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company leveraging an AI-powered generative drug design platform to discover and develop antibody therapeutics, with programs in oncology and immunology.

sources.title: Absci Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: AC Immune SA是一家瑞士临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于神经退行性疾病（包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和其他蛋白质错误折叠疾病）的精准医疗药物开发。
companies.description_en: AC Immune SA is a Swiss clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of precision medicines for neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and other protein-misfolding diseases.

sources.title: AC Immune Full Year 2025 Financial Results
AC Immune Full Year 2025 Results - GlobeNewswire

revenue.note_en: Full year 2025 GAAP total revenues US$1.07B (first time surpassing $1B); NUPLAZID $680M + DAYBUE $391M
revenue.note_zh: 2025全年GAAP总收入10.7亿美元（首次突破10亿美元）；NUPLAZID 6.80亿 + DAYBUE 3.91亿

companies.description_zh: 阿卡迪亚制药是一家专注于神经系统与罕见病治疗的商业化阶段生物制药公司，销售NUPLAZID（哌马色林，帕金森病精神病症）与DAYBUE（曲非奈肽，Rett综合征）。2025全年总收入首次突破10亿美元（10.7亿美元），两款药物均实现两位数增长。
companies.description_en: ACADIA Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on neurological and rare disease treatments. It markets NUPLAZID (pimavanserin) for Parkinson's disease psychosis and DAYBUE (trofinetide) for Rett syndrome. Full year 2025 total revenue surpassed $1 billion for the first time ($1.07B), with both drugs posting double-digit growth.

sources.title: ACADIA Pharmaceuticals Q4 & Full Year 2025 Results

companies.description_zh: ACELYRIN是一家专注于免疫疾病的临床阶段生物制药公司，其主要候选药物lonigutamab（靶向IGF-1R的皮下单克隆抗体）用于治疗甲状腺眼病。该公司已于2025年5月与Alumis合并，不再作为独立上市公司运营。
companies.description_en: ACELYRIN was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on immune-mediated diseases, with lead program lonigutamab (anti-IGF-1R mAb) for thyroid eye disease. The company merged with Alumis in May 2025 and is no longer an independent public company.

companies.description_zh: Aclaris Therapeutics是一家临床阶段的生物制药公司，专注于开发用于免疫炎症性疾病的新型小分子和大分子候选药物，主要管线包括ATI-1777（局部JAK 1/3抑制剂，用于特应性皮炎）和ATI-052。
companies.description_en: Aclaris Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel small and large molecule candidates for immuno-inflammatory diseases, with lead programs including ATI-1777 (topical JAK 1/3 inhibitor for atopic dermatitis) and ATI-052.

companies.description_zh: Actinium制药是一家临床阶段的生物制药公司，专注于开发针对血液系统恶性肿瘤和实体瘤的靶向放射治疗，包括锕-225（Ac-225）标记的抗体偶联放射性药物。
companies.description_en: Actinium Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering targeted radiotherapies for hematologic malignancies and solid tumors, including Actinium-225 (Ac-225) labeled antibody-based radiopharmaceuticals.

companies.description_zh: Acumen制药是一家临床阶段的生物制药公司，专注于阿尔茨海默病领域，其主要候选药物sabirnetug（ACU193）是一种靶向毒性可溶性淀粉样β寡聚体（AβOs）的靶向免疫治疗药物，正在开展ALTITUDE-AD 2期临床试验。
companies.description_en: Acumen Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapies and diagnostics for Alzheimer's disease. Its lead candidate sabirnetug (ACU193) is a targeted immunotherapy targeting toxic soluble amyloid beta oligomers (AβOs) in Phase 2 (ALTITUDE-AD).

companies.description_zh: 亚达基因是一家平台驱动的临床阶段生物技术公司，利用其专有的SAFEbody®和NEObody®技术平台转型抗体药物的发现与开发，专注于新型肿瘤免疫治疗的开发。总部位于苏州工业园区，在圣地亚哥和上海设有办公室。
companies.description_en: Adagene Inc. is a platform-driven, clinical-stage biotechnology company transforming antibody discovery and development using its proprietary SAFEbody® and NEObody® platforms. Headquartered in Suzhou Industrial Park, China, with offices in San Diego and Shanghai.

companies.description_zh: Invivyd（原Adagio Therapeutics）是一家商业化阶段的生物制药公司，专注于针对传染病（尤其是COVID-19及其变种）的抗体解决方案的发现、开发和商业化。该公司于2022年9月由Adagio Therapeutics更名为Invivyd。
companies.description_en: Invivyd, Inc. (formerly Adagio Therapeutics) is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of antibody-based solutions for infectious diseases, particularly COVID-19 variants. Renamed from Adagio to Invivyd in September 2022.

sources.title: Invivyd Q4 2025 Financial Results - SEC Filing

companies.description_zh: Adaptimmune Therapeutics是一家英国T细胞免疫治疗公司，专注于利用工程化T细胞受体（TCR）技术开发癌症实体肿瘤疗法。其TECELRA产品已于2024年获FDA批准用于治疗晚期滑膜肉瘤，为首个用于实体瘤的TCR-T细胞疗法。2025年从纳斯达克退市。
companies.description_en: Adaptimmune Therapeutics is a UK-based T-cell immunotherapy company developing engineered T-cell receptor (TCR) therapies for solid tumors. TECELRA was the first FDA-approved TCR-T cell therapy for a solid tumor (synovial sarcoma, approved 2024). Delisted from Nasdaq in late 2025.

sources.title: Adaptimmune Therapeutics Market Cap - Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: ADMA Biologics是一家端到端的商业化生物制药公司，专注于生产、营销和开发血浆来源的特种生物制剂，用于治疗免疫缺陷患者及有感染风险的患者。旗舰产品ASCENIV（静脉用免疫球蛋白）2025年营收达3.63亿美元。
companies.description_en: ADMA Biologics is an end-to-end commercial biopharmaceutical company dedicated to manufacturing, marketing, and developing specialty plasma-derived biologics for immunodeficient patients. Its flagship product ASCENIV (IVIG) generated $363M in 2025 revenue.

sources.title: ADMA Biologics Preliminary Full Year 2025 Revenue

companies.description_zh: Adverum Biotechnologies是一家专注于眼科疾病基因疗法的临床阶段公司，其主要候选产品ixoberogene soroparvovec（Ixo-vec）是用于治疗湿性年龄相关性黄斑变性和糖尿病性黄斑水肿的单次玻璃体内注射基因疗法。该公司已于2025年12月被礼来公司收购。
companies.description_en: Adverum Biotechnologies was a clinical-stage gene therapy company focused on ocular diseases. Its lead candidate Ixo-vec (ixoberogene soroparvovec) is a single intravitreal injection gene therapy for wet AMD and DME. Acquired by Eli Lilly in December 2025.

sources.title: Lilly to Acquire Adverum Biotechnologies - Eli Lilly IR
Adverum sells to Lilly - BioPharma Dive

companies.description_zh: Affimed是一家德国海德堡的临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于利用其专有ROCK平台开发固有细胞衔接器（ICE）类肿瘤免疫治疗药物。该公司于2025年5月在德国曼海姆法院申请破产，已无法作为独立上市公司继续运营。
companies.description_en: Affimed N.V. was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Heidelberg, Germany, developing innate cell engagers (ICE) using its ROCK platform for oncology. The company filed for insolvency proceedings in Mannheim, Germany in May 2025 due to inability to raise sufficient funds.

sources.title: Affimed Announces Filing for Insolvency Proceedings

companies.description_zh: Agenus是一家专注于开发和商业化肿瘤免疫治疗药物的生物技术公司，其主要管线包括botensilimab（BOT，增强Fc功能的CTLA-4抗体）与balstilimab（BAL，PD-1抗体）联合疗法，用于多种实体肿瘤的治疗。前身为Antigenics，1994年成立于马萨诸塞州列克星敦。
companies.description_en: Agenus Inc. is a biotechnology company developing and commercializing immunotherapies for cancer and infectious diseases. Its lead programs include botensilimab plus balstilimab (BOT+BAL), a next-generation Fc-enhanced CTLA-4 plus PD-1 combination for solid tumors. Founded in 1994 as Antigenics.

companies.description_zh: Agios制药是一家商业化阶段的生物制药公司，专注于血液系统罕见疾病（特别是溶血性贫血）的治疗。其已上市产品PYRUKYND®（mitapivat）是一种丙酮酸激酶激活剂，已被批准用于治疗成人丙酮酸激酶缺乏症引起的溶血性贫血，并正在研究用于地中海贫血和镰状细胞病的适应症。
companies.description_en: Agios Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on rare blood diseases (hemolytic anemias). Its marketed product PYRUKYND® (mitapivat), a pyruvate kinase activator, is approved for hemolytic anemia due to pyruvate kinase deficiency, with ongoing studies in thalassemia and sickle cell disease.

sources.title: Agios Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: Akero Therapeutics是一家临床阶段公司，开发用于严重代谢性疾病的变革性疗法。其主要候选药物efruxifermin（EFX）是一种每周一次皮下注射的FGF21类似物，用于治疗代谢功能相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH）。该公司已于2025年10月被诺和诺德以52亿美元收购。
companies.description_en: Akero Therapeutics was a clinical-stage company developing transformational treatments for serious metabolic diseases. Its lead candidate efruxifermin (EFX) is a once-weekly injectable FGF21 analog for MASH (metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis). Acquired by Novo Nordisk for $5.2B in October 2025.

sources.title: Akero Therapeutics Q4 & Full Year 2024 Results

companies.description_zh: Aldeyra Therapeutics是一家临床阶段的生物制药公司，专注于开发针对干眼病和过敏性结膜炎的创新疗法。其主要候选药物reproxalap是一种小分子活性醛捕获剂，正处于临床后期开发阶段，等待FDA审批。
companies.description_en: Aldeyra Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapies for dry eye disease and allergic conjunctivitis. Its lead candidate reproxalap is a small molecule reactive aldehyde species (RASP) modulator in late-stage development awaiting FDA approval.

companies.description_zh: Alector是一家临床阶段的生物技术公司，专注于开发对抗神经退行性疾病的变革性药物，尤其是通过靶向先天免疫系统（神经免疫学）来治疗阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病。主要管线包括nivisnebart（AL101/GSK4527226）用于阿尔茨海默病以及AL050用于帕金森病和路易体痴呆。
companies.description_en: Alector, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on neurodegeneration, particularly neurimmunology approaches targeting the innate immune system for Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease. Key programs include nivisnebart (AL101/GSK4527226) for Alzheimer's and AL050 for Parkinson's/Lewy body dementia.

sources.title: Alector Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 临床阶段生物技术公司，开发异体嵌合抗原受体T细胞（AlloCAR T）疗法，主要针对大B细胞淋巴瘤、肾细胞癌及自身免疫疾病。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering allogeneic CAR T (AlloCAR T) therapies for cancer and autoimmune diseases, with lead programs cemacabtagene ansegedleucel (LBCL, pivotal ALPHA3 trial), ALLO-316 (RCC), and ALLO-329 (autoimmune).

sources.title: Allogene Therapeutics Q4 and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 临床阶段精准神经精神科学公司，利用脑部生物标志物开发精准治疗抑郁症、精神分裂症等精神疾病，管线包含ALTO-300（agomelatine）、ALTO-207等。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage biopharma developing precision medicines for neuropsychiatric disorders using brain-based biomarkers. Pipeline includes ALTO-300 (agomelatine, MDD adjunctive) and ALTO-207 (treatment-resistant depression). Total 2025 operating expenses ~$66M.

sources.title: Alto Neuroscience Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 专注心血管疾病的医药公司，旗舰产品为VASCEPA®/VAZKEPA®（二十碳五烯酸乙酯），获批用于严重高甘油三酯血症及降低心血管事件风险。在欧洲10个市场以VAZKEPA品牌销售。
companies.description_en: Cardiovascular-focused pharma company; flagship product VASCEPA (icosapent ethyl) approved for severe hypertriglyceridemia and CV risk reduction. US generic competition has pressured revenue; EU expansion ongoing under VAZKEPA brand across 10 markets.

companies.description_zh: 专注罕见病的生物技术公司，商业化产品包括Galafold（迷格拉他，法布里病）和Pombiliti+Opfolda（庞贝病），2025年营收6.34亿美元，2025年12月BioMarin宣布48亿美元收购。
companies.description_en: Rare disease biotech with two marketed therapies: Galafold (migalastat, Fabry disease, $522M in 2025) and Pombiliti+Opfolda (Pompe disease, $113M in 2025). BioMarin announced $4.8B acquisition in December 2025; expected to close Q2 2026.

sources.title: BioMarin to Acquire Amicus Therapeutics for $4.8 Billion

companies.description_zh: 临床阶段生物技术公司，专注经典补体（C1q）介导的自身免疫和神经退行性疾病。主要管线包括tanruprubart（ANX005，吉兰-巴雷综合征Ph3/BLA/MAA，亨廷顿病Ph2）和ANX007（地图状萎缩Ph3）。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage biotech targeting classical complement (C1q) activation for autoimmune and neurodegenerative diseases. Lead programs: tanruprubart (Ph3 in Guillain-Barré syndrome, EU MAA filed, US BLA planned 2026) and ANX007 (Ph3 geographic atrophy).

sources.title: Annexon Q4 and Year-End 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 临床阶段生物技术公司，开发半衰期延长型大分子药物用于免疫炎症适应症。领军项目为zumilokibart（APG777，抗IL-13单抗），开展中重度特应性皮炎和哮喘的临床研究，Blackstone提供13亿美元战略融资支持Ph3。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage biotech advancing novel half-life-extended biologics in large I&I markets. Lead asset zumilokibart (anti-IL-13 mAb, APG777) in Ph2 for atopic dermatitis and asthma. $1.3B Blackstone strategic financing for Phase 3. Cash runway $903M (end-2025).

sources.title: Apogee Therapeutics Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 专注感染性疾病和医疗对策的小型生物技术公司，总部位于加拿大新斯科舍省哈利法克斯，商业产品为LIKMEZ™（甲硝唑口服混悬液，FDA已批准），同时开展生物威胁疫苗和抗寄生虫药研究。
companies.description_en: Small Canadian biotech focused on anti-infectives and medical countermeasures. Commercially launched LIKMEZ (metronidazole oral suspension, FDA-approved). Also developing a biodefense vaccine candidate and antiparasitic; submitted five US government proposals totaling up to $125M.

sources.title: Appili Therapeutics Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.sub_sector: Anti-infectives and biodefense vaccines; infectious disease; medical countermeasures

companies.description_zh: 临床阶段肿瘤学生物技术公司，专注血液系统恶性肿瘤，主要管线包含tuspetinib（HM43239，激酶抑制剂）。2025年11月宣布被韩美制药以CAD 2.41/股现金收购；股东已批准，2026年一季度获法院批准。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage oncology biotech focused on hematologic malignancies. Lead asset tuspetinib (oral kinase inhibitor). Definitive agreement to be acquired by Hanmi Pharmaceuticals at CAD 2.41/share (~28% premium). Court approval received Q1 2026.

sources.title: Aptose Biosciences Acquisition by Hanmi Pharmaceutical

companies.description_zh: mRNA药物公司，开发利用自扩增mRNA（sa-mRNA）平台的肝脏和呼吸道罕见病疗法及疫苗。KOSTAIVE是全球首个获批的自扩增mRNA新冠疫苗（英国MHRA）；核心管线聚焦囊性纤维化（ARCT-032）和OTC缺陷症（ARCT-810）。
companies.description_en: mRNA medicines company using its LUNAR and STARR sa-mRNA platforms. KOSTAIVE (COVID-19 sa-mRNA vaccine) approved by Japan PMDA and UK MHRA. Core pipeline: ARCT-032 (inhaled mRNA for cystic fibrosis, Ph2) and ARCT-810 (OTC deficiency, Ph2 data readout).

sources.title: Arcturus Therapeutics Q4 and Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 商业阶段皮肤科药物公司，核心产品ZORYVE®（roflumilast）是一种磷酸二酯酶-4抑制剂，获批用于斑块型银屑病、特应性皮炎和脂溢性皮炎，2025年全年净销售额3.72亿美元（同比增长123%）。
companies.description_en: Commercial-stage medical dermatology company. Lead product ZORYVE (roflumilast, PDE4 inhibitor) approved in 4 indications (plaque psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, seborrheic dermatitis). 2025 net product revenue $372.1M (+123% YoY); raised 2026 guidance to $480–$495M.

sources.title: Arcutis Q4 and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 临床阶段生物技术公司，专注肿瘤和炎症/自身免疫疾病，开发差异化小分子及组合疗法。领军肿瘤项目为casdatifan（HIF-2α抑制剂，肾细胞癌Ph3），炎症管线包含MRGPRX2及TNF程序，与吉利德有战略合作。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage biopharma developing differentiated molecules for cancer and inflammatory/autoimmune diseases. Lead oncology asset casdatifan (HIF-2α inhibitor) in Phase 3 PEAK-1 trial for clear cell RCC; inflammation pipeline advancing MRGPRX2 and TNF programs. Cash ~$1B (end-2025). Collaboration with Gilead Sciences.

sources.title: Arcus Biosciences Q4 and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 临床阶段生物制药公司，专注EGFR突变型非小细胞肺癌，核心项目为firmonertinib（口服第三代EGFR抑制剂）。FURVENT Ph3研究在EGFR外显子20插入突变NSCLC中的数据于2026年初公布，中国NMPA已批准用于EGFR外显子20插入突变二线治疗。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage biopharma focused on EGFR-mutant NSCLC. Lead asset firmonertinib (3rd-gen EGFR inhibitor, broad mutation-selective). NMPA-approved in 2L EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC; FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation; Phase 3 FURVENT (1L ex20ins) and ALPACCA (1L PACC) trials ongoing. Cash $312.8M (end-2025).

sources.title: ArriVent BioPharma Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: RNA干扰（RNAi）技术领军企业，利用自主TRiM™平台开发靶向性RNAi药物，2025财年营收达8.29亿美元（主要来自Sarepta/Sanofi/GSK授权里程碑）。REDEMPLO获FDA批准，是首个治疗家族性乳糜微粒综合征（FCS）的siRNA药物，也是首个基于TRiM平台的批准产品。
companies.description_en: RNA interference (RNAi) therapeutics company using proprietary TRiM platform. REDEMPLO received FDA approval (FCS, familial chylomicronemia syndrome) – first siRNA drug for FCS and first TRiM-based approval. FY2025 revenue $829M (fiscal year ends Sept 30), driven by Sarepta, Sanofi, GSK milestone payments.

companies.description_zh: 商业阶段生物制药公司，产品neffy®（肾上腺素鼻喷雾剂）是全球首个获FDA及欧盟批准的无针肾上腺素，用于I型过敏反应（包括过敏性休克）的救治。2025年全年净产品收入7220万美元（商业化第一年），总收入8430万美元。
companies.description_en: Commercial-stage biopharma with one product: neffy (epinephrine nasal spray) – first and only needle-free, FDA- and EC-approved epinephrine for Type I allergic reactions including anaphylaxis. Full-year 2025 US net product revenue $72.2M in its first commercial year; total revenue $84.3M. Strong balance sheet: $245M cash.

sources.title: ARS Pharmaceuticals Q4 and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 临床阶段平台公司，开发基于致幻剂、迷幻药和相关物质的精神疾病疗法，2025年11月被Atai Beckley收购。管线涵盖多个精神疾病适应症，多项Ph2临床试验的数据读取预期于2026年。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage platform company developing psychedelic-based treatments for mental health disorders. In November 2025, merged with Beckley Psytech to form AtaiBeckley. Multiple Ph2 trials underway; data readouts anticipated 2026. Cash runway extended into 2027 via recent capital raise.

companies.description_zh: 全球领先的生命科学和先进技术行业关键产品与服务提供商，覆盖实验室试剂、生物加工解决方案、单次使用技术等，2025年净销售额65.52亿美元（有机下降约3%），业务涵盖实验室解决方案和生物科学生产两大板块。
companies.description_en: Global provider of mission-critical products and services to life sciences and advanced technology industries. Portfolio includes reagents, lab consumables, bioprocessing/single-use technologies. 2025 net sales $6.55B (down 3.4%, organic -2.8%). Segments: Laboratory Solutions and Bioscience Production. Adjusted EBITDA $1.07B (16.3% margin).

companies.description_zh: 商业阶段中枢神经系统（CNS）生物技术公司，三款上市产品：AUVELITY®（重度抑郁症，2025年净销售5.07亿美元，同比增74%）、SUNOSI®（日间过度嗜睡，1.25亿美元）、SYMBRAVO®（偏头痛，660万美元）。2025年全年净产品收入6.385亿美元（同比增66%）。
companies.description_en: Commercial-stage CNS biopharma with three marketed products: AUVELITY (MDD, $507M in 2025, +74% YoY), SUNOSI (excessive daytime sleepiness, $125M), and SYMBRAVO (migraine, $6.6M). Full-year 2025 total net product revenue $638.5M (+66% YoY). Robust pipeline of CNS candidates.

sources.title: Axsome Therapeutics Q4 and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 生命科学服务公司（原Brooks Automation，2021年更名），提供样本管理、多组学服务和自动化解决方案，覆盖生物样本库、基因测序和基因合成等领域。业务板块：样本管理解决方案（冷链存储、自动化）和多组学（基因组学分析服务）。2025财年营收5.94亿美元，2026年3月收购英国UK Biocentre。
companies.description_en: Life sciences services company (formerly Brooks Automation; renamed 2021). Provides sample management, multiomics services (genomics, gene synthesis), and automation solutions for biopharma, biotech, and academic clients. Two segments: Sample Management Solutions and Multiomics. FY2025 revenue $593.8M (+3.6%). Acquired UK Biocentre March 2026.

companies.description_zh: 瑞士骨愈合技术领导者，旗舰产品MagnetOs先进骨移植物已在五大洲用于脊柱手术，2025年实现首次盈利。
companies.description_en: Swiss leader in bone healing technologies; flagship product MagnetOs advanced bone graft (NeedleGrip surface technology) used across five continents in spine and extremity procedures; achieved first-ever net profit in 2025.

sources.title: Kuros Biosciences delivers 72% year-over-year sales growth, reaching USD 146.1 million for 2025

companies.description_zh: 前身为CombiGene AB（基因治疗公司），2025年6月股东大会决议更名并转型为投资控股公司，专注低风险工具、未上市盈利公司直接投资及反向并购平台，已不再从事制药研发。
companies.description_en: Formerly CombiGene AB (gene therapy); renamed Lärkberget AB in June 2025 after pivoting from pharma R&D to an investment holding model focused on direct investments in profitable unlisted companies and a reverse acquisition platform. No longer an active pharma developer.

companies.description_zh: 瑞典临床阶段生物技术公司，开发靶向BSSL的人源化抗体SOL-116用于慢性炎症性疾病（类风湿关节炎等），2025年完成1期临床研究。目前处于与Flerie公司合并进程中并申请退市。
companies.description_en: Swedish clinical-stage biotech developing SOL-116, a humanised antibody targeting BSSL (bile salt-stimulated lipase) for chronic inflammatory diseases including rheumatoid arthritis; completed Phase 1 in 2025. Currently in merger process with Flerie and seeking delisting from Nasdaq First North.

sources.title: MFN.se > Lipum > Lipum AB – Year-end report 2025
Delisting of Lipum AB (publ) from Nasdaq First North Growth Market

companies.description_zh: 挪威临床阶段生物技术公司，基于宿主防御肽衍生分子平台开发溶瘤免疫疗法。核心候选药物ruxotemitide（原LTX-315）为首创溶瘤小分子，可直接杀伤肿瘤细胞并激活免疫系统，联合检查点抑制剂用于多种实体瘤。
companies.description_en: Norwegian clinical-stage biotech developing oncolytic immunotherapy based on host-defence peptide-derived molecules. Lead candidate ruxotemitide (formerly LTX-315) is a first-in-class oncolytic molecule evaluated across multiple solid tumour indications in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors.

sources.title: Lytix Biopharma AS: Annual Report for 2025

companies.description_zh: 法国临床晚期肠道微生物组治疗公司，专注通过调节免疫系统提高癌症患者生存率。旗舰产品MaaT013（Xervyteg®）针对急性移植物抗宿主病，已向EMA提交上市申请。
companies.description_en: French late-stage clinical company developing gut microbiome-driven therapies to modulate the immune system in cancer patients. Flagship MaaT013 (Xervyteg®) targets acute graft-versus-host disease; Marketing Authorization Application submitted to EMA June 2025.

sources.title: MaaT Pharma Announces 2025 Annual Results and Provides Business Updates
MaaT Pharma Announces 2025 Annual Results - Euronext

companies.description_zh: 波兰领先生物制品CDMO，提供从细胞系到商业化产品的端到端GMP开发和生产服务，专长单克隆抗体、双特异性抗体、ADC及生物类似药，主要客户包括Novavax等。
companies.description_en: Leading Polish biologics CDMO providing end-to-end GMP development and manufacturing services including monoclonal antibodies, bispecific antibodies, ADCs and biosimilars; key clients include Novavax. Revenue declined sharply in 2025 following end of a major contract.

companies.description_zh: 奥地利生物技术公司，2006年成立于维也纳兽医大学，专注病毒学与免疫学创新疗法。Carragelose抗病毒OTC产品线已于2025年出售给Unither制药（将获€1300万里程碑），公司聚焦免疫调节管线。
companies.description_en: Austrian biotech spun off from University of Veterinary Medicine Vienna in 2006; develops antiviral and immunology therapies. Carragelose-based OTC antiviral product line sold to Unither Pharmaceuticals in 2025 (€13M earn-out); focusing on remaining immunology pipeline.

sources.title: Marinomed Biotech AG announces results for the first half year of 2025

companies.description_zh: 美国细胞工程平台公司，总部马里兰州罗克维尔，以Flow Electroporation技术赋能细胞和基因治疗开发；同时在AIM上市（伦敦）。2025年因部分SPL客户逆风收入同比下降，并完成34%裁员。
companies.description_en: US-based cell-engineering platform company (HQ Rockville, MD); Flow Electroporation technology enables discovery, development and commercialisation of next-generation cell therapeutics. Dual-listed NASDAQ/AIM. Revenue declined 15% in 2025 due to SPL partner headwinds; 34% workforce reduction completed.

sources.title: MaxCyte Reports Second Quarter 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 德国肿瘤免疫生物技术公司，专注开发TCR-T（T细胞受体工程化T细胞）疗法用于实体肿瘤。核心项目MDG1015（第三代TCR-T）已获IND批准并启动EPITOME-1015-I试验；与武汉生物制品研究所合作研发TCR引导的T细胞衔接器（TCE）。
companies.description_en: German immuno-oncology biotech focused on TCR-T (T cell receptor-engineered T cell) therapies for solid tumours. Lead programme MDG1015 (3rd-generation TCR-T) received IND approval 2024; EPITOME-1015-I Phase 1 trial initiated. Strategic partnership with WuXi Biologics on TCR-guided T cell engagers.

sources.title: Medigene (MDG1) Investor Relations, Earnings Summary & Outlook
Medigene AG Extends Cash Runway into July 2025

companies.description_zh: 法国临床与商业阶段生物制药授权公司，基于专有BEPO®技术开发长效注射剂（LAI）。旗舰产品UZEDY®（利培酮LAI）2023年获FDA批准，合作伙伴Teva的UZEDY净销售额2025年达$2.15亿（+52.5%）；奥氮平LAI NDA已获FDA受理。
companies.description_en: French clinical- and commercial-stage biopharma licensing company specialising in long-acting injectable (LAI) therapies using proprietary BEPO® technology. Flagship UZEDY® (risperidone LAI, schizophrenia/bipolar I) licensed to Teva achieved $215M net sales in FY2026; olanzapine LAI NDA accepted by FDA Feb 2026.

sources.title: UZEDY Net Sales Increased from $117M in 2024 to $191M in 2025

companies.description_zh: 瑞典抗病毒/肿瘤临床阶段公司，成立于1988年。核心项目fostroxacitabine bralpamide（fostrox）为肝靶向DNA复制抑制剂，用于晚期肝细胞癌，1b/2a期研究显示中位总生存期13.7个月；MIV-711获骨形成不全症孤儿药资格。
companies.description_en: Swedish clinical-stage company founded 1988. Lead programme fostroxacitabine bralpamide (fostrox), a liver-targeted DNA replication inhibitor for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC); Phase 1b/2a showed median OS 13.7 months. MIV-711 received Orphan Drug Designation for Osteogenesis Imperfecta.

companies.description_zh: 瑞典生物技术公司，开发基于同种异体树突状细胞生物学的现货型细胞免疫疗法。核心产品vididencel（DCP-001）处于ADVANCE-II 2期临床，靶向急性髓系白血病（AML）缓解后复发预防，已获FDA快速通道认定。
companies.description_en: Swedish biotech developing off-the-shelf, cell-based immunotherapies based on allogeneic dendritic cell biology. Lead product vididencel (DCP-001) in Phase 2 ADVANCE-II trial for post-remission AML relapse prevention; FDA Fast Track Designation received.

companies.description_zh: 英国临床阶段生物制药公司，专注稀有疾病和肿瘤。主要项目：setrusumab（骨形成不全症3期，与Ultragenyx合作）、alvelestat（α1-抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症相关肺病3期）。现金跑道延伸至2027年中。
companies.description_en: UK clinical-stage biopharma focused on rare diseases and oncology. Key programmes: setrusumab (osteogenesis imperfecta, partnered with Ultragenyx), alvelestat (AATD-associated lung disease pursuing Phase 3). Cash runway into mid-2027.

sources.title: Mereo BioPharma Reports Full Year 2025 Financial Results
Mereo BioPharma Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2024

companies.description_zh: 瑞士临床阶段生物技术公司，2004年成立于苏黎世大学，先驱开发DARPin®（设计锚蛋白重复蛋白）疗法新药类别。核心管线：MP0533（四特异性T细胞衔接器，AML 1/2a期），Radio-DARPin项目MP0712（SCLC，与Orano Med合作），MP0317（胆管癌，CD40激动剂）。
companies.description_en: Swiss clinical-stage biotech; spun off from University of Zurich 2004; pioneering DARPin® (Designed Ankyrin Repeat Protein) therapeutics. Key pipeline: MP0533 (tetra-specific T-cell engager for r/r AML, Phase 1/2a); MP0712 radio-DARPin (SCLC, Orano Med partnership); MP0317 (cholangiocarcinoma, CD40 agonist). Up to ~24% workforce reduction announced June 2025.

sources.title: Molecular Partners Reports Highlights and Financial Results for Full Year 2025
Molecular Partners presents positive Phase 1/2a data of MP0533 in AML at EHA 2025

companies.name_zh: 莫菲斯股份公司（已被诺华收购）
companies.description_zh: 德国抗体发现先驱，成立于1992年，开发HuCAL抗体库技术。旗舰产品Monjuvi®（tafasitamab，弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤）。2024年5月被诺华以€68/股（约€27亿）全面收购并退市，现为诺华子公司。
companies.description_en: German antibody discovery pioneer (HuCAL library); flagship Monjuvi® (tafasitamab, DLBCL). Acquired by Novartis in May 2024 at €68/share (~€2.7B total equity value) and delisted. Now a wholly owned Novartis subsidiary; no longer independently traded.

sources.title: MorphoSys AG - Form 6-K FY2024 (Novartis acquisition press release)

companies.description_zh: 英国微型专业制药公司，开发Nuvec®二氧化硅纳米粒子递送系统，用于增强癌症治疗和疫苗的细胞内递送与效力；另有liptide平台ECP105。正在积累临床前数据集以支持合作授权。
companies.description_en: UK micro-cap specialty pharma developing Nuvec® non-viral silica nanoparticle delivery system for improved cellular delivery of cancer treatments and vaccines; additional liptide platform ECP105. Building preclinical data set toward licensing partnerships.

sources.title: N4 Pharma PLC - Final Results, Annual Report and Notice of AGM
N4P N4 Pharma PLC Financial Scores

companies.description_zh: 法国纳米医学先驱，2003年成立，开发基于氧化铪纳米粒子的放射增强剂JNJ-1900（NBTXR3）。与强生（Janssen）达成价值最高达$25亿的全球许可协议，程序跨越头颈癌、肺癌、胰腺癌、食道癌等多瘤种。
companies.description_en: French nanomedicine pioneer founded 2003; develops JNJ-1900 (NBTXR3), a hafnium oxide nanoparticle radioenhancer activated by radiotherapy. Global licensing agreement with Janssen (J&J) worth up to $2.5B; programmes in head & neck, lung, pancreatic, esophageal and other solid tumours.

sources.title: NANOBIOTIX Provides Business Update and Reports Full Year 2025 Financial Results
NANOBIOTIX Announces License Agreement for Worldwide Co-development of NBTXR3 with Janssen

companies.description_zh: 博士健康公司（前身为Valeant制药）是一家多元化专科药企，涵盖胃肠病学（Salix/XIFAXAN）、皮肤科、神经科及医疗美容设备，旗下持有Bausch+Lomb约88%股权。总部位于加拿大魁北克省拉瓦尔，在新泽西州布里奇沃特设立美国业务总部。
companies.description_en: Bausch Health Companies (formerly Valeant Pharmaceuticals) is a diversified specialty pharma and medical-device company operating through five segments: Salix (GI/XIFAXAN), International, Solta Medical, Diversified, and Bausch+Lomb (majority-owned, ~88%). Incorporated in 1959 as ICN Pharmaceuticals, renamed Valeant in 2003, rebranded Bausch Health in 2018. HQ in Laval, QC; U.S. base in Bridgewater, NJ.

sources.title: Bausch Health Cos Number of Employees 2010-2025

companies.sub_sector: Diversified pharma; GI, hepatology, neuroscience, dermatology, dentistry, aesthetics

companies.description_zh: 博士伦是全球领先的眼科健康公司，创立于1853年美国纽约罗彻斯特。2022年独立上市，仍为Bausch Health约88%持股子公司。产品涵盖视力保健（隐形眼镜/护理液）、眼科药品及手术设备，销售超400种产品覆盖约100个国家。2025年收入51亿美元，三大业务：视力保健（57%）、眼科药品（25%）、手术（18%）。
companies.description_en: Bausch + Lomb is a leading global eye-health company founded in Rochester, NY in 1853. Listed separately on TSX/NYSE (2022); ~88% owned by Bausch Health. Portfolio spans contact lenses, lens-care solutions, ophthalmic pharmaceuticals, and surgical devices sold in ~100 countries. FY2025 revenue $5.10B: Vision Care 57%, Pharma 25%, Surgical 18%.
companies.sub_sector: Eye health; contact lenses, surgical devices, ophthalmic pharmaceuticals

companies.description_zh: Bicycle Therapeutics是一家临床阶段生物技术公司，总部位于英国剑桥，同时在美国波士顿设有运营机构。公司开发专有Bicycle®双环肽平台，聚焦肿瘤学及放射性药物偶联物（RDC）。2025年战略重组，裁员约30%并专注于核心管线：nuzefatide pevedotin（EphA2靶向ADC）、zelenectide pevedotin（Nectin-4 ADC）及BT1702（Pb-212 RDC）。现金跑道延伸至2030年。
companies.description_en: Bicycle Therapeutics (NASDAQ: BCYC) is a UK-incorporated clinical-stage biopharma with principal operations in Cambridge, UK and Boston, MA. Its proprietary constrained bicyclic peptide (Bicycle®) platform generates targeted oncology ADCs and radioconjugates. Lead programs: nuzefatide pevedotin (EphA2 ADC), zelenectide pevedotin (Nectin-4 ADC), BT1702 (Pb-212 radioconjugate). 2025 strategic reprioritization cut ~30% of workforce; cash runway extended to 2030 with $628M on hand (Dec 31, 2025).

companies.description_zh: 百泰克公司是全球生命科学工具与试剂领域领先企业，创立于1976年，总部位于明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯。旗下品牌包括R&D Systems、Tocris、ProteinSimple及ACD，产品覆盖重组蛋白、抗体、细胞因子、小分子及仪器，服务于科研和临床诊断市场。2025财年（截至2025年6月）收入12.2亿美元，有机增长约5%。
companies.description_en: Bio-Techne Corporation (NASDAQ: TECH) is a global life-sciences tools company founded in 1976 (as Research and Diagnostic Systems) and rebranded in 2014. It develops and manufactures reagents (cytokines, antibodies, proteins), instruments (Simple Western, RNAscope), and diagnostic assays through brands R&D Systems, Tocris, ProteinSimple, and ACD. Serves research and clinical communities in 70+ countries. FY2025 revenue $1.22B (+5% organic). HQ: Minneapolis, MN.

companies.description_zh: 拜奥克莱斯特制药（NASDAQ: BCRX）是专注罕见病的小分子药物公司，总部位于北卡罗来纳州达勒姆，创立于1986年。核心产品ORLADEYO®（berotralstat）用于预防遗传性血管性水肿（HAE），2025年净收入6.01亿美元（同比+37%），超出指引上限。管线包括BCX17725（HAE注射剂）、avoralstat（HAE口服）。
companies.description_en: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: BCRX) is a Durham, NC-based rare-disease company founded in 1986. Lead product ORLADEYO® (berotralstat, oral HAE prophylaxis) generated $601M net revenue in FY2025 (+37% YoY), beating guidance of $590–$600M. Pipeline: BCX17725 (injectable HAE) in Phase 1, avoralstat (oral plasma kallikrein inhibitor) in Phase 1 for HAE and diabetic macular edema. GAAP net loss significantly reduced by European business sale proceeds.

sources.title: BioCryst Preliminary FY2025 ORLADEYO Revenue of $601M

companies.description_zh: BioSyent是加拿大专科药公司（TSXV: RX），总部位于安大略省密西沙加，专注引进和商业化原创药品。产品涵盖院内急救（Aggrastat、Brinavess）及消费者健康类别。2025年收入同比增长23%，维持21%净利润率，是加拿大上市药企中少数持续盈利的小型公司。
companies.description_en: BioSyent Inc. (TSXV: RX) is a profitable Canadian specialty pharma company headquartered in Mississauga, ON. Founded 2006 (formerly Hedley Technologies). Strategy is in-licensing originator or niche branded drugs for Canada: hospital acute-care (Aggrastat, Brinavess) and specialty segments. FY2025 revenue grew 23% with a ~21% net-income-after-tax margin. Cash-generative micro-cap with ~61 employees.
companies.sub_sector: Specialty pharma; in-licensing established brands; iron health (FeraMAX), women's wellness

companies.description_zh: BriaCell是一家临床阶段癌症免疫治疗公司，总部位于加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省西温哥华，成立于2006年。核心产品Bria-IMT™（整合素靶向细胞免疫疗法）正处于针对转移性乳腺癌的关键III期临床研究阶段。公司目前尚无产品收入，2025财年（截至2025年7月31日）运营亏损3040万美元，通过股权融资筹集约5090万美元。
companies.description_en: BriaCell Therapeutics (TSX: BCT; NASDAQ: BCTX) is a clinical-stage immunotherapy company incorporated in BC, Canada in 2006. Lead candidate Bria-IMT™ (whole-cell allogeneic breast cancer immunotherapy) is in a pivotal Phase 3 trial for metastatic breast cancer. Also developing Bria-OTS™, a personalized off-the-shelf HLA-matched immunotherapy. Pre-revenue stage; FY2025 (ending Jul 31, 2025) operating expenses ~$30.4M; raised ~$50.9M gross from equity financings.

companies.description_zh: 桥生物制药（NASDAQ: BBIO）是专注遗传疾病的精准药企，2015年成立，总部位于加利福尼亚州帕洛阿尔托。核心商业产品Attruby®（acoramidis）于2024年11月获FDA批准用于ATTR-CM（转甲状腺素蛋白心肌病），2025年净产品收入3.624亿美元。管线候选药物包括BBP-418（LGMD2I）、encaleret（ADH1）和infigratinib（软骨发育不全），均处于NDA申报阶段。
companies.description_en: BridgeBio Pharma (NASDAQ: BBIO) is a Palo Alto-based precision medicine company founded in 2015 targeting genetically defined diseases across 20+ programs. FDA-approved Attruby® (acoramidis) for ATTR-CM (Nov 2024) drove $362M net product revenue in FY2025. Near-term NDA submissions: BBP-418 (LGMD2I, NDA 1H 2026), encaleret (ADH1, NDA 1H 2026), infigratinib (achondroplasia, NDA 2H 2026). Total FY2025 revenue $502M vs $222M in 2024. Net loss $724.9M; cash $587.5M at Dec 31, 2025.

companies.description_zh: C4 Therapeutics（NASDAQ: CCCC）是专注靶向蛋白降解（TORPEDO®平台）的临床阶段生物技术公司，2015年成立，总部位于马萨诸塞州沃特敦。核心管线：cemsidomide（IKZF1/3降解剂，多发性骨髓瘤，Ph2）、CFT8919（EGFR L858R降解剂，NSCLC，Ph1）。合作伙伴包括默克KGaA、罗氏/Betta Pharma、辉瑞和渤健。2025年收入3590万美元，现金2.971亿美元（跑道至2028年末）。
companies.description_en: C4 Therapeutics (NASDAQ: CCCC) is a clinical-stage biotech founded in 2015 in Watertown, MA, pioneering targeted protein degradation via its TORPEDO® platform. Lead programs: cemsidomide (IKZF1/3 degrader, multiple myeloma, Phase 2; 53% ORR reported 2025) and CFT8919 (EGFR L858R degrader, NSCLC, Phase 1). Partners: Merck KGaA, Roche/Betta Pharma, Pfizer, Biogen. Expanding into CNS-penetrant degraders for neurodegeneration. FY2025 revenue $35.9M (collaboration-based); net loss $105M; cash $297.1M (runway to end-2028).

companies.description_zh: Cardiol Therapeutics（TSX/NASDAQ: CRDL）是加拿大临床阶段心血管药企，2017年成立，总部位于安大略省奥克维尔。核心候选药物CardiolRx™（纯化大麻二酚配方）靶向心包炎及心肌炎中的炎症小体通路，正在开展复发性心包炎的关键III期MAVERIC试验（已超过50%入组）及II期心肌炎ARCHER试验。2025年末现金2770万美元，跑道至2027年第四季度。
companies.description_en: Cardiol Therapeutics (TSX/NASDAQ: CRDL) is a Canadian clinical-stage cardiovascular company founded in 2017, HQ in Oakville, ON. Lead candidate CardiolRx™ (pharmaceutically pure cannabidiol) modulates NLRP3 inflammasome pathway in recurrent pericarditis and myocarditis. Pivotal Phase 3 MAVERIC trial (recurrent pericarditis) >50% enrolled; Phase 2 ARCHER data published in ESC Heart Failure (2025). Pre-revenue; cash $27.7M (Dec 31, 2025) funding operations into Q4 2027.

companies.description_zh: CareDx（NASDAQ: CDNA）是专注器官移植精准医疗的领先诊断公司，1998年成立，总部位于加利福尼亚州布里斯班。核心产品AlloSure®（dd-cfDNA供体源细胞游离DNA检测，肾脏/心脏）及AlloMap®（基因表达分析），用于移植患者排异反应早期检测。2025年收入3.8亿美元（同比+14%），非GAAP净利润3200万美元，提供2026年指引4.20~4.44亿美元。
companies.description_en: CareDx (NASDAQ: CDNA) is a Brisbane, CA-based precision medicine company founded in 1998, focused on transplant patient care. Key products: AlloSure® (dd-cfDNA NGS test for kidney/heart rejection risk), AlloMap® (gene-expression profiling for heart), and HistoMap™ Kidney (tissue-based molecular rejection characterization). FY2025 revenue $380M (+14% YoY); non-GAAP net income $32M; adjusted EBITDA $32M. 2026 guidance $420–$444M. ~765 employees.

companies.description_zh: CARGO Therapeutics是一家前CAR-T细胞疗法公司，总部原位于加利福尼亚州圣卡洛斯。其主要候选药物firicabtagene autoleucel（CD22 CAR-T）在LBCL的II期临床试验中因安全性问题被叫停。2025年3月公司裁员90%并暂停全部研发工作；2025年8月被Concentra Biosciences以每股4.379美元（约2.175亿美元）完成收购，已从纳斯达克退市。
companies.description_en: CARGO Therapeutics (formerly NASDAQ: CRGX) was a San Carlos, CA CAR-T cell therapy company. Its lead candidate firicabtagene autoleucel (autologous CD22 CAR-T) was discontinued in March 2025 after Phase 2 (FIRCE-1) showed an unfavorable benefit-risk profile. In March 2025 CARGO halted all development and cut 90% of its workforce. In July 2025 it agreed to be acquired by Concentra Biosciences for $4.379/share (~$217.5M); acquisition completed August 18, 2025. No longer publicly traded.

sources.title: CARGO Therapeutics Cuts 90% Workforce, Halts Development – Hoodline

companies.description_zh: Caribou Biosciences（NASDAQ: CRBU）是由CRISPR发明者Jennifer Doudna等人于2011年联合创立的临床阶段同种异体CAR-T公司，总部位于加利福尼亚州伯克利。使用专有chRDNA基因组编辑平台开发现货型异体细胞疗法。主要管线：vispa-cel（CD19 CAR-T，NHL B细胞）和CB-011（BCMA CAR-T，多发性骨髓瘤）。2025年4月战略重组，裁员约32%并终止GALLOP/AMpLify试验。2025年GAAP净亏损1.481亿美元。
companies.description_en: Caribou Biosciences (NASDAQ: CRBU) was co-founded in 2011 by Jennifer Doudna, Rachel Haurwitz and others. Berkeley, CA-based clinical-stage allogeneic cell therapy company using proprietary chRDNA genome-editing for off-the-shelf products. Lead programs: vispa-cel (anti-CD19, relapsed/refractory B-NHL, ANTLER Ph1 showing durable efficacy) and CB-011 (anti-BCMA, r/r multiple myeloma, Ph1). April 2025 pipeline reprioritization: discontinued GALLOP (lupus) and AMpLify (AML) and ~32% workforce reduction. FY2025 R&D $109.4M; GAAP net loss $148.1M.

sources.title: Caribou Biosciences FY2025 Financial Results – GlobeNewswire

companies.description_zh: Century Therapeutics（NASDAQ: IPSC）是一家iPSC衍生细胞疗法公司，2018年成立，总部位于宾夕法尼亚州费城。利用诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）平台开发异体NK和T细胞疗法用于自身免疫性疾病和癌症治疗。核心项目CNTY-101（CD19靶向iPSC衍生iNK细胞）正在CALiPSO-1 Ph1试验中评估自身免疫疾病。2025年与百时美施贵宝的合作协议终止，确认协作收入1.092亿美元；现金跑道延伸至2029年Q1。
companies.description_en: Century Therapeutics (NASDAQ: IPSC) is a Philadelphia, PA iPSC-derived cell therapy company founded in 2018. Platform leverages cellular reprogramming to produce allogeneic, off-the-shelf iNK and iT cells. Lead program CNTY-101 (CD19-targeted iPSC-iNK) in CALiPSO-1 Phase 1/2 for B-cell autoimmune diseases. Next-gen CNTY-308 (CD19 CAR-iT) and CNTY-341 (CD19/CD22 dual-targeted) in IND-enabling studies. BMS collaboration terminated Mar 2025; $109.2M collaboration revenue recognized FY2025. Cash runway into Q1 2029; net loss narrowed to $9.6M.

sources.title: Century Therapeutics FY2025 Financial Results – GlobeNewswire

companies.description_zh: CG Oncology（NASDAQ: CGON）是一家临床阶段溶瘤免疫疗法公司，原名Cold Genesys，2010年成立于加利福尼亚州，总部位于欧文市（400 Spectrum Center Drive）。核心产品cretostimogene grenadenorepvec是膀胱内给药的溶瘤腺病毒，靶向非肌层浸润性膀胱癌（NMIBC）。正在开展两项III期试验（BOND-003/BCG不应答；PIVOT-006/中危NMIBC）及II期CORE-008。现金约9.03亿美元，跑道至2029年上半年。
companies.description_en: CG Oncology (NASDAQ: CGON), formerly Cold Genesys, was founded September 24, 2010 in California; renamed March 2020. HQ: Irvine, CA. Lead candidate cretostimogene grenadenorepvec is an intravesically delivered oncolytic immunotherapy targeting non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC). Phase 3 BOND-003 (BCG-unresponsive high-risk NMIBC) and Phase 3 PIVOT-006 (intermediate-risk NMIBC) are ongoing; Phase 2 CORE-008 (checkpoint inhibitor combination). Pre-revenue clinical stage. FY2025 net loss $161M; cash ~$903M (Feb 26, 2026), runway into 1H 2029. IPO: January 25, 2024.

sources.title: CG Oncology FY2025 Year-End Financial Results
CG Oncology Company Profile – Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: 赛弗制药（TSX: CPH）是加拿大小型专科药企，2000年成立，总部位于安大略省密西沙加，为CML HealthCare拆分子公司。通过引进原创药品在加拿大及美国商业化，产品线涵盖皮肤科（Actikerall、Epuris/isotretinoin、Vaniqa、Natroba）和院内急救（Aggrastat、Brinavess）。2025年全年收入5050万加元（创纪录，同比+51%），净利润2730万加元（+137%）。美国业务（旗下子公司）驱动主要增长。员工极少，资产轻型商业模式。
companies.description_en: Cipher Pharmaceuticals (TSX: CPH) is a Mississauga, ON specialty pharma company founded in 2000 as a spin-off from CML HealthCare. Operates an asset-light licensing/commercialization model: in-licenses branded originator drugs for Canada and the US. Products include dermatology (Actikerall, Epuris, Vaniqa, Natroba) and hospital acute-care (Aggrastat, Brinavess). FY2025 record revenue CAD 50.5M (+51% YoY); net income CAD 27.3M (+137%). US segment contributed CAD 30.0M in 2025 (+150%). Very lean headcount (~6 employees); headquartered in Mississauga.

sources.title: Cipher Pharmaceuticals FY2025 Record Revenue and Earnings – Newswire

companies.sub_sector: Specialty pharma; dermatology, CNS; in-licensing established products

companies.description_zh: 科金生物科学（NASDAQ: COGT）是专注基因定义疾病的精准治疗公司，2014年成立（前身为Unum Therapeutics，2020年更名），总部位于马萨诸塞州沃尔瑟姆。核心候选药物bezuclastinib是一种高选择性KIT抑制剂（靶向KIT D816V突变），针对系统性肥大细胞增多症（SM）和胃肠道间质瘤（GIST）。已向FDA提交三项NDA：NonAdvSM（PDUFA日期2026年11月/12月）、GIST（RTOR加速审评）和AdvSM（提交1H 2026）。2025年末现金9.008亿美元，跑道至2028年。
companies.description_en: Cogent Biosciences (NASDAQ: COGT) was founded in 2014 (as Unum Therapeutics, renamed October 2020) in Waltham, MA. Lead candidate bezuclastinib is a selective KIT tyrosine kinase inhibitor targeting KIT D816V (and other exon 17 mutations) for systemic mastocytosis (SM) and KIT-mutant GIST. Three NDA submissions: NonAdvSM (SUMMIT NDA, Dec 2025; PDUFA Nov/Dec 2026), GIST (PEAK NDA under RTOR, Apr 2026), and AdvSM (APEX NDA submitted 1H 2026). FY2025 net loss $328.9M; cash/securities $900.8M (runway into 2028). Pre-revenue clinical stage.

sources.title: Cogent Biosciences 2025 loss, $901M cash into 2028 – StockTitan

companies.description_zh: COSCIENS生物制药（前身为Aeterna Zentaris与Ceapro合并而成）是一家生命科学公司，专注于植物来源的天然活性成分（燕麦素Avenanthramides和β-葡聚糖）的开发与商业化，应用于护肤品领域；其此前的制药业务（Macrilen®）已于2026年初停止。
companies.description_en: COSCIENS Biopharma (formerly formed by the merger of Aeterna Zentaris and Ceapro) is a life science company focused on natural, plant-based active ingredients—avenanthramides and oat beta-glucan—used in cosmeceutical skincare brands globally; its pharmaceutical programs (Macrilen®, AvenActive) were discontinued by early 2026.

sources.title: COSCIENS Biopharma Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 科里内特制药是一家专注于内分泌疾病的临床阶段生物制药公司，旗舰产品PALSONIFY®（帕替索汀，paltusotine）于2025年9月获FDA批准用于肢端肥大症。
companies.description_en: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on endocrine diseases, with its flagship product PALSONIFY® (paltusotine) FDA-approved in September 2025 for acromegaly. Pipeline includes atumelnant for Cushing's syndrome and CAH.

sources.title: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 赛宾制药（2026年初更名为Helus Pharma）是一家突破性3期神经精神科临床公司，专注于开发氘代迷幻药疗法，核心产品CYB003（氘代裸盖菇素类似物）用于重度抑郁症（3期），CYB004（氘代DMT）用于广泛性焦虑障碍（2期）。
companies.description_en: Cybin (rebranded Helus Pharma in January 2026, NASDAQ: HELP) is a breakthrough Phase 3 neuropsychiatry company developing deuterated psychedelic therapeutics; CYB003 for major depressive disorder is in pivotal Phase 3 (PARADIGM), and CYB004 for generalized anxiety disorder is in Phase 2.
companies.sub_sector: Psychedelic therapeutics; CYB003 (deuterated psilocybin analog) for MDD, alcohol use disorder

companies.description_zh: 细胞动力学是一家专注于肌肉生物学的专科生物制药公司，旗舰产品MYQORZO®（aficamten）于2025年12月获FDA批准用于症状性梗阻性肥厚型心肌病（oHCM），并已在欧盟及中国获批。
companies.description_en: Cytokinetics is a specialty biopharmaceutical company focused on muscle biology. Its flagship MYQORZO® (aficamten) received FDA approval in December 2025 for symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM), with subsequent EC and NMPA approvals. The company is pursuing Vision 2030 to become a leading muscle biology company.

companies.description_zh: 迪亚美迪卡治疗是一家专注于缺血性脑卒中和先兆子痫的临床阶段生物制药公司，核心产品DM199（重组人激肽释放酶1）正在ReMEDy2 2/3期脑卒中试验（已达70%中期入组）及先兆子痫2期研究中推进。
companies.description_en: DiaMedica Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing DM199 (recombinant human kallikrein-1) for acute ischemic stroke (ReMEDy2 Phase 2/3, ~70% enrolled toward interim analysis in H2 2026) and preeclampsia/fetal growth restriction. Cash runway through H2 2027.

sources.title: DiaMedica Therapeutics Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 圆盘医疗是一家专注于严重血液病的临床阶段生物制药公司，核心管线包括：bitopertin（用于红细胞生成性卟啉症）3期APOLLO试验进行中，DISC-0974（用于骨髓纤维化相关贫血）及DISC-3405（用于真性红细胞增多症）。公司持有7.912亿美元现金，可运营至2029年。
companies.description_en: Disc Medicine is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on serious hematologic diseases, targeting heme biosynthesis and iron homeostasis. Lead programs: bitopertin in Phase 3 (APOLLO, erythropoietic porphyrias, topline data Q4 2026), DISC-0974 (anemia of myelofibrosis/CKD), and DISC-3405 (polycythemia vera). Cash runway to 2029.

companies.description_zh: 戴亚迪克国际是一家生物技术平台公司，专有C1（Thermothelomyces heterothallica真菌）蛋白表达平台可用于快速、可扩展的疫苗和生物制剂研发生产；与比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会及CEPI合作开展传染病疫苗研究。2025年收入390万美元，较上年下降。
companies.description_en: Dyadic International is a platform biotechnology company whose proprietary C1 fungal expression system (Thermothelomyces heterothallica) enables rapid, scalable biomanufacturing of vaccines and biologics. Partners include Gates Foundation and CEPI. FY2025 revenues of $3.09M, with FY2026 guidance of $7.4M as commercial adoption accelerates.

companies.description_zh: 戴恩治疗是一家专注于神经肌肉疾病的临床阶段生物制药公司，采用FORCE™平台开发针对肌肉和CNS的寡核苷酸疗法。旗舰候选药物z-rostudirsen（DMD）和z-basivarsen（强直性肌营养不良1型）均处于全球1/2期试验，并报告了积极的肌营养不良蛋白表达数据。
companies.description_en: Dyne Therapeutics is a clinical-stage company developing FORCE™ platform-based oligonucleotide therapies targeting muscle and CNS for neuromuscular diseases. Lead candidates z-rostudirsen (DMD) and z-basivarsen (DM1) are in global Phase 1/2 trials with supportive proof-of-concept data. Cash of $1.1B provides runway to Q1 2028.

sources.title: Dyne Therapeutics Q4 & FY2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 边缘治疗是一家专注于严重肌肉疾病的临床阶段生物制药公司，旗舰产品sevasemten（快速骨骼肌球蛋白抑制剂）用于杜氏和贝克肌营养不良症正处于后期临床阶段；EDG-15400（心脏肌节调节剂）正在1期开发用于射血分数保留的心力衰竭。截至2025年底持有5.3亿美元现金。
companies.description_en: Edgewise Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing first-in-class fast skeletal myosin inhibitors for severe muscle diseases. Sevasemten is in late-stage trials for Becker and Duchenne muscular dystrophy; EDG-15400 is in Phase 1 for HFpEF. Cash of ~$530M as of December 2025.

sources.title: Edgewise Therapeutics Q4 & FY2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 编辑医药是一家领先的CRISPR/Cas9基因组编辑公司，现重点推进EDIT-401（通过上调LDL受体降低LDL胆固醇，用于高脂血症）等候选药物；reni-cel（镰刀型细胞贫血症）项目已于2024年底停止，公司进行了大幅裁员并将重心转向单一新领先项目。
companies.description_en: Editas Medicine is a pioneering CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing company. Following the discontinuation of reni-cel in December 2024, the company refocused on EDIT-401 (LDL receptor upregulation for hyperlipidemia) and other emerging CRISPR programs. FY2025 revenue of $40.5M was collaboration-derived; cash runway to Q3 2027.

sources.title: Editas Medicine IR Press Release FY2025

companies.description_zh: 新兴生物解决方案是一家专注于公共健康威胁医疗对策的全球生命科学公司，核心产品包括CYFENDUS®（炭疽疫苗）、ACAM2000®（天花疫苗）、BioThrax®及纳洛酮（NARCAN）；公司正经历多年业务转型，2025年全年收入7.43亿美元，实现净利润5260万美元。
companies.description_en: Emergent BioSolutions is a global life sciences company focused on medical countermeasures against public health threats. Key products include CYFENDUS® (anthrax vaccine adjuvanted), ACAM2000® (smallpox vaccine), BioThrax®, and naloxone (NARCAN). FY2025 revenues of $742.9M; net income of $52.6M reflecting ongoing multi-year turnaround.

sources.title: Emergent BioSolutions Q4 & FY2025 Financial Results
Emergent BioSolutions Corporate Fact Sheet Jan 2026

companies.description_zh: 伊拉斯卡是一家专注于RAS/MAPK通路驱动肿瘤的精准肿瘤学临床公司，核心候选药物包括ERAS-0015（潜在同类最佳pan-RAS分子胶）和ERAS-4001（潜在首创pan-KRAS抑制剂），均预计2026年提供1期单药数据。截至2025年底持有3.418亿美元现金。
companies.description_en: Erasca is a clinical-stage precision oncology company singularly focused on RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers. Lead programs ERAS-0015 (potential best-in-class pan-RAS molecular glue) and ERAS-4001 (potential first-in-class pan-KRAS inhibitor) are advancing through Phase 1. Cash of $341.8M as of December 31, 2025.

companies.description_zh: 优普拉西亚制药是一家利用专有Diffusphere™局部控释递药技术的临床阶段生物技术公司；EP-104IAR（膝骨关节炎疼痛）已完成2b期SPRINGBOARD试验并达到主要终点；EP-104GI（嗜酸性食管炎）正在1b/2期RESOLVE试验中，2026年1月报告了积极数据。
companies.description_en: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biotech using its proprietary Diffusphere™ controlled-release drug delivery technology. EP-104IAR (knee osteoarthritis pain) completed Phase 2b (SPRINGBOARD), meeting primary endpoint; EP-104GI (eosinophilic esophagitis) reported positive Phase 1b/2a data in January 2026. Cash runway into H2 2028.
companies.sub_sector: Clinical-stage; DiffuSphere injectable drug delivery; knee osteoarthritis, eosinophilic esophagitis

companies.description_zh: 伊沃明新是一家临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于慢性炎症性疾病的关键驱动靶点。核心产品EVO756（口服MRGPRX2拮抗剂，用于慢性自发性荨麻疹和特应性皮炎）及EVO301（IL-18结合蛋白融合蛋白，用于特应性皮炎和溃疡性结肠炎）预计2026年提供3项2期数据读出。公司于2025年11月完成1.5亿美元IPO。
companies.description_en: Evommune is a clinical-stage biotech developing therapies targeting key drivers of chronic inflammatory diseases. EVO756 (oral MRGPRX2 antagonist for CSU and AD) and EVO301 (IL-18 binding protein fusion for AD and UC) are both in Phase 2 with three data readouts expected in 2026. IPO raised $150M in November 2025; cash of $216.7M at year-end 2025.

companies.description_zh: 命运治疗是一家专注于iPSC（诱导多能干细胞）衍生的现货型细胞免疫疗法的临床阶段生物制药公司；FT819（MICA/B靶向CAR-T）已获MHRA和EMA授权开展临床试验，FT836（结直肠癌）和FT839正在早期临床/IND准备阶段。持有约2.05亿美元现金，可运营至2027年底。
companies.description_en: Fate Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing iPSC-derived off-the-shelf cellular immunotherapies. FT819 (MICA/B-targeted CAR T-cell) received MHRA and EMA authorization in 2025; FT836 shows early antitumor activity in colorectal cancer. Cash of $205M provides runway through year-end 2027.

sources.title: Fate Therapeutics Q4 & FY2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 芬尼克制药是一家专注于PEDMARK®（硫代硫酸钠注射液）商业化阶段的特种制药公司。PEDMARK是首个也是唯一获FDA批准用于降低顺铂治疗局限性非转移性实体瘤儿科患者耳毒性风险的药物，2025年全年净产品销售额4460万美元，同比增长51%。
companies.description_en: Fennec Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage specialty pharma company focused on PEDMARK® (sodium thiosulfate injection), the first and only FDA-approved therapy to reduce cisplatin-induced ototoxicity risk in pediatric patients with localized non-metastatic solid tumors. FY2025 net product sales of $44.6M, up 51% YoY.

sources.title: Fennec Pharmaceuticals Q4 & FY2025 Financial Results
Fennec Pharmaceuticals IR FY2025 Press Release

companies.description_zh: 雾号治疗是一家临床阶段生物制药公司，利用Gene Traffic Control®平台靶向色素调控系统（BAF/SWI-SNF复合体）中的基因依赖性。核心产品FHD-909（BRM选择性ATPase抑制剂）与礼来公司合作推进；管线还涵盖SMARCA2、CBP、EP300和ARID1B等7个靶点项目。截至2025年底持有约1.59亿美元现金，加上2026年1月的5000万美元融资后约有2.09亿美元。
companies.description_en: Foghorn Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company using its Gene Traffic Control® platform to target genetically determined dependencies within the chromatin regulatory system (BAF/SWI-SNF). Lead program FHD-909 (selective BRM ATPase inhibitor) is in dose escalation in collaboration with Lilly; pipeline spans 7 programs including SMARCA2, CBP, EP300, and ARID1B. Pro-forma cash ~$209M.

sources.title: Foghorn Therapeutics Financial Update 2025 and 2026 Outlook

revenue.note_en: FY2025 revenue $2,723.4M (vs $2,696.4M FY2024); Adjusted EBITDA $189.9M; GAAP net loss $(986.2)M
revenue.note_zh: 2025财年收入27.234亿美元（2024财年26.964亿美元）；调整后EBITDA 1.899亿美元；GAAP净亏损9.862亿美元

companies.description_zh: 福蒂瑞控股是2023年6月从Labcorp分拆而来的全球领先合同研究组织（CRO），在约100个国家提供I-IV期临床开发服务，员工约14,300人。2025财年收入27.234亿美元；肿瘤学占全方位服务治疗收入的40%。2025年调整后EBITDA为1.899亿美元。
companies.description_en: Fortrea Holdings is a leading global contract research organization (CRO) spun off from Labcorp in June 2023, providing Phase I-IV clinical development services across ~100 countries with ~14,300 employees. FY2025 revenue $2,723.4M; oncology represents 40% of full-service therapeutic revenue. Adjusted EBITDA $189.9M for 2025.

companies.description_zh: 加莱拉治疗公司是一家临床阶段的生物制药公司，专注于开发小分子歧化酶模拟物（SOD模拟物），用于改善放射治疗中癌症患者的预后。其候选药物阿瓦帕森锰（GC4419/avasopasem）正在开发用于减少放疗引起的严重口腔黏膜炎。公司现已移至OTC市场交易，员工仅剩3人。
companies.description_en: Galera Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a portfolio of small molecule superoxide dismutase (SOD) mimetics to improve radiotherapy in cancer patients. Its lead candidate avasopasem manganese (GC4419) targets severe oral mucositis in head and neck cancer patients undergoing chemoradiotherapy. Following FDA rejection, the company shifted to OTC markets and now operates with minimal staff.

sources.title: Galera Therapeutics Company Profile – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: GeneDx控股公司是美国领先的基因组诊断公司，专注于儿科罕见病的全外显子组和全基因组测序诊断。公司由美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）前科学家于2000年创立，2025年收入达4.28亿美元，同比增长40%，并于2025年实现盈利。通过其AI驱动的基因组平台，为数十万患者提供罕见遗传疾病诊断服务。
companies.description_en: GeneDx Holdings is a leading US genomics company specializing in whole exome and whole genome sequencing (WGS/WES) for rare and inherited pediatric disorders. Founded in 2000 by former NIH scientists, it achieved $427.5M revenue in 2025 (40% YoY growth) and returned to profitability. Its AI-enabled genomic platform accelerates rare disease diagnoses across thousands of hospitals globally.

companies.description_zh: 杰朗公司是一家商业阶段生物制药公司，专注于血液肿瘤治疗。其首个且唯一的产品RYTELO（伊美替司他/imetelstat）是全球首个也是唯一一个获批的端粒酶抑制剂，已在美国和欧盟获批用于治疗输血依赖性低危骨髓增生异常综合征（LR-MDS）贫血，2025年净产品收入达1.84亿美元。2025年公司宣布重组，裁减约三分之一员工。
companies.description_en: Geron Corporation is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company targeting blood cancers. Its sole product RYTELO (imetelstat), the world's first and only telomerase inhibitor, is approved in the US and EU for transfusion-dependent anemia in lower-risk MDS. Full-year 2025 net product revenue reached $184M. In late 2025, the company announced a restructuring reducing headcount by roughly one-third.

sources.title: Geron Q4 and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

revenue.note_en: FY2025 total revenue USD 1,396.6 million (+38% YoY, from USD 1,015.3M in 2024); royalty revenue USD 867.8M (+52%); net income USD 316.9M

rnd_spend.note_en: FY2025 R&D expense USD 81.5 million (USD 79.0M in 2024)

companies.description_zh: 哈洛济姆以ENHANZE给药技术著称，这是基于重组人透明质酸酶（rHuPH20）的专有皮下给药平台，授权给阿斯利康、强生、辉瑞、罗氏等大型合作方，将静脉注射生物药转为皮下给药。2025财年创纪录收入13.97亿美元（同比+38%），其中特许权收入8.68亿美元，净利润3.17亿美元。
companies.description_en: Halozyme Therapeutics is a biopharma company best known for its ENHANZE drug delivery technology, a proprietary subcutaneous (SC) platform based on recombinant human hyaluronidase (rHuPH20). Licensed to major partners including AstraZeneca, J&J, Pfizer, and Roche to convert IV biologics to SC administration. Achieved record FY2025 revenue of USD 1.397B (+38% YoY), with royalty revenue of USD 868M and net income of USD 317M.

sources.title: Halozyme Full Year 2025 Record Revenue $1.4B – PRNewswire

companies.description_zh: 血干细胞公司（Hemostemix Inc.）是一家加拿大临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于自体干细胞疗法ACP-01的开发，主要用于治疗慢性肢体威胁性缺血（CLTI）及外周动脉疾病等心血管疾病，面向无法进行血运重建的患者。公司已完成7项临床研究，纳入318例受试者，并发表11篇同行评审论文。市值约790万加元，属于微型股公司。
companies.description_en: Hemostemix is a Canadian clinical-stage biotech developing ACP-01, an autologous stem cell therapy for patients with chronic limb-threatening ischemia (CLTI) and peripheral arterial disease who have no revascularization options. Seven clinical studies of 318 subjects have been completed with 11 peer-reviewed publications. The company is a micro-cap with a market cap of ~C$7.9M and minimal revenue.
companies.sub_sector: Autologous stem cell therapy (VesCell/ACP-01) for vascular ischemic disease and critical limb ischemia

companies.description_zh: HLS治疗公司是一家加拿大专科制药公司，专注于收购和商业化北美市场的专利药品，主要针对精神科和心血管疾病领域的未满足医疗需求。旗下主要产品包括Clozaril（氯氮平，用于难治性精神分裂症）、Vascepa（伊考沙奔乙酯，用于心血管疾病）、Nilemdo和Nexlizet（苯丁二酸/苯丁二酸+依折麦布，心血管风险降低）。2025年收入约6080万加元，调整后EBITDA增长18%至1960万加元。
companies.description_en: HLS Therapeutics is a Canadian specialty pharma company focused on acquiring and commercializing branded pharmaceuticals in North American markets for psychiatry and cardiovascular disease. Key products include Clozaril (clozapine for treatment-resistant schizophrenia), Vascepa (icosapent ethyl for cardiovascular risk), Nilemdo and Nexlizet (bempedoic acid-based LDL-lowering agents). 2025 revenue was C$60.8M with 18% Adjusted EBITDA growth.
companies.sub_sector: Specialty pharma; cardiovascular, CNS; in-licensing and commercialization in Canada

companies.name_zh: 影像生物公司（原Ikena肿瘤学）
companies.description_zh: ImageneBio公司于2025年7月由Ikena Oncology与Inmagene Biopharmaceuticals合并成立，并更名为ImageneBio，在纳斯达克以IMA代码交易。公司专注于免疫学、自身免疫和炎症性疾病的创新疗法开发，主要候选药物IMG-007是一种非耗竭性抗OX40单克隆抗体，处于临床阶段。公司为小型临床阶段企业，市值约6000万美元。
companies.description_en: ImageneBio was formed in July 2025 through the merger of Ikena Oncology and Inmagene Biopharmaceuticals, trading on Nasdaq as 'IMA'. The company focuses on immunological, autoimmune, and inflammatory diseases. Lead candidate IMG-007 is a non-depleting anti-OX40 monoclonal antibody. The company is a small clinical-stage biotech with a market cap of ~$60M and minimal revenue from the legacy Ikena collaboration.

sources.title: Ikena Oncology Merger with Inmagene – Nasdaq

companies.description_zh: 伊玛提克斯公司是一家临床阶段肿瘤免疫治疗公司，总部位于美国休斯顿及德国图宾根，专注于开发基于T细胞受体（TCR）的双特异性药物和ACTengine细胞疗法，靶向肿瘤相关抗原PRAME。2025年全年收入为5680万美元（较2024年的1.831亿美元大幅下降，主要因合作收入减少），现金储备充裕，达5.514亿美元，资金可覆盖运营至2028年。公司于2000年从图宾根大学分拆成立。
companies.description_en: Immatics N.V. is a clinical-stage oncology immunotherapy company headquartered in Houston, TX and Tübingen, Germany. It develops TCR-bispecific molecules and ACTengine cell therapies targeting PRAME and other tumor-associated antigens. Full-year 2025 revenue was $56.8M (down from $183.1M in 2024 due to lower collaboration revenue). Cash position as of Dec 31, 2025 was $551.4M, funding operations into 2028. Spun out from the University of Tübingen in 2000.

companies.name_zh: 英博科斯生物科学公司
companies.description_zh: 英博科斯生物科学公司于2024年从原Inhibrx分拆成立，当时赛诺菲收购了原Inhibrx的α1-抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症项目（INBRX-101）。新公司专注于肿瘤学领域，基于可适应和可扩展的多价多特异性蛋白质平台开发创新疗法，总部位于加州拉霍亚，市值约8.5亿美元。
companies.description_en: Inhibrx Biosciences emerged in 2024 following Sanofi's acquisition of legacy Inhibrx's INBRX-101 alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency program, leaving an oncology-focused biotech trading as INBX. Based in La Jolla, CA, it leverages an adaptable multi-valent, multi-specific protein engineering platform. Market cap ~$853M; the company had a net loss of $140.1M in FY2025.

companies.description_zh: 英思迈公司是一家专注于罕见病肺部疾病的商业阶段生物制药公司，总部位于新泽西州布里奇沃特。旗下两款商业产品：ARIKAYCE（阿米卡星脂质体吸入混悬液，用于鸟分枝杆菌肺病）和BRINSUPRI（溴化司他肽，用于非囊性纤维化支气管扩张），2025年合计实现收入6.06亿美元（同比增长67%），其中ARIKAYCE全年收入4.34亿美元，BRINSUPRI上市首年即产生约1.45亿美元收入。市值超过300亿美元。
companies.description_en: Insmed is a commercial-stage biopharma company focused on rare pulmonary diseases, headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ. It markets two products: ARIKAYCE (amikacin liposome inhalation suspension, for refractory MAC lung disease) and BRINSUPRI (brensocatib, for non-CF bronchiectasis). Full-year 2025 total revenue was $606.4M (+67% YoY), with ARIKAYCE at $433.8M and BRINSUPRI contributing ~$145M in its launch year. Market cap exceeded $31B.

sources.title: Insmed Q4 and Full Year 2025 Financial Results – PRNewswire

companies.description_zh: 因特利亚治疗公司是一家领先的CRISPR基因编辑生物制药公司，总部位于马萨诸塞州剑桥，于2014年与博德研究所合作成立。公司专注于体内基因编辑疗法，主要候选药物lonvo-z（nexiguran ziclumeran，用于遗传性转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性）和nex-z（nuilokibart，用于遗传性血管性水肿）均处于三期临床，lonvo-z已为HAE适应症做好商业化准备。2025年全年合作收入为6770万美元，现金储备6.05亿美元可支持运营至2027年下半年。
companies.description_en: Intellia Therapeutics is a leading CRISPR-based in vivo gene editing company founded in 2014 in Cambridge, MA. Lead programs lonvo-z (nexiguran ziclumeran for ATTR amyloidosis) and nex-z (nuilokibart for hereditary angioedema, HAE) are in Phase 3. FY2025 collaboration revenue was $67.7M (+17% YoY). Cash of $605.1M funds operations into H2 2027 and through anticipated lonvo-z HAE launch.

sources.title: Intellia Therapeutics Q4 and Full Year 2025 Results

companies.description_zh: 爱泰奥斯治疗公司是一家专注于肿瘤免疫治疗的临床阶段生物制药公司，于2012年创立于比利时戈瑟利，总部后迁至美国马萨诸塞州沃特敦。公司专注于腺苷通路和免疫抑制检查点靶点，主要候选药物belrestotug（EOS-448）曾与GSK合作开展联合疗法研究。2025年5月，公司终止了belrestotug研究项目和与GSK的合作协议并启动重组。2025年下半年，公司与Concentra Biosciences达成收购协议并从纳斯达克退市。
companies.description_en: iTeos Therapeutics was a Belgian-American clinical-stage immuno-oncology company targeting the adenosine pathway and immunosuppressive checkpoints. Founded in 2012 in Gosselies, Belgium; US HQ in Watertown, MA. Lead program belrestotug was co-developed with GSK until the collaboration was terminated in May 2025 following disappointing Phase 2 data. In late 2025, iTeos agreed to be acquired by Concentra Biosciences and was delisted from Nasdaq.

sources.title: ITOS Stock: iTeos Corporate Profile and Delisting Overview
iTeos Q4 and Full Year 2024 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 美洲虎健康公司是一家专注于肠胃道疾病和动物健康的商业阶段制药公司，总部位于旧金山。主要产品Mytesi（克罗菲莱尔，crofelemer）获FDA批准用于治疗HIV/AIDS患者的非感染性腹泻。公司还开发Canalevia-CA1（犬用克罗菲莱尔，用于化疗引起的腹泻）。2025年总净收入为1150万美元，市值仅约500万美元，属于微型股。子公司Napo Pharmaceuticals专注于热带雨林植物来源的全球胃肠道药物研发。
companies.description_en: Jaguar Health is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company focused on gastrointestinal conditions and animal health, headquartered in San Francisco. Its flagship product Mytesi (crofelemer) is FDA-approved for HIV/AIDS-related non-infectious diarrhea. Canalevia-CA1 targets chemotherapy-induced diarrhea in dogs. FY2025 total net revenue was $11.5M. The company is a micro-cap with ~$5M market cap and 49 employees.

companies.description_zh: 凯恩生物技术公司是一家加拿大生物技术公司，专注于微生物生物膜的研究、开发和商业化，业务涵盖动物健康和人类健康两个细分领域。公司核心技术包括coactiv+（一种持续活性的生物膜去稳定配方）和DispersinB（一种天然酶，裂解细菌表面多糖PNAG，用于伤口和耳部感染治疗）。公司总收入极小，市值约720万加元，属于微型股。
companies.description_en: Kane Biotech is a Canadian biotech engaged in research, development, and commercialization of technologies and products to prevent and remove microbial biofilms. Operates across animal health and human health segments. Key technologies: coactiv+ (biofilm destabilizing formula with continuous activity) and DispersinB (enzyme cleaving bacterial surface PNAG polysaccharide for wound and otic infections). Revenue ~C$575K (trailing twelve months to Sep 2025); micro-cap market cap ~C$7.2M.

sources.title: Kane Biotech Market Cap – Stock Analysis

companies.sub_sector: Biofilm prevention and removal technologies; antimicrobial products for infection control

companies.description_zh: 科罗斯治疗公司是一家临床阶段生物制药公司，总部位于马萨诸塞州列克星顿，专注于肌肉和血液疾病的治疗。其主要产品elritercept（KER-065）已与汉信（上海）健康科技达成全球许可协议，2025年产生了2亿美元预付款和1000万美元里程碑，推动当年收入达到2.437亿美元。公司还通过武田制药过渡服务协议产生了3810万美元服务收入。
companies.description_en: Keros Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Lexington, MA, focusing on diseases involving muscle and blood. Its lead asset elritercept (KER-065) targets anemia and thrombocytopenia. In 2025, a global license agreement with Hansoh (Shanghai) Healthtech generated a $200M upfront payment and $10M milestone, driving total 2025 revenue to $243.7M. Additional $38.1M came from Takeda transition services. Market cap ~$229M as of early 2026.

companies.description_zh: 骑士治疗公司是一家泛美洲（美国以外）专科制药公司，总部位于加拿大蒙特利尔，专注于为加拿大和拉丁美洲收购、许可及商业化专利药品。2025年全年收入4.501亿加元（同比增长21%），主要受益于Paladin和住友制药收购带来的增量收入及核心推广产品增长。公司拥有830名员工，覆盖加拿大和多个拉丁美洲市场。
companies.description_en: Knight Therapeutics is a pan-American (ex-US) specialty pharma company headquartered in Montreal, Canada. It acquires, in-licenses, and commercializes pharmaceutical products for Canada and Latin America. Full-year 2025 revenues were C$450.1M (+21% YoY) driven by incremental revenues from the Paladin and Sumitomo Transactions. The company has 830 employees and operates across Canada and multiple Latin American markets.

sources.title: Knight Therapeutics Q4 and Year-End 2025 Results

companies.sub_sector: Specialty pharma; in-licensing and commercialization in Canada and Latin America

companies.name_zh: 克里斯托生物技术公司
companies.description_zh: 克里斯托生物技术公司是一家专注于遗传性皮肤病和其他罕见遗传疾病的整合型商业阶段生物技术公司，总部位于宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡。公司拥有专有的HSV-1（单纯疱疹病毒1型）基因治疗平台。旗舰产品VYJUVEK（beremagene geperpavec）是全球首个可反复给药的基因疗法，已获美国、欧洲和日本批准用于治疗营养不良型大疱性表皮松解症（DEB）。2025年全年收入达3.89亿美元，同比增长约34%。
companies.description_en: Krystal Biotech is an integrated commercial-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA, focused on genetic medicines for diseases with high unmet medical needs using its proprietary HSV-1-based gene therapy platform. Flagship product VYJUVEK (beremagene geperpavec) is the first-ever redosable gene therapy, approved in the US, Europe, and Japan for dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (DEB). Full-year 2025 revenue was $389M (+34% YoY).

sources.title: Krystal Biotech Q4 and Full Year 2025 Results

companies.description_zh: 库拉肿瘤学公司是一家聚焦于肿瘤精准医疗的商业阶段生物制药公司，总部位于加州圣地亚哥。公司专注于menin抑制和法尼基转移酶抑制（FTI）领域，核心产品ziftomenib（KOMZIFTI）是一种menin抑制剂，2025年11月获FDA批准用于具有特定基因突变（NPM1突变或KMT2Ar重排）的复发/难治性急性髓系白血病（AML）。2025年全年收入6750万美元（其中大部分来自授权及里程碑收入），并以约5周商业销售产生210万美元净产品收入。
companies.description_en: Kura Oncology is a precision oncology company headquartered in San Diego, CA, focused on menin inhibition and farnesyl transferase inhibition (FTI). Lead product KOMZIFTI (ziftomenib) was approved by the FDA in November 2025 for relapsed/refractory AML with NPM1 mutation or KMT2Ar rearrangement. Full-year 2025 revenue was $67.5M (largely milestone and licensing revenue) plus $2.1M net product revenue from approximately five weeks of commercial sales. Pipeline includes next-generation FTI darlifarnib (KO-2806) for solid tumors.

sources.title: Kura Oncology Q4 and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 临床阶段生物技术公司，专注靶向蛋白降解（TPD），利用自有Pegasus平台开发IRAK4、STAT6、TYK2等靶点的小分子降解剂，主要布局炎症/免疫及血液肿瘤领域。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage biotech pioneering targeted protein degradation (TPD) via its Pegasus platform; lead programs include IRAK4 degrader KT-474 (with Sanofi) in atopic dermatitis and a STAT6 program; collaborations with Sanofi and Gilead.

sources.title: Kymera Therapeutics Q4 and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 专注药物发现技术授权与版权收益的生物制药公司，通过Captisol平台技术（磺丁基醚-β-环糊精）及广泛的版权组合（逾200个合作项目）获得特许权使用费收入，为资产轻型商业模式。
companies.description_en: Asset-light biopharma royalty and licensing company; generates revenue from royalties on partner-marketed drugs and Captisol excipient sales; portfolio spans >200 programs; key royalty drivers include Kyprolis, Evomela, and Rylaze.

sources.title: Ligand Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 临床阶段细胞替代疗法公司，主要项目包括与罗氏/基因泰克合作开发的OpRegen（视网膜色素上皮细胞疗法，用于地图状萎缩/AMD）和OPC1（脊髓损伤寡树突胶质细胞前体疗法）。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage cell replacement therapy company; lead programs OpRegen (RPE therapy for geographic atrophy, partnered with Roche/Genentech, Phase 2a) and OPC1 (OPC therapy for spinal cord injury, Phase 1/2a); additional programs ReSonance and PNC1.

sources.title: Lineage Cell Therapeutics Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 专注代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH）的生物制药公司；Rezdiffra（resmetirom，甲状腺激素受体β激动剂）于2024年3月获FDA批准用于MASH伴显著肝纤维化，2025年全年销售额近10亿美元。
companies.description_en: Biopharmaceutical company focused on MASH (non-alcoholic steatohepatitis); Rezdiffra (resmetirom), the first FDA-approved therapy for MASH with significant fibrosis, generated $958M in net sales in its first full commercial year (2025); blockbuster trajectory.

sources.title: Madrigal Pharmaceuticals Reports Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 加拿大特药公司，产品组合覆盖血友病B（IXINITY®）、造血干细胞移植预处理（GRAFAPEX™/treosulfan，2025年1月获FDA批准）、神经胶质瘤手术光学成像（Gleolan）及辅助生殖领域。
companies.description_en: Canadian specialty pharmaceutical company; commercial portfolio includes IXINITY (factor IX for hemophilia B), GRAFAPEX (treosulfan for HSCT conditioning, FDA-approved Jan 2025), and Gleolan (optical imaging for glioma surgery); also markets products in Canada and the US via Medexus Pharma divisions.

sources.title: Medexus Announces Strong Fiscal Year 2025 Results

companies.sub_sector: Specialty pharma; hematology, oncology, rheumatology, autoimmune, rare disease

companies.description_zh: 临床阶段生物技术公司，基于IL-2、IL-4和IL-13超激肽（Superkine）平台开发肿瘤免疫与炎症疗法；主要项目MDNA11（IL-2超激肽，Phase 1/2 ABILITY-1研究治疗晚期实体瘤，与KEYTRUDA联用）及MDNA55（bizaxofusp，治疗胶质母细胞瘤）。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage biotech developing IL-2/IL-4/IL-13 Superkines and BiSKITs for cancer and autoimmune diseases; lead program MDNA11 (IL-2 superkine) in Phase 1/2 ABILITY-1 trial for advanced solid tumors (±pembrolizumab); MDNA55 targeting glioblastoma.

sources.title: Medicenna Therapeutics Reports Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.sub_sector: Clinical-stage immunotherapy; IL-2/IL-4/IL-13 Superkines for oncology and inflammation

companies.description_zh: 加拿大小型专科制药公司，主要商品化产品包括AGGRASTAT®（替罗非班，GP IIb/IIIa受体拮抗剂，用于急性冠脉综合征）、ZYPITAMAG及三家美国零售药房（Marley Drug、Gateway、West Olympia）；PNPO缺乏症药物MC-1处于临床开发中。
companies.description_en: Small Canadian specialty pharma; commercial products include AGGRASTAT (tirofiban, ACS/unstable angina), ZYPITAMAG, and revenues from three US pharmacies; clinical pipeline includes MC-1 for pyridox(am)ine 5'-phosphate oxidase (PNPO) deficiency.

sources.title: Medicure Reports Financial Results for the Year Ended December 31, 2025
Medicure Financial Results Quarter and Year Ended December 31, 2024

companies.description_zh: 全球科学驱动型合同研究组织（CRO），提供Phase I-IV全流程临床开发服务，主要服务生物技术、制药和医疗器械企业；2025年收入25.3亿美元，同比增长约20%。
companies.description_en: Scientifically-driven, global full-service CRO providing Phase I-IV clinical development services to biotech, pharma and medical device industries; 2025 revenue of $2.53B (+20% YoY); headquarters in Cincinnati with global operations.
