companies.description_zh: 临床阶段生物技术公司，专注BET（溴结构域和超末端）蛋白抑制剂。核心资产apabetalone（RVX-208）：首创口服选择性BET抑制剂，用于高风险心血管疾病合并2型糖尿病及低HDL-C患者；曾完成BETonMACE Phase III试验。微型市值公司，市值约2700万加元，仅约19名员工。
companies.description_en: Micro-cap clinical-stage biotech (Calgary, CA) developing apabetalone (RVX-208), first-in-class oral selective BET (bromodomain and extra-terminal) inhibitor for cardiovascular disease with type 2 diabetes and low HDL-C. Completed BETonMACE Phase 3 trial. Market cap ~C$27M; ~19 employees; revenues negligible. Also exploring COVID-19 sequelae. High-risk clinical-stage company.

companies.description_zh: 晚期临床肿瘤学公司，专注RAS驱动型癌症靶向治疗（RAS(ON)抑制剂），旗舰RAS/MAPK通路项目：daraxonrasib（多选择性RAS抑制剂）、elironrasib（KRAS G12C选择性）、zoldonrasib（KRAS G12D选择性）。2025年R&D支出9.873亿美元，员工883人（同比增65%）；现金19.3亿美元（截至2025年9月30日）；市值超300亿美元为管线高溢价定价。
companies.description_en: Late-stage clinical precision oncology company targeting RAS-addicted cancers with RAS(ON) inhibitors. Pipeline: daraxonrasib (multi-selective RAS inhibitor), elironrasib (KRAS G12C selective), zoldonrasib (KRAS G12D selective). FY2025 R&D expenses $987.3M; 883 employees (+65% YoY); cash $1.93B (Q3 2025); no product revenue yet; market cap ~$30.7B. Founded Oct 2014 by Mark Goldsmith, Kevan Shokat et al.

companies.description_zh: 节律制药是一家商业阶段的生物制药公司，专注于开发罕见神经内分泌疾病的疗法。其核心产品IMCIVREE（setmelanotide，MC4R激动剂）已获FDA批准用于多种遗传性肥胖症，2025年全球净产品收入达1.948亿美元。
companies.description_en: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on rare neuroendocrine diseases. Its lead product IMCIVREE (setmelanotide), an MC4R agonist, is FDA-approved for multiple genetic obesity conditions. FY2025 global net product revenue reached $194.8M. Pipeline includes bivamelagon for acquired hypothalamic obesity.

sources.title: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals Q4 & FY2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 里格尔制药是一家商业阶段的生物制药公司，总部位于南旧金山。核心产品包括TAVALISSE（fostamatinib，SYK抑制剂，用于慢性免疫血小板减少症）和REZLIDHIA（olutasidenib，IDH1抑制剂，用于复发/难治性AML）。2025年净产品销售额达2.32亿美元，同比增长60%。
companies.description_en: Rigel Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in South San Francisco. Key products include TAVALISSE (fostamatinib, SYK inhibitor for chronic ITP) and REZLIDHIA (olutasidenib, IDH1 inhibitor for relapsed/refractory AML). Net product sales reached $232M in 2025, up 60% YoY. FY2025 net income was $367M including ~$246M non-cash deferred tax benefit.

sources.title: Rigel Pharmaceuticals Q4 2025 Earnings Call Highlights

companies.description_zh: 罗伊万特科学是一家多元化生物技术公司，总部位于纽约，采用Vant子公司模式运营多条管线。旗下包括Immunovant（抗FcRn抗体batoclimab）等子公司。公司致力于开发免疫学、罕见病领域的创新药物，财年截至3月31日，2025财年非GAAP研发费用达5.08亿美元。
companies.description_en: Roivant Sciences is a diversified biopharmaceutical company headquartered in New York operating through specialized 'Vant' subsidiaries. Key pipeline includes Immunovant's anti-FcRn antibody batoclimab for IgG-mediated diseases, Kiniksa therapeutics, and mosliciguat. Non-GAAP R&D spend was $508M for FY ended March 31, 2025. Market cap ~$20B reflects pipeline optionality.

sources.title: Roivant FY2025 Financial Results (year ended March 31, 2025)

companies.description_zh: 萨纳生物技术是一家临床阶段的细胞工程公司，总部位于西雅图，专注于工程化细胞疗法。主要候选产品SC451（低免疫原性胰岛细胞，用于1型糖尿病）和SG293（低免疫原性CAR-T，用于血液癌症）。2025年底现金1.384亿美元，净亏损2.44亿美元。
companies.description_en: Sana Biotechnology is a clinical-stage cell engineering company based in Seattle focused on engineering cells as medicines. Lead programs: SC451 (hypoimmune islet cells for T1D) and SG293 (hypoimmune CAR-T for blood cancers). As of Dec 31, 2025: cash $138.4M, net loss $244M. Total operating expenses ~$250M in 2025.

sources.title: Sana Biotechnology Q4 & FY2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 萨特洛斯生物科学是一家临床阶段的药物开发公司，专注于通过恢复自然肌肉修复来治疗肌肉退行性疾病。旗下主要候选药物SAT-3247为口服小分子，用于杜氏肌营养不良症（DMD）。公司为预收入阶段，2025年底现金2770万加元，2026年Q1通过股权融资后升至6990万加元。
companies.description_en: Satellos Bioscience is a clinical-stage drug development company focused on restoring natural muscle repair in degenerative muscle diseases. Lead candidate SAT-3247 is an oral small molecule for Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD). Pre-revenue; year-end 2025 cash C$27.7M, rising to C$69.9M after Q1 2026 equity offering.
companies.sub_sector: Clinical-stage; Duchenne muscular dystrophy; small-molecule muscle stem cell regeneration (SAT-3247)

companies.description_zh: 学者岩是一家临床阶段的生物制药公司，专注于开发针对脊髓性肌萎缩症（SMA）等严重神经肌肉疾病的创新疗法。核心产品apitegromab（肌肉生长抑制素激活抑制剂）已完成III期SAPPHIRE研究，达到主要终点，BLA已被FDA接受，预计2026年9月30日前获批决定。2025年底现金3.676亿美元。
companies.description_en: Scholar Rock is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on SMA and other severe neuromuscular diseases. Lead candidate apitegromab (myostatin activation inhibitor) met primary endpoint in Phase 3 SAPPHIRE study; BLA accepted by FDA with decision expected by September 30, 2026. Cash: $367.6M as of December 31, 2025. Secured $550M debt facility for commercialization.

sources.title: Scholar Rock Q4 & FY2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 西奈克斯是一家专注于严重真菌感染的生物制药公司，总部位于新泽西州泽西市。其核心抗真菌平台fungerps的首个药物ibrexafungerp已授权给葛兰素史克（GSK），商品名BREXAFEMME，已获FDA批准用于治疗和预防外阴阴道念珠菌病。2025年授权收入1.92亿美元，研发支出2230万美元，现金5630万美元。
companies.description_en: SCYNEXIS is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to antifungal innovation, headquartered in Jersey City, NJ. Its novel fungerp-class ibrexafungerp has been licensed to GSK (marketed as BREXAFEMME) and is FDA-approved for vulvovaginal candidiasis (VVC). Pipeline includes second-generation SCY-247. FY2025 revenue: $20.6M (primarily GSK license); R&D: $22.3M; cash: $56.3M.

companies.description_zh: 塞普特纳是一家生物技术公司，总部位于南旧金山，专注于GPCR靶向口服小分子药物开发，运用其专有天然复合物平台。管线包括SEP-786（PTH1R，用于甲状旁腺功能减退症）、SEP-631等。2025年收到诺和诺德1.95亿美元预付款和Vertex 1250万美元里程碑款，全年收入约2.075亿美元，研发支出9760万美元。
companies.description_en: Septerna is a South San Francisco-based biotech using its proprietary native complex platform to develop oral small-molecule GPCR-targeted medicines. Pipeline led by SEP-786 (PTH1R for hypoparathyroidism) and SEP-631 (MRGPRX2). Received $195M upfront from Novo Nordisk plus $12.5M milestone from Vertex in 2025. FY2025 revenue ~$207.5M; R&D $97.6M; runway into 2029.

companies.description_zh: SIGA技术是一家专注于生物防御和传染病的制药公司，总部位于纽约。核心产品TPOXX（tecovirimat）是全球领先的天花抗病毒药物，已获FDA、EMA等多个监管机构批准。2025年全年收入9460万美元（主要来自向美国战略国家储备交付口服和静脉注射TPOXX），较2024年下降32%。
companies.description_en: SIGA Technologies is a biodefense-focused pharmaceutical company headquartered in New York. Core product TPOXX (tecovirimat) is the leading antiviral approved for smallpox by FDA and EMA; also approved for monkeypox in some jurisdictions. FY2025 revenue: $94.6M (oral TPOXX $53M + IV TPOXX $26M to US Strategic National Stockpile + $6M international), down 32% YoY.

companies.description_zh: 斯佩克特医疗是一家加拿大晚期诊疗一体化公司，致力于治疗脓毒症和脓毒性休克。其核心产品Toraymyxin（PMX）是一种血液灌流设备，通过清除血流中的内毒素来治疗内毒素性脓毒性休克。III期Tigris确认性研究达到主要终点，正在申请美国FDA批准。2025财年收入约244万加元。
companies.description_en: Spectral Medical is a Canadian late-stage theranostic company advancing treatment for sepsis and septic shock. Its Toraymyxin (PMX) hemoperfusion device removes endotoxin from bloodstream. Phase 3 TIGRIS confirmatory study met prespecified primary endpoint (95.3% posterior probability of benefit, aOR 0.67 for 28-day mortality). Pursuing FDA approval. FY2025 revenue: C$2.44M.
companies.sub_sector: Theranostics; sepsis/septic shock; Toraymyxin (PMX) hemoperfusion device

companies.description_zh: Spyre 疗法是临床阶段生物技术公司，通过靶向 α4β7、TL1A 与 IL-23 的长半衰期抗体以及合理组合与剂量优化，开发新一代炎症性肠病（IBD）及免疫介导疾病疗法。其前身为罕见病壳公司 Aeglea BioTherapeutics，2023年11月收购私营 Spyre 后更名；2023年完成1.8亿美元以上私募融资。
companies.description_en: Spyre Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech developing next-generation inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and immune-mediated disease therapies via extended half-life antibodies targeting α4β7, TL1A and IL-23, plus rational combinations and dose optimization. It is the former rare-disease shell Aeglea BioTherapeutics, renamed in Nov 2023 after acquiring privately held Spyre; raised $180M+ in a 2023 private financing.

sources.title: Aeglea Announces Name Change to Spyre Therapeutics
Spyre raises $180m to advance IBD antibody pipeline

companies.description_zh: 斯托克治疗是一家生物技术公司，总部位于马萨诸塞州贝德福德，致力于通过RNA医学（TANGO技术平台）恢复蛋白质表达。核心管线zorevunersen（STK-001，ASO）是治疗Dravet综合征的潜在首创疾病修饰疗法，正处于III期EMPEROR研究中（与Biogen合作）。2025年收入1.844亿美元，主要来自Biogen合作里程碑款。
companies.description_en: Stoke Therapeutics is a Bedford, MA-based biotech using its TANGO (Targeted Augmentation of Nuclear Gene Output) RNA medicine platform to restore protein expression. Lead program zorevunersen (antisense oligonucleotide for Dravet syndrome) is in Phase 3 EMPEROR study in collaboration with Biogen ($165M upfront). FY2025 revenue: $184.4M (primarily Biogen milestones); R&D ~$138M.

companies.description_zh: 峰会治疗是一家肿瘤学生物制药公司，总部位于迈阿密。核心候选药物ivonescimab（SMT112）是一种PD-1/VEGF双特异性抗体，与中国Akeso合作授权。在中国III期肺癌试验中显示优于帕博利珠单抗的疗效，BLA已于2026年1月被FDA接受，PDUFA日期为2026年11月14日。市值约146亿美元，尚无产品收入。
companies.description_en: Summit Therapeutics is a clinical-stage oncology company headquartered in Miami, FL. Lead candidate ivonescimab (SMT112) is a first-in-class PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody licensed from China's Akeso. Demonstrated superiority over pembrolizumab in Chinese Phase 3 NSCLC trials. FDA accepted BLA in January 2026 with PDUFA date November 14, 2026. Market cap ~$14.6B; pre-revenue.

sources.title: Summit Therapeutics FDA BLA Acceptance for Ivonescimab

companies.description_zh: 超级制药是一家专注于中枢神经系统疾病的商业化生物制药公司，总部位于马里兰州罗克维尔。核心产品组合包括QELBREE（viloxazine，ADHD）、GOCOVRI（金刚烷胺，帕金森病运动波动）、ONAPGO（阿朴吗啡皮下给药，帕金森病，2025年4月获批上市）以及2025年7月收购Sage Therapeutics后新增的ZURZUVAE（brexanolone）等。2025年创纪录收入7.19亿美元，同比增长9%。
companies.description_en: Supernus Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage CNS-focused biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Rockville, MD. Portfolio: QELBREE (viloxazine for ADHD), GOCOVRI (amantadine for PD motor fluctuations), ONAPGO (apomorphine for PD, launched April 2025), and ZURZUVAE (acquired via Sage Therapeutics acquisition July 2025 for ~$561M). Record FY2025 revenue: $719M (+9% YoY); R&D: $106.2M.

sources.title: Supernus Pharmaceuticals Q4 & FY2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 探戈治疗是一家总部位于波士顿的临床阶段精准肿瘤学公司，利用CRISPR功能基因组学平台发现合成致死靶点。核心管线包括TNG462（MTA协同PRMT5抑制剂，针对MTAP缺失实体瘤）和TNG348（USP1抑制剂，针对DNA修复缺陷癌症）。2025年收入6240万美元，主要来自与吉利德的合作协议，年底现金3.43亿美元。
companies.description_en: Tango Therapeutics is a Boston-based clinical-stage precision oncology company using CRISPR-based functional genomics to identify synthetic lethal targets. Lead programs: TNG462 (MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor for MTAP-deleted tumors) and TNG348 (USP1 inhibitor for DNA-repair-deficient cancers). FY2025 revenue: $62.4M (primarily from Gilead collaboration); net loss: $101.6M; cash: $343M (runway into 2028).

sources.title: Tango Therapeutics Q4 & FY2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 望远镜创新是一家加拿大生命科学工具公司，总部位于温哥华，开发智能自动化和先进化学制造技术，包括灵活机器人平台和AI软件，用于提高实验通量、效率和数据质量。旗下产品DirectInject-LC™用于高通量化学分析，与辉瑞合作SDL（自驱式实验室）项目。2025财年（截至8月31日）收入580万加元，同比增长32%。
companies.description_en: Telescope Innovations is a Vancouver-based life science tools company developing intelligent automation and advanced chemical manufacturing technologies including flexible robotic platforms and AI software for pharmaceutical R&D. Products include DirectInject-LC for high-throughput analysis and self-driving lab (SDL) technology. Active partnership with Pfizer. FY2025 (year ended Aug 31, 2025) revenue: C$5.8M (+32% YoY).
companies.sub_sector: Chemical process automation and AI robotics for pharmaceutical manufacturing; Pfizer collaboration

companies.description_zh: 特纳亚治疗是一家临床阶段的生物技术公司，总部位于南旧金山，专注于心脏疾病基因治疗。核心候选药物TN-201（AAV基因治疗，针对MYBPC3相关肥厚型心肌病，HCM）和TN-401（AAV基因治疗，针对PKP2相关致心律失常性右心室心肌病，ARVC）正处于1b/2期临床试验阶段。2025年底现金5630万美元；2025年通过两轮公开募股筹得约1.125亿美元。
companies.description_en: Tenaya Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech in South San Francisco focused on gene therapies for heart disease. Lead programs: TN-201 (AAV gene therapy for MYBPC3-related HCM, Phase 1b/2) and TN-401 (AAV gene therapy for PKP2-related ARVC, Phase 1b/2). Pre-revenue; Q3 2025 cash $56.3M; raised ~$112.5M gross proceeds in two 2025 equity offerings.

companies.description_zh: 汀斯制药是一家临床阶段的生物制药公司，总部位于加利福尼亚州福斯特城，专注于开发肿瘤学和代谢病领域的小分子候选药物。管线包括TERN-501（THR-β激动剂，MASH/肥胖症）、TERN-601（口服GLP-1R激动剂，肥胖症，I期数据积极）以及BCR-ABL等肿瘤学项目。2025年市值约43亿美元（已于2026年被默克收购）。
companies.description_en: Terns Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in Foster City, CA developing small-molecule candidates for oncology and metabolic diseases. Pipeline: TERN-501 (THR-β agonist for MASH/obesity), TERN-601 (oral GLP-1R agonist for obesity with positive Phase 1 data), and an allosteric BCR-ABL inhibitor for oncology. Pre-revenue; market cap ~$4.3B at December 2025. Company was acquired by Merck.

companies.description_zh: TG生物制药专注于B细胞恶性肿瘤和自身免疫疾病的治疗药物开发与商业化，旗舰产品BRIUMVI（乌布妥昔单抗）已获FDA批准用于复发型多发性硬化症。
companies.description_en: TG Therapeutics acquires, develops, and commercializes novel treatments for B-cell malignancies and autoimmune diseases. Its flagship product BRIUMVI (ublituximab), an anti-CD20 glycoengineered monoclonal antibody, is FDA-approved for relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis and generated $594M US net revenue in 2025.

sources.title: TG Therapeutics Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: Travere Therapeutics（前身为Retrophin）专注于罕见肾脏和代谢疾病，旗舰产品FILSPARI（sparsentan）是首个获FDA完全批准的IgA肾病和FSGS治疗药物，2025年美国净销售额达3.22亿美元。
companies.description_en: Travere Therapeutics (formerly Retrophin) identifies, develops, and delivers therapies for rare kidney and metabolic diseases. Its flagship FILSPARI (sparsentan), the first dual endothelin/angiotensin receptor antagonist, achieved FDA full approval for both IgAN and FSGS. 2025 total net product sales reached $410M.

sources.title: Travere Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results
FILSPARI Full FDA Approval for FSGS

companies.description_zh: Twist生物科学是合成生物学和DNA合成领域的领先企业，利用硅基制造平台提供高通量合成DNA，服务于基因组学研究、抗体文库开发和数字数据存储等应用领域。2025财年（截至9月30日）实现营收3.77亿美元，同比增长20%。
companies.description_en: Twist Bioscience is a leading synthetic biology company using semiconductor-based DNA synthesis technology to produce high-throughput, high-fidelity synthetic DNA. Products serve genomics research, antibody libraries, gene synthesis, and data storage. Fiscal 2025 (ended Sep 30) revenue of $376.6M, +20% YoY, with 50.7% gross margin.

sources.title: Twist Bioscience FY2025 Full Year Results Press Release
Twist Bioscience Fiscal 2025 Q4 & Full Year Results

companies.description_zh: Tyra生物科学是临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于FGFR生物学领域的精准医学，利用SNÅP平台开发下一代选择性FGFR3抑制剂。核心产品dabogratinib（TYRA-300）正在多项Phase 2临床试验中评估用于尿路上皮癌、膀胱癌及软骨发育不全。
companies.description_en: Tyra Biosciences is a clinical-stage precision oncology company using its SNÅP platform to develop next-generation FGFR3-selective inhibitors. Lead candidate dabogratinib (TYRA-300) is in Phase 2 trials for low-grade upper tract urothelial carcinoma (LG-UTUC), non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (IR NMIBC), and achondroplasia.

sources.title: Tyra Biosciences Q4 & Full Year 2025 Results

companies.description_zh: Ultragenyx制药专注于罕见和超罕见遗传疾病的新型疗法研发与商业化。主要产品包括Crysvita（burosumab，X连锁低磷酸血症）、Dojolvi（triheptanoin）和Evkeeza。2025年总营收6.73亿美元，同比增长20%，并积极推进基因疗法管线。
companies.description_en: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical is a biopharmaceutical company committed to developing novel products for rare and ultra-rare genetic diseases, founded by Dr. Emil Kakkis. Commercial portfolio includes Crysvita (burosumab, XLH), Dojolvi (LC-FAOD), and Evkeeza. FY2025 total revenue of $673M (+20% YoY); gene therapy pipeline targets Angelman syndrome and other rare conditions.

sources.title: Ultragenyx Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: Vaxcyte（原SutroVax）是临床阶段疫苗开发公司，专注于新一代肺炎球菌结合疫苗（PCV）。核心候选产品VAX-31（31价PCV）处于临床开发阶段，有望超越现有市售PCV覆盖更广泛的血清型。截至2025年9月，公司持有约27亿美元现金。
companies.description_en: Vaxcyte (formerly SutroVax) is a clinical-stage vaccine company focused on next-generation pneumococcal conjugate vaccines (PCVs) with broader serotype coverage than marketed products. Lead candidate VAX-31 is a 31-valent PCV in clinical development. The company had ~$2.7B in cash as of Q3 2025, with no commercial revenue.

companies.description_zh: Vector Science and Therapeutics是早期阶段公司，开发基于Smart-Steered-Sustained框架的新型生物力学装置和主动局部给药平台，主要应用于肌肉骨骼组织再生领域。公司于2026年4月在TSX创业板以PAIN为代码上市，总部实际运营位于美国威斯康星州Mequon。
companies.description_en: Vector Science and Therapeutics develops novel biomechanical devices and active localized drug delivery platforms under its Smart, Steered, and Sustained framework for site-directed interventions in musculoskeletal tissue regeneration. Listed on TSXV in April 2026 under symbol PAIN. Early-stage with minimal revenue; cash ~US$2.9M as of August 2025.

companies.description_zh: Veeva Systems是全球领先的生命科学行业云计算软件解决方案提供商，产品涵盖商业云（CRM/合规）和研发云（临床、监管、质量）。2025财年（截至2025年1月31日）总营收27.47亿美元，同比增长16%，订阅服务营收22.85亿美元，同比增长20%。
companies.description_en: Veeva Systems is the global leading provider of cloud-based software solutions for the life sciences industry, serving commercial (CRM, medical, compliance) and R&D (clinical, regulatory, quality) functions. FY2025 (ended Jan 31, 2025) total revenues of $2,746.6M (+16% YoY), subscription revenues of $2,284.7M (+20% YoY). 7,291 employees.

companies.description_zh: Veracyte是全球癌症基因组诊断公司，通过宽幅基因组和AI技术提供高性能癌症检测产品，主要测试包括Decipher Prostate（前列腺癌）、Afirma（甲状腺癌）、Prosigna（乳腺癌）和Decipher Bladder。2025年总营收5.17亿美元，同比增长16%。
companies.description_en: Veracyte is a global cancer diagnostics company delivering genomic tests powered by broad genomic data and AI. Key tests: Decipher Prostate, Afirma (thyroid), Prosigna (breast), and Decipher Bladder. FY2025 total revenue of $517.1M (+16% YoY), testing revenue of $493.2M (+18%), with 755 employees as of Dec 31, 2025.

sources.title: Veracyte Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.name_en: Verve Therapeutics, Inc. (acquired by Eli Lilly, July 2025)
companies.description_zh: Verve Therapeutics是心血管基因编辑先驱，专注通过体内基因编辑实现一次治疗终身获益的心血管疾病防治。礼来制药于2025年7月以约10亿美元（最高达13亿美元）完成对Verve的全面收购，核心资产为PCSK9靶向基因编辑候选药VERVE-102。
companies.description_en: Verve Therapeutics pioneered in vivo gene editing for cardiovascular disease prevention with a single-course treatment approach. Founded in 2018 by Dr. Sekar Kathiresan. Eli Lilly completed the acquisition of Verve Therapeutics in July 2025 for ~$1B ($10.50/share, 113% premium), acquiring the base editing PCSK9-targeting program VERVE-102 in Phase Ib.

sources.title: Eli Lilly Completes Acquisition of Verve Therapeutics
Eli Lilly to Acquire Verve Therapeutics for $1 Billion

companies.description_zh: 辉致制药由Mylan与辉瑞旗下Upjohn部门于2020年11月合并成立，是全球最大的仿制药和专利药混合型制药集团之一，每年向全球约10亿患者供应高质量药品。2025年总营收143亿美元，持续推进品牌仿制药组合优化及复杂创新药管线建设。
companies.description_en: Viatris was formed in November 2020 from the merger of Mylan and Pfizer's Upjohn division, bridging generics and brands at global scale. Supplies medicines to ~1 billion patients annually. FY2025 total revenues of $14.3B; executing portfolio transformation with divestitures, complex generics, and biosimilars while building an innovative pipeline. ~32,000 employees (2024).

sources.title: Viatris Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: Viking Therapeutics专注代谢和内分泌疾病治疗药物开发，核心候选产品VK2735是GLP-1/GIP双受体激动剂，用于肥胖症治疗，Phase 3 VANQUISH试验（皮下注射）已完成入组。公司年末现金达7.06亿美元，2025年净亏损3.585亿美元。
companies.description_en: Viking Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapies for metabolic and endocrine disorders. Lead asset VK2735, a long-acting GLP-1/GIP dual agonist for obesity, is in Phase 3 VANQUISH trials. Year-end 2025 cash of $706M; net loss $358.5M. A novel amylin agonist program is also advancing toward IND.

sources.title: Viking Therapeutics Q4 & Year-End 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: Vir生物技术是专注传染病防治的生物技术公司，开发单克隆抗体、疫苗及抗病毒疗法。核心研究方向包括乙肝（HBV）、慢性丁肝（HDV，tobevibart+elebsiran组合）和肿瘤学。2025年全年营收6407万美元，与Norgine签署乙肝许可协议后现金跑道延伸至2027年Q4。
companies.description_en: Vir Biotechnology is focused on developing therapies to prevent and treat infectious diseases using monoclonal antibodies, vaccines, and antiviral approaches. Key programs target hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis delta (HDV, tobevibart + elebsiran combination showed 88% undetectable HDV RNA at 96 weeks), HIV, and oncology. FY2025 revenue $64.1M; cash ~$781M.

sources.title: Vir Biotechnology Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: Vor Biopharma于2025年完成战略转型，从干细胞工程癌症疗法转向自身免疫疾病，以1.75亿美元融资取得RemeGen公司telitacicept（BAFF/APRIL双靶点融合蛋白）的独家授权，聚焦重症肌无力等自身免疫疾病。
companies.description_en: Vor Biopharma underwent a major strategic pivot in 2025, transitioning from engineered hematopoietic stem cell cancer therapies to autoimmune diseases. The company in-licensed telitacicept (a BAFF/APRIL dual inhibitor fusion protein) from RemeGen with $175M in financing, targeting myasthenia gravis and other autoimmune conditions.

sources.title: Vor Bio Reinvents Itself as Autoimmune Biotech with Telitacicept
Vor with New CEO Changes Course to Target Autoimmune Disease

companies.description_zh: Wave生命科学是临床阶段RNA医药公司，通过PRISM平台结合立体化学创新和多模态（RNA编辑、基因沉默、剪接调控）开发RNA药物，核心项目WVE-006（GalNAc偶联RNA编辑寡核苷酸）是全球首个进入人体临床的RNA编辑候选药，靶向甲1-抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症。
companies.description_en: Wave Life Sciences is a clinical-stage RNA medicines company using its PRISM platform across RNA editing, gene silencing, and splicing. WVE-006 (GalNAc RNA editing oligonucleotide for alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency) achieved first-ever therapeutic RNA editing in humans. FY2025 revenue $42.7M (down from $108.3M in 2024 on collaboration changes); cash $602.1M through Q3 2028.

sources.title: Wave Life Sciences Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results
Wave Life Sciences Achieves First RNA Editing in Humans

companies.description_zh: Werewolf Therapeutics是肿瘤免疫治疗公司，开发基于PREDATOR条件激活技术的INDUKINE（IL-2/IL-12）和INDUCER（T细胞接合器）平台候选药物，包括WTX-124和WTX-330。公司于2026年2月启动战略替代方案探索（含出售/合并），并削减约64%员工，存在持续经营风险。
companies.description_en: Werewolf Therapeutics uses its PREDATOR conditionally activated technology to engineer immunotherapy candidates: INDUKINE (IL-2/IL-12, tumor microenvironment-restricted) candidates WTX-124 and WTX-330, plus INDUCER T-cell engagers WTX-1011 (STEAP1) and WTX-2022 (CDH6). In February 2026 announced strategic alternatives review and ~64% workforce reduction. Going-concern risk noted.

sources.title: Werewolf Therapeutics Announces Strategic Alternatives Review

companies.description_zh: Xenon制药是加拿大神经科学公司，专注离子通道科学，尤其是钾通道（Kv7）和钠通道调节剂的开发。核心候选产品azetukalner是高效选择性Kv7钾通道开放剂，正在进行多项Phase 3临床试验，适应症包括局灶性癫痫、全身性强直-阵挛性癫痫、重性抑郁障碍和双相抑郁。
companies.description_en: Xenon Pharmaceuticals is a Canadian neuroscience company leveraging its ion channel expertise (Kv7 potassium and sodium channels) to develop precision medicines for epilepsy and neuropsychiatry. Lead candidate azetukalner (Kv7 opener) is in multiple Phase 3 trials: focal onset seizures (FOS), PGTCS, major depressive disorder (MDD), and bipolar depression. Cash $1.34B as of Q1 2025; 2025 revenue $7.5M (collaboration).

sources.title: Xenon Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: XORTX Therapeutics是临床阶段加拿大制药公司，专注通过靶向嘌呤代谢异常和黄嘌呤氧化酶来开发痛风及慢性进展性肾病创新疗法。核心产品XRx-026（XORLO™制剂）正加速推进痛风NDA申请，黄嘌呤氧化酶抑制率超90%，已在700余名患者中完成多项试验。
companies.description_en: XORTX Therapeutics is a clinical-stage Canadian pharmaceutical company targeting aberrant purine metabolism and xanthine oxidase to develop therapies for gout and progressive kidney disease. Lead program XRx-026 (XORLO formulation) is being accelerated toward NDA filing for gout, having achieved >90% xanthine oxidase inhibition in over 700 patients. Micro-cap with ~3 employees; market cap <$1M.

companies.description_zh: 曾塔利斯制药是一家临床阶段的肿瘤生物制药公司，专注于开发靶向WEE1的小分子抑制剂azenosertib（ZN-c3），用于铂耐药卵巢癌及其他肿瘤的治疗；正处于3期临床试验阶段。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage oncology biopharmaceutical company focused on developing small molecule cancer therapeutics. Lead asset azenosertib (ZN-c3) is a WEE1 inhibitor in Phase 3 trials for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer and other solid tumors. Founded December 2014 in San Diego, CA.

companies.description_zh: 安特里斯技术是一家结构性心脏病医疗器械公司，总部位于澳大利亚布里斯班，在美国明尼阿波利斯设有运营中心。旗舰产品DurAVR®是全球首款仿生单片式经导管主动脉瓣（TAVR），采用专有ADAPT抗钙化组织技术，用于治疗严重主动脉瓣狭窄。
companies.description_en: Structural heart medical device company headquartered in Brisbane, Australia, with US operations in Minneapolis. Flagship product DurAVR® is the world's first single-piece biomimetic transcatheter heart valve (TAVR) using proprietary ADAPT anti-calcification tissue technology to treat severe aortic stenosis.

companies.description_zh: 爱威塔医疗是一家再生医学公司，商业化运营RECELL®系统——一种自体细胞采集器械，用于治疗热烧伤创面、全层皮肤缺损及白癜风色素再生。RECELL使用极少量患者自身皮肤样本，30分钟内制备Spray-On Skin™喷雾细胞悬液，供皮肤修复使用。公司在美国、日本、欧盟及澳大利亚开展商业化。
companies.description_en: Regenerative medicine company commercializing the RECELL® System, an autologous cell harvesting device for thermal burn wounds, full-thickness skin defects, and vitiligo repigmentation. RECELL uses a small skin sample to prepare Spray-On Skin™ cells within 30 minutes. Incorporated in Australia (1992); current corporate headquarters in Valencia, CA. Listed on ASX (AVH) and NASDAQ (RCEL).

sources.title: AVITA Medical Q4 & Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 克拉瑞提制药是一家临床阶段的放射性药物公司，基于专有的SAR技术平台，利用铜同位素配对（Cu-64诊断/Cu-67治疗）开发次世代theranostics产品，主要针对前列腺癌、神经母细胞瘤、乳腺癌等适应症。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company developing next-generation theranostic products using proprietary SAR Technology platform based on copper isotope pairings (Cu-64 imaging / Cu-67 therapy). Lead programs include SAR-bisPSMA for prostate cancer and SAR-Bombesin for multiple tumor types. Incorporated 2010, Sydney, Australia.

companies.description_zh: 克利纽维尔制药专注于开发治疗遗传性、代谢性及危及生命疾病的药物。旗舰产品SCENESSE®（afamelanotide 16mg皮下植入剂）已在美国（FDA 2019年批准）和欧盟（EMA 2014年批准）上市，用于预防成人红细胞生成性原卟啉症（EPP）患者的光毒性反应，是全球唯一获批治疗EPP的药物。
companies.description_en: Biopharmaceutical company developing treatments for genetic, metabolic, and life-threatening disorders. Flagship SCENESSE® (afamelanotide 16 mg implant) is the world's only approved treatment for erythropoietic protoporphyria (EPP), approved by FDA (2019) and EMA (2014). FY2025 revenue A$105.3M; eighth consecutive annual dividend declared. Pipeline includes PRÉNUMBRA and CUV9900.

sources.title: Clinuvel Pharmaceuticals Form DRS FY2025 – SEC EDGAR

companies.description_zh: 科利耳是全球领先的可植入听觉解决方案制造商，成立于1981年并于1995年在ASX上市。总部位于澳大利亚悉尼麦考瑞大学校园。产品组合涵盖Nucleus®人工耳蜗系统、Baha®骨导植入系统及Hybrid电声联合植入系统，在全球逾180个国家销售，市场份额约60%。
companies.description_en: World's leading manufacturer of implantable hearing solutions. Founded 1981 (commercializing Graeme Clark's research), headquartered at Macquarie University campus, Sydney. Products: Nucleus® cochlear implants, Baha® bone conduction systems, Hybrid electro-acoustic implants. FY2025 revenue A$2.36B (+4.8%); ~60% global cochlear implant market share; operations in 180+ countries.

companies.description_zh: 赛克洛法姆是一家放射性药物公司，专注于肺健康领域，核心产品Technegas®是用于肺通气显像（肺栓塞诊断）的功能性肺成像产品。Technegas已获FDA批准（2023年），美国市场处于快速放量阶段，2025年美国收入同比增长226%。
companies.description_en: Radiopharmaceutical company specializing in lung health. Core product Technegas® (Technetium-99m carbon-Technegas) is the world's leading functional lung ventilation imaging agent for pulmonary embolism diagnosis. FDA approved in 2023, driving accelerating US uptake. FY2025 record operating revenue ~A$30.7M (+17% YoY). Headquartered at Kingsgrove NSW.

sources.title: Cyclopharm delivers record revenue as US emerges as growth engine – Biotech Dispatch

companies.description_zh: 戴默里克斯是一家生物制药公司，专注于炎症性肾脏和呼吸系统疾病。核心候选药物DMX-200（repagermanium，CCR2抑制剂）用于治疗局灶节段性肾小球硬化症（FSGS），已完成3期临床试验（ACTION3）招募，并获FDA和EMA孤儿药认定。Amicus Therapeutics以3000万美元取得该药合作开发权。
companies.description_en: Biopharmaceutical company developing treatments for inflammatory kidney and respiratory diseases. Lead asset DMX-200 (repagermanium, CCR2 inhibitor) is in Phase 3 (ACTION3) for focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS), with Orphan Drug Designation from FDA and EMA. Amicus Therapeutics acquired rights for $30M upfront. FY2025 revenue A$5.59M (+1271% YoY, reflecting milestone payments). HQ in Fitzroy, Melbourne.

sources.title: Dimerix Appendix 4E and 2025 Annual Report – Listcorp

companies.description_zh: EBOS集团是澳大利亚和新西兰最大的医疗保健产品分销及服务商，业务涵盖药品批发（TerryWhite Chemmart药店网络）、医疗器械分销及动物保健品分销。公司1922年创立于新西兰，2013年在ASX上市，同时在NZX双重挂牌。
companies.description_en: Largest healthcare products marketer, wholesaler, and distributor in Australia and New Zealand. Operations span pharmaceutical wholesaling (TerryWhite Chemmart pharmacy network), medical device distribution, and animal care products. Founded 1922 in Christchurch NZ as Early Brothers Trading; dual listed ASX/NZX since 2013. FY2025 revenue A$12.27B.

companies.description_zh: EBR系统是一家专注于无线心脏起搏领域的医疗器械公司，总部位于美国加利福尼亚州森尼维尔，以ASX挂牌。旗舰产品WiSE®系统是全球唯一的无线心内膜左心室起搏系统，无需传统起搏导线，采用超声波能量传输技术驱动心脏内极小的起搏器植入体（约米粒大小）。
companies.description_en: Medical device company developing wireless cardiac pacing solutions. Core product WiSE® System is the world's only wireless endocardial left ventricular pacing system, eliminating LV pacing leads via ultrasound energy transfer to a rice-grain-sized implant. Founded 2003, Sunnyvale CA; ASX-listed (IPO 2021). FY2025 revenue US$1.6M; net loss US$48.8M reflecting aggressive commercialization spend.

sources.title: EBR Systems Q4 FY2025 Financial and Operational Highlights – TradingView

companies.description_zh: 埃米里亚是一家整合临床药物开发与治疗服务的公司，专注于迷幻辅助疗法（MDMA、氯胺酮、裸盖菇素/psilocybin）用于PTSD、焦虑障碍等难治性精神健康疾病。公司在珀斯设有Empax临床中心，并与西澳大学合作开展全球最大MDMA类似物库研究。
companies.description_en: Integrated clinical drug development and care delivery company focused on psychedelic-assisted therapies (MDMA, ketamine, psilocybin) for PTSD and other treatment-resistant mental health conditions. Operates Empax clinic in Perth; collaborates with University of Western Australia on MDMA analogue library. FY2025 revenue A$1.39M. Founded March 2018, HQ in Leederville, Perth WA.

companies.description_zh: 希利斯是澳大利亚领先的医学病理及诊断服务提供商，通过Laverty Pathology、Dorevitch Pathology、QML Pathology等品牌运营逾100个医学实验室和2000个患者采集中心。2025年完成以9.65亿澳元出售Lumus影像业务，专注于病理学核心业务。
companies.description_en: Australia's leading medical diagnostics and pathology provider, operating 100+ medical laboratories and 2,000+ patient collection centres under brands including Laverty Pathology, Dorevitch Pathology, and QML Pathology. In 2025 divested Lumus Imaging for A$965M to concentrate on pathology. FY2025 revenue A$1.34B. Founded 1994, HQ Sydney.

companies.description_zh: 伊缪金是一家临床阶段免疫肿瘤学公司，开发多种新型免疫疗法，核心管线包括：azer-cel（azercabtagene zapreleucel，靶向CD19的同种异体CAR-T细胞疗法，用于淋巴瘤/白血病，2025年获FDA快速通道认定，ORR 82%）和CF33 VAXINIA（溶瘤病毒，1期临床）。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage immuno-oncology company developing immunotherapies for cancer. Key programs: azer-cel (azercabtagene zapreleucel), an off-the-shelf allogeneic CD19-targeting CAR-T in Phase 1 for lymphoma/leukemia (82% response rate, FDA Fast Track June 2026); and CF33 VAXINIA oncolytic virus in Phase 1 for solid tumors. HER-VAXX completed Phase 2. Founded 1986 (incorporated May 30, 1986), Sydney.

companies.description_zh: 纳诺声学是一家感染预防公司，核心产品Trophon®系列设备实现超声探头自动高水平消毒，全球安装量超3.7万台（截至2025年6月）。2025年推出Coris®新型医疗器械再处理平台，并获FDA许可。FY2025总收入A$1.987亿（+17%），现金余额A$1.616亿，零负债。
companies.description_en: Infection prevention company specializing in automated high-level disinfection of ultrasound probes (Trophon® platform). 37,000+ Trophon units installed globally as of June 2025. New Coris® instrument reprocessing platform launched with FDA clearance. FY2025 total revenue A$198.6M (+17%); EBIT +95% to A$17.8M; A$161.6M cash, zero debt. Founded 2001, Sydney NSW.

companies.description_zh: 纽伦制药专注于罕见神经发育障碍领域。旗舰产品trofinetide（品牌名DAYBUE™）由合作方Acadia Pharmaceuticals在美国商业化，是首个也是唯一获FDA批准用于瑞特综合征（Rett syndrome）的治疗药物（2023年批准）。Neuren通过版权收入分成获益。2025年版权收入A$6500万（+15%），净利润A$3000万，现金储备A$2.96亿。管线候选NNZ-2591正在推进3期。
companies.description_en: Biopharmaceutical company focused on rare neurodevelopmental disorders. Lead asset trofinetide (DAYBUE™) commercialized by Acadia Pharmaceuticals is the first and only FDA-approved treatment for Rett syndrome (approved March 2023). Neuren receives royalties: FY2025 A$65M (+15%), net profit A$30M, cash A$296M. Pipeline NNZ-2591 in Phase 3 for Phelan-McDermid syndrome. Founded 2001, Melbourne.

sources.title: Neuren Pharmaceuticals 2025 Royalty Income A$65M – Neuren IR

companies.description_zh: 奥普提亚是一家临床阶段生物制药公司，曾开发针对VEGF-C/D的融合蛋白sozinibercept（OPT-302）用于湿性年龄相关性黄斑变性（wAMD）。2025年4月，COAST和ShORe两项3期临床试验因未达主要终点而终止，公司随后裁员约85%。目前探索在淋巴管平滑肌瘤病（LAM）等罕见疾病领域的应用机会。
companies.description_en: Clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. Previously advanced sozinibercept (OPT-302), a VEGF-C/D trap fusion protein, through two pivotal Phase 3 trials (COAST and ShORe) for wet AMD. Both trials failed primary endpoints in early 2025; company subsequently laid off ~85% of workforce. Currently pursuing sozinibercept in rare disease indications including LAM. Incorporated 1984 as Circadian Technologies; renamed Opthea 2015. Market cap heavily impacted post-trial failure.

sources.title: Opthea Full-Year Financial Results and Business Updates – IR
Opthea ramps up layoffs to 85% – FierceBiotech

companies.description_zh: 范式生物制药是一家晚期候选药物开发公司，核心资产为Zilosul（注射用戊糖多硫酸钠，iPPS），用于治疗膝关节骨关节炎，已进入3期全球临床试验，并已获FDA快速通道认定。此外亦开发该分子在黏多糖贮积症、罗斯河病毒感染等适应症的应用。
companies.description_en: Late-stage drug development company. Lead candidate Zilosul (injectable pentosan polysulfate sodium, iPPS) is in a global Phase 3 trial for knee osteoarthritis (27 clinical sites initiated in Australia and US by FY2025 end); FDA Fast Track Designation granted. Pipeline also covers mucopolysaccharidosis, Ross River virus, and alphaviral arthritis. Founded/incorporated 2014, ASX-listed 2015, HQ Melbourne.

companies.description_zh: 台湾体外诊断公司，拥有自主研发的条码磁珠（BMB）多重检测平台技术，生产多重PCR及免疫检测试剂盒，适用于传染病和其他疾病诊断，产品销往美国、欧洲和亚洲。2017年IPO上市，目前仍处于亏损阶段。
companies.description_en: Taiwan-based in vitro diagnostics company with proprietary Barcoded Magnetic Bead (BMB) multiplex detection platform enabling highly multiplexed molecular and immunoassays. Products include optical analyzers, IVD reagents, and diagnostic kits targeting the USD 52B IVD market. Sales in US, Europe, and Asia. Listed TWSE February 2017. Currently pre-profitability; EBITDA approximately -107M TWD.

companies.description_zh: 韩国春川市生物技术公司，专注SAFA™平台（抗血清白蛋白Fab技术）开发长效抗体和蛋白药物；管线聚焦罕见病、癌症、男性不育、自身免疫及炎症性疾病；2024年6月与Evommune就IL-18靶向融合蛋白达成全球授权协议。2022年7月KOSDAQ上市。
companies.description_en: South Korea biotech based in Chuncheon, developing biobetter and antibody biologics via proprietary SAFA™ (anti-Serum Albumin Fab Associated) platform for long-acting antibody and protein drugs. Pipeline targets rare diseases, cancer, male infertility, autoimmune, and inflammatory diseases. June 2024: worldwide license agreement with Evommune Inc. for IL-18-targeted fusion protein. KOSDAQ IPO July 2022.

sources.title: AprilBio Co.,Ltd. (397030.KQ) Company Profile – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 韩国城南市适体技术平台生物风险企业，专注于癌症和神经疾病治疗与诊断，核心平台：AlloMAp、双功能适体（BiFAp）治疗平台，及Aptodetect-lung（早期肺癌液态活检诊断）；2024年3月向韩国食品药品安全处提交AST-201的I期IND申请。
companies.description_en: South Korea-based biotech founded 2011 in Seongnam. Proprietary aptamer discovery and optimization platforms for cancer and neurological disorders. Key programs: AlloMAp platform, BiFAp (Bi-Functional Aptamer) therapeutics platform, Aptodetect-lung (early lung cancer liquid biopsy diagnostic). March 2024: IND filed for AST-201 Phase 1 with Korean MFDS. Micro-cap clinical-stage company.

sources.title: Aptamer Sciences Inc (KOSDAQ:291650) Stock Price & Overview

companies.name_zh: 阿斯利康制药印度有限公司
companies.description_zh: 阿斯利康英国旗下印度上市子公司（75%控股），从事药品制造、分销和营销，主攻心肾代谢、肿瘤、呼吸和免疫领域，代表品牌包括Symbicort、Fasenra及多个肿瘤药物。FY2025创纪录收入171.6亿卢比，同比增长32%。同时在印度开展临床试验服务。
companies.description_en: India-listed subsidiary of AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals AB (75% stake). Manufactures, distributes, and markets pharmaceutical products with focus on cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, oncology, respiratory, and immunological conditions. Portfolio includes Symbicort, Fasenra, Tagrisso, and other AZ branded medicines. FY2025 revenue INR 17.16B (+32.6% YoY), record performance. Also provides clinical trial services in India.

sources.title: AstraZeneca Pharma India achieves 29% growth FY2024

companies.description_zh: 印度班加罗尔综合制药公司，成立于1987年，专注于原料药（API）、处方药、仿制药及阿育吠陀产品。为全球最大格列齐特（II型糖尿病）生产商及出口商之一，产品出口至欧洲、远东、拉美、非洲和中东市场，出口收入约165亿卢比（FY2024-25）。
companies.description_en: Integrated pharmaceutical company based in Bommasandra Industrial Estate, Bangalore, founded 1987. Specialises in APIs, prescription drugs, generics, pharma intermediates, and Ayurvedic products. One of largest producers/exporters of Gliclazide (type-2 diabetes). Therapeutic areas: anti-diabetic, anti-histamine, anti-inflammatory, acne, gastroenterology, cardiology, dermatology. Exports to Europe, Far East, Latin America, Africa, and Middle East; export revenue INR 165Cr (FY2024-25).

sources.title: Bal Pharma Ltd share price – Screener

companies.name_zh: 曼谷实验室与化妆品公众有限公司
companies.name_en: Bangkok Lab and Cosmetic Public Company Limited
companies.description_zh: 泰国那曲蒲水府综合医疗健康集团，1992年由三位药剂师创立，制造和销售人类及动物用药品、化妆品、草药制剂、食品补充剂，产品销往泰国、老挝、柬埔寨、越南、香港等地，持有GMP PIC/S、ISO 22000等多项认证。
companies.description_en: Thai comprehensive healthcare solutions group headquartered in Ratchaburi, founded 30 September 1992 by three pharmacists. Manufactures and distributes generic and new generic drugs, herbal medicines, animal medicines, cosmetics, food supplements, and health products. Markets: Thailand, Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam, Hong Kong. Certifications: GMP PIC/S, ISO/IEC 17025, ISO 22000 GHP, HACCP, ISO 14001. FY2024 revenue THB 1.579B (+11.4% YoY).

sources.title: Financial Highlights – Bangkok Lab and Cosmetic
Bangkok Lab And Cosmetic PCL (BKK:BLC) Stock Price & Overview

companies.description_zh: 印度哈里亚纳邦潘奇库拉市专科抗癌药制造商，成立于1985年，专注于肿瘤原料药及制剂（固体、注射剂），覆盖乳腺癌、肺癌、血液肿瘤、淋巴瘤等多癌种，跻身印度肿瘤药企前十，多个品种市场排名前五，FY2024收入同比增长22.5%。
companies.description_en: Specialty oncology pharmaceutical manufacturer headquartered in Panchkula, Haryana, India, founded 1985. Manufactures anti-cancer bulk drugs and finished dosages (solid and injectables) plus cosmeceutical products and APIs. Therapeutic areas: breast, lung, colorectal, head & neck, ovarian, testicular, renal, prostate cancer, brain tumor, leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma. Ranked top-10 Indian oncology company; several products ranked top-5 in respective categories. FY2024 revenue INR 3.62B (+22.5% YoY).

sources.title: Beta Drugs Ltd share price – Screener

companies.description_zh: 巴基斯坦生物技术制药公司，由Ferozsons实验室与阿根廷Grupo Empresarial Bagó合资设立（2006年），制造和销售肾科、心脏、肝炎C、肿瘤等领域药品；制造基地位于拉合尔Raiwind路，配备Telstar设计的先进生物技术产能（包括预填充注射器生产线），出口至尼泊尔、阿富汗、毛里塔尼亚、瑞士等地。2024年收入同比增长102%。
companies.description_en: Pakistan biotech pharma company established 2006 as a joint venture between Ferozsons Laboratories (Pakistan) and Grupo Empresarial Bagó S.A. (Argentina). Manufacturing facility at 5KM Sunder Raiwind Road, Lahore. Therapeutic areas: nephrology, hepatology (hepatitis C), oncology, cardiology, gastroenterology, diabetes, antivirals. State-of-the-art biotech plant (Telstar, Spain) including pre-filled syringe line (fully commissioned 2024). Exports to Nepal, Afghanistan, Mauritania, Switzerland. FY2024 revenue PKR 3.66B (+102% YoY).

sources.title: BF Bioscience IPO and Outlook – Profit by Pakistan Today

companies.name_zh: 博雅控股集团有限公司
companies.description_zh: 马来西亚加影综合保健品公司，从事草药种植、研发、制造、分销及零售（旗下Constant Pharmacy连锁），ODM/OBM双模式经营功能性食品和保健品，在马来西亚、印尼和中国设有业务。2024年收入同比增长34.6%，但仍录得净亏损5000万令吉。
companies.description_en: Malaysia-based integrated health supplement company headquartered in Kajang, operating across the full value chain: herbal cultivation, R&D, manufacturing, distribution, and retail pharmacy (Constant Pharmacy brand). ODM and OBM models for functional food and health supplement products. Markets: Malaysia, Indonesia, and China. FY2024 revenue MYR 62.02M (+34.6% YoY), net loss MYR 50M. Incorporated 2011; operations from 2005.

sources.title: Bioalpha Holdings Berhad (KLSE:BIOHLDG) Stock Price & Overview
Bioalpha Holdings Berhad Full Year 2024 Earnings

companies.description_zh: Nanologica开发、制造并销售用于药物纯化的纳米多孔二氧化硅颗粒，专注于胰岛素和GLP-1类似物等肽类药物的制备色谱耗材，并于2025年收购Ardena Södertälje合同制造商以扩大产能。
companies.description_en: Nanologica develops, manufactures and sells nanoporous silica particles and preparative chromatography consumables optimised for purification of peptide drugs such as insulin and GLP-1 analogues. In 2025 it acquired Ardena Södertälje AB to expand manufacturing capacity.

companies.description_zh: NanoRepro AG成立于1998年，总部位于德国马尔堡，在法兰克福证券交易所上市，专注于开发、生产和销售家用及专业快速诊断检测试剂盒和保健补充剂。产品覆盖家庭计划、疾病检测及食物不耐受等领域。
companies.description_en: NanoRepro AG, founded in 1998 and listed on the Frankfurt Scale segment, develops, manufactures and distributes rapid diagnostic self-tests and food supplements for home and professional use, covering family planning, disease detection, food intolerances, allergies and infectious diseases.

companies.description_zh: Neola Medical成立于2016年，总部位于瑞典隆德，基于隆德大学先进研究成果，开发NEOLA新生儿肺部分析仪——首款针对早产儿肺部进行非侵入性连续监测的医疗设备，可实时预警危及生命的并发症。
companies.description_en: Neola Medical, founded in 2016 and based in Lund, Sweden, develops the NEOLA neonatal lung analyser—the first medical device for non-invasive continuous lung monitoring of preterm infants, providing real-time alerts for life-threatening complications. The technology originated from Lund University research.

sources.title: Neola Medical AB (STO:NEOLA) Stock Price & Overview

market_cap.note_en: Market cap PLN ~3.24B (as of mid-2026; 2024 year-end data not separately confirmed)

revenue.note_en: FY2024 revenue PLN 12.61B (+6.76% YoY); prior figure of 13.64B was FY2025, not FY2024 — corrected

employees.note_en: ~5,339 per StockAnalysis (2025 data; 2024 exact figure ~4,738–5,339 per various sources)

companies.description_zh: 波兰最大医药批发分销商（市场份额逾39%），华沙证交所上市。1990年创立，2010年更名为NEUCA。业务涵盖医药批发、自有品牌、门诊及IT服务。
companies.description_en: Poland's largest pharmaceutical wholesale distributor (>39% market share), listed on Warsaw Stock Exchange. Founded 1990 as Torfarm, renamed NEUCA in 2010. Operations span pharma wholesale, own-brand products, outpatient clinics, and IT services. FY2024 revenue PLN 12.6B.

companies.description_zh: Newron Pharmaceuticals成立于1999年，总部位于意大利米兰附近布雷索，在瑞士交易所上市。公司专注于中枢及外周神经系统疾病，旗下已上市产品Xadago（safinamide）用于帕金森病治疗，核心管线药物evenamide为治疗难治性精神分裂症的首创谷氨酸调节剂（III期）。
companies.description_en: Newron Pharmaceuticals SpA, founded 1999 and listed on SIX Swiss Exchange, is a CNS-focused biotech headquartered near Milan. Its approved drug Xadago® (safinamide, commercialised with Zambon and Meiji Seika) treats Parkinson's disease; lead pipeline asset evenamide is a first-in-class glutamate modulator in Phase 3 for treatment-resistant schizophrenia.

companies.description_zh: NFL Biosciences成立于2006年，总部位于法国卡斯特尔诺勒雷兹，在Euronext Growth Paris上市，专注于开发基于标准化烟草叶提取物的戒烟天然疗法。核心候选产品NFL-101正在进行III期临床试验，另有NFL-201（大麻+烟草提取物，临床前）和NFL-301（植物提取物，临床前）。2025年度无收入。
companies.description_en: NFL Biosciences, founded 2006 and listed on Euronext Growth Paris, develops natural botanical addiction withdrawal solutions for smokers. Lead candidate NFL-101 (standardised tobacco leaf extract protected by three patent families) is in Phase 3; NFL-201 and NFL-301 are in preclinical. Zero revenue in 2025.

sources.title: NFL Biosciences SA (EPA:ALNFL) Stock Price & Overview

companies.description_zh: Nicox SA成立于1996年，总部位于法国索菲亚-安提波利斯，在Euronext Paris上市，专注于眼科领域。已上市产品VYZULTA（拉坦酯-布他诺）授权给博士伦，ZERVIATE（西伐沙星）用于过敏性结膜炎。核心管线NCX 470（一氧化氮释放前列腺素类似物）III期用于青光眼，预计2026年夏向FDA提交NDA。
companies.description_en: Nicox SA, founded 1996 and listed on Euronext Paris, is an ophthalmology company headquartered in Sophia Antipolis. Marketed products VYZULTA® (licensed to Bausch + Lomb) and ZERVIATE® generate royalty/milestone revenues. Lead asset NCX 470, a nitric oxide-donating prostaglandin analogue for glaucoma, completed Phase 3 (Denali trial); US NDA filing expected summer 2026.

companies.description_zh: Nyxoah SA成立于2009年，总部位于比利时蒙圣吉伯特，在Euronext Brussels和纳斯达克双重上市。核心产品Genio®系统为无电池下颏神经刺激装置，用于治疗中重度阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）。2025年8月获得FDA批准并在美国正式商业化，全年净收入达1000万欧元，同比增长122%。
companies.description_en: Nyxoah SA, founded 2009 and dual-listed on Euronext Brussels and Nasdaq, is a Belgium-based medtech company. Its Genio® system—a battery-free, single-incision hypoglossal neurostimulation device—received FDA approval in August 2025 for obstructive sleep apnea. Full-year 2025 net revenue was €10.0 million (+122% YoY).

companies.description_zh: Oncimmune Holdings plc成立于2015年，总部位于英国诺丁汉，是癌症免疫诊断领域的领先公司，开发、制造和商业化用于癌症筛查、检测和护理的癌症特异性免疫诊断产品。公司于2025年3月26日进入破产管理程序（Joint Administration），AIM交易已暂停。
companies.description_en: Oncimmune Holdings plc, incorporated 2015 and formerly listed on AIM, is a cancer immunodiagnostics company headquartered in Nottingham, with a lab in Dortmund, Germany. It entered Joint Administration on 26 March 2025 following failure to secure a buyer for its trading subsidiary or short-term financing. AIM trading was suspended.

companies.description_zh: Oncoinvent ASA成立于2010年，总部位于挪威奥斯陆，在Euronext Growth Oslo上市，是一家临床阶段放射性药物生物技术公司。核心产品Radspherin®为受体无关的α放射性微球悬浮液，通过单次靶向剂量消灭腹腔内癌细胞。在卵巢癌（Phase 2随机对照）和结直肠癌（Phase 1/2a）均有积极疗效信号。
companies.description_en: Oncoinvent ASA, founded 2010 and listed on Euronext Growth Oslo, is a clinical-stage biotech developing receptor-independent alpha-radiopharmaceuticals. Lead candidate Radspherin® (alpha-emitting microsphere suspension) targets peritoneal metastases with a single dose; Phase 2 randomised controlled trial in ovarian cancer is actively enrolling, with interim data expected 2026.

companies.description_zh: Oncopeptides AB成立于2000年，总部位于斯德哥尔摩，在Nasdaq斯德哥尔摩上市。旗下肽偶联烷化剂Pepaxti（melflufen）已获欧盟批准用于复发/难治性多发性骨髓瘤治疗，2025年全年净销售额达7112万瑞典克朗（同比增长125%），在意大利表现尤为突出。在瑞典、德国、奥地利、西班牙和意大利运营。
companies.description_en: Oncopeptides AB, founded 2000 and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, is a commercial-stage biotech focused on difficult-to-treat haematological cancers. Pepaxti® (melflufen), a peptide-drug conjugate alkylator, is approved in the EU for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. FY2025 net sales were SEK 71.1 million (+125% YoY), driven especially by the Italian market.

companies.name_zh: 昂赛欧（现名瓦莱里奥治疗）
companies.description_zh: Onxeo SA于2023年6月更名为Valerio Therapeutics，总部位于法国巴黎，在Euronext Growth Paris（代码ALVIO）上市，是一家临床阶段肿瘤学生物技术公司，专注于DNA损伤应答（DDR）领域的创新药物。2025年宣布战略转型，终止临床活动，聚焦V-Body和集成化学平台的临床前研发。
companies.description_en: Formerly Onxeo SA, renamed Valerio Therapeutics in June 2023 and listed on Euronext Growth Paris (ALVIO). The Paris-based clinical-stage biotech develops oncology drugs targeting DNA damage response. In 2025 it announced a strategic transformation, ending clinical activities and refocusing on preclinical V-Body and integrated chemistry platform research.

sources.title: Onxeo Changes Name to Valerio Therapeutics

companies.description_zh: OptiBiotix Health成立于2012年，总部位于英国约克，在AIM上市，专注于开发调节人体微生物组的化合物，提供SlimBiome（饱腹感/体重管理）、CholBiome（降胆固醇）和Sweetbiotix（糖替代品）等益生元产品。2025年收入同比增长34%至117万英镑，亚洲业务增长182%。
companies.description_en: OptiBiotix Health plc, founded 2012 and listed on AIM, is a York-based microbiome company developing prebiotic formulations including SlimBiome® (weight management), CholBiome® (cholesterol/blood pressure) and Sweetbiotix® (sugar alternative). FY2025 revenue rose 34% to £1.17 million, with Asia revenue growing 182%.

sources.title: OptiBiotix reports higher revenue improved margins

revenue.note_en: FY2025 net sales EUR 1,889.5M (+22.5%, of which EUR 183.4M milestones); operating profit EUR 631.6M (+51.6%).
revenue.note_zh: 2025财年净销售额18.895亿欧元（同比+22.5%，其中里程碑款1.834亿欧元）；营业利润6.316亿欧元（+51.6%）。

companies.description_zh: 奥里翁制药成立于1917年，在纳斯达克赫尔辛基上市，总部位于芬兰埃斯波，是北欧领先的制药公司。其在全球开发、生产并销售人用与兽用药物及原料药。2025财年净销售额18.9亿欧元（+22.5%），营业利润6.316亿欧元。Nubeqa（darolutamide，与拜耳共同开发）是核心肿瘤增长驱动力。研发投入2.104亿欧元。
companies.description_en: Orion Oyj, founded 1917 and listed on Nasdaq Helsinki, is a leading Nordic pharmaceutical company headquartered in Espoo, Finland. It develops, manufactures and markets human and veterinary pharmaceuticals and APIs globally. FY2025 net sales reached EUR 1.89 billion (+22.5%), operating profit EUR 631.6 million. Nubeqa (darolutamide, co-developed with Bayer) is the key oncology growth driver. R&D spend EUR 210.4 million.

sources.title: Orion Group Financial Statement Release January-December 2025

companies.description_zh: OSE Immunotherapeutics SA成立于2012年，总部位于法国南特（兼有巴黎办公室），在Euronext Paris上市，专注于开发肿瘤免疫和免疫炎症领域的first-in-class资产。核心管线包括Tedopi®（肿瘤肽疫苗，III期Artemia试验积极招募中）、lusvertikimab（IL-7Rα抗体，I&I适应症）及OSE-172（SIRPα抗体）。2024年与AbbVie就OSE-230签署4800万美元授权协议。
companies.description_en: OSE Immunotherapeutics SA, founded 2012 and listed on Euronext Paris, is a Nantes/Paris-based clinical-stage biotech developing first-in-class assets in immuno-oncology (IO) and immuno-inflammation (I&I). Key pipeline: Tedopi® (neoepitope vaccine, Phase 3 Artemia enrolling), lusvertikimab (anti-IL-7Rα), OSE-172 (anti-SIRPα). A $48 million AbbVie licence on OSE-230 closed in 2024. FY2025 R&D spend EUR 33.9 million; cash runway to Q4 2026.

companies.description_zh: OssDsign AB成立于2011年，总部位于瑞典乌普萨拉，在Nasdaq First North Growth Market上市，是一家骨再生材料科技公司。产品组合包括用于颅骨手术的个性化植入体（Craniomosaic系列）和用于脊柱手术的现货合成骨移植物，以先进材料科学支持机体自愈能力。2025年收入1.8亿瑞典克朗（固定货币增长45%）。
companies.description_en: OssDsign AB, founded 2011 and listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market, is an Uppsala-based orthobiologics company specialising in patient-specific cranial implants (Craniomosaic® series) and off-the-shelf synthetic bone grafts for spine surgery. FY2025 revenue was SEK 180 million (45% constant-currency growth).

companies.description_zh: Oxford BioDynamics plc成立于2007年，总部位于英国牛津，在AIM上市，专注于通过其专有EpiSwitch®三维基因组学平台开发和商业化精准临床诊断检测，已上市产品包括EpiSwitch PSE（前列腺癌检测）和EpiSwitch CiRT（免疫检查点抑制剂响应预测）。2025财年收入110万英镑（同比增长72%）。
companies.description_en: Oxford BioDynamics plc, incorporated 2007 and listed on AIM, develops and commercialises precision clinical diagnostics using its proprietary EpiSwitch® 3D genomics platform, which maps chromatin conformational changes. Commercialised products: EpiSwitch PSE (prostate cancer detection) and EpiSwitch CiRT (checkpoint inhibitor response prediction). FY2025 revenue £1.10 million (+72% YoY).

sources.title: Oxford BioDynamics Publication of 2025 Annual Report

companies.description_zh: Oxurion NV（原ThromboGenics NV，1998年成立）总部位于比利时鲁汶，在Euronext Brussels上市。公司已从眼科制药开发商战略转型为欧洲临床研究机构（CRO）并购整合平台，2025年收购Axiodis CRO。现有员工约11人，旧眼科业务收入接近为零。
companies.description_en: Oxurion NV (formerly ThromboGenics NV, founded 1998), listed on Euronext Brussels and headquartered in Leuven, has pivoted from ophthalmic drug development to building a leading European CRO group through buy-and-build acquisitions. Acquired Axiodis CRO in August 2025. Legacy ophthalmic revenues are near zero; the company has ~11 employees.

companies.name_zh: 博晟生醫股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 博晟生醫專注於骨科醫療器材研發與商業化，核心產品包括骨誘導填充物（BiG-001/BiG-006）及自體軟骨修復系統（RevoCart/BiG-009），現已在台灣、中國大陸、香港及馬來西亞銷售。
companies.description_en: BioGend Therapeutics researches, develops, and commercializes orthopedic medical devices, including osteoinductive bone graft substitutes (BiG-001, BiG-006) and autologous cartilage repair systems (RevoCart/BiG-009). Products are marketed in Taiwan, Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Malaysia.

companies.description_zh: 바이오니아（Bioneer）成立于1992年，是韩国首家生物技术公司，专注于PCR试剂、寡核苷酸与siRNA合成、分子生物学工具及仪器的研发与销售，产品覆盖全球多个市场。
companies.description_en: Bioneer Corporation, founded in 1992 as South Korea's first biotechnology company, specializes in PCR reagents, oligonucleotide and siRNA synthesis, molecular biology tools and instruments. The company serves researchers across the Americas, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

companies.description_zh: BioPlus专注于透明质酸衍生生物材料的研发、生产与销售，核心产品包括SkinPlus-Hyal、Bio+ Dew、HyalDew等皮肤填充剂品牌，以及InterBlock防粘连屏障、Synofil关节腔注射液等医疗产品。
companies.description_en: BioPlus Co., Ltd. engages in R&D, production, and sale of bio-products in South Korea. Core offerings include hyaluronic acid dermal fillers (SkinPlus-Hyal, HyalDew, DeneB Classic), anti-adhesion barriers (InterBlock), synovial fluid substitutes (Synofil), and mesotherapy products.

companies.description_zh: Bliss GVS Pharma成立于1984年，总部位于孟买，是印度一家专注于抗疟疾、抗真菌、避孕及普通科制剂出口的全球化制药公司，产品出口至60余个国家。
companies.description_en: Bliss GVS Pharma Limited, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Mumbai, develops, manufactures, and exports over 150 branded pharmaceutical formulations across 60+ countries, with a focus on anti-malarials, anti-fungals, anti-bacterials, and contraceptives.

sources.title: Bliss GVS Pharma - Simply Wall St

companies.name_zh: 蓝杰医疗保健有限公司
companies.description_zh: Blue Jet Healthcare（原Jet Chemicals）成立于1968年，总部位于孟买（Thane），是印度领先的对比剂中间体和糖精生产商，同时提供新化学实体（NCE）从开发到商业化的CDMO服务。
companies.description_en: Blue Jet Healthcare Limited, incorporated in 1968 and headquartered in Thane/Mumbai, manufactures pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs with a leadership position in contrast media intermediates and saccharin in India. The company also provides end-to-end CDMO/CMO services for NCEs.

sources.title: Blue Jet Healthcare Annual Report - Official

companies.description_zh: Boditech Med成立于1998年，总部位于春川，是韩国领先的体外诊断（IVD）仪器与试剂制造商，专注于即时检测（POCT）解决方案，产品覆盖心脏、传染病及癌症生物标志物检测。2024年实现营收13.81亿元人民币当量（KRW 1,381亿）。
companies.description_en: Boditech Med Inc., founded in 1998 and headquartered in Chuncheon-si, is a South Korean in-vitro diagnostics company offering point-of-care testing instruments and reagents for cardiac, cancer, and infectious disease biomarkers. 2024 consolidated revenue was USD 103.8 million (KRW 138.1 billion), up 2.9% YoY.

companies.name_zh: 鴻鈞生醫股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 鴻鈞生醫成立于2015年，总部位于台中，专注于男性不育症诊断解决方案，核心产品为LensHooke®系列AI全自动精液分析系统（X12 PRO/X1 PRO），已获台湾、中国大陆、美国、欧盟产品许可，销往53个国家，持有90项专利。
companies.description_en: Bonraybio Co., Ltd., founded in 2015 and based in Taichung, develops AI-powered optical microscopy solutions for male infertility diagnostics. Its LensHooke® brand (X12 PRO, X1 PRO semen analyzers) is licensed in Taiwan, China, USA, and EU and marketed in 53 countries, with 90+ patents.

companies.name_zh: 寶齡富錦生技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 寶齡富錦生技成立于2007年，总部位于台北，是台湾领先的CDMO（合同开发和制造）及仿制药公司，在台湾（5个）、美国（3个）、加拿大（1个）共设9处cGMP设施，涵盖口服固体制剂、液体/半固体、眼科、生物制品及无菌注射剂。2024年合并营收达新台币192.57亿元。
companies.description_en: Bora Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd., founded in 2007 and headquartered in Taipei, is a leading Taiwan-based CDMO and generic pharmaceutical company operating 9 cGMP facilities across Taiwan, the U.S., and Canada. Services span oral solids, liquids, semi-solids, ophthalmics, biologics, and sterile injectables. 2024 consolidated revenue was NT$19.26 billion (+35.6% YoY).

sources.title: Bora Pharmaceuticals Record Revenue 2024 - Taiwan Healthcare+

companies.description_zh: 保令制药（현 Boryung Corporation）成立于1957年，总部位于首尔，是韩国领先的处方药制造商，核心产品包括自研新化学实体Fimasartan（高血压）及Canaplex（抗肿瘤），另有降脂、降糖类产品线。2024年营收突破1万亿韩元，同比增长18.3%。
companies.description_en: Boryung Corporation (formerly Boryung Pharmaceutical), founded in 1957 and headquartered in Seoul, is a leading South Korean pharma company focused on prescription drugs for hypertension (Fimasartan/Kanarb), dyslipidemia, diabetes, CNS, and oncology. 2024 revenue exceeded KRW 1 trillion, up 18.3% YoY.

sources.title: Boryung eyes KRW 1 trillion sales - Korea BioMed

companies.description_zh: PT Brigit Biofarmaka Teknologi成立于2015年，总部位于中爪哇苏科哈尔霍，专注于草药、蜂蜜草药、护肤品、化妆品、植物茶及功能性粉末饮料的合同制造，2025年1月于印尼证交所上市（IDX: OBAT）。2024年销售额达Rp 1,200亿，同比增长112%。
companies.description_en: PT Brigit Biofarmaka Teknologi Tbk, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Sukoharjo, Central Java, provides contract manufacturing services for herbal medicine, herbal honey, skincare, cosmetics, botanical tea, and functional powdered drinks. Listed on IDX in January 2025. 2024 revenue was approximately IDR 120 billion (+112% YoY).

companies.name_zh: 必因生醫股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 必因生醫成立于2013年，总部位于台北，是临床阶段生物技术公司，基于PEDF衍生短链多肽（PDSP）技术平台开发眼科与退行性关节疾病再生疗法，核心管线包括BRM421（干眼症，已完成美国II期）、BRM423（严重角膜损伤）及BRM424（神经营养性角膜炎）。
companies.description_en: BRIM Biotechnology, Inc., founded July 2013 and headquartered in Taipei, is a clinical-stage biotech developing regenerative therapies for ophthalmology and degenerative joint diseases using its PEDF-derived short peptide (PDSP) platform. Lead candidate BRM421 (dry eye syndrome) completed Phase 2 in the U.S. Pipeline also includes BRM423, BRM424, BRM411, and BRM412.

sources.title: TWSE New Listed Company - BRIM Biotechnology

companies.description_zh: 부광약품成立于1960年，总部位于首尔，是韩国专注于乙型肝炎抗病毒（Levovir/Clevudine）、抗癌、糖尿病并发症及精神科药物的制药公司。2024年营收达1,600.87亿韩元（同比增长27.2%），研发投入占营收14.8%。
companies.description_en: Bukwang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., founded in 1960 and headquartered in Seoul, manufactures and markets medicines for hepatitis B (Levovir/Clevudine), oncology, diabetes complications, and psychiatry in South Korea and internationally. 2024 revenue was KRW 160.1 billion (+27.2% YoY); R&D was 14.8% of revenue.

companies.name_zh: 卡利美生技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 卡利美生技成立于2012年，总部位于新北市，是临床阶段生物制药公司，核心管线CBL-514（非手术脂肪减少）已进入II期临床，同时开发CBA-539用于中心性肥胖及皮肤老化。2024年12月纳入富时台湾中型股100指数。
companies.description_en: Caliway Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd., founded in 2012 and headquartered in New Taipei City, is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing drugs for aesthetic medicine and chronic inflammation. CBL-514 is in Phase 2 for non-surgical fat reduction and Dercum's disease; CBA-539 targets central obesity and skin aging. Included in FTSE TWSE Mid-Cap 100 Index in December 2024.

sources.title: Caliway Included in FTSE TWSE Mid-Cap 100 - PR Newswire

companies.name_zh: 卡普林点实验室有限公司
companies.description_zh: 卡普林点实验室成立于1990年，总部位于金奈，是印度专注于拉丁美洲、非洲法语区及美国市场的仿制药出口商，拥有4,000+产品注册，覆盖注射剂、眼用制剂、口服固体制剂等，并获FDA批准用于美国市场。
companies.description_en: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited, founded in 1990 and headquartered in Chennai, is a fully integrated generic pharmaceutical company with strong presence in Latin America, Francophone Africa, and expanding in the U.S. Capabilities span sterile injectables, ophthalmics, and oral formulations across 36+ therapeutic segments.

companies.description_zh: 케어젠成立于2001年，总部位于安阳市，是专注于仿生多肽（Biomimetic Peptide）研发和全球商业化的韩国生物技术企业，产品涵盖皮肤填充剂（REVOFIL、DR.CYJ、PROSTROLANE）、皮肤护理（Dermaheal）及头皮护理（Pelo Baum）系列，同时开发湿性黄斑变性及干性黄斑变性治疗候选药物。
companies.description_en: Caregen Co., Ltd., founded in 2001 and headquartered in Anyang-si, South Korea, researches, develops, and commercializes biomimetic peptides worldwide. Products include filler brands (REVOFIL, DR.CYJ, PROSTROLANE), skin care (Dermaheal), and scalp care (Pelo Baum). Also in clinical pipeline: COVID-19 and wet/dry macular degeneration treatments.

companies.description_zh: 셀리드成立于2006年，总部位于首尔，是临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于基于B细胞和单核细胞的免疫治疗性肿瘤疫苗（BVAC平台），核心管线包括BVAC-C（HPV相关宫颈癌）、BVAC-B（HER-2相关乳腺胃癌）及BVAC-P（前列腺癌/胶质母细胞瘤）。
companies.description_en: Cellid Co., Ltd., founded in 2006 and headquartered in Seoul, is a clinical-stage biotech developing immunotherapeutic cancer vaccines based on B-cell/monocyte (BVAC) platform. Pipeline includes BVAC-C (HPV+ cervical cancer), BVAC-B (HER-2+ breast/stomach cancer), BVAC-P (prostate/glioblastoma), and BVAC-M (melanoma).

companies.description_zh: 셀트리온제약成立于1976年，总部位于清州，是Celltrion集团子公司，专注于生物类似药及OTC药品的韩国市场销售与流通，主要产品涵盖肝炎、抗炎、抗组胺、呼吸系统、消化系统、激素代谢、免疫及肿瘤用药。
companies.description_en: Celltrion Pharm, Inc., founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cheongju-si, is a subsidiary of Celltrion, Inc. focused on domestic Korean sales and distribution of biosimilars and OTC drugs across hepatotonic, anti-inflammatory, antihistamine, respiratory, oncology, and immunology categories.

companies.name_zh: 中央制药有限公司（孟加拉国）
companies.description_zh: 中央制药有限公司成立于1980年，总部位于达卡，是孟加拉国小型仿制药企业，生产并销售片剂、胶囊、液体及软膏剂，涵盖消化系统、抗感染、维生素矿物质、皮肤科及抗糖尿病等治疗领域，在达卡证交所（DSE）上市。
companies.description_en: Central Pharmaceuticals Limited, founded in 1980 and headquartered in Dhaka, is a small-cap Bangladeshi generic pharmaceutical manufacturer producing tablets, capsules, liquids, and ointments across gastrointestinal, anti-infective, vitamin/mineral, dermatological, and anti-diabetic segments. Fiscal year is July–June.

companies.description_zh: CG Invites（原CrystalGenomics Invites，2024年4月更名）是韩国专注于结构化学蛋白质组学药物发现与开发的生物制药公司，核心管线包括镇痛药Acelex（polmacoxib）、抗癌候选Ivaltinostat（胰腺癌/骨髓增生异常综合征Ph2）以及camrelizumab联合方案。
companies.description_en: CG Invites Co., Ltd. (formerly CrystalGenomics Invites, renamed April 2024) is a South Korean biopharma company pioneering structural chemoproteomic-based drug discovery. Key pipeline includes Acelex (polmacoxib, marketed COX-2 inhibitor), Ivaltinostat (HDAC inhibitor, Ph2 in pancreatic cancer and MDS), and Luxeptinib for hematologic malignancies.

sources.title: CG Invites Company Profile - Stock Analysis
Crystal Genomics restarts as CG Invites - KBR

companies.name_zh: 正瀚生技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 正瀚生技（CH Biotech R&D）专注于农业生物技术领域，研发、生产和销售有机肥料、生物刺激素和植物生长调节剂，同时提供生物技术服务，产品销往台湾、美国及国际市场，于台湾创新板上市。
companies.description_en: CH Biotech R&D Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based agricultural biotechnology company engaged in the research, development, production, and sale of fertilizers, biostimulants, and plant growth regulators, as well as providing biotechnology services. Listed on the Taiwan Innovation Board (TWSE:6534) since December 2023.

sources.title: CH Biotech R&D Company Profile - Stock Analysis
CH Biotech R&D Company Information - Simply Wall St

companies.description_zh: 차바이오텍（Chabiotech）是韩国CHA医疗集团旗下生物技术公司，专注于干细胞与免疫细胞治疗，提供脐带血存储、再生医学、免疫细胞与干细胞保存服务，并开发CAR-NK疗法（CBT101/CBT111）及干细胞产品CordSTEM-DD（慢性背痛）。同时提供IVF服务、抗衰老疗法和生物保险存储。
companies.description_en: Chabiotech Co., Ltd. is the biotech subsidiary of CHA Medical Group (South Korea), specializing in cell and gene therapy related to stem and immune cells. Services include umbilical cord blood storage, regenerative medicine, immune/stem cell preservation, and anti-aging programs. Pipeline includes CBT101 (immune cell for recurrent GBM), CBT111, CAR-NK (solid cancers), and CordSTEM-DD (chronic back pain). Also provides IVF services.
companies.sub_sector: cord blood / stem cell & digital health

revenue.note_en: FY2024 record-high revenue KRW 1.6924T driven by blockbuster co-marketing (incl. Wegovy); operating profit KRW 80.5B (-19% YoY), net profit KRW 77.8B (-30% YoY)
revenue.note_zh: 2024财年创纪录营收1.6924万亿韩元，受重磅药联合营销（含Wegovy）驱动；营业利润805亿韩元（同比-19%），净利润778亿韩元（同比-30%）

companies.description_zh: 钟根堂制药（创立于1941年）是韩国规模最大、历史最悠久的制药企业之一。生产降压、降脂、降糖、免疫抑制剂等处方药，以及OTC药品和消费健康产品。2024财年营收创纪录达1.69万亿韩元。
companies.description_en: Chong Kun Dang Pharmaceutical Corp. (est. 1941) is one of South Korea's largest and oldest pharmaceutical companies. It manufactures prescription drugs including anti-hypertensives, anti-hyperlipidaemics, anti-diabetics, and immunosuppressants, as well as OTC medicines and consumer health products. FY2024 set a record KRW 1.69T in revenue.

sources.title: Chong Kun Dang Pharmaceutical KRX:185750 Overview
Chong Kun Dang Revenue - Alpha Spread

companies.name_zh: 中化合成生技股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Chung-Hwa Chemical Synthesis & Biotech Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 中化合成生技成立于1964年，是台湾领先的原料药（API）制造商，通过生物技术和化学合成工艺生产免疫抑制剂（他克莫司、雷帕霉素、依维莫司等）、肿瘤药物API及肽类药物，产品销往台湾、美国和欧洲。
companies.description_en: Chung-Hwa Chemical Synthesis & Biotech Co., Ltd. (est. 1964) is a leading Taiwanese API manufacturer, producing immunosuppressants (tacrolimus, rapamycin, everolimus, mycophenolate mofetil), oncology APIs, and peptide drugs via fermentation and chemical synthesis. Markets in Taiwan, USA, and internationally.

sources.title: Chunghwa Chemical Synthesis & Biotech TWSE:1762 Overview
Chunghwa Chemical Synthesis & Biotech Profile - Yahoo Finance
Chunghwa Chemical Synthesis & Biotech - Dun & Bradstreet

companies.description_zh: 西提制药（Citi Pharma）成立于2012年，总部位于巴基斯坦卡苏尔，是巴基斯坦主要的原料药（API）及制剂生产商，拥有46.2英亩厂区，产品组合超过30种API，包括阿莫西林、对乙酰氨基酚、头孢类、青霉素和环丙沙星。为GSK和雅培等国际大厂提供API供应。
companies.description_en: Citi Pharma Ltd. (est. 2012, incorporated Oct 8 2012) is a Pakistan-based pharmaceutical manufacturer headquartered in Kasur. The company manufactures APIs and finished dosage forms including amoxicillin, paracetamol, cephalosporins, penicillin, and ciprofloxacin from a 46.2-acre facility (527,384 sq ft). Supplies to GSK and Abbott. Acquired Askari Pharmaceuticals operations in 2013.

companies.description_zh: Clearbridge Health是新加坡SGX Catalist板上市的综合医疗保健公司，通过战略投资、医疗系统和医疗中心三大分部运营，提供癌症早期检测（ClearCell FX System循环肿瘤细胞检测）、影像、健康筛查、肾脏护理及实验室检测服务，业务覆盖新加坡、菲律宾、香港等地区。
companies.description_en: Clearbridge Health Ltd is a Singapore-listed (SGX Catalist:1H3) integrated healthcare investment holding company providing early cancer detection (ClearCell FX System for circulating tumour cells), imaging, health screening, vaccination, renal care, and laboratory services across Singapore, Philippines, and Hong Kong.

companies.name_zh: 康科德生物技术有限公司
companies.description_zh: 康科德生物技术（Concord Biotech）成立于1984年，是印度领先的发酵法原料药（API）制造商，专注于免疫抑制剂（他克莫司、霉酚酸酯、环孢素、西罗莫司等6种）、抗肿瘤、抗真菌和降脂API，同时生产制剂产品。FY2025年营收120亿卢比，同比增长18%。
companies.description_en: Concord Biotech Limited (est. 1984) is an Ahmedabad-based R&D-driven biopharma company and leading manufacturer of fermentation-based APIs across immunosuppressants (6 products incl. tacrolimus, mycophenolate mofetil, cyclosporine, sirolimus) and oncology/antifungal APIs. FY2025 revenue ₹12B INR (+18% YoY). Also launched 21 new formulation products in FY2025.

companies.description_zh: Corestemchemon（原Corestem）成立于2003年，是韩国专注于难治性疾病干细胞疗法的生物制药公司，旗舰产品NEURONATA-R（自体骨髓间充质干细胞注射液）已获批用于治疗肌萎缩性侧索硬化症（ALS），同时开发系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）、多系统萎缩（MSA）和小脑性共济失调（CA）的干细胞疗法。
companies.description_en: Corestemchemon Inc. (est. 2003) is a South Korean biopharmaceutical company developing stem cell therapies for incurable diseases. Its flagship product NEURONATA-R inj (autologous bone marrow MSC) is approved for ALS treatment. Pipeline includes stem cell therapies for SLE, multiple system atrophy (MSA), and cerebellar ataxia.

companies.name_zh: 大炸弹蛋白生技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 大炸弹蛋白生技（DaBomb Protein Biotech，2023年10月更名）成立于2001年，是台湾台南的动物健康生物技术公司，专注于开发抗生素替代品，提供水产/畜牧用植物蛋白（DaBomb-P）、抗生素替代品（DBT-100 HT/LS）及宠物护理产品（LACTOTIDES HEALTH A+），产品出口至越南、菲律宾、韩国等亚洲市场。
companies.description_en: DaBomb Protein Biotech Corp. (formerly DaBomb Protein Corp., renamed Oct 2023, est. 2001) is a Tainan-based animal health biotech specializing in antibiotic alternatives. Products include plant protein (DaBomb-P Aqua/Livestock), antibiotic alternatives (DBT-100 HT/LS), and pet care products (LACTOTIDES HEALTH A+). Markets in Vietnam, Philippines, South Korea, Taiwan, and Asia.

sources.title: DaBomb Protein Biotech Profile - Yahoo Finance

companies.name_zh: 达亚·瓦里亚实验室公开公司
companies.description_zh: 达亚·瓦里亚实验室（PT Darya-Varia Laboratoria Tbk）成立于1976年，是印度尼西亚IDX上市的制药公司，业务涵盖处方药、消费健康产品、出口及代工服务。2024年营收2.09万亿印尼盾（同比增10.4%），为印尼本土主要仿制药制造商。
companies.description_en: PT Darya-Varia Laboratoria Tbk (est. 1976) is an Indonesia-listed (IDX:DVLA) pharmaceutical manufacturer and trader operating across Prescription Drugs, Consumer Health Products, Export & Toll Manufacturing, and Services segments. 2024 revenue IDR 2.09 trillion (+10.4% YoY). Part of the Blue Bird Group ecosystem.

companies.description_zh: D&D Pharmatech（2014年成立，2024年5月KOSDAQ上市）是韩国城南市的临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于GLP-1/胰高血糖素受体双激动剂等肽类药物开发。核心管线DD01（每周一次皮下注射，GLP-1/胰高血糖素双激动剂）处于MASH/MASLD II期临床；NLY01（Pegsebrenatide）处于帕金森病和阿尔茨海默病II期；TLY012靶向系统性硬化和肝纤维化。
companies.description_en: D&D Pharmatech Inc. (est. 2014, IPO KOSDAQ May 2024) is a Seongnam-based clinical-stage biotech developing peptide and protein therapeutics. Lead asset DD01 (long-acting dual GLP-1/glucagon agonist) in Phase 2 for MASH/MASLD. NLY01 (Pegsebrenatide) in Phase 2 for Parkinson's and Alzheimer's. TLY012 targets systemic sclerosis and liver fibrosis. Market cap surged ~600% in 12 months on GLP-1 excitement.

sources.title: DD-01 by D&D Pharmatech for MASLD - Pharmaceutical Technology

companies.description_zh: 东亚ST株式会社（Dong-A ST）成立于1932年，2013年从东亚Socio控股集团拆分独立。是韩国综合制药公司，专注于特药、生物类似药和自研新药。核心产品包括胃炎/功能性消化不良治疗药、抗生素（噁唑烷酮类）、糖尿病治疗药，以及IMULDOSA（ustekinumab生物类似药，2024年获FDA及EC批准，参比药STELARA）。
companies.description_en: Dong-A ST Co., Ltd. (est. 1932, restructured 2013 as specialty pharma subsidiary of Dong-A Socio Holdings) develops, manufactures, and markets specialty pharmaceuticals, biosimilars, and proprietary NCEs in South Korea and internationally. Key assets: IMULDOSA (ustekinumab-srlf biosimilar to STELARA, FDA approved Oct 2024, EC approved Dec 2024), plus in-house drugs for gastritis, erectile dysfunction, functional dyspepsia, antibiotics, and diabetes.

sources.title: US FDA Approves Dong-A ST's IMULDOSA - BusinessWire
Dong-A ST Secures European Approval for IMULDOSA - BusinessWire

companies.description_en: Dongkook Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (est. 1968) is a South Korean pharmaceutical manufacturer producing prescription/OTC drugs, quasi-drugs, medical devices, APIs, and cosmetics. 2024 record revenue of KRW 812.17 billion (+11.1% YoY). 2025 annual revenue reached KRW 926.88 billion (+14.1% YoY) — another record. Operating profit rose 20.1% in 2025.

sources.title: Dongkook Pharmaceutical Posts Record Annual Results - Seoul Economic Daily

companies.description_zh: 杜法玛生技（Duopharma Biotech Berhad）成立于1978年，是马来西亚Bursa上市的制药公司，在马来西亚和国际市场研发、生产和销售仿制药、专科药、生物类似药（ERYSAA® EPO、Biocon胰岛素独家代理）及消费健康产品。2024年营收8.137亿令吉（同比增15.5%），创历史新高。
companies.description_en: Duopharma Biotech Berhad (est. 1978) is a Malaysia-listed (Bursa:DPHARMA) pharmaceutical company manufacturing and distributing generic drugs, specialty pharmaceuticals, biosimilars (ERYSAA® erythropoietin co-developed with PanGen; exclusive Biocon insulin distribution rights), and consumer healthcare products. 2024 record revenue RM813.70M (+15.5% YoY). companies.description_en: Easywell Biomedicals, Inc. (est. 1998, Hsinchu Science Park) develops, manufactures, and sells thermometers (digital clinical, infrared ear), probe covers, cholesterol/blood/urine monitoring systems, and TENS devices, plus generic pharmaceuticals (epilepsy, depression, angina). Has cGMP facilities in Shenzhen (devices) and Cranbury NJ (pharma).

companies.description_en: EirGenix Inc. (est. Dec 21, 2012) is a New Taipei-based CDMO and biosimilar developer. CDMO services: cell line development, process development, analytical/QC, cGMP mammalian/microbial manufacturing, and ADC services. Key biosimilars: Eirgasun (trastuzumab biosimilar, Taiwan NHI reimbursed since Oct 2023 for HER2+ breast/gastric cancer); EG1206A (pertuzumab biosimilar, FDA/EMA granted Ph3 waiver). 2024 operating revenue NTD 1.009B.
