companies.description_en: Genovate Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is an integrated specialty pharmaceutical company founded in 1982 and based in Hsinchu, Taiwan. It provides drugs, APIs, intermediates, and release agents for cardiovascular, esophageal, gastrointestinal, cancer, and autoimmune diseases, as well as controlled-release dosage forms and contract pharmaceutical manufacturing services.

companies.description_zh: GI Innovation是韓國生物技術公司，專注於蛋白質新藥研發，主要管線包括GI-101/GI-102（雙功能融合蛋白免疫腫瘤藥物，I/II期）、GI-108（代謝免疫治療）、GI-301（IgE介導過敏症治療，I期）。
companies.description_en: GI Innovation, Inc. is a Korean bio-venture focused on protein-based new drug R&D. Its pipeline includes GI-101/GI-102 (dual fusion protein immuno-oncology, Ph I/II), GI-108 (metabolic immunotherapy oncology agent), and GI-301 (IgE-mediated allergy treatment, Ph I). The company raised over $230 million since founding through funding, IPO, and licensing deals.

companies.name_zh: 醣基生醫股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 醣基生醫股份有限公司成立於2001年，位於新北市，致力開發結合醣鞘脂抗原與人源化單株抗體技術的癌症藥物。核心管線GNX102（人源化單株抗體）正進行I期臨床試驗，用於實體腫瘤治療。
companies.description_en: GlycoNex Incorporation, founded in 2001 and based in New Taipei, Taiwan, develops cancer drugs based on the combination of glycosphingolipid antigen and human monoclonal antibody technologies. Lead pipeline includes GNX102 (humanized mAb, Phase 1 for solid tumors) and several preclinical antibody candidates (GNX201–204).

companies.name_zh: 共信醫藥控股股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 共信醫藥控股股份有限公司成立於2014年，總部位於台北，是跨台灣、中國大陸及香港的臨床階段生物製藥公司。核心管線包括PTS302（非小細胞肺癌，已完成III期臨床）、PTS100（肝細胞癌，II期）及PTS02（腺樣囊性癌，I期）。
companies.description_en: Gongwin Biopharm Holdings Co., Ltd. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing anticancer drugs across Taiwan, China, and Hong Kong. Its lead drug Purocenta (PTS302) has completed Phase III for NSCLC-MAO and has treated over 1,000 patients; PTS100 is in Phase II for hepatocellular carcinoma; PTS02 in Phase I for adenoid cystic carcinoma.

companies.name_zh: 格兰优斯印度有限公司
companies.description_zh: 格兰优斯印度有限公司成立於1984年，總部位於海德拉巴，是印度領先的仿製藥及API生產商。主要產品包括對乙醯氨基酚（撲熱息痛）、二甲雙胍、愈創木酚甘油醚及甲基卡巴莫，以API、藥物製劑中間體（PFI）及成品（FD）三種形式供應全球市場，並在美國維吉尼亞州設有製造設施。
companies.description_en: Granules India Limited is a leading Indian generic pharmaceutical manufacturer founded in 1984, headquartered in Hyderabad. The company manufactures and sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharmaceutical Formulation Intermediates (PFIs), and Finished Dosages (FDs) across key molecules including paracetamol, metformin, guaifenesin, and methocarbamol, with manufacturing facilities in India and Chantilly, Virginia (USA).

companies.name_zh: GC Cell 股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: GC Cell股份有限公司（原Green Cross Cell，031390 KOSDAQ）是韓國領先的細胞治療公司，2021年與GC LabCell合併後成為整合型免疫細胞療法企業。主要產品Immuncell-LC是已獲批的自體T細胞免疫療法，用於肝細胞癌術後輔助治療，並提供臍帶血冷凍保存及免疫細胞庫服務。
companies.description_en: GC Cell Corp. (formerly Green Cross Cell, KOSDAQ:031390) is South Korea's premier cell therapy company, formed by the merger of Green Cross Cell and GC LabCell in 2021. Key product Immuncell-LC is an approved autologous T-cell immunotherapy for adjuvant treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma post-resection. The company also provides KGMP manufacturing services, cord blood cryopreservation, and immune cell banking.

sources.title: GC LabCell and GC Cell to Merge – BusinessWire 2021
GC Cell and New Management Embarking on a New Chapter – BioSpace

companies.name_zh: 葛兰素史克制药（印度）有限公司
companies.description_zh: 葛兰素史克制药（印度）有限公司是GSK plc的印度上市子公司，成立於1924年，總部位於孟買。FY2025年營收37,230億盧比（同比增長9%），稅後利潤915億盧比（增長32%），EBITDA利潤率31.4%。產品涵蓋普通藥品、特藥及疫苗，是印度最大的外資藥企之一。
companies.description_en: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Limited is the Indian-listed subsidiary of GSK plc (UK), founded in 1924 and headquartered in Mumbai. FY2025 (ending March 31, 2025) revenue was Rs 3,723 crores (+9% YoY); PAT Rs 915 crores (+32%); EBITDA margin 31.4%. Portfolio spans General Medicines, Specialty, and Vaccines, supported by innovation-driven sales and digital acceleration.

sources.title: GSK India FY2025 Full Year Results Press Release
GSK Pharmaceuticals India Revenue – Alpha Spread

companies.name_zh: 古菲科生物科学有限公司
companies.description_zh: 古菲科生物科学有限公司成立於1970年，總部位於孟買，是印度最大的凍乾注射劑生產商之一。產品覆蓋100餘種藥品、200餘個SKU，涵蓋危重症護理、不孕不育、抗菌、抗真菌等15+治療領域，並積極向生物製劑及免疫腫瘤學延伸。
companies.description_en: Gufic Biosciences Limited, founded in 1970 and headquartered in Mumbai, is one of India's largest manufacturers of lyophilized injections. The company offers a portfolio of 100+ pharmaceutical products across 200+ SKUs spanning 15+ therapeutic areas including critical care, infertility, antibiotics, antifungals, cardiac, and PPI injectables, with growing expansion into biologicals and immuno-oncology.

companies.name_zh: 古吉拉特西米斯生物合成有限公司
companies.description_zh: 古吉拉特西米斯生物合成有限公司成立於1981年，登記於瓦皮（古吉拉特邦），是印度領先的發酵製藥中間體生產商，專注生產利福黴素S（利福平前體）、利福黴素O（利福昔明前體）和洛伐他汀。2025年5月在瓦皮GIDC工業區新建的多用途合成及發酵API廠正式投產。
companies.description_en: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited (GTBL), incorporated in 1981 and headquartered in Ankleshwar/Vapi (Gujarat), is India's leading manufacturer of fermentation-based pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs. Principal products include Rifamycin S (Rifampicin intermediate), Rifamycin O (Rifaximin intermediate), and Lovastatin. A new multi-purpose synthetic and fermentation API plant commenced commercial production in May 2025.

companies.description_zh: 韓올바이오파마（KOSDAQ:009420）成立於1973年，總部位於大田，專注免疫學、眼科學及腫瘤學抗體藥物研發。2025年總收入1,552億韓元（同比增長12%），主力管線包括Batoclimab（抗FcRn抗體，多種自體免疫病）、HL161ANS/IMVT-1402、Tanfanercept/HL036（乾眼症，III期）及HL192（帕金森）。
companies.description_en: Hanall Biopharma Co., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:009420) was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Daejeon, South Korea. The company focuses on autoimmune, ophthalmology, oncology, and neurology antibody therapeutics. FY2025 revenue reached KRW 155.2 billion (+12% YoY). Key pipeline assets: Batoclimab (anti-FcRn mAb, myasthenia gravis/CIDP/thyroid eye disease), Tanfanercept/HL036 (Phase 3 dry eye), and HL161ANS/IMVT-1402 (next-gen anti-FcRn).

companies.name_zh: 漢康生技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 漢康生技股份有限公司成立於2020年，總部位於台北（同時設有上海及矽谷辦公室），是全球臨床階段免疫腫瘤學公司，依托自主Fc基設計生物製劑（FBDB™）平台開發多功能融合蛋白藥物，管線聚焦腫瘤及免疫介導疾病。累計融資超8,000萬美元，已獲台灣證交所創新板上市批准。
companies.description_en: HanchorBio Co., Ltd. is a global clinical-stage immunology company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Taipei (with offices in Shanghai and San Francisco Bay Area). Its proprietary Fc-Based Designer Biologics (FBDB™) platform enables multifunctional biologics targeting oncology and immune-mediated diseases. HCB101 (immunotherapy) is advancing in global clinical development. The company raised over USD 80 million and received TWSE Innovation Board listing approval in early 2026.

sources.title: HanchorBio Advances Toward TWSE Innovation Board Listing – PR Newswire 2026
TPEx-Listed HanchorBio Advances Global Impact of HCB101 – PR Newswire

companies.name_zh: 涵德製藥股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 涵德製藥股份有限公司成立於2014年，總部位於台南，是主攻美國市場的特殊藥品公司。依托自有ONCORE控釋技術平台，開發多發性硬化症、腫瘤、精神分裂症及胃食管反流等疾病治療藥物，2025年營收17.3億新台幣，年增108%。
companies.description_en: Handa Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical company founded in 2014 in Tainan, Taiwan, focused on developing drugs for the US market. Key products include Tascenso ODT (multiple sclerosis), and its proprietary ONCORE drug delivery platform (oncology). Revenue grew 108% YoY in 2025 to TWD 1.73 billion, driven by US-market specialty pharma launches.

sources.title: Handa Pharmaceuticals (TPEX:6620) Company Profile – Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: 헬릭스미스（原ViroMed，2019年更名）成立於1996年，首爾上市韓國基因治療公司，主要管線為Engensis（VM202），是針對糖尿病周圍神經病變（DPN）的非病毒性質粒DNA基因療法，正在美國進行III期臨床試驗。同時開發CAR-T及AAV向量項目用於神經肌肉疾病。
companies.description_en: Helixmith Co., Ltd. (formerly ViroMed, renamed 2019) is a Seoul-based Korean gene therapy company founded in 1996. Its lead asset Engensis (VM202) is a non-viral plasmid DNA gene therapy for diabetic peripheral neuropathy (Phase III, USA), with additional programs in ALS, claudication, charcot-marie-tooth disease, and coronary artery disease. The company also advances CAR-T (solid tumors) and AAV programs (neuromuscular diseases).

companies.description_zh: HEM Pharma Inc.成立於2016年，總部位於浦項市（韓國），2024年10月在KOSDAQ上市。是以微生物組為核心的醫療公司，透過自主PMAS腸道微生物體仿真技術平台開發個性化健康分析、活性生物治療產品（LBP）及CDMO業務，與安利合作構建了韓國最大規模腸道微生物體數據庫（逾9萬受試者）。
companies.description_en: HEM Pharma Inc. is a microbiome-specialized healthcare company founded in 2016 in Pohang, South Korea, listed on KOSDAQ in October 2024. The company operates personalized gut microbiome analysis services, Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBP) drug discovery (using the proprietary PMAS simulation platform), and CDMO businesses. Strategic partnership with Amway has yielded one of the world's largest gut microbiome databases (90,000+ participants in South Korea).

sources.title: HEM Pharma, debuting on Kosdaq next month, vows to lead microbiome sector – Korea BioMed
Amway and HEM Pharma Deepen Strategic Partnership – Amway Global Newsroom
HEM Pharma Inc Financial Summary – Investing.com

companies.name_zh: 鷺鳥中子醫療股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 鷺鳥中子醫療研發加速器型硼中子捕獲治療（AB-BNCT）系統，為台灣唯一大型放射治療設備本土製造商；2025年在台灣證交所掛牌上市。
companies.description_en: Heron Neutron Medical develops accelerator-based boron neutron capture therapy (AB-BNCT) systems for cancer treatment. Spun from NTHU and ITRI expertise, it is Taiwan's only domestic developer of large-scale radiation therapy equipment; listed on TWSE in September 2025.

sources.title: TWSE new-listed company announcement – Heron Neutron Medical (7799)
Heron Neutron Medical Aims to Go Public – Healthcare+ B2B
Heron Neutron Medical Market Cap – Stock Analysis

companies.name_zh: 海斯特生物科学有限公司
companies.description_zh: 海斯特生物科学是印度第二大禽畜疫苗生产商，拥有超过50种疫苗和35种动物保健品，涵盖禽类疫苗、大型动物疫苗及宠物保健三大板块；在古吉拉特邦Kadi拥有亚洲最大一站式动物生物制品制造基地。
companies.description_en: Hester Biosciences is India's second-largest poultry vaccine manufacturer, producing over 50 vaccines and 35 health products across poultry, large-animal, and petcare segments. Its Kadi facility in Gujarat is billed as Asia's largest integrated animal biologics manufacturing complex.

sources.title: Hester Biosciences 2024-25 Annual Report Analysis – Equitymaster

companies.description_zh: 海卡尔是印度领先的CDMO，服务制药、农药及特种化学品客户，提供原料药研发与合同制造服务；制药厂设于本加罗尔Jigani和古吉拉特Panoli，农药厂位于马哈拉施特拉邦Taloja和Mahad。
companies.description_en: Hikal is a leading Indian CDMO serving pharmaceutical, crop-protection, and specialty-chemical customers, supplying APIs and intermediates and offering research and custom-manufacturing services. Pharma plants are in Jigani (Bengaluru) and Panoli (Gujarat); crop-protection plants in Taloja and Mahad (Maharashtra). FY2025 revenue ₹1,860 crore, +4.5% YoY.

companies.description_zh: HK이노엔是韩国知名制药企业，前身为CJ Healthcare，2020年加入韩国Kolmar集团后更名。旗舰产品K-CAB（替戈拉生）是韩国第30个自主创新药，为P-CAB类胃酸抑制剂，2024年累计韩国门诊处方额突破9,233亿韩元，已在55个国家签署授权协议。2024年营收突破1万亿韩元，成为韩国第8家进入万亿俱乐部的制药企业。
companies.description_en: HK inno.N (formerly CJ Healthcare, joined Kolmar Group in 2018, rebranded 2020) is a leading Korean pharma originator. Its blockbuster K-CAB (tegoprazan) – Korea's 30th new chemical entity, a P-CAB acid-blocker approved 2019 – reached cumulative KRW 923.3 billion in domestic outpatient prescriptions and is licensed in 55 countries. FY2024 revenue broke 1 trillion KRW for the first time (+18.5% YoY).

sources.title: HK inno.N Surpasses 1 Trillion Won in Annual Revenue – BigGo Finance
HK inno.N Phase 3 K-CAB US Trial Results – inno-n.com
HK inno.N Stock Overview – Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: HLB是韩国上市控股公司，通过子公司Elevar Therapeutics开发抗癌创新药利伏西拉尼（Rivoceranib），主攻肝细胞癌。FDA于2024年5月发出完整回应函，重新提交的NDA于2024年10月获受理，PDUFA目标日期为2026年7月。
companies.description_en: HLB Co., Ltd. is a Korean holding company whose subsidiary Elevar Therapeutics is developing rivoceranib (apatinib), a small-molecule TKI, for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in combination with camrelizumab. The FDA issued a CRL in May 2024; the resubmitted NDA was accepted October 2024 with PDUFA date July 23, 2026.

sources.title: Elevar NDA Resubmission Accepted – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: HLB Genex是位于大田的工业酶及生物健康材料专业公司，主要产品包括过氧化氢酶、乳糖酶和UDCAse，子公司GF Fermentech提供精密发酵CDMO服务。
companies.description_en: HLB Genex is a Daejeon-based industrial enzyme and bio-healthcare materials company (formerly GenoFocus). Flagship enzymes include Catalase, Lactase, and UDCAse. Subsidiary GF Fermentech offers precision-fermentation CDMO services covering R&D through commercial production. Q1 2025 consolidated revenue KRW 11.7 billion (+9.3% YoY).

sources.title: HLB Genex Sustains Operating Profit – Seoul Economic Daily
GF Fermentech CDMO Platform – Seoul Economic Daily

companies.description_zh: 휴온스（原光明制药，2003年更名）是韩国领先的综合医药企业，在韩国牙科麻醉药市场占有率超80%；产品涵盖循环系统、麻醉剂、代谢及消化系统药物、抗生素及医疗器械；拥有12家子公司和关联公司。
companies.description_en: Huons (formerly Kwang Myung Pharm, rebranded 2003) is South Korea's leading pharma and injectables company, holding over 80% domestic market share in dental anesthetics. Portfolio spans circulatory, anesthetic, metabolic, digestive, antibiotic products, and medical devices, across 12 subsidiaries. FY2024 revenue ~USD 600 million.

companies.name_zh: 海芬制药国际有限公司
companies.description_zh: 海芬制药是东南亚领先专科药公司，总部新加坡，专注皮肤科、儿科及新生儿科、耳鼻喉科等领域；自有品牌Ceradan®（皮肤屏障）、Ocean Health®（保健品）及CG210®（头皮护理）；在越南、马来西亚、印尼、菲律宾设有分支机构，覆盖10个额外市场。FY2024收入1.95亿新加坡元，同比增长14.6%。
companies.description_en: Hyphens Pharma is ASEAN's leading specialty pharma company (IPO May 2018, SGX Catalist), founded 1998. Segments: specialty pharma distribution (dermatology, paediatrics/neonatology, allergy, ENT, orthopaedics, ophthalmology), and proprietary brands Ceradan® (skin-barrier), Ocean Health® (supplements), CG210® (scalp care). Offices in SG, VN, MY, ID, PH and 10 other markets. FY2024 revenue SGD 195.4 million (+14.6% YoY).

sources.title: Hyphens Pharma Stock Overview – Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: 현대바이오사이언스是韩国生物科技公司，开发口服抗病毒药CP-COV03（活性成分氯硝柳胺，COVID-19 II期临床）及抗肿瘤药Polytaxel（胰腺癌/实体瘤）；同时销售Vitabrid C12维生素C皮肤透皮递送产品。
companies.description_en: Hyundai Bioscience (formerly Hyundai IBT) develops CP-COV03, an oral niclosamide-based antiviral in Phase 2 for COVID-19, and Polytaxel for pancreatic cancer and solid tumors. The company also markets Vitabrid C12, a transdermal vitamin C delivery system. FY2024 revenue KRW 15.05 billion (+58.7% YoY).

sources.title: Hyundai Bioscience Stock Overview – Stock Analysis
Hyundai Bioscience Phase II COVID-19 Trial – Clinical Trials Arena
Hyundai Bioscience Company Profile – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: IBL医疗保健是巴基斯坦领先的医药及营养品营销分销商，为Searle公司子公司，代理美强生营养、雀巢健康科学、Terumo、Meditech等国际品牌；产品涵盖婴儿营养、血浆蛋白、医院耗材及OTC保健品。FY2025营收43.2亿卢比，同比增长20%，创历史最高纪录。
companies.description_en: IBL HealthCare is a subsidiary of The Searle Company Limited and Pakistan's leading health-and-wellness distributor. It markets nutritional products (Mead Johnson, Nestlé Health Science), hospital disposables, vision care, and OTC brands (Stevia-based sweeteners, cold/cough/flu). Incorporated 1997, converted to public limited company 2008. FY2025 revenue PKR 4.32 billion (+20% YoY) – a record high.

sources.title: IBL Healthcare Aims to Triple Revenue by 2030 – Pakistan Today
IBL HealthCare Stock Analysis – Simply Wall St

companies.name_zh: 应用奈米医材科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 应用奈米医材科技是台湾眼科医材公司，研发、生产及销售人工晶体（含白内障、近视、远视、老花及散光用途）及纳米医材，在全球参与约一半的白内障手术供应链；服务台湾、中国、美国、日本、西班牙、英国等市场。
companies.description_en: ICARES Medicus (founded 2011, Zhubei, Taiwan) designs, manufactures, and sells intraocular lenses (IOLs) for cataract, myopia, hyperopia, presbyopia, and astigmatism correction, plus nanomedical devices. Its IOLs are used in roughly half of all cataract surgeries worldwide. Markets: TW, CN, US, JP, ES, UK. FY2024 revenue TWD 859.8 million (+42% YoY).

sources.title: ICARES Medicus Company Profile – Stock Analysis
Taiwanese medtech behind half of all cataract surgeries – CommonWealth Magazine

companies.description_zh: Ikapharmindo Putramas是印度尼西亚上市制药企业，业务涵盖非处方药、处方药及合同制造三个板块，在印尼生产和销售各类药品。2024年营收4,120亿印尼盾，净利润50亿印尼盾。
companies.description_en: PT Ikapharmindo Putramas Tbk is an Indonesian listed pharmaceutical manufacturer operating across Non-Pharma, Pharma, and Contract Manufacturing segments. It researches, develops, manufactures, and markets pharmaceutical products in Indonesia. FY2024 revenue IDR 412.1 billion; net income IDR 5.0 billion.

companies.description_zh: 일동제약创立于1941年，是韩国历史悠久的综合制药企业，1963年推出Aronamin（维生素B1）系列奠定市场地位；现研发重点为肿瘤/免疫肿瘤、内分泌/代谢、肝纤维化及神经系统疾病。2024年营收6,149亿韩元。
companies.description_en: Ildong Pharmaceutical (founded Seoul, 1941) is a century-old Korean pharma originator. Its Aronamin vitamin brand (launched 1963) popularised preventive nutrition in Korea. Current R&D focuses on oncology/immuno-oncology, endocrinology, liver fibrosis, and neurology. FY2024 revenue KRW 614.9 billion (+2.4% YoY); FY2025 revenue declining ~5-6% YoY.

sources.title: Brief History of Ildong Pharmaceuticals – MatrixBCG

companies.description_zh: Imexpharm创立于1977年，总部位于越南同塔省高岭市，是越南头部EU-GMP标准制药企业，拥有3个EU-GMP厂区及12条EU-GMP生产线，是越南最大抗生素生产商；ETC渠道占比持续扩大，2024年注射剂营收占总收入33%；2024年营收22,050亿越南盾（同比+10.6%）。
companies.description_en: Imexpharm (founded 1977, Cao Lanh, Dong Thap Province) is Vietnam's leading EU-GMP pharma company, operating 3 EU-GMP factory clusters with 12 production lines and holding the largest EU-GMP injectable antibiotic capacity in Vietnam. FY2024 net revenue VND 2,205 billion (+10.6% YoY); EU-GMP injectable products = 33% of revenue; ETC channel +56% YoY. FY2025 target VND 2,649 billion.

sources.title: Imexpharm and the Breakthrough of Domestic Pharmaceuticals – VnEconomy

companies.description_zh: 이뮨온시아成立于2016年，是由柳韩양行（Yuhan）与Sorrento合资创立的免疫肿瘤生物技术公司，总部位于城南市。主要管线：IMC-001（抗PD-L1全人IgG1单抗，NK/T细胞淋巴瘤II期及实体瘤）；IMC-002（抗CD47抗体，阻断CD47-SIRPα信号，实体瘤I期）。
companies.description_en: ImmuneOncia Therapeutics (founded 2016, Seongnam; JV of Yuhan and Sorrento) is an immuno-oncology biotech. Lead programs: IMC-001 (fully human anti-PD-L1 IgG1 mAb, Phase 2 in NK/T-cell lymphoma and high-TMB solid tumors with Fc effector function) and IMC-002 (anti-CD47 checkpoint inhibitor, Phase 1 in solid tumors). Revenue is minimal; pre-profit stage with ~9 months cash runway as of late 2024.

sources.title: ImmuneOncia at ESMO 2025 – Korea Biomedical Review

companies.name_zh: 印度斯威夫特实验室有限公司
companies.description_zh: Ind-Swift实验室成立于1995年，是印度API及CDMO企业，同时提供HPAPI及中间体合成、工艺研发和合同制造服务，在全印度拥有6个制造基地及独立研发中心。FY2025营收大幅缩减至56.2亿卢比（同比-67%），员工数量也从逾千人骤降至47人，处于重组阶段。
companies.description_en: Ind-Swift Laboratories (founded 1995, Chandigarh) is an API and CDMO company offering HPAPI manufacturing, process R&D, custom synthesis, and regulatory services from 6 manufacturing sites across India. FY2025 revenue collapsed to INR 5.62 billion (-67% YoY from INR 17.09 billion peak in FY2024) and employee count fell sharply to 47 – company is in restructuring.

companies.description_zh: 印孟制药创立于1954年，总部位于达卡，是孟加拉国上市历史药企，生产和销售各类普通药品、医疗制剂及化学品；近期披露Q2C2026净销售额同比增长67.24%。
companies.description_en: Indo-Bangla Pharmaceuticals Limited (founded 1954, Dhaka) is a Bangladesh-listed generics manufacturer and seller of medicines, medical preparations, and chemicals for domestic and international markets. A small-cap company with 127 employees; recent disclosures indicate net sales revenue increase of 67.24% in the latest reported quarter (Q2C2026). Specific BDT revenue figures not available from public sources.

companies.description_zh: Indoco Remedies创立于1947年8月23日（印度独立后一周），总部位于孟买，是印度上市综合制药企业，拥有7个制剂制造厂和4个API制造厂（共11座工厂）及研发/CRO中心；治疗领域涵盖胃肠道、呼吸、抗感染、口腔医学、眼科、心血管、代谢及糖尿病。FY2025营收166亿卢比，同比下降8.4%，录得净亏损7.37亿卢比。
companies.description_en: Indoco Remedies (founded 23 Aug 1947, Mumbai) is an integrated Indian pharma company with 7 FDF manufacturing plants, 4 API plants, and an R&D/CRO facility. Therapeutic areas: GI, respiratory, anti-infectives, stomatology, ophthalmology, cardiovascular, metabolics, and diabetology. FY2025 revenue INR 16.6 billion (-8.4% YoY); reported net loss of INR 737 million vs. profit in FY2024. Strong in domestic branded generics and regulated-market exports.

sources.title: Indoco Full Year 2025 Earnings – Simply Wall St
Indoco Remedies Stock Overview – Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: PT Indofarma Tbk（IDX:INAF）是印尼国有药企，历史可追溯至1918年荷兰殖民时期的药品工厂。主营仿制药、OTC药品、天然提取物制剂、医疗器械及委托生产服务，通过全国29个分支机构覆盖印尼各地。2024年录得净亏损334.5亿卢比，收入同比大幅萎缩。
companies.description_en: PT Indofarma Tbk (IDX:INAF) is an Indonesian state-owned pharmaceutical and medical device enterprise tracing its origins to a Dutch colonial-era factory in 1918. The company produces branded generics, OTC medicines, natural extracts, medical devices and provides toll manufacturing, supported by 29 branch offices nationwide. It reported a net loss of IDR 334.5 billion in 2024, with revenue declining sharply year-on-year.

companies.description_zh: 因诺瓦卡普塔布（NSE:INNOVACAP）是印度第二大国内制剂合同研发生产组织（CDMO），服务于14家顶级品牌制药公司。两个生产基地分别专注头孢菌素制剂和通用固体制剂生产，FY2024营收约109亿卢比。
companies.description_en: Innova Captab (NSE:INNOVACAP) is India's second-largest domestic formulations CDMO, serving 14 of the top 15 branded pharmaceutical companies in India. Its two plants specialise in cephalosporin formulations and general oral/topical dosage forms respectively. FY2024 revenue was approximately INR 10.9 billion.

sources.title: Innova Captab IC Research Note – JM Financial, Aug 2024

companies.name_zh: 益得生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 益得生技（TPEx:6461）是台湾专注呼吸道疾病药物的生物制药公司，隶属昇陽製藥集团。拥有专利吸入低乙醇制剂平台iLEF（MDI）和干粉吸入剂（DPI），主要开发用于哮喘和COPD的产品，旗下产品包括SYN006（已入三期临床）、SYN010、Synflutide、Duasma等。
companies.description_en: Intech Biopharm (TPEx:6461) is a Taiwan-based biotech focused on inhaled therapies for respiratory diseases, affiliated with Synmosa Group. It owns the proprietary iLEF (inhaled low ethanol formulation) MDI platform and DPI technology, developing products for asthma and COPD under brands including SYN006 (Phase 3), SYN010, Synflutide and Duasma.

sources.title: Intech Biopharm Company Profile – Stock Analysis
Intech Biopharm Partners with North American Company – Taiwan Healthcare

companies.description_zh: Inter Pharma PCL（SET:IP）成立于2006年，是泰国上市药企，主要从事人用药品、保健食品和动物用药的生产、进口与销售，通过人类医疗、动物医疗及医院/诊所三个业务板块运营。2024年营收约19.1亿泰铢。
companies.description_en: Inter Pharma PCL (SET:IP) was founded in 2006 and manufactures, imports and distributes pharmaceutical and dietary supplement products for humans and animals in Thailand through three segments: Human Healthcare, Animal Healthcare, and Hospital & Clinics. Revenue was approximately THB 1.91 billion in 2024.

sources.title: Inter Pharma Company Milestone – Investor Relations

companies.description_zh: IOL化学制药（NSE:IOLCP）成立于1986年，是印度最大的布洛芬原料药（API）生产商，全球市场占有率约35%，同时生产抗糖尿病、降压和抗癫痫等多个治疗领域的原料药及中间体。FY2024营收约213亿卢比。
companies.description_en: IOL Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals (NSE:IOLCP), founded in 1986, is India's largest ibuprofen API manufacturer with ~35% global market share. It also produces APIs and intermediates across pain management, anti-diabetic, anti-hypertensive, and anticonvulsant segments. FY2024 revenue was approximately INR 21.3 billion.

companies.description_zh: ISU Abxis（KOSDAQ:086890）是韩国罕见病和生物类似药专业公司。核心产品包括：治疗高雪病的Abcertin（imiglucerase，2012年获批）和治疗法布里病的Fabagal（agalsidase beta，2014年获批）以及Clotinab（abciximab）。同时推进早期肿瘤管线研发。2024年营收603亿韩元，净利润同比大幅提升。
companies.description_en: ISU Abxis (KOSDAQ:086890) is a Korean biopharmaceutical company focused on rare disease enzyme replacement therapies and biosimilars. Key marketed products include Abcertin (imiglucerase for Gaucher disease, approved 2012), Fabagal (agalsidase beta for Fabry disease, approved 2014), and Clotinab (abciximab). The company also has early-stage oncology pipeline assets. Revenue was KRW 60.3 billion in 2024.

sources.title: ISU Abxis: Charting a New Direction – PharmaBoardroom
ISU303 ERT Shows Promise – Fabry Disease News

companies.description_zh: iX Biopharma（SGX:42C）是新加坡特种药及保健品公司，拥有专利WaferiX舌下给药平台，核心研发管线包括Wafermine（氯胺酮舌下含片，已完成2b期，正进入三期，获美国国防部4095万美元资助）、BnoX（丁丙诺啡舌下含片）和iXB 401（舌下semaglutide，临床前）。
companies.description_en: iX Biopharma (SGX:42C) is a Singapore specialty pharmaceutical company with its proprietary WaferiX sublingual drug delivery platform. Key pipeline assets include Wafermine (sublingual ketamine wafer, completed Phase 2b, entering Phase 3 with US$40.95M DoD funding), BnoX (buprenorphine, Phase 1), and iXB 401 (sublingual semaglutide, pre-clinical). Also commercialises erectile dysfunction and cannabinoid products.

sources.title: iX Biopharma 1H25 Press Release – SGX Filing
iX Biopharma Secures US$40.95M DoD Contract – The Edge Singapore

companies.name_en: Jack Chia Industries (Thailand) Public Company Limited
companies.description_zh: 杰西亚工业（泰国）（SET:JCT）成立于1966年，主营医疗耗材与消费品，产品线涵盖Tigerplast、Tensoplast伤口护理品牌以及香水、沐浴露等化妆品。通过制药产品和消费品两大业务板块运营，2024年营收约8.47亿泰铢。
companies.description_en: Jack Chia Industries Thailand (SET:JCT), founded in 1966, manufactures and distributes pharmaceutical supplies and consumer products in Thailand, including wound care under the Tigerplast and Tensoplast brands, cosmetics (perfumes, soaps, shower gels) and sports tapes. Operates through Pharmaceutical Products and Other Consumer Products segments. Revenue was approximately THB 847 million in 2024.

companies.description_zh: 贾格森帕尔制药（BSE:JAGSNPHARM）成立于1978年，是印度中型制药公司，专注妇科、骨科、皮肤科和儿科领域，提供片剂、软胶囊、注射剂等多种剂型。FY2024营收约21.8亿卢比，FY2025大幅增长至27.7亿卢比。
companies.description_en: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals (BSE:JAGSNPHARM), founded in 1978, is an Indian mid-size pharma company focused on gynaecology, orthopaedics, dermatology, and paediatrics. It manufactures and markets branded pharmaceuticals and APIs across India and internationally. FY2024 revenue was approximately INR 2.18 billion, growing 27% to INR 2.77 billion in FY2025.

companies.description_zh: JB化学制药（NSE:JBCHEPHARM）成立于1976年，是印度领先制药企业，专注胃肠科、心血管、皮肤科等领域，在国内外市场均有品牌产品销售。FY2024营收约348亿卢比，同比增长约12%。2025-2026年，印度Torrent Pharmaceuticals完成收购，持股约48.8%。
companies.description_en: JB Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals (NSE:JBCHEPHARM), founded in 1976, is a leading Indian pharma company with a focus on gastroenterology, cardiovascular, dermatology, and respiratory therapeutic areas. FY2024 revenue was approximately INR 34.84 billion (+12% YoY). In 2025-26, Torrent Pharmaceuticals acquired ~48.8% equity stake, becoming the promoter.

sources.title: JB Pharma Financial Information – Investor Relations

companies.description_zh: 詹伯克特制药（BSE:JENBURPH）成立于1985年，是印度中型制药公司，专注老年病、糖尿病、疼痛管理和保健品领域，产品覆盖抗糖尿病、胃肠、抗生素、骨质疏松等多个治疗类别，出口至13个国家，旗下约85个品牌覆盖逾10万名医生。FY2024营收约14.7亿卢比。
companies.description_en: Jenburkt Pharmaceuticals (BSE:JENBURPH), founded in 1985, is an Indian pharma company focused on geriatrics, diabetes, pain management and nutraceuticals. It markets ~85 brands across anti-diabetic, GI, antibiotic, anti-arthritic, anti-osteoporotic and other categories, exporting to 13 countries. FY2024 revenue was approximately INR 1.47 billion.

companies.name_en: JSP Pharmaceutical Manufacturing (Thailand) Public Company Limited
companies.description_zh: JSP制药生产（泰国）（SET:JSP）成立于1954年，是泰国GMP合同制药生产商，提供药品、保健食品、传统草药和医疗耗材的研发、生产和注册服务，同时提供血液透析产品和纯化水系统，2024年营收约9.6亿泰铢。
companies.description_en: JSP Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Thailand (SET:JSP), founded in 1954, is a Thai GMP contract manufacturer providing R&D, production, and regulatory registration services for pharmaceuticals, dietary supplements, traditional medicines, herbal products, and cosmetics. It also produces haemodialysis supplies and purified water systems. Revenue was approximately THB 960 million in 2024.

companies.description_zh: JW制药（KOSPI:001060）成立于1945年，是韩国综合性制药企业，产品线涵盖镇痛退热药、抗菌药、抗肿瘤药、胃肠道药和静脉输液制剂。关联子公司JW Life Science专注输液产品，2024年集团合并营收约7194亿韩元。
companies.description_en: JW Pharmaceutical Corporation (KOSPI:001060), founded in 1945, is a diversified Korean pharmaceutical group manufacturing analgesics, antipyretics, antimicrobials, anticancer agents, GI agents and IV solutions. Its affiliate JW Life Science specialises in infusion products. Consolidated revenue was approximately KRW 719.4 billion in 2024.

sources.title: JW Pharmaceutical Q1 2026 Results – Seoul Economic Daily

companies.description_zh: PT卡尔贝法玛（IDX:KLBF）成立于1966年，是东南亚最大的上市制药公司，业务涵盖处方药、消费者健康、营养品和配送物流四大板块。内部研发生物制剂Zerpidio（肿瘤用）和Efesa（慢性肾病用）于2024年上市。2024年营收约326亿卢比，净利润324亿卢比。
companies.description_en: PT Kalbe Farma (IDX:KLBF), founded in 1966, is Southeast Asia's largest listed pharmaceutical company with four divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutritionals, and distribution & logistics. In-house biologic drugs Zerpidio (oncology) and Efesa (chronic kidney disease) were launched in 2024. Revenue was IDR 32.63 trillion in 2024 with net profit of IDR 3.24 trillion.

companies.description_zh: 康斯特姆生物科技（KOSDAQ:217730）成立于2010年，是韩国专注于干细胞疗法的生物制药公司。核心管线包括Furestem-AD（特应性皮炎，3期）、Furestem-RA（类风湿关节炎，2b期）、Furestem-CD（克罗恩病）以及骨关节炎适应症的Furestem-OA Kit（1/2a期）。2024年营收77.5亿韩元。
companies.description_en: Kangstem Biotech (KOSDAQ:217730), founded in 2010, is a Korean clinical-stage stem cell therapy company. Core pipeline includes Furestem-AD (atopic dermatitis, Phase 3), Furestem-RA (rheumatoid arthritis, Phase 2b), Furestem-CD (Crohn's disease), and Furestem-OA Kit (osteoarthritis, Phase 1/2a). Revenue was KRW 7.75 billion in 2024.

sources.title: Kangstem Biotech – BIO International Convention Directory

companies.description_zh: 基立奇药业（NSE:KILITCH）成立于1978年，是印度注射剂制药商，在非洲头孢菌素注射剂领域居于领先地位，另有眼科滴剂、泡腾片和OTC营养品等产品线，在印度和埃塞俄比亚设有生产基地。FY2024营收约15.4亿卢比。
companies.description_en: Kilitch Drugs (India) (NSE:KILITCH), founded in 1978, is a sterile injectable pharmaceutical company and one of Africa's largest cephalosporin injectable manufacturers, with manufacturing in India and Ethiopia. Product portfolio includes parenteral, ophthalmic, effervescent and nutraceutical formulations. FY2024 revenue was approximately INR 1.54 billion.

sources.title: Kilitch Drugs Manufacturing Plant – Pharmaceutical Technology

companies.description_zh: PT金马法玛（IDX:KAEF）是印尼历史最悠久的国有制药企业，可追溯至1817年荷兰东印度时期的药房。现为Bio Farma集团子公司，业务涵盖原料药（API）、高功能化学品及制剂生产、分销和零售。2024年营收约9.94万亿卢比，录得净亏损842亿卢比。
companies.description_en: PT Kimia Farma (IDX:KAEF), tracing its history to a 1817 Dutch East Indies apothecary, is Indonesia's oldest state-owned pharmaceutical enterprise and a subsidiary of Bio Farma group. It manufactures APIs, high-function chemicals and finished dosage forms, with integrated distribution and retail pharmacy operations. Revenue was IDR 9.94 trillion in 2024 with a net loss of IDR 842 billion.

companies.description_zh: 可隆生命科学（KOSPI:102940）成立于2000年，是韩国可隆集团旗下生命科学子公司，主营化学事业和生物事业两大板块。旗舰产品Invossa（退行性骨关节炎基因治疗）是全球首个细胞介导基因疗法，目前管线还包括神经性疼痛候选药KLS-2031。2024年营收1614亿韩元（同比增长29%）。
companies.description_en: Kolon Life Science (KOSPI:102940), founded in 2000 as a subsidiary of Kolon Group, operates Chemical and Bio business divisions. Its flagship Invossa is the world's first cell-mediated gene therapy for degenerative osteoarthritis. The pipeline also includes KLS-2031 for neuropathic pain (Phase 1/2a completed). Revenue was KRW 161.4 billion in 2024, up 29% YoY, with a return to profitability driven by the chemical division.

sources.title: Kolon Life Science Turns Profit in Chemicals Biz – KBR

companies.description_zh: 科隆组织基因是韩国科隆集团旗下的生物科技子公司，专注于膝关节骨性关节炎和其他骨骼肌肉疾病的细胞与基因疗法研发。核心候选药物TG-C（原Invossa）是全球首个针对骨关节炎的细胞基因疗法，在美国正进行三期临床试验，患者给药已完成，2026年7月完成随访后将申请美国FDA批准。
companies.description_en: Kolon TissueGene is the biotech subsidiary of Korea's Kolon Group, developing cell and gene therapies for knee osteoarthritis and musculoskeletal disorders. Its lead candidate TG-C (formerly Invossa) is the world's first cell-gene therapy for osteoarthritis; U.S. Phase 3 dosing completed and BLA filing expected following patient follow-up through July 2026. The Korean license was revoked in 2019 due to a cell-line disclosure error; U.S. FDA clinical hold lifted in 2020 after safety data review.

sources.title: Kolon TissueGene OARSI 2025 Press Release – PR Newswire

companies.description_zh: 科米法玛国际1972年创立，韩国领先的动物健康公司，生产并出口兽用疫苗（包括猪传染性疾病综合疫苗、牛炭疽病疫苗）、兽用药物、消毒剂及生物肥料。公司亦在人类健康领域开展抗癌药研发及临床病理检测服务。
companies.description_en: Founded in 1972, Komipharm International is a leading South Korean animal health company manufacturing and exporting veterinary vaccines (swine respiratory, cattle anthrax/blackleg), veterinary pharmaceuticals, disinfectants, and bio-fertilizers. The company also operates human health R&D in anticancer drugs and clinical pathology testing.

companies.description_zh: 科普兰制药1958年成立，是印度一家全产业链制药企业，在孟买设总部，在马哈拉施特拉邦Khopoli（制剂）和Mahad（API）设有生产基地，产品涵盖成品制剂和原料药，出口至全球多个市场。
companies.description_en: Founded in 1958, Kopran Limited is a fully-integrated Indian pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai, manufacturing finished dosage forms at its Khopoli, Maharashtra facility and active pharmaceutical ingredients at its Mahad, Maharashtra API plant. Products span formulations and consumer healthcare, with global export presence.

companies.description_zh: 科特拉工业1982年在马来西亚马六甲州成立，从事制药和健康产品的开发、制造和贸易。旗下三大品牌：Appeton（OTC营养保健品）、Axcel（儿科及皮肤科处方药）及Vaxcel（无菌抗生素注射剂）。FY2025营收RM2.31亿。
companies.description_en: Kotra Industries Berhad, incorporated 1982 and headquartered in Malacca, Malaysia, develops, manufactures and trades pharmaceutical and healthcare products under three principal brands: Appeton (OTC nutraceuticals and supplements), Axcel (prescription products for pediatrics and dermatology), and Vaxcel (sterile antibiotic injectables). FY2025 revenue of RM 230.8 million.

sources.title: Kotra Industries Berhad – Stock Analysis Overview
Kotra Industries FY2025 Earnings – Simply Wall St

companies.description_zh: 光丽生物科技控股（原光丽光电）2012年创立，在台湾和中国大陆生产用于手机、数码相机及医疗设备的盖板玻璃/镜片组件，同时从事生物科技产品（化妆品、护肤品、健康食品）的研发销售。公司正从光电制造向大健康领域转型。
companies.description_en: Kuangli Bio-Tech Holdings (formerly Kuangli Photoelectric Technology), founded 2012, manufactures cover lens panels used in mobile phones, digital cameras, and medical equipment in Taiwan and China. The company is also developing biotech products including cosmetics, skincare, and health food products, reflecting a pivot from optics manufacturing toward health & wellness.

sources.title: Kuangli Bio-Tech Holdings Company Profile – Stock Analysis
Kuangli Bio-Tech Holdings – Simply Wall St Information

companies.description_zh: 广东制药1963年创立，韩国综合型制药集团，业务涵盖药品（处方药、OTC）、矿泉水、医院及药店分销等五大板块。以'비타500'能量饮料等OTC健康产品见称，同时生产心血管、中枢神经系统等多类处方药。FY2024营收约1.64万亿韩元。
companies.description_en: Founded in 1963, Kwang Dong Pharmaceutical is a diversified South Korean pharma group with five segments: prescription drugs, OTC products (including the popular Vita500 energy drink), mineral water, pharmacy distribution, and hospital sales. The company manufactures cardiovascular, CNS, anti-allergic, and other drug categories alongside its beverage operations. FY2024 revenue approximately KRW 1.64 trillion.

sources.title: Kwang Dong Pharmaceutical Income Statement – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 拉克希米有机工业1989年创立，是印度领先的专特化工品制造商，在乙酸乙酯市场占有率超30%，并是印度唯一的双乙烯酮（Diketene）衍生物生产商。产品服务制药、农化、食品包装、涂料等多个下游行业，在马哈拉施特拉邦Mahad和Lote设有大型生产基地。
companies.description_en: Founded 1989, Laxmi Organic Industries is a leading Indian specialty chemical manufacturer with over 30% domestic market share in ethyl acetate and the sole Indian manufacturer of diketene derivatives. Two business segments—Acetyl Intermediates and Specialty Intermediates—serve pharmaceutical, agrochemical, food-packaging, coatings and dye industries. Manufacturing at Mahad and Lote, Maharashtra.

sources.title: Laxmi Organic Annual Reports – Company IR

companies.description_zh: L&C BIO 2011年创立于韩国城南，专注组织再生医学研发，产品涵盖人体组织（皮肤、骨骼等）、医疗设备和化妆品。旗下核心产品Re2O是一种高端细胞外基质（ECM）再生溶液，在中国、日本和东南亚市场迅速扩张，已成为韩国医疗旅游的热门项目。
companies.description_en: Founded 2011 in Seongnam, South Korea, L&C BIO is a tissue regeneration medicine R&D company offering human tissue products (skin, bone), medical devices, and cosmetics. Its premium Re2O extracellular matrix (ECM) regenerative solution has become a top K-Medical tourism procedure, with rapid growth in China, Japan, and Southeast Asia. Revenue grew 34% YoY to KRW 98.1 billion (TTM).

sources.title: L&C Bio Re2O K-Medical Tour Procedure – Korea Herald

companies.sub_sector: tissue regeneration medicine / human tissue grafts

companies.description_zh: 利伯拉输液1985年创立，是孟加拉国最大的静脉输液（生理盐水等IV Fluid）生产商，工厂位于达卡Mirpur工业区，占地约2英亩，产品为重症救治基本物资。公司未能按时召开AGM，财务披露自2021年起延迟，2025年DSE现场核查显示运营状态仍正常。
companies.description_en: Founded in 1985 (DSE record: 1976) with Swiss technical support, Libra Infusions is Bangladesh's largest manufacturer of intravenous (IV) saline and infusion fluids, operating a factory at Mirpur Industrial Estate, Dhaka. The company has had delayed financial disclosures since FY2021 due to AGM scheduling issues; a DSE inspection confirmed ongoing operations. Revenue data only verifiable through FY2019 at BDT 197 million.

sources.title: Libra Infusions DSE Overview – Stock Analysis
DSE Confirms Libra Infusions Still in Operation – TBS News

companies.name_zh: 利卡姆生物科学（原乐高化学生物科学）
companies.description_zh: 利卡姆生物科学（2024年4月由乐高化学生物科学更名）2006年创立于韩国大田，是全球领先的ADC（抗体药物偶联物）技术平台公司，自主研发ConjuAll连接子-有效载荷技术。已与强生、安进、武田等多家大型药企达成多项ADC许可合作，潜在里程碑总额超过30亿美元。2025年R&D支出约2169亿韩元，超过当年营收。
companies.description_en: LigaChem Biosciences (renamed from LegoChem Biosciences in April 2024), founded 2006 in Daejeon, is a leading global ADC technology platform company with proprietary ConjuAll linker-payload technology. Major license deals include J&J/Janssen (LCB84 Trop2 ADC, up to USD 1.7B), Amgen (5-target ADC collaboration, up to USD 1.25B), and Takeda (next-gen ADC research). R&D spend of KRW 216.9B in FY2025 exceeded total revenue of KRW 141.6B, reflecting the company's pipeline-first model.

sources.title: LegoChem Biosciences – Amgen ADC License – BioSpace
LegoChem LCB84 J&J License – Business Wire

companies.description_zh: 林肯制药1979年创立于印度艾哈迈达巴德，在古吉拉特邦Khatraj和Mehsana设有生产基地，产品出口至60多个国家，目标3年内实现出口90个国家。公司以仿制药制剂和API制造为核心，FY2025营收约62.3亿卢比，10年CAGR达10%。
companies.description_en: Lincoln Pharmaceuticals, founded 1979 in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, is an Indian generics manufacturer with production facilities in Khatraj and Mehsana, Gujarat. The company exports to over 60 countries and targets 90-country reach within 3 years. FY2025 revenue approximately INR 6.23 billion (+7.4% YoY), with a 10-year revenue CAGR of 10%.

companies.description_zh: 利文制药前身为地标纺纱工业，2024年11月更名并转型为制药公司，在巴基斯坦生产和销售药品。公司规模极小（员工41人），目前处于转型初期，营收较小且亏损，战略方向尚在调整中。
companies.description_en: Liven Pharma Limited, formerly Landmark Spinning Industries Limited, pivoted to pharmaceutical manufacturing and changed its name in November 2024. Based in Lahore, Pakistan, the company is in early-stage transition with 41 employees, minimal revenue (PKR 99 million TTM), and ongoing operating losses. Listed on PSX.

sources.title: Liven Pharma Company Profile – Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: 路摩沙治疗2000年创立于台湾台北，是一家临床阶段生物制药公司，聚焦神经及肿瘤疾病治疗。核心产品Naldebain（LT-1001）为术后重度疼痛镇痛注射剂（已获批）；LT3001处于II期临床（急性缺血性脑卒中）；LT5001完成I期临床（尿毒症瘙痒症）；另有LT6001和LT2003处于临床前阶段。
companies.description_en: Founded 2000 in Taipei, Lumosa Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech focused on neurological and oncological diseases. Approved product: Naldebain (LT-1001), an analgesic injection for post-surgical severe pain. Pipeline: LT3001 in Phase 2 for acute ischemic stroke; LT5001 completed Phase 1 for uremic pruritus; LT6001 and LT2003 in preclinical stage. Revenue declining as product launch ramps.

sources.title: Lumosa Therapeutics Company Profile – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 卢尼特2013年创立于韩国首尔，是领先的AI医疗影像软件公司，专注癌症诊断和治疗。旗下产品包括胸部X光和乳腺摄影AI检测方案（Lunit INSIGHT）和肿瘤微环境AI生物标志物分析平台（Lunit SCOPE）。2024年以1940亿韩元收购新西兰乳腺健康AI公司Volpara Health（已于2025年11月整合为Lunit品牌）。前三季度2025年累计营收达566.5亿韩元，同比增长66%。
companies.description_en: Founded 2013 in Seoul, Lunit provides AI-powered software for cancer diagnostics and therapeutics. Products: Lunit INSIGHT (chest X-ray and mammography AI detection) and Lunit SCOPE (AI biomarker for immune phenotyping and PD-L1 analysis). Acquired Volpara Health (breast health AI) for USD 194 million in 2024; Volpara fully rebranded under Lunit in November 2025. Q1-Q3 2025 cumulative revenue KRW 56.65 billion (+66% YoY). Partnership with AstraZeneca for lung cancer mutation prediction AI.

sources.title: Lunit Completes Volpara Acquisition – Lunit IR
Lunit Q3 2025 IR Letter – Company IR

companies.description_zh: 马克特国际1992年创立于巴基斯坦卡拉奇，是一家制药合同制造商，为跨国药企提供固体和液体口服制剂（片剂、胶囊、糖浆、干粉等）的委托生产服务，涵盖抗生素、抗过敏、心血管、抗病毒等多个治疗领域。FY2025营收约119.5亿巴基斯坦卢比，同比增长约30%。
companies.description_en: Founded 1992 in Karachi, Macter International is a contract pharmaceutical manufacturer providing solid and liquid oral dosage forms (tablets, capsules, syrups, suspensions, dry powders) to healthcare companies in Pakistan. Therapeutic areas include antibiotics, anti-allergy, cardiovascular, and anti-viral categories. FY2025 revenue approximately PKR 11.95 billion (+30% YoY), with earnings growth of 91%.

companies.name_zh: 马来西亚基因资源中心
companies.description_zh: 马来西亚基因资源中心2004年创立，是马来西亚领先的基因组和精准医疗服务提供商，提供基因组测序、遗传筛查、合同研究及先进细胞疗法（含免疫细胞治疗）和化妆品活性成分等服务，在Bursa Malaysia上市。TTM营收约930万马币，规模较小但正快速增长。
companies.description_en: Founded 2004, Malaysian Genomics Resource Centre (MGRC) is Malaysia's pioneer personalised healthcare company offering genetics and genomics services (sequencing, genetic screening), contract R&D, cell-based therapies, and cosmeceutical active ingredients. Listed on Bursa Malaysia. TTM revenue MYR 9.33 million (up 83% YoY); small but growing rapidly.

sources.title: Malaysian Genomics Resource Centre – Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: 马克尚斯制药1992年创立于印度孟买，是面向美国、英国和欧洲市场的仿制药制造商，以OTC产品为核心（占营收约74%），覆盖止痛、感冒咳嗽、消化、维生素等品类。FY2025营收创历史新高262.3亿卢比（同比增长20.5%），美国市场增长35%。2023年收购Teva位于果阿的制造基地，进一步扩大印度产能。
companies.description_en: Founded 1992 in Mumbai, Marksans Pharma is an India-based generics manufacturer focused on US, UK, and European OTC and prescription markets. OTC (pain management, cough/cold, digestive, vitamins) represents ~74% of revenue; Rx includes cardiovascular, CNS, and oncology. FY2025 record revenue INR 26.23 billion (+20.5% YoY), with US growing 35%. Acquired Teva Pharma India's Goa manufacturing site in April 2023, doubling Indian capacity.

sources.title: Marksans Pharma Annual Report FY2024-25 – Company IR

revenue.note_en: FY2025 revenue IDR 14.89 trillion (+2.2% YoY); net profit IDR 398.1 billion (+16% YoY)
revenue.note_zh: 2025财年收入14.89万亿印尼盾（同比+2.2%）；净利润3,981亿印尼盾（同比+16%）

companies.description_zh: PT Medela Potentia Tbk成立于2011年，隶属Argon集团，是印度尼西亚的医药与医疗健康产品分销控股公司，通过子公司Anugrah Argon Medica（AAM）及Djembatan Dua（DD）覆盖印尼及柬埔寨。2025财年收入14.89万亿印尼盾（同比+2.2%），净利润增长16%至3,981亿印尼盾。
companies.description_en: PT Medela Potentia Tbk, founded 2011 as part of the Argon Group, is an Indonesian pharmaceutical and healthcare products distribution holding company operating through subsidiaries Anugrah Argon Medica (AAM) and Djembatan Dua (DD) across Indonesia and Cambodia. FY2025 revenue IDR 14.89 trillion (+2.2% YoY), with net profit growing 16% to IDR 398.1 billion.

sources.title: PT Medela Potentia Double Digit Profit Growth FY2025 – VOI
PT Medela Potentia – Stock Analysis Overview
Medela Potentia FY2025 Dividend Announcement – Company IR

companies.description_en: Indian pharmaceutical manufacturer engaged in developing, producing, marketing and exporting formulations across oncology, cardiology, CNS, diabetology, anti-infectives and pain management in tablet, capsule, syrup, ointment, and ORS formats.

sources.title: Business Standard – Medicamen Biotech quarterly results

companies.description_en: Taiwan biopharmaceutical company focused on novel drug development (OBP-301 oncolytic adenovirus for solid tumors, NK cell therapy for colon/pancreatic cancer), vaccine production, molecular diagnostics, and generic drugs; parent of Medigen Vaccine Biologics (6547).

sources.title: Medigen Biotechnology Corp Company Profile – GlobalData

companies.description_en: Taiwan vaccine biotech company developing and commercializing COVID-19 vaccines, enterovirus A71 vaccine (Envacgen), quadrivalent influenza vaccine, dengue, and RSV vaccine candidates; facilities at Hsinchu Biomedical Science Park in Zhubei.

companies.name_zh: 美迪博斯特股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 韩国干细胞与脐血库企业，旗下三大业务：CELLTREE脐血库、干细胞疗法（CARTISTEM软骨退行性变、PNEUMOSTEM支气管肺发育不良）及健康功能食品；2024年CARTISTEM销售额逾200亿韩元。
companies.description_en: South Korean cord blood bank and stem cell therapeutics company operating CELLTREE cord blood bank, CARTISTEM (cartilage degeneration / osteoarthritis) and PNEUMOSTEM (bronchopulmonary dysplasia) therapeutics, and health functional food division; over 30,000 CARTISTEM patients treated by mid-2024.
companies.sub_sector: cord blood bank / stem cell therapy

companies.name_zh: 美普拉斯健康服务有限公司
companies.description_zh: 印度第二大连锁药店，覆盖13个邦、逾5100家门店（2026年），提供药品零售、保健品、诊断服务及自有品牌仿制药；总部位于海得拉巴。
companies.description_en: India's second-largest pharmacy retail chain operating 5,100+ stores across 13 states (2026), offering pharmaceutical retail, wellness products, diagnostics services, and private-label generic medicines; headquartered in Hyderabad.

companies.name_zh: 美迪托克斯股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 韩国生物制药公司，专注肉毒杆菌毒素制剂，主要产品包括Neuronox（小儿脑瘫痉挛治疗）、INNOTOX（液态眉间纹注射）及Coretox，投入超过总销售额15%用于研发；主要设施位于忠清北道Ochang。
companies.description_en: South Korean biopharmaceutical company specializing in botulinum toxin products including Neuronox (pediatric spasticity), INNOTOX (liquid-formulation glabellar wrinkles), and Coretox; invests >15% of revenue in R&D; manufacturing and R&D in Ochang, Chungbuk.

companies.name_zh: 美格生命科学公众有限公司
companies.description_zh: 泰国领先制药与健康产品企业，以Mega We Care品牌运营，在35个国家销售保健补充剂、处方药、OTC及草药产品；三大业务部门：品牌、分销与OEM。
companies.description_en: Thailand-based leading pharmaceutical and nutraceutical company operating under the Mega We Care brand across 35 countries; manufactures and distributes health food supplements, prescription pharmaceuticals, OTC, herbal products and vitamins through Brands, Distribution, and OEM segments.

companies.description_zh: 韩国罕见病生物制药公司，主要资产为JURVIGO（乌地那非），一种高选择性口服PDE5抑制剂，正在进行全球最大规模的Fontan患者III期临床试验（FUEL-2），旨在改善单心室先天性心脏病患者的运动耐量。
companies.description_en: South Korean rare-disease biopharmaceutical company developing JURVIGO (udenafil), a selective oral PDE5 inhibitor in Phase 3 (FUEL-2 trial) for Fontan physiology patients with single-ventricle congenital heart disease; formerly Dong-A Pharmtech; US patent coverage into early 2040s.

companies.name_zh: 中天生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 台湾生技公司，研发、生产及销售生物技术药物与保健食品，代表产品有MS-20（化疗副作用缓解）及Herbiron（缺铁性贫血/痛经治疗）；另涉及有机食品、饮料及技术咨询。
companies.description_en: Taiwan biotech company researching, developing, manufacturing and trading biotech drugs and dietary supplements; lead products include MS-20 for chemotherapy-related fatigue/anorexia and Herbiron for iron-deficiency anemia and dysmenorrhea; also trades organic foods and beverages.

companies.name_zh: 莫里本实验室有限公司
companies.description_zh: 印度原料药与医疗器械领先企业，出口逾80个国家；API产品线涵盖抗组胺、抗哮喘、调脂、降压、降糖等；家用诊断品牌Dr. Morepen涵盖血压计、血糖仪等点诊产品；总部位于古尔加翁。
companies.description_en: Indian API and home diagnostics leader exporting to 80+ countries; APIs span antihistamines, antiasthmatics, antilipemics, antihypertensives, antidiabetics; consumer health brand Dr. Morepen covers blood pressure monitors, glucose meters, nebulizers; debt-free; headquartered in Gurugram.

companies.name_zh: 永昕生物医药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 台湾生物制药CDMO，提供细胞系开发、工艺开发、药物特征分析、检测方法建立及PIC/S GMP药品生产服务；业务覆盖台湾、日本、韩国、新加坡及欧美；位于新竹竹北Hsinchu生物医学科学园区。
companies.description_en: Taiwan biologics CDMO offering cell line development, process development, drug characterization, testing method establishment, and PIC/S GMP manufacturing; services biopharmaceutical clients in Taiwan, Japan, Korea, Singapore, Europe and the US; facilities in Zhubei, Hsinchu.

companies.description_zh: 韩国多元化企业（前身RNL Sammi），2013年更名；业务涵盖健康功能食品（果汁、芦荟饮料、咖啡、韩国酱料）、干细胞研究、内皮祖细胞/血小板富血浆保存服务及化妆品。
companies.description_en: South Korean diversified company (formerly RNL Sammi, renamed 2013) operating in canned and health functional foods (fruit drinks, aloe vera, coffee, Korean sauces under SAMMI/OEM brands), stem cell cosmetics, and blood cell preservation services (endothelial progenitor cells, platelet rich plasma).

companies.name_zh: 纳瓦纳制药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 孟加拉国制药企业，从事人用及兽用药品的生产、市场营销与分销，剂型涵盖片剂、胶囊、注射剂、眼鼻液等；2020年改制为上市公司，2022年在达卡证券交易所挂牌。
companies.description_en: Bangladesh pharmaceutical company manufacturing, marketing and distributing human (tablets, capsules, suspensions, creams, injections, eye/nasal drops) and veterinary drug products; converted to public limited company 2020; listed on DSE and CSE in 2022.

sources.title: Navana Pharma to go public – The Business Standard

companies.name_zh: 那微弗斯股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 台湾医疗设备公司（2025年3月在台湾柜买中心上市），研发神经导航引导聚焦超声系统（NaviFUS System），通过开放血脑屏障（BBB）靶向递送CNS肿瘤药物；临床管线涵盖复发性胶质母细胞瘤（rGBM）、耐药性癫痫（DRE）及阿尔茨海默病。
companies.description_en: Taiwan medtech company (listed TPEx March 2025) developing neuronavigation-guided focused ultrasound systems enabling transient blood-brain barrier opening for targeted CNS drug delivery; clinical pipeline includes recurrent glioblastoma (rGBM), drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE), Alzheimer's disease, and stroke rehabilitation.

sources.title: NaviFUS Company Profile – Focused Ultrasound Foundation

companies.name_zh: 花蜜生命科学有限公司
companies.description_zh: 印度头孢菌素原料药及制剂专家，生产头孢菌素中间体（头孢氨苄、头孢呋辛酯、头孢曲松等）及口服/注射制剂，向全球约75个国家出口；总部位于昌迪加尔。
companies.description_en: Indian cephalosporin API and formulation specialist manufacturing cephalosporin intermediates (cefixime, cefuroxime axetil, ceftriaxone sodium, etc.) and finished dosage forms (tablets, capsules, dry powder suspensions, injectables) exported to ~75 countries; headquartered in Chandigarh.

companies.description_zh: 印度领先原料药企业，生产并销售活性药物成分（API）及提供定制开发与生产（CDMO）服务，并开展多肽合成业务，出口美国、欧洲及全球；FY2024总收入15.71亿卢比，EBITDA利润率30.2%；总部位于海得拉巴。
companies.description_en: India's leading API manufacturer producing and selling active pharmaceutical ingredients in India, Europe, the US and internationally; also provides custom manufacturing solutions and peptide synthesis services; FY2024 revenue ₹1,571 crore, EBITDA margin 30.2%; headquartered in Hyderabad.

companies.description_zh: 韩国NGS精准诊断公司，开发NGS体外诊断（IVD）及伴随诊断（CDx）产品和生物信息学软件；核心产品包括BRCAaccuTest（乳腺癌/卵巢癌）、HEMEaccuTest（血液肿瘤）、SOLIDaccuTest、MTBaccuPanel（结核/非结核分枝杆菌）等；总部位于首尔九老区。
companies.description_en: South Korean NGS molecular diagnostics company developing IVD panel and companion diagnostic products with bioinformatics software; key products include BRCAaccuTest (breast/ovarian cancer), HEMEaccuTest (hematological malignancies), SOLIDaccuTest (solid tumors), MTBaccuPanel (TB/NTM), and HLAaccuTest; headquartered in Guro-gu, Seoul.

companies.description_zh: NKMax（原ATGen）是一家韩国生物技术公司，专注于NK细胞疗法、重组蛋白、单克隆抗体及免疫细胞活性检测产品。2024年4月申请破产，2025年9月被NKGen Biotech收购。
companies.description_en: NKMax (formerly ATGen) is a Korean biotech focused on NK cell therapy, recombinant proteins, monoclonal antibodies, and immune cell activity test kits. Filed for bankruptcy in April 2024; acquired by NKGen Biotech out of bankruptcy in September 2025.

companies.description_en: Nova Wellness Group Berhad, through Nova Laboratories Sdn Bhd, develops, produces and sells nutraceutical and skincare products under house brands and provides contract manufacturing services; upgraded to Bursa Main Market in February 2021.

companies.description_en: OB Holdings manufactures fortified food & beverage and dietary supplements, and provides contract packing services (milk powder, tea, honey, herb powder); house brands include Bonlife, GoHerb, and Zen Night. Manufacturing services contributed ~62% of FY24 revenue.

sources.title: OB Holdings Realigning For Greater Wellness - I3investor

companies.description_zh: OBI Pharma是台湾临床阶段肿瘤公司，专注于糖类抗原靶向疗法及ADC平台（GlycOBI），核心管线包括Adagloxad simolenin（三阴性乳腺癌Phase 3）、OBI-992及OBI-999 ADC。
companies.description_en: OBI Pharma is a Taiwan-based clinical-stage oncology company specializing in glycan-targeting therapies and its GlycOBI ADC platform; lead pipeline includes Adagloxad simolenin (Phase 3, TNBC), OBI-833, OBI-3424, OBI-992, and OBI-999 ADC.

companies.description_zh: OliX制药是韩国临床阶段RNAi治疗公司，专注于皮肤、眼科及肺部疾病，采用专有cp-asiRNA技术；2025年与礼来签订最高6.3亿美元授权合同。
companies.description_en: OliX Pharmaceuticals is a Korean clinical-stage RNAi therapeutics company focused on dermal, ophthalmic, and pulmonary diseases using proprietary cp-asiRNA technology; signed a deal with Eli Lilly worth up to USD 630 million in February 2025.

companies.description_zh: Onconic Therapeutics是韩国Jeil Pharmaceutical子公司，已获批产品为JAQBO（zastaprazan，钾离子竞争性酸阻断剂），用于糜烂性食管炎和胃溃疡；研发管线涵盖肿瘤及DDR领域。2024年12月在KOSDAQ上市。
companies.description_en: Onconic Therapeutics, a Jeil Pharmaceutical subsidiary, holds MFDS-approved JAQBO (zastaprazan, P-CAB) for erosive esophagitis and gastric ulcer; pipeline includes OCN-201 (cancer) and DDR/immuno-oncology programs. IPO on KOSDAQ in December 2024.

sources.title: Onconic Therapeutics Nesuparib Licensing - Seoul Economic Daily

companies.description_zh: 兰花制药是印度著名头孢菌素API和制剂制造商，已发现并拥有新化学实体恩美他唑巴坦（enmetazobactam）——目前在美国、欧洲和印度获批，是印度唯一发现NCE的公司之一；现为Dhanuka Laboratories子公司。
companies.description_en: Orchid Pharma manufactures oral and sterile cephalosporin APIs and finished dosage forms; discovered enmetazobactam (NCE), approved in US/EU/India; India's only USFDA-approved plant for sterile cephalosporins; subsidiary of Dhanuka Laboratories.

companies.description_zh: PT Organon Pharma Indonesia（原PT Schering-Plough Indonesia，后更名为PT MSD Pharma Indonesia）是全球Organon集团印度尼西亚上市子公司，制造并销售处方药、避孕药及健康产品；1990年在IDX上市。
companies.description_en: PT Organon Pharma Indonesia Tbk (formerly Schering-Plough Indonesia, then MSD Pharma Indonesia) is the IDX-listed subsidiary of global Organon; manufactures and distributes prescription medicines, contraceptives, and consumer health products. Listed on IDX since 1990.

sources.title: Organon Pharma Indonesia Revenue Rp3.09 Trillion

companies.description_zh: 友霖生技医药是东洲欧化药业（Orient EuroPharma）旗下新药研发及CDMO子公司，产品涵盖心血管用药Pitator/Tonvasca及精神神经科用药；主要贡献来自降脂药销售。
companies.description_en: Orient Pharma, a new drug development and CDMO subsidiary of Orient EuroPharma, offers cardiovascular agents (Pitator, Tonvasca, Zulitor) and CNS drugs; listed on TPEx since 2008.

companies.description_zh: 猎户座制药（孟加拉）成立于1965年，是孟加拉国领先的制药企业之一，生产片剂、胶囊、注射剂及疫苗，并涉足电力供应业务；2013年在达卡及吉大港证券交易所上市。
companies.description_en: Orion Pharma Ltd., incorporated in 1965, is a leading Bangladeshi pharmaceutical company manufacturing tablets, capsules, injections, vaccines, and consumer health products; also generates and supplies electricity; listed on DSE and CSE in 2013.

sources.title: Orion Pharma DSE:ORIONPHARM Revenue - Stock Analysis

companies.description_zh: Orum Therapeutics是韩国（大田）和美国（列克星敦）双据点的生物技术公司，专注于降解剂-抗体偶联物（DAC）及靶向蛋白降解技术；2025年与Vertex签订最高9.3亿美元合同，并于2025年12月完成约1亿美元融资。2025年2月在KOSDAQ上市。
companies.description_en: Orum Therapeutics pioneers degrader-antibody conjugates (DACs) combining antibody-drug conjugate with targeted protein degradation; operations in Daejeon (KR) and Lexington (MA); Vertex deal up to USD 930M (3 targets); USD 100M funding in Dec 2025; KOSDAQ IPO Feb 2025.

companies.description_zh: Oscotec是韩国（城南）生物技术公司，从事新药研发（激酶抑制剂）、功能材料及牙科骨移植材料，核心管线包括cevidoplenib（SYK抑制剂，已授权Agios获1.65亿美元）、lazertinib（EGFR，授权Yuhan/杨森）及SKI-G-801（FLT3/AXL，AML）。
companies.description_en: Oscotec is a Korean biotech with divisions in drug development (kinase inhibitors), functional materials, and dental bone graft; key assets: cevidoplenib (SYK inhibitor, licensed to Agios for USD 165M), lazertinib (3rd-gen EGFR, licensed to Yuhan/J&J), and SKI-G-801 (FLT3/AXL for AML).

companies.description_zh: 大冢制药巴基斯坦是日本大冢制药的间接子公司，主营静脉输液制造、医疗设备及临床营养品；产品覆盖巴基斯坦和阿富汗市场，1988年注册成立。
companies.description_en: Otsuka Pakistan Limited is an indirect subsidiary of Otsuka Pharmaceutical Company, Japan; manufactures, markets, and distributes intravenous infusions, medical devices, and clinical nutrition products in Pakistan and Afghanistan; incorporated in 1988.

companies.description_zh: 帕纳西亚生物技术是印度领先的疫苗和制药公司，疫苗组合包括EasySix六联疫苗、EasyFive、bOPV，管线含DengiALL登革热疫苗和NucoVac 11肺炎疫苗；总部位于新德里。
companies.description_en: Panacea Biotec is a leading Indian biotech engaged in vaccines (EasySix, EasyFive, bOPV), pharmaceutical formulations, and nutraceuticals; pipeline includes DengiALL (dengue) and NucoVac 11 (pneumococcal) vaccines.

companies.description_zh: PanGen Biotech是韩国（水原）生物制药公司，专注于生物类似药（EPO、重组凝血因子VIII、G-CSF、Aflibercept）的研发和合同制造（CDMO），提供CHO细胞株及GMP生产一体化服务。
companies.description_en: PanGen Biotech is a Korean biosimilar and CDMO company in Suwon; products include biosimilar EPO, recombinant Factor VIII, G-CSF, and Aflibercept; offers CHO cell line development through GMP production as one-stop services.

companies.description_zh: Parabolic Drugs是印度（昌迪加尔）API及中间体制造商，产品涵盖半合成青霉素、头孢菌素、心血管及NSAID等非抗生素API；2019年被Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals收购，市值极小。
companies.description_en: Parabolic Drugs manufactures APIs and intermediates including semi-synthetic penicillins, cephalosporins, and non-antibiotic APIs (cardiovascular, NSAID, anti-hypertensive); acquired by Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals in 2019; micro-cap with thin liquidity.

companies.description_zh: Parataxis Korea（原Bridge Biotherapeutics，2025年8月更名）是韩国临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于溃疡性结肠炎（BBT-401，Pellino-1抑制剂）、特发性肺纤维化（BBT-877，ATX抑制剂）及肿瘤治疗；2025年通过与Parataxis Holdings LLC的交易转型为比特币财库公司。
companies.description_en: Parataxis Korea (formerly Bridge Biotherapeutics, renamed August 2025) is a Korean clinical-stage biotech with BBT-401 (Pellino-1 inhibitor, ulcerative colitis) and BBT-877 (autotaxin inhibitor, IPF) in Phase I; in 2025 entered a reverse-merger arrangement with Parataxis Holdings LLC to become a Bitcoin treasury company.

sources.title: Parataxis Holdings - Bridge Biotherapeutics Bitcoin Treasury Deal

companies.sub_sector: IBD / pulmonary fibrosis small molecules (fka Bridge Biotherapeutics)

companies.name_zh: 沛爾生醫科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 沛爾生醫聚焦於CAR-T細胞治療、脂肪幹細胞（ADSC）再生醫學及自然殺手細胞（NK Cell）免疫療法的研發、製造與銷售，主要產品涵蓋自體脂肪幹細胞骨關節炎療法及細胞激活殺手細胞腫瘤療法。
companies.description_en: PELL Bio-Med Technology specializes in research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of CAR-T cell therapies, adipose-derived stem cell (ADSC) regenerative medicine, and cytokine-induced killer (CIK) cell immunotherapies for oncology and musculoskeletal indications.

sources.title: Pell Bio-Med Technology (TPE:6949) Stock Price & Overview
Pell Bio-Med Technology TWSE:6949 market cap news

companies.description_zh: PT Penta Valent Tbk成立於1968年，是印尼領先的藥品、醫療設備及消費品分銷商，業務覆蓋處方藥、OTC藥品、醫療輔助設備及快速診斷試劑盒，旗下設有藥品產品及消費品兩大業務板塊。
companies.description_en: PT Penta Valent Tbk is a leading Indonesian distributor of pharmaceutical products, medical equipment, and consumer goods, founded in 1968. The company distributes prescription medicines, OTC products, blood-pressure monitors, diagnostic rapid tests (COVID-19, blood sugar, pregnancy), and other healthcare consumables.

sources.title: PT. Penta Valent Tbk (IDX:PEVE) Stock Price & Overview
Yearly Financial Reports - PT. Penta Valent

companies.description_zh: Peptron是一家韓國生物技術公司，專注於肽類藥物的長效緩釋製劑開發，核心技術為SmartDepot超音波噴霧乾燥平台，主要管線包括長效GLP-1受體激動劑（肥胖、糖尿病）及神經退行性疾病候選藥物。
companies.description_en: Peptron is a South Korean biotech founded in 1997, headquartered in Daejeon, specializing in peptide-based long-acting drug formulations using its proprietary SmartDepot ultrasonic spray-drying technology. Its pipeline centers on a long-acting GLP-1 receptor agonist for obesity/diabetes and candidates for neurodegenerative diseases.

companies.description_zh: PeterLabs Holdings Berhad是馬來西亞領先的動物健康與營養產品製造商、分銷商及出口商，主要產品涵蓋飼料添加劑、獸用藥品、生物製品、消毒劑及營養補充品，服務養禽、養豬及水產業，在馬來西亞Nilai設有生產基地並出口至東南亞多國。
companies.description_en: PeterLabs Holdings Berhad is a leading Malaysian manufacturer, distributor, and exporter of animal health and nutrition products including veterinary pharmaceuticals, biologicals, feed additives, disinfectants, and supplements for poultry, swine, and aquaculture sectors. Listed on Bursa Malaysia ACE Market since 2011.

sources.title: PeterLabs Holdings Berhad (KLSE: PLABS) Stock Price & Overview

companies.description_zh: 輝瑞有限公司（印度）是輝瑞全球的印度上市子公司，從事製藥產品的製造、行銷、貿易及出口，為印度第三大跨國製藥公司，產品涵蓋抗感染、心血管、疼痛管理等多個治療領域，在印度設有多個合同生產合作夥伴及獨立分銷渠道。
companies.description_en: Pfizer Limited (India) is the NSE/BSE-listed Indian subsidiary of Pfizer Inc., engaged in manufacturing, marketing, trading, and export of pharmaceutical products in India. It is India's third-largest MNC pharma company, with 1,721 employees and a diverse portfolio spanning anti-infectives, vaccines, pain management, cardiovascular, and oncology.

sources.title: Pfizer Ltd share price | Key Insights - Screener

companies.description_zh: PT Phapros Tbk成立於1954年，是PT Kimia Farma Tbk的子公司，在印尼生產超過250種藥品，涵蓋OTC、倫理藥、仿製藥及農業用藥，旗下知名產品包括Antimo（暈車藥）、X-Gra及Livron B Plex，生產基地位於三寶瓏，總部設於雅加達。
companies.description_en: PT Phapros Tbk, established in 1954 in Semarang and a subsidiary of PT Kimia Farma Tbk since 2019, manufactures over 250 pharmaceutical variants including OTC, ethical generic, branded, and agro-medicine products. Key brands include Antimo (anti-motion sickness), X-Gra, and Livron B Plex.

sources.title: Financial Statements Full Year 2024 of PEHA - IndoPremier
PT Phapros Tbk - Spirit To Level Up

companies.description_zh: Pharma Aids Limited成立於1981年，是孟加拉國主要的USP I型中性玻璃安瓿製造商，其產品為製藥公司提供液體注射劑灌裝用的玻璃容器，是醫藥包裝行業的專業製造商。
companies.description_en: Pharma Aids Limited, incorporated in 1981 and headquartered in Dhaka, manufactures and supplies USP type-1 neutral glass ampoules used by pharmaceutical companies for filling liquid injectable products. It is a specialist pharmaceutical packaging manufacturer listed on the Dhaka Stock Exchange.

companies.description_zh: 파마리서치（PharmaResearch）成立於1993年，是韓國領先的生物製藥公司，以PDRN/PN（聚脫氧核苷酸）技術平台見長，旗艦產品Rejuran廣泛用於皮膚再生及眼科，另有Condoran用於骨關節炎，公司持續向全球高利潤美容市場擴張，2024年收入達3501億韓元，同比增長34%。
companies.description_en: PharmaResearch Co., Ltd., founded in 1993 and headquartered in Seongnam, South Korea, is a biopharmaceutical company known for its PDRN/PN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) technology platform. Its flagship product Rejuran drives aesthetic dermatology sales globally; Condoran targets orthopedic conditions. 2024 revenue of KRW 350 billion grew 34% YoY.

companies.description_zh: PharmAbcine成立於2008年，是韓國大田的臨床階段生物技術公司，專注於開發用於癌症及新生血管性眼病的人源化單克隆抗體，主要管線包括olinvacimab（腫瘤血管生成）、PMC-403（眼科mAb）及PMC-309（聯合PD-1抑制劑用於實體腫瘤），2025年6月已被韓國交易所宣告退市。
companies.description_en: PharmAbcine Inc. is a clinical-stage Korean biotech founded in 2008 in Daejeon, developing human IgG monoclonal antibodies for oncology and neovascular eye diseases. Pipeline includes olinvacimab (anti-angiogenesis), PMC-403 (ophthalmic mAb), and PMC-309 (solid tumor combo with pembrolizumab). The company was delisted from KOSDAQ in June 2025 due to financial viability concerns.

sources.title: PharmAbcine to be delisted from Kosdaq amid financial and pipeline collapse

companies.name_zh: 台灣東洋藥品工業股份有限公司旗下 PharmaEngine Inc.
companies.description_zh: PharmaEngine是台灣腫瘤精準醫療平台公司，成立於2002年，採用「無研發、純開發」的Networked Pharma模式，旗艦產品ONIVYDE（脂質體伊立替康）已獲美國FDA、台灣TFDA及EMA批准用於胰腺癌，2024年歐亞市場銷售里程碑達成，獲得5000萬美元里程碑付款；管線PEP07（CHK1抑制劑）及PEP08（PRMT5抑制劑）均已進入Phase I。
companies.description_en: PharmaEngine Inc., founded in 2002 in Taipei, is a Taiwan-based oncology drug developer operating a networked pharma model. Its approved product ONIVYDE (irinotecan liposome injection), partnered with Ipsen, holds FDA/EMA/TFDA approvals for metastatic pancreatic cancer. A US$50M milestone was received in 2024. Pipeline includes PEP07 (CHK1 inhibitor, Phase I) and PEP08 (PRMT5 inhibitor, Phase I).

sources.title: PharmaEngine Reaches 2024 Sales Target, Secures $50 Million Milestone Payment

companies.description_zh: Pharmaniaga Berhad成立於1994年，是馬來西亞最大的上市綜合醫療保健公司，業務涵蓋藥品研發、製造、物流及分銷，擁有5個製造廠（含印尼一個），2024年收入達38億林吉特，並於2024年9月正式啟用馬來西亞首個本地生物製藥生產廠。
companies.description_en: Pharmaniaga Berhad, founded in 1994 and listed on Bursa Malaysia Main Market since 1999, is Malaysia's largest listed integrated healthcare company. It provides R&D, manufacturing, logistics, and pharmaceutical distribution with five manufacturing plants including one in Indonesia. FY2024 revenue reached MYR 3.8 billion. The company launched Malaysia's first local biopharmaceutical manufacturing plant in September 2024.

sources.title: Pharmaniaga Berhad Reports Second Quarter 2024 Earnings
PHARMANIAGA BERHAD Company Profile - Bursa Malaysia

companies.name_zh: 法莫西斯國際有限公司
companies.description_zh: Pharmesis International Ltd.是在新加坡交易所上市的投資控股公司，主要在中國市場研發、生產、包裝和銷售西藥及傳統中成藥（TCM），業務分三段：西藥/中草藥採購、中成藥知識產權及中草藥分銷，2024年收入達人民幣6760萬元，同比增長48%。
companies.description_en: Pharmesis International Ltd. is a Singapore Exchange-listed holding company that researches, develops, produces, packages, and sells western medicines and traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) formulated products for hospitals and medical institutions in China. Three segments: western drugs/TCM procurement, TCM IP licensing, and distribution. FY2024 revenue RMB 67.6M (+48% YoY).

sources.title: Q&As on AR - Pharmesis International Ltd 2025

companies.name_zh: 法摩莎生物醫藥股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 法摩莎生物醫藥成立於2000年，原名Pharmosa Limited，2016年更名並遷址台北，專注於吸入製劑與醫療器械組合（Drug-Device Combination）的創新開發，以505(b)(2)路徑開發肺動脈高壓治療藥物，主要產品L606（PAH/PH-ILD/CTEPH）及L608（PAH孤兒藥）均已完成重要臨床里程碑。
companies.description_en: Pharmosa Biopharm Inc., founded in 2000 (formerly Pharmosa Limited) and headquartered in Taipei, develops inhalation/device combination products via the 505(b)(2) regulatory pathway. Its lead candidates L606 (pulmonary arterial hypertension, PH-ILD, CTEPH; Phase III) and L608 (PAH, FDA orphan drug designation 2023; Phase I complete) leverage proprietary sustained-release inhalation formulation technology.

sources.title: Pharmosa Biopharm Inc. (6875.TWO) Income Statement - Yahoo Finance

companies.name_zh: 植慶生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 植慶生物科技成立於1998年，在台灣研究開發、製造及銷售藥品、化妝品、健康食品及精準醫療器材，設有藥品與健康食品、醫療診斷及精準醫療設備三大業務板塊，主要研發管線PHN031（骨質疏鬆，Phase II完成）、PHN033（糖尿病腎病，Phase II完成）及PHN016（癌症，Phase II進行中）均以植物活性成分為基礎。
companies.description_en: PhytoHealth Corporation, founded in 1998 in Taipei, researches, develops, manufactures, and sells pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, dietary supplements, and precision medical equipment in Taiwan. Pipeline highlights include PHN031 (osteoporosis, Phase II completed), PHN033 (diabetic nephropathy, Phase II completed), and PHN016 (cancer, Phase II). Products are derived from phytochemical active ingredients.

sources.title: PhytoHealth Corporation (4108.TW) Company Profile - Yahoo Finance

companies.name_zh: 皮拉马尔制药有限公司

revenue.note_en: FY2025 consolidated revenue from operations INR 9,151 crore (+12% YoY); CDMO INR 5,447cr, PCC INR 2,633cr, ICH INR 1,093cr; crossed US$1B revenue
revenue.note_zh: 2025财年合并营业收入915.1亿卢比（同比+12%）；CDMO 544.7亿、关键护理263.3亿、印度消费健康109.3亿；收入突破10亿美元

companies.description_zh: 皮拉马尔制药（2022年从Piramal Enterprises分拆上市）经营三大板块：Piramal Pharma Solutions（全球一体化CDMO）、Piramal Critical Care（复杂医院仿制药）及印度消费健康。拥有17个全球生产基地、业务覆盖100+国家，2025财年收入915.1亿卢比（同比+12%），突破10亿美元，EBITDA利润率17%，净利润增长约5倍。
companies.description_en: Piramal Pharma Limited, listed in 2022 (demerged from Piramal Enterprises), operates three segments: Piramal Pharma Solutions (PPS, global integrated CDMO), Piramal Critical Care (PCC, complex hospital generics), and India Consumer Healthcare. With 17 global manufacturing facilities and operations in 100+ countries, FY2025 revenue reached INR 9,151 crore (+12% YoY), crossing US$1B with a 17% EBITDA margin and a ~5x increase in net profit.

sources.title: Piramal Pharma Limited Announces Results for Q4 and FY2024
Piramal Pharma Ltd share price | Screener

companies.name_zh: 台灣浩鼎生技股份有限公司旗下 Polaris Group
companies.description_zh: Polaris Group成立於2006年，是台灣腫瘤藥物與CDMO服務集團，核心資產為pegargiminase（ADI-PEG 20），一種精氨酸脫亞胺酶-聚乙二醇結合物，已完成惡性胸膜間皮瘤Phase III ATOMIC研究並於2023年啟動FDA BLA滾動申請，子公司涵蓋仿製藥、API、藥物測試及CDMO服務，2024年研發投入達21.9億台幣。
companies.description_en: Polaris Group, founded in 2006 (incorporated in Cayman Islands), is a Taiwan-listed oncology drug developer and CDMO service provider. Its lead biologic pegargiminase (ADI-PEG 20), a PEGylated arginine deiminase, completed the Phase III ATOMIC trial for malignant pleural mesothelioma with positive results; BLA rolling submission to the US FDA was initiated in November 2023. Subsidiaries offer API, generics, drug testing, and CDMO services.

sources.title: Polaris Group Initiates Rolling BLA Submission for ADI-PEG 20 with FDA

companies.description_zh: 풍전약품（Poongjeon Pharm，原 SCM Lifescience／에스씨엠생명과학）2014 年成立、2020 年於韓國 KOSDAQ 上市，原為幹細胞治療研發公司（總部仁川松島）。2025 年 7 月收購成立於 1995 年的醫藥品批發商풍전약품，2026 年 4 月吸收合併並更名為풍전약품，主業轉為專業醫藥品（造影劑、輸液、麻醉藥等）批發配送，並保留少量幹細胞與化妝品業務。FY2025 合併營收約 238 億韓元。
companies.description_en: Poongjeon Pharm Co., Ltd. (formerly SCM Lifescience / 에스씨엠생명과학) was founded in 2014 and listed on KOSDAQ in 2020 as a stem-cell therapeutics R&D biotech (HQ Incheon Songdo). In July 2025 it acquired Poongjeon Pharm, a prescription-drug wholesaler founded in 1995; it absorbed the subsidiary via merger and renamed the listed entity Poongjeon Pharm in April 2026. Its primary business is now prescription-drug wholesale/distribution (contrast media, IV fluids, narcotics to hospitals), with residual stem-cell and cosmetics operations. FY2025 consolidated revenue ≈ KRW 23.8B.
companies.sub_sector: pharmaceutical wholesale/distribution (SCM Lifescience merged into Poongjeon Pharm, 2026)

companies.name_zh: 普瑞斯生物製藥有限公司
companies.description_zh: Prestige BioPharma成立於2015年，總部位於新加坡並在韓國KOSDAQ上市，是聚焦於生物類似藥開發的生物製藥公司，旗艦產品Tuznue（曲妥珠單抗生物類似藥）已獲EMA批准並於歐洲30個市場商業化，另有貝伐珠單抗及阿達木單抗生物類似藥在研，2024年下半年實現首次盈利（淨利潤321億韓元），主要得益於里程碑付款。
companies.description_en: Prestige BioPharma Limited, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Singapore (KRX-listed), develops biosimilars, antibody drugs, and vaccines. Its trastuzumab biosimilar Tuznue received EMA approval and is commercialized in 30 European markets. Pipeline includes bevacizumab biosimilar and adalimumab biosimilar PBP1502 (Phase I). H2 2024 marked the company's first-ever profit of KRW 32.1B driven by milestone payments from Tuznue licensing.

companies.description_en: Spanish biopharmaceutical company specialising in marine-derived oncology drugs; key products are Zepzelca (lurbinectedin, SCLC, FDA-approved) and Yondelis (trabectedin, soft-tissue sarcoma/ovarian cancer, EU-approved).

companies.description_en: Dutch rare-disease biopharmaceutical company; lead products are RUCONEST (C1-esterase inhibitor, hereditary angioedema) and Joenja (leniolisib, activated PI3Kδ syndrome). 2025 revenue grew 27% to US$376M.

companies.description_en: French biotech targeting Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 1A (CMT1A); lead asset PXT3003 (baclofen/naltrexone/sorbitol) failed pivotal Phase III (PREMIER trial, high placebo effect) in 2023; placed into judicial liquidation by Paris court August 2024; shares suspended and subsequently delisted from Euronext Growth Paris.

companies.description_en: Italian biotech engineering antibody-drug conjugates and immunocytokines targeting tumour vasculature and inflammation; 2025 record revenues of €314.3M boosted by a major upfront licence payment from BMS/RayzeBio for a prostate cancer asset; net profit ~€230M; cash €380M.

companies.description_en: Norwegian specialty pharma focused on photodiagnosis of bladder cancer; single-product franchise Hexvix/Cysview (hexaminolevulinate, blue-light cystoscopy) with 2025 revenue NOK 532.6M (+1% YoY); guided 7–11% constant-currency growth for 2026.

companies.description_en: Irish clinical-stage biotech spun out of hVIVO (2021); lead asset POLB 001, first-in-class small molecule targeting cytokine release syndrome (CRS; FDA Orphan Drug Designation), advancing into TOPICAL Phase I/II oncology trial (interim data expected H2 2026); also exploring POLB 001 for severe influenza and an oral GLP-1 programme.

companies.description_zh: 英国合同蛋白质组学服务公司，专有TMT同位素标记技术通过赛默飞全球分销；提供SysQuant靶标发现、生物标志物鉴定和单细胞蛋白质组学服务。
companies.description_en: UK specialist contract proteomics CRO; proprietary TMT® isobaric labelling reagents (TMT 11-plex, TMTpro 18-plex/35-plex) distributed globally via Thermo Fisher Scientific; services include SysQuant®, super-depletion, DIA multiplex, and first commercial single-cell proteomics (SCP) contract secured Q4 2024. FY2024 revenue £4.89M.

companies.description_en: Polish biotech founded by University of Wrocław scientists; develops therapeutic antibody and aptamer drug candidates for immuno-oncology, autoimmunology, and rare neurological diseases; transferred from NewConnect to WSE Main Market in 2020; Q4 2025 revenue €6.8M (180% YoY growth).

companies.description_zh: 瑞典医疗器械微型公司，专门开发血液透析过程中针穿出报警系统（Redsense System），产品在欧洲、加拿大、澳大利亚等地销售。
companies.description_en: Swedish micro-cap medtech; develops and markets the Redsense System, a fibre-optic sensor-based alarm device that detects needle dislodgement (blood leakage) during haemodialysis; sold in Europe, Canada, Australia. Annual revenue ~SEK 25M.

companies.description_zh: 英国癌症和纤维化靶向药物发现公司，总部阿德雷公园；核心管线包括RXC008（ROCK2抑制剂，纤维化）、Zelasudil（ROCK2，GVHD）及多个肿瘤项目；FDA已授予RXC008快速通道资格。
companies.description_en: UK drug-discovery biotech at Alderley Park focused on oncology and fibrosis; lead programmes include RXC008 (ROCK2 inhibitor, fibrosis; FDA Fast Track) and Zelasudil (ROCK2, GvHD); fiscal year ends September; approximately 74 employees; changed fiscal year-end to December 2025.

companies.description_zh: 西班牙老牌制药企业（1929年创立），专注注射剂、冻干制剂和抗生素的生产和销售；2025年营收3.31亿欧元（同比-2%），受托莱多工厂抗生素产线整改影响；旗下生物技术和疫苗业务持续扩展。
companies.description_en: Spanish specialty pharma founded 1929; manufactures complex injectables (lyophilisates) and beta-lactam antibiotics across plants in Barcelona, Toledo (×2), and Sweden; 2025 revenue €331.1M (−2% YoY) impacted by Toledo antibiotic line upgrades; gross margin 59%; EBITDA €30.5M.

sources.title: Reig Jofre FY2025 Full Year Financial Results

companies.description_zh: 瑞士日内瓦罕见病生物技术公司，管线包括RLF-TD011（次氯酸溶液，大疱性表皮松解症伤口护理）和RLF-OD032（液态沙丙蝶呤，苯丙酮尿症）；2024年营收增长至840万瑞郎。
companies.description_en: Swiss rare-disease biotech headquartered in Geneva; clinical pipeline includes RLF-TD011 (hypochlorous acid, wound care in epidermolysis bullosa) and RLF-OD032 (liquid sapropterin formulation, phenylketonuria); 2024 revenue CHF 8.42M (+40% YoY); H1 2025 revenue CHF 1.2M (full 2025 data not yet published).

companies.description_zh: 英国干细胞治疗公司，专注中风残障（CTX细胞）和视网膜色素变性（hRPC，2期临床）；2024年2月因无法获得资金而股票暂停交易，3月进入行政管理，8月从AIM退市；管理人程序仍在进行中（截至2025年）。
companies.description_en: UK stem-cell therapeutics company; lead programmes were CTX cells (stroke disability) and hRPC (human retinal progenitor cells; Phase II retinitis pigmentosa); failed to secure financing, shares suspended February 2024, appointed administrators March 2024, delisted from AIM August 2024; administration proceedings ongoing as of early 2025.

companies.description_zh: 西班牙马德里综合制药公司（1946年创立），兼营自有专科药（贝米肝素低分子量肝素、依诺肝素生物类似药）和CDMO业务（与Moderna签订10年疫苗代工合同）；2025年总营收7.56亿欧元。
companies.description_en: Spanish integrated pharma and CDMO founded 1946; specialty pharma segment includes bemiparin (2nd-gen LMWH) and enoxaparin biosimilar (approved 26 European markets); CDMO segment includes 10-year Moderna COVID/RSV seasonal vaccine manufacturing agreement; 2025 revenue €756.1M (−1% YoY); EBITDA €216.2M (+4%); IBEX 35 component.

companies.description_zh: 波兰克拉科夫临床阶段肿瘤药物发现公司；核心资产Romaciclib（RVU120，CDK8/19抑制剂）处于2期（急性髓性白血病、骨髓纤维化）；Dapolsertib与Menarini合作；2025年大幅裁员聚焦临床推进。
companies.description_en: Polish clinical-stage oncology company (Kraków, founded 2007); lead asset romaciclib (RVU120, CDK8/19 inhibitor) in Phase II (r/r AML; myelofibrosis); dapolsertib partnered with Menarini (DLBCL); underwent 30% headcount reduction in Feb 2025; 2025 total revenues €20.7M; EBITDA loss €23.2M; cash €7M + €20.9M non-dilutive grants secured.
