companies.description_zh: 丹麦临床阶段神经/精神病学生物技术公司，专注离子通道靶点；2025年与Jazz Pharmaceuticals达成SAN2355（癫痫）授权协议，获4250万美元首付款；其他管线包括SAN2219（癫痫）、SAN2465（抑郁症）及与多家公司的合作项目。
companies.description_en: Danish clinical-stage biotech specialising in ion channel modulators for neurological and psychiatric disorders; transformative 2025 licensing deal with Jazz Pharmaceuticals for SAN2355 (epilepsy; USD 42.5M upfront + up to USD 992.5M milestones); pipeline also includes SAN2219 (epilepsy), SAN2465 (MDD), tesofensine (obesity, Medix), and Tesomet (rare eating disorders); 34 employees after expansion.

companies.description_zh: 瑞士罕见神经肌肉疾病专科制药公司（2004年成立），核心产品AGAMREE（vamorolone）用于治疗杜氏肌营养不良（DMD），已在欧美多国获批；2025年营收增长97%至7720万瑞郎；与日本及亚太多个合作伙伴达成授权协议。
companies.description_en: Swiss rare disease specialty pharma (founded 2004, Pratteln); sole commercial product AGAMREE® (vamorolone), a dissociative steroid for Duchenne muscular dystrophy approved in Europe and USA; 2025 total revenue CHF 77.2M (+97% YoY; product sales CHF 25.8M + royalties/milestones CHF 23.1M + supply revenue CHF 28.3M); R&D spend CHF 22.2M; targeting €150M revenue (ex-milestones) by 2028.

companies.description_zh: 宝洁健康有限公司（前身为默克印度有限公司）是印度领先的维生素、矿物质及补充剂（VMS）企业，旗下拥有Neurobion、Evion、Livogen、Polybion等知名品牌，产品覆盖OTC药品及营养补充剂，在孟买设有总部并在果阿设有生产基地。2019年由宝洁公司完成品牌重塑。
companies.description_en: Procter & Gamble Health Limited (formerly Merck Limited, India) is one of India's largest vitamins, minerals and supplements (VMS) companies, marketing over-the-counter products and nutritional brands including Neurobion, Polybion, Evion, Livogen, and Nasivion. Incorporated in 1967, it was acquired by P&G's consumer health business in 2018 and rebranded in 2019. Manufacturing facilities are located in Goa.

companies.description_zh: 彼利达姆制药创立于1976年，是印尼中型制药公司，业务涵盖抗生素、维生素、补充剂、传统草药等现代药及传统药生产，并通过CDMO、医美（皮肤填充剂、线雕）及健康饮料品牌PYFAHEALTH等多元化业务。2024年通过收购澳大利亚Probiotec公司实现跨越式收入增长。
companies.description_en: PT Pyridam Farma Tbk, founded in 1976 in Jakarta, manufactures and trades pharmaceuticals (antibiotics, vitamins, OTC drugs, traditional herbal products) and medical devices in Indonesia. The company has expanded into aesthetics (dermal fillers, thread-lift), CDMO services, and consumer health brands. Revenue nearly tripled in 2024 driven by CDMO expansion and acquisition of Australian Probiotec Ltd.

companies.name_zh: 科瑞恩特生物技术公司
companies.description_zh: Qurient成立于2008年，总部位于韩国城南，是临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于结核病、实体瘤及特应性皮炎等未满足医疗需求领域。核心管线包括抗TB新药Telacebec（Q203，Phase II）、CDK7抑制剂Q901（Phase I）、Axl/Mer抑制剂Adrixetinib（Q702）及外用Q301（Phase II，特应性皮炎）。
companies.description_en: Qurient Co., Ltd. (founded 2008, Seongnam, South Korea) is a clinical-stage biotech addressing unmet medical needs in tuberculosis, oncology, and atopic dermatitis. Key pipeline assets include Telacebec (Q203, Phase II for MDR-TB), Q901 (Phase I, CDK7 inhibitor for solid tumors), Adrixetinib (Q702, Axl/Mer/CSF1R inhibitor, Phase I completed), and Q301 (Phase II, topical for atopic dermatitis).

companies.description_zh: 彩虹儿童医疗是印度领先的儿科、妇产科专科医院连锁，由Dr. Ramesh Kancharla于1999年创立于海得拉巴。公司在印度多个城市运营三级儿科和妇产科医院，五年CAGR约24%，FY2025收入同比增长17.5%。
companies.description_en: Rainbow Children's Medicare Limited, founded in 1999 by Dr. Ramesh Kancharla in Hyderabad, operates a multi-specialty pediatric, obstetrics and gynecology hospital chain across major Indian cities. The company focuses on neonatal intensive care, pediatric surgery, and maternal care. FY2025 revenue grew 17.5% YoY with a 5-year CAGR of ~24%.

companies.description_zh: 隆马控股是马来西亚领先的动物健康综合解决方案提供商，业务涵盖动物药品、疫苗、饲料添加剂和农药的制造、分销与营销，同时涉足食品原料分销和兽医诊断服务。2024年实现营收2.116亿马币，同比增长4%，其中动物健康产品及设备分部增长16%。
companies.description_en: Rhone Ma Holdings Berhad (founded 2000, Petaling Jaya) is a Malaysia-based end-to-end animal health solutions provider whose subsidiaries manufacture, market and distribute veterinary pharmaceuticals, vaccines, feed additives, and pesticides. The group also distributes food ingredients and provides veterinary diagnostic services. FY2024 revenue was RM211.6M, up 4% YoY.

companies.description_zh: ROKIT Healthcare成立于2012年，总部位于首尔，是韩国4D生物打印与脏器再生领域领军企业。公司融合AI、3D生物打印和自体细胞技术，开发用于糖尿病足溃疡、骨关节炎、慢性肾病等慢性疾病的器官再生平台，并积极布局美国和中东市场。2025年收入同比增长100%达262.5亿韩元。
companies.description_en: ROKIT Healthcare Inc. (founded 2012, Seoul) is a South Korean regenerative medicine company combining AI, 4D bioprinting, and autologous cell technologies to create organ regenerative healthcare solutions for diabetic foot ulcers, osteoarthritis, and chronic kidney disease. The company is commercializing its platform in the US and Middle East. Revenue doubled in 2025 to KRW 26.25 billion.

companies.name_zh: 罗萨里生物技术有限公司
companies.description_zh: 罗萨里生物技术成立于2009年，总部位于孟买，是印度领先的特种化学品制造商，向3000余家客户供应4300余种产品，出口至65个以上国家。核心业务涵盖家庭及个人护理与性能化学品（HPPC，占比78%）、纺织特种化学品（TSC，17%）和动物健康与营养（AHN，5%）。FY2025年收入208亿卢比，同比增长13.6%。
companies.description_en: Rossari Biotech Limited (founded 2009, Mumbai) is one of India's largest specialty chemical manufacturers, supplying 4,300+ products to 3,000+ customers across 65+ countries. Business segments: Home, Personal Care & Performance Chemicals (HPPC, ~78%), Textile Specialty Chemicals (TSC, ~17%), and Animal Health & Nutrition (AHN, ~5%). FY2025 revenue: ₹20.8B, up 13.6% YoY.

companies.description_zh: RPG生命科学有限公司成立于1993年（前身为GD Searle与RPG集团合资公司，始于1968年），总部位于孟买，是RPG企业旗下成员。公司在品牌制剂、全球仿制药、合成及发酵API领域运营，在安卡尔斯瓦尔（古吉拉特邦）和纳维孟买设有生产基地，产品出口至50余个国家，重点覆盖免疫抑制剂、肾病、肿瘤、心脏病等13个治疗领域。
companies.description_en: RPG Life Sciences Limited (founded 1993 as successor to GD Searle-RPG JV, est. 1968) is an integrated pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. Operations span branded formulations, global generics, and synthetic/fermentation APIs across 13 therapeutic areas with emphasis on immunosuppressants, nephrology, oncology, and cardiology. Manufacturing facilities in Ankleshwar (Gujarat) and Navi Mumbai; exports to 50+ countries.

companies.description_zh: S生物医学成立于2005年，总部位于首尔，是韩国细胞治疗领域领先企业，专注于干细胞和细胞疗法的研究开发。核心管线包括TED-N（脊髓损伤，Phase 1/2a）、TED-A9（帕金森病，Phase 1/2a）、FECS-Ad（严重肢体缺血）及FECS-DF（面部皱纹）。2025年收入增长20.5%至165.5亿韩元，但仍处于亏损阶段。
companies.description_en: S.Biomedics Co., Ltd. (founded 2005, Seoul) is a South Korean biopharmaceutical company developing stem cell and cell therapy products. Clinical pipeline includes TED-N for subacute spinal cord injury (Phase 1/2a), TED-A9 for Parkinson's disease (Phase 1/2a), FECS-Ad for critical limb ischemia, and FECS-DF for facial wrinkles. Revenue grew 20.5% to KRW 16.55B in 2025; company remains pre-profitability.

companies.description_zh: 赛生命科学成立于1999年，总部位于海得拉巴，2024年12月在NSE上市，是印度领先的以创新药为核心的合同研究、开发和生产（CRDMO）企业，覆盖药物发现、开发到商业化生产全价值链，兼具CRO和CDMO能力。FY2025年收入169.5亿卢比，同比增长16%，PAT增长105%。
companies.description_en: Sai Life Sciences Limited (founded 1999, Hyderabad; NSE-listed Dec 2024) is an innovator-focused CRDMO providing end-to-end services from drug discovery through commercial manufacturing. Capabilities span chemistry-based CRO, process development, and API/formulation CDMO. FY2025 revenue: ₹16.95B (+16% YoY); PAT surged 105% to ₹1.70B.

companies.name_zh: 萨卡医疗保健有限公司
companies.description_zh: 萨卡医疗保健成立于2004年，总部位于艾哈迈达巴德（昌戈达尔），专注于液体口服制剂、头孢菌素、干粉注射液及冻干注射液的生产。公司在肿瘤学领域建立了研究驱动的API集成制造单元，通过欧盟GMP认证，已与Zydus签订第40份供应协议，并获欧盟MA批准上市肿瘤产品。
companies.description_en: Sakar Healthcare Limited (founded 2004, Ahmedabad) manufactures liquid orals, cephalosporins, dry powder injectables, lyophilized injectables, and API-integrated oncology formulations. The company operates EU-GMP certified facilities and has built 21 APIs and filed 23 EU Marketing Authorizations. FY2025 revenue: ₹1.78B (+15.5% YoY). Strategic focus on differentiated oncology products.

companies.name_en: Sam Chun Dang Pharm Co., Ltd.
companies.description_zh: 三千堂制药创立于1943年，是韩国历史最悠久的制药企业之一，总部位于首尔，以眼科产品为核心（占收入约60%），并在生物类似药领域取得重大突破。核心产品SCD411（阿柏西普生物类似药）已获韩国、日本及加拿大、欧盟批准，并与Fresenius Kabi签订美国及拉丁美洲独家许可协议。2024年收入2109亿韩元，同比增长9.5%。
companies.description_en: Sam Chun Dang Pharm (founded 1943, Seoul) is one of Korea's oldest pharmaceutical companies. Ophthalmic products account for ~60% of revenues. Key biosimilar asset SCD411 (aflibercept biosimilar, reference: Eylea) received approval in Korea, Japan, Canada, and Europe, with Fresenius Kabi holding exclusive US/Latin America commercial rights. FY2024 revenue: KRW 210.92B (+9.5% YoY).

companies.name_zh: 赛诺菲-安万特巴基斯坦有限公司
companies.description_zh: 赛诺菲-安万特巴基斯坦有限公司（PSX: SAPL）成立于1967年，前身为Hoechst Pakistan，总部位于卡拉奇科兰基工业区，是全球赛诺菲集团在巴基斯坦的上市子公司，制造和销售药品及相关产品，出口至阿富汗和其他国家。2024年季度收入规模约76-77亿卢比。注：公司部分资料中亦被称为Hoechst Pakistan Limited。
companies.description_en: Sanofi-Aventis Pakistan Limited (PSX: SAPL, est. 1967 as Hoechst Pakistan) is the publicly listed Pakistani subsidiary of the global Sanofi SA group, headquartered in Korangi Industrial Area, Karachi. The company manufactures and sells pharmaceutical and related products in Pakistan, Afghanistan, and internationally. Quarterly revenues run approximately PKR 7-8B.

companies.description_zh: 赛诺菲印度有限公司成立于1956年（前身为Hoechst Fedco Pharma），2012年改为现名，是全球赛诺菲集团的印度上市子公司，总部位于孟买鲍威。公司在印度市场销售糖尿病、心脏病、血栓、中枢神经系统及抗过敏药物，大股东赛诺菲与Hoechst GmbH共持股60.37%。2024年收入201.3亿卢比。
companies.description_en: Sanofi India Limited (incorporated 1956 as Hoechst Fedco Pharma, renamed 2012) is the publicly listed Indian subsidiary of Sanofi SA, headquartered in Powai, Mumbai. The company manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products in diabetes, cardiology, thrombosis, CNS, and anti-histamines. Sanofi SA and Hoechst GmbH together hold 60.37% stake. FY2024 revenue: ₹20.13B.

companies.name_zh: 松瑞制药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 松瑞制药成立于2004年，总部位于台南，专注于碳青霉烯类抗菌药（亚胺培南/西司他丁、美罗培南、厄他培南）的无菌API及制剂生产，实现垂直整合。公司拥有台南注射剂生产基地，向全球制药商供应高品质API，并持有FDA、EMA等多个国际GMP认证。
companies.description_en: Savior Lifetec Corporation (founded 2004, Tainan) is a vertically integrated specialist in sterile carbapenem antibiotics (imipenem/cilastatin, meropenem, ertapenem), supplying high-quality APIs and finished dosage forms to global pharmaceutical companies. The company operates cGMP-certified manufacturing facilities in Tainan and holds multiple international regulatory approvals.

companies.name_zh: 台湾神隆股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 台湾神隆成立于1997年，总部位于台南南部科学工业园区，是全球领先的高活性API（HPAPI）制造商，专攻肿瘤学领域，同时提供CDMO服务（从工艺开发到商业化生产）。2024年合并年营收34.06亿台币，同比增长7%；CDMO业务达10亿台币规模，过去五年CAGR约14%。在台南及中国常熟设有cGMP生产设施。
companies.description_en: ScinoPharm Taiwan, Ltd. (founded 1997, Tainan Science Park) is a global leader in high-potency API (HPAPI) manufacturing with a focus on oncology generics, and provides CDMO services spanning process/analytical development, clinical supply and commercial-scale production. FY2024 consolidated revenue: NT$3.41B (+7% YoY); CDMO business reached NT$1B with ~14% 5-year CAGR. cGMP facilities in Tainan and Changshu, China.

companies.name_zh: 科妍生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 科妍生物科技成立于2001年，总部位于高雄，是全球领先的交联透明质酸产品专业企业，为全球唯一可在无任何化学添加剂条件下生产交联透明质酸的公司。主要产品包括皮肤填充剂（医美用）、关节腔注射液（骨关节炎）和防粘连凝胶（外科）。
companies.description_en: SciVision Biotech, Inc. (founded 2001, Kaohsiung) specializes in medical-grade hyaluronic acid products using proprietary cross-linking technology (unique: no chemical additives). Key products: hyaluronic acid dermal fillers (aesthetic/medical), viscosupplement injections for knee osteoarthritis, and anti-adhesion gels for surgery. Also active in DNA identification/sequencing applications.

companies.name_zh: 生华生物科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 生华生物科技成立于2012年，总部位于台湾新北市，2017年在TPEx上市，是专注于下一代DNA损伤应答（DDR）疗法的临床阶段生物技术公司，在美国圣地亚哥设有运营基地。核心管线：Pidnarulex（CX-5461，G4稳定剂，靶向BRCA1/2突变/HRD实体瘤，Phase I/II）和Silmitasertib（CX-4945，CK2抑制剂，皮肤基底细胞癌Phase 1/II）。
companies.description_en: Senhwa Biosciences, Inc. (founded 2012, New Taipei; TPEx-listed 2017) is a clinical-stage biotech focused on next-generation DNA Damage Response (DDR) therapeutics for cancer, rare diseases, and infectious diseases. Lead assets: Pidnarulex (CX-5461, G4 stabilizer for BRCA1/2 or HRD solid tumors, Phase I/II) and Silmitasertib (CX-4945, selective CK2 inhibitor, Phase I/II for basal cell carcinoma). US operations in San Diego.

companies.name_en: Viyash Scientific Limited (formerly Sequent Scientific Limited)
companies.description_zh: 印度领先的动物保健公司，提供原料药（API）、制剂及分析服务，产品覆盖90余国；2026年1月与Viyash Life Sciences合并后更名为Viyash Scientific。
companies.description_en: India's leading animal health company providing APIs, finished dosage formulations, and analytical services across 90+ countries. Rebranded to Viyash Scientific in January 2026 following merger with Viyash Life Sciences.

companies.description_zh: 印度卡纳塔克邦领先的原料药及制剂制造商，聚焦肿瘤科API、仿制药及生物类似药，产品出口至美国、欧洲及全球市场，并提供CDMO服务。
companies.description_en: Leading Karnataka-based manufacturer of APIs, formulations, and biosimilars with a strong oncology focus. Serves the US, Europe, and global markets, and offers contract development and manufacturing services.

companies.description_zh: 韩国老牌制药公司，创立于1962年，生产并销售头孢类抗生素、青霉素、抗病毒药、抗癌药及抗疟疾药（Pyramax），产品出口约50国。
companies.description_en: Established Korean pharma company founded in 1962, manufacturing cephalosporin/penicillin antibiotics, antivirals, oncology drugs, and the anti-malarial Pyramax. Exports to approximately 50 countries.

companies.description_zh: 孟加拉国制药公司，生产和销售成品制剂，产品覆盖抗生素、镇痛药、抗糖尿病药、抗抑郁药等多个治疗领域，面向国内外市场。
companies.description_en: Bangladeshi pharmaceutical manufacturer producing finished dosage forms across analgesic, antibiotic, antidiabetic, antidepressant, and other therapeutic categories for domestic and international markets.

companies.description_zh: 孟加拉国成品制剂制造商，产品覆盖抗生素、镇痛药、抗糖尿病、中枢神经系统及血液系统用药，面向国内外市场。2024财年收入下滑。
companies.description_en: Bangladeshi manufacturer of finished pharmaceutical products including antibiotics, analgesics, anti-diabetics, narcotics, and CNS/blood disorder treatments for domestic and international markets.

companies.name_zh: 斯穆尔蒂有机物有限公司
companies.description_zh: 印度马哈拉施特拉邦索拉普尔的小型API制造商，专注于抗糖尿病、降压及抗感染类原料药，面向印度国内及国际市场。
companies.description_en: Small-cap API manufacturer based in Solapur, Maharashtra, specializing in anti-diabetic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-infective active pharmaceutical ingredients for Indian and export markets.

sources.title: Smruthi Organics Share Price - Business Standard

companies.name_zh: 索拉拉原料药科学有限公司
companies.description_zh: 纯API制造商，由Strides Shasun原料药业务分拆成立（2017年），并收购Sequent Scientific人用API业务；专注神经、心血管及抗感染类API，服务全球市场。
companies.description_en: Pure-play API manufacturer formed in 2017 through demerger from Strides Shasun and subsequent acquisition of Sequent Scientific's human API business. Focuses on neurological, cardiovascular, and anti-infective APIs for global markets.

sources.title: Solara Active Pharma Sciences (NSE:SOLARA) Stock Price & Overview
Solara Active Pharma Sciences Annual Report 2024-25

companies.name_zh: 特种天然产品股份有限公司
companies.name_en: Specialty Natural Products Public Company Limited
companies.description_zh: 泰国领先的标准化草本提取物制造商，产品用于药品、膳食补充剂、功能性食品及化妆品行业，2024年11月在泰交所上市。
companies.description_en: Leading Thai manufacturer of standardized botanical herbal extracts for pharmaceutical, dietary supplement, nutraceutical, functional food, and cosmetic industries. IPO on SET in November 2024.

sources.title: Specialty Natural Products PCL on Investing.com

companies.description_zh: 韩国领先的核酸疗法CDMO，擅长寡核苷酸和mRNA原料药及中间体合成，并提供小分子API、基因治疗（CRISPR向导RNA）等服务；东亚药品集团核心子公司。
companies.description_en: Korea's leading nucleic acid therapeutics CDMO specializing in oligonucleotide and mRNA APIs, small-molecule APIs, and gene therapy (CRISPR guide RNA). Core affiliate of Dong-A Socio Holdings. KOSDAQ IPO in 2016.

sources.title: ST Pharm turns from white elephant to cash cow for Dong-A Socio Holdings

companies.name_zh: 斯达德制药科学有限公司
companies.description_zh: 印度班加罗尔仿制药公司，专注复杂仿制药开发与制造，剂型覆盖片剂、胶囊、液体制剂、鼻喷、外用药和管制药品；美国、欧洲、澳大利亚等市场均有布局。
companies.description_en: Bengaluru-based generics company developing and manufacturing complex generics across tablets, capsules, liquids, nasal sprays, topicals, and controlled substances for the US, Europe, and Australia.

sources.title: Strides Pharma Science (NSE:STAR) Stock Price & Overview
Strides Pharma Science Number of Employees
Strides Pharma Science Company Profile - GlobalData

companies.description_zh: 马来西亚上市控股公司（2024年12月由Sunzen Biotech Berhad更名），经营动物保健营养品（饲料添加剂、兽用制剂）、人用健康品、医疗设备及贷款金融三大业务板块。
companies.description_en: Malaysian listed holding company (renamed from Sunzen Biotech Berhad in December 2024) operating animal health/nutrition, human health (cosmetics/wellness), medical devices, and loan financing segments. Manufactures and markets animal feed supplement products across Malaysia, China, and Singapore.

sources.title: Sunzen Group Berhad (KLSE:SUNZEN) Stock Price & Overview

companies.name_zh: 苏普里亚生命科学有限公司
companies.description_zh: 印度API制造商，在抗组胺药、抗过敏药、维生素、抗哮喘和镇痛类原料药领域位居全球前列；制造基地位于马哈拉施特拉邦Ratnagiri，2021年12月于NSE上市。
companies.description_en: Indian API manufacturer and global leader in antihistamines, anti-allergic, vitamin, anti-asthmatic, and analgesic API categories. Manufacturing facility in Ratnagiri, Maharashtra. NSE IPO in December 2021.

companies.name_en: Suven Pharmaceuticals Limited (now Cohance Lifesciences Limited)
companies.description_zh: 印度海德拉巴CDMO公司，专注创新药CRDMO服务（CNS等领域），2025年5月与Cohance Life Sciences合并后更名为Cohance Lifesciences；目标2030年实现10亿美元营收，2024年收购NJ Bio（56%股权）和Sapala Organics（67.5%）。
companies.description_en: Hyderabad-based innovator-focused CRDMO providing custom R&D and manufacturing services, particularly for CNS drugs. Renamed to Cohance Lifesciences in May 2025 following merger with Cohance Life Sciences. Revenue target of $1B by 2030; acquired NJ Bio (56%) and Sapala Organics (67.5%) in 2024.

companies.name_zh: 杏国新药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 台湾早期临床阶段生物制药公司，由杏辉集团与国家卫生研究院共同创立（2008年），管线包括SB01（抗癌注射剂，2期）、SB04（老年性黄斑变性，2/3期）、SB05-EndoTAG-1（胰腺癌/三阴性乳腺癌，3期）及SB03-Veregen（外用，尖锐湿疣）。
companies.description_en: Early-stage biopharmaceutical company co-founded by Sinphar Group and Taiwan's National Health Research Institute (NHRI) in 2008. Pipeline includes SB01 (anti-cancer injectable, Ph2), SB04 (AMD, Ph2/3), SB05-EndoTAG-1 (pancreatic/TNBC, Ph3), and SB03-Veregen (genital warts).

companies.description_zh: 泰国领先制药公司，从事制药及医疗健康产品的生产与分销，经营超过50年，拥有226个以上品牌，业务包括自有品牌产品、第三方合同制造及贸易商品；2024年10月在泰交所上市（SET:TMAN）。
companies.description_en: Leading Thai pharmaceutical and healthcare product manufacturer and distributor with over 50 years of operations and 226+ brands. Operates through branded, contract manufacturing, and traded product segments. Listed on SET in October 2024.

sources.title: T.MAN Pharmaceutical PCL (SET: TMAN) Showcases Leadership in Health Innovation

companies.name_zh: 太景生物科技控股有限公司
companies.description_zh: 台湾临床阶段制药公司，旗舰产品为Taigexyn（奈诺沙星）——非氟喹诺酮类抗生素，已获台湾FDA批准用于社区获得性肺炎；管线另含TG-1000（流感，3期）、Furaprevir（丙肝HCV）及Burixafor（干细胞动员，2期）。
companies.description_en: Taiwan-based clinical-stage pharma company. Flagship product Taigexyn (Nemonoxacin), a non-fluorinated quinolone antibiotic, approved in Taiwan for CAP. Pipeline includes TG-1000 (influenza, Ph3), Furaprevir (HCV), and Burixafor (stem cell mobilization, Ph2).

companies.name_zh: 台医生物股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 台湾专注传染病治疗的生物技术公司，旗舰产品Trogarzo（ibalizumab，iMAb）为全球首个FDA批准的HIV单克隆抗体（2018年批准，用于多重耐药HIV-1）；在研管线TMB-365/380为长效HIV维持疗法（2b期正在入组）。
companies.description_en: Taiwan-based biotech focused on infectious disease treatments. Flagship product Trogarzo (ibalizumab-uiyk) is the world's first FDA-approved monoclonal antibody for HIV (approved 2018, for multi-drug resistant HIV-1). Pipeline lead: TMB-365/380, a long-acting HIV maintenance therapy in Phase 2b.

sources.title: TaiMed Biologics CEO Interview - Platform Strategy for Precision Immunotherapy
TaiMed Biologics Completes Phase 2b Enrollment for TMB-365/380

companies.name_zh: 探索生技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 台湾生物仿制药公司，专注于生物仿制药的研发、生产与销售，主要产品包括已获FDA批准的filgrastim生物仿制药Nypozi（filgrastim-txid）及pegfilgrastim生物仿制药TX-05，适应症涵盖中性粒细胞减少症、乳腺癌及转移性结直肠癌等。
companies.description_en: Taiwan-based biosimilar company with vertically integrated development, manufacturing and commercialization capabilities. FDA approved its filgrastim biosimilar Nypozi (filgrastim-txid) in July 2024 and accepted BLA for TX-05 (pegfilgrastim biosimilar). Licensed NYPOZI US commercialization to InvaGen/Cipla in 2025.

sources.title: Tanvex received BLA approval from FDA July 2024

companies.name_zh: 塔特瓦钦坦医药化学有限公司
companies.description_zh: 印度特种化学品制造商，专注于结构导向剂（SDA）、相转移催化剂（PTC）、超级电容器电解质盐及医药农化中间体的生产，产品出口至印度、德国、美国、中国及新加坡等地。
companies.description_en: India-based specialty chemicals manufacturer producing structure directing agents (41% of revenue), phase transfer catalysts (28%), pharma & agrochemical intermediates (29%), and electrolyte salts for supercapacitors. Listed on NSE/BSE; serves automotive, refinery, pharma, and agrochemical industries globally.

sources.title: Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem (NSE:TATVA) Stock Price & Overview
Financial Information - Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem

companies.name_zh: 泰宗生技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 台湾生技公司，专注于肝脏疾病药物的研发，产品涵盖骨关节炎治疗、骨质疏松制剂、补铁产品、泌尿系统药物及抗癌药物，同时代理飞利浦呼吸机在台湾的独家销售。
companies.description_en: Taiwan-based biotech focused on liver disease drug R&D. Revenue mix includes pharmaceuticals (osteoarthritis, iron supplements, anticancer drugs), medical devices (blood cell separators), functional foods, and exclusive Philips ventilator distribution in Taiwan.

sources.title: TCM Biotech International Corp. Company Profile - Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 孟加拉国制药公司，生产和销售人用及兽用药物，包括肿瘤科药物，产品销往孟加拉国国内及国际市场。
companies.description_en: Bangladesh-based generics pharma manufacturer producing human and veterinary medicines for domestic and international markets, including oncology drugs. Revenue grew 32% in 2024 to BDT 3.61B. Listed on Dhaka Stock Exchange.

companies.description_zh: 印度制药公司，1952年创立，与匈牙利Gedeon Richter公司合资，生产和销售API及制剂产品，专注于抗结核、抗疟疾、心血管、镇痛及抗感染等治疗领域，在Vapi（古吉拉特邦）、海得拉巴及哈里德瓦尔设有制造工厂。
companies.description_en: Indian pharmaceutical company founded 1952, operating as a JV with Hungary's Gedeon Richter. Manufactures APIs and formulations across anti-tuberculosis, antimalarials, cardiology, pain management, and anti-infectives. Four manufacturing facilities in Vapi, Hyderabad, and Haridwar.

companies.description_zh: 韩国临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于罕见和难治疾病的创新疗法研发，主要管线包括TU2218（TGF-β/VEGFR2双靶点口服免疫肿瘤药，处于2期）、TU2670（口服GnRH拮抗剂，处于1期）及TU7710（血友病旁路因子，处于1期）。
companies.description_en: Korean clinical-stage biotech founded 2016 targeting rare and incurable diseases. Pipeline: TU2218 (oral TGF-beta/VEGFR2 immuno-oncology, Ph2), TU2670 (oral GnRH antagonist, Ph1), TU7710 (bypass-factor for hemophilia with inhibitors, Ph1). Research collaboration with Oncodesign on fibrosis.

companies.description_zh: 韩国基因组编辑技术开发公司，1999年成立，专注于CRISPR-Cas9基因剪刀技术，业务涵盖专利货币化、基因治疗及种子业务。2025年与GenEditBio签署战略交叉授权协议，共同推进体内基因组编辑疗法。
companies.description_en: Korean biotech founded 1999 focusing on CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing technology in eukaryotic cells. Business includes patent monetization (IP licensing), therapeutic development, and seed/agri applications. Cross-licensed with GenEditBio (2025) for next-gen in vivo gene editing.

sources.title: ToolGen Enters 'Harvest Season' for Global IP Monetization

companies.name_zh: 优尼化学实验室有限公司
companies.description_zh: 1944年成立的印度综合制药公司，生产和销售品牌仿制药及仿制药，业务覆盖印度、美国及国际市场，产品涵盖胃肠科、心脏科、糖尿病、精神科、神经科、抗菌及镇痛等多个治疗领域，在果阿、加济阿巴德、巴迪及Roha等地设有制造工厂。
companies.description_en: Indian integrated specialty pharma company founded 1944, manufacturing branded generics and generics across gastroenterology, cardiology, diabetology, psychiatry, neurology, anti-bacterials, and pain management. Operations in India, US, and internationally; API plants at Roha, Pithampur, Kolhapur.

companies.name_zh: 向荣生医科技股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 台湾干细胞新药公司，专注于同种异体脂肪干细胞药物ELIXCYTE的研发，适应症包括膝关节骨性关节炎（3期临床）和慢性肾病，已于2025年10月从台湾创新板转至主板上市，成为台湾首家在主板上市的再生医学干细胞药物公司。
companies.description_en: Taiwan clinical-stage biotech specializing in allogeneic adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cell drugs. Lead asset ELIXCYTE in Phase III for knee osteoarthritis and Phase II for CKD. Transferred from Taiwan Innovation Board to General Board in October 2025. Also operates autologous stem cell banking and CDMO services.

sources.title: UnicoCell Biomed Completes Patient Enrollment in Phase III of ELIXCYTE

companies.name_en: WooGene B&G Co., Ltd. (formerly listed as Vaxcell Bio, KOSDAQ:018620)
companies.description_zh: 韩国动物卫生公司，1977年成立，原名WooJin，从事兽用药物、微生物技术及疫苗业务，产品涵盖猪、禽、牛、水产、伴侣动物的抗生素、疫苗、营养剂、抗炎药及铁补充剂，同时设有疫苗研究中心。注：所提供代码018620在KOSDAQ上对应WooGene B&G而非Vaxcell Bio。
companies.description_en: Korean animal health company founded 1977 (formerly WooJin, rebranded WooGene B&G). Engages in veterinary medicines, microbial technology, and vaccines for swine, poultry, cattle, aquatic animals, and companion animals. Operates a vaccine research center. Note: KOSDAQ:018620 corresponds to WooGene B&G, not Vaxcell-Bio Therapeutics (323990).

sources.title: WooGene B&G Co., Ltd Company Profile

companies.description_zh: 印度研发驱动型制药公司，1989年成立于旁遮普邦潘奇库拉，专注于抗菌素耐药性解决方案及肿瘤科产品，持有全球逾120项专利，产品出口至70余个国家，拥有Venus Medicine Research Centre（VMRC）研究中心。
companies.description_en: Indian research-driven pharma founded 1989, headquartered in Panchkula, Haryana. Specializes in antimicrobial resistance solutions with 120+ global patents, critical care injectables, oncology drugs, and herbal/OTC products. Exports to 70+ countries. Revenue FY2025: INR 6.48B (+7.7% YoY).

companies.name_zh: 台湾维诺斯动物医药股份有限公司
companies.description_zh: 台湾动物医药公司，2012年由永信药品整合其动物保健部门及收购外资公司后成立，专注于动物用药品、保健食品、饲料添加剂及饲料的进口、生产和销售，持有逾300项国内外兽药许可证，位于新竹县。
companies.description_en: Taiwan animal health company established in 2012 under YungShin Group, holding 300+ domestic/international veterinary product licenses. Products include antibiotics, hormonal preparations, topical disinfectants, dewormers, vitamins, and non-medicated feed additives for swine, cattle, poultry, pets, and aquaculture. Revenue 2024: NT$1.294B.

sources.title: Vetnostrum Animal Health (TPE:6936) Stock Price & Overview
New Listed Company: Vetnostrum Animal Health - TWSE Market Insights

companies.name_zh: 维姆塔实验室有限公司
companies.description_zh: 印度领先的合同研究与检测机构（CRTO），1984年成立于海得拉巴，服务制药、生物制药、食品、医疗器械、农药及特种化学品等行业，提供药物发现、临床前研究、临床研究及分析服务，被誉为印度CRTO行业之父。
companies.description_en: India's most comprehensive contract research and testing organization (CRTO) founded 1984 in Hyderabad. Services: preclinical/clinical research, GMP analytical services, method development, microbiology, stability testing, medical device testing, agrochemical and food testing. Revenue FY2025: INR 3.44B (+8% YoY); Q1 FY2026 up 22%.

companies.name_zh: 维维迈德实验室有限公司
companies.description_zh: 印度API和特种化学品制造商，1988年成立于海得拉巴，经营特种化学品（包括头发染料、成像化学品及光致变色材料）和制药（API、品牌制剂）两大板块，目前财务状况较为困难，净债权比率偏高，收入下滑。
companies.description_en: Indian manufacturer of APIs, finished dosage formulations, specialty chemicals, and retail branded formulations. Two segments: Speciality Chemicals (hair dyes, imaging chemicals, photochromics) and Pharma (APIs, branded ophthalmic/derma/pain formulations). Revenue FY2025: INR 1.21B (down 24%). High leverage.

companies.description_zh: 韩国多元化公司，前身为Vivozon Healthcare，2022年更名。经营制药（包括酒精代谢、老年痴呆及成人病治疗药物）和LED照明产品（室内外及汽车照明）两大业务，主要市场在韩国，总部位于华城市。
companies.description_en: Korean diversified company formerly known as Vivozon Healthcare (renamed 2022). Operates pharmaceutical division (alcohol detoxification, senile dementia, adult disease treatments) and LED lighting division (interior, general, automotive lighting packages). Revenue 2024: KRW 87.6B (+22.8% YoY); 2025 revenue fell 32% to KRW 59.3B.

companies.description_zh: 韩国仁川生物技术公司，2015年成立，专注于小分子激酶抑制剂的研究与发现，管线包括VRN01（LRRK2抑制剂，神经胶质瘤/胰腺癌）、VRN06/07/11（肺癌）、VRN08/10（乳腺癌）、VRN02（类风湿关节炎/特应性皮炎）及VRN13（肺动脉高压）。
companies.description_en: Korean small-molecule kinase inhibitor biotech founded 2015, headquartered in Incheon (Songdo). Pipeline: VRN01 (LRRK2, GBM/pancreatic), VRN06/07/11 (lung cancer), VRN08/10 (breast cancer), VRN02 (RA/atopic dermatitis), VRN04-1/04-2 (autoimmune/neurological), VRN13 (PAH), VRN14 (refractory solid tumors). TTM revenue KRW 7.51B.

companies.description_zh: 韩国医疗AI解决方案公司，2014年成立于首尔，提供多种医学影像AI诊断产品：BoneAge（骨龄评估）、DeepBrain（神经退行性疾病脑分割）、DeepCARS（心脏骤停风险管理，2024年营收主要驱动力）、胸部X光诊断支持及LungCT AI肺结节检测系统。
companies.description_en: Korean medical AI company founded 2014 in Seoul. Products: BoneAge (AI bone age), DeepBrain (brain parcellation for neurodegeneration), DeepCARS (cardiac arrest risk, KRW 7B revenue in Q3 2025), chest X-ray diagnostic support, fundus AI, LungCT AI. Full-year 2024 revenue KRW 25.9B; first three quarters 2025 already exceeded 2024 full year.

sources.title: Medical AI Company VUNO Reports Profit in Q3, Driven by DeepCARS Growth

companies.description_zh: 印度制药公司，1988年成立（原名Pearl Organics），2004年更名为旺伯里，全球最大的盐酸二甲双胍制造商（月产能950吨）及印度最大的盐酸曲马多出口商，产品覆盖API和制剂，销往50余个国家，65%以上收入来自受监管市场。
companies.description_en: Indian API and formulations pharma founded 1988 (formerly Pearl Organics). World's largest Metformin HCl manufacturer (950 MT/month capacity) and largest Tramadol exporter from India to USA. API portfolio: Metformin, Sertraline, Tramadol, Diphenhydramine, Paroxetine. Present in 50+ countries; 65%+ revenue from regulated markets.

sources.title: Pharma API player Wanbury to focus on profitability and growth

rnd_spend.note: R&D ~1.4–1.75% of revenue in FY22–FY23; not separately disclosed in FY25 filing

companies.description_zh: 温德拉斯生物技术是印度领先的制药制剂合同开发与制造组织（CDMO），按收入计位居国内前五。公司在德拉敦（北阿坎德邦）运营五座WHO-GMP认证的制造工厂（其中一座获EU GMP认证），为印度前十大制剂药企中的七家提供服务，客户超过583家，包括辉瑞、赛诺菲、Cadila和Zydus。产品覆盖口服固体制剂、液体制剂及注射剂，涵盖心血管、降糖、呼吸、神经/中枢神经等多个治疗领域，出口至19个国家。
companies.description_en: Windlas Biotech Limited is a top-five Indian pharmaceutical formulations CDMO by revenue, offering end-to-end services from product discovery to commercial manufacturing of generic and complex generic products. The company operates five WHO-GMP certified manufacturing facilities in Dehradun, Uttarakhand (one EU-GMP certified), serving 583+ CDMO clients in FY2024, including seven of India's top ten formulation companies (Pfizer, Sanofi, Cadila, Zydus). Portfolio spans 278+ brands across cardiovascular, anti-diabetic, respiratory, neuro/CNS, GI, urology, and pain management. Listed on NSE/BSE via IPO in August 2021.

sources.title: Windlas Biotech (NSE:WINDLAS) Market Cap & Net Worth
Deep Dive: Windlas Biotech Limited – A Pharmaceutical Growth Story

rnd_spend.note: R&D spend ~KRW 6.8B in FY2024, representing ~118% of revenue

companies.description_zh: Y生物制药是一家专注于抗体新药发现和开发的韩国临床阶段生物技术公司，总部位于大田市，2023年在KOSDAQ上市。公司基于Korea最高水平的抗体发现平台，独立开发或共同开发抗体治疗药物，主要业务模式为新型抗体候选药物的开发及早期技术许可转让，以及合同研究服务（CRO）。核心管线包括：YBL-006（Acrixolimab，抗PD-1抗体，已完成1/2a期临床试验）、YBL-001（ADC，靶向小细胞肺癌/肝癌）及多个双特异性抗体和ADC候选物。2025年与LigaChem完成ADC技术转让。
companies.description_en: Y-Biologics Inc. is a South Korean clinical-stage antibody therapeutics company headquartered in Daejeon, KOSDAQ-listed in 2023. Built on a proprietary antibody discovery platform, the company develops novel immuno-oncology and immunoregulatory antibodies, with a primary business model of early-stage technology licensing and contract research services (CRO arm: ybioservice.com). Lead asset YBL-006 (Acrixolimab, anti-PD-1 mAb) completed Phase 1/2a trials for advanced solid tumors. Pipeline of 20+ candidates includes ADCs, bispecifics, and LAG-3 inhibitors. Revenue base is thin and volatile (largely milestone/licensing income), with substantial net losses as a pre-commercial company.

rnd_spend.note: R&D not separately disclosed; company is primarily a generics manufacturer/trader

companies.description_zh: Y.S.P.东南亚控股是马来西亚领先的仿制药制造和贸易集团，控股公司成立于2001年（核心制造子公司Y.S.P. Industries成立于1990年，注册于1987年），2004年在马来西亚证交所上市。集团运营涵盖制造、贸易及投资控股三大板块，产品组合超过800个品规，包括处方药、非处方药（OTC）、兽药、水产药物、传统中草药及保健品。主要制造工厂位于雪兰莪州Bandar Baru Bangi（cGMP认证），业务覆盖东南亚、中东、非洲、澳大利亚及新西兰。
companies.description_en: Y.S.P. Southeast Asia Holding Berhad is a Malaysian generic pharmaceuticals manufacturer and trader, listed on Bursa Malaysia since 2004. The investment holding company (incorporated 2001) controls Y.S.P. Industries (M) Sdn. Bhd. (manufacturing subsidiary, incorporated 1990), which operates a cGMP-certified facility in Bandar Baru Bangi, Selangor. The group carries 800+ product SKUs across prescription, OTC, veterinary, aquaculture, traditional Chinese medicine, and health supplement categories. Distribution spans ASEAN, Middle East, Africa, Australia and New Zealand. Manufacturing capabilities include gel, capsule, tablet, suppository, cream, syrup, suspension, powder, and eye drops dosage forms.

sources.title: YSPSAH (7178): Y.S.P. Southeast Asia Holding Berhad – KLSE Screener
Y.S.P. Industries SDN BHD – Pharma Boardroom

rnd_spend.note: R&D not separately disclosed in filings; company is primarily a generics/OTC/nutraceutical manufacturer

companies.description_zh: 佐塔医疗是总部位于古吉拉特邦苏拉特的印度仿制药和OTC企业，由创始人Ketankumar Zota于1995年创立。公司开发、生产并销售仿制药、专利药、阿育吠陀制剂、保健品及OTC产品，覆盖国内市场及国际半管制/管制市场，在亚洲、非洲、俄罗斯和拉丁美洲均有出口。产品组合超过4,000个SKU（18+个治疗部门）。2017年推出DavaIndia泛型药品零售连锁，目前已通过1,050+家分销商铺设国内渠道。苏拉特经济特区（SEZ）设有30,000平方英尺的cGMP制造工厂。公司于2020年在NSE/BSE上市。
companies.description_en: Zota Health Care Limited is a Surat, Gujarat-based Indian pharmaceutical company founded in 1995 by Chairman Ketankumar Zota. The company manufactures and markets generic, ayurvedic, nutraceutical, and OTC products across India and international semi-regulated/regulated markets (Asia, Africa, Russia, Latin America). Portfolio exceeds 4,000 SKUs across 18+ therapeutic divisions including cardiovascular, anti-diabetic, respiratory, neuropsychiatry, GI, analgesics, and dermatology. Operates a cGMP-certified manufacturing plant (30,000 sq ft) in the Surat Special Economic Zone near Sachin Railway Station. Launched DavaIndia generic pharmacy retail chain in 2017, now with 1,050+ domestic distributors. Listed NSE/BSE in 2020. Revenue grew 62% YoY in FY2025 and 84% in FY2026, though the company recorded a net loss in FY2026 due to expansion costs.

sources.title: Zota Health Care (NSE:ZOTA) Market Cap & Net Worth
Zota Health Care (NSE:ZOTA) Financials – Income Statement
NSE – Zota Health Care Press Release August 2024

companies.description_zh: 萨利姆控股是一家临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于开发新一代激酶抑制剂，用于自身免疫疾病和癌症治疗。其主要候选药物SDC-1801是TYK2/JAK1双重抑制剂，主要用于银屑病治疗。
companies.description_en: Sareum Holdings plc is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation kinase inhibitors for autoimmune diseases and cancer. Its lead candidate SDC-1801 is a dual TYK2/JAK1 inhibitor for psoriasis; SDC-1802 targets cancer immunotherapy.

sources.title: Sareum Notice of AGM, Annual Report 2025 – Investegate

companies.description_zh: 斯坎塞尔控股是一家临床阶段生物制药公司，开发癌症免疫疗法。其核心技术平台包括ImmunoBody和Moditope癌症疫苗以及GlyMab和AvidiMab单克隆抗体。iSCIB1+（黑色素瘤）和Modi-1（头颈癌/肾癌）处于2期试验阶段。
companies.description_en: Scancell Holdings plc is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing immunotherapies for cancer. Its four proprietary platforms — ImmunoBody, Moditope, GlyMab and AvidiMab — underpin iSCIB1+ (melanoma, Phase 2) and Modi-1 (head & neck cancer/RCC, Phase 2). Partnered with Genmab.

companies.name_zh: 塞尔丘克药品仓储贸易工业公司
companies.name_en: Selçuk Ecza Deposu Ticaret ve Sanayi A.Ş.
companies.description_zh: 塞尔丘克药品仓储是土耳其主要的药品批发分销商，负责在药品制造商、医院和药店之间组织分销渠道，同时分销化妆品、个人护理、婴儿食品、维生素及医疗产品。
companies.description_en: Selçuk Ecza Deposu is a major Turkish pharmaceutical wholesale distributor, organizing distribution channels between drug manufacturers, hospitals and pharmacies, and also distributing cosmetics, personal care products, infant food, vitamins and medical supplies.

sources.title: Selcuk Ecza Deposu Stock Overview – StockAnalysis

companies.description_zh: 塞尔维塔是欧洲领先的临床前CRO之一，总部位于波兰克拉科夫，在六个站点提供药物发现与开发服务，并拓展至CDMO和生物药物发现领域。大型制药公司占其营收的26%。
companies.description_en: Selvita S.A. is one of Europe's leading preclinical CROs, headquartered in Kraków, Poland. It provides multidisciplinary drug discovery and drug development services across six sites in four countries, with expanding CDMO and biological drug discovery capabilities. Big Pharma represents 26% of revenue.

sources.title: Selvita Reports Rebound in H2 2024 – PRNewswire

companies.description_zh: 森索里翁是一家临床阶段生物技术公司，专注于开发听力损失障碍的新型疗法。其主要项目SENS-501（Audiogene基因疗法）针对OTOF基因突变引起的遗传性先天性耳聋，另有GJB2基因治疗项目和小分子SENS-401（Arazasetron）。获得赛诺菲2000万欧元战略投资。
companies.description_en: Sensorion SA is a clinical-stage biotech pioneering treatments for hearing loss. Lead programme SENS-501 (Audiogene Phase 1/2) targets OTOF-gene congenital deafness; GJB2 gene therapy is advancing toward CTA/IND; small-molecule SENS-401 (Arazasetron) addresses acquired hearing loss. Received €20M strategic investment from Sanofi as part of a €60M financing.

companies.description_zh: 森扎根AB通过其专有的GARD（基因组过敏原快速检测）体外测试平台，提供皮肤和呼吸道致敏性评估服务，服务于化妆品、化学品、医疗器械、制药和营养食品添加剂领域。在瑞典和意大利设有GLP认证实验室，在美国和意大利设有子公司。
companies.description_en: Senzagen AB provides in vitro sensitization testing using its proprietary GARD platform (genomics + machine learning) for skin and respiratory sensitization risk assessment. Serves cosmetics, chemicals, medical devices, pharma and nutrition/food additive markets. GLP-certified labs in Sweden and Italy.

companies.description_zh: 盾牌治疗公司是一家专注于铁缺乏症治疗的商业阶段特殊制药公司，其核心产品ACCRUFeR（铁麦芽糖醇）在美国市场2025年净收入达4580万美元（同比增长56%），在欧洲以FeRACCRU品牌由Norgine销售。已实现现金流转正。
companies.description_en: Shield Therapeutics plc is a commercial-stage specialty pharma company focused on iron deficiency. ACCRUFeR (ferric maltol) achieved $45.8M US net revenue in 2025 (+56% YoY); ~199,000 prescriptions dispensed with 15,000+ prescribers. Achieved positive cash flow in Q4 2025. Feraccru marketed in Europe by Norgine.

sources.title: Shield Therapeutics Audited Results FY2025 – Investegate

companies.description_zh: 西格弗里德控股是一家全球合同开发和制造组织（CDMO），专注于小分子原料药和各种剂型的制剂生产。在三大洲拥有13个生产基地，包括瑞士、德国、西班牙、法国、马耳他、美国和中国的设施。2024年净销售额为13亿瑞士法郎。
companies.description_en: Siegfried Holding AG is a global CDMO focused on small molecule drug substance and drug product manufacturing across multiple dosage forms. Operates 13 manufacturing sites across three continents (CH, DE, ES, FR, MT, US, CN). 2024 net sales CHF 1,294.6M; core EBITDA margin 22.1%.

companies.description_zh: 沉默治疗公司是一家RNAi领域先驱，通过其专有mRNAi GOLD平台开发siRNA疗法。主要项目包括：Zerlasiran（SLN360，针对高脂蛋白(a)心血管疾病，已完成3期准备）和Divesiran（SLN124，针对真性红细胞增多症，2期SANRECO试验进行中）。
companies.description_en: Silence Therapeutics plc is a pioneer in RNAi, developing siRNA therapies via its mRNAi GOLD™ platform. Lead programmes: Zerlasiran (SLN360, high Lp(a)/CVD, Phase 3-ready) and Divesiran (SLN124, polycythemia vera, Phase 2 SANRECO trial). 2025 R&D spend $67.8M; cash $85.1M at year-end.

sources.title: Silence Therapeutics FY2025 Financial Results – Yahoo Finance

companies.description_zh: 皮肤生物疗法公司专注于利用人类微生物组中发现的蛋白质来保护、管理和修复皮肤健康的技术开发和商业化。其SkinBiotix技术源于曼彻斯特大学的研究。FY2025营收因前CEO数据造假问题重述为390万英镑。
companies.description_en: SkinBioTherapeutics plc is a life science group focused on skin health, harnessing the microbiome via its SkinBiotix platform (derived from University of Manchester research) for dermatological products. FY2025 revenues restated to GBP 3.9M following an investigation that found fabricated figures by the former CEO.

sources.title: SkinBioTherapeutics HY26 and Restated FY25 Results – Investegate

companies.name_zh: 斯普林特生物科学公司
companies.description_zh: 斯普林特生物科学是一家专注于癌症药物发现的瑞典制药公司，通过出许可药物项目获取收入。其候选药物组合包括VRK1、VPS34、PETRA01、TREX1、NNMT、STK25和DCPS等激酶和非激酶靶点。总部位于斯德哥尔摩胡丁厄新卡罗林斯卡科学园区。
companies.description_en: Sprint Bioscience AB is a Swedish drug discovery company focused on developing kinase inhibitors for cancer. Its portfolio includes VRK1, VPS34, PETRA01, TREX1, NNMT, STK25 and DCPS programs, generating revenue through out-licensing arrangements. Located at Novum, Karolinska Institutet area, Huddinge.

companies.description_zh: 赛纳根公司由南安普顿大学教授于2003年创立，是一家呼吸道药物开发公司，专注于开发吸入式干扰素-β（IFN-β）SNG001，作为针对高风险患者群体的病毒性肺部感染宿主靶向广谱抗病毒治疗。
companies.description_en: Synairgen PLC, founded by University of Southampton professors in 2003, is a respiratory drug discovery company focused on SNG001, an investigational inhaled interferon beta (IFN-β) as a potential first host-targeted broad-spectrum antiviral for severe viral lung infections in high-risk patients.

companies.description_zh: 西奈克蒂克是波兰领先的创新医疗设备、IT解决方案和放射性药物供应商，服务于放射成像和核医学领域。在波兰、捷克、斯洛伐克和波罗的海国家独家分销达芬奇机器人手术系统，同时是波兰PET/CT放射性药物的生产和分销领导者。
companies.description_en: Synektik S.A. is a Polish supplier of innovative medical equipment, IT solutions and radiopharmaceuticals for diagnostic imaging and nuclear medicine. Exclusive distributor of da Vinci surgical robots in Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia and Baltic states. FY2024 (Oct 2023-Sep 2024) revenue PLN 624.8M; FY2025 (Oct 2024-Sep 2025) grew to PLN 682M.

companies.description_zh: 帝肯集团是专注于生命科学实验室自动化解决方案的国际知名瑞士制造商，为生物制药、法证和临床诊断行业的实验室提供自动化仪器和服务。2025年销售额8.825亿瑞士法郎，调整后EBITDA利润率16.1%。在70多个国家设有销售和服务网络。
companies.description_en: Tecan Group AG is an internationally active Swiss manufacturer of laboratory automation solutions for life sciences, biopharmaceuticals, forensics and clinical diagnostics. 2025 sales CHF 882.5M (adj. EBITDA margin 16.1%); sales split between Life Sciences (CHF 377M) and Partnering/OEM (CHF 505M) segments. Sales and service network in 70+ countries.

sources.title: Tecan Group AG TECN Stock Overview – StockAnalysis

companies.description_zh: 泰拉耐克苏斯（现更名为THX Pharma）是一家专注于罕见神经系统疾病创新疗法开发的生物制药公司，源自法国原子能委员会（CEA）。核心项目TX01用于戈谢病和C型尼曼-匹克病儿童患者；Batten-1靶向青少年型巴滕病。已与Exeltis达成商业化合作。
companies.description_en: THX Pharma (formerly Theranexus), born from the French CEA, develops rare neurological disease therapies. TX01 is a novel pediatric formulation for Gaucher disease and Niemann-Pick type C (EMA PIP approved; filing by Exeltis targeted Q1 2027). Batten-1 targets juvenile Batten disease. 2025 operating income €813K (mostly grants).

sources.title: THX Pharma and Exeltis EMA PIP Approval for TX01 – Euronext

companies.name_zh: 蒂齐亚纳生命科学公司
companies.description_zh: 蒂齐亚纳生命科学是一家双重上市（纳斯达克：TLSA，AIM：TILS）生物技术公司，其主要候选药物为鼻内给药的foralumab（全人源抗CD3单克隆抗体），正在进行非活动性继发进展型多发性硬化症2期临床试验（约翰霍普金斯大学）。2025年净亏损1840万美元，面临持续经营疑虑。
companies.description_en: Tiziana Life Sciences plc (Nasdaq: TLSA; AIM: TILS) is developing intranasal foralumab, a fully human anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody, as its lead programme. A Phase 2a RCT in non-active secondary progressive MS (na-SPMS) is underway at Johns Hopkins; topline data expected Q3 2026. 2025 net loss $18.4M; going concern doubt flagged.

sources.title: Tiziana Life Sciences Form 6-K FY2025 – SEC
Johns Hopkins Phase 2 MS Trial Dosing – Tiziana

companies.description_zh: 转基因公司是一家以病毒为基础的肿瘤免疫疗法开发商，总部位于法国斯特拉斯堡（梅里厄研究所控股）。核心平台包括myvac（个体化新抗原治疗性疫苗）和Invir.IO（溶瘤病毒）。主要候选药物TG4050（头颈癌2期）已展示24个月无病生存临床概念验证。已完成约1.05亿欧元融资，资金使用期延至2028年初。
companies.description_en: Transgene SA designs and develops virus-based immunotherapies for cancer (majority owned by Institut Mérieux). Portfolio: TG4050 (myvac individualized neoantigen vaccine, Phase 1/2 head & neck cancer – proof-of-principle at 24 months), TG4001 (shared antigen vaccine), BT-001 and TG6050 (Invir.IO oncolytic viruses). ~€105M fundraise extends visibility to early 2028.

companies.description_zh: 优尼库尔是一家领先的基因治疗公司，总部位于荷兰阿姆斯特丹，在美国莱克星顿设有运营机构。主导项目AMT-130是针对亨廷顿病的基因疗法，3年临床数据显示疾病进展具有统计显著性减缓。其他项目包括颞叶癫痫、法布里病、ALS（SOD1）和B型血友病。2025年研发支出1.407亿美元。
companies.description_en: uniQure NV is a leading gene therapy company (Amsterdam HQ, Lexington MA operations). Lead asset AMT-130 (Huntington's disease) showed statistically significant slowing of disease progression at 36 months – a potential first disease-modifying therapy. Pipeline also includes temporal lobe epilepsy, Fabry disease, ALS (SOD1) and Hemophilia B. 2025 R&D spend $140.7M.

companies.description_zh: 英国 AIM 上市的微型肿瘤学生物制药公司，专注早期癌症治疗药物及伴随诊断的开发，核心资产包括 CLX001（脂质体肽剂型）和 Inaphaea 生物库平台。公司于 2024 年完成战略重组，精简团队至约 9 人，大幅降低现金消耗。
companies.description_en: Micro-cap AIM-listed biopharmaceutical company focused on early-stage oncology therapeutics and companion diagnostics. Lead assets include CLX001 (liposomal peptide) and the Inaphaea biobank/assay-ready platform. Following a 2024 restructure the team was reduced to ~9 staff.

companies.description_zh: 瑞典临床阶段生物制药公司，专注肺纤维化及纤维化疾病的新型疾病修饰疗法开发。核心管线 buloxibutid（AT2R 激动剂）正在开展全球 52 周 Phase 2b ASPIRE 试验，治疗特发性肺纤维化（IPF），已获 FDA 孤儿药及快速通道资格。2025 年底公司从 Nasdaq 小盘股晋升至中盘股。
companies.description_en: Swedish clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a new class of disease-modifying therapies for respiratory and fibrotic diseases. Lead candidate buloxibutid (AT2R agonist, oral small-molecule) is in the global 52-week Phase 2b ASPIRE trial in IPF; has FDA Orphan Drug and Fast Track designations.

companies.description_zh: 丹麦医疗科技公司，研发并销售以 suPAR（可溶性尿激酶受体）为核心的慢性炎症血液检测产品（品牌：suPARnostic），应用于医院急诊、预防医学及长寿领域。超过 1175 篇同行评审文献验证了 suPAR 的临床价值。
companies.description_en: Danish medtech company that develops and markets blood tests measuring suPAR (soluble urokinase receptor) for chronic inflammation risk assessment under the suPARnostic® brand. Expanding from acute care into preventive health and longevity diagnostics.

sources.title: ViroGates FY2025 Annual Report – SAHM Capital

companies.description_zh: 瑞典生物仿制药公司，专注眼科疾病生物仿制药开发。核心产品 Ximluci®（雷尼珠单抗生物仿制药）已在 24 个国家上市，包括 20 个欧洲市场。公司同步开发 Xdivane™ 等后续管线候选产品，并正向 FDA 重新提交雷尼珠单抗 BLA 申请。
companies.description_en: Swedish biosimilar company developing ophthalmology biosimilar candidates. Ximluci® (ranibizumab biosimilar of Lucentis) is approved and launched in 24 countries (20 Europe + 4 Asia/Middle East); FDA BLA resubmission pending. Phase 2 pipeline includes Xdivane™.

companies.description_zh: 瑞士上市生命科学投资控股公司，聚焦从大学及研究机构孵化的早期技术平台、生物技术疗法、医疗器械及 AI/数字健康领域，将组合公司支持至临床前概念验证阶段并实现战略退出。旗下 VERAXA Biotech AG 正推进纳斯达克上市。
companies.description_en: Swiss-listed life science investment holding company focusing on early-stage innovations spun off from universities and research centers, covering tech platforms, biotech therapies, medtech, and AI/digital health. Supports portfolio companies to preclinical PoC and strategic exits; portfolio company VERAXA Biotech is pursuing a NASDAQ listing.

companies.description_zh: 上海临床阶段肿瘤学生物制药公司，专注创新小分子精准肿瘤和免疫肿瘤疗法的发现与开发。核心产品 pimicotinib（ABSK021，CSF-1R 抑制剂）已于 2025 年 12 月获中国 NMPA 批准用于腱鞘巨细胞瘤，美国 FDA NDA 已获受理，并与默克签署了里程碑高达数十亿美元的授权合作。管线含 21 个候选项目。
companies.description_en: Shanghai-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company discovering and developing innovative precision oncology and immuno-oncology small molecule therapies. Lead product pimicotinib (CSF-1R inhibitor) approved by China NMPA in Dec 2025 for TGCT; FDA NDA accepted; licensed to Merck. Pipeline of 21 candidates.

companies.description_zh: 陕西西安高新区植物提取企业，专注植物原料、食品添加剂、健康食品原料及膳食补充剂的研发、生产与销售。工厂位于西安市周至县，占地 40,000 平方米，年处理原料 5,000 吨，持有 cGMP、ISO22000、HACCP、有机、清真等认证。为陕西省内第一家植物提取新三板上市公司。
companies.description_en: Xi'an-based plant extract company engaged in the R&D, production and sales of herbal extracts, organic plant proteins, food additives, health food ingredients, and dietary supplements. GMP/ISO22000/HACCP/Organic certified; 40,000 sqm facility in Zhouzhi County.

companies.name_en: Sino Biological Inc. (Beijing Yiqiao Shenzhou Technology)
companies.description_zh: 北京领先的重组蛋白与抗体试剂供应商，为全球生命科学研究和生物制药开发提供高质量蛋白、抗体、cDNA 克隆、检测试剂盒及血清培养基等产品。2021 年于深交所创业板上市，在苏州、泰州、美国、欧洲及日本均设有子公司，年收入约 7 亿元，同比增长 14%。
companies.description_en: Beijing-based leading supplier of recombinant proteins and antibody reagents for global life science research and biopharmaceutical development. Offers proteins, antibodies, cDNA clones, assay kits, and serum-free media. Listed on SZSE ChiNext in 2021; subsidiaries in Suzhou, Taizhou, USA, Europe, and Japan.

companies.description_zh: 中国第三大独立医学实验室（按临床检测收入），提供逾 4,000 项常规及特检服务，拥有 34 家自营实验室，覆盖全国主要城市。2023 年于港交所主板上市，受 Carlyle 控股，2025 年宣布收购 CrownBio 进入 CRO 领域。全年营收 26.4 亿元，同比下降 9.5%。
companies.description_en: China's third-largest independent clinical laboratory (ICL) by revenue, offering 4,000+ routine and specialty diagnostic tests via 34 self-operated labs nationwide. Listed on HKEX in 2023; Carlyle-backed. In 2025 announced acquisition of CrownBio. FY2025 revenue CNY 2.64 billion, down 9.5% YoY.

companies.description_zh: 苏州工业园区创新疫苗及药物公司，基于自有 DNA 疫苗及单克隆抗体技术平台，开发针对新冠病毒、RSV、乙型肝炎及肿瘤的预防性和治疗性疫苗。2023 年 2 月在新三板挂牌。可溶性微针产品 MICROEPAD™ 已获美国 FDA 注册，RSV 疫苗 BARS13 完成 II 期临床。
companies.description_en: Suzhou-based biopharmaceutical company developing innovative preventive and therapeutic vaccines and monoclonal antibodies for COVID-19, RSV, HBV, and oncology using proprietary DNA vaccine technology. MICROEPAD™ dissolving microneedle registered with FDA in 2025; BARS13 RSV vaccine Phase 2 completed; partnered with INOVIO for INO-4800.

companies.description_zh: 专注于生物工艺耗材的细分龙头，产品涵盖蛋白 A 配体、过滤系统及色谱柱，服务于抗体药物生产。
companies.description_en: Bioprocess consumables specialist with Protein A ligands, filtration systems, and chromatography columns serving antibody drug manufacturing.

companies.description_zh: 梅特勒-托利多（NYSE:MTD）全球精密仪器与服务领导者，产品涵盖实验室天平、过程分析仪器及工业称重设备。2024年收入38.72亿美元，员工17,300人。
companies.description_en: Global leader in precision instruments and services: laboratory balances, process analytical instruments, and industrial weighing equipment. Mettler founded 1945 in Switzerland, merged with Toledo Scale in 1989. FY2024 revenue $3.872B (+2.2% YoY); 17,300 employees.

Pioneer of direct-to-consumer genetic testing, offering saliva-based ancestry and health reports. After a 2023 data breach and 2025 Chapter 11 bankruptcy, its assets (Personal Genome Service, research, and Lemonaid Health telehealth) were acquired in July 2025 for $305M by TTAM Research Institute, a nonprofit led by co-founder Anne Wojcicki; it is no longer publicly traded.
companies.description_zh: 面向消费者基因检测的开创者，提供唾液采样的祖源与健康报告。在2023年数据泄露和2025年破产重组后，其核心资产（个人基因组服务、科研业务及Lemonaid Health远程医疗）于2025年7月被联合创始人Anne Wojcicki领导的非营利机构TTAM Research Institute以3.05亿美元收购，已不再公开交易。

sources.title: TTAM Research Institute completes acquisition of 23andMe assets
Bankruptcy court approves $305M sale to TTAM

companies.description_en: Pioneering brain-computer interface company whose Utah-array microelectrode technology has powered most academic human BCI trials, enabling tetraplegic patients to control robotic limbs and locked-in ALS patients to communicate. Privately held; raised ~$250M total, anchored by a $200M strategic investment from Tether in 2024.
companies.description_zh: 脑机接口领域的先驱企业，其犹他阵列微电极技术支撑了绝大多数学术界的人体BCI试验，使四肢瘫痪患者能用思维控制机械臂、闭锁综合征的ALS患者重获交流能力。公司为私有，累计融资约2.5亿美元，其中2024年获Tether 2亿美元战略投资。

sources.title: Tether takes strategic stake in Blackrock Neurotech

companies.description_en: The largest professional network for U.S. medical professionals, with the majority of American physicians as members, monetized through pharma marketing, hiring, and telehealth/workflow tools. Fiscal 2026 revenue reached $644.9M with strong profitability and a growing suite of AI clinical productivity products.
companies.description_zh: 美国最大的医生职业社交网络，覆盖大多数美国执业医师，通过药企营销、医疗招聘及远程医疗/临床工作流工具变现。2026财年营收达6.449亿美元，盈利能力强劲，并不断扩展其AI临床效率产品线。

companies.description_en: Leading oncology-focused electronic health record and real-world evidence platform, aggregating de-identified cancer patient data from a large network of community and academic practices to power research and regulatory submissions. Acquired by Roche in 2018 for $1.9B and operated as a subsidiary.
companies.description_zh: 领先的肿瘤专科电子病历与真实世界证据平台，从覆盖广泛的社区与学术医疗机构网络中汇集去标识化的癌症患者数据，用于科研与监管申报。2018年被罗氏以19亿美元收购，作为子公司运营。

sources.title: Roche completes $1.9B acquisition of Flatiron Health

companies.description_en: Developer of Galleri, a blood-based multi-cancer early detection (MCED) test that screens for more than 50 cancer types from a single draw. Spun out of Illumina and re-listed on Nasdaq in 2024; sold over 185,000 Galleri tests in 2025 for revenue of $147M, though the NHS-Galleri trial readout pressured the stock.
companies.description_zh: Galleri检测的开发商——一种基于血液的多癌种早筛（MCED）测试，单次采血即可筛查50余种癌症。从Illumina拆分并于2024年重新在纳斯达克上市；2025年Galleri销量超18.5万份、营收1.47亿美元，但NHS-Galleri临床试验结果曾令股价承压。

sources.title: GRAIL Q4 and full year 2025 financial results

companies.name_zh: Hims & Hers Health（数字健康平台）
companies.description_en: Leading direct-to-consumer telehealth platform offering subscription-based treatments across weight loss (GLP-1), hair loss, sexual health, dermatology, and mental health, serving millions of U.S. subscribers. Full-year 2025 revenue reached ~$2.35B, up 59% year-over-year, with net income of $128M.
companies.description_zh: 领先的面向消费者远程医疗平台，以订阅模式提供减重（GLP-1）、脱发、性健康、皮肤科及心理健康等治疗服务，服务美国数百万订阅用户。2025全年营收约23.5亿美元、同比增长59%，净利润1.28亿美元。

sources.title: Hims & Hers reports Q4 and full year 2025 results

companies.description_en: Elon Musk's flagship implantable brain-computer interface company developing the N1 'Link' coin-sized implant and R1 surgical robot to let patients control digital devices by thought, with multiple human implants underway. Raised $650M in a Series E (mid-2025) at a reported ~$9B valuation, ~$1.29B raised total.
companies.description_zh: Elon Musk旗下的旗舰植入式脑机接口公司，研发硬币大小的N1"Link"植入体与R1手术机器人，使患者能以思维控制数字设备，已完成多例人体植入。2025年中完成6.5亿美元E轮融资，估值约90亿美元，累计融资约12.9亿美元。

companies.description_en: Medtech company spun out of EPFL developing spinal cord stimulation therapies to restore movement and function after spinal cord injury. Its non-invasive ARC-EX system gained FDA de novo clearance (Dec 2024) and CE mark (2025); 2025 revenue grew to EUR5.4M, and it is pioneering BCI-paired stimulation for thought-driven movement.
companies.description_zh: 由洛桑联邦理工学院（EPFL）孵化的医疗科技公司，研发脊髓刺激疗法以恢复脊髓损伤患者的运动与功能。其非侵入式ARC-EX系统于2024年12月获FDA de novo分类许可、2025年获CE认证；2025年营收增至540万欧元，并率先探索与脑机接口联合的意念驱动运动技术。

sources.title: ONWARD Medical reports full year 2025 results
ONWARD Medical receives CE mark for ARC-EX

companies.description_en: Paradromics develops the Connexus Direct Data Interface, a high-channel-count implantable brain-computer interface aimed at restoring communication for people with severe paralysis and speech loss. Backed by Prime Movers Lab and others with over $100M raised, it received FDA Breakthrough Device designation and began first-in-human work in 2025.
companies.description_zh: Paradromics 研发 Connexus 直接数据接口——一种高通道数植入式脑机接口，旨在为重度瘫痪和失语患者恢复沟通能力。公司由 Prime Movers Lab 等投资方支持，累计融资超过 1 亿美元，获 FDA 突破性设备认定，并于 2025 年启动首例人体试验。

companies.description_en: Precision Neuroscience, co-founded by Neuralink co-founder Benjamin Rapoport, makes the Layer 7 Cortical Interface, a thin-film 1,024-microelectrode array that sits on the brain surface without penetrating tissue. In April 2025 it received FDA 510(k) clearance, a first for a next-generation high-resolution cortical array, at a valuation approaching $500M.
companies.description_zh: Precision Neuroscience 由 Neuralink 联合创始人 Benjamin Rapoport 共同创办，研发 Layer 7 皮层接口——一种贴附于大脑表面、不穿透组织的 1,024 微电极薄膜阵列。2025 年 4 月获 FDA 510(k) 许可，为新一代高分辨率皮层阵列首例，估值接近 5 亿美元。

sources.title: Precision Neuroscience Receives FDA Clearance - GlobeNewswire
Precision Neuroscience FDA clearance - MedTech Dive

companies.description_en: Ro (originally Roman) is a US direct-to-patient telehealth platform spanning men's health, weight loss (GLP-1), dermatology, hair loss, fertility and at-home diagnostics. It raised over $1B in total funding, reaching a $7B valuation in 2022, and is a leading authorized GLP-1 telehealth partner of Novo Nordisk.
companies.description_zh: Ro（原名 Roman）是美国一家面向患者的直接远程医疗平台，业务涵盖男性健康、减重（GLP-1）、皮肤科、脱发、生育及居家诊断。累计融资超过 10 亿美元，2022 年估值达 70 亿美元，是诺和诺德授权的主要 GLP-1 远程医疗合作方之一。

companies.description_en: Synchron developed the Stentrode, the world's first endovascular brain-computer interface, implanted via the blood vessels without open brain surgery to give paralyzed patients hands-free digital control. It was the first company to implant a BCI in US patients; a November 2025 $200M Series D led by Double Point Ventures (Bezos Expeditions, ARCH, Khosla, QIA) lifted total funding to ~$345M at a near-$1B valuation.
companies.description_zh: Synchron 研发了 Stentrode——全球首个血管内脑机接口，经血管植入、无需开颅手术，使瘫痪患者免手控制数字设备。该公司是首家在美国患者体内植入脑机接口的企业；2025 年 11 月由 Double Point Ventures 领投（贝索斯探险、ARCH、Khosla、卡塔尔主权基金）的 2 亿美元 D 轮使累计融资约 3.45 亿美元，估值接近 10 亿美元。

companies.description_en: Teladoc Health is the world's largest standalone virtual-care provider, offering telehealth visits, chronic-condition management (Livongo) and direct-to-consumer mental health via BetterHelp. It reported 2024 revenue of $2.57B but a $1B net loss driven by a BetterHelp goodwill impairment.
companies.description_zh: Teladoc Health 是全球最大的独立虚拟医疗服务商，提供远程问诊、慢病管理（Livongo）及面向消费者的心理健康服务 BetterHelp。2024 年营收 25.7 亿美元，但因 BetterHelp 商誉减值录得约 10 亿美元净亏损。

sources.title: Teladoc Health Full Year 2024 Results - IR
Teladoc reports $1B loss in 2024 - Fierce Healthcare

companies.description_en: Truveta is a health-system-founded company that aggregates de-identified electronic health record data from ~30 US health systems (over 120M patients) into an AI-ready research platform for life sciences and clinical research. A January 2025 $320M Series C from member systems plus Illumina and Regeneron made it a unicorn (>$1B valuation) and funds a large genome project.
companies.description_zh: Truveta 由美国约 30 家医疗系统共同发起，将其去标识化电子病历数据（覆盖超 1.2 亿患者）汇聚为面向生命科学和临床研究的 AI 就绪平台。2025 年 1 月由成员系统及 Illumina、Regeneron 参与的 3.2 亿美元 C 轮使其成为估值超 10 亿美元的独角兽，并资助大型基因组计划。

companies.description_en: Verily Life Sciences (formerly Google Life Sciences) is Alphabet's precision-health subsidiary, spun out of Google X, building data and AI platforms for research, clinical trials and chronic-disease management. It raised a $1B round led by Alphabet in 2022 and operates as a standalone Alphabet company.
companies.description_zh: Verily 生命科学（原名 Google 生命科学）是 Alphabet 旗下的精准健康子公司，由 Google X 分拆而来，构建用于研究、临床试验与慢病管理的数据与 AI 平台。2022 年完成由 Alphabet 领投的 10 亿美元融资，作为 Alphabet 旗下独立运营公司。

companies.description_en: AGC Biologics is the global biopharmaceutical CDMO arm of Japan's AGC Inc. (TSE:5201), formed in 2018 from CMC Biologics, AGC Bioscience and Biomeva. It provides development and manufacturing of protein biologics, plasmid DNA, cell and gene therapies and mRNA across sites in the US, Denmark, Germany, Italy and Japan, employing over 2,500 people.
companies.description_zh: AGC Biologics 是日本 AGC 株式会社（东证 5201）旗下的全球生物制药 CDMO，2018 年由 CMC Biologics、AGC Bioscience 与 Biomeva 整合而成。公司在美国、丹麦、德国、意大利和日本设有基地，提供蛋白质生物药、质粒 DNA、细胞与基因治疗及 mRNA 的开发与生产，员工逾 2,500 人。

sources.title: CMC Biologics Becomes AGC Biologics - Pharma's Almanac

companies.description_en: Baxter International is a global medical products company providing renal care (dialysis), IV solutions and infusion systems, hospital and surgical products, and clinical nutrition. It is one of the world's largest suppliers of infusion and acute-care hospital supplies.
companies.description_zh: 百特国际是一家全球医疗产品公司，提供肾科治疗（透析）、静脉输液与输注系统、医院与外科产品及临床营养，是全球最大的输液和急症医院耗材供应商之一。

companies.description_en: Boston Scientific is a leading global maker of minimally invasive medical devices spanning interventional cardiology, electrophysiology, structural heart, endoscopy, urology and neuromodulation. Its WATCHMAN LAA closure and FARAPULSE pulsed-field ablation systems are category leaders.
companies.description_zh: 波士顿科学是全球领先的微创医疗器械制造商，业务涵盖介入心脏病学、电生理、结构性心脏病、内窥镜、泌尿和神经调控；其 WATCHMAN 左心耳封堵器与 FARAPULSE 脉冲场消融系统为品类领导者。

companies.description_en: Coloplast is a Danish medtech company and the global leader in ostomy and continence care, also serving wound and skin care and interventional urology. Its intimate-healthcare products are sold in over 140 countries.
companies.description_zh: 康乐保是丹麦医疗科技公司，为造口护理与失禁护理领域的全球领导者，同时涉足伤口与皮肤护理及介入泌尿；其私密健康护理产品销往 140 多个国家。

companies.description_en: Dexcom pioneered real-time continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) and is a global leader in CGM systems (G7, Stelo) used by people with diabetes. It is one of the most prominent pure-play wearable metabolic-monitoring companies.
companies.description_zh: 德康医疗（Dexcom）开创了实时连续血糖监测（CGM）技术，是糖尿病患者所用 CGM 系统（G7、Stelo）的全球领导者，也是最知名的可穿戴代谢监测纯业务公司之一。

sources.title: Dexcom Reports Fourth Quarter and FY2024 Results

companies.description_en: Dräger (Drägerwerk AG & Co. KGaA) is a German medical and safety technology company producing anesthesia machines, ICU ventilators, patient monitoring, and gas-detection/safety equipment. It is a leading global supplier of acute-care and respiratory equipment.
companies.description_zh: 德尔格（Drägerwerk AG & Co. KGaA）是一家德国医疗与安全技术公司，生产麻醉机、ICU 呼吸机、患者监护及气体检测/安防设备，是全球领先的急救与呼吸设备供应商。

companies.description_en: Edwards Lifesciences is the global leader in heart valves and transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR), best known for its SAPIEN platform. It focuses exclusively on structural heart disease and critical-care monitoring.
companies.description_zh: 爱德华兹生命科学是心脏瓣膜和经导管主动脉瓣置换（TAVR）领域的全球领导者，以 SAPIEN 平台闻名，专注于结构性心脏病与重症监护监测。

companies.description_en: Fresenius Medical Care is the world's largest provider of dialysis products and services, operating a global network of dialysis clinics and manufacturing dialyzers, machines and related renal-care products. It serves millions of patients with chronic kidney failure.
companies.description_zh: 费森尤斯医疗是全球最大的透析产品与服务提供商，运营遍布全球的透析诊所网络，并生产透析器、透析机及相关肾科产品，为数百万慢性肾衰竭患者提供服务。

sources.title: Fresenius Medical Care delivers 18% earnings growth in 2024

companies.description_en: Getinge is a Swedish medtech company supplying surgical workflows, intensive-care equipment (ventilators, ECMO), cardiovascular devices, and sterilization/infection-control systems for hospitals and life-science facilities. It is a leading global provider of acute-care and sterile-reprocessing technology.
companies.description_zh: 洁定（Getinge）是一家瑞典医疗科技公司，为医院和生命科学机构提供手术流程、重症监护设备（呼吸机、ECMO）、心血管器械及灭菌/感染控制系统，是全球领先的急救与无菌再处理技术供应商。

companies.description_en: Hologic is a US medical-technology company and a global leader in women's health, best known for its 3D mammography (Genius) breast-imaging systems, Cytyc/ThinPrep cervical screening, and Aptima molecular diagnostic assays. It is one of the most influential players in early cancer detection and women's diagnostics worldwide.
companies.description_zh: 豪洛捷是美国医疗科技公司、全球女性健康领域龙头，以其 3D 乳腺 X 光（Genius）成像系统、ThinPrep 宫颈筛查与 Aptima 分子诊断试剂闻名，是全球癌症早筛与女性诊断领域最具影响力的企业之一。

companies.description_en: Insulet is a US medical-device maker known for the Omnipod, the leading tubeless, wearable insulin pump for diabetes management. Its Omnipod 5 automated insulin delivery system integrating continuous glucose monitoring has made it a global leader in insulin-delivery technology.
companies.description_zh: 英苏莱特是美国医疗器械公司，以糖尿病管理领域领先的无导管可穿戴胰岛素泵 Omnipod 闻名。其整合连续血糖监测的 Omnipod 5 自动胰岛素输注系统使其成为全球胰岛素输注技术的领导者。

companies.description_en: Intuitive Surgical is the dominant global maker of robotic-assisted surgery systems, with its da Vinci platform installed in more than 11,000 hospitals worldwide as of end-2025. It pioneered and commercialized minimally invasive robotic surgery and remains the clear market leader in the field.
companies.description_zh: 直觉外科是全球机器人辅助手术系统的领导者，截至 2025 年底其达芬奇（da Vinci）系统已在全球逾 11,000 家医院装机。公司开创并商业化了微创机器人手术，至今稳居该领域市场龙头。

sources.title: Intuitive Surgical Q4 and Full Year 2025 Results

companies.description_en: Masimo is a US medical-technology company best known for its SET and rainbow SET pulse oximetry and non-invasive patient-monitoring technologies, which are used in hospitals worldwide to measure blood oxygen and other physiological signals. It is a leader in signal-extraction oximetry and patient-monitoring innovation.
companies.description_zh: 迈心诺是美国医疗科技公司，以其 SET 与 rainbow SET 脉搏血氧及无创患者监测技术闻名，全球医院广泛用于血氧及其他生理信号测量。公司是信号提取式血氧监测与患者监护创新的领导者。

companies.description_en: Medtronic is the world's largest standalone medical-device company by revenue, with a legal/executive base in Ireland and operational headquarters in Minneapolis. Its portfolio spans cardiac rhythm devices, surgical and neuromodulation systems, diabetes technology, and minimally invasive therapies sold across more than 150 countries.
companies.description_zh: 美敦力是全球营收最大的独立医疗器械公司，法定及行政总部位于爱尔兰，运营总部设于明尼阿波利斯。其产品涵盖心律管理器械、外科与神经调控系统、糖尿病技术及微创治疗，销往全球 150 多个国家。

companies.description_en: Olympus is a Japanese medical-technology company and the world's dominant maker of gastrointestinal endoscopy systems, with over 60% of revenue from its Endoscopic Solutions business including the EVIS X1 platform. Founded in 1919 as a microscope and camera maker, it has refocused into a pure-play medical-devices company.
companies.description_zh: 奥林巴斯是日本医疗科技公司，全球消化道内窥镜系统的领导者，逾 60% 营收来自含 EVIS X1 平台的内窥镜解决方案业务。公司创立于 1919 年，原为显微镜与相机制造商，现已转型为专注医疗器械的企业。

companies.description_en: Penumbra is a US interventional medical-device company and a global leader in mechanical thrombectomy, with computer-assisted vacuum (CAVT) systems used to remove blood clots in stroke and peripheral/venous disease. In January 2026 Boston Scientific agreed to acquire Penumbra for about $14.5 billion, a deal pending at the time of this record.
companies.description_zh: 彭博是美国介入医疗器械公司，全球机械取栓领域的领导者，其计算机辅助真空抽吸（CAVT）系统用于清除卒中及外周/静脉疾病中的血栓。2026 年 1 月波士顿科学同意以约 145 亿美元收购彭博，本记录建立时交易尚待完成。

sources.title: Penumbra Q4 and Full Year 2025 Results
Boston Scientific to acquire Penumbra for $14.5B

companies.description_en: Royal Philips is a Dutch health-technology giant focused on diagnostic imaging (MRI, CT, ultrasound), image-guided therapy, patient monitoring and connected-care systems, plus personal-health products. Founded in 1891, it has transformed from a diversified electronics conglomerate into a pure-play health-technology company.
companies.description_zh: 皇家飞利浦是荷兰健康科技巨头，专注于诊断影像（MRI、CT、超声）、影像引导治疗、患者监护与互联医疗系统及个人健康产品。公司创立于 1891 年，已从多元化电子集团转型为专注健康科技的企业。

companies.description_en: ResMed is the global leader in CPAP machines, masks and connected devices for sleep apnea and respiratory care, with a cloud-based digital health platform managing over a billion nights of patient data.
companies.description_zh: 瑞思迈是睡眠呼吸暂停与呼吸照护领域的全球领导者，主营CPAP呼吸机、面罩及互联设备，并运营管理逾十亿夜患者数据的云端数字健康平台。

companies.description_en: Siemens Healthineers is the world's largest medical imaging and in-vitro diagnostics company, spanning CT/MRI/ultrasound systems, laboratory diagnostics and the Varian radiation-oncology business; it was carved out of Siemens AG and listed in 2018.
companies.description_zh: 西门子医疗是全球最大的医学影像与体外诊断公司，业务涵盖CT/MRI/超声系统、实验室诊断及瓦里安放疗业务；2018年从西门子集团分拆上市。

companies.description_en: Smith+Nephew is a UK-based portfolio medical-technology company focused on tissue repair and replacement across three units: Orthopaedics (joint reconstruction), Sports Medicine & ENT, and Advanced Wound Management; it reports in US dollars and dual-lists in London and New York.
companies.description_zh: 施乐辉是总部位于英国的医疗科技组合型公司，专注于组织修复与置换，旗下设骨科（关节重建）、运动医学与耳鼻喉、先进伤口管理三大业务，以美元报告并在伦敦及纽约双重上市。

companies.description_en: Sonova is the world's largest hearing-care company, a vertically integrated group spanning the Phonak, Unitron, AudioNova and Advanced Bionics brands across hearing aids, retail audiology and cochlear implants; its fiscal year ends 31 March.
companies.description_zh: 索诺瓦是全球最大的听力照护公司，为垂直整合集团，旗下Phonak、Unitron、AudioNova和Advanced Bionics品牌覆盖助听器、零售听力服务及人工耳蜗；财年截至3月31日。

companies.description_en: Straumann Group is the global leader in dental implants and tooth-replacement and orthodontic solutions, spanning implantology, clear aligners and digital dentistry across more than 100 countries.
companies.description_zh: 士卓曼集团是种植牙、牙齿修复及正畸解决方案的全球领导者，业务涵盖种植学、隐形矫治及数字化牙科，覆盖逾100个国家。

companies.description_en: Stryker is one of the world's largest medical-technology companies, a leader in orthopedic implants, surgical equipment, the Mako robotic-arm surgical system, and neurovascular and neurotech products; FY2025 revenue reached $25.1B.
companies.description_zh: 史赛克是全球最大的医疗科技公司之一，在骨科植入物、外科设备、Mako机器人手术系统以及神经血管和神经科技产品领域处于领先地位；2025财年营收达251亿美元。

companies.description_en: Terumo is Japan's largest medical-device maker, a global leader in blood and cell technologies, cardiac and vascular interventional devices, catheters and general hospital products; in FY2024 (ended March 2025) it surpassed ¥1 trillion in revenue for the first time.
companies.description_zh: 泰尔茂是日本最大的医疗器械制造商，在血液与细胞技术、心血管介入器械、导管及通用医院产品领域处于全球领先地位；2024财年（截至2025年3月）营收首次突破1万亿日元。

companies.description_en: Zimmer Biomet is a leading global musculoskeletal-healthcare company specializing in knee and hip joint reconstruction, sports medicine, trauma and surgical-robotics products; it was formed by the 2015 merger of Zimmer Holdings and Biomet, with roots dating to 1927.
companies.description_zh: 捷迈邦美是全球领先的肌肉骨骼医疗保健公司，专注于膝、髋关节重建、运动医学、创伤及外科机器人产品；由2015年捷迈控股与邦美合并而成，渊源可追溯至1927年。

companies.description_en: Clinical-stage respiratory biotech founded in 2023, backed by Atlas Venture, Bain Capital Life Sciences and Sofinnova; its lead asset AIO-001, a long-acting anti-TSLP antibody in-licensed from China's Jiangsu Hengrui, drove a ~$1B upfront ($1.4B total) acquisition by GSK within roughly five months of launch.
companies.description_zh: 成立于2023年的临床阶段呼吸系统生物技术公司，由Atlas Venture、贝恩资本生命科学等支持；其核心资产AIO-001（一款从中国江苏恒瑞引进的长效抗TSLP抗体）促成GSK在其成立约五个月内以约10亿美元首付款（总额14亿美元）将其收购。

sources.title: GSK enters agreement to acquire Aiolos Bio
GSK to buy asthma drug startup Aiolos for $1B (BioPharma Dive)

companies.description_en: Cambridge, MA neuroscience biotech spun out of Pfizer's discontinued CNS programs in 2018 (backed by Bain Capital), built around clinical candidates for schizophrenia, Parkinson's and epilepsy; AbbVie acquired it for ~$8.7B in 2023, though lead asset emraclidine later failed Phase 2 schizophrenia trials.
companies.description_zh: 总部位于马萨诸塞州剑桥的神经科学生物技术公司，2018年由辉瑞停止开发的中枢神经项目分拆而来（贝恩资本支持），聚焦精神分裂症、帕金森和癫痫的临床候选药物；艾伯维于2023年以约87亿美元将其收购，但核心资产emraclidine后在精神分裂症二期试验中失败。

sources.title: AbbVie to buy Cerevel in $8.7B bet (BioPharma Dive)

companies.description_en: Value-based care provider spun out of Alphabet's Sidewalk Labs in 2017, delivering integrated primary, behavioral and social care to Medicaid and dual-eligible members; backed by General Catalyst, SoftBank and Tiger Global, it reached a ~$5.7B valuation in 2021, making it one of the largest digital-health unicorns.
companies.description_zh: 2017年从Alphabet旗下Sidewalk Labs分拆出来的价值导向医疗服务商，为医疗补助和双重资格人群提供整合的初级、行为及社会照护；由General Catalyst、软银和老虎环球支持，2021年估值达约57亿美元，是规模最大的数字健康独角兽之一。

sources.title: Cityblock Health raises megaround, $5.7B valuation (Fierce Healthcare)

companies.description_en: Founded in 2015 (as Color Genomics) by Othman Laraki and Elad Gil, Color pivoted from population-scale genetic testing and COVID-19 programs to a vertically integrated Virtual Cancer Clinic offering employer-sponsored cancer prevention, screening and care; backed by General Catalyst, T. Rowe Price and Khosla Ventures at a ~$4.6B valuation.
companies.description_zh: 由Othman Laraki和Elad Gil于2015年创立（原名Color Genomics），从人群规模基因检测和新冠项目转向垂直整合的虚拟癌症诊所，提供雇主赞助的癌症预防、筛查与照护；由General Catalyst、普信和Khosla Ventures支持，估值约46亿美元。

companies.description_en: Next-generation Medicare Advantage insurer and integrated care provider founded in 2017 by athenahealth veterans Todd and Ed Park; having raised over $2.6B from investors including a16z and SoftBank, it reached a ~$12.6B valuation in 2021 and operates plans across multiple US states.
companies.description_zh: 由athenahealth资深高管Todd和Ed Park兄弟于2017年创立的新一代Medicare Advantage保险及整合医疗服务商；累计融资超26亿美元（投资方包括a16z和软银），2021年估值约126亿美元，在美国多个州运营保险计划。

companies.description_en: Santa Monica-based digital health company founded in 2011, operating the leading US prescription-price comparison and discount marketplace; in 2024 nearly 30 million consumers used the platform saving an estimated $17B on medications, on full-year revenue of $792M.
companies.description_zh: 总部位于圣莫尼卡的数字健康公司，成立于2011年，运营美国领先的处方药价格比较与折扣平台；2024年近3000万消费者使用其平台，节省约170亿美元药费，全年营收7.92亿美元。

companies.description_en: San Francisco genetic-testing company founded in 2010 that scaled to one of the largest clinical genetics labs in the US (hereditary cancer, rare disease, reproductive testing); after rapid debt-fueled expansion it filed Chapter 11 in February 2024, and Labcorp acquired most of its assets for $239M in August 2024.
companies.description_zh: 总部位于旧金山的基因检测公司，成立于2010年，发展为美国最大的临床遗传学实验室之一（遗传性癌症、罕见病、生殖检测）；在债务驱动的快速扩张后，于2024年2月申请破产保护，Labcorp于2024年8月以2.39亿美元收购其大部分资产。

sources.title: Labcorp to acquire Invitae's assets for $239M (MedTech Dive)
Invitae Receives Court Approval for Sale to Labcorp

companies.description_en: Boston neuroscience biotech founded by PureTech Health in 2009, developer of KarXT, the first antipsychotic targeting cholinergic (muscarinic) rather than dopamine receptors; Bristol Myers Squibb acquired Karuna for ~$14B ($330/share) in 2023, and the drug won FDA approval as Cobenfy for schizophrenia in 2024.
companies.description_zh: 由PureTech Health于2009年创立的波士顿神经科学生物技术公司，开发KarXT——首个靶向胆碱能（毒蕈碱）受体而非多巴胺受体的抗精神病药；百时美施贵宝于2023年以约140亿美元（每股330美元）收购Karuna，该药于2024年以Cobenfy之名获FDA批准用于精神分裂症。

sources.title: BMS Strengthens Neuroscience Portfolio with Karuna (BMS)
Bristol Myers to acquire Karuna for $14B (BioPharma Dive)

companies.description_en: Komodo Health operates a 'Healthcare Map' AI platform that links de-identified data on 325M+ patients from hundreds of sources for life-sciences, payer and provider analytics. A US healthcare-data unicorn, it raised a $220M Series E (2021) at a $3.3B valuation led by Tiger Global and Casdin.
companies.description_zh: Komodo Health 运营基于 AI 的“医疗地图”平台，整合超过 3.25 亿名患者的去标识化数据，服务药企、支付方与医疗机构的分析需求。作为美国医疗数据独角兽，其 2021 年 2.2 亿美元 E 轮融资估值达 33 亿美元，由 Tiger Global 与 Casdin 领投。

companies.description_en: Oscar Health is a US technology-driven health insurer co-founded by Joshua Kushner, building a vertically integrated, member-engagement platform centered on the ACA individual market. It serves roughly 3.4M members and reported ~$11B in 2025 revenue.
companies.description_zh: Oscar Health 是由 Joshua Kushner 联合创立的美国科技驱动型健康保险公司，以会员互动平台为核心、聚焦 ACA 个险市场，构建垂直整合模式。公司服务约 340 万会员，2025 年营收约 110 亿美元。

companies.description_en: Sword Health is a virtual musculoskeletal-care company (founded in Portugal, now HQ'd in New York) pairing AI clinicians like its 'Phoenix' specialist with human physical therapists. Its June 2025 round lifted its valuation to about $4B.
companies.description_zh: Sword Health 是一家虚拟肌肉骨骼护理公司（创立于葡萄牙，现总部位于纽约），将“Phoenix”等 AI 临床助手与人类理疗师结合。其 2025 年 6 月融资使估值升至约 40 亿美元。

sources.title: Sword Health $3B valuation, Phoenix AI (Fierce Healthcare)

companies.description_en: Telavant Holdings was a Roivant/Pfizer 'NewCo' (Roivant 75%, Pfizer 25%) formed in 2022 to develop the TL1A antibody RVT-3101 for inflammatory bowel disease in the US and Japan. Roche acquired Telavant for $7.1B upfront in December 2023, one of the year's largest single-asset biopharma deals.
companies.description_zh: Telavant Holdings 是 Roivant 与 Pfizer 于 2022 年共同组建的“NewCo”（Roivant 持股 75%、Pfizer 持股 25%），开发用于炎症性肠病的 TL1A 抗体 RVT-3101（美、日权益）。罗氏于 2023 年 12 月以 71 亿美元预付款收购 Telavant，为当年最大单资产生物医药交易之一。

companies.description_en: AgeX Therapeutics was a Michael West-founded longevity biotech advancing 'induced Tissue Regeneration' (iTR) and PureStem/UniverCyte stem-cell platforms. In March 2024 it completed a reverse merger with Serina Therapeutics; the combined company trades on NYSE American as SER, developing the POZ-drug-conjugate SER-252 for advanced Parkinson's disease.
companies.description_zh: AgeX Therapeutics 是 Michael West 创立的长寿生物技术公司，推进“诱导组织再生”（iTR）及 PureStem/UniverCyte 干细胞平台。2024 年 3 月与 Serina Therapeutics 完成反向并购，合并后公司以 SER 于 NYSE American 交易，开发用于晚期帕金森病的 POZ 药物偶联物 SER-252。

companies.description_en: Altos Labs is a longevity moonshot that launched publicly in January 2022 with $3B in initial financing — the largest-ever biotech launch — backed by Jeff Bezos and Yuri Milner. It pursues 'cellular rejuvenation programming' (partial reprogramming) to restore cell health and reverse disease, recruiting Nobel laureates and a star C-suite led by CEO Hal Barron.
companies.description_zh: Altos Labs 是长寿领域的登月项目，2022 年 1 月以 30 亿美元初始资金公开亮相——史上最大规模生物技术启动——背后有 Jeff Bezos 与 Yuri Milner 支持。公司研究“细胞回春编程”（部分重编程）以恢复细胞健康、逆转疾病，招募多位诺奖得主，并由 CEO Hal Barron 领衔豪华高管团队。

companies.description_en: BioAge Labs is a clinical-stage biopharma that uses a human-aging discovery platform to develop therapies for metabolic disease, notably obesity. It IPO'd on Nasdaq in September 2024, raising roughly $198M (about $238M with the concurrent private placement).
companies.description_zh: BioAge Labs 是一家临床阶段生物制药公司，利用人类衰老发现平台开发代谢疾病（尤其是肥胖）疗法。公司于 2024 年 9 月在纳斯达克上市，募资约 1.98 亿美元（含同步定向增发约 2.38 亿美元）。

companies.description_en: Calico Life Sciences is an Alphabet-founded, secretive R&D company led by former Genentech chief Arthur Levinson, devoted to the biology of aging and age-related disease. Its multi-billion-dollar AbbVie partnership (renewed with an extra $1B in 2021) has produced 20+ early-stage programs spanning immuno-oncology and neurodegeneration.
companies.description_zh: Calico Life Sciences 是由 Alphabet 创立、行事低调的研发公司，由前基因泰克掌门人 Arthur Levinson 领导，专注衰老生物学及与年龄相关的疾病。其与艾伯维的数十亿美元合作（2021 年追加 10 亿美元续约）已产出 20 多个早期项目，覆盖免疫肿瘤与神经退行性疾病。

companies.description_en: Cambrian Biopharma is a New York-based clinical-stage 'distributed company' (DisCo) that incubates and finances a pipeline of subsidiary biotechs targeting the hallmarks of aging to extend human healthspan. It has raised roughly $200M (including a $100M Series C co-led by Anthos Capital and SALT Fund) at an approximately $1.8B valuation.
companies.description_zh: Cambrian Biopharma 是总部位于纽约的临床阶段'分布式公司'（DisCo），孵化并资助一系列针对衰老标志的子公司生物技术企业，以延长人类健康寿命。公司累计融资约2亿美元（含由 Anthos Capital 与 SALT Fund 联合领投的1亿美元 C 轮），估值约18亿美元。

sources.title: Cambrian Biopharma Closes $100 Million Series C

companies.description_en: Gero is a Singapore-headquartered (with San Francisco operations) techbio applying physics-informed AI and large-scale human health data to discover drugs against aging and age-related disease. It has raised about $34M in equity, ran a fibrosis target-discovery collaboration with Pfizer, struck a deal worth up to $250M with Roche's Chugai, and was named a 2026 WEF Technology Pioneer.
companies.description_zh: Gero 总部位于新加坡（并在旧金山设有运营），是一家利用物理学驱动的 AI 与大规模人类健康数据来发现抗衰老及年龄相关疾病药物的科技生物公司。公司累计股权融资约3400万美元，曾与辉瑞开展纤维化靶点发现合作，与罗氏旗下中外制药达成最高2.5亿美元的合作，并入选2026年世界经济论坛技术先锋。

companies.description_en: Juvenescence is an Isle of Man-headquartered longevity drug-development holding company co-founded by billionaire investor Jim Mellon, combining an internal 'core medicines' pipeline with equity stakes in adjacent aging-focused therapeutics and platform companies. It has raised well over $200M across rounds (including a $100M raise in 2019).
companies.description_zh: Juvenescence 是总部位于马恩岛的长寿药物开发控股公司，由亿万富翁投资人 Jim Mellon 联合创立，结合内部'核心药物'管线与对一系列抗衰老治疗及平台公司的股权投资。公司累计融资超过2亿美元（含2019年的1亿美元融资）。

companies.description_en: Loyal (Cellular Longevity, Inc.) is a San Francisco clinical-stage animal-health company developing the first drugs to extend healthy lifespan in dogs, with lead program LOY-002 targeting metabolic drivers of canine aging. Founded by Celine Halioua in late 2019, it has raised over $250M, including a $100M Series C led by age1 with participation from Baillie Gifford.
companies.description_zh: Loyal（Cellular Longevity, Inc.）是一家位于旧金山的临床阶段动物健康公司，致力于开发首个延长犬类健康寿命的药物，主打项目 LOY-002 针对犬类衰老的代谢驱动因素。公司由 Celine Halioua 于2019年底创立，累计融资超过2.5亿美元，含由 age1 领投、Baillie Gifford 参投的1亿美元 C 轮。

sources.title: Loyal Raises $100M Series C, Led by age1 (BusinessWire)
Loyal's Series C: $100M to advance the first longevity drug

companies.description_en: NewLimit is a San Francisco longevity biotech co-founded in 2021 by Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong, Blake Byers and Jacob Kimmel, developing epigenetic-reprogramming medicines that restore youthful function to aged cells using its 'Ambrosia' AI model and single-cell profiling.
