After demonstrating age reversal in human liver cells, it raised a $130M Series B, bringing total funding to roughly $300M+.
companies.description_zh: NewLimit 是一家旧金山长寿生物技术公司，于2021年由 Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong、Blake Byers 及 Jacob Kimmel 联合创立，利用其'Ambrosia' AI 模型与单细胞分析开发表观遗传重编程药物，以恢复衰老细胞的年轻功能。在人类肝细胞中展示年龄逆转后，公司完成1.3亿美元 B 轮，累计融资约3亿美元以上。

sources.title: NewLimit snags $435M after age reversal in human liver cells (BioSpace)
Billionaire Launches Startup to Reprogram Gene Expression (Futurism)

companies.description_en: Rejuvenate Bio is a San Diego gene-therapy company spun out of George Church's Harvard/Wyss lab in 2018, developing one-shot gene therapies that target the root causes of aging and chronic disease in humans and dogs. It has raised about $14.6M in equity plus over $13M in non-dilutive SBIR/STTR funding, with its dog cardiac-disease gene therapy extending lifespan by over two years in animal studies.
companies.description_zh: Rejuvenate Bio 是一家位于圣地亚哥的基因治疗公司，2018年从乔治·丘奇（George Church）的哈佛/Wyss 实验室分拆而来，开发针对人类与犬类衰老及慢性病根源的单次注射基因疗法。公司累计股权融资约1460万美元，另获超过1300万美元的非稀释性 SBIR/STTR 资助，其犬类心脏病基因疗法在动物研究中延长寿命超两年。

sources.title: Rejuvenate Bio banks $10M for gene therapy for aging (Fierce Biotech)
Rejuvenate Bio Raises Over $10M Series A (company)

companies.description_en: Rejuveron Life Sciences is a Zurich-based integrated healthy-aging biotech that builds a portfolio of subsidiary companies targeting the hallmarks of aging such as stem-cell exhaustion, telomere shortening and cellular senescence. It raised a $75M dual-tranche Series B and convertible financing co-led by Catalio Capital and Apeiron Investment Group, funding portfolio companies through clinical proof-of-concept.
companies.description_zh: Rejuveron Life Sciences 是一家总部位于苏黎世的整合型健康衰老生物技术公司，构建针对干细胞耗竭、端粒缩短、细胞衰老等衰老标志的子公司组合。公司完成由 Catalio Capital 与 Apeiron Investment Group 联合领投的7500万美元双轨 B 轮及可转债融资，为旗下组合公司提供资金直至临床概念验证。

sources.title: Rejuveron lands $75m to advance healthy aging portfolio (Longevity.Technology)
Creating therapies for improved aging and longer lives (Nature)
Rejuveron Life Sciences AG — Swiss Biotech

companies.description_en: Repair Biotechnologies is a Syracuse, New York longevity biotech founded in 2018 by Reason and Bill Cherman, developing a Cholesterol Degrading Platform (CDP) to treat atherosclerosis plus a thymus-regeneration program via FOXN1 upregulation to restore aged immune function. Its seed funding was led by billionaire investor Jim Mellon (chairman of Juvenescence).
companies.description_zh: Repair Biotechnologies 是一家位于纽约州锡拉丘兹的长寿生物技术公司，2018年由 Reason 与 Bill Cherman 创立，开发用于治疗动脉粥样硬化的'胆固醇降解平台'（CDP），以及通过上调 FOXN1 实现胸腺再生、恢复衰老免疫功能的项目。其种子轮融资由亿万富翁投资人、Juvenescence 主席 Jim Mellon 领投。

sources.title: A Profile of Repair Biotechnologies (Fight Aging!)

companies.description_en: Sam Altman-backed longevity biotech aiming to add 10 healthy years to human lifespan via partial cellular reprogramming, autophagy enhancement and plasma-inspired therapeutics; raised a $1B round in 2025 (Altman personally committed ~$180M early) and works with OpenAI on AI-designed proteins, with lead autophagy candidate RTR242 in a first-in-human Alzheimer's trial.
companies.description_zh: 由 Sam Altman 资助的长寿生物技术公司，目标是通过部分细胞重编程、自噬增强和血浆启发疗法为人类健康寿命增加 10 年；2025 年完成 10 亿美元融资（Altman 早期个人投入约 1.8 亿美元），并与 OpenAI 合作进行 AI 蛋白质设计，主打自噬候选药物 RTR242 已进入首个阿尔茨海默病人体试验。

sources.title: Retro Biosciences raises $1B for healthspan extension

companies.description_en: Cambridge (UK) longevity biotech building single-cell AI aging clocks and a virtual-cell platform to discover gene factors for safe cellular rejuvenation without pluripotency-inducing reprogramming; raised ~$16M seed (led by BGF, with F-Prime, Kindred and Jonathan Milner) and operates out of the Gurdon Institute.
companies.description_zh: 位于英国剑桥的长寿生物技术公司，构建单细胞 AI 衰老时钟和虚拟细胞平台，以发现无需诱导多能性即可实现安全细胞返老还童的基因因子；获约 1600 万美元种子轮（BGF 领投，F-Prime、Kindred 及 Jonathan Milner 参与），实验室设于剑桥 Gurdon 研究所。

sources.title: Shift Bioscience raises $16M for AI virtual cell platform
Shift Bioscience lands $16m to identify safe rejuvenation genes

companies.description_en: Consumer longevity company co-founded by aging scientist Dr. David Sinclair and entrepreneur Whitney Casey, offering the at-home epigenetic TallyAge cheek-swab biological-age test plus longevity supplements; raised a $10M seed led by Forerunner Ventures and was acquired by Infinite Epigenetics in April 2026.
companies.description_zh: 由衰老科学家 David Sinclair 博士与企业家 Whitney Casey 共同创立的消费级长寿公司，提供居家表观遗传 TallyAge 颊拭子生物学年龄检测及长寿补充剂；获 Forerunner Ventures 领投的 1000 万美元种子轮，并于 2026 年 4 月被 Infinite Epigenetics 收购。

sources.title: Tally Health $10M seed round led by Forerunner Ventures

companies.description_en: Stanford-spinout longevity biotech developing mRNA-based Epigenetic Reprogramming of Aging (ERA) therapies with lipid-nanoparticle delivery to restore youthful cell function while preserving cell identity, targeting dermatologic, osteoarthritic, ophthalmic and muscular conditions; founded by Marco Quarta and backed by Khosla Ventures, Astellas Venture Management and Daewoong, having raised ~$30M.
companies.description_zh: 斯坦福衍生的长寿生物技术公司，开发基于 mRNA 的衰老表观遗传重编程（ERA）疗法，采用脂质纳米颗粒递送，在保留细胞身份的同时恢复细胞年轻功能，靶向皮肤、骨关节、眼科及肌肉疾病；由 Marco Quarta 创立，获 Khosla Ventures、安斯泰来风投及大熊制药支持，累计融资约 3000 万美元。

sources.title: Turn Biotechnologies completes latest round of funding

companies.description_en: Pioneering senolytics company that aimed to slow age-related disease by clearing senescent cells; its lead ophthalmology asset UBX1325 (foselutoclax) for diabetic macular edema showed mixed Phase 2b ASPIRE results in 2025, after which Unity laid off its entire workforce and filed a certificate of dissolution effective September 2025, winding the company down.
companies.description_zh: 开创性的衰老细胞清除（senolytics）公司，旨在通过清除衰老细胞延缓年龄相关疾病；其主打眼科资产 UBX1325（foselutoclax）治疗糖尿病性黄斑水肿的 2b 期 ASPIRE 试验 2025 年结果好坏参半，随后 Unity 裁撤全部员工并于 2025 年 9 月提交解散证书，公司清算关闭。

sources.title: Unity Biotechnology ASPIRE Phase 2b UBX1325 results

companies.description_en: Canada's largest drug manufacturer, producing more than 300 generic and specialty products sold in over 115 countries; founded by Barry Sherman in 1974 and acquired by US private-equity firm SK Capital Partners in 2022, with ~CA$3.9B revenue and ~8,000 employees, it has filed for a TSX IPO (reportedly seeking a ~$10B valuation) but is not yet listed.
companies.description_zh: 加拿大最大的药品制造商，生产 300 多种仿制药和特种药品，销往 115 个以上国家；由 Barry Sherman 于 1974 年创立，2022 年被美国私募股权公司 SK Capital Partners 收购，营收约 39 亿加元、员工约 8000 人，已申请多伦多证交所 IPO（据报估值约 100 亿美元）但尚未上市。

sources.title: Apotex files to go public on TSX at ~$10B valuation

companies.description_en: Fast-growing, owner-managed German generics and branded-medicines group headquartered in Berlin, producing and distributing active-ingredient generics under its own brands; operates a headquarters, five production sites, a logistics center and thirteen European sales locations with more than 1,700 employees.
companies.description_zh: 总部位于柏林、快速成长的德国家族式仿制药与品牌药集团，以自有品牌生产并分销活性成分仿制药；拥有总部、五个生产基地、一个物流中心和遍布欧洲的十三个销售网点，员工超过 1700 人。

companies.description_en: Family-controlled Italian biopharmaceutical group based in Parma, a global leader in respiratory health (asthma/COPD), rare diseases and specialty care; founded 1935, B-Corp certified since 2019, it posted FY2024 revenue of €3.4B with a record €829M (24% of sales) in R&D and ~7,700 employees, ranking among Europe's top pharma R&D investors.
companies.description_zh: 总部位于帕尔马的意大利家族控股生物制药集团，在呼吸系统（哮喘/慢阻肺）、罕见病和特种药领域处于全球领先地位；成立于 1935 年，自 2019 年起获 B-Corp 认证，2024 财年营收 34 亿欧元，研发投入创纪录达 8.29 亿欧元（占销售额 24%），员工约 7700 人，跻身欧洲制药研发投入前列。

sources.title: Chiesi Group delivers FY2024 double-digit growth

companies.description_en: Desitin Arzneimittel is an independent, family-owned German specialty pharmaceutical company focused on epilepsy and other neurological/psychiatric disorders, including Parkinson's disease and rare conditions such as cystinuria and Wilson's disease. Founded in 1919, it is a fully integrated developer-marketer with its own sales presence across Europe.
companies.description_zh: 德世汀制药是一家独立的德国家族制药企业，专注于癫痫及其他神经精神疾病，包括帕金森病以及胱氨酸尿症、威尔逊病等罕见病。创立于1919年，是一家在欧洲拥有自有销售网络的全流程一体化药企。

companies.description_en: Dr. Falk Pharma is a family-owned German specialty pharmaceutical company headquartered in Freiburg, focused on developing and marketing medicines for gastroenterology and hepatology, including inflammatory bowel disease and liver disorders. Founded in 1960, it is a globally recognized leader in GI/liver specialty therapeutics.
companies.description_zh: 福克药业是一家总部位于弗赖堡的德国家族制药企业，专注于胃肠病学与肝病学领域药物的研发与销售，涵盖炎症性肠病及肝脏疾病。创立于1960年，是全球公认的消化／肝病专科治疗领域领导者。

sources.title: Dr. Falk Pharma – Why we are

companies.description_en: Engelhard Arzneimittel is a family-owned German consumer-health company best known for Prospan, a herbal ivy-leaf cough remedy sold in over 100 countries. With roots dating to 1826 in Frankfurt, it is a globally distributed leader in herbal respiratory OTC products.
companies.description_zh: 恩格哈德制药是一家德国家族健康消费品企业，以常春藤叶止咳药Prospan（易坦静）闻名，该产品销往逾100个国家。其历史可追溯至1826年的法兰克福，是全球草本呼吸道非处方产品的领导者。

companies.description_en: Esteve is a family-owned Spanish pharmaceutical group based in Barcelona, combining a specialty drug business (CNS, pain) with an API/CDMO arm (Esteve Química) and production centers in Mexico and China. Founded in 1929, it reported net revenue of €744 million in 2024.
companies.description_zh: 埃斯特维是一家总部位于巴塞罗那的西班牙家族制药集团，业务涵盖专科药（中枢神经、疼痛）及原料药／CDMO板块（Esteve Química），并在墨西哥和中国设有生产基地。创立于1929年，2024年净收入达7.44亿欧元。

companies.description_en: Ferrer is a family-owned Spanish pharmaceutical company headquartered in Barcelona, increasingly focused on pulmonary vascular and interstitial lung diseases and neurological disorders. Founded in 1959, it is a certified B Corp and the highest-rated pharmaceutical B Corp in the world for social and environmental impact.
companies.description_zh: 费雷尔是一家总部位于巴塞罗那的西班牙家族制药企业，日益聚焦肺血管及间质性肺病和神经系统疾病。创立于1959年，是认证B型企业，并在社会与环境影响方面被评为全球评分最高的制药类B Corp。

companies.description_en: Ferring Pharmaceuticals is a privately owned Swiss biopharmaceutical company (controlled by Frederik Paulsen) headquartered in Saint-Prex, specializing in reproductive medicine, fertility, gastroenterology and urology, including the bladder-cancer gene therapy Adstiladrin. Founded in 1950, it surpassed €2.5 billion in revenue for the first time in 2025.
companies.description_zh: 辉凌制药是一家由Frederik Paulsen控股的瑞士私营生物制药公司，总部位于圣普雷，专注于生殖医学、生育、胃肠病学与泌尿学，包括膀胱癌基因疗法Adstiladrin。创立于1950年，2025年收入首次突破25亿欧元。

sources.title: Ferring reports revenue of over €2.5 billion in 2025

companies.description_en: Galderma is the world's pure-play dermatology category leader, spanning Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology across ~90 countries. Founded in 1981, it was private under EQT/ADIA ownership until its March 2024 IPO on the SIX Swiss Exchange, and delivered record 2025 net sales of USD 5.207 billion.
companies.description_zh: 高德美是全球纯皮肤科领域的领导者，业务覆盖注射美容、皮肤护理及治疗性皮肤科，遍及约90个国家。创立于1981年，在2024年3月于瑞士证券交易所上市前由EQT/ADIA私有持有，2025年净销售额创纪录达52.07亿美元。

sources.title: Galderma prices IPO at CHF 53 per share

companies.description_en: Grünenthal is a privately owned, Wirtz-family-controlled German pharmaceutical company headquartered in Aachen, specializing in pain therapy with brands such as Palexia, Qutenza and Versatis. Founded in 1946 (and historically the originator of thalidomide), it reported revenue of €1.8 billion in 2024 across more than 100 countries.
companies.description_zh: 格兰泰是一家由维尔茨家族控股的德国私营制药企业，总部位于亚琛，专注于疼痛治疗，旗下品牌包括Palexia、Qutenza和Versatis。创立于1946年（历史上为沙利度胺的原研者），2024年在逾100个国家实现18亿欧元收入。

companies.description_en: Helsinn is a privately held, family-owned Swiss pharmaceutical group focused on cancer supportive care and oncology, best known as the originator of the anti-emetic palonosetron (Aloxi). It builds, manufactures and licenses products to partners with a commercial presence in roughly 90 countries.
companies.description_zh: 赫尔森是一家瑞士家族私有制药集团，专注于肿瘤支持治疗与肿瘤学，以止吐药帕洛诺司琼（Aloxi）的原研者身份著称，产品通过合作伙伴覆盖约90个国家。

companies.description_en: Hexal is a major German generics brand founded in 1986 by the Strüngmann brothers, who sold it to Novartis for about €5.65 billion in 2005. It is now a brand and subsidiary of Sandoz (spun off from Novartis in 2023) and is not independently listed.
companies.description_zh: 赫素是德国主要仿制药品牌，1986年由施特林曼兄弟创立，2005年以约56.5亿欧元出售给诺华。现为山德士（2023年从诺华分拆上市）旗下品牌及子公司，不再独立上市。

sources.title: Sandoz Picks Hexal's Hometown For Generics HQ — Citeline

companies.description_en: LEO Pharma is a Danish, foundation-owned (LEO Foundation) global leader in medical dermatology, treating chronic skin conditions such as psoriasis, atopic dermatitis and actinic keratosis. It posted DKK 12.45 billion in 2024 revenue with double-digit growth driven by its dermatology portfolio.
companies.description_zh: 利奥制药是丹麦由利奥基金会控股的全球医学皮肤病学领导者，治疗银屑病、特应性皮炎及光化性角化病等慢性皮肤病，2024年营收124.53亿丹麦克朗，皮肤病业务推动两位数增长。

companies.description_en: Laboratoires Théa is the largest independent European pharmaceutical group dedicated solely to ophthalmology, family-owned and run by the Chibret family and founded by Henri Chibret in 1994. It expanded into the US with the 2022 acquisition of Akorn's branded ophthalmic products.
companies.description_zh: 泰乐康制药是欧洲最大的专注眼科的独立制药集团，由希布雷家族所有并经营，1994年由亨利·希布雷创立，2022年通过收购Akorn眼科品牌产品进入美国市场。

companies.description_en: H. Lundbeck is a Danish pharmaceutical company specializing exclusively in brain diseases (CNS), including depression, schizophrenia, Alzheimer's and migraine. Though publicly listed in Copenhagen, it is controlled by the Lundbeck Foundation, which owns roughly 69% of shares; revenue reached a record DKK 22 billion in 2024.
companies.description_zh: 灵北是专注于脑部疾病（中枢神经系统）的丹麦制药公司，涵盖抑郁症、精神分裂症、阿尔茨海默病及偏头痛。尽管在哥本哈根上市，但由持股约69%的灵北基金会控股，2024年营收创纪录达220亿丹麦克朗。

sources.title: Lundbeck — Record revenue DKK 22 billion in 2024

companies.description_en: Menarini is the largest privately held Italian pharmaceutical and diagnostics company, controlled by the Aleotti family and founded in 1886. With around 17,800 employees and presence in 140 countries, it is strong in cardiology and has expanded into oncology via Stemline Therapeutics; 2024 turnover was about €4.9 billion.
companies.description_zh: 美纳里尼是意大利最大的私有制药与诊断公司，由阿莱奥蒂家族控股，创立于1886年。拥有约17,800名员工，业务遍及140个国家，在心血管领域实力雄厚，并通过Stemline Therapeutics拓展肿瘤业务，2024年营收约49亿欧元。

sources.title: Menarini turnover soars to 4.88 billion — Il Sole 24 ORE

companies.description_en: Mundipharma is a global network of independent associated companies owned by members of the Sackler family, headquartered at Cambridge Science Park in England. Long the international counterpart to Purdue Pharma, it focuses on anti-infectives, oncology and consumer health; it acquired Cidara's rezafungin assets in 2024 and has been the subject of a pending sale amid opioid settlements.
companies.description_zh: 萌蒂制药是由萨克勒家族成员所有的全球独立关联公司网络，总部位于英国剑桥科学园。长期作为普渡制药的国际对应方，专注于抗感染、肿瘤及消费者健康；2024年收购Cidara的rezafungin资产，并在阿片类和解背景下面临待定出售。

companies.description_en: Pierre Fabre is a French diversified pharmaceutical and dermocosmetics group founded in 1962, owning brands such as Eau Thermale Avène, Klorane and Ducray alongside an oncology pharma portfolio. It is 86% owned by the public-interest Pierre Fabre Foundation, generating roughly €3.1 billion in 2024 revenue.
companies.description_zh: 皮尔法伯是1962年创立的法国多元化制药与皮肤化妆品集团，旗下拥有雅漾、康如、馥绿德雅等品牌及肿瘤药物组合。公司86%由公益性皮尔法伯基金会持有，2024年营收约31亿欧元。

companies.description_en: STADA is a major European generics, consumer-health and specialty pharma group reporting record 2025 sales of €4.3 billion; after a long private-equity ownership by Bain Capital and Cinven, a majority stake passed to CapVest Partners in March 2026, keeping the company delisted.
companies.description_zh: 史达德是欧洲主要的仿制药、消费者保健与专科药企业，2025 年销售额创纪录达 43 亿欧元；在贝恩资本与 Cinven 长期私募持股后，2026 年 3 月 CapVest Partners 接手多数股权，公司仍未上市。

sources.title: CapVest Completes Majority Acquisition of STADA
CapVest to Acquire Majority Stake in STADA (Bain/Cinven)

companies.description_en: Servier is the largest French independent drugmaker, governed by a non-profit foundation, with FY2024/25 group revenue of €6.9 billion (oncology now ~32% of sales). It operates in ~150 countries with strong cardiometabolic and oncology franchises.
companies.description_zh: 施维雅是法国最大的独立制药企业，由非营利基金会治理，2024/25 财年集团收入达 69 亿欧元（肿瘤业务约占销售额 32%）。公司业务遍及约 150 个国家，在心血管代谢与肿瘤领域优势突出。

companies.description_en: Tillotts Pharma is a Swiss specialty pharmaceutical company focused on gastroenterology — inflammatory bowel disease and Clostridioides difficile infection. It has been wholly owned by Japan's Zeria Pharmaceutical group since 2009.
companies.description_zh: 添力斯制药是一家专注于胃肠病学（炎症性肠病及艰难梭菌感染）的瑞士专科制药公司，自 2009 年起由日本 Zeria（折居）制药集团全资拥有。

companies.description_en: CSL Vifor (formerly Vifor Pharma) is a global specialty pharma leader in iron deficiency and nephrology/cardio-renal therapies, with flagship products Ferinject/Injectafer. CSL Limited acquired it for ~US$11.7 billion in 2022; it now operates as a CSL business unit (~US$2.2bn revenue).
companies.description_zh: CSL威发（原 Vifor Pharma）是全球铁缺乏症及肾脏/心肾治疗领域的专科制药龙头，核心产品为 Ferinject/Injectafer。CSL 于 2022 年以约 117 亿美元收购，现作为 CSL 旗下业务单元运营（收入约 22 亿美元）。

sources.title: CSL 2025 Annual Report — CSL Vifor segment

companies.description_en: Wörwag Pharma is a family-owned German specialty pharmaceutical company built on founder Fritz Wörwag's concept of 'biofactors' (micronutrients), with ~€358 million revenue and ~1,500 employees across 35 countries. It focuses on metabolic, nervous-system and musculoskeletal conditions.
companies.description_zh: 沃达制药是一家德国家族企业，基于创始人 Fritz Wörwag 提出的'生物因子'（微量营养素）理念发展，收入约 3.58 亿欧元、约 1,500 名员工，业务覆盖 35 个国家，聚焦代谢、神经系统及肌肉骨骼疾病。

companies.description_en: Atomwise is an AI drug-discovery pioneer that built AtomNet, one of the first deep-learning systems for structure-based small-molecule virtual screening. It has raised ~US$175 million (including a $123M Series B co-led by B Capital and Sanabil) and runs 750+ research collaborations plus partnerships with firms like Sanofi.
companies.description_zh: Atomwise 是 AI 药物发现先驱，打造了 AtomNet——最早用于基于结构的小分子虚拟筛选的深度学习系统之一。公司累计融资约 1.75 亿美元（含由 B Capital 与 Sanabil 共同领投的 1.23 亿美元 B 轮），开展 750 多项研究合作并与赛诺菲等企业建立合作。

companies.description_en: Basecamp Research builds what it calls the world's largest ethically sourced biodiversity-scale biological database, sampling microbes globally to power protein-design and AI foundation models. Founded by Glen Gowers and Oliver Vince, it raised a $60M Series B led by Singular (~$85M total) and partners with the David Liu lab on genetic medicines.
companies.description_zh: Basecamp Research 构建其所称的全球最大、合乎伦理来源的生物多样性级生物数据库，在全球采样微生物以驱动蛋白质设计与 AI 基础模型。公司由 Glen Gowers 与 Oliver Vince 创立，完成由 Singular 领投的 6,000 万美元 B 轮（累计约 8,500 万美元），并与 David Liu 实验室合作开发基因疗法。

sources.title: Basecamp Research $60M Series B + Liu Lab collaboration

companies.description_en: BenevolentAI is a pioneer of knowledge-graph AI for drug target identification and indication discovery, integrating literature, omics and clinical data via NLP and graph ML. After listing on Euronext Amsterdam (BAI) in 2022, it delisted on 13 March 2025 via merger into Osaka Holdings and is now privately held, pivoting to modular AI products for pharma partners.
companies.description_zh: BenevolentAI 是知识图谱 AI 用于药物靶点识别与适应症发现的先驱，通过 NLP 与图机器学习整合文献、组学和临床数据。继 2022 年在泛欧阿姆斯特丹交易所上市（BAI）后，公司于 2025 年 3 月 13 日通过并入 Osaka Holdings 退市，现为私有，转向为药企提供模块化 AI 产品。

sources.title: Result of EGM and Delisting from Euronext Amsterdam
BenevolentAI to delist and merge into Osaka Holdings

companies.description_en: Aenova is one of the world's ten largest pharmaceutical CDMOs, formed in 2008 from the merger of Dragenopharm and Swiss Caps and operating ~14 sites across Europe and the US; it manufactures finished dosage forms (oral solids, softgels, sterile) for major pharma clients. Now owned by Klaus-Michael Kühne's Kühne Holding (acquired from BC Partners in 2024).
companies.description_zh: 安诺华是全球十大医药 CDMO 之一，2008 年由 Dragenopharm 与 Swiss Caps 合并而成，在欧洲和美国运营约 14 个生产基地，为大型药企代工口服固体制剂、软胶囊及无菌制剂。2024 年由 Kühne Holding 从 BC Partners 手中收购。

sources.title: Kühne Holding acquires Aenova from BC Partners

companies.description_en: Cambrex is a US small-molecule CDMO providing integrated drug substance, drug product and analytical services across the development-to-commercial lifecycle. Founded in 1979, it was taken private by Permira in 2019 in a deal valued at ~$2.4B.
companies.description_zh: 康宾士是一家美国小分子 CDMO，提供从开发到商业化全周期的原料药、制剂及分析检测一体化服务。公司创立于 1979 年，2019 年由私募基金 Permira 以约 24 亿美元收购退市。

companies.description_en: Delpharm is one of Europe's largest CDMOs, management-owned, operating ~19 plants across France, Italy, Canada, Poland and the Netherlands and producing a broad range of dosage forms; it was a key COVID-19 vaccine fill-finish partner (Pfizer/BioNTech). 2023 revenue ~€1.1B.
companies.description_zh: 德尔制药是欧洲最大的 CDMO 之一，由管理层持股，在法国、意大利、加拿大、波兰和荷兰运营约 19 家工厂，覆盖多种剂型，曾是新冠疫苗（辉瑞/BioNTech）灌装代工的重要伙伴。2023 年营收约 11 亿欧元。

companies.description_en: Famar is a long-standing Southern-European CDMO founded in 1949, operating manufacturing and R&D sites across Greece, Germany, Italy and Spain and producing pharmaceutical, cosmetic and consumer-health products. The group is backed by Mid Europa and partners and has been expanding via acquisitions including a sterile site in 2025.
companies.description_zh: 法玛是一家历史悠久的南欧 CDMO，创立于 1949 年，在希腊、德国、意大利和西班牙运营生产及研发基地，制造药品、化妆品和大众健康产品。集团由 Mid Europa 等私募支持，近年通过收购（含 2025 年一处无菌生产基地）持续扩张。

companies.description_en: Fareva is one of the world's largest privately held contract manufacturers, spanning pharmaceuticals (API and finished dose), cosmetics and household/industrial products across ~41 production sites in 13 countries. 2024 turnover was ~€2.2B with ~13,000 employees.
companies.description_zh: 法瑞瓦是全球最大的私营合同制造商之一，业务横跨制药（原料药与制剂）、化妆品及日化/工业产品，在 13 个国家拥有约 41 个生产基地。2024 年营业额约 22 亿欧元，员工约 1.3 万人。

companies.description_en: Lotte Biologics is the biologics CDMO arm of South Korea's Lotte Corporation, launched in 2022 with the ~$160M acquisition of Bristol Myers Squibb's East Syracuse (NY) mammalian-cell drug-substance site and now building out a multi-billion-dollar Songdo Bio Campus in Korea plus a new ADC facility. It targets becoming a top-ten global CDMO by 2030.
companies.description_zh: 乐天生物是韩国乐天集团旗下的生物药 CDMO，2022 年以约 1.6 亿美元收购百时美施贵宝位于纽约东锡拉丘兹的哺乳动物细胞原液生产基地起家，目前正在韩国松岛建设数十亿美元级的生物园区并新设 ADC 设施，目标到 2030 年跻身全球十大 CDMO。

sources.title: Lotte Biologics begins full-scale ADC facility operation

companies.description_en: PPD is a major global clinical CRO providing Phase I-IV clinical research, central-lab and laboratory services in nearly 50 countries. Founded in 1985 in Wilmington, NC, it was acquired by Thermo Fisher Scientific in December 2021 for $17.4B and now operates within Thermo Fisher's Laboratory Products & Biopharma Services segment; 2020 revenue was ~$4.7B.
companies.description_zh: PPD 是全球大型临床 CRO，在近 50 个国家提供 I 至 IV 期临床研究、中心实验室及检测服务。公司 1985 年创立于北卡罗来纳州威尔明顿，2021 年 12 月被赛默飞世尔以 174 亿美元收购，现隶属于赛默飞的实验室产品与生物制药服务部门；2020 年营收约 47 亿美元。

sources.title: Thermo Fisher Completes Acquisition of PPD, Inc.
Thermo Fisher to Acquire PPD for $17.4B

companies.description_en: BigHat Biosciences pairs a high-speed antibody characterization wet lab with machine learning to design safer, more effective antibody therapeutics. It has raised ~$148M (Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, Series B led by Section 32 with Amgen Ventures and Bristol Myers Squibb) and signed an AI antibody discovery collaboration with Eli Lilly.
companies.description_zh: BigHat 生物科学将高速抗体表征湿实验室与机器学习结合，设计更安全、更有效的抗体疗法。累计融资约 1.48 亿美元（A 轮由 a16z 领投，B 轮由 Section 32 领投、Amgen Ventures 与 BMS 参与），并与礼来签署 AI 抗体发现合作。

companies.description_en: Causaly builds an AI platform that lets pharma R&D teams search, visualize, and reason over biomedical evidence to accelerate target discovery and preclinical research. Founded in 2018 by Yiannis Kiachopoulos and Artur Saudabayev, it has raised ~$93M (Series B led by ICONIQ Growth with Index Ventures) and serves 12 of the top 20 pharma companies.
companies.description_zh: Causaly 打造 AI 平台，让药企研发团队对生物医学证据进行检索、可视化与推理，加速靶点发现与临床前研究。2018 年创立，累计融资约 9300 万美元（B 轮由 ICONIQ Growth 领投、Index Ventures 参与），客户涵盖全球前 20 大药企中的 12 家。

companies.description_en: Cellarity, a Flagship Pioneering company, applies single-cell technologies and machine learning to design medicines that correct disease-driving cell states rather than hitting a single molecular target. It has raised over $274M (including a $123M Series B and a $121M Series C) and partners with Novo Nordisk on MASH.
companies.description_zh: Cellarity 是 Flagship Pioneering 旗下公司，运用单细胞技术与机器学习，设计针对致病细胞状态（而非单一分子靶点）的药物。累计融资超 2.74 亿美元（含 1.23 亿美元 B 轮、1.21 亿美元 C 轮），并与诺和诺德就 MASH 展开合作。

companies.description_en: Chai Discovery builds AI foundation models that predict and reprogram biomolecular interactions; its open-source Chai-1 matches state-of-the-art structure prediction and Chai-2 designs de novo antibodies with a ~20% hit rate. Founded in 2024 and backed by OpenAI, Thrive Capital, and Menlo Ventures, it has raised over $225M, reaching a $1.3B valuation in its Series B.
companies.description_zh: Chai Discovery 构建预测并重编程生物分子相互作用的 AI 基础模型；开源的 Chai-1 达到结构预测最先进水平，Chai-2 可从头设计抗体、命中率约 20%。2024 年创立，获 OpenAI、Thrive Capital 与 Menlo Ventures 支持，累计融资逾 2.25 亿美元，B 轮估值达 13 亿美元。

companies.description_en: Cradle offers generative AI software that lets scientists design and optimize proteins for desired properties, combining ML models with experimental data across drug, food, and industrial applications. Founded in 2021 by Stef van Grieken and Jelle Prins with operations in Amsterdam and Zurich, it has raised over $100M (Series B led by IVP, with Index Ventures).
companies.description_zh: Cradle 提供生成式 AI 软件，让科学家设计并优化具备目标性质的蛋白质，将机器学习模型与实验数据结合，应用于制药、食品与工业领域。2021 年由 Stef van Grieken 与 Jelle Prins 创立，运营地在阿姆斯特丹与苏黎世，累计融资超 1 亿美元（B 轮由 IVP 领投、Index Ventures 参与）。

companies.description_en: Enveda Biosciences combines mass-spectrometry metabolomics with machine learning to decode the chemistry of nature and turn natural compounds into small-molecule drugs, having characterized over 1 million natural compounds. Founded in 2019, it has raised ~$360M (Series A led by Lux Capital, $130M Series C led by Kinnevik and FPV) advancing a pipeline of clinical-stage candidates.
companies.description_zh: Enveda 生物科学将质谱代谢组学与机器学习结合，解码自然界化学并把天然化合物转化为小分子药物，已表征逾 100 万种天然化合物。2019 年创立，累计融资约 3.6 亿美元（A 轮由 Lux Capital 领投，1.3 亿美元 C 轮由 Kinnevik 与 FPV 领投），推进多个临床阶段候选药物。

companies.description_en: EvolutionaryScale, founded in 2023 by former Meta AI protein-team scientists, builds frontier protein language models; its 98B-parameter ESM3 reasons jointly over protein sequence, structure, and function to generate novel proteins. It raised a ~$142M seed (Nat Friedman, Daniel Gross, Lux Capital, Amazon, NVIDIA's NVentures) and was acquired by Chan Zuckerberg Biohub in November 2025.
companies.description_zh: EvolutionaryScale 由原 Meta AI 蛋白质团队科学家于 2023 年创立，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型；其 980 亿参数的 ESM3 可同时对蛋白质序列、结构与功能进行推理并生成新蛋白。完成约 1.42 亿美元种子轮（Nat Friedman、Daniel Gross、Lux Capital、亚马逊、英伟达 NVentures），并于 2025 年 11 月被 Chan Zuckerberg Biohub 收购。

companies.description_en: Generate:Biomedicines, a Flagship Pioneering company launched in 2020 after founding research begun in 2018, runs a clinical-stage generative-biology platform that designs novel protein therapeutics. It has raised over $690M (incl. a $370M Series B and $273M Series C with Amgen and NVIDIA's NVentures) and struck collaborations with Amgen (up to $1.9B) and Novartis (up to $1B).
companies.description_zh: Generate:Biomedicines 是 Flagship Pioneering 旗下公司，研究始于 2018 年、2020 年正式推出，运营临床阶段生成式生物学平台以设计新型蛋白质疗法。累计融资逾 6.9 亿美元（含 3.7 亿美元 B 轮、2.73 亿美元 C 轮，Amgen 与英伟达 NVentures 参与），并与 Amgen（最高 19 亿美元）及诺华（最高 10 亿美元）达成合作。

companies.description_en: Stanford spinout building the GEMS (Genesis Exploration of Molecular Space) AI platform that uses graph neural networks for small-molecule drug design. Closed an oversubscribed $200M Series B (2023, co-led by a16z Bio + Health) and signed a strategic collaboration with Eli Lilly worth up to ~$670M plus an equity investment and collaboration with NVIDIA.
companies.description_zh: 斯坦福大学衍生公司，构建以图神经网络驱动的 GEMS 分子探索 AI 平台用于小分子药物设计。2023 年完成 2 亿美元 B 轮（a16z Bio + Health 联合领投），并与礼来达成总额约 6.7 亿美元的战略合作，另获 NVIDIA 股权投资与合作。

sources.title: Genesis Therapeutics Closes Oversubscribed $200 Million Series B
Genesis Therapeutics strategic collaboration with Lilly
Genesis Therapeutics announces investment and collaboration with NVIDIA

companies.description_en: Clinical-stage AI biotech whose platform (NeuralPLexer structure prediction, Enchant multimodal outcome prediction) generates novel oncology small molecules; lead asset IAM1363 is a brain-penetrant HER2 inhibitor in Phase 1/1b. Has raised ~$334M including a $100M Series B and a $50M extension, with backers including Abingworth, Mubadala Capital, Illumina Ventures and NVIDIA.
companies.description_zh: 临床阶段 AI 生物科技公司，平台含 NeuralPLexer 结构预测与 Enchant 多模态疗效预测，用于生成新型肿瘤小分子；主打药物 IAM1363 为入脑 HER2 抑制剂，处于 1/1b 期。累计融资约 3.34 亿美元，含 1 亿美元 B 轮及 5000 万美元延伸轮，投资方包括 Abingworth、Mubadala、Illumina Ventures 与 NVIDIA。

sources.title: Iambic Raises Over $100 Million in Oversubscribed Round

companies.description_en: Founded by Transformer co-inventor Jakob Uszkoreit (ex-Google) and Stanford biochemist Rhiju Das to design 'biological software' — RNA molecules (notably mRNA) using deep learning plus high-throughput biochemistry. Raised $100M led by Andreessen Horowitz and NVIDIA to apply generative AI to vaccines and therapeutics.
companies.description_zh: 由 Transformer 共同发明人、前谷歌科学家 Jakob Uszkoreit 与斯坦福生化学家 Rhiju Das 创立，运用深度学习加高通量生化实验设计'生物软件'——以 mRNA 为代表的 RNA 分子。获 a16z 与 NVIDIA 领投的 1 亿美元融资，将生成式 AI 应用于疫苗与疗法设计。

sources.title: Inceptive Raises $100 Million to Design Vaccines and Therapies with AI
Inceptive's Jakob Uszkoreit on biological software - pharmaphorum
Inceptive CEO Jakob Uszkoreit on AI in pharma - CNBC

companies.description_en: ML-driven drug discovery company founded by renowned AI researcher Daphne Koller, combining human genetic/phenotypic data with machine learning to identify targets and design medicines in metabolic disease and neuroscience. Has raised roughly $800M (including a $400M Series C) with pharma partnerships including Gilead, Bristol Myers Squibb and Eli Lilly.
companies.description_zh: 由知名 AI 研究者 Daphne Koller 创立的机器学习药物发现公司，融合人类基因与表型数据及机器学习，聚焦代谢疾病与神经科学的靶点发现与药物设计。累计融资约 8 亿美元（含 4 亿美元 C 轮），与吉利德、百时美施贵宝、礼来等达成合作。

sources.title: Insitro raises $400M for ML-powered drug discovery - Fierce Biotech
insitro partners with Lilly on machine learning models
Daphne Koller: How Insitro is Reprogramming Drug Discovery

companies.description_en: Alphabet/DeepMind spinout founded by Demis Hassabis to reimagine drug design with AI built on AlphaFold. Raised $600M from Thrive Capital (2025) and a further ~$2.1B Series B (2026) for total outside capital of ~$2.7B, with pharma deals with Eli Lilly (up to $1.7B) and Novartis (up to $1.2B); first AI-designed drugs heading toward clinical trials.
companies.description_zh: 由 Demis Hassabis 创立的 Alphabet/DeepMind 衍生公司，基于 AlphaFold 用 AI 重塑药物设计。2025 年获 Thrive Capital 领投 6 亿美元，2026 年再融约 21 亿美元 B 轮，外部融资合计约 27 亿美元；与礼来（最高 17 亿美元）及诺华（最高 12 亿美元）达成合作，首批 AI 设计药物即将进入临床。

sources.title: DeepMind Spinout Isomorphic Labs Raises $600M Toward AI Drug Design
Alphabet's Isomorphic Labs raises $600M from Thrive - TechCrunch
Isomorphic Labs prepares to launch trials for AI-designed drugs

companies.description_en: AI startup founded by ex-DeepMind AlphaFold 2 scientist Simon Kohl, building web-accessible generative models for de novo protein design (antibodies, enzymes) to make biology programmable. Emerged from stealth in 2025 with $50M, including a $40M Series A co-led by Radical Ventures and Sofinnova Partners.
companies.description_zh: 由前 DeepMind AlphaFold 2 科学家 Simon Kohl 创立的 AI 初创公司，构建可在线访问的生成式模型用于全新蛋白质（抗体、酶）设计，使生物学可编程。2025 年揭开面纱并融资 5000 万美元，含 Radical Ventures 与 Sofinnova 联合领投的 4000 万美元 A 轮。

sources.title: Latent Labs Secures $50M in Funding - Business Wire
Latent Labs launches with $50M to make biology programmable - TechCrunch
Ex-DeepMind scientist launches drug discovery company - pharmaphorum

companies.description_en: French-American AI and precision-medicine company co-founded by Thomas Clozel and Gilles Wainrib that uses federated learning to unlock insights from siloed patient datasets while preserving privacy, focused on oncology drug discovery and diagnostics. Became a unicorn via a $180M equity investment from Sanofi (2021) and has raised over $300M in total.
companies.description_zh: 由 Thomas Clozel 与 Gilles Wainrib 共同创立的法美 AI 与精准医疗公司，运用联邦学习在保护隐私的前提下从分散的患者数据中提取洞见，聚焦肿瘤药物发现与诊断。2021 年获赛诺菲 1.8 亿美元股权投资晋升独角兽，累计融资超 3 亿美元。

sources.title: Owkin becomes unicorn with $180m investment from Sanofi
Sanofi inks $270M cancer AI deal with Owkin - Fierce Biotech

companies.description_en: AI protein-design company co-founded by Ali Madani using large language models to generate novel proteins; created OpenCRISPR-1, the first AI-designed, open-source gene editor shown to edit the human genome. Has raised ~$150M total, including a $106M round (2025) co-led by Altimeter Capital and Bezos Expeditions.
companies.description_zh: 由 Ali Madani 共同创立的 AI 蛋白质设计公司，运用大语言模型生成全新蛋白质；推出全球首个 AI 设计的开源基因编辑器 OpenCRISPR-1，并验证可编辑人类基因组。累计融资约 1.5 亿美元，含 2025 年由 Altimeter Capital 与 Bezos Expeditions 联合领投的 1.06 亿美元融资。

sources.title: Profluent Edits Human Genome with OpenCRISPR-1 - Business Wire
Profluent Raises $106M to Scale Frontier AI Models - Business Wire
Profluent combines LLMs and CRISPR - Fierce Biotech

companies.description_en: Recursion is the largest publicly traded AI-enabled drug discovery company, pairing high-throughput automated wet-lab biology with a proprietary 'Recursion OS' machine-learning platform; it acquired UK-based Exscientia in a ~$688M all-stock merger that closed November 2024, creating an end-to-end techbio discovery engine partnered with Sanofi, Roche-Genentech and Merck KGaA.
companies.description_zh: Recursion 是全球最大的上市 AI 药物发现公司，将高通量自动化湿实验室生物学与自有的 'Recursion OS' 机器学习平台结合；2024 年 11 月以约 6.88 亿美元全股票交易并购英国 Exscientia，打造端到端的技术驱动发现引擎，并与赛诺菲、罗氏-基因泰克及默克集团达成合作。

sources.title: Recursion Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
AI biotechs Exscientia and Recursion agree $688m merger

companies.description_en: Schrödinger is the pioneer of physics-based computational molecular-design software, selling its platform to most major pharma and materials companies while also running its own pipeline of proprietary and partnered drug-discovery programs built on over 30 years of R&D.
companies.description_zh: 薛定谔是基于物理学的计算分子设计软件先驱，向大多数大型制药与材料企业销售其平台，同时基于逾 30 年研发积累运营自有及合作的药物发现管线。

sources.title: Schrödinger Reports Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_en: Founded by Groupon co-founder Eric Lefkofsky, Tempus AI is an AI-enabled precision-medicine company combining molecular and clinical diagnostics with one of healthcare's largest multimodal clinical-genomic datasets, which it licenses to pharma for drug discovery; 2025 revenue grew 83% to ~$1.3B.
companies.description_zh: 由 Groupon 联合创始人 Eric Lefkofsky 创立，Tempus AI 是一家 AI 精准医疗公司，将分子与临床诊断同医疗界最大的多模态临床-基因组数据集之一相结合，并将数据授权给药企用于药物发现；2025 年营收增长 83% 至约 13 亿美元。

sources.title: Tempus Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results

companies.description_en: Xaira Therapeutics launched in April 2024 with over $1 billion in committed funding co-led by ARCH Venture Partners and Foresite Labs, making it one of biotech's largest-ever launches; led by CEO Marc Tessier-Lavigne and co-founded by 2024 Nobel laureate David Baker, it builds drugs using generative-AI protein and antibody design models (RFdiffusion, RFantibody) from the Baker lab.
companies.description_zh: Xaira 疗法于 2024 年 4 月成立，由 ARCH 创投伙伴与 Foresite Labs 联合领投，承诺融资逾 10 亿美元，是生物技术史上规模最大的初创之一；由 CEO Marc Tessier-Lavigne 领导，2024 年诺贝尔奖得主 David Baker 联合创立，利用 Baker 实验室的生成式 AI 蛋白与抗体设计模型（RFdiffusion、RFantibody）开发药物。

sources.title: Enter Xaira, with $1bn for its AI in drug discovery platform
New AI drug discovery powerhouse Xaira rises with $1B in funding

companies.description_en: ARCH Venture Partners is a seminal early-stage life-sciences venture firm that co-founds biotech companies alongside leading academic scientists, with roughly $12B in assets under management and a portfolio spanning Illumina, Alnylam, Juno, Bridgebio and Xaira; it pioneered the university-spinout company-creation model.
companies.description_zh: ARCH 创投伙伴是开创性的早期生命科学风险投资机构，与顶尖学术科学家共同创立生物技术公司，管理资产约 120 亿美元，投资组合涵盖 Illumina、Alnylam、Juno、Bridgebio 及 Xaira；其开创了大学衍生企业的公司创建模式。

sources.title: ARCH Venture Partners investment portfolio - PitchBook

companies.description_en: Centessa Pharmaceuticals, founded in 2020 with backing from Medicxi, pioneered an asset-centric multi-program model consolidating several biotech subsidiaries; its lead program ORX750 is an oral OX2R orexin agonist in Phase 2 for narcolepsy and idiopathic hypersomnia, alongside ORX142 and ORX489.
companies.description_zh: Centessa 制药于 2020 年成立，获 Medicxi 支持，开创以资产为中心、整合多家生物技术子公司的多管线模式；其主打项目 ORX750 是一种口服 OX2R 食欲素激动剂，正处于治疗发作性睡病及特发性嗜睡的 2 期临床，另有 ORX142 与 ORX489。

companies.description_en: Flagship Pioneering is the premier biotech company-builder, founded in 1999 by Noubar Afeyan as NewcoGen; using a 'hub-and-spoke' model it has conceived and built over 100 ventures worth more than $100B in aggregate, most famously founding and incubating Moderna.
companies.description_zh: 旗舰先锋是顶级的生物技术公司创建者，1999 年由 Noubar Afeyan 以 NewcoGen 之名创立；采用'中心-辐射'模式，已构想并孵化逾 100 家企业，合计价值超过 1000 亿美元，其中最著名的是创立并孵化了 Moderna。

companies.description_en: PureTech Health is a hub-and-spoke biotech founding platform that creates and advances medicines, having originated KarXT (now BMS's FDA-approved schizophrenia drug Cobenfy) on which it earns royalties; its wholly-owned pipeline includes deupirfenidone (LYT-100) for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and LYT-200 in oncology.
companies.description_zh: PureTech 健康是一家'中心-辐射'式生物技术创建平台，创建并推进药物，曾originate KarXT（现为 BMS 已获 FDA 批准的精神分裂症药物 Cobenfy），并由此获得特许权使用费；其全资管线包括用于特发性肺纤维化的 deupirfenidone（LYT-100）及肿瘤学的 LYT-200。

sources.title: PureTech Announces Annual Results for Year Ended December 31, 2024

companies.description_en: Third Rock Ventures is a Boston-based life-science venture creation firm founded by former Millennium Pharmaceuticals leaders that discovers, launches and builds biotech companies, having raised about $3.8 billion across six funds including a $1.1 billion Fund VI in 2022. It is one of the most iconic company-builder VCs, having seeded firms such as Editas Medicine, Bluebird Bio, Sana Biotechnology, Foundation Medicine and Agios.
companies.description_zh: 第三磐石创投是一家总部位于波士顿的生命科学风险孵化机构，由前千禧制药高管创立，专注于发现、创办并培育生物技术公司，迄今通过六只基金募集约38亿美元，其中2022年的第六期基金规模达11亿美元。作为最具标志性的创业孵化型创投，它孵化了Editas Medicine、Bluebird Bio、Sana Biotechnology、Foundation Medicine、Agios等公司。

sources.title: Third Rock Ventures Raises $1.1 Billion Fund VI

companies.description_en: Parexel is one of the world's largest full-service contract research organizations (CROs), providing clinical trial management, regulatory consulting and biopharma services across 100+ countries. It was taken private in 2021 for $8.5 billion by EQT Private Equity and Goldman Sachs Asset Management.
companies.description_zh: 精鼎医药是全球最大的全方位合同研究组织（CRO）之一，在100多个国家提供临床试验管理、法规咨询及生物制药服务。2021年被EQT私募股权与高盛资产管理以85亿美元收购实现私有化。

sources.title: EQT and Goldman Sachs Complete Acquisition of Parexel

companies.description_en: Recipharm is a leading European specialty CDMO operating ~18 facilities across nine countries in oral solid dosage, sterile fill & finish and advanced therapies. Founded in 1995 by Thomas Eldered and Lars Backsell, it was taken private and delisted in 2021 by EQT alongside its founders.
companies.description_zh: 瑞普制药是欧洲领先的专科合同研发生产组织（CDMO），在9个国家运营约18处工厂，覆盖口服固体制剂、无菌灌装及先进疗法。公司由Thomas Eldered与Lars Backsell于1995年创立，2021年由EQT联合创始人收购并从瑞典证交所退市。

companies.description_en: Syneos Health is a global biopharmaceutical solutions organization combining a full-service CRO with commercial and contract-sales operations under one roof. Formed in 2017 from the merger of INC Research and inVentiv Health, it was taken private in 2023 for $7.1 billion by Elliott Investment Management, Patient Square Capital and Veritas Capital.
companies.description_zh: 赛纽仕是全球性生物制药解决方案机构，将全方位CRO与商业化及合同销售业务整合于一体。公司2017年由INC Research与inVentiv Health合并而成，2023年被Elliott、Patient Square Capital与Veritas Capital以71亿美元收购实现私有化。

companies.description_en: Vetter Pharma is a family-owned German CDMO and global leader in aseptic fill-finish of prefilled syringes, cartridges and vials, with sites in Germany, Austria and the United States. Founded in 1950, it pioneered the ready-to-use prefilled syringe and generated over €1.1 billion in sales in 2024.
companies.description_zh: 维特制药是德国家族企业，全球无菌灌装预充式注射器、卡式瓶及西林瓶领域的领导者，在德国、奥地利和美国设有生产基地。公司创立于1950年，开创了即用型预充式注射器，2024年销售额超过11亿欧元。

sources.title: Vetter celebrates 75th anniversary as global CDMO

companies.description_en: Arcellx is a cell-therapy biotech developing anitocabtagene autoleucel (anito-cel), a BCMA-directed CAR-T using a compact D-Domain binder for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. Founded in 2014, it was acquired by Gilead Sciences in April 2026 for up to ~$7.8 billion ahead of anito-cel's potential commercial launch.
companies.description_zh: Arcellx是一家细胞疗法生物技术公司，开发靶向BCMA的CAR-T疗法anito-cel（采用紧凑型D-Domain结合域），用于复发难治性多发性骨髓瘤。公司创立于2014年，2026年4月被吉利德以最高约78亿美元收购，正值anito-cel潜在商业化上市前。

sources.title: Gilead to acquire Arcellx in $8B deal

companies.description_en: Generation Bio is a genetic-medicine biotech built on a non-viral platform pairing closed-ended ceDNA ("immune-quiet" DNA) with a cell-targeted lipid nanoparticle (ctLNP) delivery system enabling repeatable, redosable gene therapy. After failing to advance independently, it agreed in December 2025 to be acquired by XOMA Royalty for ~$4.29 per share, closing in early 2026.
companies.description_zh: Generation Bio是一家基因医学生物技术公司，其非病毒平台将闭合末端ceDNA（"免疫静默"DNA）与细胞靶向脂质纳米颗粒（ctLNP）递送系统结合，实现可重复给药的基因疗法。在难以独立推进后，公司于2025年12月同意被XOMA Royalty以约每股4.29美元收购，2026年初完成交易。

sources.title: XOMA Royalty to Acquire Generation Bio
Xoma to acquire Generation Bio - BioPharma Dive

companies.description_en: Prime Medicine is a clinical-stage gene-editing company pioneering prime editing, a "search-and-replace" technology that makes precise DNA edits without double-strand breaks. Founded in 2019 by David Liu and Andrew Anzalone, it reported breakthrough Phase 1/2 data for PM359 in chronic granulomatous disease and trades on Nasdaq as PRME.
companies.description_zh: Prime医药是一家临床阶段基因编辑公司，开创"搜索-替换"式先导编辑（prime editing）技术，可在不产生双链断裂的情况下精确编辑DNA。公司由David Liu与Andrew Anzalone于2019年创立，其慢性肉芽肿病疗法PM359公布了突破性1/2期数据，在纳斯达克以PRME上市。

companies.description_en: Replimune is a clinical-stage biotech pioneering tumor-directed oncolytic immunotherapies built on its proprietary RPx HSV-1 platform, with lead candidates RP1 (vusolimogene oderparepvec) and RP2 in melanoma and other solid tumors. It trades on Nasdaq as REPL and held $483.8 million in cash at its fiscal year ended March 2025.
companies.description_zh: Replimune是一家临床阶段生物技术公司，基于其专有的RPx HSV-1平台开发肿瘤靶向溶瘤免疫疗法，主力候选药物RP1与RP2用于黑色素瘤及其他实体瘤。公司在纳斯达克以REPL上市，截至2025年3月财年末持有4.838亿美元现金。

companies.description_en: Adlai Nortye is a global clinical-stage oncology biotech with R&D centers in Hangzhou and New Jersey, advancing immuno-oncology candidates including the oral PD-L1 inhibitor AN4005, EP4 antagonist AN0025, and pan-RAS(ON) programs. It listed on NASDAQ in 2023 and raised $150M in a 2026 private placement.
companies.description_zh: 德琪医药是一家全球临床阶段肿瘤生物科技公司，在杭州和美国新泽西设有研发中心，推进包括口服PD-L1抑制剂AN4005、EP4拮抗剂AN0025及泛RAS(ON)项目在内的免疫肿瘤管线。公司于2023年在纳斯达克上市，并在2026年完成1.5亿美元定向增发。

companies.description_en: LaNova Medicines is a privately held Shanghai biotech developing novel ADCs and bispecific antibodies; its PD-1/VEGF bispecific LM-299 was licensed to Merck in a deal worth up to $3.3 billion ($588M upfront). In 2025 Sino Biopharmaceutical agreed to acquire LaNova for up to $951 million.
companies.description_zh: 礼新医药是一家位于上海的私营生物科技公司，专注于开发新型ADC和双特异性抗体；其PD-1/VEGF双抗LM-299以最高33亿美元（首付5.88亿美元）授权给默沙东。2025年中国生物制药同意以最高9.51亿美元收购礼新医药。

sources.title: Merck closes LM-299 license from LaNova
Sino Biopharm buys LaNova for up to $951M

companies.description_en: Connect Biopharma is a clinical-stage immunology biotech (founded in China, now headquartered in San Diego) developing rademikibart, a next-generation IL-4R-alpha antibody for acute exacerbations of asthma and COPD, with two Phase 2 Seabreeze STAT trials underway.
companies.description_zh: 康乃德生物是一家临床阶段免疫学生物科技公司（创立于中国，现总部位于圣地亚哥），开发新一代IL-4Rα抗体rademikibart，用于哮喘和慢阻肺急性加重，目前正在进行两项二期Seabreeze STAT试验。

companies.description_en: Duality Biologics (DualityBio) is a Shanghai-based clinical-stage biotech and global leader in next-generation antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), with a 12+ pipeline and partnerships valued over $4B including BioNTech, GSK, BeiGene and Adcendo; it listed on HKEX (9606.HK) in April 2025, the largest Chapter 18A biotech IPO in four years, surging ~117% on debut.
companies.description_zh: 映恩生物（DualityBio）是总部位于上海的临床阶段生物科技公司，是新一代抗体偶联药物（ADC）领域的全球领跑者，拥有12款以上管线及总值超40亿美元的合作（含BioNTech、GSK、百济神州、Adcendo）；2025年4月在港交所（9606.HK）上市，为四年来最大的18A章生物科技IPO，上市首日涨约117%。

sources.title: DualityBio (9606.HK) Officially Lists on Hong Kong Stock Exchange
BioNTech-backed ADC maker DualityBio plans Hong Kong IPO (Endpoints)

companies.description_en: Gracell Biotechnologies pioneered the FasTCAR CAR-T platform that shortens cell manufacturing to overnight, with lead asset GC012F (BCMA/CD19) for multiple myeloma and autoimmune disease. AstraZeneca acquired Gracell in 2024 in a deal valued at up to $1.2 billion, delisting it.
companies.description_zh: 亘喜生物开创了FasTCAR CAR-T平台，可将细胞生产周期缩短至一夜，主打产品GC012F（BCMA/CD19）用于治疗多发性骨髓瘤和自身免疫疾病。阿斯利康于2024年以最高12亿美元收购亘喜生物并使其退市。

sources.title: Gracell to be acquired by AstraZeneca

companies.description_en: Hengenix Biotech is the California-based antibody-discovery subsidiary and US innovation arm of Shanghai Henlius Biotech, focused on monoclonal and bispecific antibodies for oncology and autoimmune disease across a pipeline of more than 20 mAb programs.
companies.description_zh: 恒翼生物是上海复宏汉霖的加州抗体发现子公司及美国创新中心，专注于面向肿瘤和自身免疫疾病的单克隆及双特异性抗体，拥有超过20个单抗项目的管线。

companies.description_en: I-Mab is a US-based, China-founded clinical-stage immuno-oncology biotech headquartered in Rockville, MD. Its lead program givastomig is a Claudin 18.2 x 4-1BB bispecific antibody for gastric cancers, showing an 83% ORR in Phase 1b combination data at ESMO GI 2025; pro-forma cash was ~$226.8M mid-2025.
companies.description_zh: 天境生物是一家在美国注册、源自中国的临床阶段免疫肿瘤生物科技公司，总部位于美国马里兰州罗克维尔。其主打项目givastomig是用于胃癌的Claudin 18.2 x 4-1BB双特异性抗体，在2025年ESMO GI公布的一期b联合用药数据中客观缓解率达83%；2025年中期备考现金约2.268亿美元。

companies.description_en: LianBio was a high-profile China-focused license-in NewCo (formerly Nasdaq: LIAN) that in-licensed Western drugs such as mavacamten and infigratinib for the China market. After a 2024 strategic review it began winding down operations, voluntarily delisted from Nasdaq, and returned roughly US$528 million to shareholders as a special dividend, with final dissolution expected by 2027.
companies.description_zh: 联拓生物曾是备受瞩目的中国 license-in NewCo（原纳斯达克代码 LIAN），引进 mavacamten、infigratinib 等西方药物用于中国市场。2024 年完成战略评估后启动清盘、自愿从纳斯达克退市，并以特别股息向股东返还约 5.28 亿美元，预计 2027 年完成最终清算。

sources.title: LianBio Announces Completion of Strategic Review
LianBio to shut down, return cash to investors - BioPharma Dive

companies.description_en: Bharat Biotech is a major private Indian vaccine maker founded in 1996 by Krishna and Suchitra Ella, best known for Covaxin (the indigenous COVID-19 vaccine co-developed with ICMR), the Rotavac rotavirus vaccine, and Typbar-TCV typhoid conjugate vaccine. FY2022 revenue surged to about ₹8,148 crore on Covaxin demand.
companies.description_zh: 巴拉特生物技术是印度主要的私营疫苗企业，1996 年由 Krishna 与 Suchitra Ella 创立，以与 ICMR 联合研发的本土新冠疫苗 Covaxin、Rotavac 轮状病毒疫苗及 Typbar-TCV 伤寒结合疫苗著称。受 Covaxin 拉动，2022 财年营收激增至约 814.8 亿卢比。

companies.description_en: Biological E. Limited, founded in 1953, is India's first private-sector biological products company and a major vaccine and specialty pharmaceutical maker supplying more than 130 countries. It is best known for Corbevax, a low-cost protein-subunit COVID-19 vaccine, alongside pentavalent and other pediatric vaccines.
companies.description_zh: 印度百欧诺生物（Biological E. Limited）创立于 1953 年，是印度首家私营生物制品公司，也是向 130 多个国家供货的主要疫苗与特色药企业。其以低成本蛋白亚单位新冠疫苗 Corbevax 及五联苗等儿科疫苗著称。

sources.title: Corbevax WHO Emergency Use Listing - PR Newswire

companies.description_en: CSL Behring is the largest division of Australia's CSL Limited and the world's leading plasma-products company, developing immunoglobulins, clotting factors and other plasma-derived and recombinant therapies for rare and serious diseases. It operates CSL Plasma, one of the world's largest plasma-collection networks, and is headquartered in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania.
companies.description_zh: 杰特贝林（CSL Behring）是澳大利亚 CSL 集团旗下最大的事业部，也是全球领先的血浆制品公司，研发免疫球蛋白、凝血因子及其他血浆衍生与重组疗法以治疗罕见及重症疾病。公司运营全球最大血浆采集网络之一 CSL Plasma，总部位于美国宾州 King of Prussia。

companies.description_en: Church & Dwight (NYSE: CHD), founded in 1846, is a major US consumer-products company best known for its Arm & Hammer baking-soda franchise and a portfolio of OTC and personal-care brands including Zicam, vitamins (VitaFusion), OxiClean, Waterpik and First Response. It reported 2024 net sales of about US$6.11 billion.
companies.description_zh: Church & Dwight（纽交所 CHD）创立于 1846 年，是美国主要的消费品公司，以 Arm & Hammer 小苏打品牌系列著称，并拥有 Zicam、VitaFusion 维生素、OxiClean、Waterpik、First Response 等 OTC 与个护品牌。2024 年净销售额约 61.1 亿美元。

companies.description_en: Dynavax Technologies (Nasdaq: DVAX) is a US commercial-stage vaccine company best known for Heplisav-B, the only two-dose adult hepatitis B vaccine approved in the US, EU and Great Britain, built on its CpG 1018 toll-like-receptor-9 adjuvant platform. Heplisav-B net product revenue reached about US$268 million in 2024, up 26%.
companies.description_zh: 迪纳瓦克斯（纳斯达克 DVAX）是美国商业化阶段疫苗公司，以 Heplisav-B 著称——这是美国、欧盟及英国唯一获批的两剂成人乙肝疫苗，基于其 CpG 1018（TLR9 激动剂）佐剂平台。2024 年 Heplisav-B 净产品收入约 2.68 亿美元，同比增长 26%。

sources.title: Dynavax Full Year 2024 Financial Highlights - PR Newswire

companies.description_en: Haleon (LSE/NYSE: HLN) is the world's largest standalone consumer-health company, spun off from GSK in 2022, with leading brands including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Centrum and Voltaren across oral health, pain relief, respiratory, digestive health and vitamins. It reported 2024 revenue of about £11.2 billion and net income of roughly £1.44 billion.
companies.description_zh: 赫力昂（伦交所/纽交所 HLN）是全球最大的独立消费者健康公司，2022 年从葛兰素史克（GSK）分拆，旗下拥有 Sensodyne、Panadol、Advil、Centrum、Voltaren 等领先品牌，覆盖口腔护理、止痛、呼吸、消化与维生素品类。2024 年营收约 112 亿英镑，净利润约 14.4 亿英镑。

companies.description_en: Italian plasma-derivatives manufacturer making medicines from human blood plasma for rare and life-threatening conditions; in 2022 Permira and the founding Marcucci family combined Kedrion with the UK's Bio Products Laboratory (BPL) to form a ~EUR1.1bn-revenue global plasma group.
companies.description_zh: 意大利血浆衍生物制造商，从人类血浆中提取药物治疗罕见及危及生命的疾病；2022年Permira与创始人Marcucci家族将其与英国BPL合并，组成营收约11亿欧元的全球血浆制品集团。

sources.title: Permira/Marcucci complete Kedrion & BPL investment (PR Newswire)

companies.description_en: World's largest pure-play consumer health company, spun off from Johnson & Johnson in 2023, owning iconic OTC and personal-care brands including Tylenol, Band-Aid, Listerine, Neutrogena and Aveeno.
companies.description_zh: 全球最大的纯消费者健康公司，2023年从强生分拆上市，拥有泰诺、邦迪、李施德林、露得清、艾惟诺等标志性非处方药与个护品牌。

companies.name_zh: 法国血液分馏与生物技术实验室
companies.description_en: French state-owned (wholly owned by the French State) biopharmaceutical group specializing in plasma-derived medicinal products and recombinant proteins for immunology, hemostasis and intensive care.
companies.description_zh: 由法国政府全资持有的生物制药集团，专注血浆衍生药物及重组蛋白，用于免疫学、止血及重症监护领域。

companies.description_en: World's largest privately owned and family-owned plasma fractionator, developing human proteins from plasma and human cell lines across hematology, immunotherapy and critical care, operating its own network of US and German plasma donation centers.
companies.description_zh: 全球最大的私人及家族所有血浆分馏企业，从血浆和人类细胞系中开发人类蛋白，覆盖血液学、免疫治疗与重症监护，并自营美国与德国血浆采集中心网络。

companies.description_en: World's third-largest over-the-counter and VMS consumer-healthcare business, carved out of Sanofi with a controlling 50% stake sold to private-equity firm Clayton, Dubilier & Rice in 2024 (enterprise value ~EUR16bn); brands include Doliprane, Allegra and Dulcolax.
companies.description_zh: 全球第三大非处方药与维生素矿物质补充剂消费健康企业，2024年从赛诺菲剥离并将50%控股权出售给私募基金CD&R（企业价值约160亿欧元）；旗下品牌包括Doliprane、Allegra和Dulcolax。

sources.title: Sanofi and CD&R partner on Opella (Sanofi PR)

companies.description_en: Global health, hygiene and nutrition consumer-products group formed in 1999 from the merger of Reckitt & Colman and Benckiser; owns OTC and household brands including Mucinex, Strepsils, Nurofen, Durex, Dettol, Lysol and Finish.
companies.description_zh: 全球健康、卫生与营养消费品集团，1999年由Reckitt & Colman与Benckiser合并而成；拥有Mucinex、Strepsils、Nurofen、杜蕾斯、滴露、Lysol及Finish等非处方药及家用品牌。

companies.description_en: Commercial-stage biotech translating the genetics of the adaptive immune system into clinical products; its clonoSEQ assay is an FDA-cleared next-generation-sequencing test for measurable (minimal) residual disease monitoring in blood cancers.
companies.description_zh: 处于商业化阶段的生物科技公司，将适应性免疫系统的基因学转化为临床产品；其clonoSEQ检测是获FDA批准的下一代测序产品，用于血液肿瘤微小残留病灶监测。

companies.description_en: Genome analysis company and leader in optical genome mapping (OGM), whose Saphyr/Stratys systems detect structural variations in the genome for cytogenetics, hematology and rare-disease research; underwent a major 2024 restructuring and workforce reduction.
companies.description_zh: 基因组分析公司及光学基因组图谱（OGM）技术领导者，其Saphyr/Stratys系统检测基因组结构变异，应用于细胞遗传学、血液学及罕见病研究；2024年经历重大重组与裁员。

companies.description_en: Caris Life Sciences is a molecular science and AI company offering comprehensive tumor profiling (whole-exome and whole-transcriptome) to guide precision oncology treatment decisions. It IPO'd on Nasdaq in June 2025 and runs one of the largest clinico-genomic databases in oncology.
companies.description_zh: Caris Life Sciences 是一家分子科学与人工智能公司，提供全外显子组和全转录组肿瘤分子谱分析，指导精准肿瘤治疗决策。公司于2025年6月在纳斯达克上市，拥有肿瘤学领域最大的临床基因组数据库之一。

companies.description_en: Complete Genomics is the US sequencing arm of MGI (BGI Group), commercializing DNBSEQ-based instruments such as the DNBSEQ-T7+ to compete in the global NGS market. Founded in 2005, it was acquired by BGI in 2013 and now operates as a wholly owned MGI subsidiary.
companies.description_zh: Complete Genomics 是 MGI（华大智造，隶属华大集团）的美国测序业务部门，商业化基于 DNBSEQ 技术的测序仪（如 DNBSEQ-T7+），参与全球 NGS 市场竞争。公司成立于2005年，2013年被华大收购，现为 MGI 全资子公司。

companies.description_en: Element Biosciences makes the AVITI benchtop DNA sequencer, a high-accuracy platform challenging Illumina with avidity-based chemistry, and has expanded into multiomic and clinical research. It has raised over $850M across rounds (Series E led by Samsung Electronics) at a roughly $1B valuation.
companies.description_zh: Element Biosciences 开发 AVITI 台式 DNA 测序仪，采用亲合力测序化学，以高准确度挑战 Illumina，并已拓展至多组学与临床研究领域。公司累计融资超过8.5亿美元（E 轮由三星电子领投），估值约10亿美元。

companies.description_en: Foundation Medicine pioneered FDA-approved comprehensive genomic profiling assays (FoundationOne CDx/Liquid) used as companion diagnostics to match cancer patients to targeted therapies. Founded in 2010, it became a wholly owned independent affiliate of the Roche Group in 2018.
companies.description_zh: Foundation Medicine 开创了获 FDA 批准的综合基因组分析检测（FoundationOne CDx/Liquid），作为伴随诊断帮助癌症患者匹配靶向治疗。公司成立于2010年，2018年成为罗氏集团全资独立子公司。

companies.description_en: NeoGenomics operates a leading US network of oncology-focused clinical laboratories providing cytogenetics, FISH, flow cytometry, molecular and NGS cancer testing to oncologists, hospitals and pharma. FY2024 revenue reached $661M with continued double-digit growth into 2025.
companies.description_zh: NeoGenomics 运营美国领先的肿瘤学临床实验室网络，为肿瘤医生、医院和药企提供细胞遗传学、FISH、流式细胞、分子及 NGS 癌症检测。2024财年营收达6.61亿美元，2025年保持两位数增长。

companies.description_en: Oxford Nanopore Technologies develops portable, real-time nanopore sequencing devices (MinION, GridION, PromethION) enabling direct electronic analysis of DNA and RNA. Listed on the LSE in 2021, it is the leading long-read sequencing platform globally.
companies.description_zh: 牛津纳米孔科技开发便携式实时纳米孔测序设备（MinION、GridION、PromethION），可对 DNA 和 RNA 进行直接电子分析。公司于2021年在伦敦证券交易所上市，是全球领先的长读长测序平台。

companies.description_en: SOPHiA GENETICS is a cloud-native healthcare technology company whose SOPHiA DDM platform applies AI to genomic and multimodal data analytics for cancer and rare-disorder diagnostics across a global hospital network. It reports its financials in USD and listed on Nasdaq in 2021.
companies.description_zh: SOPHiA GENETICS 是一家云原生医疗科技公司，其 SOPHiA DDM 平台运用人工智能对基因组及多模态数据进行分析，服务于全球医院网络的癌症与罕见病诊断。公司以美元报告财务，于2021年在纳斯达克上市。

companies.description_en: Ultima Genomics builds the UG 100 high-throughput sequencing platform that delivers an ultra-low-cost '$100 genome' to scale population-scale and single-cell genomics. Founded by Gilad Almogy, it emerged from stealth in 2022 with $600M in funding from backers including a16z, General Atlantic and Khosla Ventures.
companies.description_zh: Ultima Genomics 开发 UG 100 高通量测序平台，以超低成本实现“100美元基因组”，推动人群规模和单细胞基因组学应用。公司由 Gilad Almogy 创立，2022年携6亿美元融资走出隐身模式，投资方包括 a16z、General Atlantic 和 Khosla Ventures。

companies.description_en: Adcendo is a Danish clinical-stage biotech developing first- and best-in-class antibody-drug conjugates, led by ADCE-D01, the first uPARAP-targeted ADC (FDA Fast Track for soft tissue sarcoma). It raised an oversubscribed $135M Series B (2024, led by TCGX) and a $75M Series C (2026, led by Jeito Capital).
companies.description_zh: Adcendo 是一家丹麦临床阶段生物技术公司，开发首创及同类最佳的抗体偶联药物（ADC），核心产品 ADCE-D01 是首个靶向 uPARAP 的 ADC（获 FDA 软组织肉瘤快速通道）。公司完成 1.35 亿美元 B 轮（2024，TCGX 领投）及 7500 万美元 C 轮（2026，Jeito Capital 领投）。

sources.title: Adcendo Completes Oversubscribed $135M Series B (Ysios Capital)

companies.description_en: Avidity pioneered antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates (AOCs), attaching RNA payloads to targeting antibodies to reach previously undruggable tissues such as muscle. Novartis acquired the company for ~$12B ($72.00/share), completing the deal in February 2026 and delisting it from Nasdaq (former ticker RNA).
companies.description_zh: Avidity 开创了抗体-寡核苷酸偶联物（AOC）技术，将 RNA 负载连接到靶向抗体上，递送至此前难以成药的肌肉等组织。诺华以约 120 亿美元（每股 72 美元）收购该公司，并于 2026 年 2 月完成交易，从纳斯达克退市（原代码 RNA）。

companies.description_en: Kailera is a clinical-stage obesity biotech that launched in October 2024 with a $400M Series A (Atlas Venture, Bain Capital Life Sciences, RTW), built around four GLP-1-based metabolic assets in-licensed from China's Hengrui. Lead candidate ribupatide (KAI-9531), a GLP-1/GIP dual agonist, is in global Phase 3; the company later raised ~$625M in one of biotech's largest IPOs.
companies.description_zh: Kailera 是一家临床阶段肥胖症生物技术公司，2024 年 10 月以 4 亿美元 A 轮（Atlas Venture、Bain Capital Life Sciences、RTW 领投）成立，核心为从中国恒瑞引进的四项 GLP-1 代谢资产。主打候选药 ribupatide（KAI-9531）为 GLP-1/GIP 双重激动剂，处于全球 III 期；公司后续以约 6.25 亿美元完成生物技术领域最大 IPO 之一。

sources.title: Kailera Launches with $400M Series A (Bain Capital)
Kailera nets $625M in one of biotech's biggest-ever IPOs (BioPharma Dive)

companies.description_en: Mariana Oncology was a radiopharmaceutical platform developing targeted radioligand therapies for breast, prostate and lung cancers, led by MC-339, an actinium-based candidate for small cell lung cancer. Novartis acquired it in 2024 for $1B upfront plus up to $750M in milestones (up to $1.75B total).
companies.description_zh: Mariana Oncology 是一家放射性药物平台公司，开发针对乳腺、前列腺和肺癌的靶向放射性配体疗法，核心为靶向小细胞肺癌的锕基候选药 MC-339。诺华于 2024 年以 10 亿美元首付款外加最高 7.5 亿美元里程碑款（总额最高 17.5 亿美元）收购该公司。

sources.title: Mariana Oncology to be Acquired by Novartis (BusinessWire)
Novartis to Acquire Mariana for Up to $1.75B (GEN)

companies.description_en: Metsera is an obesity and cardiometabolic biotech (founded 2022, Population Health Partners/ARCH-backed) developing both oral and injectable GLP-1 and amylin candidates. It became the center of a 2025 bidding war: Pfizer won over Novo Nordisk with an offer valuing the company at up to ~$10B ($65.60/share upfront plus up to $20.65/share in CVRs).
companies.description_zh: Metsera 是一家肥胖症与心血管代谢生物技术公司（2022 年成立，由 Population Health Partners／ARCH 支持），开发口服及注射型 GLP-1 与胰淀素候选药。它成为 2025 年竞购战焦点：辉瑞击败诺和诺德，报价使公司估值最高达约 100 亿美元（每股 65.60 美元首付款外加最高 20.65 美元或有价值权）。

sources.title: Pfizer wins $10B bidding war for Metsera (CNBC)
Pfizer finalizes Metsera buy after bidding war (Fierce Biotech)

companies.description_en: RayzeBio is a radiopharmaceutical therapeutics company pioneering actinium-225 alpha-emitter therapies, led by RYZ101 (225Ac-DOTATATE) targeting SSTR2 in GEP-NETs and small cell lung cancer. Bristol Myers Squibb acquired it for ~$4.1B ($62.50/share), completing the deal in February 2024, just months after RayzeBio's IPO.
companies.description_zh: RayzeBio 是一家放射性药物治疗公司，开创锕-225 阿尔法发射体疗法，核心产品 RYZ101（225Ac-DOTATATE）靶向 GEP-NET 与小细胞肺癌中的 SSTR2。百时美施贵宝以约 41 亿美元（每股 62.50 美元）收购该公司，并于 2024 年 2 月完成交易，距其 IPO 仅数月。

sources.title: BMS enters radiopharma race with $4.1B RayzeBio acquisition (Fierce Biotech)

companies.description_en: Structure Therapeutics (Nasdaq: GPCR) is a clinical-stage biopharma using structure-based drug discovery to develop oral small-molecule GPCR therapies for metabolic disease. Lead candidate aleniglipron, a once-daily oral GLP-1 receptor agonist, delivered 16.3% placebo-adjusted weight loss at 44 weeks in Phase 2; the company held $1.4B cash at end-2025 (no product revenue, net loss $141.2M).
companies.description_zh: Structure Therapeutics（纳斯达克代码 GPCR）是一家临床阶段生物制药公司，运用基于结构的药物发现开发针对代谢疾病的口服小分子 GPCR 疗法。核心候选药 aleniglipron 是每日一次口服 GLP-1 受体激动剂，II 期 44 周安慰剂校正减重达 16.3%；公司 2025 年末持有 14 亿美元现金（无产品收入，净亏损 1.412 亿美元）。

sources.title: Structure Therapeutics Reports Q4 and Full Year 2025 Results
Structure Therapeutics Positive Topline ACCESS Data (IR)

companies.description_en: Verdiva Bio is a London-based clinical-stage cardiometabolic company that launched in January 2025 with over $411M Series A (co-led by Forbion and General Atlantic) — one of the largest early-stage rounds for a UK biotech. Led by ex-Aiolos CEO Khurem Farooq, it in-licensed a once-weekly oral GLP-1 and amylin pipeline from China's Sciwind Biosciences.
companies.description_zh: Verdiva Bio 是一家总部位于伦敦的临床阶段心血管代谢公司，2025 年 1 月以超过 4.11 亿美元 A 轮（Forbion 与 General Atlantic 联合领投）成立，是英国生物技术领域最大的早期融资之一。由前 Aiolos CEO Khurem Farooq 领导，从中国 Sciwind（鸿运华宁/双爱）引进每周一次口服 GLP-1 及胰淀素管线。

sources.title: Verdiva Bio Launches with Over $410M Series A (General Atlantic)
Verdiva launches with $411M and weekly-dosed oral GLP-1 (Fierce Biotech)

companies.description_en: Bharat Serums and Vaccines (BSV) is an Indian biopharmaceutical company specializing in women's health, fertility, and critical-care biologics; previously owned by Advent International, it was acquired 100% by Mankind Pharma in 2024 for ~Rs 13,630 crore enterprise value.
companies.description_zh: 巴拉特血清与疫苗（BSV）是一家专注于女性健康、生育和重症生物制剂的印度生物制药公司；曾由安宏资本持有，2024 年被 Mankind Pharma 以约 136.3 亿卢比企业价值全资收购。

sources.title: Mankind Pharma acquires Bharat Serums and Vaccines (Business Standard)
Mankind Pharma Completes Landmark Acquisition of BSV

companies.description_en: Dexa Medica, flagship of the privately held Dexa Group, is one of Indonesia's largest ethical-pharmaceutical companies, producing branded generics and prescription drugs with strong domestic R&D and natural-product (DLBS) franchises.
companies.description_zh: 德沙制药是私营 Dexa 集团的旗舰企业，为印尼最大的处方药制药公司之一，生产品牌仿制药和处方药，拥有强大的本土研发能力及天然药物（DLBS）业务。

sources.title: Dexa Medica - Indonesia's leading pharma (Körber Pharma)

companies.description_en: Hovid is an established Malaysian generics, OTC and herbal-supplement manufacturer (tracing to the Ho Yan Hor herbal-tea brand) that exports 400+ products to ~50 countries; it was delisted from Bursa Malaysia and taken private in 2019.
companies.description_zh: 豪威是一家历史悠久的马来西亚仿制药、非处方药及草本保健品制造商（源自“何人可”凉茶品牌），向约 50 个国家出口 400 多种产品；2019 年从马来西亚交易所退市并私有化。

companies.description_en: Intas Pharmaceuticals is one of India's largest privately held pharmaceutical companies, with a global generics and biosimilars footprint across 85+ countries operating in regulated markets under its Accord Healthcare subsidiary; FY24 revenue was ~Rs 19,667 crore.
companies.description_zh: 印塔斯制药是印度最大的私营制药公司之一，通过其子公司 Accord Healthcare 在 85 个以上国家开展全球仿制药和生物类似药业务；2024 财年营收约 196.67 亿卢比。

companies.description_en: LG Chem is a major South Korean chemicals and battery-materials conglomerate whose Life Sciences division develops vaccines, diabetes and metabolic-disease drugs; its US oncology subsidiary AVEO Oncology (acquired 2023, maker of kidney-cancer drug Fotivda) helped life-sciences sales exceed KRW 1 trillion for the first time.
companies.description_zh: LG化学是韩国大型化工与电池材料集团，其生命科学部门研发疫苗、糖尿病及代谢病药物；2023 年收购的美国肿瘤子公司 AVEO Oncology（肾癌药 Fotivda 的制造商）推动其生命科学业务销售额首次突破 1 万亿韩元。

sources.title: LG Chem life science sales exceed KRW 1 tril (KBR)
LG Chem completes acquisition of AVEO (KED Global)

companies.description_en: Siam Bioscience is Thailand's first and only biopharmaceutical manufacturer (owned by the Thai Crown Property Bureau / King Vajiralongkorn), producing mammalian-cell biologics such as erythropoietin and filgrastim; it served as AstraZeneca's regional CDMO making COVID-19 vaccine for Southeast Asia.
companies.description_zh: 暹罗生物科学是泰国首家也是唯一一家生物制药生产商（由泰国王室资产局/瓦集拉隆功国王持有），生产促红细胞生成素和非格司亭等哺乳动物细胞生物制剂；新冠期间作为阿斯利康的区域 CDMO 为东南亚生产新冠疫苗。

sources.title: AstraZeneca commences COVID-19 vaccine supply chain in Thailand

companies.description_en: Align Technology is the global leader in clear-aligner orthodontics, maker of the Invisalign system and iTero intraoral scanners, controlling the vast majority of the clear-aligner market; FY2024 revenue was ~$4.0 billion.
companies.description_zh: 阿莱技术是全球隐形矫正正畸领域的领导者，Invisalign 隐形牙套系统和 iTero 口内扫描仪的制造商，占据绝大部分隐形矫正市场份额；2024 财年营收约 40 亿美元。

companies.description_en: Alivira Animal Health is the wholly-owned animal-health operating arm of India's listed Sequent Scientific (now branded Viyash), and India's largest pure-play veterinary API and finished-formulation maker with seven plants across India, Spain, Brazil and Turkey serving 100+ countries.
companies.description_zh: 阿莉维拉动物保健是印度上市公司 Sequent Scientific（现更名 Viyash）的全资动物保健运营主体，是印度最大的纯动物保健原料药与制剂企业，在印度、西班牙、巴西和土耳其设有七座工厂，产品销往 100 多个国家。

companies.description_en: Bimeda is a privately held global manufacturer, marketer and distributor of veterinary pharmaceuticals and animal-health products, founded by Irish vets in 1960 and now selling across 80+ countries with manufacturing on multiple continents.
companies.description_zh: 比美达是一家私营的全球兽药与动物保健产品制造、营销和分销商，1960 年由爱尔兰兽医创立，如今产品销往 80 多个国家，并在多大洲设有生产基地。

companies.description_en: Ceva Santé Animale is a privately held French firm ranking among the world's top-five animal-health companies, with particular strength in poultry, swine and ruminant vaccines and a presence in 110+ countries.
companies.description_zh: 诗华动物保健是一家私营法国企业，位列全球动物保健五强，尤其擅长禽类、猪和反刍动物疫苗，业务遍及 110 多个国家。

companies.description_en: Chanelle Pharma is a privately held Irish R&D and manufacturer of generic human and veterinary pharmaceuticals, founded in 1985 by veterinary surgeon Michael Burke, operating from a Loughrea (Co. Galway) campus with sites in the UK, Portugal, Jordan and India.
companies.description_zh: 沙内尔制药是一家私营爱尔兰企业，从事人用和兽用仿制药的研发与生产，1985 年由兽医 Michael Burke 创立，总部位于戈尔韦郡 Loughrea，并在英国、葡萄牙、约旦和印度设有基地。

companies.description_en: Covetrus is a leading global animal-health distribution and veterinary practice-software platform, formed in 2019 from Henry Schein Animal Health and Vets First Choice; it was taken private in October 2022 by Clayton, Dubilier & Rice and TPG in a ~$4B deal ($21/share).
companies.description_zh: 科唯思是全球领先的动物保健分销与兽医诊所软件平台，2019 年由 Henry Schein Animal Health 与 Vets First Choice 合并而成；2022 年 10 月被 Clayton, Dubilier & Rice 与 TPG 以约 40 亿美元（每股 21 美元）私有化收购。

sources.title: CD&R and TPG Complete Acquisition of Covetrus - TPG

companies.description_en: Dechra Pharmaceuticals is a specialist veterinary pharma developing and marketing companion-animal and equine therapeutics; formerly listed on the LSE, it was taken private in January 2024 by EQT and the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority for ~£4.46B (3,875p/share).
companies.description_zh: 德诚动物保健是一家专业兽药企业，研发和销售伴侣动物及马用治疗药物；原在伦敦证交所上市，2024 年 1 月被 EQT 与阿布扎比投资局以约 44.6 亿英镑（每股 3,875 便士）私有化收购。

sources.title: Recommended cash acquisition of Dechra - EQT

companies.description_en: Elanco Animal Health is one of the world's largest standalone animal-health companies, spun out of Eli Lilly in 2018-19 and greatly enlarged by its 2020 acquisition of Bayer Animal Health; it serves pet-health and farm-animal markets globally with 2024 revenue of $4.44B.
companies.description_zh: 礼蓝动物保健是全球最大的独立动物保健公司之一，2018-19 年从礼来公司分拆上市，并通过 2020 年收购拜耳动物保健大幅扩张；其覆盖全球宠物健康与畜牧市场，2024 年营收 44.4 亿美元。

sources.title: Elanco Animal Health Form 10-K FY2024 - SEC

companies.description_en: Heska is a maker of advanced veterinary point-of-care diagnostic instruments, lab analyzers and specialty products; previously Nasdaq-listed (HSKA), it was acquired by Mars in June 2023 (~$120/share, ~$1.3B) and folded into Mars Petcare's Antech/Science & Diagnostics division.
companies.description_zh: 海斯卡是先进兽用即时诊断仪器、实验室分析仪和专科产品制造商；原在纳斯达克上市（HSKA），2023 年 6 月被玛氏以约每股 120 美元（约 13 亿美元）收购，并入玛氏宠物护理旗下 Antech/科学与诊断部门。

sources.title: Mars to Acquire Heska - PR Newswire
Mars announces acquisition of Heska - dvm360

companies.description_en: HIPRA is a privately held Spanish biotech specializing in vaccines and diagnostics for animal health (swine, poultry, ruminants), and one of the largest dedicated animal-vaccine makers in Europe. It expanded into human health with its PHH-1V COVID-19 booster (BIMERVAX), authorized by the EMA in 2023.
companies.description_zh: 海博莱（HIPRA）是西班牙私营生物技术公司，专注于动物健康（猪、禽、反刍动物）疫苗与诊断，是欧洲最大的专业动物疫苗制造商之一。其新冠加强针 PHH-1V（BIMERVAX）于2023年获欧洲药品管理局批准，标志其进入人用健康领域。

sources.title: HIPRA Group revenue reaches 452 million euros (2023)

companies.description_en: Huvepharma is a privately owned, fast-growing global pharmaceutical group headquartered in Sofia, Bulgaria, developing and manufacturing human and animal-health products plus feed and industrial enzymes via large-scale fermentation. It is widely cited among the world's largest animal-health companies by revenue.
companies.description_zh: 虎博制药（Huvepharma）是总部位于保加利亚索非亚的私营全球制药集团，通过大规模发酵开发并生产人用与动物健康产品及饲料/工业酶。常被列为全球营收规模最大的动物健康公司之一。

companies.description_en: IDEXX Laboratories is the global leader in companion-animal veterinary diagnostics, supplying in-clinic analyzers, reference laboratory services, rapid assays and practice software, plus water and livestock/poultry testing. NASDAQ-listed with ~$3.9B revenue in 2024.
companies.description_zh: 爱德士（IDEXX）是全球伴侣动物兽医诊断龙头，提供院内分析仪、参考实验室服务、快速检测试剂与诊所管理软件，并涉足水质及畜禽检测。纳斯达克上市，2024年营收约39亿美元。

companies.name_zh: 印度免疫制品有限公司
companies.description_en: Indian Immunologicals Limited (IIL), established by India's National Dairy Development Board, is one of the world's largest producers of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccine and the largest veterinary-biologics company in India, also making human vaccines (rabies, measles-rubella). FY2025 revenue grew ~7% to about Rs 1,461 crore.
companies.description_zh: 印度免疫制品有限公司（IIL）由印度国家乳业发展委员会（NDDB）设立，是全球最大的口蹄疫（FMD）疫苗生产商之一，也是印度最大的兽用生物制品公司，同时生产人用疫苗（狂犬病、麻疹-风疹）。2025财年营收增长约7%至约146.1亿卢比。

companies.description_en: Jinhe Biotechnology (Inner Mongolia Jinhe Industrial Group), Shenzhen-listed, is a major Chinese producer of chlortetracycline feed additives and animal vaccines, having diversified into environmental and chemical businesses. 2024 revenue rose ~9% to RMB 2.37 billion.
companies.description_zh: 金河生物（内蒙古金河生物科技股份有限公司）在深交所上市，是中国主要的金霉素饲料添加剂与兽用疫苗生产商，并向环保、化工等多元业务拓展。2024年营业收入同比增长约9%至23.71亿元人民币。

sources.title: 金河生物2024年年报 - 上海证券报
金河生物(002688) - 东方财富

companies.description_en: Kyoritsu Seiyaku is a privately held Japanese veterinary pharmaceutical and biologics manufacturer (vaccines, general medicines, therapeutic foods and pet-care products) that pioneered importing the first canine distemper vaccine into Japan in 1955. It is one of Japan's leading dedicated animal-health firms.
companies.description_zh: 共立制药是日本私营兽用药品与生物制品制造商（疫苗、普通药品、处方食品及宠物护理品），1955年率先将首支犬瘟热疫苗引入日本，是日本主要的专业动物健康企业之一。

companies.description_en: Meiji Animal Health is the animal-health arm of Japan's Meiji Group, formed in April 2022 by integrating the veterinary divisions of Meiji Seika Pharma and KM Biologics. It is strong in Asian veterinary vaccines and pharmaceuticals; its ultimate listed parent is Meiji Holdings (TSE:2269). The stub's public/TYO:2269 status refers to the parent, not this private subsidiary.
companies.description_zh: 明治动物保健是日本明治集团的动物健康业务部门，于2022年4月由明治Seika制药与KM Biologics的兽药业务整合而成，在亚洲兽用疫苗与药品领域实力突出。其最终上市母公司为明治控股（东证:2269）；该实体本身为非上市子公司。

companies.description_en: Nippon Zenyaku Kogyo, marketed under the ZENOAQ brand and based in Koriyama, Fukushima, is a major privately held Japanese animal-health company researching, manufacturing and distributing veterinary pharmaceuticals, biologics, diagnostics and devices, with the widest veterinary distribution network in Japan. It now sits under ZENOAQ Holdings.
companies.description_zh: 日本全药工业（品牌 ZENOAQ）总部位于福岛县郡山市，是日本主要的私营动物健康企业，从事兽用药品、生物制品、诊断与器械的研发、生产与分销，拥有日本最广的兽用产品分销网络，现隶属于 ZENOAQ 控股。

companies.description_en: Anavex is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing oral SIGMAR1 agonist blarcamesine (ANAVEX 2-73) for Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and Rett syndrome. It held $102.6M cash at September 30, 2025; in November 2025 the EMA's CHMP issued a negative trend vote on its Alzheimer's MAA, which Anavex intends to appeal.
companies.description_zh: Anavex是一家临床阶段生物制药公司，开发口服SIGMAR1激动剂blarcamesine（ANAVEX 2-73），用于阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和Rett综合征。2025年9月底持有现金1.026亿美元；2025年11月欧洲药品管理局CHMP对其阿尔茨海默病上市申请给出负面倾向投票，公司拟提出复议。

companies.description_en: Annovis Bio is a Phase 3 clinical-stage biotech in Malvern, Pennsylvania developing once-daily oral buntanetap (formerly posiphen), which inhibits translation of multiple neurotoxic proteins (APP/amyloid-beta, tau, alpha-synuclein, TDP-43) for Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease. It held $19.5M cash at December 31, 2025 with R&D spend of $25.2M and a runway into Q3 2026.
companies.description_zh: Annovis生物是位于宾州Malvern的3期临床阶段生物技术公司，开发每日一次口服buntanetap（原名posiphen），抑制多种神经毒性蛋白（APP/β淀粉样蛋白、tau、α-突触核蛋白、TDP-43）的翻译，用于阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病。2025年底持有现金1950万美元，研发支出2520万美元，资金可支撑至2026年第三季度。

companies.description_en: Bial is Portugal's largest pharmaceutical company, founded 1924 in Porto and privately held by the Portela family. It is notable for an originator CNS franchise including Zebinix (eslicarbazepine acetate) for epilepsy and Ongentys (opicapone) for Parkinson's disease, sold in 58+ countries; FY2023 turnover was about EUR 340M.
companies.description_zh: Bial是葡萄牙最大的制药公司，1924年创立于波尔图，由Portela家族私人持有。以原研中枢神经系统产品线著称，包括治疗癫痫的Zebinix（醋酸艾司利卡西平）和治疗帕金森病的Ongentys（奥匹卡朋），销往58个以上国家；2023财年营收约3.4亿欧元。

companies.description_en: Cassava Sciences is an Austin-based clinical-stage biotech that became a high-profile cautionary tale: its oral Alzheimer's candidate simufilam failed both Phase 3 trials and the program was discontinued in November 2024, and in September 2024 the SEC charged the company with securities fraud over Phase 2 data misrepresentations, settled for a $40M penalty. It is now pivoting simufilam toward other CNS disorders (e.g. epilepsy).
companies.description_zh: Cassava科学是总部位于奥斯汀的临床阶段生物技术公司，成为高调的警示案例：其口服阿尔茨海默病候选药simufilam两项3期试验均失败，该项目于2024年11月终止；2024年9月美国证监会因其歪曲2期数据指控其证券欺诈，以4000万美元罚款和解。目前正将simufilam转向其他中枢神经系统疾病（如癫痫）。

sources.title: Cassava ends simufilam after second Phase III failure

companies.description_en: Cerevance is a clinical-stage CNS biotech headquartered in Cambridge (UK) with US operations in Boston, built on its proprietary NETSseq (Nuclear Enriched Transcript Sort sequencing) human-brain transcriptomics platform for novel target discovery. Its lead candidate solengepras is in a fully-enrolled pivotal Phase 3 trial (ARISE) for Parkinson's disease; it raised >$116M Series B (2024) and a $20M Series C in May 2026, extending runway into 2027.
companies.description_zh: Cerevance是一家临床阶段中枢神经系统生物技术公司，总部位于英国剑桥，美国业务设于波士顿，基于其专有的NETSseq（核富集转录本分选测序）人脑转录组学平台进行新靶点发现。主打候选药solengepras正处于已完成入组的帕金森病关键性3期试验（ARISE）；公司于2024年完成超1.16亿美元B轮，2026年5月完成2000万美元C轮，资金延展至2027年。

companies.description_en: CervoMed (formerly EIP Pharma, founded 2014, public via 2023 reverse merger with Diffusion Pharmaceuticals) is a clinical-stage biotech developing oral small molecule neflamapimod, which inhibits a neuroinflammation enzyme, for dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB). It aligned with the FDA on a registration path in late 2025 and held ~$12.9M cash at March 31, 2026 with new financing extending runway into Q2 2027.
companies.description_zh: CervoMed（前身为EIP Pharma，2014年成立，2023年通过与Diffusion Pharmaceuticals反向合并上市）是一家临床阶段生物技术公司，开发口服小分子neflamapimod（抑制神经炎症相关酶），用于路易体痴呆（DLB）。2025年底与FDA就注册路径达成一致，2026年3月底持有现金约1290万美元，新融资将资金延展至2027年第二季度。

companies.description_en: Denali Therapeutics is a South San Francisco biopharmaceutical company built on a proprietary Transport Vehicle (TV) platform engineered to cross the blood-brain barrier, targeting neurodegenerative and lysosomal storage diseases. Its lead program tividenofusp alfa (DNL310) for Hunter syndrome (MPS II) is in late-stage development; net loss for FY2025 was $512.5M and it held roughly $988M cash.
companies.description_zh: Denali治疗是位于南旧金山的生物制药公司，基于其专有的Transport Vehicle（TV）平台（设计用于穿越血脑屏障），针对神经退行性疾病和溶酶体贮积症。主打项目tividenofusp alfa（DNL310）用于Hunter综合征（MPS II）处于后期开发阶段；2025财年净亏损5.125亿美元，持有现金约9.88亿美元。

companies.description_en: Morphic Therapeutic was a Waltham, Massachusetts biotech developing oral small-molecule integrin inhibitors, led by MORF-057 (a selective oral alpha4-beta7 inhibitor) for inflammatory bowel disease as an oral rival to injectable Entyvio. Eli Lilly acquired Morphic for ~$3.2B, with the deal announced July 2024 and completed August 2024; it now operates as part of Lilly.
companies.description_zh: Morphic治疗曾是位于马萨诸塞州Waltham的生物技术公司，开发口服小分子整合素抑制剂，主打MORF-057（选择性口服α4β7抑制剂）用于炎症性肠病，作为注射剂Entyvio的口服竞品。礼来于2024年7月宣布、8月完成以约32亿美元收购Morphic；现已并入礼来。

companies.description_en: Muna Therapeutics is a Danish-Belgian clinical-stage biotech developing first-in-class small-molecule therapies targeting brain resilience and neuroinflammation for Alzheimer's, frontotemporal dementia and Parkinson's. Launched in 2021 with a US$73M Series A co-led by Novo Holdings, Sofinnova Partners, Droia Ventures and LSP Dementia Fund, it is built around the progranulin pathway and microglial biology of founders Simon Glerup and Bart De Strooper.
companies.description_zh: 穆纳治疗是一家丹麦-比利时临床阶段生物技术公司，开发针对脑韧性与神经炎症的首创小分子疗法，用于阿尔茨海默病、额颞叶痴呆和帕金森病。2021年以7300万美元A轮融资启动，由诺和控股、Sofinnova、Droia与LSP痴呆基金联合领投。

sources.title: Novo Holdings launches Muna with US$73M Series A
