companies.description_en: Neumora Therapeutics is a clinical-stage precision-neuroscience biopharma building a pipeline of targeted CNS therapies; its lead kappa-opioid antagonist navacaprant for major depressive disorder failed a key Phase 3 (KOASTAL-1), prompting a pipeline pivot toward NMRA-215 and other programs. Founded in 2019 (as RBNC Therapeutics), it IPO'd on Nasdaq in 2023.
companies.description_zh: Neumora治疗是一家临床阶段精准神经科学生物制药公司，构建针对中枢神经系统疾病的靶向疗法管线；其主打κ阿片受体拮抗剂navacaprant在重度抑郁症三期关键试验中失败，推动管线转向NMRA-215等项目。公司2019年成立，2023年纳斯达克上市。

companies.description_en: Q32 Bio is a clinical-stage immunology biotech developing bempikibart, a fully human anti-IL-7Ra antibody blocking IL-7 and TSLP signaling, in the Phase 2a SIGNAL-AA trial for alopecia areata and atopic dermatitis. It became public in March 2024 via a reverse merger with Homology Medicines and reported $48.3M cash at end-2025, with runway into Q4 2027 after divesting its complement asset ADX-097.
companies.description_zh: Q32生物是一家临床阶段免疫学生物技术公司，开发全人源抗IL-7Rα抗体bempikibart，阻断IL-7与TSLP信号，用于斑秃和特应性皮炎二期SIGNAL-AA试验。2024年3月通过与Homology Medicines反向合并上市，2025年底现金4830万美元。

companies.description_en: Sage Therapeutics pioneered neuroactive steroid medicines, co-developing ZURZUVAE (zuranolone) with Biogen as the first FDA-approved oral treatment for postpartum depression. Once valued above $9B, Sage was acquired by Supernus Pharmaceuticals on July 31, 2025 for $8.50/share cash plus a $3.50 CVR (up to ~$795M), ending its run as an independent public company.
companies.description_zh: Sage治疗是神经活性甾体药物的先驱，与渤健共同开发ZURZUVAE（zuranolone），为首个FDA批准的产后抑郁口服疗法。公司曾估值超90亿美元，2025年7月31日被Supernus制药以每股8.50美元现金加3.50美元或有价值权（总额至多约7.95亿美元）收购，结束独立上市公司历程。

sources.title: Fierce Pharma — Supernus acquires Sage for $561M

companies.description_en: Ventyx Biosciences is a San Diego clinical-stage biopharma developing oral small molecules for inflammatory-mediated disease, including NLRP3 inflammasome inhibitors and allosteric TYK2 inhibitors spanning cardiometabolic, neurodegenerative and inflammatory disorders. Eli Lilly agreed in January 2026 to acquire Ventyx for $14.00/share (~$1.2B), and the company is being absorbed into Lilly's immunology pipeline.
companies.description_zh: Ventyx生物科学是一家位于圣地亚哥的临床阶段生物制药公司，开发治疗炎症介导疾病的口服小分子，包括NLRP3炎症小体抑制剂和变构TYK2抑制剂，涵盖心血管代谢、神经退行性及炎症疾病。礼来于2026年1月同意以每股14.00美元（约12亿美元）收购Ventyx，纳入其免疫学管线。

companies.description_en: Vigil Neuroscience developed microglia-targeting therapies for neurodegeneration, led by VG-3927, a novel oral small-molecule TREM2 agonist for Alzheimer's disease. Sanofi completed its acquisition of Vigil on August 6, 2025 for $8.00/share at closing plus a $2.00 CVR (up to $10.00/share), folding VG-3927 into Sanofi's neurology portfolio.
companies.description_zh: Vigil神经科学开发靶向小胶质细胞的神经退行性疾病疗法，主打VG-3927——一种用于阿尔茨海默病的新型口服小分子TREM2激动剂。赛诺菲于2025年8月6日完成收购，交割价每股8.00美元加2.00美元或有价值权（至多每股10.00美元），将VG-3927纳入其神经学组合。

sources.title: Sanofi completes acquisition of Vigil Neuroscience

companies.description_en: Nichi-Iko Pharmaceutical is one of Japan's largest generic-drug manufacturers, historically the first generics maker listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and once expanded into the US via its 2016 acquisition of Sagent Pharmaceuticals. After a manufacturing-quality scandal at its Toyama plants and a debt crisis, it was delisted from the TSE on March 9, 2023 and taken private under a turnaround led by private-equity firm J-STAR and Japan's REVIC; it later divested Sagent and exited North America.
companies.description_zh: 日医工是日本最大的仿制药制造商之一，曾是首家在东京证券交易所上市的仿制药企业，并于2016年收购美国Sagent制药拓展北美业务。因富山工厂质量丑闻和债务危机，公司于2023年3月9日从东证退市并被私有化，由私募J-STAR与日本REVIC主导重整；其后剥离Sagent、退出北美市场。

sources.title: JPX — Decision on Delisting: Nichi-Iko Pharmaceutical
Generics Bulletin — Nichi-Iko hives off Sagent, exits North America

companies.description_en: Privately held Osaka specialty pharma founded in 1939, best known for Neurotropin, a non-protein bioactive extract that is a first-line analgesic for post-herpetic neuralgia and chronic pain in Japan, with operations extended into China and the ASEAN market.
companies.description_zh: 总部位于大阪的非上市特色制药企业，成立于1939年，以镇痛药 Neurotropin（神经妥乐平）闻名——该药为日本带状疱疹后神经痛及慢性疼痛的一线用药，并已拓展至中国及东南亚市场。

sources.title: Nippon Zoki Pharmaceutical — About Us / Brief History

companies.description_en: Korean biopharma that developed Cellgram-AMI (Hearticellgram), one of the world's first approved autologous bone-marrow mesenchymal stem-cell therapies, with a pipeline spanning stroke, spinal-cord injury, lung and liver disease alongside a biochemical/CDMO business.
companies.description_zh: 韩国生物制药公司，开发了 Cellgram-AMI（Hearticellgram），为全球最早获批的自体骨髓间充质干细胞疗法之一，研发管线涵盖中风、脊髓损伤、肺与肝病，并兼营生化与代工业务。

sources.title: Pharmicell Co., Ltd. — Yahoo Finance profile

companies.description_en: Japan's largest OTC/self-medication company, maker of the Lipovitan energy-drink line and a broad consumer-health and prescription portfolio; delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange in 2024 via a ~JPY700bn founding-family management buyout, now privately held.
companies.description_zh: 日本最大的 OTC／自我药疗企业，旗下拥有力保健（Lipovitan）能量饮料系列及广泛的消费健康与处方药产品；2024年经创始家族约7000亿日元的管理层收购从东京证券交易所退市，现为非上市公司。

sources.title: Japan's Taisho Pharma to go private after successful tender offer — Nikkei Asia

companies.description_en: The pharmaceutical and home-healthcare arm of Teijin Limited (TSE:3401), with priority fields in bone/joint, respiratory, rehabilitation/neurology and cardio-metabolic; notable for osteoporosis drugs (Bonalon) and a leading Japanese home-respiratory (oxygen concentrator / CPAP) business.
companies.description_zh: 帝人株式会社（东证3401）旗下制药与居家医疗事业部，重点领域为骨/关节、呼吸、康复/神经及心血管代谢；以骨质疏松药 Bonalon 及日本领先的居家呼吸（制氧机／CPAP）业务著称。

companies.description_en: One of Brazil's three largest pharmaceutical companies and 100% Brazilian-owned, with branded-prescription, OTC, dermocosmetic and phytomedicine portfolios manufactured across five domestic plants; remains privately held after prior multi-billion-dollar acquisition interest from global pharma.
companies.description_zh: 巴西三大制药企业之一，100% 巴西本土控股，业务涵盖品牌处方药、OTC、皮肤美容及植物药，在国内拥有五座工厂；尽管曾引发跨国药企数十亿美元收购兴趣，仍保持非上市独立运营。

companies.description_en: Leading South African pharmaceutical manufacturer (JSE:AIP) founded in 1890, with branded prescription, OTC, hospital (renal/critical care) and consumer divisions; majority-controlled by Bidvest. M&A flag: in 2025 NATCO Pharma agreed to acquire the minority shares not held by Bidvest via a scheme of arrangement.
companies.description_zh: 南非领先制药企业（约堡交易所 AIP），成立于1890年，业务涵盖品牌处方药、OTC、医院（肾科/重症）及消费品，由 Bidvest 控股。并购提示：2025年印度 NATCO Pharma 同意通过安排方案收购 Bidvest 以外的少数股东股份。

companies.description_en: One of Egypt's largest manufacturers/exporters of branded human and veterinary pharmaceuticals (flagship products Hibiotic, Antinal, Alphintern); acquired by Abu Dhabi sovereign fund ADQ from Bausch Health for ~USD 740m in 2021, now an ADQ healthcare-portfolio company.
companies.description_zh: 埃及最大的品牌人用及兽用药生产/出口商之一（旗舰产品 Hibiotic、Antinal、Alphintern）；2021年由阿布扎比主权基金 ADQ 以约7.4亿美元从 Bausch Health 收购，现为 ADQ 医疗投资组合企业。

sources.title: ADQ to acquire Amoun Pharmaceutical — ADQ newsroom
Bausch Health sells Amoun for $740m — Yahoo Finance

companies.description_en: Biolab (Biolab Sanus Farmacêutica) is one of Brazil's largest privately held prescription-pharma companies, a market leader in cardiology and dermatology with three industrial units in São Paulo state plus R&D centers in Brazil and Canada.
companies.description_zh: 百欧莱（Biolab Sanus Farmacêutica）是巴西最大的私营处方药企之一，在心血管与皮肤科领域居市场领先地位，在圣保罗州拥有三个生产基地，并在巴西和加拿大设有研发中心。

companies.description_en: Chemo is the industrial (API and generics) arm of Argentine-founded multinational Insud Pharma, which also spans branded pharma (Exeltis) and biotech (biosimilars maker mAbxience and vaccine producer Sinergium Biotech), operating in more than 50 countries.
companies.description_zh: Chemo 是阿根廷创办的跨国集团 Insud Pharma 的工业（原料药与仿制药）板块；集团还涵盖品牌药（Exeltis）与生物技术（生物类似药企业 mAbxience 及疫苗企业 Sinergium Biotech），业务遍及 50 多个国家。

companies.description_en: Cristália is a vertically integrated Brazilian chemical-pharmaceutical company, Latin America's leader in anesthetics and narcotic analgesics, with its own API synthesis, ~130 patents and a growing biopharmaceutical portfolio.
companies.description_zh: 克里斯塔利亚是一家垂直整合的巴西化学制药公司，为拉美麻醉剂与麻醉镇痛药市场领导者，自主合成原料药，拥有约 130 项专利及不断扩大的生物制药产品组合。

companies.description_en: EMS is Brazil's largest pharmaceutical company by revenue and a generics pioneer, part of family-owned Grupo NC (Carlos Sanchez); in October 2024 it proposed a merger with Hypera Pharma that would create Brazil's largest drugmaker.
companies.description_zh: EMS 是巴西按营收计最大的制药企业、仿制药先驱，隶属家族企业 Grupo NC（Carlos Sanchez）；2024 年 10 月提出与 Hypera Pharma 合并，若成将打造巴西最大制药商。

sources.title: EMS proposes merger with Hypera - GaBI Online

companies.description_en: Hikma is a Jordan-founded, London-listed (FTSE 250) multinational generics and injectables leader, and one of the largest suppliers of generic injectable medicines to US hospitals; founded by Samih Darwazah in Amman in 1978.
companies.description_zh: 希克玛是一家约旦创办、伦敦上市（富时 250 指数）的跨国仿制药与注射剂龙头，也是美国医院仿制注射药的最大供应商之一；由 Samih Darwazah 于 1978 年在安曼创立。

companies.description_en: Laboratorio Pablo Cassará is a family-owned Argentine pharma-biotech founded in 1948, notable for ~30 years of applied biotech R&D spanning vaccines, monoclonal antibodies, probiotics and cancer immunotherapy platforms; it has developed seven biotechnological medicines.
companies.description_zh: 巴勃罗·卡萨拉实验室是阿根廷家族企业，创立于 1948 年，以约 30 年的应用生物技术研发著称，涵盖疫苗、单克隆抗体、益生菌及癌症免疫治疗平台，已开发七款生物技术药物。

companies.description_en: Laboratorios Bagó is a vertically integrated Argentine pharmaceutical group founded in 1934 by Sebastián Bagó, one of Latin America's most prominent pharma houses with a presence in over 50 countries spanning oncology, cardiology, neurology and rare diseases.
companies.description_zh: 巴戈实验室是阿根廷垂直整合的制药集团，由 Sebastián Bagó 于 1934 年创立，是拉美最知名的制药企业之一，业务遍及 50 多个国家，涵盖肿瘤、心血管、神经及罕见病领域。

companies.description_en: Libbs Farmacêutica is a major Brazilian branded-prescription manufacturer founded in 1958, notable for heavy biotech investment including Biotec, the first industrial-scale monoclonal-antibody (biosimilars) plant in Brazil, at its Embu das Artes complex.
companies.description_zh: 利布斯制药是巴西主要的品牌处方药制造商，创立于 1958 年，以巨额生物技术投资著称，其位于 Embu das Artes 的工业园区内建有巴西首个工业规模单克隆抗体（生物类似药）工厂 Biotec。

companies.description_en: Megalabs is one of Latin America's largest home-grown biopharmaceutical groups, with operations across more than 20 countries, ~1,800 products and 18 manufacturing plants; it is affiliated with Argentina's Roemmers ownership family.
companies.description_zh: 美佳莱是拉丁美洲最大的本土生物制药集团之一，业务遍及20多个国家，拥有约1,800种产品和18家生产工厂，与阿根廷罗默斯家族控股关联。

sources.title: Megalabs: Playing Among Giants in LatAm - PharmaBoardroom

companies.description_en: Pharco is one of Egypt's and the MENA region's largest privately owned pharmaceutical manufacturers, globally notable for developing low-cost hepatitis-C cures (sofosbuvir/ravidasvir brands such as Gratisovir) that supported Egypt's national HCV elimination program.
companies.description_zh: 法尔科是埃及及中东北非地区最大的私营制药企业之一，因开发低价丙肝治愈药物（如Gratisovir）并支撑埃及国家丙肝消除计划而享誉全球。

companies.description_en: Grupo Roemmers is Argentina's largest domestic pharmaceutical company and the fifth-largest player overall in Latin America and the Caribbean, with a broad branded and generic portfolio built over a century since its 1921 founding.
companies.description_zh: 罗默斯集团是阿根廷最大的本土制药企业，也是拉美及加勒比地区整体排名第五的制药公司，自1921年创立以来积累了广泛的品牌和仿制药组合。

sources.title: Grupo Roemmers Case Study - World Bank / IFC

companies.description_en: Tabuk Pharmaceuticals is one of Saudi Arabia's leading pharmaceutical companies, present in 20+ markets across the Middle East and Africa with several Western in-licensing partnerships; it is a wholly owned subsidiary of Tadawul-listed Astra Industrial Group (acquired 2006).
companies.description_zh: 塔布克制药是沙特阿拉伯领先的制药企业之一，业务遍及中东和非洲20多个市场，并拥有多项西方授权合作；它是在沙特证券交易所上市的Astra工业集团的全资子公司（2006年收购）。

companies.description_en: Tecnofarma is a broad Latin American pharmaceutical manufacturer headquartered in Montevideo, focused on generics and oncology/immunology specialty products and operating commercial organizations across more than a dozen LatAm countries, with in-licensing deals such as Astellas' enzalutamide.
companies.description_zh: 泰诺法玛是一家总部位于蒙得维的亚的泛拉美制药企业，专注于仿制药及肿瘤/免疫专科产品，在十多个拉美国家设有商业机构，并拥有如安斯泰来恩杂鲁胺等授权合作。

sources.title: Astellas Signs Distribution Agreement With Tecnofarma - PR Newswire
Pharmaceuticals in Latin America and the Caribbean - World Bank

companies.description_en: mAbxience is a Spanish biosimilar monoclonal-antibody developer and CDMO, founded as Insud Pharma's biotech division; Fresenius Kabi acquired a 55% majority stake for ~EUR 495M in 2022, and the firm supplies globally distributed biosimilars (rituximab, bevacizumab, denosumab) with plants in Spain and Argentina.
companies.description_zh: 曼比申是一家西班牙生物类似药单抗开发商兼CDMO，源自Insud Pharma的生物技术部门；2022年Fresenius Kabi以约4.95亿欧元收购其55%控股权，公司在西班牙和阿根廷设厂，向全球供应生物类似药（利妥昔单抗、贝伐珠单抗、地舒单抗）。

sources.title: Fresenius Kabi buys a majority stake in mAbxience
Insud Pharma and Fresenius Kabi combine efforts - mAbxience

companies.description_en: Adcentrx is a clinical-stage San Diego biotech building next-generation antibody-drug conjugates via its proprietary i-Conjugation platform; lead candidate ADRX-0706 is a Nectin-4 ADC (DAR 8) with FDA Fast Track for cervical cancer, backed by a $51M Series A+.
companies.description_zh: Adcentrx是位于圣地亚哥的临床阶段生物技术公司，利用其专有i-Conjugation平台开发新一代抗体偶联药物；主打候选药物ADRX-0706是靶向Nectin-4的ADC（DAR 8），获FDA宫颈癌快速通道认定，已完成5,100万美元A+轮融资。

sources.title: Adcentrx Announces Extension of Series A+ Financing to $51 Million
Adcentrx Granted Fast Track Designation for ADRX-0706 Nectin-4 ADC

companies.description_en: CDR-Life is a Swiss clinical-stage immuno-oncology biotech developing antibody-based MHC-targeting T-cell engagers; lead program CDR404 is a first-in-class dual MAGE-A4 T-cell engager for solid tumors, funded by a $76M Series A from Jeito Capital, RA Capital and Omega Funds.
companies.description_zh: CDR-Life是一家瑞士临床阶段免疫肿瘤生物技术公司，开发基于抗体的MHC靶向T细胞衔接器；主打项目CDR404是首创的双MAGE-A4 T细胞衔接器，用于实体瘤，由Jeito Capital、RA Capital和Omega Funds提供7,600万美元A轮融资。

sources.title: CDR-Life Announces $76 Million Raised in Series A Funding
CDR-Life Preparing for Phase I Testing of MAGE-A4 T-Cell Engager

companies.description_en: Clinical/commercial-stage oncology company built on a proprietary switch-control kinase inhibitor platform, with Qinlock (ripretinib) approved for fourth-line GIST and Romvimza (vimseltinib) approved for tenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT). Acquired by Japan's Ono Pharmaceutical in 2024 for ~$2.4 billion ($25.60/share).
companies.description_zh: 基于专有开关控制激酶抑制剂平台的临床/商业阶段肿瘤公司，旗下Qinlock（ripretinib）获批用于四线胃肠间质瘤（GIST），Romvimza（vimseltinib）获批用于腱鞘巨细胞瘤（TGCT）。2024年被日本小野制药以约24亿美元（每股25.60美元）收购。

sources.title: FDA approves Ono's rare tumor drug from $2.4B Deciphera buyout

companies.description_en: Cell-therapy company that won FDA approval for Amtagvi (lifileucel), the first approved tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy and the first cell therapy for a solid tumor (advanced melanoma), launched February 2024; it also markets Proleukin (IL-2).
companies.description_zh: 细胞治疗公司，旗下Amtagvi（lifileucel）于2024年2月上市，是首个获批的肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（TIL）疗法、也是首个用于实体瘤（晚期黑色素瘤）的细胞疗法；同时销售Proleukin（IL-2）。

sources.title: Iovance cuts staff amid slow sales start for TIL cell therapy

companies.description_en: Biopharma pioneer in polymer-conjugate and cytokine engineering whose lead candidate rezpegaldesleukin (a regulatory-T-cell-stimulating IL-2 conjugate) advanced into Phase 2b for atopic dermatitis and alopecia areata; it earns substantial collaboration/royalty revenue from partnered programs.
companies.description_zh: 在聚合物偶联与细胞因子工程领域的生物制药先驱，主打候选药物rezpegaldesleukin（一种刺激调节性T细胞的IL-2偶联物）已进入特应性皮炎和斑秃的2b期临床；并通过合作/特许权项目获得可观收入。

sources.title: Nektar Q4 and Full Year 2024 Financial Results

companies.description_en: Rare-disease and oncology biopharma with Ogsiveo (nirogacestat) approved for desmoid tumors and Gomekli (mirdametinib) for NF1-associated plexiform neurofibromas. Acquired by Germany's Merck KGaA in July 2025 for an enterprise value of ~$3.4 billion (~$3.9B equity, $47/share).
companies.description_zh: 专注罕见病与肿瘤的生物制药公司，Ogsiveo（nirogacestat）获批治疗硬纤维瘤，Gomekli（mirdametinib）获批治疗NF1相关丛状神经纤维瘤。2025年7月被德国默克（Merck KGaA）以约34亿美元企业价值（约39亿美元股权、每股47美元）收购。

sources.title: Merck KGaA Completes Acquisition of SpringWorks
Merck KGaA's Rare Tumor Strategy - $3.9B SpringWorks Acquisition

companies.description_en: Clinical/commercial-stage oncology company targeting RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers; in May 2025 won FDA approval for the Avmapki Fakzynja co-pack (avutometinib, a RAF/MEK clamp, plus the FAK inhibitor defactinib) for KRAS-mutated recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer.
companies.description_zh: 针对RAS/MAPK通路驱动型癌症的临床/商业阶段肿瘤公司；2025年5月其Avmapki Fakzynja组合包（avutometinib——RAF/MEK钳制剂，与FAK抑制剂defactinib联用）获FDA批准用于KRAS突变复发性低级别浆液性卵巢癌。

sources.title: Verastem Q4 and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

companies.description_en: Clinical-stage immuno-oncology biotech developing tumor-activated (masked) cytokines, antibodies, bispecifics and immune-cell engagers designed to localize anti-tumor activity in the tumor microenvironment and limit systemic toxicity; it licensed its tumor-activated IL-12 program to Gilead in 2024.
companies.description_zh: 临床阶段免疫肿瘤生物技术公司，开发肿瘤激活（掩蔽）型细胞因子、抗体、双特异性抗体及免疫细胞接合器，旨在将抗肿瘤活性局限于肿瘤微环境、降低全身毒性；2024年将其肿瘤激活IL-12项目授权给吉利德。

sources.title: Gilead and Xilio License Agreement for Tumor-Activated IL-12

companies.description_en: World's largest dedicated eye-care company, split between Surgical (cataract/vitreoretinal/refractive equipment, intraocular lenses) and Vision Care (contact lenses, ocular health). Spun off from Novartis as an independent listed company in 2019.
companies.description_zh: 全球最大的专业眼科护理公司，业务分为外科（白内障/玻璃体视网膜/屈光设备、人工晶状体）与视力保健（隐形眼镜、眼部健康）。2019年从诺华分拆并独立上市。

companies.description_en: Leading medical-technology company (majority-owned by the Carl Zeiss Group / Zeiss Foundation) in ophthalmic diagnostics, refractive and cataract laser systems, intraocular lenses, and surgical microscopes for neuro/ENT surgery. Reported revenue of EUR 2.23 billion in fiscal year 2024/25.
companies.description_zh: 领先的医疗技术公司（由卡尔蔡司集团/蔡司基金会控股），业务涵盖眼科诊断、屈光与白内障激光系统、人工晶状体，以及用于神经/耳鼻喉外科的手术显微镜。2024/25财年营收22.3亿欧元。

sources.title: Carl Zeiss Meditec Annual Report FY 2024/25
Carl Zeiss Meditec Reports Revenue Growth for FY 2024-2025

companies.description_en: Dentsply Sirona is the world's largest manufacturer of professional dental products and technologies, spanning imaging systems, CAD/CAM (CEREC), implants, orthodontics, endodontics and consumables. Formed by the 2016 merger of Dentsply (1889) and Sirona (1877), it serves dental practices and labs in over 150 countries.
companies.description_zh: 登士柏西诺德是全球最大的专业牙科产品与技术制造商，业务涵盖影像系统、CAD/CAM（CEREC）、种植体、正畸、牙髓治疗及耗材。由登士柏（1889）与西诺德（1877）于2016年合并而成，服务150多个国家的牙科诊所与技工所。

companies.description_en: DermTech pioneered non-invasive molecular skin-cancer testing via an adhesive patch that collects skin RNA/DNA to assess melanoma risk (the DermTech Melanoma Test). The original Nasdaq-listed company (DMTK) filed Chapter 11 in June 2024 and was delisted; its assets were acquired in August 2024 and the business was revived as a small private 'DermTech 2.0' continuing to process the test.
companies.description_zh: DermTech 开创了无创分子皮肤癌检测，通过粘贴式贴片采集皮肤RNA/DNA以评估黑色素瘤风险（DermTech黑色素瘤检测）。原纳斯达克上市公司（DMTK）于2024年6月申请破产保护并退市，其资产于2024年8月被收购，业务以小型私有的“DermTech 2.0”形式重生并继续提供该检测。

companies.description_en: Envista Holdings is a global dental products group spun off from Danaher in 2019, organized around Specialty Products & Technologies (Nobel Biocare implants, Ormco/Spark clear aligners) and Equipment & Consumables (KaVo, DEXIS imaging). It is one of the largest dental device companies worldwide.
companies.description_zh: 恩维斯塔是2019年从丹纳赫分拆出来的全球牙科产品集团，业务分为专业产品与技术（Nobel Biocare种植体、Ormco/Spark隐形矫治器）以及设备与耗材（KaVo、DEXIS影像）。它是全球最大的牙科器械公司之一。

companies.description_en: EssilorLuxottica is the global leader in ophthalmic optics and eyewear, formed by the 2018 merger of France's Essilor (lenses: Varilux, Transitions, Stellest) and Italy's Luxottica (frames/retail: Ray-Ban, Oakley, Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters). It is vertically integrated from lens manufacturing to retail and is expanding into smart eyewear and myopia management.
companies.description_zh: 依视路陆逊梯卡是全球眼视光与眼镜行业的领导者，由法国依视路（镜片：Varilux、Transitions、Stellest）与意大利陆逊梯卡（镜架/零售：雷朋、Oakley、Sunglass Hut、亮视点）于2018年合并而成。公司从镜片制造到零售实现垂直整合，并正拓展智能眼镜与近视管理业务。

companies.description_en: EyePoint Pharmaceuticals develops sustained-delivery retinal therapeutics built on its Durasert bioerodible insert platform. Its lead candidate DURAVYU (vorolanib + Durasert E) is in global Phase 3 trials for wet AMD and Phase 2 for diabetic macular edema, with ~$371M cash funding the program into 2027.
companies.description_zh: EyePoint制药基于其Durasert可降解缓释植入物平台开发视网膜缓释疗法。主打候选药物DURAVYU（vorolanib + Durasert E）正处于湿性年龄相关性黄斑变性的全球三期临床及糖尿病性黄斑水肿的二期临床，约3.71亿美元现金可支撑项目运营至2027年。

companies.description_en: Glaukos is the pioneer of micro-invasive glaucoma surgery (MIGS), best known for its iStent family of trabecular micro-bypass stents, the smallest medical devices ever approved by the FDA. It is expanding into corneal health (iLink cross-linking for keratoconus) and ophthalmic pharmaceuticals (iDose TR sustained-release implant).
companies.description_zh: 格劳克斯是微创青光眼手术（MIGS）的开创者，以其iStent系列小梁微旁路支架闻名，这是FDA批准的最小医疗器械。公司正拓展至角膜健康（治疗圆锥角膜的iLink交联）及眼科药物（iDose TR缓释植入物）领域。

companies.description_en: Harrow is a U.S. eyecare-focused pharmaceutical company that commercializes branded ophthalmic products including IHEEZO (chloroprocaine ocular surface anesthetic) and VEVYE (cyclosporine for dry eye), alongside a large portfolio of compounded ophthalmic formulations via ImprimisRx. It posted record 2024 revenue of ~$200M, up over 50%.
companies.description_zh: Harrow 是一家专注于眼科的美国制药公司，商业化销售品牌眼科产品，包括IHEEZO（氯普鲁卡因眼表麻醉剂）和VEVYE（治疗干眼症的环孢素），并通过ImprimisRx提供大量复方眼科制剂。2024年营收创纪录约2亿美元，增长逾50%。

companies.description_en: Henry Schein is the world's largest distributor of healthcare products and services to office-based dental and medical practitioners, also supplying veterinary and specialty markets plus dental practice-management software and corporate brands. A Fortune 500 company founded in 1932, it operates across more than 30 countries.
companies.description_zh: 汉瑞祥是全球最大的向诊所牙科和医疗从业者分销医疗健康产品与服务的公司，同时供应兽医及专科市场，并提供牙科诊所管理软件及自有品牌。这家成立于1932年的财富500强企业业务遍及30多个国家。

companies.description_en: Hoya is a Japanese technology and medical group whose Life Care segment is a world leader in eyeglass lenses (Hoya Vision), intraocular lenses, and endoscopy products, alongside an Information Technology segment supplying optical glass and EUV photomask blanks for semiconductors. It is one of the largest global makers of optical and ophthalmic products.
companies.description_zh: 豪雅是日本科技与医疗集团，其生命护理部门是眼镜镜片（豪雅视觉）、人工晶状体及内窥镜产品的全球领导者，同时其信息技术部门为半导体行业供应光学玻璃和EUV光罩基板。它是全球最大的光学与眼科产品制造商之一。

companies.description_en: Ivoclar (formerly Ivoclar Vivadent) is a privately held, family-owned Liechtenstein company that is a global leader in premium dental materials, ceramics, and CAD/CAM systems, best known for its IPS e.max lithium-disilicate glass-ceramic and Programat ceramic furnaces. Founded in Zurich in 1923, it serves customers in 130 countries.
companies.description_zh: 义获嘉（原义获嘉伟瓦登特）是一家列支敦士登私营家族企业，是高端牙科材料、陶瓷及CAD/CAM系统的全球领导者，以其IPS e.max二硅酸锂玻璃陶瓷和Programat陶瓷炉闻名。公司1923年创立于苏黎世，业务遍及130个国家。

companies.description_en: Lensar is a US ophthalmic medical-device company that develops femtosecond laser systems for cataract surgery, anchored by its ALLY Robotic Laser Cataract System, which reached roughly 23% US market share by end-2025. A planned acquisition by Alcon was terminated in 2025, leaving Lensar independent.
companies.description_zh: 莱莎是一家美国眼科医疗器械公司，开发用于白内障手术的飞秒激光系统，核心产品为ALLY机器人激光白内障手术系统，2025年底美国市场份额约23%。其与爱尔康的拟收购交易于2025年终止，公司维持独立运营。

companies.description_en: Nidek is a privately held Japanese manufacturer of ophthalmic, optometric, and lens-edging equipment, with a broad portfolio spanning intraocular lenses, cataract surgery systems, laser photocoagulators, OCT systems, fundus cameras, and optical biometers. It is one of Japan's leading global ophthalmic device makers.
companies.description_zh: 尼德克是一家日本私营企业，生产眼科、验光及镜片磨边设备，产品涵盖人工晶状体、白内障手术系统、激光光凝仪、OCT系统、眼底相机和光学生物测量仪。它是日本领先的全球眼科器械制造商之一。

companies.description_en: Nikon is a Japanese optics and imaging conglomerate whose Healthcare Business (about JPY116bn revenue in FY2025) includes ophthalmic instruments, retinal imaging via its Optos subsidiary (ultra-widefield imaging), microscopes, and cell-biology/bioscience tools. It also makes cameras and semiconductor/FPD lithography equipment.
companies.description_zh: 尼康是一家日本光学与成像企业集团，其医疗保健业务（2025财年营收约1160亿日元）涵盖眼科仪器、通过子公司Optos提供的视网膜超广角成像、显微镜及细胞生物学/生命科学工具。集团同时生产相机及半导体/平板显示光刻设备。

companies.description_en: Ocular Therapeutix is a US biopharmaceutical company developing sustained-release ophthalmic therapies based on its ELUTYX bioresorbable hydrogel platform. Its commercial product DEXTENZA (dexamethasone insert) treats post-surgical inflammation, while lead candidate AXPAXLI (axitinib intravitreal implant) is in Phase 3 for wet AMD and diabetic retinopathy.
companies.description_zh: 眼力健治疗是一家美国生物制药公司，基于其ELUTYX可生物降解水凝胶平台开发缓释眼科疗法。其上市产品DEXTENZA（地塞米松植入剂）用于治疗术后炎症，主打候选药AXPAXLI（阿昔替尼玻璃体内植入剂）正处于湿性AMD和糖尿病视网膜病变的3期临床。

companies.description_en: Patterson Companies is a major value-added specialty distributor serving US/Canadian dental supply markets and US/Canadian/UK animal-health markets. It was taken private in April 2025 by Patient Square Capital in a roughly US$4.1 billion ($31.35/share) all-cash deal, delisting from Nasdaq.
companies.description_zh: 帕特森公司是一家大型增值型专业分销商，服务于美国/加拿大牙科用品市场及美国/加拿大/英国动物健康市场。2025年4月，公司被Patient Square Capital以约41亿美元（每股31.35美元）全现金收购私有化，从纳斯达克退市。

sources.title: Patterson completes acquisition by Patient Square Capital

companies.description_en: RxSight is a US ophthalmic medical-device company that markets the only FDA-approved Light Adjustable Lens (LAL/LAL+) system, allowing a patient's intraocular lens power to be non-invasively fine-tuned after cataract surgery using its Light Delivery Device. It generated about $134.5 million in revenue in 2025.
companies.description_zh: 锐视是一家美国眼科医疗器械公司，销售唯一获FDA批准的可调光人工晶状体（LAL/LAL+）系统，可在白内障手术后通过其光照投递装置无创微调晶状体度数。公司2025年营收约1.345亿美元。

companies.description_en: STAAR Surgical makes the EVO family of implantable collamer lenses (ICLs) for refractive vision correction, having sold over 3 million ICLs across 75+ countries. In 2025 it agreed to be acquired by Alcon for $30.75 per share in cash (an amended deal), a transaction pending close.
companies.description_zh: 视达康（STAAR Surgical）生产 EVO 系列植入式胶原蛋白晶体（ICL）用于屈光矫正，已在 75 多个国家销售逾 300 万枚 ICL。2025 年公司同意被爱尔康（Alcon）以每股 30.75 美元现金收购（经修订），交易尚待完成。

sources.title: Alcon Agrees to Acquire STAAR Surgical

companies.description_en: Sight Sciences is an eyecare medtech focused on minimally-invasive glaucoma surgery via its OMNI Surgical System and dry-eye disease via its TearCare device. FY2024 revenue was $79.9M (Surgical Glaucoma $75.9M, Dry Eye $4.0M).
companies.description_zh: 视界科学（Sight Sciences）是一家眼科医疗器械公司，主打用于微创青光眼手术的 OMNI 系统及用于干眼症的 TearCare 设备。2024 财年营收 7,990 万美元（青光眼手术 7,590 万、干眼 400 万）。

companies.description_en: Tarsus Pharmaceuticals is an eyecare biotech whose lead product Xdemvy (lotilaner ophthalmic solution) is the first FDA-approved treatment for Demodex blepharitis. First full launch year FY2024 net product sales reached $180.1M, with a growing pipeline in Lyme prevention and rosacea.
companies.description_zh: 塔尔苏斯制药（Tarsus Pharmaceuticals）是一家眼科生物技术公司，核心产品 Xdemvy（洛替拉纳滴眼液）是首个获 FDA 批准治疗蠕形螨睑缘炎的药物。首个完整上市年（2024 财年）净销售额达 1.801 亿美元，并在莱姆病预防、玫瑰痤疮等方向拓展管线。

companies.description_en: The Cooper Companies is a global medical device maker operating two units: CooperVision, a top-three global contact lens maker (MyDay, Biofinity), and CooperSurgical in women's health and fertility. FY2024 (ended Oct 31, 2024) revenue was about $3.90B with CooperVision at $2.61B.
companies.description_zh: 库博光学（The Cooper Companies）是全球性医疗器械公司，旗下两大业务：全球前三大隐形眼镜制造商 CooperVision（MyDay、Biofinity），以及妇女健康与生殖领域的 CooperSurgical。2024 财年（截至 2024 年 10 月 31 日）营收约 39 亿美元，其中 CooperVision 达 26.1 亿美元。

companies.description_en: Topcon is a Japanese precision instruments maker and a global leader in ophthalmic imaging and screening devices (3D fundus imaging, OCT, fundus cameras, slit lamps, tonometers) alongside positioning and surveying businesses. FY2024 sales were about JPY 211B; in 2025 it agreed to a management buyout backed by KKR and JIC Capital (~$2.3B), taking the company private and delisting from the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
companies.description_zh: 拓普康（Topcon）是日本精密仪器制造商，在眼科成像与筛查设备（3D 眼底成像、OCT、眼底相机、裂隙灯、眼压计）领域居全球领先，同时经营定位与测量业务。2024 财年销售约 2,110 亿日元；2025 年公司同意由 KKR 与 JIC Capital 支持的管理层收购（约 23 亿美元），将私有化并从东京证券交易所退市。

sources.title: Topcon Management Buyout with KKR and JIC Capital

companies.description_en: Aktis Oncology develops targeted alpha-emitting radiopharmaceuticals using a proprietary miniprotein platform delivering actinium-225 (225Ac) to solid tumors. Its lead Nectin-4 radioconjugate AKY-1189 received FDA Fast Track for metastatic urothelial cancer; the company raised a $175M Series B in 2024 and went public in early 2026 via an upsized ~$318M IPO (2026's first biotech IPO).
companies.description_zh: 阿克提斯肿瘤（Aktis Oncology）基于专有微型蛋白平台开发靶向阿尔法放射性药物，将锕-225（225Ac）递送至实体瘤。其核心 Nectin-4 放射偶联药物 AKY-1189 获 FDA 治疗转移性尿路上皮癌的快速通道资格；公司 2024 年完成 1.75 亿美元 B 轮，并于 2026 年初通过约 3.18 亿美元的扩大 IPO 上市（2026 年首个生物技术 IPO）。

sources.title: Aktis FDA Fast Track for AKY-1189
Aktis raises $318M in 2026's first biotech IPO

companies.description_en: Ariceum Therapeutics is a Berlin-based clinical-stage radiopharma developing satoreotide, an SSTR2-targeting peptide paired with lutetium-177 and actinium-225 payloads as a theranostic for SSTR2-expressing cancers such as small cell lung cancer, Merkel cell carcinoma and neuroendocrine tumours. Backed by EQT Life Sciences and HealthCap, it is a well-funded European radiopharma with a Phase I/II SANTANA-225 program cleared by the FDA.
companies.description_zh: 阿瑞塞姆疗法（Ariceum Therapeutics）是一家总部位于柏林的临床阶段放射性药物公司，开发 satoreotide——一种靶向 SSTR2 的肽，与镥-177 和锕-225 放射载荷配对，作为针对小细胞肺癌、默克尔细胞癌、神经内分泌肿瘤等 SSTR2 阳性癌症的诊疗一体化方案。公司由 EQT Life Sciences 与 HealthCap 支持，是资金充裕的欧洲放射药企，其 SANTANA-225 一/二期项目已获 FDA 批准。

companies.name_en: Cardinal Health Nuclear & Precision Health Solutions
companies.name_zh: 康德乐核医学与精准健康解决方案
companies.description_en: Cardinal Health's Nuclear & Precision Health Solutions operates the largest US radiopharmacy network—roughly 130 nuclear pharmacies plus 30+ PET and manufacturing sites—manufacturing, compounding and delivering radiopharmaceuticals for nuclear imaging and theranostics. It is a reporting operating segment of Cardinal Health (NYSE: CAH), investing heavily (~$150M+) in cyclotron and isotope capacity.
companies.description_zh: 康德乐（Cardinal Health）核医学与精准健康解决方案部门运营着全美最大的放射性药房网络——约 130 家核药房及 30 多个 PET 与生产基地，负责生产、调配并配送用于核成像与诊疗的放射性药物。它是康德乐（纽交所代码 CAH）的报告运营分部，并大举投资（逾 1.5 亿美元）扩建回旋加速器与同位素产能。

sources.title: Cardinal Health Nuclear & Precision Health Solutions

companies.description_en: Curium is one of the world's largest nuclear medicine companies, formed in 2017 from the merger of IBA Molecular and Mallinckrodt Nuclear Medicine, supplying SPECT/PET diagnostic and therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals to over 14 million patients per year across 70+ countries. It develops, manufactures and distributes radiopharmaceutical products with a growing focus on cancer therapy.
companies.description_zh: 居里制药是全球最大的核医学公司之一，2017年由IBA Molecular与Mallinckrodt核医学业务合并而成，每年为70多个国家逾1400万患者提供SPECT/PET诊断与治疗用放射性药物，并日益聚焦肿瘤治疗。

sources.title: IBA Molecular and Mallinckrodt Merge to Become Curium

companies.description_en: Eckert & Ziegler SE is a leading global supplier of medical isotopes, radioactive sources, generators and radiopharma CDMO services, operating across radiopharmaceuticals and medical segments. In FY2024 it grew revenue ~20% to EUR 295.9M on strong radiopharma demand.
companies.description_zh: 埃克特-齐格勒（Eckert & Ziegler SE）是全球领先的医用同位素、放射源、发生器及放射性药物CDMO服务供应商，业务横跨放射性药物与医疗两大板块；2024财年受放射性药物需求强劲推动，营收增长约20%至2.959亿欧元。

companies.description_en: Fusion Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage developer of next-generation actinium-225 radioconjugates for cancer, with lead program FPI-2265 targeting PSMA in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. AstraZeneca completed its ~USD 2.4B acquisition (USD 2B upfront plus USD 400M milestone) of Fusion in June 2024, delisting it.
companies.description_zh: Fusion Pharmaceuticals是一家临床阶段公司，开发新一代锕-225放射偶联物用于肿瘤治疗，主打项目FPI-2265靶向PSMA治疗转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌。阿斯利康于2024年6月完成对其约24亿美元的收购（20亿美元预付+4亿美元里程碑），公司随之退市。

sources.title: Fusion to be Acquired by AstraZeneca (PR Newswire)

companies.name_zh: ITM同位素技术慕尼黑公司
companies.description_en: ITM Isotope Technologies Munich SE is a leading radiopharmaceutical biotech and a major global supplier of non-carrier-added Lutetium-177 (Lu-177) and Actinium-225 (Ac-225), supporting both its own therapeutic/diagnostic pipeline and the broader industry. It is one of the world's key n.c.a. Lu-177 sources for targeted radionuclide therapy.
companies.description_zh: ITM同位素技术慕尼黑公司（ITM SE）是领先的放射性药物生物技术企业，也是全球主要的非载体添加镥-177（Lu-177）和锕-225（Ac-225）供应商，既支撑自身治疗/诊断管线，也服务整个行业，是全球靶向放射性核素治疗的关键n.c.a. Lu-177来源之一。

companies.description_en: Jubilant Radiopharma is the US radiopharma business of India's Jubilant Pharmova, operating 43 SPECT radiopharmacies and three PET manufacturing facilities and delivering over 3 million doses annually to 1,800+ providers — the second-largest radiopharmaceutical network in the USA. It manufactures and distributes diagnostic and therapeutic isotopes and radiopharmaceuticals.
companies.description_zh: 朱比兰放射药业是印度Jubilant Pharmova在美国的放射性药物业务，运营43家SPECT放射药房和3家PET生产基地，每年向1800多家医疗机构供应逾300万剂，是美国第二大放射性药物网络，从事诊断与治疗用同位素及放射性药物的制造与分销。

companies.description_en: Lantheus Holdings (NASDAQ: LNTH) is the leading US radiopharmaceutical company, whose PYLARIFY PSMA-PET prostate-cancer imaging agent surpassed USD 1B in net sales to become the first blockbuster radiodiagnostic. It reported worldwide revenue of USD 1.53B for full-year 2024.
companies.description_zh: 蓝瑟斯控股（NASDAQ: LNTH）是美国领先的放射性药物公司，其PYLARIFY PSMA-PET前列腺癌显像剂净销售额突破10亿美元，成为首个放射诊断领域的重磅产品；2024全年全球营收达15.3亿美元。

sources.title: Lantheus Q4 and Full Year 2024 Results

companies.name_zh: 北极星医用放射性同位素公司
companies.description_en: NorthStar Medical Radioisotopes is a commercial-stage US nuclear medicine company and the first domestic producer in ~30 years of Molybdenum-99 (Mo-99) via a non-uranium process, plus customized radiopharmaceutical development services. It is positioned to become a leading commercial-scale producer of non-carrier-added Actinium-225 (Ac-225) and Copper-67 (Cu-67).
companies.description_zh: 北极星医用放射性同位素公司是美国一家商业化阶段核医学企业，采用非铀工艺成为近30年来美国首家本土钼-99（Mo-99）生产商，并提供定制放射性药物开发服务，同时正打造成为非载体添加锕-225（Ac-225）和铜-67（Cu-67）的领先商业化生产商。

companies.description_en: Nusano is a privately held physics company building supply stability into the undersupplied medical radioisotope market, operating a 190,000-sq-ft Salt Lake City facility capable of producing 40+ radioisotopes including n.c.a. Lu-177, Ac-225, Cu-67 and Cu-64. It raised a Series C of over USD 115M in 2024 from backers including S32, Verily, Wasatch Group and the American Cancer Society's BrightEdge, with isotope supply deals signed with Clarity, Ratio Therapeutics and Cellectar.
companies.description_zh: 努萨诺（Nusano）是一家私有物理学公司，致力于为供应不足的医用放射性同位素市场带来供给稳定性，在盐湖城运营一座19万平方英尺的工厂，可生产40余种放射性同位素，包括n.c.a. Lu-177、Ac-225、Cu-67和Cu-64。2024年完成超1.15亿美元C轮融资，投资方包括S32、Verily、Wasatch Group及美国癌症协会BrightEdge，并与Clarity、Ratio Therapeutics、Cellectar等签署同位素供应协议。

sources.title: Nusano Announces Series C of over $115M
Nusano debuts radioisotope production plant (Fierce Pharma)

companies.description_en: Norbrook is one of the world's largest privately owned veterinary pharmaceutical companies, founded in 1969 by Lord Ballyedmond in Newry, Northern Ireland, manufacturing antibiotics, anti-inflammatories, parasiticides and injectables for farm and companion animals across more than 100 countries.
companies.description_zh: 诺伯克是全球最大的私人持股兽药企业之一，1969年由Ballyedmond勋爵在北爱尔兰纽里创立，研发并生产抗生素、抗炎药、驱虫药及注射剂等农场与伴侣动物用药，产品销往100多个国家。

companies.description_en: Phibro Animal Health is a US-based diversified animal health and mineral nutrition company supplying medicated feed additives, vaccines, anti-infectives, anthelmintics and nutritional specialties for livestock; fiscal 2025 net sales reached $1.30B after acquiring Zoetis's medicated feed additive portfolio.
companies.description_zh: 菲布罗动物保健是美国一家多元化动物保健与矿物营养公司，为畜禽提供药物饲料添加剂、疫苗、抗感染药、驱虫药及营养专用品；收购硕腾药物饲料添加剂业务后，2025财年净销售额达13亿美元。

companies.description_en: Pulike Biological Engineering, based in Luoyang and founded in 2002, is a leading Chinese veterinary biologics and chemical-drug company developing swine, poultry, ruminant and companion-animal vaccines; 2024 revenue was RMB1.04B, down on weak downstream livestock demand while its pet segment grew.
companies.description_zh: 普莱柯生物工程位于洛阳，成立于2002年，是中国领先的兽用生物制品与化药企业，研发猪、禽、反刍及宠物用疫苗；2024年营收10.43亿元，受下游养殖需求疲弱影响有所下滑，但宠物板块成增长引擎。

sources.title: 普莱柯 2024年度财报解读 — 大畜牧网

companies.description_en: Shandong Sinder Technology, founded in 1999 in Weifang, supplies a full range of animal-health products — veterinary biologics (vaccines, antibodies), traditional Chinese veterinary medicines, chemical drugs and feed additives; 2024 revenue was about RMB982M and it ranked ninth among domestic Chinese animal-health firms, filing for a Hong Kong listing in early 2026.
companies.description_zh: 山东信得科技1999年成立于潍坊，提供全系列动物保健产品，涵盖兽用生物制品（疫苗、抗体）、中兽药、化药制剂及饲料添加剂；2024年营收约9.82亿元，按收入计列中国本土动保企业第九，2026年初递表港交所。

sources.title: 信得科技递表港交所 — 东方财富
信得科技冲刺港股 — 东方财富

companies.description_en: Tianjin Ringpu Bio-Technology, founded in 1998, is a leading Chinese veterinary biologics maker producing poultry and livestock vaccines, diagnostics, chemical drugs and feed additives, and is expanding into companion-animal health; 2024 revenue rose 13.3% to RMB3.07B.
companies.description_zh: 天津瑞普生物技术成立于1998年，是中国领先的兽用生物制品企业，生产禽用与畜用疫苗、诊断试剂、化药及饲料添加剂，并向宠物动保拓展；2024年营收同比增长13.3%至30.70亿元。

sources.title: 瑞普生物 2024年营收30.70亿元 — 新浪财经
瑞普生物 2024年年度报告摘要

companies.description_en: Vetoquinol is a family-controlled French veterinary pharmaceutical group founded in 1933 and listed on Euronext Paris since 2006, innovating medicines and non-medicated products for companion and farm animals; 2024 revenue was €539.2M with €58.7M net income.
companies.description_zh: 威隆药业是法国家族控股的兽药集团，1933年创立，2006年起在泛欧巴黎交易所上市，为伴侣动物与农场动物研发药品及非药品；2024年营收5.392亿欧元，净利润5870万欧元。

companies.description_en: Virbac is an independent French animal-health company founded in 1968 by veterinarian Pierre-Richard Dick in Carros near Nice, devoted exclusively to animal health with vaccines, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics and nutrition; 2024 revenue grew 12.1% to €1,397.5M, boosted by the Globion (India) and Sasaeah (Japan) acquisitions.
companies.description_zh: 维克是法国独立的动物保健公司，1968年由兽医Pierre-Richard Dick在尼斯附近的卡罗创立，专注动物健康，提供疫苗、药品、诊断与营养产品；2024年营收增长12.1%至13.975亿欧元，受益于收购印度Globion与日本Sasaeah。

companies.description_en: ANI Pharmaceuticals is a US specialty and generics manufacturer headquartered in Baudette, Minnesota, founded in 1996, anchored by its rare-disease Purified Cortrophin Gel franchise and an ophthalmology portfolio (ILUVIEN, YUTIQ) plus branded and generic products; full-year 2024 total net revenues were about $614M.
companies.description_zh: ANI制药是美国专科与仿制药制造商，总部位于明尼苏达州博德特，成立于1996年，核心为罕见病产品Purified Cortrophin Gel及眼科组合（ILUVIEN、YUTIQ），并涵盖品牌与仿制药；2024全年净营收约6.14亿美元。

companies.description_en: POINT Biopharma was a radioligand therapy company developing Lutetium-177 PSMA (PNT2002 for prostate cancer) and SSTR2 (PNT2003) radiopharmaceuticals plus large-scale radioisotope manufacturing in Indianapolis. Eli Lilly acquired it for approximately $1.4B (~$12.50/share) in December 2023; it now operates as Lilly's radiopharmaceutical hub.
companies.description_zh: POINT 生物制药曾是放射性配体疗法公司，在印第安纳波利斯开发镥-177 PSMA（前列腺癌 PNT2002）和 SSTR2（PNT2003）放射性药物并具备大规模放射性同位素生产能力。礼来于2023年12月以约14亿美元（约每股12.50美元）收购，现作为礼来放射性药物中心运营。

sources.title: Lilly Completes Acquisition of POINT Biopharma

companies.description_en: Perspective Therapeutics is a clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company pioneering Lead-212 (Pb-212) targeted alpha therapy, with a proprietary lead-specific chelator enabling paired SPECT imaging (Pb-203) and therapy; lead asset [212Pb]VMT-α-NET targets neuroendocrine tumors. Formed February 2023 from Viewpoint Molecular Targeting's reverse merger with Isoray; Lantheus is a strategic investor (up to 19.9% stake) and option holder.
companies.description_zh: 视角疗法是临床阶段放射性药物公司，专注铅-212（Pb-212）靶向α疗法，拥有专有铅特异性螯合剂，可配对 SPECT 成像（Pb-203）与治疗；主打资产 [212Pb]VMT-α-NET 靶向神经内分泌肿瘤。2023年2月由 Viewpoint Molecular Targeting 反向并购 Isoray 而成；Lantheus 为战略投资者（持股至多19.9%）及选择权持有方。

sources.title: Lantheus Strategic Agreements with Perspective Therapeutics

companies.description_en: Ratio Therapeutics is a privately held Boston radiopharmaceutical company founded June 2022 by Jack Hoppin and John Babich, advancing next-generation precision radiotherapies for solid tumors via its Trillium and Macropa platforms. Backed by ~$90M across seed/Series A/Series B financing, with funded collaborations with Bayer and Lantheus and a Novartis SSTR2 license/collaboration worth up to $745M (announced Nov 2024).
companies.description_zh: 瑞蒂奥疗法是位于波士顿的私营放射性药物公司，由 Jack Hoppin 和 John Babich 于2022年6月创立，借助 Trillium 与 Macropa 平台推进面向实体瘤的新一代精准放射疗法。累计融资约9000万美元（种子/A轮/B轮），与拜耳、Lantheus 有资金支持的合作，并于2024年11月与诺华达成总额最高7.45亿美元的 SSTR2 许可与合作。

sources.title: Novartis inks $745M radiopharma partnership with Ratio

companies.description_en: Inozyme Pharma was a clinical-stage rare-disease biopharma targeting the PPi-Adenosine pathway regulating bone and blood-vessel health, with lead enzyme replacement therapy INZ-701 for ENPP1 Deficiency. BioMarin acquired it for $4.00/share (~$270M all-cash), completing July 1, 2025; Phase 3 pivotal data expected early 2026.
companies.description_zh: Inozyme 制药曾是临床阶段罕见病生物制药公司，靶向调控骨骼与血管健康的 PPi-腺苷通路，主打 ENPP1 缺乏症的酶替代疗法 INZ-701。BioMarin 以每股4.00美元（约2.7亿美元全现金）收购，于2025年7月1日完成；三期关键数据预计2026年初公布。

sources.title: BioMarin Strengthens Enzyme Therapy Business with Acquisition of Inozyme

companies.description_en: Larimar Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech developing nomlabofusp (CTI-1601), a first-in-class mitochondrial frataxin protein replacement therapy for Friedreich's ataxia, a rare progressive neurodegenerative disease. FDA granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation in Feb 2026; a rolling BLA targeting accelerated approval was planned for June 2026.
companies.description_zh: Larimar 疗法是临床阶段生物技术公司，开发 nomlabofusp（CTI-1601）——一种首创的线粒体 frataxin 蛋白替代疗法，用于治疗罕见进行性神经退行性疾病 Friedreich 共济失调。FDA 于2026年2月授予突破性疗法认定；计划2026年6月启动以加速批准为目标的滚动 BLA 提交。

sources.title: Larimar Receives Breakthrough Therapy Designation for Nomlabofusp

companies.description_en: Rocket Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage gene therapy company developing AAV and lentiviral therapies for rare devastating diseases. Its first commercial product, KRESLADI (lentiviral gene therapy for severe leukocyte adhesion deficiency-I), won FDA accelerated approval in 2026; cardiovascular pipeline includes Danon disease, PKP2-ACM and BAG3-DCM. Operationally founded 2015; public via 2018 reverse merger with Inotek; sold a priority review voucher for $180M in 2026.
companies.description_zh: Rocket 制药是商业化阶段基因治疗公司，开发针对罕见严重疾病的 AAV 与慢病毒疗法。首个商业化产品 KRESLADI（用于严重白细胞黏附缺陷-I 的慢病毒基因疗法）于2026年获 FDA 加速批准；心血管管线包括 Danon 病、PKP2-ACM 与 BAG3-DCM。2015年运营成立，2018年通过反向并购 Inotek 上市；2026年以1.8亿美元出售优先审评券。

sources.title: Rocket Announces FDA Approval of KRESLADI
Rocket and Inotek Complete Merger Transaction

companies.description_en: Solid Biosciences is a clinical-stage gene therapy company focused on Duchenne muscular dystrophy and other neuromuscular/cardiac diseases. Its lead candidate SGT-003 uses a rationally designed AAV-SLB101 capsid to deliver R16-R17 nNOS-binding microdystrophin; the Phase 1/2 INSPIRE DUCHENNE and Phase 3 IMPACT DUCHENNE trials are underway, with FDA Fast Track, Orphan and Rare Pediatric Disease designations.
companies.description_zh: Solid 生物科学是临床阶段基因治疗公司，专注杜氏肌营养不良症及其他神经肌肉/心脏疾病。主打候选药 SGT-003 采用合理设计的 AAV-SLB101 衣壳递送含 R16-R17 nNOS 结合域的微抗肌萎缩蛋白；1/2 期 INSPIRE DUCHENNE 与3期 IMPACT DUCHENNE 试验进行中，已获 FDA 快速通道、孤儿药及罕见儿科疾病认定。

sources.title: Solid Biosciences Doses First Participant in Phase 3 IMPACT DUCHENNE

companies.description_en: Taysha is a clinical-stage biotech developing AAV-based gene therapies for severe monogenic CNS diseases; its lead candidate TSHA-102 (intrathecal MECP2) is in pivotal Phase 1/2-3 evaluation for Rett syndrome and holds FDA Breakthrough Therapy, RMAT, Fast Track and Orphan Drug designations.
companies.description_zh: Taysha是一家临床阶段生物技术公司，开发针对严重单基因中枢神经系统疾病的AAV基因疗法；其主导候选药物TSHA-102（鞘内注射MECP2）正处于Rett综合征的关键性临床试验阶段，并获得FDA突破性疗法、RMAT、快速通道及孤儿药资格认定。

sources.title: FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation for TSHA-102

companies.description_en: Vera Therapeutics is a late-clinical-stage biotech advancing atacicept, a dual APRIL/BAFF inhibitor, with positive Phase 3 ORIGIN data in IgA nephropathy; its BLA received FDA priority review with a PDUFA date of July 2026 and held ~$714.6M cash at end-2025.
companies.description_zh: Vera Therapeutics是一家临床后期生物技术公司，开发APRIL/BAFF双重抑制剂atacicept，其在IgA肾病的三期ORIGIN研究取得积极数据；生物制品许可申请已获FDA优先审评，PDUFA日期为2026年7月，2025年底持有约7.146亿美元现金。

companies.description_en: Zevra Therapeutics is a commercial-stage rare-disease company whose lead product Miplyffa (arimoclomol) was FDA-approved in September 2024 for Niemann-Pick disease type C; FY2025 net revenue reached $106.5M (with $87.4M from Miplyffa) and the company turned profitable with $83.2M net income.
companies.description_zh: Zevra Therapeutics是一家商业阶段罕见病公司，其主导产品Miplyffa（arimoclomol）于2024年9月获FDA批准用于C型尼曼-匹克病；2025财年净收入达1.065亿美元（其中Miplyffa贡献8740万美元），并实现盈利，净利润8320万美元。

companies.description_en: Akoya Biosciences is a spatial biology / spatial proteomics company offering the PhenoImager and PhenoCycler (CODEX) tissue phenotyping platforms; it was acquired by Quanterix in an all-stock merger that closed in 2025, becoming a Quanterix subsidiary and delisting from Nasdaq.
companies.description_zh: Akoya生物科学是一家空间生物学/空间蛋白质组学公司，提供PhenoImager和PhenoCycler（CODEX）组织表型分析平台；2025年被Quanterix以全股票方式收购完成合并，成为Quanterix子公司并从纳斯达克退市。

companies.description_en: Cytiva is Danaher's flagship bioprocessing business (formed from GE Healthcare Life Sciences, acquired by Danaher for ~$21B in 2020), supplying instruments, consumables and services for biopharma manufacturing; in 2023 Danaher merged Pall's life-sciences business into Cytiva to create a ~$7.5B bioprocessing leader with ~16,000 associates.
companies.description_zh: 思拓凡（Cytiva）是丹纳赫旗下旗舰生物工艺业务（前身为GE医疗生命科学，2020年被丹纳赫以约210亿美元收购），为生物制药生产提供仪器、耗材与服务；2023年丹纳赫将Pall生命科学业务并入思拓凡，组建约75亿美元营收、约1.6万名员工的生物工艺龙头。

companies.description_en: Gilson is a family-owned scientific instrument manufacturer best known for the PIPETMAN adjustable-volume pipette (the first on the market, patented 1972); it also makes automated liquid handlers, purification systems, fraction collectors and SPE systems, with its PIPETMAN line produced at Gilson SAS near Paris.
companies.description_zh: Gilson是一家家族企业科学仪器制造商，以PIPETMAN可调量程移液器（市场首款，1972年获专利）闻名；公司还生产自动化液体处理器、纯化系统、馏分收集器和固相萃取系统，PIPETMAN产品线在巴黎附近的Gilson SAS生产。

companies.description_en: HORIBA, Ltd. is a Japanese precision-instruments maker spanning Automotive, Process & Environmental, Medical-Diagnostic, Semiconductor and Scientific segments; it holds roughly 80% of the global automotive emissions-measurement market and supplies hematology and clinical-chemistry diagnostic systems, with FY2024 revenue of ¥317.4B.
companies.description_zh: 堀场制作所是日本精密测量分析仪器制造商，业务横跨汽车、流程与环境、医疗诊断、半导体及科学仪器五大板块；其在全球汽车尾气测量市场占有约80%份额，并提供血液学和临床化学诊断系统，2024财年营收3173.7亿日元。

companies.description_en: Hamilton Company is a privately held global manufacturer of precision automated liquid-handling robots, syringes, process measurement sensors and automated sample-storage systems, serving pharmaceutical, clinical-diagnostic, academic and government laboratories worldwide.
companies.description_zh: 哈美顿（Hamilton Company）是一家私营全球制造商，生产精密自动化液体处理机器人、注射器、过程测量传感器及自动化样本存储系统，服务于全球制药、临床诊断、学术及政府实验室。

companies.description_en: Wholly owned Hitachi Ltd subsidiary supplying analytical instruments, electron microscopes, clinical chemistry analyzers and semiconductor manufacturing/inspection systems. A global leader in scientific and diagnostic instrumentation; clinical analyzer technology is widely OEM-licensed (e.g. to Roche).
companies.description_zh: 日立株式会社全资子公司，提供分析仪器、电子显微镜、临床生化分析仪及半导体制造/检测系统。全球科学与诊断仪器领导者，其临床分析仪技术广泛对外OEM授权（如罗氏）。

companies.description_en: Leading manufacturer of custom DNA/RNA oligonucleotides and CRISPR genome-editing reagents, shipping tens of thousands of custom oligos daily worldwide. Acquired by Danaher in March 2018 for ~$1.9B; operates within Danaher's Life Sciences segment and is expanding into MRD (minimal residual disease) solutions.
companies.description_zh: 全球领先的定制DNA/RNA寡核苷酸及CRISPR基因编辑试剂制造商，每日向全球发运数万条定制寡核苷酸。2018年3月被丹纳赫以约19亿美元收购，归入其生命科学板块，并正扩展至MRD（微小残留病）解决方案。

companies.description_en: Tokyo-listed maker of electron microscopes (TEM/SEM), NMR and mass spectrometers, electron-beam lithography systems and clinical chemistry analyzers. A global pioneer in electron optics; built Japan's first commercial TEM (JEM-1) in 1950.
companies.description_zh: 东京上市的电子显微镜（TEM/SEM）、核磁共振仪、质谱仪、电子束光刻系统及临床生化分析仪制造商。电子光学领域的全球先驱，1950年制造出日本首台商用透射电镜JEM-1。

companies.description_en: Single-cell multi-omics company whose Tapestri platform simultaneously profiles DNA, protein and targeted gene expression from the same cell, targeting measurable residual disease (MRD) in cancer. Raised a $70M Series C in 2020 led by Novo Growth (total >$120M) and secured further equity in 2025 led by Ally Bridge Group; backers include Mayfield, Agilent and Soleus.
companies.description_zh: 单细胞多组学公司，其Tapestri平台可在同一细胞中同步分析DNA、蛋白及靶向基因表达，聚焦癌症的可测量残留病（MRD）。2020年完成由Novo Growth领投的7000万美元C轮（累计超1.2亿美元），2025年再获Ally Bridge Group领投股权融资；投资方包括Mayfield、Agilent与Soleus。

companies.description_en: Functional single-cell biology company formed in 2023 from the merger of Berkeley Lights and IsoPlexis; products include the Beacon optofluidic platform and IsoLight/IsoSpark proteomics systems. Acquired by Bruker in 2023 for ~$108M (all-cash, $1.00/share), becoming Bruker's entry into functional single-cell research solutions.
companies.description_zh: 功能性单细胞生物学公司，2023年由Berkeley Lights与IsoPlexis合并而成；产品包括Beacon光流控平台及IsoLight/IsoSpark蛋白质组学系统。2023年被布鲁克以约1.08亿美元（全现金、每股1.00美元）收购，成为布鲁克进入功能性单细胞研究领域的入口。

companies.description_en: Privately held maker of more than 4,000 molecular biology reagents, enzymes and assays spanning genomics, protein analysis, cellular analysis, drug discovery and forensic/genetic-identity kits. Founded 1978 by Bill Linton; serves ~100 countries via offices in 16 countries.
companies.description_zh: 私营企业，提供超过4,000种分子生物学试剂、酶和检测产品，覆盖基因组学、蛋白分析、细胞分析、药物发现及法医/遗传身份鉴定试剂盒。1978年由Bill Linton创立，通过16个国家的办事处服务约100个国家。

companies.description_en: Nasdaq-listed maker of the Simoa (Single Molecule Array) ultra-sensitive protein detection platform, enabling biomarker quantification up to ~1,000x more sensitive than conventional immunoassays, widely used in neurodegeneration (e.g. Alzheimer's pTau) research. Founded 2007 by David Walt and Nicholas Naclerio.
companies.description_zh: 纳斯达克上市公司，开发Simoa（单分子阵列）超灵敏蛋白检测平台，灵敏度较传统免疫分析高约1,000倍，广泛用于神经退行性疾病（如阿尔茨海默病pTau）生物标志物研究。2007年由David Walt与Nicholas Naclerio创立。

companies.description_en: UK laboratory-automation specialist in low-volume liquid handling and sample prep, with the mosquito, dragonfly and firefly product lines spanning nanoliter-to-milliliter dispensing. Spun out of TTP Group in 1997; acquired by EQT Private Equity from Battery Ventures in 2022 for ~GBP 650M.
companies.description_zh: 英国实验室自动化专家，专注微量液体处理与样品制备，旗下mosquito、dragonfly、firefly产品线覆盖纳升至毫升级分液。1997年从TTP集团分拆；2022年EQT私募股权以约6.5亿英镑从Battery Ventures手中收购。

sources.title: EQT to acquire SPT Labtech for GBP 650M

companies.description_en: Kyoto-based maker of analytical and measuring instruments including chromatography (HPLC/GC), mass spectrometers, and spectroscopy systems, plus medical imaging and industrial equipment. Founded 1875, it is one of the world's leading analytical-instrument vendors widely used across pharma R&D, QC, and clinical labs.
companies.description_zh: 总部位于京都的分析与测量仪器制造商，产品涵盖色谱（HPLC/GC）、质谱、光谱系统，以及医疗影像与工业设备。创立于1875年，是全球领先的分析仪器供应商之一，广泛应用于制药研发、质控和临床实验室。

companies.description_en: Global provider of mission-critical, outsourced sterilization, lab testing, and advisory services for healthcare via three brands — Sterigenics (gamma/EO/E-beam sterilization), Nordion (Cobalt-60 supply), and Nelson Labs (microbiology/lab testing). 2025 net revenues reached $1.164B; it is the dominant outsourced sterilization player for the medtech and pharma industries.
companies.description_zh: 通过三大品牌为医疗行业提供关键的外包灭菌、实验室检测与咨询服务：Sterigenics（伽马/环氧乙烷/电子束灭菌）、Nordion（钴-60供应）和Nelson Labs（微生物/实验室检测）。2025年净营收达11.64亿美元，是医疗器械与制药行业最主要的外包灭菌服务商。

companies.description_en: Privately held spatial-biology firm commercializing the MERSCOPE platform based on MERFISH single-cell spatial transcriptomics. In late 2024 it merged with multiplex-proteomics company Ultivue to form a combined spatial multi-omics player; backed by ARCH Venture Partners, Northpond Ventures, Tao Capital, and M Ventures (Merck KGaA), with a $48M financing announced January 2026.
companies.description_zh: 私营空间生物学公司，基于MERFISH单细胞空间转录组技术推出MERSCOPE平台。2024年末与多重蛋白质组学公司Ultivue合并，组建空间多组学联合体；投资方包括ARCH Venture Partners、Northpond Ventures、Tao Capital及M Ventures（默克KGaA），并于2026年1月宣布4800万美元融资。

sources.title: Vizgen to Merge With Ultivue, Series D — GenomeWeb

companies.description_en: Amneal is a diversified US pharmaceutical company spanning affordable generics, specialty branded drugs and a growing biosimilars franchise (Alymsys, Releuko, Fylnetra), plus the AvKARE distribution arm. Founded in 2002 by brothers Chirag and Chintu Patel, it is one of the largest US generic-drug makers by prescription volume with ~$3.0B in 2025 net revenue.
companies.description_zh: Amneal 是一家多元化美国制药企业，业务涵盖平价仿制药、特色品牌药及不断壮大的生物类似药组合（Alymsys、Releuko、Fylnetra），并拥有 AvKARE 分销部门。公司由 Patel 兄弟于 2002 年创立，是美国按处方量计最大的仿制药企业之一，2025 年净收入约 30 亿美元。

companies.description_en: Amphastar is a US specialty maker of complex injectable and inhalation products and difficult-to-make generics, including enoxaparin, glucagon, epinephrine and an insulin biosimilar pipeline. Vertically integrated with its own API manufacturing, it reported ~$720M in 2025 net revenue and $98M net income.
companies.description_zh: Amphastar 是一家美国特色药企，专注于复杂注射剂、吸入剂及难仿制药，包括依诺肝素、胰高血糖素、肾上腺素及胰岛素生物类似药管线。公司纵向整合自有原料药生产，2025 年净收入约 7.2 亿美元，净利润 9,800 万美元。

companies.description_en: Bioeq AG is a Swiss biosimilars licensing and commercialisation joint venture, now wholly held within the Formycon/Polpharma Biologics orbit, that owns FYB201 — ranibizumab biosimilar to Lucentis, marketed as Cimerli (US), Ranivisio (EU) and Ongavia (UK). It out-licenses commercialisation to partners such as Sandoz and Teva.
companies.description_zh: Bioeq AG 是一家瑞士生物类似药授权与商业化合资公司，现归属于 Formycon／Polpharma Biologics 体系，拥有 FYB201——Lucentis 的雷珠单抗生物类似药，商品名为 Cimerli（美国）、Ranivisio（欧盟）和 Ongavia（英国），并将商业化权益授权给 Sandoz、Teva 等合作伙伴。

companies.description_en: Once a leading US biosimilars company (Udenyca, Cimerli, Yusimry), Coherus fully divested its biosimilar franchises across 2024-2025 — including the $558M Udenyca sale to Intas in April 2025 — to reinvent itself as a focused immuno-oncology innovator now branded Coherus Oncology. Its lead asset is the FDA-approved PD-1 inhibitor LOQTORZI (toripalimab), alongside the IL-27 antagonist casdozokitug and CCR8 antibody CHS-114.
companies.description_zh: Coherus 曾是美国领先的生物类似药企业（Udenyca、Cimerli、Yusimry），但在 2024–2025 年间完全剥离了生物类似药业务——包括 2025 年 4 月以 5.58 亿美元将 Udenyca 出售给 Intas——转型为专注免疫肿瘤的创新企业（更名 Coherus Oncology）。核心产品为已获 FDA 批准的 PD-1 抑制剂 LOQTORZI（特瑞普利单抗），并推进 IL-27 拮抗剂 casdozokitug 与 CCR8 抗体 CHS-114。

companies.description_en: Fresenius Kabi is the biopharma, clinical-nutrition and medical-device arm of German healthcare group Fresenius SE, generating more than EUR 8.6B in 2025 revenue. Its growing Biopharma unit develops and markets biosimilars including Idacio (adalimumab), Tyenne (tocilizumab), Otulfi (ustekinumab) and denosumab biosimilars Conexxence/Bomyntra, alongside a large IV-generics and parenteral-nutrition portfolio.
companies.description_zh: Fresenius Kabi 是德国医疗集团 Fresenius SE 旗下的生物制药、临床营养与医疗器械部门，2025 年收入超过 86 亿欧元。其不断扩张的生物制药部门开发并销售生物类似药，包括 Idacio（阿达木单抗）、Tyenne（托珠单抗）、Otulfi（乌司奴单抗）及地舒单抗生物类似药 Conexxence／Bomyntra，同时拥有庞大的静脉仿制药与肠外营养产品组合。

companies.description_en: Hetero is a privately held Indian generics and active-pharmaceutical-ingredient giant founded in 1993 by Dr. B. Parthasaradhi Reddy, and the world's largest producer of antiretroviral drugs. It runs a broad biosimilars portfolio (rituximab, trastuzumab, adalimumab) and employs over 22,000 people across API, generics, branded generics and custom manufacturing.
companies.description_zh: Hetero 是一家私营印度仿制药与原料药巨头，由 B. Parthasaradhi Reddy 博士于 1993 年创立，是全球最大的抗逆转录病毒药物生产商。公司拥有广泛的生物类似药组合（利妥昔单抗、曲妥珠单抗、阿达木单抗），在原料药、仿制药、品牌仿制药及定制生产领域雇佣超过 22,000 名员工。

sources.title: Interview with Dr. B. Parthasaradhi Reddy (PharmaBoardroom)

companies.description_en: Lannett is one of the oldest US generic-drug makers, which filed a prepackaged Chapter 11 in May 2023 and emerged in June 2023 as a privately held company under its prepetition lenders, cutting debt by ~$600M. It is advancing a biosimilar insulin glargine (co-developed with the HEC Group) and insulin aspart toward commercialisation. (Status: delisted from NYSE; emerged from bankruptcy private.)
companies.description_zh: Lannett 是美国最古老的仿制药企业之一，于 2023 年 5 月提交预包装第 11 章破产，并于 2023 年 6 月在债权人控股下作为私营公司重组退出，削减约 6 亿美元债务。公司正推进与 HEC 集团联合开发的甘精胰岛素生物类似药及门冬胰岛素走向商业化。（状态：已从纽交所退市，破产重组后转为私营。）

companies.description_en: Polpharma Biologics is a Polish end-to-end biosimilars developer and CDMO (cell line to finished product) headquartered in Gdansk, part of the Polpharma Group. It developed Tyruko (natalizumab) — the first FDA- and EU-approved biosimilar for multiple sclerosis, commercialised by Sandoz — plus ranibizumab and other monoclonal-antibody programs.
companies.description_zh: Polpharma Biologics 是一家波兰端到端（从细胞系到成品）生物类似药开发商兼 CDMO，总部位于格但斯克，隶属 Polpharma 集团。公司开发了 Tyruko（那他珠单抗）——首个获 FDA 与欧盟批准用于多发性硬化症的生物类似药，由 Sandoz 商业化——并推进雷珠单抗等单克隆抗体项目。

sources.title: Polpharma Biologics confirms US launch of Tyruko
Polpharma Biologics: The Polish Biosimilar Powerhouse
Sandoz launches Tyruko in the US (Contract Pharma)

companies.description_en: Sandoz is the world's leading generics and biosimilars company, spun off from Novartis as an independent listed firm on the SIX Swiss Exchange in October 2023; it traces its heritage to the original Sandoz chemical works founded in Basel in 1886. It posted USD 10.4B in 2024 net sales, with biosimilars rising to roughly 28% of revenue on the back of products like Hyrimoz.
companies.description_zh: 山德士是全球领先的仿制药与生物类似药企业，2023年10月从诺华分拆并在瑞士证券交易所独立上市，其品牌可追溯至1886年在巴塞尔创立的山德士化工厂。2024年净销售额达104亿美元，生物类似药（如Hyrimoz）占比升至约28%。

companies.description_en: Adragos Pharma is a fast-consolidating European drug-product CDMO built on a buy-and-build strategy, backed by FSN Capital and Germany's Prange Group. Since 2020 it has acquired legacy sites from Sanofi (Kawagoe, Japan), Fresenius Kabi (Halden, Norway), Lamda Laboratories (Greece) and Swiss fill-finish specialist Baccinex, assembling a multi-site sterile and oral manufacturing platform.
companies.description_zh: 阿德拉戈斯制药是一家快速整合的欧洲药物制剂CDMO，采用并购扩张策略，由FSN Capital与德国Prange集团支持。自2020年成立以来，它收购了赛诺菲（日本川越）、费森尤斯卡比（挪威哈尔登）、Lamda实验室（希腊）及瑞士灌装专家Baccinex等遗留产能，构建了多基地无菌与口服制剂生产平台。

sources.title: Adragos snaps up Swiss CDMO Baccinex (FiercePharma)
FSN Capital VI & Prange Group: Accelerating Adragos Pharma Growth

companies.description_en: Ajinomoto Bio-Pharma Services (Aji Bio-Pharma) is a fully integrated global CDMO formed in 2018 by combining Ajinomoto Althea (San Diego) and Belgium's OmniChem; it provides small-molecule API, biologics drug substance, oligonucleotide synthesis and aseptic fill-finish. It is a wholly owned unit of Japan's Ajinomoto Co. (TSE: 2802), giving it notable scale within the food-and-amino-acid group's healthcare arm.
companies.description_zh: 味之素生物制药服务（Aji Bio-Pharma）是2018年由味之素Althea（圣地亚哥）与比利时OmniChem合并组建的全球一体化CDMO，提供小分子原料药、生物药原液、寡核苷酸合成及无菌灌装服务。它是日本味之素株式会社（东证：2802）的全资子公司，是其健康业务的重要组成部分。

sources.title: Ajinomoto Althea and OmniChem Combine to Form Aji Bio-Pharma

companies.description_en: Allucent is a mid-size, full-service specialty CRO focused on supporting small and emerging biotech sponsors, formed in January 2022 by merging CATO SMS with Pharm-Olam. Backed by Water Street Healthcare Partners and JLL Partners, it operates roughly 35 offices across North America, Latin America, Europe, India and the Middle East with over 1,200 staff.
companies.description_zh: 安路森是一家中型全方位专业CRO，专注于服务中小及新兴生物技术公司，于2022年1月由CATO SMS与Pharm-Olam合并组建。公司由Water Street Healthcare Partners与JLL Partners支持，在北美、拉美、欧洲、印度和中东设有约35个办事处，员工超1200人。

sources.title: CATO SMS and Pharm-Olam Merge to Create Global Leader

companies.description_en: Aragen Life Sciences (formerly GVK BIO, founded 2001 in Hyderabad) is a leading Indian integrated discovery-to-manufacturing CRO/CDMO serving 450+ global life-sciences customers across small and large molecules. Goldman Sachs took a significant minority stake in 2021, joining ChrysCapital as the company scaled its discovery, development and manufacturing platform.
companies.description_zh: 阿拉根生命科学（前身为GVK BIO，2001年创立于海得拉巴）是印度领先的从药物发现到生产的一体化CRO/CDMO，服务全球450余家生命科学客户，覆盖大小分子。2021年高盛入股取得重要少数股权，与ChrysCapital共同支持其发现、开发与生产平台的扩张。

sources.title: Goldman Sachs Invests in Aragen Life Sciences

companies.description_en: Asahi Kasei's bioprocess business is a globally notable bioprocessing supplier and CDMO arm of Asahi Kasei Corp (TSE: 3407), best known for Planova virus-removal filters, MOTIV inline buffer formulation and oligonucleotide-synthesis hardware. It expanded into biologics CDMO via the 2022 acquisition of U.S.-based Bionova Scientific and into viral-safety/mycoplasma testing through ViruSure (Austria) and Bionique (U.S.).
companies.description_zh: 旭化成的生物工艺业务是旭化成株式会社（东证：3407）旗下全球知名的生物工艺供应商及CDMO板块，以Planova病毒去除滤膜、MOTIV在线缓冲液配制系统及寡核苷酸合成设备著称。通过2022年收购美国Bionova Scientific进入生物药CDMO领域，并借ViruSure（奥地利）与Bionique（美国）拓展病毒安全与支原体检测服务。

sources.title: Asahi Kasei enters CDMO biz with Bionova buy
Asahi Kasei Life Science begins operation

companies.description_en: BioSpring is a leading independent oligonucleotide CDMO founded in 1997 in Frankfurt, manufacturing GMP DNA/RNA APIs for antisense, siRNA and gene-editing therapeutics, with roughly 600 staff and nine commercial oligonucleotide products supported. It is investing about USD 150M in a new high-tech manufacturing facility in Offenbach, its largest metric-ton capacity expansion to date.
companies.description_zh: 百思普林是1997年创立于法兰克福的领先独立寡核苷酸CDMO，为反义、siRNA及基因编辑疗法生产GMP级DNA/RNA原料药，员工约600人，支持九款商业化寡核苷酸产品。公司正投资约1.5亿美元在奥芬巴赫建设新型高科技生产基地，是其迄今最大的吨级产能扩张。

sources.title: CDMO BioSpring looks to dominate DNA, RNA API production

companies.description_en: Caidya is a differentiated mid-size global CRO formed in 2021 by merging Shanghai-based dMed Global with North Carolina-based Clinipace, rebranded as Caidya in 2022. With over 1,600 staff across 22 countries it provides a strong US-China clinical-development bridge, and secured a USD 165M growth investment to scale its therapeutic and geographic footprint.
companies.description_zh: 凯迪亚是一家差异化的中型全球CRO，2021年由总部位于上海的dMed Global与北卡罗来纳州的Clinipace合并组建，2022年更名为Caidya。公司在22个国家拥有超1600名员工，提供有力的中美临床开发桥梁，并获得1.65亿美元增长投资以扩大其治疗领域与地域覆盖。

companies.description_en: Cellares is an Integrated Development and Manufacturing Organization (IDMO) whose flagship Cell Shuttle platform delivers walk-away, end-to-end automated CAR-T and cell-therapy production at roughly 10x the throughput of conventional CDMOs. Backed by Bristol Myers Squibb, BlackRock, Eclipse and Koch Disruptive Technologies, it has raised over $600M and is targeting an IPO around 2027.
companies.description_zh: Cellares 是一家集成开发与制造组织（IDMO），其旗舰 Cell Shuttle 平台实现 CAR-T 及细胞疗法端到端全自动化生产，产能约为传统 CDMO 的 10 倍。公司获百时美施贵宝、贝莱德、Eclipse 及 Koch Disruptive Technologies 投资，累计融资超 6 亿美元，计划于 2027 年前后上市。

sources.title: Cellares Raises $257M Series D Led by BlackRock and Eclipse
Cellares' Series D round draws $257M - FiercePharma

companies.description_en: Corning Life Sciences is the bioproduction and laboratory-consumables division of Corning Incorporated (NYSE: GLW), a leading global supplier of cell-culture vessels, media, surfaces and single-use bioprocess solutions. Parent Corning reported full-year 2024 net sales of about $13.1B; the Life Sciences segment runs roughly $0.9-1B annually.
companies.description_zh: 康宁生命科学是康宁公司（NYSE: GLW）的生物生产与实验室耗材部门，是细胞培养器皿、培养基、表面处理及一次性生物工艺方案的全球领先供应商。母公司康宁 2024 年全年净销售额约 131 亿美元，生命科学板块年营收约 9-10 亿美元。

companies.description_en: Cytel is a global biostatistics and clinical-research organization founded in 1987 by Harvard/MIT statisticians Cyrus Mehta and Nitin Patel, best known for its adaptive-trial design software (East) and statistical consulting. With ~1,900 staff across North America, Europe and Asia, it is a category leader in advanced trial design; it is backed by Nordic Capital and Astorg.
companies.description_zh: Cytel 是一家全球生物统计与临床研究机构，1987 年由哈佛/MIT 统计学家 Cyrus Mehta 与 Nitin Patel 创立，以其自适应试验设计软件（East）及统计咨询闻名。公司在北美、欧洲和亚洲拥有约 1,900 名员工，是先进试验设计领域的领导者，由 Nordic Capital 与 Astorg 控股。

companies.description_en: Donaldson Company (NYSE: DCI) is a global filtration technology leader founded in 1915 that has built a Life Sciences segment around bioprocessing via acquisitions of Solaris Biotechnology, Purilogics, Isolere Bio and Belgium's Univercells Technologies (€136M, 2023), supplying bioreactors, TFF and cell-and-gene-therapy biomanufacturing systems. Fiscal-2024 sales were about $3.6B.
companies.description_zh: 唐纳森公司（NYSE: DCI）创立于 1915 年，是全球过滤技术领导者，通过收购 Solaris Biotechnology、Purilogics、Isolere Bio 及比利时 Univercells Technologies（2023 年 1.36 亿欧元）构建了围绕生物工艺的生命科学板块，提供生物反应器、TFF 及细胞与基因疗法生产系统。2024 财年销售额约 36 亿美元。

sources.title: Donaldson Reports Record Fiscal Year 2024 Sales and Earnings

companies.description_en: Emmes is a global tech-enabled full-service CRO founded in 1977 in Rockville, MD, with deep expertise in government- and NIH/FDA/DoD-funded clinical trials spanning vaccines, infectious disease, oncology and neurology. Backed by New Mountain Capital, it has more than 1,600 employees and has run thousands of public-health studies in 70+ countries.
companies.description_zh: Emmes 是一家全球性的技术驱动型全方位 CRO，1977 年于美国马里兰州罗克维尔成立，在政府及 NIH/FDA/DoD 资助的临床试验领域具有深厚经验，涵盖疫苗、传染病、肿瘤与神经病学。公司由 New Mountain Capital 控股，拥有超过 1,600 名员工，在 70 多个国家开展了数千项公共卫生研究。

companies.description_en: Entegris (NASDAQ: ENTG) is primarily a semiconductor materials and contamination-control specialist whose life-sciences business supplies the Aramus single-use bag and fluid-handling systems used in vaccine and biologics production. The company reported about $3.24B in 2024 revenue with roughly 8,200 employees.
companies.description_zh: 恩特格里斯（NASDAQ: ENTG）主营半导体材料与污染控制，其生命科学业务提供用于疫苗及生物制剂生产的 Aramus 一次性袋及流体处理系统。公司 2024 年营收约 32.4 亿美元，员工约 8,200 人。

companies.description_en: Eppendorf SE is a family-owned German life-sciences instrument maker founded in 1945 in Hamburg, globally renowned for its pipettes, centrifuges, and DASGIP/BioFlo bioreactor and fermentation systems. It reported 2024 revenue of about €980M with 4,658 employees and remains privately held.
companies.description_zh: 艾本德（Eppendorf SE）是一家家族所有的德国生命科学仪器制造商，1945 年创立于汉堡，以移液器、离心机及 DASGIP/BioFlo 生物反应器与发酵系统享誉全球。公司 2024 年营收约 9.8 亿欧元，员工 4,658 人，仍为私人持股。

companies.description_en: George Clinical is a global, scientific-leadership-driven CRO originally spun out of Sydney's George Institute for Global Health, with a strong Asia-Pacific footprint across 9+ countries plus the UK, Europe and US. It was acquired by Hillhouse in 2022 and employs over 500 people across roughly 40 locations.
companies.description_zh: 乔治临床是一家以科学领导力驱动的全球性 CRO，最初由悉尼乔治全球健康研究所分拆而来，在亚太 9 个以上国家及英国、欧洲、美国拥有强大布局。公司于 2022 年被高瓴资本收购，在约 40 个地点拥有 500 多名员工。

sources.title: The George Institute sells George Clinical

companies.description_en: Hovione is a privately held, family-owned integrated CDMO globally recognized as a leader in spray drying, particle engineering and continuous tableting to enhance drug solubility and bioavailability. It operates sites across Portugal, Ireland, the US and Macau, serving innovator and generic pharma clients with API development and complex drug-product manufacturing.
companies.description_zh: 霍维恩是一家私有的家族企业型综合CDMO，以喷雾干燥、颗粒工程和连续制片技术著称，用于提升药物溶解度和生物利用度。其在葡萄牙、爱尔兰、美国和澳门设有生产基地，为创新药和仿制药客户提供原料药开发与复杂制剂生产。

companies.description_en: Novotech is a leading Asia-Pacific-focused, full-service biotech CRO supporting clinical trials across more than 30 offices in the region and North America. Majority-owned by TPG Capital Asia with strategic investment from GIC and Temasek, it is among the largest CROs specialized in early- and late-phase biotech development in APAC.
companies.description_zh: 诺洼科是一家专注于亚太地区的全方位生物科技合同研究组织（CRO），在该区域及北美设有逾30个办事处支持临床试验。公司由TPG亚洲资本控股，并获GIC和淡马锡战略投资，是亚太地区专注生物科技早期及后期开发的最大CRO之一。

sources.title: Novotech welcomes investment from GIC, Temasek, TPG

companies.description_en: PCI Pharma Services is a leading global CDMO specializing in clinical and commercial packaging, sterile fill-finish and lyophilization for innovative biotherapies, operating 38 sites across seven countries with over 7,500 employees. In July 2025 it received a strategic investment co-led by Bain Capital and existing lead investor Kohlberg, with reinvestment from Mubadala.
companies.description_zh: PCI制药服务是全球领先的CDMO，专注于创新生物疗法的临床与商业包装、无菌灌装及冻干，业务遍及七个国家38个基地，员工逾7,500人。2025年7月，公司获得由贝恩资本与现有主要投资者Kohlberg共同领投、并由穆巴达拉再投资的战略投资。

sources.title: PCI Pharma Services strategic investment - Bain Capital

companies.description_en: Premier Research is a mid-size full-service CRO headquartered in the Research Triangle (Morrisville/Durham), North Carolina, specializing in clinical development for rare disease, cell and gene therapy, oncology, neuroscience, dermatology and medical devices. It is known for its biotech-focused approach with over 90 rare-disease trials across more than 30 indications.
companies.description_zh: 普瑞研究是一家中型全方位CRO，总部位于美国北卡罗来纳州研究三角园区（Morrisville/Durham），专注于罕见病、细胞与基因疗法、肿瘤、神经科学、皮肤病及医疗器械的临床开发。公司以面向生物科技企业的服务著称，已在30多个适应症中开展逾90项罕见病试验。

companies.description_en: Saint-Gobain Life Sciences is the bioprocess and life-sciences division of French industrial group Compagnie de Saint-Gobain (Euronext Paris: SGO), a leading supplier of single-use TPE/silicone tubing, connectors, bioprocess bags, filtration and over-molded fluid-management components operating ~20 manufacturing facilities worldwide. Financials shown are for the parent group; the division's standalone figures are not separately disclosed.
companies.description_zh: 圣戈班生命科学是法国工业集团圣戈班（巴黎泛欧交易所：SGO）旗下的生物工艺与生命科学部门，是单次使用TPE/硅胶管路、连接件、生物工艺袋、过滤及包覆成型流体管理组件的领先供应商，在全球运营约20个生产基地。所列财务数据为母集团数据；该部门的独立财务未单独披露。

companies.description_en: Solventum is the US healthcare company spun off from 3M on April 1, 2024 (NYSE: SOLV, S&P 500), spanning MedSurg, dental, health information systems and purification & filtration. In early 2025 it agreed to sell its Purification & Filtration (bioprocessing membranes) business to Thermo Fisher Scientific for ~$4.1 billion, sharpening its focus on core medtech.
companies.description_zh: 速维特是3M于2024年4月1日分拆出的美国医疗保健公司（纽交所：SOLV，标普500成分股），业务涵盖外科手术、口腔、健康信息系统及纯化过滤。2025年初，公司同意以约41亿美元将其纯化与过滤（生物工艺膜）业务出售给赛默飞世尔，以聚焦核心医疗器械业务。

companies.description_en: Stevanato Group is a leading global provider of glass primary packaging (vials, cartridges, syringes), drug-delivery systems, and fill-finish/inspection engineering for pharma, biotech and life sciences, listed on the NYSE (STVN). Founded in 1949 in Italy and still family-controlled, it is one of the world's largest suppliers of pharmaceutical glass containers and integrated drug-delivery platforms.
companies.description_zh: 史蒂瓦纳托集团是全球领先的玻璃初级包装（西林瓶、卡式瓶、注射器）、给药系统及灌装-检测工程的供应商，服务于制药、生物科技与生命科学行业，在纽交所上市（STVN）。公司1949年创立于意大利，至今仍由家族控股，是全球最大的药用玻璃容器及一体化给药平台供应商之一。

companies.description_en: Univercells is a privately held Belgian biotech developing compact, intensified end-to-end biomanufacturing platforms (notably NevoLine and scale-X) to produce vaccines and viral vectors at a fraction of conventional cost. Backed by the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, the European Investment Bank, the Global Health Investment Fund and KKR's Gamma Biosciences (~EUR 50m), it spun out the CGT-focused CDMO Exothera and the bioprocess-tools firm Univercells Technologies.
companies.description_zh: 环球细胞是一家私有的比利时生物科技公司，开发紧凑、强化的端到端生物制造平台（尤以NevoLine和scale-X著称），以远低于传统的成本生产疫苗和病毒载体。公司获比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会、欧洲投资银行、全球健康投资基金及KKR旗下Gamma Biosciences（约5,000万欧元）支持，并分拆出专注细胞基因疗法的CDMO Exothera及生物工艺工具公司Univercells Technologies。

sources.title: KKR backs Belgian tech provider Univercells - European Biotechnology
Univercells wins $14m grant for low-cost measles vaccines - BioProcess Intl

companies.description_en: Veeda Clinical Research is a leading Indian contract research organization providing the full drug-development spectrum from preclinical to Phase IV, with a strong franchise in bioavailability/bioequivalence studies and access to 280+ clinical sites; it pursued a 2025 BSE/NSE IPO.
companies.description_zh: 维达临床研究是印度领先的合同研究机构（CRO），提供从临床前到IV期的全程药物开发服务，在生物利用度/生物等效性（BA/BE）研究领域优势突出，可触达280多个临床试验点，并于2025年在印度BSE/NSE上市。

companies.description_en: Veristat is a private, science-led full-service CRO and regulatory consultancy with ~30 years of experience and 100+ regulatory approvals, particularly known for rare/ultra-rare-disease and complex trials; in April 2026 it agreed to acquire Certara's regulatory and medical-writing business.
companies.description_zh: 维瑞斯塔是一家以科学为驱动的私营全方位CRO及法规咨询公司，拥有约30年经验和100多项监管批准记录，尤以罕见病/超罕见病及复杂临床试验见长；2026年4月达成收购Certara法规与医学写作业务的协议。

sources.title: Veristat to Acquire Certara's Regulatory and Medical Writing Business
Rare Disease Clinical Trial and Regulatory Submissions | Veristat

companies.description_en: Wacker Biotech is the contract-manufacturing (CDMO) arm of Wacker Chemie AG for therapeutic proteins, vaccines, pDNA and live microbials produced in microbial systems, with sites in Jena, Halle, Amsterdam and San Diego and a 2024 mRNA competence center; it is a 100%-owned subsidiary of listed Wacker Chemie (ETR:WCH).
companies.description_zh: 瓦克生物是瓦克化学（Wacker Chemie AG）旗下的合同生产（CDMO）业务，专注以微生物系统生产治疗性蛋白、疫苗、pDNA及活体微生物，拥有耶拿、哈勒、阿姆斯特丹和圣地亚哥多处基地，并于2024年设立mRNA能力中心；为上市公司瓦克化学（ETR:WCH）全资子公司。

companies.description_en: West Pharmaceutical Services is the dominant global supplier of elastomer-based closures (stoppers, seals), non-glass containment and self-injection/auto-injector delivery systems for injectable drugs and biologics, operating proprietary-products (~80% of sales) and contract-manufactured segments; FY2024 net sales were $2.335B.
companies.description_zh: 西氏制药是注射药物及生物制剂用弹性体密封件（胶塞、铝塑盖）、非玻璃包装容器及自助注射/自动注射给药系统的全球主导供应商，业务分为自有产品（约占营收80%）和合同制造两大板块；2024财年净销售额23.35亿美元。

sources.title: West Announces Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2024 Results

companies.description_en: Wilson Wolf Manufacturing makes the G-Rex (Gas Permeable Rapid Expansion) bioreactor, a widely adopted simple-and-efficient platform for expanding T cells, NK cells and other immune cells used by 800+ cell-and-gene-therapy entities; it co-founded the ScaleReady joint venture with Bio-Techne and Fresenius Kabi (2020).
companies.description_zh: 威尔逊沃尔夫制造公司生产G-Rex（气体可渗透快速扩增）生物反应器，是一种被广泛采用、简单高效的T细胞、NK细胞等免疫细胞扩增平台，已被800多家细胞与基因治疗机构使用；2020年与Bio-Techne和费森尤斯卡比共同创立ScaleReady合资公司。

sources.title: ScaleReady Launches Second Generation of Wilson Wolf G-Rex Product

companies.description_en: Worldwide Clinical Trials is a mid-size global, full-service CRO with deep therapeutic strength in CNS/neuroscience, oncology, rare disease and cardiometabolic; majority-owned by Kohlberg & Company since August 2023 (TJC retains a minority stake), it agreed in early 2026 to acquire oncology-focused CRO Catalyst Clinical Research.
companies.description_zh: 环球临床试验是一家中型全球全方位CRO，在中枢神经/神经科学、肿瘤、罕见病和心血管代谢领域治疗专长深厚；自2023年8月起由Kohlberg & Company控股（TJC保留少数股权），并于2026年初达成收购肿瘤专长CRO Catalyst Clinical Research的协议。

sources.title: Worldwide Clinical Trials Completes Recapitalization with Kohlberg & Company
Worldwide Clinical Trials to acquire Catalyst Clinical Research

companies.description_en: Burning Rock Biotech is a leading Chinese precision-oncology company applying next-generation sequencing (NGS) to cancer therapy-selection testing and early cancer detection, with NMPA-approved tumor panels; it is NASDAQ-listed (BNR) and reported FY2024 revenue of ~RMB 515.8M.
companies.description_zh: 燃石医学是中国领先的精准肿瘤学公司，将二代测序（NGS）技术应用于癌症用药选择检测和癌症早筛，拥有NMPA批准的肿瘤检测Panel；在纳斯达克上市（BNR），2024财年营收约人民币5.158亿元。

sources.title: Burning Rock Reports Unaudited Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Results

companies.name_zh: 深圳新产业生物医学工程
companies.description_en: SNIBE is China's leading maker of chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA) in-vitro diagnostic instruments and reagents, best known for its Maglumi analyzer line, with a large and growing overseas export business across emerging markets.
companies.description_zh: 新产业生物是中国领先的化学发光免疫分析（CLIA）体外诊断仪器与试剂厂商，以 Maglumi 系列分析仪闻名，并在新兴市场拥有快速增长的出口业务。

rnd_spend.note_en: FY2024 R&D expense

companies.description_en: Akili is the maker of EndeavorRx, the first FDA-cleared video-game digital therapeutic for pediatric ADHD. After a 2022 SPAC listing that valued it near $1B, it was taken private by Virtual Therapeutics in a $34M all-cash deal completed July 2024 and now operates as a wholly owned subsidiary.
companies.description_zh: Akili 是 EndeavorRx 的开发商，这是首个获 FDA 批准用于儿童多动症的电子游戏数字疗法。2022 年通过 SPAC 上市时估值近 10 亿美元，2024 年 7 月被 Virtual Therapeutics 以 3400 万美元全现金收购后私有化，现为其全资子公司。

sources.title: Virtual Therapeutics to Acquire Akili for $34M - MD+DI
Virtual Therapeutics Announces Results of Tender Offer to Acquire Akili - Nasdaq

companies.description_en: ArsenalBio, spun out of the Parker Institute for Cancer Immunotherapy in 2019, develops synthetic-biology logic-gated CAR-T cell therapies for solid tumors (lead AB-1015 in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer). It closed a $325M Series C in September 2024 (backers incl. ARCH, Regeneron Ventures, NVIDIA's NVentures, BMS, SoftBank Vision Fund 2), bringing total funding to roughly $700M.
companies.description_zh: ArsenalBio 于 2019 年从帕克癌症免疫治疗研究所剥离，开发用于实体瘤的合成生物学逻辑门控 CAR-T 细胞疗法（核心管线 AB-1015 针对铂耐药卵巢癌）。2024 年 9 月完成 3.25 亿美元 C 轮融资（投资方包括 ARCH、Regeneron Ventures、英伟达 NVentures、BMS、软银愿景基金二期），累计融资约 7 亿美元。

sources.title: ArsenalBio raises $325M for solid tumor CAR-T - Fierce Biotech

companies.description_en: Big Health develops fully-automated, FDA-cleared cognitive-behavioral-therapy digital therapeutics — Sleepio/SleepioRx for insomnia and Daylight/DaylightRx for anxiety. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund among others, it has raised over $150M across multiple rounds and distributes via employer and health-plan formularies.
companies.description_zh: Big Health 开发全自动、获 FDA 批准的认知行为疗法数字疗法——治疗失眠的 Sleepio/SleepioRx 和治疗焦虑的 Daylight/DaylightRx。投资方包括软银愿景基金等，累计融资逾 1.5 亿美元，通过雇主与医保处方目录分销。

sources.title: Big Health Secures Funding to Accelerate Adoption - Big Health
Big Health hauls in $75M - Fierce Healthcare

companies.description_en: Cartesian Therapeutics develops mRNA-engineered, non-viral autologous CAR-T cell therapies for autoimmune disease; lead candidate Descartes-08 (anti-BCMA, no preconditioning chemo) is in the Phase 3 AURORA trial for myasthenia gravis with additional programs in SLE and myositis.
